Listener Promises are not awaited and do not drive loading. beforeCommit uses payload/done/context, with value/previousValue in payload and signal/optional event in context; undefined waits for done. ### Complete standalone panel events Standalone panels have the seven events below, without the old preview event. Navigation uses picker-value-change and update:pickerValue. Navigation/shortcut hover-focus preview does not imply selection or commit. Confirmation only notifies when valid; select draft is separate from committed change. | Event | Prop | | --- | --- | | `update:modelValue` | `DateRangePickerEmits['update:modelValue']` | | `change` | `DateRangePickerEmits['change']` | | `select` | `DateRangePickerEmits['select']` | | `confirm` | `DateRangePickerEmits['confirm']` | | `update:pickerValue` | `DateRangePickerEmits['update:pickerValue']` | | `picker-value-change` | `DateRangePickerEmits['picker-value-change']` | | `select-shortcut` | `DateRangePickerEmits['select-shortcut']` | ### Complete slot and instance boundaries Field default replaces the trigger; prefix/selected/suffix replace content, and ranges also support separator. Preserve names, endpoint distinctions and keyboard access when replacing native controls. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?), respecting emptyValue and disabled/readonly guards. actions receives confirm/disabled/selectNow/nowDisabled, with both actions returning void. It has no Time-panel canConfirm/value arguments. disabled=true prevents confirmation. Standalone panels can replace the action region; the outer editing shell owns final saving in hosted editing, while the panel contributes auxiliary actions. Panel confirm is not the outer-save method. Now capabilities follow the actual panel: Cedar single panels support it, while Cedar range panels have no now action. Maple range panels stage now for the active endpoint, preserve the other endpoint and still require confirmation. The presence of selectNow in scope does not imply every mode supports the action. Cedar cell customizes a calendar cell with date and, for ranges, type=start/end; extra adds content. Maple Date/DatePicker page-calendar summaries support year({year}), month({year,month}), date({week,year,month,date}), range({choose}) and multiple({choose}) according to mode. Maple DateRange/DateRangePicker do not forward these single-panel summary slots, nor do scroll/line viewports promise them. loading-icon is not wired to date fields or pure panels and is not available merely because the underlying decorator supports it. Field focus(index?)/blur() delegate to real controls. Cedar/direct-field blur closes the field popup; Maple range persistent-reference blur only clears its focus, without pretending to close the outer Drawer. Pure panels expose no focus/blur methods. ### Presentation configuration and ranges datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps configure presentation without overriding owned model/rules/type/control events; Maple internal range datePickerProps uses a calendar allowlist. popupProps retains a broad dictionary, with public DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions recommended and owner keys still filtered at runtime. Cedar timePickerProps configures embedded time presentation; Maple pickerProps configures wheels. A range placeholder string applies to both endpoints; arrays configure each and missing entries are empty. readonly is separate from disabled; unset field state inherits Form. Cedar range-panel exchangeTime only handles reversed interactive candidates: true swaps their times, false retains endpoint times. It does not reorder external model/text/shortcut values. Maple does not expose this property. ### Public entry points and types ```ts import { DateRange, DateRangePicker, type DateRangeProps, type DateRangePickerProps, type DateRangeEmits, type DateRangePickerEmits, type DateValue, type DateSelection, type DateChangeArgs, type DateRules, type DateShortcut } from '@cedar-design/ui' ``` ## CSS Variables

--- title: DateRange 日期范围 description: "表单日期范围字段。通过 type 切换类型；面板请使用 DateRangePicker。" permalink: /components/date-range/ --- # DateRange 表单日期范围字段（带触发器）。内部使用 `DateRangePicker`。 纯面板请使用 [`DateRangePicker`](/components/date-range-picker/)（默认无触发器）。 字段通过 `date-picker-props`（Date）或 `date-range-picker-props`（DateRange）配置面板的该选项。 `abbreviation`（boolean，默认 `true`）控制日历月份网格的缩写；`false` 使用当前 Locale 的完整月份名。运行时修改立即生效，不改变值，也不触发选择事件。此开关不影响星期标签、标题、滚轮列或值格式。范围日历以顶层选项为准，嵌套日历参数不能覆盖。 ## 基础示例 ### 基本用法 ## 外观与日期展示 ### 外观配置对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- | | `clearable` | 可清除 | 选择类型、自定义分隔符与占位 | | `value-format` | 模型与事件的格式，可为自定义日期格式、Date 或 timestamp | 外观配置对比 | | `type` | 选择类型 | 选择类型 | | `separator` | 分隔符 | 自定义分隔符与占位 | | `placeholder` | 占位 | 自定义分隔符与占位 | 选择一个对比维度后，同屏展示它的全部可选值；其余配置和内容保持一致。可切换其他配置检查组合效果；输入类预览共享一个值。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 外观组合 适用于预订或查询的起止日期。调整变体、尺寸，用相同数据观察变化。内容保持一致，便于比较不同设置的实际效果。
### 选择类型 通过 `type` 切换日 / 周 / 月 / 年 / 季度范围。 ### 自定义分隔符与占位 ## 时间与范围规则 ### 带时间 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | | `format` | 展示格式 | 带时间、边界和端点禁用 | | `show-time` | 选择时间 | 带时间 | | `clearable` | 可清除 | 带时间 | | `value-format` | 模型与事件的格式，可为自定义日期格式、Date 或 timestamp | 边界和端点禁用 | | `disabled-date` | 禁用日期 | 边界和端点禁用 | ### 边界和端点禁用 桌面日历需要选齐起点和终点后才能确认；点击结束输入可先选终点、再选起点。Escape 关闭时丢弃未确认的范围。 ### 语言与嵌套日历参数 日期标签、标题和动作接入各库的全局 Locale 与既有 Provider。Cedar 删除日期组件级 `locale`，不保留覆盖字典或兼容别名。切换语言不会选择或提交日期。 ### 内嵌时间与滚轮展示 日期范围的内嵌时间选择也属于外层草稿：修改起点或终点时间不会提前写回，显式确认后才提交；取消保留原模型。日期时间手输的反序范围不会自动交换端点。 Embedded time edits update the outer range draft, not the committed model. Confirm explicitly to submit; cancel preserves the previous value. Reversed date-time text input is rejected rather than reordered. `time-picker-props` 使用 `DateTimePickerOptions`：`use12Hours`、`step`、`hideDisabledOptions`、`class`、`style`。仅配置时间展示；日期值、格式/秒精度、约束和确认仍由日期所有者管理。`step` 负责展示采样，不静默修正外部值。未知参数及监听函数不转发。 ### 真实端侧能力 Cedar 不公开 `Date.pickerProps`、`DateRange.pickerProps` 或 `DateRange.datePickerProps`：PC 字段不渲染移动滚轮或范围内部的移动日历插件，原无效参数已删除且无兼容别名。Maple 保留这些真实扩展，使用 DateWheelOptions 与 DateRangeCalendarOptions。两端通过 `Date.datePickerProps` / `DateRange.dateRangePickerProps` 配置完整面板，`timePickerProps` 配置内嵌时间展示。初始日期时间放在顶层 `defaultValue`，不要放在 `timePickerProps.defaultValue` 中。 ### 日期语言的实例隔离 日期组件使用当前库的 Locale/Provider 配置，周起始日由各实例的 `day-start-of-week` 控制，不会修改应用中 Dayjs 的默认语言或基础语言配置。 `value-format` 是稳定英文日期协议（包括月份名称 token），`format` 的显示及手输文本使用界面语言。切换语言不会改写模型，也不会令英文月份名称模型失效。默认数字协议、Date 对象、时间戳不变。中文核心语言与 Maple 内置语言数据已接入；其他日期格式优先使用已注册 Dayjs 语言数据，未加载的语言安全回退英文。 周号和周比较不再依赖全局周起始设置，跨年同周号不能被误判成同一周。两个不同周起始实例的挂载、更新和卸载互不影响。 ### 周与季度手输 默认周展示 `gggg-wo` 按当前界面语言与实例周起始解析为该周的第一天，模型仍为 `YYYY-MM-DD`。中文周一起始的 `2020-53周` 提交 `2020-12-28`；不存在的周、错误序数后缀不提交。默认季度 `YYYY-[Q]Q`（如 `2025-Q2`）严格解析为首月，模型 `YYYY-MM`（`2025-04`）。手输继续遵守禁用、边界和范围顺序，不自动交换端点。 自定义周/季度展示可以使用 Dayjs 支持的普通日期 token；任意自定义周序数格式没有逆解析协议。`format` 为函数时请设置 `input-editable=false`，通过面板选择。 `input-editable` 默认 true；当 `format` 为函数时无法反向解析，输入保持只读。Maple 多选模式通过面板选择，不支持手动编辑拼接文本。 ## 值模型与输入 ### 字符串模型：年月日、年月与月日范围 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | | `format` | 展示格式 | 字符串模型：年月日、年月与月日范围、手输与面板选择 | | `value-format` | 模型与事件的格式，可为自定义日期格式、Date 或 timestamp | 字符串模型：年月日、年月与月日范围 | | `disabled` | 禁用 | 手输与面板选择 | `format` 决定显示，`value-format` 决定提交值。下面直接得到 `"2026-09-10"`、`"2026-09"` 或 `["09-10", "10-10"]`，无需将 Date 再转换。日期范围使用数组。`MM-DD` 没有年份，解析时使用当前年，不能表示跨年先后或某个明确年份的 2 月 29 日；有跨年、时区或闰年要求时保留 `YYYY-MM-DD`，在业务提交时单独映射月日。默认仍是 page，未指定 timeZone 使用浏览器本地时区。 ### 手输与面板选择 ## 交互与字段配置 ### 交互状态对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | | `open` | 弹层显隐 | 受控关闭被拒绝、透传配置边界与优先级 | | `date-range-picker-props` | 面板展示选项 | 字段视口与快捷项事件、字段与面板边界 | | `value-format` | 模型与事件的格式，可为自定义日期格式、Date 或 timestamp | 交互状态对比 | | `readonly` | 只读 | 交互状态对比 | | `format` | 展示格式 | 字段视口与快捷项事件 | | `popup-props` | Trigger 展示配置；不允许覆盖展开状态及规则 | 透传配置边界与优先级 | 在同一实例上切换禁用、只读和错误状态后再操作控件，比较可编辑性和交互反馈。恢复开关位于目标控件外；错误外观本身不会执行校验。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 交互状态切换 适用于预订或查询的起止日期。调整只读、错误反馈，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。
### 受控关闭被拒绝 父级拒绝关闭时，范围面板会保留展开；同一选择的重复确认不会再次提交或请求关闭，修改起止日期后则可以开启新的确认事务。 ### 字段视口与快捷项事件 字段通过嵌套 `date-range-picker-props` 配置 `pickerValue`、`defaultPickerValue` 和快捷项，不新增第二套顶层视口 Prop。嵌套配置里的监听器不会透传；在字段组件上监听以下事件并回写嵌套 `pickerValue`。 | 事件 | 说明 | 参数 | | --------------------- | -------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | | `update:picker-value` | 请求日历视口更新，不改变选择模型 | value: DateSelection | | `picker-value-change` | 已请求的视口及展示通知 | value, date(s), formatted text(s) | | `select-shortcut` | 接受的快捷项，仍遵守字段确认策略 | shortcut: DateShortcut | 受控视口拒绝更新时保持原月份，后续回写才更新；快捷项选择先进入字段草稿，默认确认后提交。滚轮/时钟没有日历月份导航能力。 ### 展示模式的所有权 Cedar 只实现桌面日历，不公开移动 `edit-mode`。Maple 在字段/纯面板根选择真实展示模式；字段嵌套 `DatePickerOptions` / `DateRangePickerOptions` 不包含 presentation，两库复制的过滤器均拒绝嵌套选择器，不通过隐式覆盖保留无效 API。 ### 周起始日的响应式展示 `dayStartOfWeek` 更新时，日历表头与日期列位置同步更新，不改变选中值或提交草稿。纯面板使用根属性，字段通过 `datePickerProps` / `dateRangePickerProps` 配置；滚轮视图不使用星期列。 ### 动态日期限制 更新或移除 `min` / `max` 会重新计算可选日期，不自动修改已有模型或草稿。面板导航与候选日期校验是不同职责，已有值超出新限制时也不会被静默重写；用户重新选择或确认时按当前限制校验。 ### Form 字段展示与确认 本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `direct`，保留原有交互。支持值：`direct / click / dblclick`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。 Cedar 使用 edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" 在字段附近打开编辑浮层，Enter/F2 也可进入；取消/Escape 丢弃草稿，确认后提交。readPretty 为独立阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 分开。 `before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。 日期／时间字段在 inline 下沿用原确认策略；在 click/dblclick 编辑展示中，内部纯面板隐藏确认工具栏，由编辑层提供唯一一组确认／取消。独立 DatePicker、DateRangePicker、TimePicker、TimeRangePicker 保留原有面板 API 和确认行为，不继承 Form 的字段展示。 ### 范围日历的视口与选择 默认双日历从起始日期所在月开始显示连续两个月；两侧外部箭头联动翻月，跨年连续。月份／年份标题选择同步调整相邻面板，视口导航只发 picker-value 事件，不修改选中范围。显式 picker-value / default-picker-value 可以指定独立视口；同月或逆序视口只在显示层纠正，不回写受控值。 已有范围时重新点选第一个日期会进入未完成草稿，确认暂时禁用；第二个端点合法后才可确认。反向点选按日期排序，取消恢复先前已提交值。禁用端点和日期／时间限制仍在选择及确认时校验。 独立 DatePicker / DateRangePicker 与 inline 共用日历基准宽度（每个 265px）。单日期带时间时，宽屏下日历与时间列左右排列；范围在宽屏保留两个并排日历。面板会按窄容器换行，侧边快捷项另占一列，不压缩日历；确认与 actions 插槽保持由面板自身管理。 `read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。 ### 字段与面板边界 字段保留输入和浮层状态；嵌套面板参数只接受展示选项，不能覆盖顶层模型、格式或校验规则。 ### 日期值格式 年/月/日模型格式为 `YYYY` / `YYYY-MM` / `YYYY-MM-DD`，日期时间默认含秒；`format="YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm"` 与 `value-format="YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm"` 使用分钟字符串。`format` 控制显示，`value-format` 控制模型和事件，支持自定义格式、`Date` 与 `timestamp`。Cedar 提供周/季度面板；Maple 提供移动端滚轮和时钟展示。 起止输入使用同一字段焦点：Tab 在两端间切换时保留草稿，不触发 blur 校验或提交；Enter 或离开整个字段才提交，Escape 丢弃草稿。点击结束输入会让范围面板从结束端开始选择。 字段使用 PickerField → FieldDecorator；面板只负责选择，不注入表单。有效文本在回车或失焦时提交，Escape 或外部关闭丢弃未确认草稿，清除立即提交空值。四类字段的统一示例见 [Date](/components/date/#统一字段与提交)。 ### 透传配置边界与优先级 建议使用 `DateRangePopupOptions` 声明 popup-props，边界与 DatePopupOptions 一致。仅用于 inline 锚定弹层；范围值、规则、open/defaultOpen、禁用及通知归 DateRange 管理。popup-container 顶层优先、嵌套回退，popupClass 合并内部类；trigger、closeOnClickReference、preventFocus、popupOffset 由展示层固定，Maple 还固定 unmountOnClose=true。新类型不开放这些固定项，附加平移使用 popupTranslate。已有运行时字段/监听过滤和旧配置可用能力保持。 本次仅新增可主动选用的专用类型，不收窄已发布的宽属性类型，不增加运行时过滤、不改变覆盖顺序；旧业务写法继续可编译。若直接使用旧宽属性，内部托管字段仍可能通过类型检查，但不代表能控制内部状态。 ```ts import type { DateRangePopupOptions } from "@cedar-design/ui"; ``` ### 复制与编辑 open-trigger-target="icon" 时，输入区可以编辑或复制，只有右侧选择按钮响应点击打开。关闭手输或搜索后，已有文本仍可复制。 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ## 阅读方向 范围值始终保持 `[开始, 结束]`，切换阅读方向不会交换端点或提交草稿。日历范围连接线与边界圆角跟随阅读方向；分页网格的左右键按视觉方向移动焦点，上下键保持日期行序。Maple 的端点编辑和连续范围高亮是不同展示路径。显式 `shortcuts-position="left|right"` 保持物理侧；弹层继承字段来源方向。 ## API ### 空值识别与阅读空文案 `empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](/guide/empty-values/)。 | 参数 | 类型 | 缺省与范围 | | ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- | | empty-values | readonly unknown[] | null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。 ### 延迟编辑中的清空 延迟编辑时，清空只改变草稿；确认后先执行表单校验和 `beforeCommit`，通过才发布配置的 `emptyValue`，取消恢复已提交范围。初始空范围和只选一个端点的范围仍需补全端点；从非空范围主动清空得到的空草稿可以确认。禁用、只读以及任一端点锁定时不能整体清空；受控打开未被接受时也不会直接清空模型。 公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。 原生范围输入入口将字符串 placeholder（包括空字符串）应用到两端，数组则按端点保留文案；是否在输入框显示仍遵循 hint。只读原生输入保持可聚焦和复制，但不允许修改、展开或清空。disabled 的全局或单端禁用优先于只读；不改变各编辑模式省略 placeholder 时已有的默认文案。 原生日期范围引用区的 focus/blur 均无参数：首次进入输入组通知 focus，组内两端切换不重复，离开输入组通知 blur，并由 Form 按既有规则处理一次对应通知。只读 click 仍通知原始事件，但不展开或修改；disabled 点击不通知，也不提前消耗 click.once。普通事件监听器返回 Promise 不会产生 busy 或阻止展开，异步提交仍使用显式 before-commit。 ### 日期合同与值类型 DateValue 为 string、number 或原生 Date。数值按时间戳处理，0 不按空值处理；modelValue=null 是显式空值。范围使用宽数组并允许不完整端点，不把现有协议强制改成二元组；提交仍校验完整性与合法性。Maple 通用 DatePicker/Date 的多选能力不扩展到 Cedar 单值 Props。 属性表列出实际公开集合；继承及按精度说明表示有效缺省，原始 Props 可为 undefined。format 控制显示与手输，valueFormat 控制模型协议。week/quarter 的显示标签与模型格式不同；函数 format 无反向解析，不能据此开启手输。 min/max 包含端点；非法的已提供边界阻止确认，不静默当作未设置。动态收紧规则不清空已有业务模型。disabledDate/disabledTime 是明确校验回调，不是异步事件任务，时间禁用回调返回 DateDisabledTime 的禁用列表。 ### 字段事件（完整） | 事件 | 参数 | | --- | --- | | `update:modelValue` | 范围面板对当前端暂存此刻，另一端保留并仍需确认。不要只因 scope 中存在 selectNow 就假定所有模式都支持此刻。 Cedar cell 定制日历格，参数含 date，范围另含 type=start/end；extra 是附加内容。Maple Date/DatePicker 在 page 日历摘要中支持 datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps 只配置展示，不能覆盖根模型、规则、类型或控制事件；Maple 范围内部 datePickerProps 另用日历白名单。popupProps 保留宽字典入口，推荐公开 DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions，运行时仍过滤所有者字段。Cedar timePickerProps ### Service popup containers

Function calls honor `popupContainer` from explicit configuration or `setDefaultOptions`, using the component's selector/HTMLElement resolution and missing/invalid-selector fallback to body. The default targets body; `false` renders inline in the service's own body host. `handle.update({ popupContainer })` moves the same dialog and preserves content state and app context. Closing removes teleported content and its service host, independently of notification callback results. A custom container controls DOM attachment; layout still follows Dialog positioning and its containing block.

### Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"` and supports runtime and nested overrides. Content, headings and action gaps use logical edges. Portals inherit their source direction. Direction changes preserve close, confirm, cancel and pending-state semantics.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, titles and action spacing use logical start/end. External popovers inherit their source direction. Closing, confirmation, cancellation and uncommitted state are unchanged by direction switches.

The `close` button, overlay, ESC and `close()` use `close` semantics without an additional `cancel` event.

Built-in buttons, overlay, Escape, footer methods and instance confirm()/cancel() request beforeClose. Instance close(), returned handle close(), Dialog.close() and parent open=false are direct commands that bypass guards; a controlled parent still decides whether to accept update:open(false). Direct closing retires pending guards so late results cannot close a reopened instance. close does not mean leave completion; observe closed/onClosed. Maple Popup close()/requestClose() instead return `Promise<boolean>` for guarded requests.

## CSS Variables

Dialog public color variables have the same meanings as Maple: `--c-dialog-background` is the raised panel background (`surface-raised`); `--c-dialog-overlay-background` is the scrim; `--c-dialog-title-text-color` and `--c-dialog-content-text-color` are primary content; `--c-dialog-close-button-color` is the secondary action. `--c-dialog-status-{info|success|warning|danger}-color` uses readable content-info/success/warning/danger, not status fills. Business themes should override these component variables; shared themes should override the corresponding system variables. Borders, widths, spacing and layout retain desktop specifications.

The backdrop consumes `sys-color-scrim` through the Dialog component variable. Maple no longer uses Popup colors for Dialog. Set a per-instance backdrop variable via `overlay-style`; a variable on the panel (`dialog-style`) does not inherit to its sibling backdrop. Explicit `overlay-style.backgroundColor` wins. Teleported content needs variables on its actual DOM ancestors. Dark themes inherit the same semantic colors; geometry remains platform-specific. Status icons use readable content colors.

Variables are grouped by purpose: background/overlay-background for panel/scrim; border-* for panel/divider borders; title-* for title typography; content-* for body typography; actions-* for actions; close-button-* for the close button; status-* for semantic icons; simple-*/fullscreen-* for mode dimensions; animation-* for enter/leave motion. width/margin-top control ordinary panel layout. Internal drag/position variables are not public customization points.

<!-- generated variable reference omitted from archive -->

### Guard waiting feedback
Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.

### Drag lifecycle
Title dragging is controlled only by the initiating primary pointer. Disabling `draggable`, closing, entering fullscreen, losing pointer capture or owner-window focus, deactivation and unmount all end the gesture and release listeners and capture. Reenabling requires a new gesture; the previous pointer cannot resume it. Disabling preserves the current offset; fullscreen and the existing post-close reset restore defaults. Listeners belong to the title element's document.

## 异步与关闭控制

### 异步关闭

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `before-close` | 返回 boolean/Promise 或调用 done；首次完成生效 | 异步关闭、before 钩子与 done 兼容 |

### before 钩子与 done 兼容

`beforeClose({ action }, done, context)` 为统一入口，不新增另一套命名。


只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。


<demo src="./__demos__/guard-protocol.vue"></demo>


Promise 与 done 共用一次完成状态：`false` / `done(false)` 阻止，`true` / `done()` 允许；Promise<void> 正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。内容、标题与动作间距使用逻辑起止位置；外部弹层继承来源方向。关闭、确认、取消和未提交状态不因方向切换改变。

## CSS Variables

Dialog 的公开颜色变量与 Maple 同义：`--c-dialog-background` 表示浮层背景（`surface-raised`），`--c-dialog-overlay-background` 表示遮罩，`--c-dialog-title-text-color` 和 `--c-dialog-content-text-color` 表示主要内容，`--c-dialog-close-button-color` 表示次要操作；`--c-dialog-status-{info|success|warning|danger}-color` 对应可读状态内容色（content-info/success/warning/danger），不是状态填充色。业务主题优先覆盖这些组件变量，跨组件主题则覆盖相应的 system 变量。边框、宽度、间距和布局仍遵循桌面端规格。

遮罩通过 Dialog 组件变量消费 `sys-color-scrim`；Maple 不再借用 Popup 的遮罩颜色。实例遮罩变量可放在 `overlay-style` 上；放在面板 `dialog-style` 上的变量不会继承给兄弟遮罩节点。显式 `overlay-style.backgroundColor` 优先。Teleport 场景需要在实际 DOM 祖先作用域设置变量。暗色主题继承同一套颜色语义；几何保留平台差异。状态图标改用可读的 content 状态色。

变量按用途分组：background／overlay-background 是面板与遮罩；border-* 是面板或分隔线边框；title-* 是标题排版；content-* 是正文排版；actions-* 是操作区；close-button-* 是关闭按钮；status-* 是语义图标；simple-*／fullscreen-* 是对应模式的尺寸；animation-* 是入退场动效。width／margin-top 控制常规面板布局。内部拖动与定位变量不构成公开定制入口。

<!-- generated variable reference omitted from archive -->

### 守卫等待反馈
before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

函数调用的通知回调不控制任务完成。服务的选择或关闭结果独立于回调异常结算，关闭完成时仍会清理所属宿主。异常继续通过调用方或 Vue 错误通道传递；回调返回 Promise 不控制 loading 或关闭。

### 拖动生命周期
标题拖动只由发起手势的主指针控制。停用 `draggable`、关闭、进入全屏、丢失指针捕获或所属窗口失焦、停用以及卸载都会结束当前手势并释放监听和捕获。重新启用后需发起新手势，不会接续旧指针；停用保留当前偏移，全屏和原有关闭结束后的重置恢复默认位置。监听归属标题元素所在文档。

# Divider

Separate content sections in lists and layouts.

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`. Horizontal text start/end follows reading order; vertical start/end remains top/bottom. Inset controls along-line indentation and spacing controls perpendicular margins. Paired horizontal inset and vertical spacing uses logical start/end. Vertical borders use inline start; hairline, border type and aria-orientation retain their meaning. Direction changes preserve content nodes.

## Content and layout

### Content height and minimum thickness

Explicit thickness accepts finite numbers greater than or equal to 1. hairline still takes priority, using half the theme width. Values below 1 (including zero and negative values), and non-finite values, are ignored and use the theme width; development builds warn.

Multiline descriptions and custom content occupy their full height, including spacing=0. Subsequent content stays below the divider.

## API

### Divider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical orientation of the divider itself, default horizontal; does not control text alignment | `horizontal` \| `vertical` | `horizontal` |
| `type` | Line style | `solid` \| `dashed` \| `dotted` \| `double` | `solid` |
| `text-align` | Text position along the line; start/end follow logical direction | `start` \| `center` \| `end` | `center` |
| `description` | Description text; the default slot takes priority | `string` | — |
| `inset` | Inset along the line: left/right horizontally, top/bottom vertically | `DividerSize` | — |
| `spacing` | Outer spacing across the line: top/bottom horizontally, left/right vertically | `DividerSize` | `md` |
| `thickness` | Finite line width of at least 1px; omission uses the 1px theme default; hairline takes precedence | `number` | — |
| `hairline` | Scale the theme line width by half; 0.5px with the default theme | `boolean` | `false` |
| `color` | Line color; defaults to the theme border color | `string` | — |
| `opacity` | Opacity of the entire divider, including text, from 0 to 1; zero preserves layout | `number` | — |

### Spacing values

`DividerSize = number | string | [number | string] | [number | string, number | string]`

`inset` controls the ends of the line; `spacing` controls the outer gap between the line and adjacent content. Both accept presets `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, a number in px, a CSS length, or an array. A scalar or single-item array applies to both ends; `[start, end]` sets each end separately. Array entries are lengths, not preset names.

| Direction | inset array order | spacing array order |
| --- | --- | --- |
| horizontal | Inline start/end inset; right/left in RTL | Top/bottom margin |
| vertical | Top/bottom inset | Inline start/end margin; right/left in RTL |

`inset` has no `inset` by default; `spacing` defaults to the platform’s `md` `spacing`. Presets use platform theme tokens, so pixel values may differ.


Development checks cover orientation, text-align, type, spacing shape, thickness and opacity. Invalid enums use defaults; invalid inset produces no indentation, invalid spacing falls back to md, and invalid opacity does not override styles. opacity must be finite and within 0–1. Arrays accept one or two lengths and no preset names. Finite negative margins and CSS var/calc expressions remain supported; browsers parse their CSS syntax.

# Drawer

A side panel with declarative and programmatic APIs and cancellable before-close operations.

The default header associates its `title` slot with the dialog through a stable, unique title id. Text and render-function service titles follow the same rule; simultaneous service roots do not reuse title ids. An explicit `ariaLabel` takes precedence, and a plain `title` prop can still name the dialog. Hidden or fully custom headers do not reference unrendered titles; provide `ariaLabel` explicitly.

`DrawerConfig` supports the same `dir`, `ariaLabel`, `closeButtonAriaLabel` and `overlayAnimationName` as the component. Guard errors notify `onGuardError(error, action)`. Retired `beforeConfirm` / `beforeCancel` have been replaced by `beforeClose`; changing a guard does not reopen a closed drawer.

Promise and done share a single completion state: false/done(false) rejects; true/done() allows; a resolved Promise<void> allows. The first completion wins. Errors emit guard-error; cancellation/unmount invalidates late completion. Synchronous void retains the callback protocol and waits for done on these close/confirm guards.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Drawer placement left/right remain physical sides, so entrance/exit follows the corresponding screen edge. Header, content and footer inherit reading direction. Direction changes do not commit or clear content.

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |

### Drawer Slots

`default`, `header`, `title`, `footer`. The `footer` slot receives `confirm`, `cancel` and `close` methods.

Footer confirm/cancel/close, built-in controls, overlay and Escape are beforeClose requests; instance confirm()/cancel() are guarded too. Instance close(), Drawer.open() handle close() and parent open=false are direct commands for completion or explicit exit, bypassing the guard without extra confirm/cancel. Controlled close() still only requests update:open(false); a rejecting parent remains authoritative. Direct closing aborts pending guards and invalidates late results. close() returns void and does not await leave; use closed/onClosed for completion.

Both Dialog implementations share this policy. Maple Popup close()/requestClose() and external model closing are awaitable guard requests returning `Promise<boolean>`; they are not Drawer direct-close commands. Popup destruction remains parent-owned. The demo Close directly action keeps an exit without changing Allow closing or pretending the guard approved.

### Imperative calls

`Drawer.open(config)` uses camelCase options such as `cancelButtonText`, `beforeClose` and `closeOnRouteChange`. Notifications use `onConfirm`, `onCancel`, `onOpen`, `onOpened`, `onClose`, `onClosed`, `onClickOverlay` and `onKeyEscape`.

```ts
import type { DrawerAction, DrawerConfig, DrawerProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## CSS Variables

Built-in fade and four-direction slide disable transitions and initial displacement under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Adapt custom animations to the reduced-motion preference in your application.

Panel bg uses surface-raised; overlay-bg uses sys-color-scrim; header-text-color/content-text-color use content-primary, with the close button inheriting header-text-color; border-color uses border-default. Drawer keeps its existing geometry, motion and stacking defaults. Drawer is a Cedar component; Maple does not define empty same-name variables.

overlay-style sets instance scrim variables; drawer-style sets panel variables. These sibling nodes do not inherit variables from one another. Set global system theme variables on a real common ancestor. Explicit background props take precedence over variable consumption. The unused close-icon-right variable is removed; title layout and close-btn-margin-left position the close button, without an ineffective compatibility alias.

### Guard waiting feedback
Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

# Drawer

从容器一侧进入的桌面抽屉。Drawer 与 Maple Popup 共用同一套模态表面控制逻辑；标题、页脚、操作按钮和宽高仍是 Drawer 的桌面端能力。

## 关闭与异步控制

### before 钩子与 done 兼容

`beforeClose({ action }, done, context)` 为统一入口，不新增另一套命名。


只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。


<demo src="./__demos__/guard-protocol.vue"></demo>


Promise 与 done 共用一次完成状态：`false` / `done(false)` 阻止，`true` / `done()` 允许；Promise<void> 正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。抽屉 placement 的 left/right 保持物理侧，进入/退出仍从对应屏幕边缘运动；标题、内容和底部动作继承阅读方向。方向切换不提交或清空内容。

| header / footer / cancel-button | 是否显示对应区域 | `boolean` | `true` |


### Drawer Events

| 事件 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:open | 可见状态请求 | `boolean` |
| confirm / cancel | 点击对应操作按钮并获准关闭 | `Event` |
| open / close | 开始打开 / 开始关闭 | - |
| opened / closed | 打开 / 关闭动画结束 | - |
| click-overlay | 点击当前最上层遮罩 | `MouseEvent` |
| key-escape | 当前最上层抽屉收到 ESC | `KeyboardEvent` |
| guard-error | beforeClose 抛错或拒绝时通知；保持打开并结束等待 | `(error: unknown, action: DrawerAction)` |

### Drawer Slots

`default`、`header`、`title`、`footer`。`footer` 获得 `confirm`、`cancel`、`close` 三个方法。

footer 的 confirm、cancel、close 和内置按钮、遮罩、Esc 都是守卫请求，走 beforeClose；实例 confirm()/cancel() 也走守卫。实例 close()、Drawer.open() 返回句柄的 close()、父级直接设置 open=false 是不经过守卫的关闭命令，用于业务完成或主动退出，不额外发 confirm/cancel。受控实例的 close() 仍只请求 update:open(false)，父级拒绝时不会强改模型。直接关闭会终止当前守卫并使迟到结果失效；close() 返回 void，不等待离场，完成请监听 closed/onClosed。

这一职责与两端 Dialog 一致。Maple Popup 的 close()/requestClose() 和外部模型关闭属于可等待的守卫请求，返回 `Promise<boolean>`；不要将它们当作 Drawer 的直接关闭命令。Popup 的直接销毁仍由父级掌握。示例的“直接关闭”保留退出入口，不修改“允许关闭”选择，也不会伪装成守卫批准。

### 命令式调用

`Drawer.open(config)` 使用 camelCase 的同名配置，例如 `cancelButtonText`、`beforeClose`、`closeOnRouteChange`。通知事件使用 `onConfirm`、`onCancel`、`onOpen`、`onOpened`、`onClose`、`onClosed`、`onClickOverlay` 和 `onKeyEscape`。

```ts
import type { DrawerAction, DrawerConfig, DrawerProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## CSS Variables

内置淡入和四方向滑动在 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 下关闭过渡及起始位移。自定义动画需由业务适配减少动态效果的偏好。

面板 bg 使用 surface-raised；overlay-bg 使用 sys-color-scrim；header-text-color／content-text-color 使用 content-primary，关闭按钮与标题共享 header-text-color；border-color 使用 border-default。几何、动效与层级保留 Drawer 既有默认值。Drawer 是 Cedar 平台组件，不在 Maple 创建空壳同名变量。

overlay-style 可设置实例遮罩变量，drawer-style 可设置面板内变量；两者是兄弟节点，变量不会互相继承。全局主题在实际共同祖先设置 system 变量。显式背景属性优先于变量消费。已移除从未被消费的 close-icon-right 变量；关闭按钮位置由标题布局和 close-btn-margin-left 控制，不提供无效兼容别名。

### 守卫等待反馈
before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

## API

### Ellipsis Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expand` | Controlled expansion | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `default-expand` | Initial uncontrolled expansion | `boolean` | `false` |
| `expand-trigger` | Enable click / Enter / Space toggling | `'click'` | `—` |
| `line-clamp` | Positive line count; omitted or invalid means single line | `number \| string` | `—` |
| `tooltip` | Tooltip configuration; false disables it | `boolean \| TooltipProps` | `true` |

Providing `expand` makes the component request updates from its parent rather than changing controlled state. When omitted, internal state is used, initialized once by `default-expand`. Tooltip follows its own width and trigger defaults; display does not depend on measured overflow. Touch callers can include `click` in `tooltip.trigger` explicitly. External class/style/width apply directly to the text node.

### Ellipsis Events / Slots

- `update:expand(expand: boolean)`: the new state requested by user interaction; external updates do not emit it.
- `default`: body text.
- `tooltip-content`: tooltip content. Without it, tooltip.content takes precedence, then body text; content is not concatenated twice.
- Keyboard: expandable text supports Enter / Space; tooltip-enabled text is focusable with Tab. No public instance methods.


### Public entries and listener types

The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.

```ts
import Ellipsis, { Ellipsis as NamedEllipsis } from '@cedar-design/ui/ellipsis'
import { Ellipsis as RootEllipsis } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import type { EllipsisProps, EllipsisInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'

const options: EllipsisProps = { 'onUpdate:expand': (expanded: boolean) => String(expanded) }
```


### Rows and content boundaries

expand-trigger supports only click. Invalid values produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and do not enable button semantics, click or keyboard expansion. line-clamp accepts finite numbers or numeric strings of at least one row and floors decimals. Values below one, nonfinite values and invalid strings warn and fall back to ordinary single-line mode, clearing old multiline styles. Prefer plain text or inline content without independent interactions. The default Tooltip still does not detect actual overflow and remains focusable with Tab when enabled. Custom tooltip content and controlled expansion remain unchanged.

--- permalink: /components/field-decorator/ --- # FieldDecorator 字段装饰器 FieldDecorator 是 Input、Textarea、Select 与日期时间控件的展示外壳，负责边框、尺寸、浮动提示、前后缀和清除按钮；不管理输入值、表单校验或弹层开合。 - 三种变体：`outline`（默认）、`filled`、`standard`。消费者可以显式选择自己的默认变体。 - 五种尺寸：`xs / sm / md / lg / xl`，默认 `md`；具体高度使用各端 token。 - `hint` 在两端默认均为 `true`；Input 在 FormItem 已有外部标签时关闭浮动提示。 - 有内容且可编辑时才渲染清除按钮；`0` 算非空，`[]` 算空。Cedar 在 hover/focus 时显示，Maple 常驻；触屏媒体条件下 Cedar 也常驻。 - 默认按钮通过各端全局语言系统读取无障碍文案，不维护组件私有词典。 - 内容列尺寸使用 ResizeObserver 观察，支持前缀变化及隐藏容器重新显示；卸载时清理监听。 输入控件聚焦时不额外绘制外圈 outline，沿用各变体已有的边框、底线或背景聚焦反馈；适用于 Input、Textarea、Date 和 Time 等消费者。 输入框、文本域和数字输入框的光标使用 `currentColor`，与当前输入文字颜色一致；错误态不单独覆盖光标颜色。 `--c-field-caret-color` 默认 `currentColor`，统一控制 Input、InputNumber 与 Textarea 的光标颜色；不改变文字色。 ## 基础示例 ### 表单控件尺寸对照 切换五档 size 和三种字段变体，比较 Input、Button、Select、日期时间及其他单行表单控件的高度。Button 在这里固定使用 outline。DatePicker/TimePicker 是面板，此处使用带输入框的 Date/Time 字段。示例同时展示有值、可清空、标签删除与长标签多选；Select/Cascader 设置 tag-nowrap 时保持同档高度，长标签文字省略、删除图标保留；标签行可横向滚动，清空按钮和箭头固定在外侧。被省略的标签正文支持悬停、键盘聚焦或点按查看完整文字，点外部或按 Esc 关闭，不改变选中值。可清空后恢复选中值重复比较。多行文本和允许换行的多选内容按内容撑高。 ## 加载与等待 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ## API ### FieldDecorator Props 浮动提示为描边预留缺口，缺口与内容列对齐，左右间距通过 `hint-space` 调整。 | 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 / 含义 | | --- | --- | --- | | `loading` | `boolean` | `false`，显示加载状态，不改变禁用或只读 | | `loading-mode` | `'default' \| 'line'` | `default`；指示器或底部进度线 | | `tag` | `'div' \| 'span'` | `div`，外壳标签 | | `value` | `unknown` | 仅判断内容是否为空 | | `id` | `string` | 浮动标签关联的原生控件 id | | `title` | `string` | 原生标题提示 | | `size` | `ComponentSize`

An asynchronous rule must return a Promise; normal completion without an error callback means success. A delayed callback without a returned Promise is not awaited. Returning false or an error string does not replace callback. Unexpected throws or Promise rejection reject public validate. Handle them with try/catch. The current task releases validating and restores the previous business error without synthesizing a new validation failure. A stale exception cannot clear a newer pending task. ```ts import type { FieldRule } from '@cedar-design/ui' const nameRule: FieldRule = { validator: async (value, callback, context) => { await Promise.resolve() if (!value) callback(`${context?.field} is required`) }, } ``` ### Public validation and notification contract Form and FormItem default slots have no scoped arguments. Its errors.editing contains only field="editing" and message, without fabricated field-validation data. FormSubmitError distinguishes this notice from a full ValidatedError. These events notify only: listener Promises are not awaited and do not execute requests or control loading. Business code manages asynchronous-save loading. Form resetFields writes to model; an inner Form inside FilterForm has its own scope. `beforeCommit` belongs to fields supporting editing transactions. Its signature is `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise`. The payload contains value and previousValue; context contains signal and an optional event. Returning undefined waits for done; a boolean or Promise settles by its result. It is not a Form submit event or general loading entry point. ```ts import type { FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance, ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData, FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError, BeforeFieldCommit, } from '@cedar-design/ui' ``` Custom form controls can call `useFormErrorDescription()` in `setup` and bind `describe(existingIds)` to the interactive element's `aria-describedby`. --- permalink: /components/form/ --- # Form 具有数据收集、校验和提交功能的表单，包含复选框、单选框、输入框、下拉选择框等元素。 标签一律由 `FormItem` 的 `label`（或 label 插槽）负责渲染；控件本身只提供 `placeholder` 等占位文案，不承担字段标签。 ## 阅读方向 Form 与 FormItem 的 content-align 支持 start、end、left、center、right，label-align 支持 start、end、left、right；默认内容 start、标签 end。默认 LTR 位置保持不变，RTL 按阅读方向排列；显式 left/right 均为物理对齐。字段覆盖优先于 Form，逐实例标签列样式保持最高优先级。切换方向不重置业务值、校验结果或只读/禁用状态。 组件导出以下类型定义 ```ts import type { FormProps } from "@cedar-design/ui"; ``` ## 基础示例 ### 基础用法 ## 表单外观与布局 ### 全局禁用 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | | `layout` | 表单的布局方式，包括水平、垂直、多列 | 表单布局、标签与内容装饰、标签宽度方案对比 | | `model` | 表单数据对象 | 标签与内容装饰、标签宽度方案对比 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用表单 | 全局禁用 | | `label-align` | 标签的对齐方向 | 标签宽度方案对比 | | `auto-label-width` | 是否开启自动标签宽度，仅在 `layout="horizontal"` 下生效。 | 标签宽度方案对比 | | `label-col-flex` | 标签列 flex；数字为伸缩比例，带单位字符串为宽度 | 标签宽度方案对比 | 通过 disabled 属性可以禁用整个表单。 ### 表单布局 `edit-mode` 表示编辑模式：`direct` 始终显示控件；`click` / `dblclick` 保留当前在字段附近展开编辑浮层的行为。`readPretty` 是独立布尔属性。FormItem 和字段未设置时继承上层。字段旧 `presentation` 属性已移除，使用 `edit-mode` 配置编辑模式。`presentation="inline"` 迁移为 `edit-mode="direct"`，`layout="inline"` 不变。 表单支持三种布局方式： horizontal - 水平排列（默认，标签在左、控件在右）， vertical - 垂直排列（标签在上、控件在下）， inline - 行内排列。 组合切换 `layout`、`content-align` 与 `direct / click / dblclick` 编辑方式及独立的 `readPretty` 阅读开关，观察标签、字段值和长文字换行的对齐效果。备注项可单独覆盖布局，已有输入数据在切换时保留。`click` 单击进入弹层，`dblclick` 双击进入弹层，`readPretty` 只展示已保存的文字。 ### 标签与内容装饰 ### 额外信息和帮助信息 可以使用 extra 添加额外信息。 如果需要在外部自定义校验信息，可以使用`help`属性或插槽。error 状态下校验信息优先；无错误展示时显示 help。 ### 标签宽度方案对比 先输入数据，再切换自动测量、响应式栅格和固定宽度，三种方案使用同一份表单数据。修改最长标签或隐藏联系方式，观察自动测量更新。响应式方案在 576px 以下上下排列；固定宽度默认 6rem，联系方式单项覆盖为 8rem。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 自动标签宽度 设置 `auto-label-width` 开启自动标签宽度。仅在 `layout="horizontal"` 布局下生效。 自动宽度随标签修改、字段增删更新，各个表单独立计算。 #### 标签栅格与局部覆盖 两端默认横向比例为标签 5/24、内容 19/24；Cedar 默认 horizontal，Maple 默认 vertical。仅 horizontal 消费栅格比例与自动宽度；vertical/inline 不套用 Col 百分比。响应式 xs/sm 等按视口宽度生效。 #### 固定标签宽度 FormItem 显式配置优先于 Form。Col 参数与 style 对象整项覆盖，不做深层合并。label-col-flex 优先于 auto-label-width；带单位字符串指定宽度，数字沿用 Col 的伸缩比例（并非 px），内容列自动填满剩余空间。隐藏标签时内容占满。 自动宽度只测量未指定 label-col-flex 的横向标签；标签文字变化、动态增删会重新对齐。多个 Form 各自计算，标签为空或移除全部字段时不会产生 Infinity/NaN。使用很长的标签时建议在窄屏切换 vertical 或设置固定宽度。
## 字段与数据模型 ### 嵌套数据 展示了多种表单项嵌套的方式。 表单控件通过 FormItem 注入的上下文继承状态和事件，无需绑定到第一子组件。 如果使用 Grid 组件进行布局，请设置 :content-flex="false" 关闭表单项内容的 flex 布局。 ### 栅格布局 展示了使用栅格布局的方式。可以使用 `label-col-flex` 的带单位字符串指定标签宽度，数字表示 Col 伸缩比例。 ### 文本与数值字段 ### 开关与勾选字段 ### 下拉选择字段 ### 层级选择字段 ### 日期字段 ### 时间字段 ### 进度与评分字段 ### 附件字段 ### 专用字段 ## 校验与提交 ### 验证表单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | -------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | | `model` | 表单数据对象 | 验证表单、跨字段校验与原生提交、清空时校验 | | `layout` | 表单的布局方式，包括水平、垂直、多列 | 清空时校验 | 展示了表单校验的使用方法。 ### 跨字段校验与原生提交 Pause cross-field validation holds the local confirmation rule until Resolve cross-field result. disabled?: Ref; error?: Ref; }) => { mergedSize: Ref; mergedDisabled: Ref; mergedError: Ref; feedback: Ref; eventHandlers: Ref; }; ``` ### Cedar 规则协议 FieldRule 保留对象规则及 callback 错误通路：调用 callback(message) 表示业务不通过，异步规则必须返回 Promise，正常完成且没有错误回调才表示通过。仅稍后调用 callback 却不返回 Promise 不在等待合同内；返回 false 或错误字符串不会替代 callback。 意外 throw 或 Promise 拒绝会让公开 validate 拒绝，调用方用 try/catch 处理；最新任务释放 validating 并恢复之前的业务错误，不合成业务校验失败。旧任务异常不会清除新任务的等待状态。 ```ts import type { FieldRule } from '@cedar-design/ui' const nameRule: FieldRule = { validator: async (value, callback, context) => { await Promise.resolve() if (!value) callback(`${context?.field} is required`) }, } ``` ### 公开校验与通知合同 Form 与 FormItem 的默认插槽没有作用域参数；FormItem 还提供 label、help、extra 插槽，均不通过参数操作模型。Form 使用 model 对象及字段路径管理状态，不以插槽参数替代业务模型。 `validate(callback?)` 和 `validateField(fields, callback?)` 等待对应规则，成功返回 undefined，业务失败返回按字段聚合的错误对象；回调只通知当前有效任务。错误记录包含 field、message、label、value、type、isRequiredError。value 保留原字段值，不先转换成显示文字。 submit-success 先于 submit 通知，业务校验失败时 submit-failed 先于 submit。编辑会话未完成的阻止分支只通知 submit-failed，其 errors.editing 只有 field="editing" 与 message，不伪造字段校验信息；公开类型 FormSubmitError 区分该提示与完整 ValidatedError。 这些事件是通知，不等待监听器 Promise，也不自动执行请求或切换 loading。业务异步保存自行控制 loading。原生 reset 会阻止默认行为、执行 resetFields 后通知 reset；Form 的 resetFields 会写回 model，与 FilterForm 内部 Form 的职责不同。 `beforeCommit` 属于支持编辑事务的字段组件，签名为 `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise`；payload 含 value、previousValue，context 含 signal 和可选 event。返回 undefined 表示等待 done；返回布尔或 Promise 按结果结算。它不是 Form 的 submit 事件或通用加载入口。 ```ts import type { FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance, ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData, FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError, BeforeFieldCommit, } from '@cedar-design/ui' ``` 自定义表单控件可在 `setup` 中调用 `useFormErrorDescription()`，将返回的 `describe(existingIds)` 绑定到实际交互元素的 `aria-describedby`。它会保留已有描述，并在 FormItem 显示或清除错误时同步添加或移除错误 ID；控件不在 FormItem 内时仅保留已有描述。 ## CSS Variables

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。预览集合的上一张/下一张、水平键与滑动沿阅读方向工作，值数组不反转。方向切换取消尚未完成的手势并保持当前图片、缩放与旋转；图片本身和放大后的拖拽坐标不自动镜像。图片序号保持 LTR 数值显示。

## API

图片预览组使用 `v-model` 绑定从 1 开始的图片序号，`defaultValue` 提供非受控初始图片序号；面板开关独立使用 `v-model:open` 与 `defaultOpen`。函数式预览配置同步使用 modelValue/defaultValue 和 onUpdate:modelValue。

### 图片预览组序号

`modelValue/defaultValue` 从 **1** 开始，`1` 表示第 1 张。`open(imageNumber = 1)`、`to(imageNumber)` 接收相同序号，无效或非整数序号会被忽略。`prev()/next()` 在循环边界也回传同一规则的序号。模型事件为 `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`，切换通知为 `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`；外部赋值不补发切换通知。长按通知为 `long-press(imageNumber)`，指示器插槽参数为 `{ imageNumber, length }`。内部数组下标仍从 0 开始。

根节点 `class`、`style` 与 Image 容器样式合并；内部图片样式通过 `img-props.class/style` 设置。预览的 `open-change` 是 Vue 通知事件：每次状态切换只发送一次，`.once` 遵循 Vue 事件语义，返回 Promise 不控制 loading。类型中的 `onOpenChange` 监听器也走同一事件入口。

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Composition input

IME composition preserves the native text being entered; external model updates do not replace it before completion. Existing formatting and controlled-owner acceptance apply afterward. Queued restoration from an earlier input cannot replace a later edit's text or caret. Numeric updates still follow model-event, with unchanged blur/Enter commit timing.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Clear output

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Min may be finite or -Infinity; max may be finite or Infinity. Negative values and 0 are valid. Invalid individual bounds use Vue prop-validation diagnostics and fall back to their unbounded defaults. An inverted range diagnoses both bounds and becomes unbounded, without swapping values. Input commits, stepping, and ARIA share the effective bounds; clear markers still follow empty-value.

Approved clearing notifies **clear → input → update:modelValue → change**. Clear is an action notification and is not emitted after a veto. A target equal to the current model does not invent change. The default clear value is undefined; explicit empty-value may provide null or another supported numeric value.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` receives `{ value, previousValue }`; context provides `signal`. Synchronous void waits for done; true, done(), or fulfilled `Promise<void>` allows the operation. False, done(false), `Promise<false>`, throwing, or rejection cancels. Direct mode approves changed model values before committing, stepping, or clearing; `model-event="input"` also approves before publishing, without repeated approval for the same value. Pending work announces aria-busy and locks typing/stepping. External model/configuration/state changes or deactivation/unmount cancel stale work. Direct approval errors preserve the value and notify `commit-error`; deferred editing approves once at final confirmation and uses the existing panel feedback. With approval enabled, holding a button does not start repeated requests. Ordinary listener Promises are not approval tasks.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.



`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`--c-field-caret-color` sets the shared caret color, defaulting to `currentColor`. `--c-input-number-caret-color` overrides this component and defaults to `var(--c-field-caret-color)`.

Explicit beforeCommit waiting uses the existing loadingMode indicator and sets aria-busy on the actual input. Manual loading remains business-owned and does not imply readonly; beforeCommit guards retain their existing interaction lock. Notification return Promises, including change/step, do not control waiting.

Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

# InputNumber

InputNumber 用于编辑和提交业务数字。

- `model-value !== undefined` 表示受控；`default-value` 仅初始化非受控值。编辑草稿允许暂时不同于业务值；提交后若父组件拒绝更新，恢复到父组件值。外部回填不触发用户事件或校验。
- 默认在 Enter / 失焦时更新；`model-event="input"` 输入完整数字时更新，但 `change` 仍在提交时触发。Enter 后再失焦不会重复提交。
- 清空获准后按 **clear → input → update:modelValue → change** 通知；clear 表示动作通知，审批拒绝时不发出。清空目标与当前模型相同时不虚构 change。默认清空值为 undefined，显式 empty-value 可输出 null 或其他受支持数值。
- `-`、`.`、`1.` 等输入中间态暂时保留；提交 `1.` 得到数字 1，单独符号恢复之前的业务值。非法文本、NaN、Infinity 不会写入业务值。IME 组合输入结束后只处理一次。
- 范围优先于精度：舍入后仍限制在 min/max 内，非对齐边界保留实际值。两端采用独立配置的 Decimal 运算，不受应用修改 Decimal 全局配置影响；模型仍是 JavaScript number，不承诺任意精度的大数存储。
- 禁用/只读/尺寸从 InputGroup、FormItem、Form 继承，显式 false 可以覆盖；Cedar 的缺省尺寸再读取 ConfigProvider，Maple 使用现有默认系统。字段外观与 hint 可继承 InputGroup；外层已有 FormItem 标题时不重复显示浮动标签。
- 鼠标、触控都支持长按；释放、取消、移出、窗口失焦、组件停用/卸载或状态变化时停止。移动端建议用 button 布局增加触控面积；↑/↓ 步进，Enter 提交。

## 阅读方向

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](/guide/empty-values/)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

### 清空输出

`empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。

`empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 的 payload 为 `{ value, previousValue }`，context 提供 `signal`。同步 void 等待 done；true、done() 或兑现的 `Promise<void>` 允许，false、done(false)、`Promise<false>`、抛错或拒绝取消。direct 模式在不同模型值的提交、步进或清空前审批；`model-event="input"` 也先审批后回填，同值不重复审批。等待期间 aria-busy 为 true，输入和步进操作锁定；外部模型、配置、禁用/只读变化或停用/卸载取消旧请求。direct 审批异常保留原值并通知 `commit-error`；延迟编辑只在最终确认时审批一次，错误使用现有面板反馈。启用审批时长按不连续发起请求，普通事件返回 Promise 不承担审批任务。

### Form 字段展示与确认

本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `direct`，保留原有交互。支持值：`direct / click / dblclick`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Cedar 使用 edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" 在字段附近打开编辑浮层，Enter/F2 也可进入；取消/Escape 丢弃草稿，确认后提交。readPretty 为独立阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 分开。



`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

统一光标色通过 `--c-field-caret-color` 设置（默认 `currentColor`）；本组件可用 `--c-input-number-caret-color` 单独覆盖，默认 `var(--c-field-caret-color)`。

显式 beforeCommit 等待会沿用现有 loadingMode 指示器并设置实际输入的 aria-busy。手动 loading 保持业务所有权，不会隐式只读；beforeCommit 守卫保留已有输入锁定规则。change/step 等通知返回 Promise 不控制等待。

延迟编辑的 `change` 在有来源时保留真实确认事件，例如保存按钮事件；程序触发的编辑器接力没有 DOM 事件，第二个参数可缺省。事件 target 可能是确认控件，不保证是输入元素。`change` 只通知，不等待监听器返回的 Promise；异步审批请使用 `before-commit`。

公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。

The old mixin import, default/focus pseudo-element backgrounds and duplicate custom Tag text rules are removed; Tag owns its text. Existing close-button appearance, click removal and readonly/disabled behavior remain, without a new hover background. Both libraries remove tag-custom-icon-bg-hover; Cedar also removes input-tag-tag-remove-icon-color-bg / input-tag-tag-remove-icon-color-bg-focus. Unused variables have no replacements; remove ineffective overrides. No aliases remain. Maple has no InputTag component and only synchronizes shared Tag-variable cleanup. ## InputTag wrapper and content responsibilities FieldDecorator owns InputTag outline / filled / standard wrappers. Form must not redraw backgrounds, borders or focus shadows; old Form overrides for obsolete InputTag state classes are removed, while validation messages remain. filled default/hover/focus still use FieldDecorator fill-1 / fill-2 / fill-3. input-tag-* controls content density, default tag backgrounds and disabled text. Selectors match actual c-field-decorator--size-* / --focus / --disabled classes rather than nonexistent old InputTag classes; disabled overrides focus. All xs/sm/md/lg/xl sizes are covered. xl uses 32px tags, 16px input text and 4px vertical padding. Removed 33 unused wrapper variables: size-{xs,sm,md,lg}-height; color-text-error; color-placeholder, color-icon-clear, color-icon-clear-bg-hover; color-border-{default,error,disabled} and -hover/-focus forms; color-bg-{default,error}, their -hover/-focus forms, color-bg-disabled and its -hover form; color-shadow-{default,error}-focus; size-shadow-{default,error}-focus; border-radius, border-width, size-icon-clear and size-icon-clear-hover. All use --c-input-tag-. No compatibility aliases remain. Migrate by responsibility: field-variant-{variant}-background for wrapper backgrounds; field-border-radius for corners; field-placeholder-text-color for placeholders; field-clear-icon-color / field-clear-icon-size for clear icons. Prefer size for geometry; do not override internal variables. Unused legacy variables have no one-to-one replacement. Tag content uses the InputTag variables below. Default text, disabled text, tag backgrounds and focus backgrounds use the corresponding system semantic colors. Disabled state does not override explicit color / status; keep text readable when supplying custom colors. Parent disabled / readonly takes precedence over tagProps.closable / checkable. Loading or explicitly nonclosable tags cannot be removed with Backspace. ### Form field presentation and confirmation This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled. `before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. ## Configuring the cleared value `empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults. `empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

## API

The virtual list covers the viewport first and renders `buffer` items beyond it on each side. `buffer=0` is valid. `estimatedSize` must be finite and positive, including values below 1; invalid values fall back to 30px. `fixedSize` can change dynamically. Variable-height mode uses measured and estimated heights; rows are measured on mount and unmount, not continuously after asynchronous size changes. The `item` slot receives the original index and unknown data; return a single measurable root and provide a stable `itemKey`. To convey the complete collection to assistive technology, provide `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` on application rows as appropriate.

### List Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | Data consumed by item slot | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | Outer border | boolean | true |
| split | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | boolean | true |
| loading | Initial loading/refresh feedback, not pagination state | boolean | false |
| max-height | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

Virtual lists use a dedicated viewport without nesting a custom scrollbar. virtualListProps.height overrides maxHeight; with neither, height defaults to 200px. Numeric and unit-bearing CSS lengths are accepted. Invalid/nonpositive max-height does not constrain height.

ListVirtualListProps supports height, threshold, fixedSize, estimatedSize, buffer, itemKey and component. Removed isStaticItemHeight is unsupported; List.data supplies data. Counts at or below threshold render all items. Variable heights use measurements and estimatedSize; buffer controls overscan rows.

ListScrollbarProps supports type: 'track'|'embed', outerClass, outerStyle, hide, disableHorizontal and disableVertical. JavaScript object fields use camelCase.

### List Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event): one notification per real scroll event.
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align }): virtual-list positioning. index overrides key; align is top/bottom/auto. auto does nothing for a fully visible item, otherwise scrolls the minimum distance required. Invalid targets or nonvirtual mode do nothing.

### List Slots

List slots: default (overrides data), item({ item, index }), header, footer, empty. Empty state appears only without a default slot/data and while not loading. ListItem prefix/default/suffix retain list-item semantics without managing buttons/business interactions.

## Types

ListProps、ListSize、ListVirtualListProps、ListScrollbarProps、ListExpose、ListSlots、ListEmits、ListInstance、ListItemInstance。

List handles display and an optional virtual viewport. Compose InfiniteScroll status/target behavior for pagination rather than duplicating its loading state machine inside List.

## Loading and waiting

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Mention Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value (v-model) | Controlled text; null displays as empty | string \| null | undefined |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled text | string | '' |
| data | Candidate array or explicit loader, including nested groups | readonly (string \| number \| SelectOptionData \| SelectOptionGroup)[] \| ((query: string, context: { signal: AbortSignal }) => Array \| `Promise<Array>`) | undefined |
| prefix | Trigger prefix; supports multiple characters and multiple prefixes | string \| string[] | '@' |
| split | Separator before and after a mention | string | ' ' |
| type | Input presentation | input \| textarea | input |
| disabled | Inherit Form when omitted; explicit false overrides it | boolean | undefined |
| readonly | Inherit Form when omitted; explicit false overrides it | boolean | undefined |
| clearable | Allow clearing text or the editor draft | boolean | false |
| loading | Manual waiting feedback; does not implicitly disable text editing | boolean | false |
| edit-mode | Editing mode, inherited from FormItem and Form | `'direct' \| 'click' \| 'dblclick'` | `'direct'` |
| read-pretty | Independent read presentation; explicit false overrides the parent | `boolean` | `false` |
| empty-value | Clear output; explicit null is submitted unchanged | `string \| null \| (() => string \| null)` | `''` |
| empty-values | Empty-value recognition; field takes precedence over FormItem and Form | `readonly unknown[]` | `-` |
| empty-text | Read empty text; an explicit empty string is valid | `string` | `'-'` |
| before-commit | Guard before saving a deferred edit; return a boolean or Promise, or complete via done | `(payload: { value: unknown; previousValue: unknown }, done: (allow?: boolean) => void, context: { signal: AbortSignal; event?: Event }) => void \| boolean \| Promise<void \| boolean>` | `-` |
| open | Controlled editor visibility, separate from native input focus | `boolean` | `-` |
| default-open | Initial visibility of an uncontrolled editor | `boolean` | `false` |
| popup-container | Editor mount container | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |

### Mention Events

| Event | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| change | value: string \| null; no native Event argument |
| search | query: string, prefix: string |
| select | value: SelectOptionValue \| undefined; from the actual leaf candidate |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| load-error | error: unknown; preserves the original loader error |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean; field editor only |

data is an explicit loader. search, change, select and load-error only notify; listener Promises are not collected. Direct input emits update:modelValue / change, and selection emits select / update:modelValue / change. Deferred editing updates a draft and submits the final model on confirmation.

### Mention Methods

| Method | Description | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | Focus the current target; deferred mode follows the field editing protocol | void |
| blur | Blur the current target without opening the editor | void |
| refresh | Retry the current data query with cancellation and failure handling, without opening the editor; static arrays issue no request | `Promise<void>` |

### Mention Slots

| Slot | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| option | Candidates in both input presentations; data: SelectOptionInfo, including key, raw, value and label |
| read | Reading content in both input presentations; value: string \| null, text: string |
| prefix / suffix | Input prefix and suffix for type=input only |
| clear-icon | Clear node in both input presentations; clear(event?: Event): void |

clear-icon replaces the entire clear node. A custom node must call clear and provide an accessible button. There is no default input replacement, empty or loader-error slot; option does not replace the field input.

## Types

The component exports the following types

```ts
import type { MentionProps, MentionInstance, MentionEmits, MentionSlots, MentionExpose } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

Mention reuses Input/Textarea typography and spacing; its measurement mirror copies computed native input styles. Override the corresponding input variables. Ineffective mention-font-size, mention-line-height and mention-padding-* variables are removed.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

`data` accepts an array or (query, { signal }) => array/Promise. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty query; searchable fields reload when queries change. Tree root loading is independent of existing load-more child loading.

Both input and textarea show manual loading and waiting for the current explicit data loader. Displaying waiting does not disable editing. A search notification's returned Promise does not start a task. An old data request cannot clear a newer request's indicator, and load-error preserves the original error.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

### Mention ranges and grouped options

prefix accepts single characters, multiple characters and arrays of strings. Selection replaces only the matched prefix and query before the caret, preserving the trailing text; the textarea mirror uses the matched prefix. Nested data groups render nonselectable titles and only leaves may be selected; disabled leaves do not submit. The option slot receives normalized candidates, including the valid identities zero and empty string.

### Candidate feedback and instance boundaries

Explicit data loading appears in the current Input/Textarea field, whose native input announces aria-busy. Manual loading combines with request loading and text remains editable. With no available candidates the mention menu stays closed. Failure ends current waiting and emits the original load-error; business code chooses error presentation. Error strings are not inserted into candidates or text. refresh waits for one read attempt; failures notify through load-error without awaiting error-listener Promises.

disabled/readonly pause requests; deactivation, unmount and stale responses cannot update data. refresh may read while the field editor is closed without opening it. The candidate menu belongs to the internal input; public open/default-open controls only the deferred field editor. MentionProps, MentionEmits, MentionSlots and MentionExpose are exported consistently from root and mention subentries; MeasureInfo remains internal measurement state.

Mention currently exists only in Cedar. Maple has no counterpart runtime; this change adds no component, loading-mode or extra error menu.

### Input and candidate relationships

input uses combobox, while textarea retains a multiline textbox. Both link to the actual listbox and active candidate with aria-autocomplete, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant. Closing suggestions or making the field readonly removes active references; arrow navigation keeps DOM focus in the native input.

| popup-container | 编辑层挂载容器 | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `-` |

### Mention Events

| 事件 | 说明与参数 |
| --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| change | value: string \| null；不附带原生 Event |
| search | query: string, prefix: string |
| select | value: SelectOptionValue \| undefined；来自实际叶子候选 |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| load-error | error: unknown；保留加载源原始错误 |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean；仅字段编辑层 |

data 是显式数据加载入口；search、change、select 和 load-error 都是通知，不采集监听器返回的 Promise。直接输入按 update:modelValue / change 通知，选择按 select / update:modelValue / change 通知；延迟编辑中先修改草稿，确认后才提交最终模型。

### Mention Methods

| 方法 | 说明 | 返回值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | 聚焦当前目标；延迟模式按字段编辑协议打开 | void |
| blur | 失焦当前目标，不打开编辑器 | void |
| refresh | 重试当前 data 查询，沿用取消与失败协议，不打开编辑器；静态数组不发请求 | `Promise<void>` |

### Mention Slots

| 插槽 | 说明与参数 |
| --- | --- |
| option | 两种输入形态的候选内容；data: SelectOptionInfo，含 key、raw、value、label |
| read | 两种输入形态的阅读内容；value: string \| null, text: string |
| prefix / suffix | 仅 type=input 的输入框前后缀 |
| clear-icon | 两种输入形态的清空节点；clear(event?: Event): void |

clear-icon 替换整个清空节点，自定义节点需要调用 clear，并自行提供可访问的按钮。没有 default 输入替换、empty 或加载错误专用插槽；option 不替换字段输入本体。

## Types

组件导出以下类型定义

```ts
import type { MentionProps, MentionInstance, MentionEmits, MentionSlots, MentionExpose } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

Mention 复用 Input／Textarea 的排版和间距，测量镜像复制原生输入框计算样式。自定义请覆盖对应输入组件变量；不再提供无效的 mention-font-size、mention-line-height 或 mention-padding-*。

### Form 字段展示与确认

Cedar 使用 edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" 在字段附近打开编辑浮层，Enter/F2 也可进入；取消/Escape 丢弃草稿，确认后提交。readPretty 为独立阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 分开。

## 配置清空后的值

`empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。

`empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。

候选属性 `data` 支持数组或 `(query, { signal }) => 数组/Promise`。加载、取消、过期结果隔离由组件内部处理，失败触发 load-error。单选/多选分组初始化以空字符串查询，搜索型字段在查询变化时调用；树形字段根数据与原有 load-more 子节点懒加载独立。

input 与 textarea 都显示手动 loading 和当前显式 data 加载函数的等待。等待显示不会隐式禁用编辑；search 通知返回 Promise 不启动任务。旧数据请求不会清理新请求的指示器，load-error 保留原始错误。

公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。

### 提及范围与分组选项

prefix 支持单字符、多字符及字符串数组。选择时只替换光标前已匹配的前缀和查询文本，保留光标后内容；textarea 镜像使用实际命中的前缀。data 中的嵌套分组只展示标题，只有叶子选项可选；禁用叶子不提交。option 插槽接收规范化候选，数值 0 和空字符串也是有效身份，不跳过定制。

### 候选反馈与实例边界

显式 data 加载的等待统一显示在当前 Input/Textarea 字段，原生输入声明 aria-busy；手动 loading 与数据请求的等待合并，文本仍可编辑。没有可用候选时不打开提及菜单。失败结束当前等待并通知原始 load-error，业务决定错误展示；不会把异常字符串自动插进候选或文本。refresh 等待一次读取结束，失败通过 load-error 通知，不等待错误监听器的 Promise。

disabled/readonly 会暂停数据请求，停用、卸载和过期响应不能继续更新；refresh 在关闭的编辑层也可读取数据而不自动打开。候选菜单仍属于内部输入，公开 open/default-open 只控制延迟字段编辑层。MentionProps、MentionEmits、MentionSlots、MentionExpose 在根入口和 mention 子入口一致导出；MeasureInfo 为内部测量状态。

Mention 当前仅在 Cedar 提供。Maple 没有对应运行时，本次不新增组件、loading-mode 或额外错误菜单。

### 输入与候选关联

input 使用 combobox，textarea 保留支持多行的 textbox；两者都以 aria-autocomplete、aria-controls 和 aria-activedescendant 关联实际 listbox 与活动候选。候选关闭或字段只读后撤下活动关联；方向键移动候选时原生输入保留 DOM 焦点。这里验证的是 DOM 关系和键盘行为，不代表已完成所有读屏软件和真机组合的认证。

--- permalink: /components/menu/ --- # Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 Select；选择层级数据请使用 Cascader。 --- ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。菜单开启后会为触发元素添加 `c-menu-open` 类名。 ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 分组标题与选项左对齐，标题行高 20px、上下各 4px 留白（总高 28px）；后续分组额外间隔 8px，首组不添加组间距。 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，默认悬停展开；改成 `'click'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ### 与 SplitButton 组合 SplitButton 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作，完整用法见 [SplitButton](/components/split-button/)。 ### 触发方式 ### 弹出方向 ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ### 高度限制 ## 状态与内容定制 ### 选中值与 select 事件 使用 `v-model` 管理当前激活值。激活命令时先触发 `update:modelValue`，再触发 `select(value, option, event)`；`select` 表示激活菜单项，不表示表单值变化。 ### 受控打开状态 ### 页脚 ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。子级沿阅读方向展开；进入子级与返回父级的左右键跟随当前方向，上下键与首尾定位保持顺序并跳过禁用项。挂载到外部容器的菜单继承来源方向，切换方向不改变选中值。 ##
