Maple change now includes the original event as its second argument. checked-color/unchecked-color control the track consistently; tokens customize thumbs. ### Color variables and tonal foreground migration | Variable suffix: --c-switch- | Default system role | Responsibility | | ----------------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- | | track-background | content-secondary | Ordinary unchecked solid track | | track-active-background | content-brand | Checked track and keyboard-focus ring | | track-error-background | content-danger | Interactive error track and tonal error border | | handle-background | surface-default | Ordinary/checked/error thumb fill | | handle-color | content-brand | Ordinary/checked/error thumb icon color | | text-color | surface-default | Text on a solid track | | checked-text-color | switch-text-color | Checked-track text; error retains existing foreground precedence | | tonal-track-background | surface-muted | Tonal unchecked-track background | | tonal-border-color | content-secondary | Tonal unchecked border and thumb fill | | tonal-text-color | content-secondary | Added: tonal unchecked-track text | | tonal-handle-color | surface-default | Added: tonal unchecked-thumb icon | Defaults use the corresponding system roles, such as var(--c-sys-color-content-secondary). Unchecked tonal uses tonal-text-color / tonal-handle-color; override both ordinary and tonal foregrounds when customizing every variant. Interactive error state uses paired text/handle colors, while disabled / loading suppresses error colors. Keep foregrounds readable on custom track colors. ### Theme names and variant names Theme entries are Themes.default.light/dark and Themes.maple.light/dark. Switch tonal is a variant, not a theme. Public variants and eight dedicated variables consistently use tonal without old-name aliases. ### Form field presentation and confirmation This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled. `before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, context)` approves saving after FormItem candidate validation. context provides signal; the second argument is always done. Return false, `Promise` or done(false) to reject; true, done() or `Promise` allows. Synchronous void waits for done. Rejection keeps editing; exceptions use existing panel feedback without a separate error event. `open / default-open / update:open` controls the editor, and `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes reading content. Ordinary notification Promises do not run approval tasks. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. ### Form state inheritance Omitted `disabled` / `readonly` inherit FormItem, then Form; an explicit `false` overrides inherited state. Becoming `disabled` or read-only invalidates a pending `beforeChange`, so a late result cannot toggle the value. Outside a form, omitted values behave as `false`. ## Inheriting Form disabled state The default disabled=undefined means inheritance, resolved as local ?? FormItem ?? Form ?? false. Explicit false remains effective, allowing one field to stay enabled while unspecified fields follow Form. Form disabled is the form-wide default, not a lock preventing child overrides. `empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model. ```vue ``` ```ts const beforeChange = (payload, done, context) => { canChange(payload.value, { previousValue: payload.previousValue, signal: context.signal }) .then((allowed) => done(allowed), () => done(false)); }; ``` Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed. ### Guard waiting feedback Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading. Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

# TableColumnManager 表格列管理

双栏列管理内容组件：左侧搜索勾选，右侧拖拽排序 / 冻结 / 删除。

- 默认自带抽屉容器（`v-model:open`），确认后通过 `confirm` 事件回写 `columns`。
- 传入 `inline` 可只渲染内联面板，用于放入自定义弹窗 / 容器。
- 与 Table **解耦**：Table 只提供 `v-model:columns`、`extra-column`、`#header-cell-actions` 等扩展点；列管理 UI / 算法由外部组合。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

组件自身渲染抽屉；弹窗场景使用 `inline` 内联面板放入 `c-dialog`。

<demo src="./__demos__/basic.vue"></demo>

## Table 组合与持久化

### 与 Table 组合：不分组

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | 抽屉是否可见（`v-model:open`） | 按钮切换抽屉 / 弹窗 |
| `columns` | 当前表格列，确认时拼回完整列定义 | 按钮切换抽屉 / 弹窗 |
| `options` | 左侧列定义 | 按钮切换抽屉 / 弹窗 |
| `drawer-title` | 抽屉标题 | 按钮切换抽屉 / 弹窗 |
| `inline` | 是否只渲染内联面板（不渲染抽屉） | 按钮切换抽屉 / 弹窗 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

普通数组形式的 `columnDefinitions`，覆盖必选列、左右冻结、列宽调整、插槽、重命名和表头快捷操作。

<demo src="./__demos__/with-table-ungrouped.vue"></demo>

### 与 Table 组合：分组与持久化

配合 `useTableColumnManager` 组合式函数，一行接入：

- `extra-column` + `#extra-column-header`：末列冻结设置按钮
- `#header-cell-actions`：表头右侧操作，使用 `HeaderAction` 组件
- `v-model:columns` / `@column-resize`：改列并重渲染

表头操作项通过 `headerActions` 配置 key，事件绑定在组件内部完成；插入/编辑弹窗由 `c-table-column-manager` 内部渲染。

<demo src="./__demos__/with-table-header-menu.vue"></demo>

### 按钮切换抽屉 / 弹窗

外部选择容器类型：抽屉模式直接用组件，弹窗模式传入 `inline`。

<demo src="./__demos__/with-table.vue"></demo>

## 异步目录与搜索

### 异步目录与远程搜索

`loadOptions` 加载全量目录，`remoteSearch` 驱动搜索。

<demo src="./__demos__/remote.vue"></demo>

## API

### 状态与持久化结构

列的顺序、标题和冻结状态统一存放在 `items` 中。组件和 `useTableColumnManager` 不维护缓存，业务层可按需将
以下状态存入 localStorage、Pinia 或服务端：

```ts
const state: ColumnManagerState = {
  version: 2,
  items: [
    { dataIndex: 'id', fixed: 'left', width: 120 },
    { dataIndex: 'name', title: '用户名称' },
  ],
  layout: [],
}
```

这是大版本破坏性调整，不再读取旧的 `keys`、`fixedMap`、`titleMap` 结构。

```ts
const { state, restore } = useTableColumnManager({ defaultColumns, columnDefinitions })
const storageReady = ref(false)

onMounted(async () => {
  const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)
  if (raw) await restore(JSON.parse(raw))
  storageReady.value = true
})

watch(
  state,
  (value) => {
    if (!storageReady.value) return
    window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(value))
  },
  { deep: true }
)
```

`restore()` 会校验版本、移除失效或重复列、清洗非法宽度和布局、补齐 `required` 列，并修复冻结区顺序。
`state` 只记录用户重命名的标题和通过 `handleColumnResize` 调整过的宽度。保存到服务端时建议在业务层增加防抖。

### 默认列与候选定义

`defaultColumns` 是完整的 Table 初始列和重置基准；`columnDefinitions` 只负责弹窗候选项，可以只有
`dataIndex`、`title`、分组和提示：

```ts
const defaultColumns: ManagedTableColumn[] = [
  {
    title: '基本信息',
    children: [
      {
        dataIndex: 'id',
        title: '编号',
        fixed: 'left',
        width: 120,
        manager: { required: true },
      },
      { dataIndex: 'name', title: '名称', minWidth: 180 },
    ],
  },
]

const columnDefinitions: ColumnDefinitions = [
  {
    key: 'base',
    title: '基本信息',
    children: [
      { dataIndex: 'id', title: '编号' },
      { dataIndex: 'name', title: '名称' },
      { dataIndex: 'remark', title: '备注', tip: '可选列' },
    ],
  },
]

const manager = useTableColumnManager({
  defaultColumns,
  columnDefinitions,
  columnDefaults: { width: 140, ellipsis: true },
  createColumn: (definition) => ({ dataIndex: definition.dataIndex, title: definition.title }),
})
```

- `defaultColumns` 决定初始展示、重置、默认宽度、冻结、插槽、渲染和 `manager.required`。
- `columnDefinitions` 决定弹窗候选范围，不承担 Table 渲染配置。
- `columnDefaults` 是新增普通列的统一 Table 默认值。
- `createColumn` 用于少数需要特殊宽度、插槽或渲染的候选列。
- 远程场景使用 `columnSource.search` 搜索、`columnSource.resolve` 恢复未知的已选列；此时 `restore()` 返回 Promise。

建议只传 `columnDefinitions` 或 `columnSource` 其中一个。兼容旧调用时若两者同时存在，本地定义作为候选目录；远程搜索仍会调用，但搜索结果不会替换本地定义，恢复未知列仍可调用远程 `resolve`。远程 `search` 每次只请求一页，当前不会根据 `nextCursor` 自动加载更多，也不使用 `total` 分页。需要全部候选项时由业务数据源返回完整结果。

`restore()` 始终返回 Promise；远程 `resolve` 失败时拒绝，由调用方处理。状态只保存版本、叶子列和可选布局，`render` 等函数应保留在 `defaultColumns` 或业务列注册表中。打开面板会从当前列建立草稿，关闭不应用草稿；确认后才更新表格列。`required` 默认列不能删除，恢复时缺失会补回，`resetToDefault()` 恢复默认列。

| 参数名        | 描述                               | 类型                                                    | 默认值     |

| default-value | 非受控初始已选状态                 | `ColumnManagerItem[]`                                   | `-`        |
| columns       | 当前表格列，确认时拼回完整列定义   | `TableColumnData[]`                                     | `[]`       |

### `useTableColumnManager`

推荐与 `c-table` 组合使用。返回 `columns`、`state`、`restore`、`managerProps`、`HeaderAction` 等，其中
`HeaderAction` 直接通过 `inject` 获取上下文，模板中只需：

```vue
<template #header-cell-actions="{ column, dataIndex }">
  <HeaderAction :data-index="dataIndex" :column="column" />
</template>
```

可通过 `headerActions` 配置要展示的表头操作 key，默认全部展示。

返回成员如下，`Ref` / `ComputedRef` 在脚本中通过 `.value` 读取：

| 成员 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `columns`、`leafColumns`、`state` | 当前表格列、叶子列摘要和可持久化状态 |
| `managerVisible`、`managerRef`、`managerProps` | 面板显示状态、实例引用和预绑定属性/事件 |
| `open`、`close`、`confirm` | 打开并建立草稿、关闭、确认应用 |
| `insertColumns`、`getInsertableItems` | 按锚点插入列、获取当前可插入的候选 |
| `getEditInitialValues`、`applyEdit` | 获取编辑初值、应用标题及分组修改 |
| `freezeColumn`、`removeColumn` | 冻结或取消冻结、删除可删除列 |
| `resetToDefault`、`restore`、`handleColumnResize` | 重置、恢复持久化状态、保存列宽变更 |
| `headerActions`、`columnActions`、`HeaderAction` | 可用表头操作、预绑定操作和表头按钮组件 |
| `openInsert`、`insertVisible`、`insertSide`、`insertableItems`、`insertSelected`、`handleInsertConfirm` | 插入弹窗的入口、状态和确认方法 |
| `openEdit`、`editVisible`、`editGroupTitle`、`editColumnTitle`、`handleEditConfirm` | 编辑弹窗的入口、状态和确认方法 |

表头操作行为：

- **向左 / 向右插入**：新列会写入锚点所在一级分组，保证分组标题与 `colspan` 正确；若锚点列已冻结，新列会继承相同的冻结位置。
- **冻结 / 取消冻结**：按规则重排叶子列顺序，冻结列集中靠左或靠右。
- **编辑列**：可修改一级分组标题与列名称，相邻同名分组会自动合并。

必选规则只需要在 `defaultColumns` 中声明，Transfer、清空操作和表头删除都会遵循同一规则：

```ts
{
  dataIndex: 'priority',
  title: '优先级',
  manager: { required: true },
  fixed: 'left',
  width: 120,
  slotName: 'priority',
}
```

`columnDefinitions` 中无需重复宽度、冻结和必选规则。用户拖拽后的宽度保存在对应的 `items[].width`。

### 扩展列宽度

`c-table` 的 `extra-column` 扩展列（如设置按钮）默认宽度为 **28px**，可通过 `extraColumn: { width: number }` 覆盖。

### 工具函数（列管理包内）

`buildColumnsResult` / `stateFromColumns` / `applyColumnEdit` / `applyColumnFixed` / `applyInsertToLayout` / `mapLeafColumns` 等用于外部组合时拼装、编辑分组、冻结重排。扁平叶子列表请在业务侧从 `columns` 自行遍历，不必依赖 Table 导出。

目录加载、远程搜索分别持有等待状态，旧任务不能解除新任务的等待。`loadOptions` 在创建时、函数更换时以及显式 `loadCatalog` 调用时读取；当前请求失败通过 `load-error` 通知，`source` 区分目录和搜索，失效请求不再通知。手动调用 `loadCatalog` 的 Promise 仍会拒绝，由调用方处理；自动加载和搜索的错误由事件报告。普通通知事件返回的 Promise 不驱动加载。hook 目录读取/远程搜索使用最新目录代次，restore 有独立代次，更新的列编辑或卸载令旧恢复结果失效。

# Textarea

Multiline text input.

## Reading direction

The textarea inherits source `dir`, aligns text to inline start and its counter to inline end. Runtime direction changes retain the native editor, focus and selection; native caret and newline keys keep their meanings.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

`v-model.trim` follows Vue model event rules: `update:modelValue` is trimmed during input, while `input` reports the original text after length normalization. An uncontrolled editor may retain surrounding whitespace while editing and normalizes its local display on commit; committing does not repeat the same model proposal already reported. Controlled display follows the final parent value, and `change` still denotes a commit.

Auto sizing converts the measured box to the actual CSS box model, counting padding and the top/bottom borders once. ## Value model and interaction

### Dynamic empty values

Changing empty-value (including its factory) affects the next clear operation. Changing empty-values reformats the existing model without emitting a model update. Direct clear publishes immediately; deferred clear remains a draft until confirmation.

<demo src="./__demos__/empty-policy.vue"></demo>

## Design notes

- Defaults to `outline` with `clearable` disabled.
- `input` means live editing; `change` commits on changed blur or clear. Enter remains a newline.
- `auto-size` lets content determine height, overriding visual effects of `rows`/manual `resize`.
- Form/FormItem own business validation/messages; Textarea supplies event signals/error appearance only.

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom `line`); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Composition input

IME composition preserves the native text being entered; external model updates do not replace it before composition completes. Existing formatting and controlled-owner acceptance apply after completion. Queued restoration from an earlier input cannot replace the text or caret of a later edit or composition. Length limits and modifiers retain their existing post-composition input/commit timing.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

`rows` accepts a positive integer or a numeric string convertible to one. Invalid values use Vue prop-validation diagnostics and restore native default `rows`. `auto-size` minRows/maxRows accept positive finite line-height multiples, including fractions; minRows must not exceed maxRows. Invalid objects disable automatic measurement and clear its previous calculated styles. Null is treated as unset.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` approves saving. Payload contains `{ value, previousValue }`; context provides `signal`. Synchronous void waits for done; true, done(), or fulfilled `Promise<void>` allows saving. False, done(false), `Promise<false>`, throwing, or rejection cancels. Ordinary events only notify and do not await Promises; the DOM source of `change` may be absent.

### Native layout and public types

size supports five FieldDecorator densities: xs/sm/md/lg/xl. rows, auto-size and Textarea tokens still control textarea height/text metrics. Cedar allows manual resize by default; Maple does not. InputGroup/Form state is inherited, with explicit child values taking precedence. Exposes focus(options?), blur(), select() and textareaRef.

`TextareaProps`、`TextareaVariant`、`TextareaMaxLength`、`TextareaAutoSize`、`TextareaEmits`、`TextareaSlots`、`TextareaExpose`、`TextareaInstance`。

Native methods: `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`, `blur()`, `select()`; `textareaRef` is the native element.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps editing open on failure; before-commit approval runs after validation succeeds. See the property section above for approval parameters and completion rules.

`open / default-open / update:open / open-change` control and report editor visibility; `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes reading content. See Form for composed examples.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`--c-field-caret-color` sets the shared caret color, defaulting to `currentColor`. `--c-textarea-caret-color` overrides this component and defaults to `var(--c-field-caret-color)`.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

Native textarea uses `autocomplete="off"`, matching Input and Maple; forwarded native attributes cannot override this policy.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

# Textarea

Textarea 是用于多行纯文本编辑的基础表单控件，适合评论、反馈和说明等较长内容。

默认长度按 UTF-16 码元计算（emoji 通常占 2）；默认截断不会拆开有效的代理对，边界不足时舍去整个字符。若需按用户感知字符（字素簇）计数和裁剪，请配套提供 `word-length` 与 `word-slice`；自定义裁剪结果由业务负责。

## 阅读方向

多行输入继承来源 `dir`，文字默认按阅读起点对齐，计数按阅读终点排列。切换方向保留原生编辑器、焦点与选区，不交换原生光标或换行键。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法与值模型

`v-model` 用于受控值；`default-value` 只提供非受控初始值。

`v-model.trim` 遵循 Vue 模型事件规则：输入时的 `update:modelValue` 已去除首尾空白；`input` 仍通知经过长度归一化的原始文本。非受控输入可在编辑时保留空白，提交时归一化本地显示；提交不重复发布已通知的同一个模型值。受控显示始终由父级最终值决定，`change` 仍表示提交。

<demo src="./__demos__/basic.vue"></demo>

## 外观与状态

### 状态与外观

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置            | 作用                              | 相关示例   |
| --------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `placeholder`   | 占位提示文字                      | 状态与外观 |
| `variant`       | `filled` / `outline` / `standard` | 状态与外观 |
| `default-value` | 非受控模式初始值                  | 状态与外观 |
| `readonly`      | 是否只读                          | 状态与外观 |
| `disabled`      | 是否禁用                          | 状态与外观 |
| `error`         | 是否显示错误状态                  | 状态与外观 |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

支持 `filled`、`outline`、`standard` 三种外观和 `xs`、`sm`、`md`、`lg`、`xl` 五种尺寸。

<demo src="./__demos__/status.vue"></demo>

### 外观组合

适用于备注、说明等多行输入。调整变体、尺寸，用相同数据观察变化。内容保持一致，便于比较不同设置的实际效果。

<demo src="./__demos__/appearance-lab.vue"></demo>

## 内容与展示

### 字数限制

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置              | 作用                                     | 相关示例         |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `placeholder`     | 占位提示文字                             | 字数限制         |
| `max-length`      | 有限非负长度或 `{ length, errorOnly? }`；0 不限；非法值提示并回退不限 | 字数限制         |
| `clearable`       | 是否允许清空                             | 字数限制         |
| `show-word-limit` | 是否显示字数统计                         | 字数限制         |
| `aria-label`      | 无可见标签时提供的可访问名称             | 原生属性与无障碍 |
| `rows`            | 原生可见行数，仍受 min-height Token 约束 | 原生属性与无障碍 |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

数字形式会在用户编辑时截断；`errorOnly: true` 会保留超长内容并显示错误状态。外部受控值不会仅因超长而被组件反向改写。

<demo src="./__demos__/max-length.vue"></demo>

`max-length` 为有限非负数或 `{ length, errorOnly? }`，`0` 表示不限。对象的 `length` 同样须为有限非负数，`errorOnly` 为可选布尔值；非法值沿 Vue Prop 校验提示并按不限长度回退，传入 null 按未设置处理。默认截断按 UTF-16 码元计算；自定义计数与裁剪请配套提供 `word-length / word-slice`。

### 原生属性与无障碍

通过 `textarea-attrs` 补充 `name`、`inputmode`、`aria-describedby` 等原生属性。组件管理的值、禁用、只读、行数、长度、核心事件和错误态具有更高优先级。

<demo src="./__demos__/native-attrs.vue"></demo>

### 前缀、后缀和清除图标

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置          | 作用         | 相关示例             |
| ------------- | ------------ | -------------------- |

## 交互与控制

### 交互状态切换

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置          | 作用                                     | 相关示例                                           |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `placeholder` | 占位提示文字                             | 行数、自动高度与手动调整、事件语义、主体与事件契约 |
| `rows`        | 原生可见行数，仍受 min-height Token 约束 | 行数、自动高度与手动调整、主体与事件契约           |
| `auto-size`   | 是否自动高度，可设置最小/最大行数        | 行数、自动高度与手动调整、主体与事件契约           |
| `clearable`   | 是否允许清空                             | 事件语义、主体与事件契约                           |
| `disabled`    | 是否禁用                                 | 交互状态切换                                       |
| `readonly`    | 是否只读                                 | 交互状态切换                                       |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

适用于备注、说明等多行输入。调整禁用、只读、错误反馈，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。

<demo src="./__demos__/state-lab.vue"></demo>

### 行数、自动高度与手动调整

`rows` 使用原生可见行数，仍受 min-height Token 约束语义。Cedar 默认允许纵向拖动；开启 `auto-size` 后关闭手动调整，并可使用 `minRows`、`maxRows` 约束高度。

在 Form/FormItem 内未显式设置时，`size`、`disabled`、`readonly` 和 `error` 会继承表单状态；组件本地传入的值（包括 `false`）优先。

自动高度按实际盒模型换算，padding 和上下边框只计入一次。显式 `minRows / maxRows` 优先于主题默认最小高度，达到行数上限后内部滚动；关闭自动高度后恢复原生高度和平台默认 resize。示例并列比较两种盒模型，可填入六行并切换上限。

<demo src="./__demos__/auto-size.vue"></demo>

### 事件语义

`input` 先于 `update:model-value`。IME 完成后处理一次；失焦提交 `change`。清空按 `clear → input → update:model-value → change` 通知，各一次，后续失焦不重复提交。

<demo src="./__demos__/interaction.vue"></demo>

### 主体与事件契约

输入按 input → update:modelValue 通知；清空按 clear → input → update:modelValue → change 通知，各一次，Form 对应语义也各接收一次。只读、禁用和组合输入期间禁止清空。受控提议被拒绝后恢复原生内容，包括不支持光标 API 的输入类型。

<demo src="./__demos__/body-contract.vue"></demo>

## 值模型与交互

### 动态清空策略

empty-value 或其工厂函数变化会用于下一次清空；empty-values 变化只重新解释当前显示值，不主动改写模型。直接模式清空即回写，延迟模式清空草稿后仍需确认。

<demo src="./__demos__/empty-policy.vue"></demo>

## 设计要点

- 默认使用 `outline` 外观，`clearable` 默认关闭。
- `input` 表示实时编辑，`change` 在失焦值变化或清空时提交；Enter 保持换行语义。
- `auto-size` 开启后由内容决定高度，并覆盖 `rows` 与手动 `resize` 的视觉结果。
- Form/FormItem 负责业务校验规则和消息，Textarea 只提供事件信号和错误视觉状态。

### 共享字段加载

`loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。

## 组合输入

使用输入法组合文字时保留正在输入的文本，组合完成前外部模型更新不替换这段文本。组合结束后再按原有格式化和受控接受规则处理；旧输入的排队回填不会改写后续编辑或组合的文本与光标。长度限制和修饰符按组合结束后的既有输入/提交时机处理。

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](/guide/empty-values/)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

## CSS Variables


两端计数器均在外侧，使用 counter-margin-top 控制顶部间距，避免覆盖文本。

### 原生布局与公开类型

size 支持 xs/sm/md/lg/xl 的 FieldDecorator 外壳密度；文本域高度/文字度量仍由 rows、auto-size 和 Textarea Token 控制。Cedar 默认允许手动 resize，Maple 默认关闭。继承 InputGroup 与 Form 状态，子项显式值优先；提供 focus(options?)、blur()、select() 和 textareaRef。

### Form 字段展示与确认

本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `direct`，保留原有交互。支持值：`direct / click / dblclick`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Cedar 使用 edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" 在字段附近打开编辑浮层，Enter/F2 也可进入；取消/Escape 丢弃草稿，确认后提交。readPretty 为独立阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 分开。

FormItem 先校验候选值，失败时保持编辑；通过后再执行 before-commit 审批。审批参数与完成规则见上方属性说明。

`open / default-open / update:open / open-change` 控制和通知编辑层开关；`#read="{ value, text }"` 定制阅读内容。集中示例见 Form。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

统一光标色通过 `--c-field-caret-color` 设置（默认 `currentColor`）；本组件可用 `--c-textarea-caret-color` 单独覆盖，默认 `var(--c-field-caret-color)`。

## 配置清空后的值

`empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。

`empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。

延迟编辑的 `change` 在有来源时保留真实确认事件，例如保存按钮事件；程序触发的编辑器接力没有 DOM 事件，第二个参数可缺省。事件 target 可能是确认控件，不保证是输入元素。`change` 只通知，不等待监听器返回的 Promise；异步审批请使用 `before-commit`。

原生 textarea 固定使用 `autocomplete="off"`，与 Input、Maple 保持一致；原生属性透传不能覆盖此策略。

公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。

Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls. During deferred editing, clearing retains the configured valid empty-value and confirmation submits that empty value; null is not replaced by midnight. A newly created empty wheel panel may initialize a visible candidate without selecting or committing a model. Later explicit empty drafts in that panel are not automatically refilled. --- title: Time 时间 description: "表单时间字段。面板请使用 TimePicker。" permalink: /components/time/ --- # Time 父级在确认后保持弹层展开时，没有新选择的重复确认不会重复提交；新的时间选择会开启新事务，可以再次确认。 展开时，原生 combobox 通过 `aria-controls` 关联当前实例的命名弹层；关闭后同步更新状态并移除关联。`aria-label`、`aria-describedby` 可传递给原生控件。自定义 selected/触发插槽需自行保留可访问名称、键盘操作和状态关联。 表单时间字段（带触发器）。内部使用 `TimePicker`。 纯面板请使用 [`TimePicker`](/components/time-picker/)（默认无触发器）。时间范围字段请使用 [`TimeRange`](/components/time-range/)。 ## 基础示例 ### 基本用法 ## 外观与展示 ### 尺寸 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------- | | `size` | 尺寸 | 尺寸、表单控件尺寸对照 | | `variant` | 输入框变体 | 表单控件尺寸对照、字段外壳与配置边界 | | `placeholder` | 占位 | 表单控件尺寸对照、字段外壳与配置边界 | | `format` | 展示格式 | 字段外壳与配置边界、时间格式与十二小时制 | | `use12-hours` | 12 小时制 | 时间格式与十二小时制 | ### 表单控件尺寸对照 切换五档 size 和三种字段变体，比较 Input、Button、Select、日期时间及其他单行表单控件的高度。Button 在这里固定使用 outline。DatePicker/TimePicker 是面板，此处使用带输入框的 Date/Time 字段。示例同时展示有值、可清空、标签删除与长标签多选；Select/Cascader 设置 tag-nowrap 时保持同档高度，长标签文字省略、删除图标保留；标签行可横向滚动，清空按钮和箭头固定在外侧。被省略的标签正文支持悬停、键盘聚焦或点按查看完整文字，点外部或按 Esc 关闭，不改变选中值。可清空后恢复选中值重复比较。多行文本和允许换行的多选内容按内容撑高。 ### 字段外壳与配置边界 `hint` 控制浮动提示（Cedar 默认 false，Maple 默认 true），有 Form 外置标签时不启用。`line` 默认 true；`text-color / focus-color / blur-color` 为可选颜色字符串。`error` 未设置时继承 Form，显式 false 覆盖错误态。TimeRange 的 `separator` 默认 `~`，允许空字符串。默认 variant 保留 Cedar filled、Maple standard，可显式指定同一变体。 字段顶层负责值、默认值、展开、格式、步长、边界、禁用规则和只读/禁用状态。请直接在字段上设置这些属性，不放进 timePickerProps/timeRangePickerProps。嵌套配置只允许对应面板的展示属性；不能通过模型/确认/选择事件替换字段流程。类型会拒绝此类配置，运行时也过滤，且不会把嵌套规则作为顶层未设置时的回退。 Maple 的 pickerProps 可配置 optionHeight/optionCount 等外观，不可替换 columns、fieldNames、选中值、toolbar 或展开状态。popupProps 可设置定位、外观和生命周期回调，但不能设置 open/defaultOpen 或覆盖展开更新事件；顶层 popupContainer（包括 false）优先。纯时间面板内部的嵌套配置遵循相同规则。 字段交互由本库的一份实例控制器编排：select 暂存草稿，确认时按当前规则校验后提交并通知 Form。清除通过相同提交路径写入 undefined，再通知 clear；只读、禁用或未开启 clearable 时不能清除。只读仍可聚焦，focus/blur 去重；受控关闭请求尚未被接受时，不会重复提交。 ### 时间格式与十二小时制 比较分钟、秒和十二小时显示；注意午夜 12 AM 与中午 12 PM 的区别。值格式和步长边界仍独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 显示格式 未设置 `format` 时默认 `HH:mm:ss`；开启 `use12-hours` 后默认 `hh:mm:ss a`，字段与纯面板一致。显式 `format` 决定字符串值的解析和输出格式，`use12-hours` 还可独立控制面板小时列；建议十二小时格式包含 `a` 或 `A`，以区分上午与下午。 使用方括号包裹固定文字，例如 `[Time] HH:mm`。固定文字不参与时间列识别，不会因为包含 `s` 或 `A` 而额外显示秒或 AM/PM 列。空格式或没有时、分、秒 token 的格式回退到上述默认格式。
## 值模型与选择规则 ### 模型类型与固定文字 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ----------------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------- | | `format` | 展示格式 | 模型类型与固定文字、独立步长示例、时间上下限 | | `model-value` | 绑定值 | 独立步长示例 | | `use12-hours` | 12 小时制 | 独立步长示例 | | `step` | 时分秒步长 | 独立步长示例 | | `disable-confirm` | 跳过确认 | 跳过确认 | 字符串按 `format` 严格解析，不接受溢出时间或不匹配的格式；Date 和毫秒时间戳按本地时间反显。提交值始终为格式化字符串（范围为数组）。 ### 独立步长示例 十二小时显示与 5 小时步长组合时，步长从 24 小时制的零点计算，合法小时为 0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20，不在中午重新起算。AM 显示 12 / 05 / 10，PM 显示 03 / 08；03 PM 对应模型 15:30:00。切换规则不修改已有值，确认合法候选后才提交，取消保留原值；禁用 15 点后，03 PM 不可选，08 PM 仍对应 20 点。 With 12-hour display and a 5-hour step, hours remain anchored to midnight: 0/5/10/15/20, not restarted at noon. AM offers 12/05/10 and PM offers 03/08. Selecting 03 PM commits 15:30:00 because this Demo retains HH:mm:ss as its model format. Changing the rules preserves the old 09:30:00; cancellation does not commit aligned candidates. Only confirmation writes the selected value. Enable Disable 15:00 to combine disabled-hours with the step: 03 PM is unavailable while 08 PM still means 20:00. Turning off Accept controlled updates records proposals without changing the business value; re-enable it before confirming an accepted value. Proposal counts are not acceptance counts. Other non-dividing steps and physical touch remain separate coverage. 小时候选以 0 点为起点，十二小时制只改变显示；无效步长回退为 1。 ### 时间上下限 单值边界示例收紧下限至10:30:40后，字段仍反显已提交的10:30:38，纯面板不能确认。跨到31分钟后显式选择02秒，确认才将字段/模型更新为包含上界10:31:02；字段弹层改秒为00后Escape取消仍保持02。列表保留旧秒草稿时须自行选合法秒，不会把动态规则变化当作自动提交。 In the single-value bounds Demo, tightening the minimum retains committed 10:30:38 and prevents invalid confirmation. Explicitly selecting 10:31:02 and confirming commits the inclusive maximum. Editing the field popup draft to second 00 and canceling preserves second 02. Rule changes alone do not submit a new value. `min` / `max` 的类型为 `string`，默认不限制；格式固定为 24 小时制 `HH:mm` 或 `HH:mm:ss`，不受 `format` 或 `use12Hours` 影响，包含端点。`HH:mm` 的秒视为 00。范围的两个端点分别校验；`showNextDay` 不把边界变成跨午夜区间。`min > max` 时没有可提交时间。无法解析的边界按未设置处理。 动态修改边界不会改写外部模型。提交须同时满足边界、步长和禁用回调；不显示秒时按秒为 00 校验。列表粗粒度列在整个小时/分钟都越界时禁用，最终确认仍校验完整时间。隐藏禁用项使用 `hide-disabled-options`。 ### 跳过确认 ## 输入与状态控制 ### 交互状态对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ---------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------- | | `format` | 展示格式 | 交互状态对比、手输与面板选择、默认值与受控值 | | `readonly` | 只读 | 交互状态对比、选择与提交、多个字段与浮层切换 | | `clearable` | 可清除 | 手输与面板选择、默认值与受控值、选择与提交 | | `disabled` | 禁用 | 交互状态对比、选择与提交 | | `input-editable` | 允许桌面文本输入 | 手输与面板选择、复制与编辑 | | `open` | 弹层显隐 | 默认值与受控值 | 在同一实例上切换禁用、只读和错误状态后再操作控件，比较可编辑性和交互反馈。恢复开关位于目标控件外；错误外观本身不会执行校验。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 交互状态切换 适用于选择时间点。调整禁用、只读、错误反馈，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。
### 手输与面板选择 `inputEditable` 默认为 `true`（Maple 默认为 `false`）。回车或失焦提交，Esc 撤销；格式、步长、边界和禁用规则与面板一致。无效输入或父级拒绝受控更新时回到模型值；切换为不可编辑、只读或禁用会丢弃未提交输入。输入法组合期间不提交。范围两端之间移动焦点不提交。 ### 默认值与受控值 `defaultValue` 初始化字段/纯面板的非受控值，仅读取一次；后续选择保存在各自实例。传入 `modelValue` 后以父级值为准。字段 `defaultOpen` 只初始化一次；受控 `open` 需父级接收 `update:open`，`open-change(open: boolean)` 通知显隐请求。`clear` 不携带参数。纯面板支持 `disabled`，同时禁用范围两端。 ### 选择与提交 字段的 `focus` / `blur` 事件均无参数，同一次聚焦或失焦只通知一次；范围两端切换不产生额外整字段事件。只读字段仍可聚焦，但不能展开修改；禁用字段不能聚焦，已聚焦时动态禁用会释放焦点状态并通知失焦。 字段和纯面板提交时按当前格式、步长及禁用规则重新校验；Cedar 手动输入也遵守相同规则。规则变化不会自动改写已提交值。起止端点始终不自动交换；关闭 `show-next-day` 时倒序范围不能提交，开启后允许结束早于开始。清空仍提交 `undefined`，不受候选时间限制，但遵守只读/禁用状态。 `select(value, date)` 表示用户选择草稿，`change(value, date)` 表示提交。未配置 empty-value 时，单值和范围字段清除返回 `undefined`，对应 Date 参数也为 `undefined`；显式配置时保留允许的清空输出，`clear` 不带参数。Date 参数是本地时间表示（不自动进行次日日期运算）。字段默认确认后提交；`disable-confirm` 开启后仅有效选择立即提交并请求关闭，不允许次日时的倒序草稿仍不能提交。受控 `open` 仍需父级接受更新。独立纯面板同样默认确认后提交；开启 disable-confirm 后有效选择立即提交，但不会关闭面板。 父级直接替换模型会重置草稿，但不会触发 `select` 或 `change`。示例提供“外部更新”按钮，可与用户选择、确认提交分别观察。 字段使用 PickerField → FieldDecorator；面板只负责选择，不注入表单。有效文本在回车或失焦时提交，Escape 或外部关闭丢弃未确认草稿，清除立即提交空值。四类字段的统一示例见 [Date](/components/date/#统一字段与提交)。 ### 多个字段与浮层切换 示例分别展示单时间与范围的模型值。取消只丢弃当前字段的草稿，清除只影响当前字段；切换到其他字段不会提交尚未确认的选择。 ### 复制与编辑 open-trigger-target="icon" 时，输入区可以编辑或复制，只有右侧选择按钮响应点击打开。关闭手输或搜索后，已有文本仍可复制。 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，方向切换不修改时间或提交草稿。小时、分钟、秒等列按阅读顺序排列；左右键沿视觉方向跨列移动焦点。Cedar 的上下键与 Home/End 在当前时间列移动焦点，Enter/Space 选择，禁用项跳过；Maple 滚轮保留上下键和 Home/End 的选值行为。是否即时提交仍由原有确认配置决定。弹层继承字段来源方向。 ## API ### 空值识别与阅读空文案 `empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](/guide/empty-values/)。 | 参数 | 类型 | 缺省与范围 | | ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- | | empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 | | empty-text | string | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效 | 以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。 ### `time-picker-props`（支持 class/style），不再从未声明的 attrs 读取面板/浮层参数；id、aria-* 等属性透传给字段。 `click(event)` 只通知非禁用字段的点击；只读字段可通知但不展开。关闭统一监听 `open-change(false)`，它表示关闭请求，受控 open 仍需父级接受。两端不提供字段 close 事件；不要把关闭请求当作值提交。 In click/dblclick editors, internal panels hide confirmation tools, and the edit layer supplies one confirm/cancel pair. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults. `empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model. Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls. During deferred editing, clearing retains the configured valid empty-value and confirmation submits that empty value; null is not replaced by midnight. A newly created empty wheel panel may initialize a visible candidate without selecting or committing a model. Later explicit empty drafts in that panel are not automatically refilled. Reopening and cancelling does not publish another value. ### Field notifications and public types Field update:modelValue/change use TimeModelValue (TimeRangeModelValue for ranges). Normal selections commit formatted strings; explicit clears retain configured null, timestamps, Date objects or range arrays accepted by the property. Auxiliary dates may be undefined; clearing a range to an empty array also yields an empty auxiliary array. Clear does not emit select. Without format, the default is HH:mm:ss, or hh:mm:ss a with use12Hours=true. Bounds use 24-hour clock times, separate from Date-family valueFormat/time-zone rules. ### Complete field events and slots Events notify only; listener Promises are not collected. update:modelValue and change include null, 0, Date or range arrays allowed by the clearing policy. select reports formatted draft rather than saving. Field update:open/open-change are opening requests; initialization does not notify automatically. | Event | Prop | | --- | --- | | `update:modelValue` | `TimeRangeModelValue` | | `change` | `TimeRangeModelValue, (Date \| undefined)[] \| undefined` | | `select` | `(string \| undefined)[] \| undefined, (Date \| undefined)[] \| undefined` | | `clear` | `()` | | `click` | `Event` | | `focus` | `()` | | `blur` | `()` | | `update:open` | `boolean` | | `open-change` | `boolean` | Field focus(index?)/blur() target the actual input or trigger without changing model. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?). prefix, selected, suffix and extra are unscoped; ranges also have separator. Cedar direct mode has a custom default trigger slot; Maple does not. actions/extra belong to panel draft: Cedar direct forwards them, Maple direct does not, and deferred editing forwards them. Panel confirm() is not the outer field final-save entry point. Pure panels have actions/extra, without field read/clear-icon/loading-icon slots. Standalone panels expose no ref.confirm() method; custom confirmation uses actions.confirm. ### Complete pure-panel events Arguments are tuples from the corresponding public event type. Date arguments are parsed from formatted clock times and do not promise to preserve an input Date calendar day. | Event | Prop | | --- | --- | | `update:modelValue` | `TimeRangePickerEmits['update:modelValue']` | | `change` | `TimeRangePickerEmits['change']` | | `select` | `TimeRangePickerEmits['select']` | | `confirm` | `TimeRangePickerEmits['confirm']` | ### Panel business events and draft initialization Pure-panel business events are update:modelValue, change, select and confirm. select reports candidates; valid confirmation notifies confirm, while update:modelValue/change only occur for an actual value change. Field opening, clearing and focus events do not belong to pure panels. draft-initialize is an internal Maple bridge staging the first visible candidate for the field owner. It is not business selection/commit, emits no select/change and does not close editing. Cedar does not promise this signal. Public panel event types exclude it; business code should not depend on it. Complete panel actions scope below; extra has no arguments. ```ts import type { TimeValue } from '@cedar-design/ui' type PanelActionsScope = { confirm: () => boolean; canConfirm: boolean; value: Array | undefined } ``` ### Explicit save guard beforeCommit(payload, done, context) belongs to field saving. payload contains value/previousValue; context has signal and optional event. Returning undefined waits for done, while boolean/Promise results settle by their result. FormItem validates candidates first; failure retains draft. Ordinary select/change/confirm/click listener returns do not use this task protocol. ### Public types and entry points ```ts import { TimeRange, TimeRangePicker, type TimeRangeProps, type TimeRangeEmits, type TimeRangeSlots, type TimeRangeInstance, type TimeRangePickerProps, type TimeRangePickerEmits, type TimeRangePickerSlots } from '@cedar-design/ui' ``` ## CSS Variables

--- title: TimeRange 时间范围 description: "表单时间范围字段。面板请使用 TimeRangePicker。" permalink: /components/time-range/ --- # TimeRange 表单时间范围字段（带触发器）。内部使用 `TimeRangePicker`。 纯面板请使用 [`TimeRangePicker`](/components/time-range-picker/)（默认无触发器）。 ## 基础示例 ### 基本用法 ## 外观与展示 ### 尺寸 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | | `format` | 展示格式 | 字段外壳与配置边界、范围格式与十二小时制、次日标记 | | `clearable` | 可清除 | 范围格式与十二小时制、自定义占位、次日标记 | | `placeholder` | 占位 | 字段外壳与配置边界、自定义占位 | | `show-next-day` | 允许结束早于开始并显示「次日」；关闭时倒序范围不能提交，起止始终不交换 | 范围格式与十二小时制、次日标记 | | `size` | 尺寸 | 尺寸 | | `variant` | 输入框变体 | 字段外壳与配置边界 | ### 字段外壳与配置边界 `hint` 控制浮动提示（Cedar 默认 false，Maple 默认 true），有 Form 外置标签时不启用。`line` 默认 true；`text-color / focus-color / blur-color` 为可选颜色字符串。`error` 未设置时继承 Form，显式 false 覆盖错误态。TimeRange 的 `separator` 默认 `~`，允许空字符串。默认 variant 保留 Cedar filled、Maple standard，可显式指定同一变体。 字段顶层负责值、默认值、展开、格式、步长、边界、禁用规则和只读/禁用状态。请直接在字段上设置这些属性，不放进 timePickerProps/timeRangePickerProps。嵌套配置只允许对应面板的展示属性；不能通过模型/确认/选择事件替换字段流程。类型会拒绝此类配置，运行时也过滤，且不会把嵌套规则作为顶层未设置时的回退。 Maple 的 pickerProps 可配置 optionHeight/optionCount 等外观，不可替换 columns、fieldNames、选中值、toolbar 或展开状态。popupProps 可设置定位、外观和生命周期回调，但不能设置 open/defaultOpen 或覆盖展开更新事件；顶层 popupContainer（包括 false）优先。纯时间面板内部的嵌套配置遵循相同规则。 字段交互由本库的一份实例控制器编排：select 暂存草稿，确认时按当前规则校验后提交并通知 Form。清除通过相同提交路径写入 undefined，再通知 clear；只读、禁用或未开启 clearable 时不能清除。只读仍可聚焦，focus/blur 去重；受控关闭请求尚未被接受时，不会重复提交。 ### 范围格式与十二小时制 比较范围的分钟、秒与十二小时制显示，操作起止端点观察格式；跨日判断和值格式独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 显示格式 未设置 `format` 时默认 `HH:mm:ss`；开启 `use12-hours` 后默认 `hh:mm:ss a`，字段与纯面板一致。显式 `format` 决定字符串值的解析和输出格式，`use12-hours` 还可独立控制面板小时列；建议十二小时格式包含 `a` 或 `A`，以区分上午与下午。 使用方括号包裹固定文字，例如 `[Time] HH:mm`。固定文字不参与时间列识别，不会因为包含 `s` 或 `A` 而额外显示秒或 AM/PM 列。空格式或没有时、分、秒 token 的格式回退到上述默认格式。
### 自定义占位 ### 次日标记 结束时间早于开始时间时，开启 `show-next-day` 会在字段与面板结束侧显示「次日」并允许提交；关闭时倒序范围不能提交。起止端点始终不自动交换。 此示例开启文本编辑并显示模型，保留 22:00→次日06:00 的端点顺序；清除为 `undefined`，可通过重置按钮恢复。`show-next-day` 表示时间顺序与标签，不将模型自动转换为下一日日期。 ## 值模型与选择规则 ### 模型类型与固定文字 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------- | | `format` | 展示格式 | 模型类型与固定文字、独立步长示例、时间上下限 | | `use12-hours` | 12 小时制 | 独立步长示例 | 字符串按 `format` 严格解析，不接受溢出时间或不匹配的格式；Date 和毫秒时间戳按本地时间反显。提交值始终为格式化字符串（范围为数组）。 ### 独立步长示例 小时候选以 0 点为起点，十二小时制只改变显示；无效步长回退为 1。 可切换十二小时面板，分钟/秒步长保持不变；显式 `HH:mm:ss` 仍决定模型格式，AM/PM 选择转换为对应的 24 小时值。 ### 时间上下限 `min` / `max` 的类型为 `string`，默认不限制；格式固定为 24 小时制 `HH:mm` 或 `HH:mm:ss`，不受 `format` 或 `use12Hours` 影响，包含端点。`HH:mm` 的秒视为 00。范围的两个端点分别校验；`showNextDay` 不把边界变成跨午夜区间。`min > max` 时没有可提交时间。无法解析的边界按未设置处理。 动态修改边界不会改写外部模型。提交须同时满足边界、步长和禁用回调；不显示秒时按秒为 00 校验。列表粗粒度列在整个小时/分钟都越界时禁用，最终确认仍校验完整时间。隐藏禁用项使用 `hide-disabled-options`。 ## 输入与状态控制 ### 交互状态对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ---------------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------- | | `format` | 展示格式 | 交互状态对比、手输与面板选择、默认值与受控值 | | `clearable` | 可清除 | 手输与面板选择、默认值与受控值、选择与提交 | | `disabled` | 禁用 | 交互状态对比、选择与提交 | | `readonly` | 只读 | 交互状态对比、选择与提交 | | `input-editable` | 允许桌面文本输入 | 手输与面板选择、复制与编辑 | | `model-value` | 绑定值 | 默认值与受控值 | 在同一实例上切换禁用、只读和错误状态后再操作控件，比较可编辑性和交互反馈。恢复开关位于目标控件外；错误外观本身不会执行校验。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 交互状态切换 适用于营业时段等时间范围。调整禁用、只读、错误反馈，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。
### 手输与面板选择 `inputEditable` 默认为 `true`（Maple 默认为 `false`）。回车或失焦提交，Esc 撤销；格式、步长、边界和禁用规则与面板一致。无效输入或父级拒绝受控更新时回到模型值；切换为不可编辑、只读或禁用会丢弃未提交输入。输入法组合期间不提交。范围两端之间移动焦点不提交。 ### 默认值与受控值 `defaultValue` 初始化字段/纯面板的非受控值，仅读取一次；后续选择保存在各自实例。传入 `modelValue` 后以父级值为准。字段 `defaultOpen` 只初始化一次；受控 `open` 需父级接收 `update:open`，`open-change(open: boolean)` 通知显隐请求。`clear` 不携带参数。纯面板支持 `disabled`，同时禁用范围两端。 示例可分别拒绝值更新与展开更新：拒绝时保留父级模型/显隐，提案单独显示；重新打开从父级模型恢复。关闭请求不代表父级已接受。 父级拒绝关闭、面板保持展开时，没有新选择的重复确认不会重复提交；再次选择新时间会开启新事务，可重新确认提交。 ### 选择与提交 字段的 `focus` / `blur` 事件均无参数，同一次聚焦或失焦只通知一次；范围两端切换不产生额外整字段事件。只读字段仍可聚焦，但不能展开修改；禁用字段不能聚焦，已聚焦时动态禁用会释放焦点状态并通知失焦。 字段和纯面板提交时按当前格式、步长及禁用规则重新校验；Cedar 手动输入也遵守相同规则。规则变化不会自动改写已提交值。起止端点始终不自动交换；关闭 `show-next-day` 时倒序范围不能提交，开启后允许结束早于开始。清空仍提交 `undefined`，不受候选时间限制，但遵守只读/禁用状态。 `select(value, date)` 表示用户选择草稿，`change(value, date)` 表示提交。未配置 empty-value 时，单值和范围字段清除返回 `undefined`，对应 Date 参数也为 `undefined`；显式配置时保留允许的清空输出，`clear` 不带参数。Date 参数是本地时间表示（不自动进行次日日期运算）。字段默认确认后提交；`disable-confirm` 开启后仅有效选择立即提交并请求关闭，不允许次日时的倒序草稿仍不能提交。受控 `open` 仍需父级接受更新。独立纯面板同样默认确认后提交；开启 disable-confirm 后有效选择立即提交，但不会关闭面板。 父级直接替换模型会重置草稿，但不会触发 `select` 或 `change`。示例提供“外部更新”按钮，可与用户选择、确认提交分别观察。 起止输入使用同一字段焦点：Tab 在两端间切换时保留草稿，不触发 blur 校验或提交；Enter 或离开整个字段才提交，Escape 丢弃草稿。点击结束输入会激活时间面板的结束端。 字段使用 PickerField → FieldDecorator；面板只负责选择，不注入表单。有效文本在回车或失焦时提交，Escape 或外部关闭丢弃未确认草稿，清除立即提交空值。四类字段的统一示例见 [Date](/components/date/#统一字段与提交)。 ### 复制与编辑 open-trigger-target="icon" 时，输入区可以编辑或复制，只有右侧选择按钮响应点击打开。关闭手输或搜索后，已有文本仍可复制。 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ## 阅读方向 范围值始终保持 `[开始, 结束]`，LTR/RTL 切换只调整布局，不交换端点或修改跨日语义。时间列与起止面板按阅读顺序排列，左右键沿视觉方向移动焦点，可跨起止时间列；Cedar 上下键移动焦点、Enter/Space 选择，Maple 上下键保留滚轮选值语义。草稿与确认行为沿用原有配置，弹层继承字段来源方向。 ## Other settings remain unchanged while comparing. ## Layout and arrangement ### Placement #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `content` | Hint content | Placement | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default top. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement | - `placement`: Chooses the position relative to the trigger. ## Content and presentation ### Directive The directive opens on hover or focus and allows the pointer to enter the tooltip. Escape closes the topmost tooltip. Multiple directive instances can coexist with regular Tooltip components. `v-tooltip:ellipsis` applies single-line truncation; pure text shows a tooltip only when its actual layout overflows, while elements with children continue to show a tooltip. ## Directive options type `TooltipOptions` can be imported from the root or `@cedar-design/ui/tooltip`; it contains required `content` and optional `placement`. ## API ### Tooltip Props Tooltip inherits Trigger positioning, container, controlled state, and `close` policies. Its defaults are `hide-empty=true` and `auto-fit-transform-origin=true`; an omitted `animation-name` uses the Tooltip animation. Empty content hides only the tooltip and does not change `open`; component nodes count as content. The instance exposes seven methods: `open`, `close`, `resize`, `allowClose`, `getReference`, `focusReference`, and `setReference`. | Prop | Description | Type | Default | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | content | Hint content | `string` | — | | status | Panel intent | `default \| primary \| info \| success \| warning \| danger` | `default` | | size | Implemented sizes | `xs \| md` | `md` | | color | Background color | `string` | — | | text-color | Custom text color | `string` | — | | trigger | Interaction | `TriggerEvent \| TriggerEvent[]`
`TriggerEvent: 'manual' \| 'hover' \| 'click' \| 'focus' \| 'contextMenu'` | `['hover', 'focus']` | | placement | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default top. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `TriggerPlacement`
`'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'left-start' \| 'left-end' \| 'right-start' \| 'right-end'` | `top` | | show-arrow | Show the arrow | `boolean` | `true` | | popup-offset | Main-axis distance | `number` | `10` | | unmount-on-close | Unmount after close | `boolean` | `true` | Events: `update:open`, `open-change`, `open`, `opened`, `close`, `closed`, `click-outside`. Slots: `default`, `content`. Exposes `open`, `close`, `resize`, `allowClose`, `getReference`, `setReference` and `focusReference`. Tooltip content has `role="tooltip"` and its ID is added to the actual reference’s `aria-describedby` while open. Existing and reference-attrs descriptions are merged without duplicates; closing, changing references or unmounting removes the tooltip ID and preserves existing descriptions. ## Usage notes Use `color` to customize the background and `size="xs"` for the smallest size. There is no `backgroundColor` or boolean `xs` prop. ## CSS Variables These are actual :root defaults. Prefer component variables for business customization; internal positioning variables are not public API. All built-in themes use opacity 1. Colored solid text follows Button on-dark in both light/dark modes. Maple dark mode retains 4px radius, 14px font and 8px/16px vertical/horizontal padding. Neutral surfaces remain dark in both modes. `color` sets content/arrow backgrounds; `text-color` sets text. Explicit content-style/arrow-style override their respective nodes. Recheck custom colors/opacity. With Teleport, variables must be in the actual popup scope, for example through `popup-style`. Trigger-button variables do not automatically inherit into popups.

--- lang: en-US permalink: /en/components/transfer/ --- # Transfer Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases. When omitted, `disabled` and `readonly` inherit from FormItem / Form; explicit false overrides the corresponding state. Both block transfers, sorting, renaming and custom header clear actions. Readonly still allows asynchronous options to load for display. When the target list changes from empty to populated, enabled drag sorting attaches to the list. Items use their own checkboxes or action buttons without an extra inert row focus stop. Icon-only clear and target action menu controls are native buttons with localized names. Within FormItem, the form error describes the transfer group instead of being repeated on every internal option. Caller-provided `role` and `aria-describedby` remain intact. When a target value is absent from the current data, the target list still displays its label, falling back to its value. Updating data alone does not change the model. Disabled or required status cannot be inferred for a missing item; keep the corresponding option in data when those restrictions are needed. ## Basic examples ### Basic usage - `data`: Data of the transfer - `default-value`: The default value in the target selection box (uncontrolled state) ## Search and data structures ### Search #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --------------------------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------- | | `data` | Data of the transfer | Search, Grouped, Tree | | `source-filterable` | Show the source search input | Search, Grouped | | `default-value` | Complete uncontrolled target-side state | Search, Tree | | `source-filter-placeholder` | Source search placeholder | Search, Grouped | | `target-filterable` | Show the target search input | Search | | `target-filter-placeholder` | Target search placeholder | Search | - `data`: Data of the transfer - `default-value`: The default value in the target selection box (uncontrolled state) Dragging a filtered target list reorders only visible positions in the complete target sequence. --- lang: en-US permalink: /en/components/tree-select/ --- # TreeSelect A tree-backed selection field with explicit search fields and controlled selection. ## Reading direction Inherits source dir. Horizontal keys expand, enter children, return or collapse according to reading direction; vertical keys and Home/End keep logical order. Search uses the actual active match. Values and multiple-value arrays are not reversed. Portaled content retains source direction in custom containers. ## Search migration filterable replaces allowSearch. The old object retainInputValue option is now the independent retain-input-value boolean. filterable enables search; retain-input-value only retains query text after selecting. Default single selection disables search and multiple selection enables it. Default local matching now searches label and ignores case. Restore the previous matching with search-fields=['value'] and case-sensitive=true. Multiple configured fields use OR matching. Custom filter-tree-node owns its matching rules. disableFilter bypasses built-in filtering. ## Basic examples ### Basic ### Api Review ## Data and options ### Search Matching #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | -------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | | `data` | Data | Search Matching, Retain the query after selecting | | `filterable` | Whether to allow searching | Search Matching, Retain the query after selecting | | `case-sensitive` | Case-sensitive built-in search | Search Matching | | `multiple` | Whether to support multiple selection | Retain the query after selecting | | `retain-input-value` | Keep search text after selecting an option | Retain the query after selecting | ### Retain the query after selecting Type Al, then select Alice: the selected model contains Alice in both examples. Without retain-input-value the search text becomes empty; with it enabled, Al remains so Alan is still easy to select next. This does not control the selected label or whether the field is searchable. filterable enables searching. The candidate `data` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. Components own loading, cancellation and stale results, and emit load-error on failure. Choice groups initialize with an empty query; searchable fields load when queries change. TreeSelectValue, TreeSelectLabelValue, TreeSelectReadScope, TreeSelectNodeStatus, TreeSelectEmits, TreeSelectSlots and TreeSelectExpose are available from the root and tree-select entry points. There is no default editor replacement slot; use tree-slot-label for node content. ### Form field presentation and confirmation Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled. ### In-place editing and keyboard precedence `click`/`dblclick` use Form's editing inheritance. Hover/focus shows an edit icon that opens editing directly. disabled, readonly and readPretty hide edit entries. Panel clicks change only the draft. While open, arrows navigate visible enabled nodes; Left/Right collapse/expand or move to parents/children; Home/End reach first/last nodes. Enter selects/checks the current node, or toggles an unselectable branch. Search prioritizes matching nodes; multiple selection uses Tree checking rules. Esc first closes the panel, retaining the draft and restoring input focus. With the panel closed, Enter saves and Esc cancels editing. Compare AutoComplete/PeopleSelect in Form's unified field-presentation examples. Checkboxes in a multiple-selection tree do not create separate Tab stops. Pointer selection retains input focus, and nodes expose checked and mixed states through `aria-checked`. Duplicate expansion requests for the same asynchronously loaded node are merged. Replacing nodes, closing editors or resetting Form invalidates old requests so they cannot expand/check nodes. Arrows can enter loaded children immediately. Query/candidate changes clear old filters before Enter can choose stale options. Field confirmation still validates before asynchronous commit. ### Node fields and business values Nodes default to `{ value, label, children }`. `value` is a tree-wide unique string/number, including `0`; `label` is display content. Map other backend fields with `fieldNames: { value: 'id', label: 'text', children: 'items' }` without changing backend data. Declarative child `name`, Vue `:key` and Table `rowKey` retain separate meanings. Independent Tree state uses `selectedValues/defaultSelectedValues`, `checkedValues/defaultCheckedValues`, `halfCheckedValues` and `expandedValues/defaultExpandedValues`, updated through corresponding named v-models. `check` event indeterminate sets use `halfCheckedValues`. Node content uses `label`; TreeSelect forwards `tree-slot-label`. `scrollIntoView({ value })` locates business values; explicit `index` remains a zero-based virtual-list array `index`. ### Search configuration Use `filterable` for searching; omission follows only `multiple`. Enabling `tree-checkable` alone creates a `multiple`-value model without enabling searching; set `filterable` explicitly. `retain-input-value` independently retains search text after selection and defaults to false. Replace the old `allow-search` with `filterable`. Replace `{ retainInputValue: true }` with `filterable` plus `retain-input-value`. ### Built-in search fields `searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node. ## Configuring the cleared value `empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults. Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests. ### Input and open button The native combobox and separate open button both announce aria-haspopup=tree. While the panel is visible, the same aria-controls points to the actual tree. Expanded state stays synchronized; disabled/readonly and open-trigger-target rules remain in force. ### Selection actions during loading While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching. Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing. ## CSS Variables

--- permalink: /components/tree-select/ --- # TreeSelect 多选时，`inline` 下拉只显示选项；已选内容、单项移除和清空由输入框承担。确认式编辑面板保留“已选／清空”，选择为草稿，确认后提交。 可以对树形结构数据进行选择。 ## 阅读方向 继承来源 dir；左右键按阅读方向展开、进入子级、返回或折叠，上下键及 Home/End 保持逻辑顺序。搜索使用实际匹配活动项，业务值和多选数组不随 RTL 反转。弹层在自定义挂载容器内也保留来源方向。 ## 基础示例 ### 基础用法 基础用法。 ## 数据与选项 ### 搜索大小写与匹配字段 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | -------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | | `data` | 树节点数据 | 搜索大小写与匹配字段、选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 | | `filterable` | 是否启用搜索 | 搜索大小写与匹配字段、选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 | | `case-sensitive` | 内置搜索是否区分大小写 | 搜索大小写与匹配字段 | | `multiple` | 多选 | 选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 | | `retain-input-value` | 选中后保留搜索文本 | 选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 | 现在统一默认为 label、不区分大小写。` :search-fields="['value', 'label']"` 同时匹配两字段；字段通过 fieldNames 映射。自定义 filterTreeNode 优先，disableFilter=true 跳过本地筛选。匹配祖先时保留父子树路径，可见节点和键盘候选使用同一规则。 如需按 value 区分大小写搜索，显式设置 `:search-fields="['value']" case-sensitive`。 ### 选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 输入 Al，再点 Alice：两种情况都已经选中 Alice。不开 retain-input-value 时搜索输入清成空字符串；开启后输入框里还保留 Al，方便接着选同样匹配 Al 的 Alan。它不控制选中人员的显示名称，也不负责开启搜索；filterable 才是允许输入搜索词。 候选属性 `data` 支持数组或 `(query, { signal }) => 数组/Promise`。加载、取消、过期结果隔离由组件内部处理，失败触发 load-error。单选/多选分组初始化以空字符串查询，搜索型字段在查询变化时调用；树形字段根数据与原有 load-more 子节点懒加载独立。 ## 生命周期与边界 ### 透传配置边界与优先级 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | | `data` | 树节点数据 | 透传配置边界与优先级 | | `tree-props` | 传给内部树的配置，选中状态仍由 TreeSelect 管理 | 透传配置边界与优先级 | | `open-trigger-target` | 打开面板的点击区域；field 为整个字段，icon 仅右侧选择按钮。不影响键盘展开及受控 open。 | 复制与编辑 | | `filterable` | 是否启用搜索 | 复制与编辑 | 建议使用 `TreeSelectTriggerOptions`、`TreeSelectTreeOptions`。Trigger 的 open/defaultOpen、disabled、popupContainer、closeOnClickReference、autoFitTransformOrigin 由 TreeSelect 提供；这里 popup-container 只使用顶层值，没有嵌套容器回退。树的 data、选择/勾选集合、选择模式、fieldNames、加载、搜索、size、checkable/selectable 归顶层管理。Tree 普通配置覆盖默认展示配置，但随后会被顶层的托管字段覆盖；Panel 最后注入 selectedValues/checkedValues 和 disableSelectActionOnly。showLine、展开配置等未托管能力继续有效。通知监听不应代替 TreeSelect 的选择协议，使用顶层组件事件。 本次仅新增可主动选用的专用类型，不收窄已发布的宽属性类型，不增加运行时过滤、不改变覆盖顺序；旧业务写法继续可编译。若直接使用旧宽属性，内部托管字段仍可能通过类型检查，但不代表能控制内部状态。 ```ts import type { TreeSelectTreeOptions, TreeSelectTriggerOptions, } from "@cedar-design/ui"; ``` ### 复制与编辑 open-trigger-target="icon" 时，输入区可以编辑或复制，只有右侧选择按钮响应点击打开。关闭手输或搜索后，已有文本仍可复制。 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ## 或当前候选请求处于加载状态时，纯选择字段保留已有值，暂停新选择、清空与标签移除。被阻止的动作不发送业务通知，也不提交模型。字段搜索仍可输入，disabled/readonly 不因此改写；需要禁止搜索时单独设置。 延迟编辑层的清空和确认在此期间不可用，仍可取消或关闭。手动标记和当前请求都结束后，操作按正常规则恢复，并继续尊重禁用选项。Input、AutoComplete 等自由文本字段的 loading 继续允许文本编辑与清空，不套用选择值的暂停规则。 ## CSS Variables

`allowClose()` 只恢复内部关闭门控；没有公开的对应禁用方法，也不能用它阻止关闭。 ### 方位语义与配置入口 placement 是首选方位，auto-fit-position 默认 true 时最终方位可能变化；它不是 position 坐标。top-start 与 top-left 不是同一种枚举：前者是锚点方位及沿边对齐，后者是容器角落。top/bottom 的 start/end 随阅读方向镜像；left/right 仍是物理方位，纵向 start/end 维持上下语义。 ## 参考元素的原生事件修饰符 `click`、`mouseenter`、`mouseleave`、`focusin`、`focusout`、`contextmenu` 的原生监听器和 `.once`、`.capture`、`.passive` 均绑定到实际参考元素，不会落到浮层。`.once` 按原生元素的监听生命周期执行；更新回调不重新启用已消费的监听，换参考元素或移除后重加监听才开始新的周期。停用和卸载会解绑。普通监听器只通知，返回 Promise 不驱动打开或加载，异常进入 Vue 的事件错误处理链。 `reference-attrs` 的 `aria-describedby` 与参考元素已有描述 ID 合并去重；清理或更换引用时恢复原始属性。 `fixed` 定位会识别 transform、filter、perspective 等形成的固定定位包含块，并处理轴向缩放；不保证旋转或倾斜坐标系精确。可访问的同源 iframe 引用与弹层之间会换算坐标并绑定各自文档事件；不支持跨源或无共同祖先的浏览上下文。启用 `update-at-scroll` 时，两端文档及可滚动祖先的滚动都会更新位置。

--- lang: en-US permalink: /en/components/upload/ --- # Upload Disabled downloads match Link/Button link mode: remove href while retaining the link role, `aria-disabled` and `tabindex=-1`, and cancel the default click action. `readonly` still allows downloading. This differs from the file-read completion event. ### Upload Methods Provides chooseFile(), replace(file,replacement?), submit(file?), abort(file?), retry(file), remove(file), reset(), clearSuccess(), clearError(), getFiles(status?), preview(file) and closePreview(). useUploader(options) provides headless upload logic, addFiles(files), and input/drag handlers. chooseFile, replace, submit, retry and remove return `Promise` for their preparation stages. submit/retry await preparation hooks and request-factory creation, without guaranteeing network completion; success/error events report results. chooseFile completion does not mean the user has selected a file, and remove completion does not mean a controlled parent accepted its proposal. Item/remove-button remove, retry and replace, and trigger chooseFile retain the same Promise types. All public methods are callable before the editor first mounts. When it is unmounted, closed or deactivated, getFiles(status?) returns shallow snapshots of the accepted model filtered by status; asynchronous mutations settle as no-ops and synchronous mutations are no-ops. To perform an operation, first open and mount the editor through field interaction or controlled open, or use editMode="direct". Stored method references forward to the current instance after closing/reopening; cancelling an editor preserves the accepted model. ### Controlled state and lifecycle If a controlled parent rejects an addition, only read/list proposals emit; automatic upload waits until that uid is accepted, then runs once. Same-tick proposals merge transactionally; across ticks, the actual parent list is authoritative. Rejected entries do not count toward total size. Parents own consistency of late list replacements. Explicit removal of rejected items, reset or unmount releases generated URLs; external URLs are never revoked. Built-in preview retains its own URL ownership until closing and does not close another component's later preview. Cancellation covers before-upload, asynchronous headers/data/name and asynchronous custom-request handles. Retrying or replacing a File under the same uid invalidates old callbacks. before-read/before-upload replacements recheck limits. max-total-size counts accepted entries and the current valid prepared batch/request only. Disabled/readonly block selection, removal, submission and other mutations; readonly allows preview/download. KeepAlive deactivation cancels preparation/requests; reactivation allows new operations. ## Types UploadProps、UploadEmits、UploadSlots、UploadExpose、UploadPublicMethods、UploadFileItem、UploadStatus、UploadListType、UploadResolveType、UploadImageFit、UploadCapture、UploadRejectedFile、UploadRejectedReason、UploadRequestOptions、UploadRequest、UploadCustomRequest、UploadProgressEvent、UploadData、UploadHeaders、UploadBeforeRead、UploadBeforeUpload、UploadBeforeRemove、UploadCreateThumbnailUrl、UploadIsSuccessResponse、UploadRequestChoose、UploadPreviewEvent、UseUploaderOptions、UploadInstance。 ## CSS Variables Public variable suffixes match across platforms; all defaults appear below with c/mp prefixes respectively. ### Form field presentation and confirmation This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled. `before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form. Attachment confirmation commits file-list relationships; it cannot undo completed remote uploads or permanent deletion. To defer network side effects, set `auto-upload="false"` and upload after the final business submission. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. ## Cover attachments and video duration `reupload` (default false) enables a per-item replacement action, including when maxFiles has been reached. `replace(file, replacement?: File): Promise` opens a single-file chooser or validates the supplied File. It respects readonly/disabled and the chooser hook. Validation and beforeRemove run before an atomic in-place replacement proposal with a new UID; count and total size exclude the old item. Cancellation, rejection, guard veto and stale targets preserve the old item. A controlled parent decides acceptance. The `replace(next, previous)` event is a model proposal, not remote success or removal; remove is not emitted. Once accepted, obsolete transport callbacks are ignored; new upload failures can be retried. The item slot also exposes replace(). `UploadFileItem.duration?: number` uses seconds, displayed as mm:ss / h:mm:ss; unknown/invalid durations are hidden. Metadata reads local File objects only, waits at most 5 seconds and cleans temporary resources. Business code supplies remote durations. Video previews use popupContainer. Duration-badge variables: `--c-upload-duration-background: var(--c-sys-color-surface-tooltip)`, `--c-upload-duration-color: var(--c-sys-color-content-on-dark)`, `--c-upload-duration-radius: var(--c-sys-radius-sm)`, `--c-upload-duration-padding: var(--c-sys-space-1) var(--c-sys-space-2)`, `--c-upload-duration-font-size: var(--c-sys-font-size-sm)`. ### Guard waiting feedback Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection/failure restores interaction, and repeated input does not restart the same operation. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate. Files remain concurrent; feedback aggregates all current guard tasks without treating change/progress notifications as tasks. `useUploader()` exposes readonly `guardPending`, aggregating currently awaited before hooks. It does not represent upload progress. ### Preparation vetoes and exceptions `beforeUpload` returning `false` or resolving to `false` is a business veto: no transport starts, the item stays `ready`, and neither `error` nor `rejected` is emitted. Throwing or rejecting is a preparation failure: no transport starts, the item becomes `error`, and the existing `error(item)` event reports the original cause as `item.error` exactly once. This event covers preparation and transport failures; it does not imply an HTTP request was sent. Both outcomes permit a later submission with a valid hook result. Notification return Promises do not hold the preparation task open. Obsolete or canceled attempts cannot report a new `error`.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Verification codes are LTR content: rendering, pasting and focus movement use the original string order, while outer align start/end follows reading direction. RTL does not reverse code characters. Numeric and text codes share this order contract.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

Explicit null is a controlled empty code and never falls back to default-value, which applies only when model-value is absent. reset() still proposes an empty string. Presentation clearing can submit null through empty-value=null; finish never receives null. An omitted model-value remains uncontrolled.

In deferred mode input / paste describe editing, while finish describes the finally accepted complete value. Canceling, rejection, readonly, disabled, external replacement or unmount retires unaccepted completion notifications. Ordinary finish listener Promises do not hold confirmation. A synchronous undefined before-commit return waits for done. Invalid type / align values diagnose and fall back to digit / center; gutter=0 and 0px remain valid.

### VerificationCode Events

| Event | Prop | Semantics |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| input | character, index, event | Starting character and zero-based index of each valid native input proposal |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null | Complete-code proposal |
| change | value: string \| null | Complete-code proposal for each valid edit, not necessarily accepted by a controlled parent |
| finish | value: string | Direct mode notifies after the parent accepts the complete code in the current render; deferred mode waits for confirmation guards and parent acceptance, never draft completion |
| update:open | open: boolean | Controlled editor visibility update |
| open-change | open: boolean | Actual editor visibility change |
| paste | text, event | Pasted text after paste-transform/type processing |
| focus / blur | FocusEvent | Focus enters/leaves the whole component; moving between cells does not duplicate notifications |
| click | MouseEvent | Non-disabled click |

Valid input order: input → update:modelValue → change. finish waits until the parent accepts the complete value in that render. Rejected controlled values restore native inputs; later asynchronous parent assignments do not add finish. reset() proposes empty and emits update:modelValue/change without simulating native input. Disabled, readonly or composing state prevents reset from changing values.

Paste overwrites from the current cell; root-level paste starts at cell 1. Input beyond the first empty cell moves to that first empty cell. A whole-code native input distributes across subsequent cells. SMS suggestions depend on the platform and browser: Cedar hints one-time-code on the first cell, while Maple retains autocomplete=off for all cells. Typing one character in a filled cell replaces that cell even when the caret follows its old character. Composition prefers the current compositionend text, including multiple code points, and falls back to the native value only when event data is missing. Processing is type filtering, formatter, then length clipping; rejected characters consume no cell. Text counts Unicode code points rather than grapheme clusters. External values affect display without an automatic formatted model update.

| read | { value: string \| null, text: string } | Custom read content, taking precedence over empty-text |

### VerificationCode Methods

- focus(index?): zero-based index; defaults to the first empty cell or the last cell when full. Direct readonly fields can receive focus. Deferred mode opens an editable panel first; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open.
- blur(): blur the current editor without reopening the panel.
- reset(): in direct mode, propose an empty value while respecting controlled ownership, disabled/readonly state, and composition. In deferred mode, open an empty draft; model and change notifications wait for final confirmation and before-commit approval. Cancellation preserves the original value.

Public methods remain callable from initial component mount. Stored methods resolve the current editor on every call and never use an old input after closure, reopening, or mode changes. Native input references are undefined while no editor is mounted.

### Keyboard and Form

Left/Right move between cells. Backspace removes the current character, or the previous one when empty. Delete removes the current character; following characters shift forward. IME composition does not trim, delete or move focus. Each native input has an SSR-stable id. Cell 1 uses autocomplete=one-time-code, others off. Provide aria-label.

InputGroup/Form state is inherited, with explicit disabled/readonly/error/size taking precedence. Internal cell Inputs do not duplicate Form notifications; the complete control notifies input/change once per edit. Both platforms implement three variants/five sizes using local FieldDecorator tokens.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

- reset()：direct 模式提议清空，遵守受控模型及禁用/只读/组合输入限制；延迟模式先打开并清空草稿，最终确认及 before-commit 通过前不发模型更新或 change，取消则保留原值。

公开方法从组件首次挂载起保持可调用；保存下来的方法每次查找当前编辑器，关闭、重开、切换模式后不会操作旧输入。尚未挂载或已经关闭的原生输入引用为 undefined。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

# ActionSheet

### Intro

An action sheet pops up to give the user the ability to select options.
`ActionSheet` supports service and component calls. The service uses a separate application and mounts to body; the component uses its host application context and `popup-container`.
The function returns a `Promise`, on selection return `action`. Click modal close to return `close`.

## Function calls

### Basic usage

```html
<script setup>
  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui'

  async function createBasic() {
    const action = await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
        },
      ],
    })

    action !== 'close' && Message(`Selected: ${action.name}`)
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="createBasic">Basic usage</mp-button>
</template>
```

### Keep actions open after selection

`closeOnClickAction` prevents `ActionSheet` from closing automatically on selection, allowing repeated choices.
Since a `Promise` resolves only once, use `onSelect` to observe repeated user choices.

```html

  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui'

  async function handleSelect() {
    await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
        },
      ],
      closeOnClickAction: false,
      onSelect: (action) => Message(`Selected: ${action.name}`),
    })
  }
</script>

<template>

</template>
```
