## Keyboard and dialog name

Default actions use native buttons; disabled actions cannot be focused or selected. The title or title slot names the dialog, unless an explicit `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` overrides it. The visible cancel button requests closure through the close guard.

## Controlled state

When an action is selected, `close-on-click-action` requests an `open` update. A controlled parent that keeps `open=true` keeps the sheet `open`. Without `open`, `default-open` initializes internal state.

## API

`open/defaultOpen` control current/initial uncontrolled panel visibility. Use `v-model:open` for two-way binding. defaultOpen is read once without initialization writeback.

### ActionSheet Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ | -------- |
| `v-model:open` | Controlled visibility | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `default-open` | Initial uncontrolled visibility | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `before-close` | Close guard | _PopupBeforeClose_ | `-` |
| `swipe-to-close` | Enable downward swipe in the header | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `swipe-threshold` | Downward close threshold (CSS px) | _number_ | `40` |
| `actions` | Action list | _Actions_ | `[]` |
| `title` | Action sheet title | _string_ | `请选择` |
| `overlay` | Show overlay | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `overlay-class` | Custom overlay class | _string_ | `-` |
| `overlay-style` | Custom overlay style | _object_ | `-` |
| `lock-scroll` | Whether to disable scrolling penetration, scrolling the Dialog when disabled will not cause the body to scroll | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `close-on-click-action` | Whether to close the actions sheet when clicking action | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `overlay-closable` | Whether to click the overlay to close the action sheet | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `esc-to-close` | Whether to support keyboard ESC to close the action sheet | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `safe-area` | Whether to adapt to the bottom, left and right safe areas | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `popup-container` | The location of the action sheet to mount | _TeleportProps['to'] \| false_ | `body` |

### ActionSheet Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --------------- | -------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `update:open` | Request an update to visibility | `boolean` |
| `close-error` | Close guard error | `error: unknown, reason: PopupCloseReason` |
| `select` | Triggered when selecting an action sheet | `action: Action` |
| `open` | Triggered when opening an action sheet | `-` |
| `opened` | Triggered when an action sheet open-animation ends | `-` |
| `close` | Triggered when closing an action sheet | `-` |
| `closed` | Triggered when an action sheet close-animation ends | `-` |
| `click-overlay` | Triggered when clicking the overlay | `MouseEvent` |
| `key-escape` | Triggered when pressing ESC | `KeyboardEvent` |

### ActionSheet Methods

| Method | Description | Prop | Returns |

### Closing from the title dropdown

`swipe-to-close` defaults to false. When enabled, the header can be dragged down to close; `swipe-threshold` defaults to 40 CSS px. Custom title slots use the surrounding header handle. Body options and header buttons do not initiate dragging. See Popup for gesture details.
`before-close` forwards to Popup. Overlay, Esc, route, dropdown and post-action `open` changes may be rejected asynchronously. Exceptions emit `close-error(error, reason)`. An action `select` event does not mean closing was approved.

## before hooks and done compatibility

The guard signature is `beforeClose({ reason }, done, { signal, event })`.

Return true/false or `Promise<boolean>`; a normally resolved async void result allows closing. Call done() to allow or done(false) to reject; synchronous void waits for done. The first result wins. Pending requests are deduplicated; errors retain the sheet and restore temporary button state. The third context argument supplies `signal` and the optional original `event`. Closing, unmounting or replacing the hook invalidates stale results.

Synchronous logging-only hooks must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means awaiting a callback. Earlier `Promise<void>` hooks without done now allow closing when their Promise resolves.

Popup reasons are overlay, escape, route, swipe, close, api and model. Rejecting an external open=false requests update:open(true). The component does not expose `requestClose()`; use an existing guarded close entry. Direct destruction does not wait for the hook.

Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.
`ActionSheet.close()` requests closing and respects `beforeClose`. A veto retains the service owner so closing can be requested again. A new programmatic invocation replaces the previous singleton: it disposes the previous host and settles its result as `close`, without waiting for that `close` guard or synthesizing lifecycle notifications.

# 动作面板

### 介绍

弹出一个动作面板提供用户选择选项的能力。
`ActionSheet` 提供函数式和组件式调用。函数服务使用独立应用并强制挂载到 body；组件遵循所在应用上下文和 `popup-container`。
函数返回一个 `Promise`，选择时返回 `当前选择的 action`，点击背景层关闭返回 `close`。

## 函数调用

### 基本使用

```html
<script setup>
  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui'

  async function createBasic() {
    const action = await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
        },
      ],
    })

    action !== 'close' && Message(`您选择的是:${action.name}`)
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="createBasic">基本使用</mp-button>
</template>
```

## 键盘与对话框名称

默认动作使用原生按钮，禁用动作不可聚焦或选择。标题和 title 插槽为对话框提供名称；显式 `aria-label` 或 `aria-labelledby` 可覆盖。可见的取消按钮通过关闭守卫请求关闭。

## 受控状态

选择动作时，`close-on-click-action` 会请求更新 `open`；受控父组件保持 `open=true` 时面板保持打开。未传 `open` 时使用 `default-open` 初始化内部状态。

### 标题下拉关闭

`swipe-to-close` 默认 false；开启后可以从默认标题向下拖动关闭。`swipe-threshold` 默认为 40 CSS px。自定义 title 插槽沿用外层标题拖动区域，正文选项和标题内按钮不会触发拖动关闭。详见 Popup 的头部手势说明。
`before-close` 透传到 Popup，遮罩、Esc、路由、下拉以及操作后修改 `open` 的关闭请求均可异步拒绝；异常触发 `close-error(error, reason)`。操作的 `select` 表示选择事件，不代表关闭已获批准。

## before 钩子与 done 兼容

守卫签名为 `beforeClose({ reason }, done, { signal, event })`。

返回 true/false 或 `Promise<boolean>`；async 函数正常完成且返回 void 时放行。回调方式使用 done() 放行、done(false) 拒绝；同步返回 void 时等待 done，可异步调用。返回值和 done 同时使用时，第一次完成生效。等待中去重；异常保留弹层并恢复临时按钮状态。`signal` 和可选原始 `event` 由第三个 context 参数提供。关闭、卸载或更换钩子会使旧结果失效。

只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。

Popup 原因为 overlay、escape、route、swipe、close、api、model。拒绝外部 open=false 时请求 update:open(true)。组件未公开 `requestClose()`；需要受守卫控制的关闭时使用现有关闭入口，直接销毁组件不会等待内部钩子。

函数调用的通知回调不控制任务完成。服务的选择或关闭结果独立于回调异常结算，关闭完成时仍会清理所属宿主。异常继续通过调用方或 Vue 错误通道传递；回调返回 Promise 不控制 loading 或关闭。
`ActionSheet.close()` 是遵守 `beforeClose` 的关闭请求；拒绝后保留服务所有权，可以再次请求关闭。再次函数调用会替换旧单例：直接清理旧宿主并将旧结果结算为 `close`，不等待旧关闭守卫，也不合成生命周期通知。

### Affix Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |

| offset-top | Distance from the scroll container top; accepts CSS lengths | `number / string` | `0` |

| disabled | Disable affixing | `boolean` | `false` |

### Affix Events

| Event | Arguments and timing |
| --- | --- |
| change | `(fixed: boolean, offset: number)`, emitted when the fixed state changes. While fixed, offset is the affix threshold; otherwise it is the distance to the corresponding container edge. Disabling affixing reports 0. |

### Affix Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Content to affix | — |

### Affix Methods

| Method | Description | Prop | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| updatePosition | Rebind scrollers and recalculate on the next animation frame | — | `Promise<void>` |

### Usage notes

Props, event arguments, slots and public methods match across platforms. CSS mode follows browser sticky rules; examples use independent scroll containers.
<!-- same-source-api:end -->

`change` only reports transitions in fixed state: repeated measurements while fixed do not repeat true, and disabling releases fixation with false and 0. Viewport units are reevaluated on measurement. CSS mode delegates valid lengths to native sticky; JS mode resolves numbers, numeric strings, px, rem, vw, vh, vmin and vmax. target controls listeners and JS measurement, while native sticky remains constrained by actual CSS ancestors. After deactivation, a pending `updatePosition()` cannot restore listeners from an older activation.


### Public entries and listener types

The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.

```ts
import Affix, { Affix as NamedAffix } from '@maple-design/ui/affix'
import { Affix as RootAffix } from '@maple-design/ui'
import type { AffixProps, AffixInstance } from '@maple-design/ui'
import type { AffixProps as SubAffixProps } from '@maple-design/ui/affix'
const options: AffixProps = { onChange: (fixed: boolean, offset: number) => fixed && offset.toFixed() }
```


### Units and diagnostics

JS mode parses only finite numbers, decimal/scientific numeric strings, and px, rem, vw, vh, vmin or vmax, including negative offsets. Unsupported JS lengths such as em, %, calc() and var() warn in development and measure as zero instead of treating a numeric prefix as pixels. CSS mode delegates to native sticky, converting numeric strings to px and leaving other valid CSS expressions to the browser. NaN/Infinity/blank values receive Vue prop validation warnings. Invalid CSS offsets are removed and JS measurement falls back to zero. target changes listeners and JS measurement, not the actual native sticky scroll ancestor or clipping boundary.

# AutoComplete

Free-text input with suggestions. Both libraries independently maintain the same component, props, Menu and styles. Local Input/Form integration supplies hover versus touch behavior; no shared runtime or platform configuration.

Opening and filtering are independent: shouldOpen controls opening, filterOption filters candidates. Empty results, disabled and readonly keep the menu closed. No list/picker presentation is provided.

## Reading direction

The editor and suggestion popup inherit source dir, including in custom containers. Horizontal caret keys keep native editing behavior; vertical keys navigate candidates, Enter selects and Escape closes. Candidate updates preserve the native composition buffer until composition ends instead of repainting the previous model value.

### Typed passthrough configuration

AutoCompleteTriggerOptions is an opt-in configuration subset that excludes internally owned Trigger fields, consistent with Select and Cascader. The host trigger-props property intentionally retains TriggerProps, with internal state taking precedence. Candidate visibility follows focus/input and should-open; public open/default-open/update:open/open-change belong to the deferred field editor. Top-level popup-container wins when defined, including false; otherwise the nested container applies.

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### AutoComplete Events

| Event | Prop |
| --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| input | value: string, event: Event |
| search | value: string, event: Event |
| change | value: string \| null, event: Event |
| select | value: string, option: AutoCompleteOptionInfo, event: Event |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| dropdown-scroll / dropdown-reach-bottom | event: Event |
| load-error | error: unknown |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean |

Typing: `input → update:modelValue → search`; selection: `update:modelValue → select → change`; clear: `clear → input → update:modelValue → change`. Selecting the same value emits only select. change is a commit on blur, Enter or selection. Input owns typing/focus/clear Form notifications; AutoComplete notifies Form once for suggestion commits. Selection applies maxLength; select.value is the committed string, while option.value retains the original suggestion. clear receives an event, not a string.

options is an explicit data loader accepting query and { signal }; it may return an array or a Promise. Failures emit load-error, and refresh retries the current query. Ordinary events such as search only notify and do not collect listener Promises. open events refer only to the deferred field editor.

### AutoComplete Slots

| Slot | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| option | data: AutoCompleteOptionInfo |
| empty | Empty candidate content inside the field editor; no arguments. Cedar shows it with its native input; Maple shows it in the editor candidate area. |
| footer | Menu footer |
| prefix / suffix | Input prefix / suffix |
| clear-icon | clear(event?: Event): void |
| read | value: string \| null, text: string; preserves the raw empty model |

default does not replace the input. option customizes candidates, read customizes reading content, and empty customizes the field editor with no candidates. Ordinary direct input closes the menu when no candidates match.

### AutoComplete Methods

| Method | Prop | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | - | void |
| blur | - | void |
| refresh | - | `Promise<void>` |

Arrow keys reopen after Escape: ArrowDown activates the first enabled candidate and ArrowUp the last, without submitting a model; Enter selects. Composition, canceled keyboard events, readonly/disabled and should-open remain respected. Tab retains native focus navigation. Vue useId keeps SSR identifiers stable.

## CSS Variables


Clearing does not emit search or reopen candidates, including when focus returns from a keyboard-focused clear button to the input. The parent controls the value: each rejected clear or selection still emits a change proposal; an accepted candidate selection notifies Form once.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `popup` and opens an editor when the value area is clicked. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

Asynchronous search should clear old candidates when requests start and accept only the latest response for the current query. Popup arrows/Enter operate only current candidates; the bottom confirm button saves. Failed validation preserves drafts. Confirmation locks editing/closing; Form reset closes Popup and aborts submission. Closing/reset invalidates request ownership. See Form's unified field-presentation examples.

The candidate list shares group, selected and disabled styling with Select, and AutoComplete variables follow their Select counterparts by default. In direct mode the list opens below the input and updates while scrolling; trigger-props can change placement or enable automatic flipping. The field presentation owns the deferred editor while the internal input owns suggestions; each platform retains its public edit-mode values.

### Public type exports

Root and component entries export `AutoCompleteEmits`、`AutoCompleteSlots`、`AutoCompleteExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

`case-sensitive` only makes built-in local filtering `case-sensitive`: `ap` matches `Apple` when false, but not when true. It does not require choosing an option or validate the value. A custom `filterOption` takes priority; `filterOption=false` disables local filtering and makes `case-sensitive` irrelevant.


### Built-in search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

AutoComplete text input always supports searching; filter-option only controls local matching and does not issue requests. Explicit options loaders disable secondary local filtering by default; arrays enable it. Business code usually does not need filter-option.

```vue
<mp-auto-complete v-model="text" :options="loadSuggestions" />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests.

### 透传配置边界与优先级

建议使用 `AutoCompleteTriggerOptions` 声明 trigger-props。候选列表的展开由内部输入/焦点与 shouldOpen 管理。顶层 open/default-open/update:open/open-change 属于字段延迟编辑层，不能直接控制候选列表。disabled 归顶层管理；不能用嵌套配置绕过只读/禁用。placement、popupOffset、样式等普通 Trigger 属性延续原透传。popup-container 顶层明确传入时优先（包括 false），否则回退 triggerProps.popupContainer。内部 Trigger 展开监听继续执行；不要通过嵌套监听替代内部展开协议。

AutoCompleteTriggerOptions 是主动选用的安全配置子集，排除内部托管字段；trigger-props 保持 TriggerProps 宽类型，与 Select/Cascader 的现有协议一致。宽类型允许传入不代表能覆盖内部开关和禁用；专用类型用于在配置编写时提早检查职责边界。

### AutoComplete Events

| 事件 | 参数 |
| --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| input | value: string, event: Event |
| search | value: string, event: Event |
| change | value: string \| null, event: Event |
| select | value: string, option: AutoCompleteOptionInfo, event: Event |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| dropdown-scroll / dropdown-reach-bottom | event: Event |
| load-error | error: unknown |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean |

输入顺序：`input → update:modelValue → search`；选择：`update:modelValue → select → change`；清除：`clear → input → update:modelValue → change`。同值选择只发 select。change 表示失焦、Enter 或候选选择产生的提交。Input 负责输入、焦点与清除的 Form 通知，AutoComplete 仅对候选提交通知一次。选择也遵守 maxLength；select 的 value 是最终提交字符串，option.value 保留原始候选。clear 参数为事件，不再是字符串。

options 是显式数据加载入口，接收 query 和 { signal }，可以返回数组或 Promise；失败通知 load-error，refresh 可重试当前查询。search 等普通事件只通知，不采集监听器返回的 Promise。open 事件只表示延迟编辑层开关。

### AutoComplete Slots

| 插槽 | 说明与参数 |
| --- | --- |
| option | data: AutoCompleteOptionInfo |
| empty | 字段编辑面板中的无候选内容；无参数。Cedar 随原生输入显示，Maple 在编辑候选区域显示 |
| footer | 菜单底部 |
| prefix / suffix | 输入框前后缀 |
| clear-icon | clear(event?: Event): void |
| read | value: string \| null, text: string；保留原始空模型 |

default 不提供输入替换。option 定制候选内容，read 定制阅读内容；empty 定制字段编辑面板中的无候选内容，普通 direct 输入无匹配时关闭菜单。

方向键可在 Escape 关闭后重新展开：ArrowDown 定位首个可用候选，ArrowUp 定位末个可用候选，不提交模型；Enter 选择。组合输入、取消的键盘事件、readonly/disabled 和 should-open 条件仍受尊重；Tab 保持原生焦点导航。使用 Vue useId 保证 SSR 标识稳定。

### Form 字段展示与确认

本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `popup`，点击值区域打开编辑面板。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

异步搜索时应在新请求开始时清除旧候选，并只采纳当前搜索词的最后一次响应。popup 内方向键与 Enter 只操作当前候选，保存由底部确认按钮完成。校验失败保留草稿；确认期间锁定编辑和关闭，表单重置会关闭 popup 并中止提交。请求归属应在关闭和重置时失效，完整示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

候选列表与 Select 统一使用分组、选中、禁用样式，AutoComplete 样式变量默认跟随对应的 Select 变量。direct 模式的候选列表默认在输入框下方展开，随滚动更新位置；可通过 trigger-props 调整方向或开启自动翻转。延迟编辑层由字段展示层管理，候选列表仍由内部输入管理；两端保留各自公开 edit-mode 值。

### 公开类型入口

根入口和组件入口均导出 `AutoCompleteEmits`、`AutoCompleteSlots`、`AutoCompleteExpose`，与 Props、Instance 配套。Emits 为从运行时事件声明推导的参数元组映射；Expose 包含 focus/blur。

`case-sensitive` 只使内置本地过滤区分大小写：默认 false 时输入 `ap` 可以匹配 `Apple`，true 时不能。它不限制必须选择候选，不校验输入值。自定义 `filterOption` 优先；`filterOption=false` 关闭本地过滤，此时 case-sensitive 不起作用。


### 内置搜索字段配置

`searchFields` / `search-fields` 是只读 `('label' | 'value')[]`，默认 `['label']`；多字段为 OR 匹配，大小写默认不敏感。配置 `['value', 'label']` 可同时搜索编码和名称，fieldNames 将语义字段映射到业务字段；空数组对非空查询不匹配任何项。value 采用字符串比较，不做对象深层搜索，对象值或拼音等复杂规则仍用自定义回调。自定义回调优先并自行决定大小写；远程结果使用原有关闭本地过滤协议。Cascader 保留路径语义，会检查路径各节点的配置字段。

## 配置清空后的值

`empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。

## 函数属性加载候选

直接传 options(query, { signal })，无需调用 useAsyncData。options 继续接收数组，显式数组（包括 []）优先。组件内部管理 loading、旧结果隔离与请求取消；load-error 通知失败，实例 refresh() 重试。业务函数可只接收 query，忽略第二参数。

AutoComplete 的文本输入始终可搜索；filter-option 只控制本地候选匹配，不负责发请求。使用 options 加载函数时默认不再二次过滤远程结果；仅传数组时默认启用本地匹配。业务通常无需设置 filter-option。

```vue
<mp-auto-complete v-model="text" :options="loadSuggestions" />
```

`empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。

公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。

refresh 可在编辑器未打开时重试组件自有的异步选项读取，沿用既有 AbortSignal、loading 和 load-error 协议，不自动打开编辑器；静态数组不产生额外请求。

# BackTop

Visibility RAF and JS duration/easing interpolation have separate ownership. Old listeners/canceled or consumed frames cannot replay after target replacement/deactivation/disposal. Recheck after custom easing before writing; RAF/cancel/time origin use the target owner window. Retained inactive/disposed commands are inert, activation does not resume old animation. Scoped14/full30 per copy pass using controlled queues/iframe, not native browser/OS proof. Default200ms/API remain; no CSS token added.

### BackTop Events / Slots / Methods

- `click(event: MouseEvent)`: emitted once per activation.
- Default slot: noninteractive text or icons. The root is already a native button; do not nest another Button or link.
- `scrollToTop()`: scrolls the current target without emitting an additional click.
- Keyboard: Tab focuses the visible button; Enter / Space activates it. Hidden buttons are not focusable.

The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.

### Easing and errors

duration must be finite, nonnegative milliseconds; zero scrolls immediately. Invalid durations produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and retain the immediate-completion runtime fallback. The easing presets are linear, quartOut and easeInOutCubic; invalid names warn and fall back to quartOut. A custom function receives progress from 0 to 1: finite results are clamped to 0–1, while nonfinite or nonnumeric results use the current linear progress. Promises are not awaited. Thrown errors propagate unchanged to the calling environment; that frame schedules no further animation, and scrollToTop can retry. No click success or extra error event is fabricated.

# Breadcrumb

The current page uses primary text color with normal font weight and `aria-current="page"`. Plain text has no interaction feedback. Links, click actions and dropdown triggers use brand color, pointer cursor, hover / pressed feedback and a visible keyboard focus outline. Click actions support Enter and Space. Keep the last item as plain text unless an action is explicitly supplied.

On touch devices, interactive items have a minimum 44 × 44px target. Press feedback clears after release; mouse hover styles do not stick. The default ellipsis is static; use a focusable button in the more-icon slot with a Tooltip to reveal omitted paths.

The default navigation landmark and ellipsis labels follow the current locale. Set aria-label on the root to customize the landmark name.

### Intro

Identify the page location in a hierarchy and navigate upward when needed. The API aligns with Cedar Design Web core features (`routes` / `max-count` / separator slots). Affix positioning is not included for mobile.

## Usage notes



- A nonempty `routes` array takes precedence over the default slot; an empty array falls back to the slot. Default route rendering links all items except the last, which has `aria-current="page"`. `item-render` controls links itself.
- Separator precedence: child slot → child prop → parent slot → parent prop. `0` and an empty string are supported.
- `max-count` is a nonnegative integer; 0 means unlimited. A value of 1 acts as 2 to preserve the first and current items. Positive fractions are rounded down and clamped to at least 2; negative or nonfinite values act as 0. Invalid values produce a development warning. Collapsing occurs only when the total exceeds the effective count plus 1; the overflow position does not trigger omitted items’ clicks, links or dropdowns.
- Built-in dropdown selection emits `select(route, event)`. Indices and separators update with dynamic insertion, removal, reordering and SSR.
- Custom attributes apply to the breadcrumb item content node.

# 面包屑

当前位置（最后一级）默认使用主文字色，不额外加粗，并标记 `aria-current="page"`。纯文本无点击反馈；配置 `href` 的链接、绑定 `@click` 的操作和下拉入口显示品牌色、手型及悬停 / 按下反馈，键盘聚焦时显示焦点轮廓。`@click` 操作支持 Enter 和空格。最后一级通常保持纯文本；显式提供链接或操作时仍可交互。

触屏设备上，可点击项的触摸区域至少为 44 × 44px；按下显示底色和下划线，松手后恢复，不保留鼠标悬停效果。默认省略图标仅用于提示；如需查看隐藏路径，可通过 more-icon 插槽提供可聚焦的按钮并组合 Tooltip。

默认导航区域和省略提示的无障碍名称随当前语言变化；可通过根组件的 aria-label 自定义导航区域名称。

# Carousel

Autoplay interval is business playback cadence (business-clock), not CSS duration. Autoplay remains off by default; true uses3000ms, with existing numeric/config intervals and hover/focus/hidden pause rules. Cancellation/replacement invalidates old playback work; delivery consumes once before navigation. Retained inactive/disposed next/prev/to, keyboard and wheel cannot navigate or intercept input. Activation creates fresh observer/event bindings; detached deliveries cannot use a newer active state to reschedule.

### auto-sized

Reverse cards reorders the same uniquely keyed cards (their distinct widths are the Demo keys). Current is positional, not a business-card identity: slide number 2 changes from 220px to 180px without changing the index or event count. Drag left to slide number 3, restore order to show 180px there, then drag right to slide number 2. Reordering alone emits no change. Arbitrary insertion/sorting, identity-following selection, reordering during a held gesture and physical touch remain unverified.

When the active fifth card is removed, parent Current stays 5 without another change; the view clamps it to the remaining fourth card and centers that card. A subsequent left drag wraps to 1 and updates the model once. Applications that need immediate parent-index correction must update current themselves. Arbitrary reordering and deletion during a held gesture remain unverified.

Empty temporarily removes every card: navigation is disabled and dragging emits no change. Turning it off restores the configured cards without switching. Clearing and restoring from slide number 1 allows a subsequent right drag to wrap to the last item. This does not cover nonzero out-of-range controlled indices or clearing during a held gesture.

Clearing from slide number 4 retains the parent Current and change count. Restoring centers the last card; the next left drag wraps to 1 and emits once. Empty content does not force the controlled parent value to 0. Active-card deletion, arbitrary invalid indices and clearing during a held gesture remain unverified.

Extra card appends a 200px fifth item without changing a valid current index or incrementing Changes. Drag right from the first item to reach it, then right again to the original last item before removing the extra card. The index and count stay unchanged; dragging left then wraps across the restored four-item boundary. This covers removing an inactive final item, not deleting the active item, arbitrary reordering, or changes during a held gesture.

Drag to the last item, then enable Wider cards (80px added per item) and the 300px viewport. Resizing does not change the model or increment Changes: the current 340px card recenters, and a left drag can wrap to the first item. Restoring both switches recenters again. This paragraph describes ResizeObserver updates after a completed gesture, not resizing while holding a drag.

Items have different widths. Dragging keeps the current item centered and can loop across either end. Current shows the accepted page index starting at 1; Changes counts change notifications.

### Model and interaction
Public slide numbers start at 1. Controlled actions emit update:model-value, then change(slideNumber, previousSlideNumber, isManual), and do not move until the parent accepts current. External assignments do not emit change. Method option event:false suppresses only change, not the model proposal. isManual is true for user actions and false for autoplay.

loop moves existing children across boundaries without cloning component instances. Without looping or centering, the final viewport is clamped to avoid empty space; selection can move within the final visible group without moving the track. Partly visible slides remain accessible; fully offscreen slides are inert. fade displays one slide. auto uses explicit CarouselItem width horizontally or height vertically; vertical mode requires a container height. Only CarouselItem children, including those inside Vue Fragments, count as slides; comments and ordinary elements do not.

auto-play=true uses 3000ms and pauses on hover; a number sets milliseconds without hover pausing; an object configures interval/hoverToPause. Focus within, dragging, hidden documents/ancestors and KeepAlive deactivation always pause playback. Reduced-motion preferences are respected. Interactive children such as inputs/buttons keep native behavior; mark custom interactive areas with data-carousel-no-drag. show-arrow=hover also shows arrows on keyboard focus.

### Loop transition boundaries

Each slide always has one component instance. Ordinary previous/next navigation recycles positions after the departing slide exits. Multi-slide or centered jumps that would require one slide in two positions settle immediately without animation, cloning interactive content or queuing unlimited transitions. Fewer items than visible slides are not cloned to fill space. Accessible names follow global Locale; explicit label props take precedence.

Native root listeners such as `keydown`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focusin` and `focusout` run alongside internal navigation and autoplay pause handling. Native `.once` listeners fire once for the root element lifetime.

`space-between` also accepts valid CSS lengths such as percentages and `calc()`. Multi-slide layout uses unscaled CSS pixels, so ancestor scaling does not change the gap-to-slide proportion.

If a focused slide becomes inaccessible through navigation or removal, focus moves to the carousel container. Focus in a still-visible slide or outside the carousel is preserved. The container is programmatically focusable but is not in the Tab order unless `keyboard` is enabled; an explicit `tabindex` remains under caller control.

The autoplay example sets `auto-play=false` on focus entry and provides an external switch for an explicit restart. The component itself only pauses temporarily while focus is inside; playback resumes on blur. This differs from the WAI-ARIA APG recommendation to stop on focus until the user explicitly restarts, and is not a claim of full APG conformance; applications requiring that behavior should control playback state. Reduced motion disables transitions but does not by itself stop automatic navigation.

Slide numbers start at 1; finite fractions are truncated toward zero and then wrapped or clamped according to `loop`. Finite `move-speed` values use non-negative milliseconds; non-finite values use the CSS transition duration. The root is a named region and default indicator buttons have localized slide names and current state; their container has no separate group name. `line` and `slider` share the same default bar dimensions; `slider` can grow into available container space and is not draggable.

自动播放的间隔是业务播放节奏（business-clock），不是 CSS 动效时长；默认关闭，启用 true 时默认3000ms，数字／配置间隔、hover/focus/隐藏暂停规则保持。取消或重排使旧播放任务失效；当前回调消费一次后才调用导航。停用／卸载保留 next／prev／to、键盘和滚轮入口无效，不能翻页或拦截输入。激活建立新观察器／事件绑定，解绑前迟交付不得借新 active 状态重新排任务。

### 循环过渡边界

每个轮播项始终只有一个组件实例。普通上一页/下一页在出场项离开后回收位置；跨多页或居中跳转若需要同一项同时占据两个位置，则直接无动画定位，不复制交互内容，也不排队执行无限过渡。项目数量小于可视页数时不会复制项目填满。可访问名称跟随全局 Locale，显式标签属性优先。

根节点的 `keydown`、`mouseenter`、`mouseleave`、`focusin`、`focusout` 原生监听器与内部翻页、自动播放暂停逻辑同时生效；原生 `.once` 监听器在该根元素生命周期内只执行一次。

`space-between` 也接受百分比和 `calc()` 等有效 CSS 长度；多页布局按未缩放的 CSS 像素计算，祖先缩放不会改变间距与页宽的比例。

当正在聚焦的幻灯片因切页或删除而不再可访问时，焦点移至轮播容器；仍可见的幻灯片及组件外焦点保持不变。容器默认可通过程序聚焦，但 `keyboard` 未启用时不进入 Tab 顺序；显式 `tabindex` 仍由调用方控制。

自动播放示例在焦点进入时将 `auto-play` 设为 `false` 持续停止，由外部开关显式重启；组件本身的焦点暂停只是临时暂停，离开后会自动恢复。这与 WAI-ARIA APG 建议的“焦点进入后停止，直到用户显式重启”不同，不能视为完整 APG 轮播模式；需要该行为时请由业务控制播放状态。减少动态效果关闭过渡，不会单独停止自动换页。

页码从 1 开始，有限小数向零截断后，根据 `loop` 循环或限制到有效页；`move-speed` 有限值按非负毫秒处理，非有限值使用 CSS 过渡时长。根为具名 region，每个默认指示按钮有本地化页码名称和当前页状态；指示器容器本身没有单独的 group 名称。`line` 和 `slider` 默认使用相同的长条尺寸，`slider` 在容器有可分配空间时可伸展，并非拖动滑块。

# Cascader In multiple mode, the inline dropdown contains options only; the field owns selected values, removal and clearing. The popup editor retains the selected-items summary and clear action, and commits its draft on confirmation. ## Reading direction Inherits source dir. Child columns, expansion icons and separators follow reading direction. Horizontal keys enter loaded children or return to the parent in the visible direction, skipping disabled children; vertical keys retain logical order. Search preserves native horizontal caret editing. Path and multiple-value arrays are not reversed. Clearing the last value while closed resets navigation before reopening. `empty-value` / `emptyValue` sets the model value produced by clearing. It accepts a value in the component model type or a zero-argument factory. Omission preserves the existing default; use `() => undefined` to distinguish omission from returning undefined. Arrays are shallow-copied on every clear; selected items that cannot be cleared remain. It does not redefine emptiness, alter Form reset defaults or treat 0/false as universally empty. `empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model. The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. See Form's unified field-presentation examples. ## CSS Variables ### Field and mobile-presentation style boundaries Use `edit-mode` to choose direct editing or a mobile editor panel. ### Form field presentation and confirmation This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `popup` and opens an editor when the value area is clicked. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled. `before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form. Field editing uses edit-mode: Cedar supports direct/click/dblclick, and Maple supports direct/popup. The old menu/list/picker editing values are not retained. Popup editors reuse the existing option index, search, asynchronous loading and virtual-list algorithms. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. ### Single-selection checkmark ### Built-in search fields `searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node. Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls. Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests. ### Selection actions during loading While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching. Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing. option({ data }) receives normalized CascaderOptionInfo; data.raw is the original option and data.path is the normalized root-to-current path. label({ data }) receives the field display item key/value/label/closable/tagProps. arrow-icon({ focus, menuOpen }) receives the real field focus and open state. read({ value, text }) retains null/undefined and the original model shape. Public types include CascaderBaseValue, CascaderOptionInfo, CascaderReadScope, CascaderEmits, CascaderSlots and CascaderExpose from the root and cascader entry points. Standalone CascaderPanel accepts option arrays and does not own a root candidate loader.

# 级联选择器 多选时，`inline` 下拉只显示选项；已选内容、单项移除和清空由输入框承担。`popup` 编辑面板保留“已选／清空”，选择为草稿，确认后提交。 ## 阅读方向 继承来源 dir；子列沿阅读方向展开，展开图标及列分隔线随方向变化。左右键按可见方向进入已加载子级或返回父级，并跳过禁用子项；上下键保持逻辑顺序。搜索状态保留原生左右光标编辑，不反转路径或多选数组。关闭状态清空最后值后，重开从根级恢复导航。 `empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。 `empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。 候选属性 `options` 支持数组或 `(query, { signal }) => 数组/Promise`。加载、取消、过期结果隔离由组件内部处理，失败触发 load-error。单选/多选分组初始化以空字符串查询，搜索型字段在查询变化时调用；树形字段根数据与原有 load-more 子节点懒加载独立。 ## 异步加载与回显 ### 回调懒加载 ```demo ../example/demos/load-more.vue ``` ### 异步设备与 ID 回显 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | | `edit-mode` | 字段展示；未指定时继承 FormItem / Form | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `options` | 树形选项；叶值模式要求叶值唯一，路径模式可区分不同分支 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `loading` | 加载状态；禁止选择和确认 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `path-mode` | true 返回完整路径；false 返回选中节点的值 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `filterable` | 开启搜索 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `clearable` | 允许清除，保留禁用的已选项 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | ```demo ../example/demos/async-devices.vue ``` ### 介绍 通过下拉菜单或底部弹窗的形式进行级联选择。 单选已选项在右侧显示内置主色对勾。多选使用 Checkbox：可选后代全部未选为未选，部分选中为半选，全部可选叶子选中为全选；禁用叶子不参与全选计算。checkStrictly 开启时父子独立选择，不汇总半选。确认式编辑面板中的选择先作为草稿，确认后才提交。 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ### 懒加载结束与异常 字段和独立 Panel 的 `loadMore(option, done)` 均保留回调协议：`done(children)` 接收子项，`done()` 结束等待并允许重试。只接受首次回调；返回值（包括已完成的 Promise）不替代 `done`。加载函数同步抛错时结束等待，并进入 Vue 的 `errorCaptured` / 应用 `errorHandler`。`load-error` 仍仅报告 `options` 候选数据源错误，不重复报告 `loadMore` 异常。业务中的异步请求失败需自行处理并调用 `done()`。 替换选项（包括嵌套原地修改）、字段映射或加载函数会使旧请求和懒加载缓存失效。卸载、停用会取消待处理回调；旧结果不能写入替换后的节点或清除新请求的等待。 ## # Checkbox Standalone Checkbox modelValue is a boolean checked state, or an array of selected option values in array mode. The value prop identifies this option; it is not the checked state. CheckboxGroup modelValue is the selected values array. defaultValue initializes uncontrolled state only and does not write into the parent. ### Intro Basic demos follow the site language without changing business values or selection. Group demos cover accepted/rejected updates, readonly state and asynchronous option labels; removing options does not clear the model. Use `direction="column"` on the outer Space and `orientation="vertical"` on the choice group itself. A group of options for multiple choices. ## Reading direction Checkbox labels and groups follow source dir without reversing value arrays. Space keeps its toggle meaning; disabled and readonly behavior remains effective. The demo loader uses a version guard: obsolete responses cannot finish a newer load, clear selections, release a `max=2` slot, or increment user changes. Removing options invalidates in-flight results; a fresh load reflects the retained model. Deactivation or unmount settles waiting jobs and cancels timers. This is demo business logic, not automatic network-race handling by the component; no external service is used. Loading/removing options or updating the external value never emits reverse updates. Selected values absent from the current options are retained. This demo simulates a request with an 800ms local delay; removing options while loading cancels the pending result so stale options do not reappear. The selected remote value occupies one slot; selecting Device A reaches `max=2` and disables Device B. Deselecting either item frees a slot. External over-limit values are not truncated. Use Space or Enter on existing options while waiting. Reloading the same values preserves keyboard focus and the latest selection. Keep the loading-status node stable to avoid remounting the group; deselecting an item still frees a slot for another choice. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/async-options.vue ``` ## Native input attributes and keyboard cancellation Native `id`, `form`, `required`, constraints, aria/data attributes and keyboard listeners belong to the actual input. Class/`style` and other shell attributes remain on the label. Generated native IDs are stable and unique, and an external label can target an explicit `id`. HTML `required` participates in native browser `form` validation, separately from Form business rules. Once / Capture / Passive native listener modifiers stay on the input rather than firing from interactive slot children. Native preventDefault can veto Enter / Space activation and RadioGroup arrow navigation; canceled Space leaves no delayed release action. Checked, disabled, input type and group Tab navigation remain component-managed. The nullable Checkbox model is preserved. checked in default / checkbox slots is always boolean, with null shown as false; rendering alone never proposes a new model. ## API ### Parameters, presentation clearing and mount-time boundaries orientation accepts horizontal / vertical and falls back to horizontal after invalid-value diagnostics. max belongs to CheckboxGroup: valid values are finite nonnegative integers, zero forbids new choices, and omission is unlimited. Existing external values are never truncated. Invalid JavaScript callers retain the existing normalization after diagnostics: negatives become zero, fractions are floored, NaN is unlimited, and Infinity remains unlimited. icon-size accepts positive lengths. Numbers and numeric strings use px, including positive fractions such as 0.5. Invalid, nonpositive or nonfinite values diagnose and fall back to the theme; the Divider minimum of 1 does not apply. Business styles determine the final resolved value of CSS expressions. uninject-group-context decides group participation at mount. Changing it later does not reinject; change the key or remount. An isolated control still participates in Form. clearable / empty-value apply only to explicit presentation-layer clearing; native unchecking still proposes false or removes the array value and never uses empty-value. Ordinary event Promises do not participate in waiting; before-commit uses payload / done / context only when saving a deferred edit. During an explicit options request both group roots announce aria-busy and emit one load-error on failure. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots. ### Form field presentation and confirmation This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled. `before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. `empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model. The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading. Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls. CheckboxGroup checkAll/inverseAll change values only through an active editor. When a deferred editor is closed, deactivated, or unmounted, calls return an independent array copy of the current business value without opening the editor or publishing model changes.

### 异步选项 开启手动返回后，每次加载创建本地 Promise，可分别返回最早或最新任务验证两种乱序。示例业务加载器用版本保护忽略旧响应：旧结果不结束新加载、不清空选择、不释放 `max=2` 名额，也不增加用户变更次数。移除使在途结果失效，新加载仍按保留模型反显；停用或卸载会结清等待并取消定时器。此保护属于示例业务逻辑，不代表组件自动处理网络竞争；不访问外部接口。 选项载入、移除和外部值更新均不会反向触发值变化；未载入的已选值不会自动清理。示例使用 800ms 本地延迟模拟请求；加载中移除选项会取消待完成的加载，避免旧结果重新显示。已选 remote 占一个名额，再选设备 A 后达到 `max=2`，设备 B 将不可选；取消任一已选项会释放名额。外部超限值不会自动裁剪。 等待期间可用空格或 Enter 操作已有选项；同值选项重载后保留键盘焦点和最新选择。加载提示保持稳定节点，避免显隐导致分组重新挂载，取消已选项后仍可继续选择并释放名额。 ```demo ../example/demos/async-options.vue ``` ## 原生输入属性与键盘拦截 `id`、`form`、`required`、其他原生约束、`aria-*`、`data-*` 和键盘监听器传给实际 input；`class` / `style` 和其他外壳属性保留在 label。未提供 id 时生成稳定且唯一的原生 id；外部 label[for] 可以关联显式 id。HTML required 参与浏览器原生表单验证，与 Form 的业务校验规则分开。 原生监听的 Once / Capture / Passive 修饰符保留在 input，不会因插槽中嵌套按钮而错误触发。原生键盘监听 preventDefault() 可以阻止 Enter / Space 的组件激活及 RadioGroup 方向键导航；被取消的 Space 不留下延迟释放动作。组件仍管理 checked、disabled、输入类型及分组的 Tab 焦点规则。 Checkbox 的 null 模型仍表示空状态；default / checkbox 插槽中的 checked 始终为 boolean，null 对应 false，不会仅为渲染而提交新模型。 ## API ### 参数、展示清空与挂载边界 orientation 仅接受 horizontal / vertical，非法值诊断后按 horizontal 展示。max 仅用于 CheckboxGroup：合法值为有限非负整数，0 表示不能新增选择，省略为不限；不裁剪已有外部模型。非法 JS 值诊断后保留既有归一化：负数按 0、小数向下取整、NaN 按不限，Infinity 仍按不限处理。 icon-size 接受正长度，数值和纯数字字符串按 px，允许 0.5 这样的正小数；无效、非正或非有限数值诊断并回退主题，不套用 Divider 的最小 1。CSS 表达式的最终解析值由业务样式负责。 uninject-group-context 在挂载时决定是否接入分组；运行中修改不会重新注入，需改变 key 或重新挂载，脱离分组后仍参与 ## Numeric and animation boundaries

### Scientific notation and decimal floor

Precision is an integer from -292 to 292. Fractional and nonfinite precision falls back to 0; out-of-range integers are clamped. Unsupported inputs produce a development prop warning. String precision keeps the existing parseFloat conversion. Negative precision rounds at tens/hundreds and larger decimal places. The result is a number rounded toward negative infinity, without trailing-zero padding, and may use scientific notation. Changing precision only reformats the current value. IEEE-754 representability still applies; animation values are not decimal accounting values.

```demo
../example/demos/decimal-floor.vue
```

### Zero duration and replay

```demo
../example/demos/zero-duration.vue
```

### Change easing and replay

Changing timing-function affects the next reset, including resets caused by from, to or duration changes. It does not restart the current animation. Pause/start resumes the existing curve; reset creates a fresh playback using the latest function. Clearing the function restores linear easing. A curve may reach the target early, but end still reports completion of the configured duration.

```demo
../example/demos/easing-replay.vue
```

## Animation duration boundaries

Duration is a finite nonnegative number of milliseconds. Zero reaches the target on the next frame. Negative, NaN and infinite values produce development prop diagnostics and safely behave as zero without continuing to request animation frames. Pausing or unmounting before that frame cancels completion. String durations retain parseFloat conversion. reset reads auto-start again. end remains a notification; its listener Promise is not awaited.

## API

String `from`, `to`, `duration`, and `precision` values use parseFloat, so `10px` parses as 10. Invalid or non-finite endpoints produce a warning and use 0. If the difference between finite endpoints overflows, the animation completes on the next frame. `precision` floors the numeric result toward negative infinity without padding zeros and accepts integers in the range [-292, 292]. `auto-start` is read on mount or reset; calling start after completion does not replay until reset.

# Countdown

### Countdown business clock and deactivation

Countdown RAF refreshes business time, not visual interpolation; CSS duration/reduced motion must not alter the clock. Pause and KeepAlive deactivation freeze remaining duration; activation resumes that value without charging inactive time. Inactive time updates/reset may update data and emit change but schedule no RAF; auto-start is deferred to activation, and explicit pause cancels pending resume. Direct inactive start is ignored; disposed start/reset emit and schedule nothing.

Pausing or resetting cancels pending countdown updates. A newer start or reset takes precedence over an earlier update. end fires once per round; reset permits a new completion.

### Intro

For real-time display of countdown values, with millisecond precision.

`time` is remaining duration in milliseconds. To align with a deadline, pass `deadline - Date.now()`.

## API

`time` is a duration rather than an absolute deadline; the remaining duration freezes while paused or deactivated by KeepAlive. The default slot receives the five fields days, hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds directly. `change` fires on reset and animation frames and may be frequent. `auto-start` is read on mount or reset; changing it alone does not start or pause. Repeated format tokens are all replaced. Omitted larger units accumulate into smaller units, so `SSS` alone can exceed three digits.

# 倒计时

### Countdown 业务时钟与停用边界

Countdown 的 RAF 刷新业务剩余时间，不是视觉插值；CSS duration／减少动效不能改变业务计时。暂停与 KeepAlive 停用冻结剩余时间，重新激活按冻结值续跑，不把停用期间计入消耗。停用时更新 time／reset 可更新剩余数据及 change 通知，但不申请 RAF；auto-start 的启动延后到激活，手动 pause 取消待恢复。停用期间直接 start 被忽略，卸载后的 start／reset 不再通知或调度。

`time` 为剩余时长（毫秒）。若要对准某个时刻，传入 `deadline - Date.now()`。

# Date

The year panel aligns the selected year, falling back to the current year, only inside its own scroll surface. It never scrolls the outer document. Alignment runs after mounting, accounts for dialog scale transitions, and is retired on deactivation or disposal.

While expanded, the native combobox uses `aria-controls` to identify its own named popup. Closing updates the state and removes the link. `aria-label` and `aria-describedby` reach the native input. Custom selected/trigger slots must preserve accessible names, keyboard operation and state associations.

Floating panels use the visual viewport instead of a half-screen cap. A full calendar is visible when space permits; short windows scroll content while keeping actions visible. Override `--mp-date-picker-popover-max-height` to cap the panel (default `100dvh - 32px`). Switching back to default/Maple removes brand overrides.

Pure panels do not accept open/default-open, popup-container, placement, trigger-props, placeholder, variant or clearable. disable-confirm controls confirmation; actions receives { confirm, disabled }. Panels support independent app.use installation. Root and date/date-range subpaths export components, Props, Instance, Type, Options and Emits; no standalone date-picker/date-range-picker npm subpath exists.

Installing Date also registers DatePicker, which is available through the static member `Date.Picker`.

### Locale and nested calendar options

Date labels, headers and actions use the library's global Locale/LocaleProvider. Cedar no longer accepts a component-level `locale`; no compatibility alias is retained. Changing language does not select or submit a value.

### Instance locale isolation

Date owners read the library's global Locale/Provider and keep `dayStartOfWeek` per instance. They do not switch the host Dayjs default locale or overwrite its base language data. Localized date metadata is registered under each library's own namespace; component instances and source code are not shared.

`valueFormat` is a stable English date protocol, including month-name tokens; `format` display and typed text use the UI language. Language changes do not rewrite or invalidate English month-name models. Numeric default protocols, Date objects and timestamps remain unchanged. The core Chinese locales and Maple built-in languages are loaded; other formats use already registered Dayjs language data, with a safe English fallback.

### Typed format boundaries

Date input is parsed strictly according to `format`, serialized according to `value-format`, and checked against disabled rules and bounds. Manual entry is enabled by default. Clicking edits the input; the calendar button or ArrowDown opens the panel; Enter / blur commits. Set `input-editable=false` for panel-only selection. Multiple mode and function format do not support reverse parsing and keep the input readonly; disable `input-editable` with function format. Maple does not provide week/quarter presentation modes.

### Root-only presentation selection

`Date` / `DateRange` fields select their content through root `panel-type`; standalone date panels use root `presentation`. Both fields default to `calendar` content; standalone date panels default to `calendarPicker`. ### Dynamic date limits

Updating or removing `min` / `max` changes selectable dates, not the existing model or draft. In Maple calendar views, day/month/year navigation availability is derived from the current viewport and both limits; removing one limit restores only that side. A released bound does not trigger selection or submission.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

`edit-mode` inherits from field > FormItem > Form and defaults to `popup`. Supported values are `direct / popup`. Inline keeps the existing control behavior. Overlay editing uses a Cell reference and an isolated draft; only confirmation updates v-model. Cancel, reset and enabling readPretty discard the draft.

Maple edit-mode="popup" opens the editor by clicking the value area; direct edits directly. readPretty is independent reading mode, separate from readonly/disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Direct editing keeps the existing date/time confirmation policy. In popup, the inner pure panel hides its toolbar and the host owns the single confirmation boundary. Standalone DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker and TimeRangePicker retain their panel API and confirmation behavior. On fields, use `panel-type` to choose calendar/picker content; `edit-mode` controls the field container. Standalone date pickers use `presentation` for panel content; time pickers follow their panel APIs.

Standalone, inline and popup editors share the same layout. The calendar has a preferred width of 265px with extra space for a half-hour quick time Picker when time is enabled; narrow screens fit the available width. The footer displays the date, time and a clock/calendar toggle. Explicit `presentation="picker"` preserves date wheels. The panel retains standalone confirmation and actions ownership.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

# Time zones and calendar views

`time-zone` accepts an IANA zone such as `America/New_York`. Dates and millisecond timestamps represent instants; strings represent civil time in that zone. Display, text entry, limits, shortcuts and disabled rules share this protocol. Event Dates remain actual instants. Omit the prop for existing host-local behavior. DST gaps are rejected, folds choose the earlier instant, and invalid zones block submission.

`interactive-mode` is `page` by default. `scroll` shows months between the limits with `use-virtual-scroll` enabled by default; without limits, the initial viewport has a one-year window on each side. `line` separates weekday headings from a row of dates, reuses round date selection, and labels the visible week with its date range. Previous/next buttons move by one week. Navigation never commits a field draft. Day-precision date-time uses these views together with the existing quick-time and detailed wheels. Range summaries, endpoint locks, reversed-range feedback and confirmation remain owned by the existing field transaction. Non-day precision retains its existing renderer.

Virtual months have equal height and six week rows. Customize `--mp-date-calendar-scroll-height`, `--mp-date-calendar-month-height`, `--mp-date-calendar-row-height` and `--mp-date-calendar-line-height` together. Existing calendar color tokens cover both brands and light/dark modes. Disabling virtualization renders the entire range.

### Shared field and commit protocol

Date / DateRange allow manual entry by default; input-editable can disable it. Time manual entry is controlled by inputEditable. Panels edit a draft and commit on confirmation; cancellation or external closing leaves the value unchanged. Clearing commits an empty value immediately and closes the panel. Date and time ranges display two inputs, retaining a next-day indicator for overnight time ranges.

Changing week start or removing bounds does not commit a value. Restoring bounds does not clear the existing model; an out-of-bounds draft cannot be confirmed until a valid date is selected.

Calendar arrows have localized accessible names: previous/next month in the day panel, year in the month panel, and years in the year list. They use global Locale, allow local LocaleProvider overrides, and fall back to the global translation for missing navigation keys. ### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Calendar dates, months and years follow reading order; navigation icons mirror, while date values keep their meaning. In paged grids, Left/Right moves focus visually, Up/Down moves one row, and Home/End moves to the row boundary, skipping disabled items. Focus navigation does not select; Enter/Space keeps the existing selection behavior. Navigation is bounded by the displayed grid. Explicit `shortcuts-position="left|right"` remains physical; `bottom` stays below. Field popovers inherit their source direction.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Values and events

`DateValue = Date | string | number`. Invalid dates and incomplete/reversed ranges cannot commit. min/max are inclusive; strings follow value-format, while Date/timestamps are also accepted. Confirmation revalidates rules. `disabledTime` returns numeric lists from `disabledHours()`, `disabledMinutes(hour)`, `disabledSeconds(hour, minute)`. Valid pure panels emit `confirm(value, date(s), text(s))`; fields use `update:open`/`open-change`, not close. Nested panel/popup props configure presentation only, not top-level models/rules/state events. Range disabled accepts [startDisabled, endDisabled]; locked endpoints cannot be cleared/modified.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

## Visible wheel fields

`date-fields` and `time-fields` independently control date and time columns and their order. The two groups do not interleave. Fields and standalone panels share the same props; range endpoints share the configuration.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `date-fields` | readonly DatePickerField[]<br>`DatePickerField: 'month' \| 'year' \| 'day'` | Generate year/month/day columns from type | year, month, day. Only date wheels are affected; the calendar grid is unchanged. |
| `time-fields` | readonly TimePickerField[]<br>`TimePickerField: 'hour' \| 'minute' \| 'second'` | Hour/minute/second | Controls time wheels, including those embedded in calendars. |

Arrays must be nonempty and unique; explicit arrays strictly determine column visibility/order. Omission uses defaults. Date/time field groups validate separately and cannot mix. Hidden units retain existing values and merge back into the complete draft. Changing field configuration does not commit the model. Nested display options cannot override root props.

Date/DateRange time areas apply only with show-time. `format` controls input text; `value-format` controls saved representation; neither determines panel columns. Unspecified datetime formats save seconds by default. For minute strings, configure both formats explicitly. Hiding year still uses the complete draft year. MM-DD alone cannot represent cross-year ranges; save complete dates for leap-year/cross-year workflows.

### Placement semantics and configuration

The Date field prefers bottom-start below its input. Override the preferred side through popupProps.placement only when needed; the underlying Trigger positions it, not Popup or Popover. DatePicker is a standalone date panel with no input anchor; placement in the legacy date/picker directory is not a current public DatePicker prop.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

### Standalone panel public boundary

DatePicker and DateRangePicker aggregate explicit panel capabilities and view extensions rather than all private renderer parameters. DatePicker currentDate was internal render data overridden by the current date even when supplied. It is removed from public Props and nested option types; no replacement clock property is added.

Use showCurrent for current-date highlighting, showNowButton for selecting now, pickerValue/defaultPickerValue for the viewport, and min/max/disabledDate for selectable-value constraints. Existing field lists, abbreviation, wheel settings, appearance and actual panel capabilities remain available. loading-icon is not wired to a public panel or date-field slot and is not an available capability.

### Date contract and value kinds

DateValue is string, number or native Date. Numbers are timestamps and 0 is not empty; modelValue=null is explicitly empty. Ranges retain broad arrays and incomplete endpoints rather than forcing a tuple; commits still validate completeness and validity. Bounds are inclusive. Invalid supplied bounds block confirmation instead of being treated as omitted. ### Complete slot and instance boundaries

Field default replaces the trigger; prefix/selected/suffix replace content, and ranges also support separator. Preserve names, endpoint distinctions and keyboard access when replacing native controls. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?), respecting emptyValue and disabled/readonly guards.

actions receives confirm/disabled/selectNow/nowDisabled, with both actions returning void. It has no Time-panel canConfirm/value arguments. disabled=true prevents confirmation. Standalone panels can replace the action region; the outer editing shell owns final saving in hosted editing, while the panel contributes auxiliary actions. Panel confirm is not the outer-save method.

Now capabilities follow the actual panel: Cedar single panels support it, while Cedar range panels have no now action. Maple range panels stage now for the active endpoint, preserve the other endpoint and still require confirmation. The presence of selectNow in scope does not imply every mode supports the action.

Cedar cell customizes a calendar cell with date and, for ranges, type=start/end; extra adds content. Maple Date/DatePicker page-calendar summaries support year({year}), month({year,month}), date({week,year,month,date}), range({choose}) and multiple({choose}) according to mode. Maple DateRange/DateRangePicker do not forward these single-panel summary slots, nor do scroll/line viewports promise them.

loading-icon is not wired to date fields or pure panels and is not available merely because the underlying decorator supports it. Field focus(index?)/blur() delegate to real controls. Cedar/direct-field blur closes the field popup; Maple range persistent-reference blur only clears its focus, without pretending to close the outer Drawer. Pure panels expose no focus/blur methods.

### Presentation configuration and ranges

datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps configure presentation without overriding owned model/rules/type/control events; Maple internal range datePickerProps uses a calendar allowlist. popupProps retains a broad dictionary, with public DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions recommended and owner keys still filtered at runtime. Cedar timePickerProps configures embedded time presentation; Maple pickerProps configures wheels.

A range placeholder string applies to both endpoints; arrays configure each and missing entries are empty. readonly is separate from disabled; unset field state inherits Form. Cedar range-panel exchangeTime only handles reversed interactive candidates: true swaps their times, false retains endpoint times. It does not reorder external model/text/shortcut values. Maple does not expose this property.

### 日期语言的实例隔离

日期组件使用当前库的 Locale/Provider 配置，周起始日由各实例的 `day-start-of-week` 控制，不会修改应用中 Dayjs 的默认语言或基础语言配置。

`value-format` 是稳定英文日期协议（包括月份名称 token），`format` 的显示及手输文本使用界面语言。切换语言不会改写模型，也不会令英文月份名称模型失效。默认数字协议、Date 对象、时间戳不变。中文核心语言与 Maple 内置语言数据已接入；其他日期格式优先使用已注册 Dayjs 语言数据，未加载的语言安全回退英文。

### 编辑容器与面板复用

DatePicker / DateRangePicker 独立使用时自带表面背景和操作区；actions 插槽替换整个默认操作区。嵌入 Form 的弹层时，统一外壳负责标题、关闭与底部确认，日期面板只贡献此刻等辅助操作，避免重复确认。关闭放弃草稿，确认失败仍保留草稿。

独立 DatePicker / DateRangePicker 与 inline 共用面板尺寸：单个日历基准宽度为 265px，带时间时宽屏左右布局、窄屏换行。独立面板保留自身的确认按钮和 actions 插槽，不继承 Form 的 presentation。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

# 时区与多月日历

`time-zone="Asia/Shanghai"` 使用 IANA 时区名。`Date`、毫秒时间戳表示真实时刻，切换时区只改变展示；字符串按目标时区的当地时间解释。`min`、`max`、手输、快捷项、事件和禁用规则使用相同协议；事件中的 `Date` 仍是真实时刻。未设置时保持浏览器本地时区行为。夏令时不存在的时间拒绝选择，重复出现的时间取第一次，非法时区禁止提交。

`interactive-mode` 支持 `page`（默认）、`scroll`、`line`。`scroll` 在 `min` / `max` 间展示多月，默认开启 `use-virtual-scroll`，只渲染视口附近月份；未提供边界时使用初始视口前后各一年。`line` 使用独立星期表头和一行日期，复用日历日期按钮的圆形选中态；标题显示本周起止日期，前后按钮按周切换。浏览和翻周不会提交表单；选择、取消、确认仍沿用 Maple 字段草稿机制。

这两个视图支持日精度日期与日期时间，日期时间继续使用原有快捷时间和详细时间滚轮；范围端点摘要、单端点锁定、反序反馈及确认／取消继续由原封装管理。年／月／周精度沿用原有面板。设置 `use-virtual-scroll="false"` 会渲染全部月份，大范围建议保持虚拟滚动。

布局可覆盖 `--mp-date-calendar-scroll-height`、`--mp-date-calendar-month-height`、`--mp-date-calendar-row-height` 和 `--mp-date-calendar-line-height`；月份使用固定六周网格。虚拟滚动要求月份等高，调整行高时同步调整月高度，避免内容溢出。颜色复用日历既有主题 token，支持 Alps / Firefly 亮暗主题。

### 展示模式只在根设置

`Date` / `DateRange` 字段通过根 `panel-type` 选择内容，独立日期面板通过根 `presentation` 选择内容；独立面板内容默认 `calendarPicker`，不带时间时显示日历；字段的 popup 内容默认 `calendar`。字段的 `DatePickerOptions` / `DateRangePickerOptions` 已移除由根拥有的 `presentation`，JS 运行时也过滤，不能通过嵌套对象覆盖根模式。周起始、视口、快捷项和合法外观仍可嵌套配置。单值根支持 picker/calendar/calendarPicker，范围根支持 picker/calendar/calendarPicker；Cedar 只有桌面日历，不提供这些空模式。

### 周起始日的响应式展示

`dayStartOfWeek` 更新时，日历表头与日期列位置同步更新，不改变选中值或提交草稿。纯面板使用根属性，字段通过 `datePickerProps` / `dateRangePickerProps` 配置；滚轮视图不使用星期列。

### 动态日期限制

更新或移除 `min` / `max` 只影响可选日期，不自动修改已有模型或草稿。日历的日/月/年导航状态根据当前视口和两端限制派生；移除一端限制只恢复对应方向，不释放另一端，也不触发选择或提交。

### Form 字段展示与确认

本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `popup`，点击值区域打开编辑面板。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

日期／时间字段在 inline 下沿用原确认策略；在 popover/popup 中，内部纯面板隐藏确认工具栏，由编辑层提供唯一一组确认／取消。独立 DatePicker、DateRangePicker、TimePicker、TimeRangePicker 保留原有面板 API 和确认行为，不继承 Form 的字段展示。

移动端日期字段通过 `panel-type` 选择日历／滚轮内容；`edit-mode` 仅表示字段编辑方式。独立面板的内容形态以各自 API 为准，不由字段 edit-mode 控制。

### 介绍

日期选择**面板**，可单独嵌入页面使用。本页聚合 DatePicker 示例，没有独立的 date-picker 文档路由。日期范围面板请参阅 [`DateRangePicker`](#/zh-CN/date-range) 所在的范围文档；表单字段请使用 [`Date`](#/zh-CN/date) / [`DateRange`](#/zh-CN/date-range)。

### 字段与嵌入式面板

字段负责输入与浮层，纯面板直接嵌入页面。day-start-of-week 统一为数字 0～6，0 为周日；范围日历也支持动态更新。嵌套 Options 只配置展示，不覆盖顶层值、格式、边界或禁用规则。

本例纯面板显式设置 `:disable-confirm="false"`：点击日期只修改草稿，“已提交”在确认后更新。切换周起点或移除边界不提交新值；恢复边界不会清除已有模型，超出新边界的草稿不能确认，请重新选择合法日期。

日历面板箭头的可访问名称跟随全局 Locale，局部 LocaleProvider 可以覆盖对应文案，缺少的导航键回退全局语言。日面板为上一月/下一月，月份面板为上一年/下一年，年份列表为上一组/下一组年份；按钮仍遵守日期边界，预览变化不等于提交日期。

### 透传配置边界与优先级

建议使用 `DatePopupOptions` 声明 popup-props；仅用于 inline 锚定弹层的允许展示/定位配置。open/defaultOpen、disabled/readonly、modelValue、值格式、日期规则及通知监听由字段管理，已有 datePresentationOptions 会过滤托管字段和 onXxx 监听。popup-container 顶层明确传入时优先（包括 false），否则回退 popupProps.popupContainer；popupClass 与内部类合并。trigger、closeOnClickReference、preventFocus、popupOffset 由字段展示层固定（偏移当前为 4）；Maple 还固定 unmountOnClose=true。新类型为两端共同的安全子集，不能设置这些固定项；Cedar 旧配置可透传的 unmountOnClose 不受本次影响。可使用 popupTranslate 定制附加平移。其他有效展示字段保持原透传。

本次仅新增可主动选用的专用类型，不收窄已发布的宽属性类型，不增加运行时过滤、不改变覆盖顺序；旧业务写法继续可编译。若直接使用旧宽属性，内部托管字段仍可能通过类型检查，但不代表能控制内部状态。

```ts
import type { DatePopupOptions } from '@maple-design/ui'
```

### 共享字段加载

`loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。

## 阅读方向

组件继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部方向覆盖。日历日期、月份、年份按阅读顺序排列，前后翻页图形随方向调整，日期值与起止顺序保持原义。分页网格中左右键按视觉方向移动焦点，上下键移动一行，Home/End 移至当前行首尾并跳过禁用项；焦点移动不提交，Enter/Space 沿用选值行为，边界停留在当前显示网格。快捷区 `shortcuts-position="left|right"` 保持物理侧，底部使用 `bottom`。弹层继承字段来源方向。

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](#/zh-CN/emptyValues)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

### 值与事件

`DateValue = Date | string | number`。无效日期、不完整或逆序范围不能提交。min/max 包含边界，字符串按 value-format 解析，也可直接传 Date 或时间戳。确认时重新校验规则。`disabledTime` 返回 `disabledHours()`、`disabledMinutes(hour)`、`disabledSeconds(hour, minute)` 数字列表。纯面板通过校验后触发 `confirm(value, date(s), text(s))`；字段展开使用 `update:open` / `open-change`，不再使用 close。嵌套面板和弹层 props 只配置展示，不能覆盖顶层模型、规则与状态事件。范围 disabled 支持 `[起点禁用, 终点禁用]`，锁定端点不能被清除或修改。
