# DateRange

Endpoint locks are provided reactively by the local mobile presentation adapter to calendars and wheels. Inherited and current locks are merged and remain intact when switching views or unlocking the other endpoint. The shared draft/confirmation owner has no mobile injection dependency; external model updates and confirm/cancel behavior are unchanged.

Floating panels use the visual viewport instead of a half-screen cap. A full calendar is visible when space permits; short windows scroll content while keeping actions visible. Override `--mp-date-picker-popover-max-height` to cap the panel (default `100dvh - 32px`). Switching back to default/Maple removes brand overrides.

The embedded example calls `confirm` from the `actions` slot and binds its `disabled` state to the submit button. Selecting a draft does not update the committed value until confirmation. Tightening bounds does not clear the existing model, but an invalid draft cannot be submitted; choose valid endpoints to submit again.
Pure panels do not accept open/default-open, popup-container, placement, trigger-props, placeholder, variant or clearable. disable-confirm controls confirmation; actions receives { confirm, disabled }. Panels support independent app.use installation. Root and date/date-range subpaths export components, Props, Instance, Type, Options and Emits; no standalone date-picker/date-range-picker npm subpath exists.

Installing DateRange also registers DateRangePicker, which is available through the static member `DateRange.Picker`.

Fields configure this through `dateRangePickerProps`.

`abbreviation` (boolean, default `true`) controls abbreviated month labels in the calendar month grid. Set it to `false` for full month names from the active Locale. It does not affect weekday labels, headers, wheel columns, or value formats. Range calendars use the top-level option; nested calendar options cannot override it.

### Endpoint locks

Locking both endpoints does not block parent model updates, but dates and confirmation stay disabled. Unlocking the start afterward restores editing without submitting. Choosing 16 and confirming retains the new end 22 rather than restoring the old end 15.

“External range 18~~22” updates the parent model directly: the pending draft synchronizes and the locked endpoint uses the new model as its baseline. This update adds no selection or confirmation events. Choosing 24 and confirming then commits 18~~24, without restoring the old start.

Locking an endpoint after editing its draft does not authorize that draft to replace the committed endpoint. Confirmation stays disabled while that locked draft differs from the model. Unlocking preserves the draft and restores confirmation, but does not itself submit; explicitly confirm to commit.

An inverted candidate that would move a locked endpoint must be rejected before it changes a nested calendar draft. The committed range and displayed draft remain unchanged; a subsequent valid choice can still be confirmed. Range sorting must never silently relocate a locked endpoint.

This demo explicitly sets disable-confirm=false. With one locked endpoint, a single date choice edits only the unlocked endpoint instead of starting a new two-click range. With both locked, date candidates expose disabled semantics and confirmation is unavailable; unlocking restores editing without submitting.

Use disabled=[startLocked, endLocked] to retain a committed endpoint while editing the other draft. Confirmation writes the model; changing locks alone does not submit. Locking both endpoints blocks selection. This standalone panel does not demonstrate popup cancellation.

### Root-only presentation selection

`Date` / `DateRange` fields select their content through root `panel-type`; standalone date panels use root `presentation`. Date and DateRange fields default to `calendar`, and standalone date panels to `calendarPicker`. Field `DatePickerOptions` / `DateRangePickerOptions` do not accept root-owned `presentation`; untyped nested selectors are filtered at runtime. Week start, viewport, shortcuts and valid appearance remain configurable. Single roots support picker/calendar/calendarPicker; ranges support picker/calendar/calendarPicker. Cedar only implements its desktop calendar and does not expose empty mobile modes.

### Reactive first weekday

`dayStartOfWeek` updates the calendar headers and date columns together without changing the selected value or submitting a draft. Use the root prop on pure panels; on fields configure `datePickerProps` / `dateRangePickerProps`. The wheel view does not use weekday columns.

### Dynamic date limits

Updating or removing `min` / `max` changes selectable dates, not the existing model or draft. In Maple calendar views, day/month/year navigation availability is derived from the current viewport and both limits; removing one limit restores only that side. A released bound does not trigger selection or submission.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

`edit-mode` inherits from field > FormItem > Form and defaults to `popup`. Supported values are `direct / popup`. Inline keeps the existing control behavior. Overlay editing uses a Cell reference and an isolated draft; only confirmation updates v-model. Cancel, reset and enabling readPretty discard the draft.

Maple edit-mode="popup" opens the editor by clicking the value area; direct edits directly. readPretty is independent reading mode, separate from readonly/disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Direct editing keeps the existing date/time confirmation policy. In popup, the inner pure panel hides its toolbar and the host owns the single confirmation boundary. Standalone DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker and TimeRangePicker retain their panel API and confirmation behavior. On fields, use `panel-type` to choose calendar/picker content; `edit-mode` controls the field container. Standalone date pickers use `presentation` for panel content; time pickers follow their panel APIs.

### Range panel interaction

Date and date-time ranges edit only the active endpoint. Neither manual selection nor Now swaps endpoints. Reversed drafts show a red footer message and disable Confirm until corrected; correcting the range still requires explicit confirmation. Cancel discards the draft. Bounds, disabled date/time rules and locked endpoints remain enforced. Time-only ranges retain their next-day behavior.

### Disabled units inside a range

`disabled-date` restricts the start and end. A range may span disabled interior units; it is not scanned unit by unit or automatically truncated. The same rule applies to dates, months, and years. Disabled interior cells stay gray. Paging preserves the selected first endpoint and clears hover previews; reverse clicks are ordered chronologically.

Standalone DatePicker / DateRangePicker panels and inline fields share a 265px calendar width. Date and time controls appear side by side when space permits and wrap in narrow containers. Explicit `presentation="picker"` preserves wheels. Standalone confirmation and the actions slot remain owned by the panel.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

The lightning button on date-time ranges opens a localized quick-range panel. Choosing an allowed preset updates the draft only. Click Confirm to submit through the regular validation and before-commit flow and close the editor. Custom shortcuts replace the built-in ranges. Now changes only the active endpoint without swapping. Even with `disable-confirm`, Now and subsequent edits require confirmation; cancelling discards the draft. Standalone panels, inline fields and popups behave consistently; reversed ranges show a red message and disable Confirm. Set `:show-now-button="false"` to hide Now.

### Actual platform capabilities

Cedar does not expose `Date.pickerProps`, `DateRange.pickerProps` or `DateRange.datePickerProps`. PC fields do not render mobile wheels/internal mobile range-calendar plugins; ineffective props are removed without aliases. Maple retains real extensions via DateWheelOptions/DateRangeCalendarOptions. Both configure complete panels with `Date.datePickerProps` / `DateRange.dateRangePickerProps`. Range time wheels use `picker-props`; initial datetime belongs in top-level `defaultValue`.

### Per-instance date locale isolation

Date components use the current library Locale/Provider configuration. Each instance controls its first weekday through `day-start-of-week`, without changing the application Dayjs default locale or base locale configuration.

`value-format` is a stable English date protocol, including month-name tokens. `format` display/typed text uses the UI language. Locale changes do not rewrite models or invalidate English-month models. Numeric protocols, Date objects and timestamps remain unchanged. Chinese core/Maple locale data is integrated; other formats prefer registered Dayjs locale data and safely fall back to English when unavailable.

### Typed-input format boundaries

Date input is parsed strictly according to `format`, serialized according to `value-format`, and checked against disabled rules and bounds. Manual entry is enabled by default. Clicking edits the input; the calendar button or ArrowDown opens the panel; Enter / blur commits. Set `input-editable=false` for panel-only selection. Multiple mode and function format do not support reverse parsing and keep the input readonly; disable `input-editable` with function format. Maple does not provide week/quarter presentation modes.

### Clearing a deferred range

In deferred editing, clearing changes the draft; confirmation runs form validation and `beforeCommit` before publishing the configured `emptyValue`. Cancel restores the committed range. An untouched empty range or a half-selected range still requires complete endpoints; an explicit change from a non-empty range to an empty draft can be confirmed. Disabled/readonly fields and locked endpoints cannot be cleared. A rejected controlled open cannot publish a cleared model.

Range values remain `[start, end]`; changing reading direction does not swap endpoints or commit drafts. Calendar range connections and boundary radii follow reading direction. Panels edit a draft and commit on confirmation. Cancellation or closing does not commit, while clearing commits an empty value and closes immediately. `date-fields` and `time-fields` independently control date and time columns and their order. The two groups do not interleave. Fields and standalone panels share the same props; range endpoints share the configuration.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Native range-input references apply string placeholders, including empty strings, to both endpoints and retain array labels by endpoint. Input placeholder visibility still follows hint. Readonly native inputs remain focusable and copyable while editing, opening and clearing are blocked. Global or endpoint disabled states take precedence over readonly. Existing omitted-placeholder defaults for each editing mode are preserved.

Native date-range references emit focus/blur without arguments: entering the input group emits focus, switching endpoints does not duplicate it, and leaving emits blur. Form receives each corresponding notification once under its existing rules. Readonly clicks still notify the original event without opening or editing. Disabled clicks do not notify or consume click.once early. Returning a Promise from an ordinary listener does not start busy state or block opening; asynchronous submission still uses explicit before-commit.

### Complete slot and instance boundaries

Field default replaces the trigger; prefix/selected/suffix replace content, and ranges also support separator. Preserve names, endpoint distinctions and keyboard access when replacing native controls. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?), respecting emptyValue and disabled/readonly guards.

actions receives confirm/disabled/selectNow/nowDisabled, with both actions returning void. It has no Time-panel canConfirm/value arguments. disabled=true prevents confirmation. Standalone panels can replace the action region; the outer editing shell owns final saving in hosted editing, while the panel contributes auxiliary actions. Panel confirm is not the outer-save method.

Now capabilities follow the actual panel: Cedar single panels support it, while Cedar range panels have no now action. Maple range panels stage now for the active endpoint, preserve the other endpoint and still require confirmation. The presence of selectNow in scope does not imply every mode supports the action.

Cedar cell customizes a calendar cell with date and, for ranges, type=start/end; extra adds content. Maple Date/DatePicker page-calendar summaries support year({year}), month({year,month}), date({week,year,month,date}), range({choose}) and multiple({choose}) according to mode. Maple DateRange/DateRangePicker do not forward these single-panel summary slots, nor do scroll/line viewports promise them.

loading-icon is not wired to date fields or pure panels and is not available merely because the underlying decorator supports it. Field focus(index?)/blur() delegate to real controls. Cedar/direct-field blur closes the field popup; Maple range persistent-reference blur only clears its focus, without pretending to close the outer Drawer. Pure panels expose no focus/blur methods.

### Presentation configuration and ranges

datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps configure presentation without overriding owned model/rules/type/control events; Maple internal range datePickerProps uses a calendar allowlist. popupProps retains a broad dictionary, with public DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions recommended and owner keys still filtered at runtime. Cedar timePickerProps configures embedded time presentation; Maple pickerProps configures wheels.

A range placeholder string applies to both endpoints; arrays configure each and missing entries are empty. readonly is separate from disabled; unset field state inherits Form. Cedar range-panel exchangeTime only handles reversed interactive candidates: true swaps their times, false retains endpoint times. It does not reorder external model/text/shortcut values. Maple does not expose this property.

编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。 Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。 `before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。 日期／时间字段在 inline 下沿用原确认策略；在 popover/popup 中，内部纯面板隐藏确认工具栏，由编辑层提供唯一一组确认／取消。独立 DatePicker、DateRangePicker、TimePicker、TimeRangePicker 保留原有面板 API 和确认行为，不继承 Form 的字段展示。 移动端日期字段通过 `panel-type` 选择日历／滚轮内容；`edit-mode` 仅表示字段编辑方式。独立面板的内容形态以各自 API 为准，不由字段 edit-mode 控制。 ### 范围面板的交互规则 移动端日历保留单月视图，翻月不修改选中范围；可从一个月选择起点，翻到另一个月选择终点。只有一个端点或起止倒置的草稿不能确认；完整且顺序合法后才可确认。取消恢复先前已提交值，锁定端点不能被改写。 ### 范围中的禁用项 `disabled-date` 限制起止端点，范围可以跨过中间的禁用项；不会逐项扫描或自动截断范围。日期、月份、年份均采用此规则。中间禁用项保持灰色，翻页保留已选起点并清除悬浮预览；反向点选保留起止值，底部显示红色提示并禁用确认。 ### 字段与嵌入式面板 字段负责输入与浮层，纯面板直接嵌入页面。day-start-of-week 统一为数字 0～6，0 为周日；范围日历也支持动态更新。嵌套 Options 只配置展示，不覆盖顶层值、格式、边界或禁用规则。 本例通过 `actions` 插槽调用 `confirm`，并把 `disabled` 绑定到提交按钮。选择草稿不更新“已提交”，确认后才写回；动态收紧边界不会清除已有模型，但不合法草稿不能提交，重新选择合法起止日期后可再次提交。 “禁用20日结束”动态改变 `disabled-date` 回调：先选10~20草稿，再启用禁用，提交不可用且已提交值不变；解除禁用只恢复确认资格，不自动提交。禁用只作用于结束端，不应误禁起点20日。 ```demo ../example/demos/entry-boundary.vue ``` ### 快捷选项与日历视口 DateRangePicker 同样支持 shortcuts、shortcuts-position、preview-shortcut、picker-value/default-picker-value。范围视口包含两个日期，锁定端点不能被快捷项改变；预览不提交。事件为 update:picker-value、picker-value-change(value, dates, texts)、select-shortcut(shortcut)。详见 [Date 日期](../date/) 的快捷选项示例；DateRange 字段通过 date-range-picker-props 配置并转发事件。 ### 当前端点选择 show-current 仅控制高亮。范围默认提供“此刻”，通过顶层 `show-now-button` 控制，只修改顶部当前选中的端点；起止倒置时显示红色提示并禁用确认，违反日期／时间禁用规则时禁用“此刻”。详见 Date 的当前日期与范围策略示例。 高亮统一由顶层 show-current 控制，嵌套 date-picker-props 不接受 showCurrent/showNowButton，避免无效或相互覆盖的设置。 ### 语言与嵌套日历参数 日期标签、标题和动作接入各库的全局 Locale 与既有 Provider。Cedar 删除日期组件级 `locale`，不保留覆盖字典或兼容别名。切换语言不会选择或提交日期。 `DateRangePicker.datePickerProps` 与 `DateRange.datePickerProps` 仅接受 `DateRangeCalendarOptions`：`hint`、`color`、`titleColor`、`buttonElevation`、`touchable`。值、校验、视口、presentation、elevation、abbreviation 和动作由范围顶层管理；运行时未知键及监听函数不向内部日历转发。日历分支明确使用日历展示。 字段外观与 `dateRangePickerProps.datePickerProps` 合并；空默认对象不再覆盖嵌套设置，字段显式传入的键优先。 ### 内嵌时间与滚轮展示 ### 真实端侧能力 Cedar 不公开 `Date.pickerProps`、`DateRange.pickerProps` 或 `DateRange.datePickerProps`：PC 字段不渲染移动滚轮或范围内部的移动日历插件，原无效参数已删除且无兼容别名。Maple 保留这些真实扩展，使用 DateWheelOptions 与 DateRangeCalendarOptions。两端通过 `Date.datePickerProps` / `DateRange.dateRangePickerProps` 配置完整面板。范围的时间滚轮使用 `picker-props` 配置，初始日期时间放在顶层 `defaultValue`。 ### 日期语言的实例隔离 日期组件使用当前库的 Locale/Provider 配置，周起始日由各实例的 `day-start-of-week` 控制，不会修改应用中 Dayjs 的默认语言或基础语言配置。 `value-format` 是稳定英文日期协议（包括月份名称 token），`format` 的显示及手输文本使用界面语言。切换语言不会改写模型，也不会令英文月份名称模型失效。默认数字协议、Date 对象、时间戳不变。中文核心语言与 Maple 内置语言数据已接入；其他日期格式优先使用已注册 Dayjs 语言数据，未加载的语言安全回退英文。 ### 手输格式的边界 日期输入按 `format` 严格解析，再按 `value-format` 输出，并校验禁用规则及范围。默认允许手输，点击输入编辑，日历按钮或 ArrowDown 打开面板，Enter / 失焦提交。设置 `input-editable=false` 可仅通过面板选择。multiple 模式或函数 format 不支持文本逆解析，输入保持只读；函数 format 应配合关闭 `input-editable` 使用。Maple 不提供周/季度展示模式。 ### 延迟编辑中的清空 延迟编辑时，清空只改变草稿；确认后先执行表单校验和 `beforeCommit`，通过才发布配置的 `emptyValue`，取消恢复已提交范围。初始空范围和只选一个端点的范围仍需补全端点；从非空范围主动清空得到的空草稿可以确认。禁用、只读以及任一端点锁定时不能整体清空；受控打开未被接受时也不会直接清空模型。 ### 透传配置边界与优先级 建议使用 `DateRangePopupOptions` 声明 popup-props，边界与 DatePopupOptions 一致。仅用于 inline 锚定弹层；范围值、规则、open/defaultOpen、禁用及通知归 DateRange 管理。popup-container 顶层优先、嵌套回退，popupClass 合并内部类；trigger、closeOnClickReference、preventFocus、popupOffset 由展示层固定，Maple 还固定 unmountOnClose=true。新类型不开放这些固定项，附加平移使用 popupTranslate。已有运行时字段/监听过滤和旧配置可用能力保持。 本次仅新增可主动选用的专用类型，不收窄已发布的宽属性类型，不增加运行时过滤、不改变覆盖顺序；旧业务写法继续可编译。若直接使用旧宽属性，内部托管字段仍可能通过类型检查，但不代表能控制内部状态。 ```ts import type { DateRangePopupOptions } from '@maple-design/ui' ``` ```demo With `draggable` enabled, title inputs, textareas, buttons, links with href and editable content retain native pointer behavior and do not start a drag. The ordinary title area remains draggable. In non-centered mode, numeric `top=0` is supported just like the string `0px`.

### Before hooks and callback compatibility

`beforeClose({ action }, done, context)` is the only hook entry. No new closeGuard/confirmGuard/cancelGuard prop is introduced.


A before hook that only logs synchronously must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means callback completion is still pending. Old async callbacks that returned `Promise<void>` without calling done now complete on Promise resolution.


```demo
../example/demos/en-US/guard-protocol.vue
```


Promise and done share a single completion state: false/done(false) rejects; true/done() allows; a resolved Promise<void> allows. The first completion wins. Errors emit guard-error; cancellation/unmount invalidates late completion. Synchronous void retains the callback protocol and waits for done on these close/confirm guards.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, titles and action spacing use logical start/end. External popovers inherit their source direction. Closing, confirmation, cancellation and uncommitted state are unchanged by direction switches.

Instance close(), returned handle close(), Dialog.close() and parent open=false are direct commands that bypass guards; a controlled parent still decides whether to accept update:open(false). ### Dialog Methods

All open methods accept `DialogConfig | string` and return `Promise<DialogAction | void> & DialogReturn`.
Function-based Dialog calls default to simple layout (`simple: true`) with the top-right close button hidden (`closable: false`). Explicit options or global defaults can override both.

| Method | Default behavior |
| ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `Dialog.open(config)` | Ordinary dialog |
| `Dialog.confirm(config)` | `type: 'warning'`, simple layout |
| `Dialog.alert(config)` | No cancel button; overlay/ESC closing disabled |
| `Dialog.info/success/warning/error(config)` | Corresponding status, no cancel button, simple layout |
| `Dialog.close()` | Close the latest functional dialog |
| `Dialog.setDefaultOptions(config)` | Set default programmatic options |
| `Dialog.resetDefaultOptions()` | Reset default programmatic options |

`DialogConfig` matches camelCase component props and additionally supports renderable `content`/`title`/`message`/`footer` plus `onOpen`/`onOpened`/`onClose`/`onClosed`/`onConfirm`/`onCancel`/`onClickOverlay`/`onKeyEscape`.

`DialogReturn.close()` closes this dialog; `DialogReturn.update(config)` updates mutable configuration. After installation, `this.$dialog` exposes the same API.

```ts
type DialogAction = 'confirm' | 'cancel' | 'close'
type DialogType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'
```

## CSS Variables

Variables use `--mp-`, e.g. `--mp-dialog-width`, `--mp-dialog-background`, `--mp-dialog-border-radius`, `--mp-dialog-simple-width`, `--mp-dialog-fullscreen-width` and `--mp-dialog-close-button-color`.

Color semantics match Cedar: `--mp-dialog-background` uses `surface-raised`; `--mp-dialog-overlay-background` controls scrim; titles/body use primary content and close controls secondary content. `--mp-dialog-status-{info|success|warning|danger}-color` uses readable content-info/success/warning/danger, not status fill. Business themes should override component variables; shared themes override system variables. Mobile borderless geometry/layout remain independent.

The backdrop consumes `sys-color-scrim` through the Dialog component variable. Maple no longer uses Popup colors for Dialog. Set a per-instance backdrop variable via `overlay-style`; a variable on the panel (`dialog-style`) does not inherit to its sibling backdrop. Explicit `overlay-style.backgroundColor` wins. Teleported content needs variables on its actual DOM ancestors. Dark themes inherit the same semantic colors; geometry remains platform-specific. Status icons use readable content colors.

Variables are grouped by purpose: background/overlay-background for panel/scrim; border-* for panel/divider borders; title-* for title typography; content-* for body typography; actions-* for actions; close-button-* for the close button; status-* for semantic icons; simple-*/fullscreen-* for mode dimensions; animation-* for enter/leave motion. width/margin-top control ordinary panel layout. Internal drag/position variables are not public customization points.

### Guard waiting feedback
Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.

### Drag lifecycle
Title dragging is controlled only by the initiating primary pointer. Disabling `draggable`, closing, entering fullscreen, losing pointer capture or owner-window focus, deactivation and unmount all end the gesture and release listeners and capture. Reenabling requires a new gesture; the previous pointer cannot resume it. Disabling preserves the current offset; fullscreen and the existing post-close reset restore defaults. Listeners belong to the title element's document.

### Programmatic dialog mount targets
Function calls honor `popupContainer` from explicit configuration or `setDefaultOptions`, using the component's selector/HTMLElement resolution and missing/invalid-selector fallback to body. The default targets body; `false` renders inline in the service's own body host. `handle.update({ popupContainer })` moves the same dialog and preserves content state and app context. Closing removes teleported content and its service host, independently of notification callback results. A custom container controls DOM attachment; layout still follows Dialog positioning and its containing block.

## API

### Divider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical orientation of the divider itself, default horizontal; does not control text alignment | `horizontal` \| `vertical` | `horizontal` |
| `type` | Line style | `solid` \| `dashed` \| `dotted` \| `double` | `solid` |

| `inset` | Inset along the line: left/right horizontally, top/bottom vertically | `DividerSize` | — |
| `spacing` | Outer spacing across the line: top/bottom horizontally, left/right vertically | `DividerSize` | `md` |
| `thickness` | Finite line width of at least 1px; omission uses the 1px theme default; hairline takes precedence | `number` | — |
| `hairline` | Scale the theme line width by half; 0.5px with the default theme | `boolean` | `false` |
| `color` | Line color; defaults to the theme border color | `string` | — |
| `opacity` | Opacity of the entire divider, including text, from 0 to 1; zero preserves layout | `number` | — |

### Spacing values

`DividerSize = number | string | [number | string] | [number | string, number | string]`

`inset` controls the ends of the line; `spacing` controls the outer gap between the line and adjacent content. Both accept presets `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, a number in px, a CSS length, or an array. A scalar or single-item array applies to both ends; `[start, end]` sets each end separately. Array entries are lengths, not preset names.

| Direction | inset array order | spacing array order |
| --- | --- | --- |
| horizontal | Inline start/end inset; right/left in RTL | Top/bottom margin |
| vertical | Top/bottom inset | Inline start/end margin; right/left in RTL |

`inset` has no `inset` by default; `spacing` defaults to the platform’s `md` `spacing`. Presets use platform theme tokens, so pixel values may differ.


Development checks cover orientation, text-align, type, spacing shape, thickness and opacity. Invalid enums use defaults; invalid inset produces no indentation, invalid spacing falls back to md, and invalid opacity does not override styles. opacity must be finite and within 0–1. Arrays accept one or two lengths and no preset names. Finite negative margins and CSS var/calc expressions remain supported; browsers parse their CSS syntax.

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | Custom divider content; overrides description |

Providing `expand` makes the component request updates from its parent rather than changing controlled state. When omitted, internal state is used, initialized once by `default-expand`. Tooltip follows its own width and trigger defaults; display does not depend on measured overflow. Touch callers can include `click` in `tooltip.trigger` explicitly. External class/style/width apply directly to the text node.

### Ellipsis Events / Slots

- `update:expand(expand: boolean)`: the new state requested by user interaction; external updates do not emit it.
- `default`: body text.
- `tooltip-content`: tooltip content. Without it, tooltip.content takes precedence, then body text; content is not concatenated twice.
- Keyboard: expandable text supports Enter / Space; tooltip-enabled text is focusable with Tab. No public instance methods.

### Public entries and listener types

The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.

### Rows and content boundaries

expand-trigger supports only click. Invalid values produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and do not enable button semantics, click or keyboard expansion. line-clamp accepts finite numbers or numeric strings of at least one row and floors decimals. Values below one, nonfinite values and invalid strings warn and fall back to ordinary single-line mode, clearing old multiline styles. Prefer plain text or inline content without independent interactions. The default Tooltip still does not detect actual overflow and remains focusable with Tab when enabled. Custom tooltip content and controlled expansion remain unchanged.

# Fab

### Intro

The floating action button component, press to display a group of action buttons.

The live preview starts expanded. Actions show a Message and collapse the menu. Changing direction moves the button to a compatible edge. Use click on touch devices; hover is intended for a mouse.

The local preview uses `fixed=false` and `popup-container=false`. The drag example keeps the default `fixed=true` to enable dragging and uses `popup-container=false` to keep the button inside the preview container. Drag boundaries use the container dimensions. Dragging uses touch gestures.

The preview and button remain visible when toggling dragging. Switching it off stops dragging. The preview scrolls with the page.

### visible versus v-if

Use `<mp-fab v-if="showFab" />` when destroying the instance is acceptable; visible is optional. v-if=false destroys FAB, its drag state and action children; remounting reads defaultOpen again. `:visible="showFab"` retains the instance and internal state while hiding its trigger and actions. FAB uses Drag/Teleport, so visible controls the actual content internally; avoid relying on v-show on the Teleport component. The action menu itself still uses open.

The default icon button has a localized name; pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` to customize it. When actions exist, the trigger also exposes `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Bind the `triggerProps` slot value to a custom focusable button; the application owns its disabled state.

Hover mode supports Enter/Space on the trigger. It stays open while focus remains on the trigger or actions after the pointer leaves, and closes when both pointer and focus leave. Escape requests close and returns focus to the trigger when focus was in the actions. Action clicks do not close automatically; control `v-model:open` in the application when desired.

`open` and `close` are interaction requests which a controlled parent may reject. External model changes and disabling do not necessarily emit matching request events. `opened`/`closed` receive the action element after the animation. Position and placement use physical sides without automatic flipping; `FabDrag` is a boolean or an object with `axis`, `attraction`, and `boundary`.

## API

`open`/`update:open` control the action menu through `v-model:open`. Without binding, `defaultOpen` initializes internally maintained state. `visible` controls the whole component without changing saved menu-`open` state. The `trigger` slot receives `{ open, triggerProps }`; bind `triggerProps` to its actual focusable button.

### visible 与 v-if

不需要保留实例时，直接使用 `<mp-fab v-if="showFab" />`，无需再传 visible。v-if=false 会销毁 FAB、拖拽状态与动作子组件；重新显示会重新读取 defaultOpen。`:visible="showFab"` 保留实例和内部状态，只隐藏触发器与动作内容。FAB 默认通过 Drag/Teleport 挂到弹层容器，visible 在实际内容内部控制显示；不要依赖对 Teleport 组件直接使用 v-show。动作菜单自身仍使用 open。

默认图标按钮有本地化名称；可通过 `aria-label` 或 `aria-labelledby` 指定名称。若有动作，触发器还暴露 `aria-expanded` 和 `aria-controls`。自定义触发器应把 `triggerProps` 绑定到实际可聚焦按钮，并由业务自行处理禁用。

hover 模式支持触发器上的 Enter/Space；焦点仍在触发器或动作区时鼠标离开不会收起，焦点与鼠标均离开时收起。Escape 请求关闭，焦点位于动作区时回到触发器。动作点击不会自动关闭，业务可使用 `v-model:open` 收起。

`open`/`close` 表示交互请求，受控父级可以拒绝；外部改变 `open` 或禁用时的状态变化不保证产生相应请求事件。`opened`/`closed` 在动画结束时提供动作区元素。位置与展开方向均是物理方向，动作区不会自动翻转；`FabDrag` 为 boolean 或包含 `axis`、`attraction`、`boundary` 的对象。

## API

`open` / `update:open` 通过 `v-model:open` 控制动作菜单展开；未绑定时使用 `defaultOpen` 初始化，之后由组件维护。`visible` 控制整个组件显示，不改变动作菜单保存的展开状态。`trigger` 插槽参数为 `{ open, triggerProps }`，自定义原生按钮应使用 `v-bind="triggerProps"`。

# FloatingPanel

### Intro
A panel floating at the bottom of the page, is often used to provide additional functionality or information, allowing users to freely drag up and down through content.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

The demo is confined to a 400px container using `popup-container=false` and a local fixed-position containing block, so it does not cover the documentation. Application panels still default to the window bottom. Custom anchors are 80, 180 and 320px; the header-only example lets content scroll without resizing the panel.

```demo
../example/demos/basic.vue
```

## API

### Value and default value

Use normal `v-model`. `modelValue` is the strictly controlled docked height in px. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once and later changes do not reset it. An explicit binding takes precedence; initialization does not emit `update:modelValue`. Dragging shows a temporary height. Ending notifies the candidate anchor; a refusing parent restores the effective bound anchor. `touchcancel`, deactivation, or model/anchor changes during dragging cancel without committing.

### FloatingPanel Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------- |
| `v-model` | Current settled height in pixels; updated after dragging and snapping | _number_ | `-` |
| `default-value` | Initial uncontrolled height, read only at creation | _number_ | `100` |
| `anchors` | Finite nonnegative anchors in px. Invalid entries are filtered and duplicates removed; empty or entirely invalid arrays use defaults. Sorting is unnecessary; ties prefer the earlier supplied entry. | _number[]_ | `[100, window.innerHeight * 0.6]` |
| `content-draggable` | Whether to allow to drag panel content area | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `duration` | Finite nonnegative animation duration in ms. Numeric strings are supported; invalid values fall back to 300 and 0 disables transform animation. | _number \| string_ | `300` |
| `elevation` | Elevation level, options `true` `false` and level of `0-24` | _number \| boolean_ | `true` |
| `popup-container` | Mount target: defaults to body; false renders in place. Supports a selector or HTMLElement. | _PopupContainer_ | `body` |
| `safe-area` | Whether to adapt to the bottom, left and right safe areas | _boolean_ | `false` |

Omitting `popup-container` mounts to `body`; `false` renders inline. Missing or invalid selectors fall back to `body` with a development warning. Targets can change at runtime, and SSR does not query browser DOM.

### FloatingPanel Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `update:model-value` | Height after dragging and snapping; not emitted during initialization | `height: number` |
| `height-change` | Notifies a changed candidate anchor on drag end; parent acceptance is not guaranteed. | `height: number` |

### FloatingPanel Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Custom panel content | `-` |
| `header` | Custom panel header | `-` |

### Keyboard and types

The custom-anchor example uses native Collapse and Expand buttons in the header slot. Enter/Space adjusts the same v-model. The default drag handle supports touch only. The panel root does not automatically declare a dialog or button role; provide region names and interaction semantics for the content.

Heights and initial values must be finite and nonnegative; invalid values display the minimum effective anchor. Dynamic anchors rematch the nearest value without writing back. External changes do not emit user commit events. Events are notifications; Promises are not awaited and do not drive loading. `content-draggable=false` preserves native content scrolling.

```ts
import { FloatingPanel } from '@maple-design/ui/floating-panel'
import type { FloatingPanelProps, FloatingPanelInstance, PopupContainer } from '@maple-design/ui'
```

No custom public instance methods. Eight props, two events and two unscoped slots. PopupContainer accepts HTMLElement, selectors and false; the shared type is authoritative.

### 主值与默认值

| `content-draggable` | 是否允许拖拽面板内容       | _boolean_ | `true`  |

## Reading direction

Form and FormItem accept start/end/left/center/right for content-align and start/end/left/right for label-align. Content defaults to start and labels to end: default LTR placement stays the same while RTL follows reading order. Explicit left/right remain physical. Item overrides and explicit label-column styles retain precedence. Direction changes preserve values, validation and disabled/readonly state.

## Form appearance and layout

### Layout switching and item overrides

`edit-mode` describes editing behavior: `direct` always shows the control; `popup` opens the mobile editor. `readPretty` is an independent boolean. FormItem and fields inherit the mode when omitted. The legacy field `presentation` prop has been removed; use `edit-mode` to configure editing behavior. Replace `presentation="inline"` with `edit-mode="direct"`; `layout="inline"` is unchanged.

Combine `vertical`, `horizontal` and `inline` layouts with `direct / popup` editing and the independent `readPretty` boolean to compare label, control, value and wrapped-text alignment while retaining the same data. Notes can override the layout or inherit it. In `popup`, click a value to edit and confirm to save; `readPretty` uses `read-pretty` to display plain text.

`content-align` switches values between left, center and right in every field mode. FormItem inherits Form unless overridden. It positions compact controls and aligns field values; label alignment and help/error text stay independent. A field's explicit `text-align` overrides the inherited alignment.

#### Responsive label columns

Horizontal layouts default to 5/24 label and 19/24 control columns. Cedar defaults to horizontal; Maple defaults to vertical. Only horizontal uses column proportions and auto width. When not paused, confirmation immediately compares the current source code. Change the source after a successful match, then validate only confirmation or submit again to observe the dependency error; correct confirmation and submit with Enter or the submit button. Native reset clears model values, feedback and the displayed last-submission value, while the submission count remains cumulative. Dependencies are revalidated explicitly: editing alone does not guarantee that an existing success is current. This local example is not exhaustive asynchronous submit-race coverage or external persistence.

```

Pause cross-field validation holds the confirmation rule until Resolve cross-field result. Completion compares that confirmation value with the current source, not a remote service or a source snapshot from submission start. ### Maple rule protocol

FormRules maps field names to a FormRule or rule array. FormRule supports functions and Zod schemas rather than Cedar FieldRule objects; unsupported structures produce development prop diagnostics. Use FormItem.required for required validation and markers rather than a decorative-only rules.required object. Functions receive `(value, context)` with model and field; candidate saves validate a candidate model. Only true passes; other normal returns become error text through String. Promises are supported. Zod uses safeParseAsync and the first issue message.

Unexpected throws or Promise rejection reject public validate for try/catch handling. The current task releases validating and retains its previous business error, without a business-failure notification. Stale exceptions do not clear newer pending feedback. FormItem validate only notifies the latest normal boolean result. Form.useValidation, Form.useForm, Form.useFormItem and FormItem.useFormItem retain their composition roles.

```ts
import type { FormRule, FormRules, FormRuleContext } from '@maple-design/ui'
const nameRule: FormRule<string> = async (value, context) => {
  await Promise.resolve()
  return value.length > 0 || `${context.field} is required`
}
const rules: FormRules = { name: nameRule }
```

### Public validation and notification contract

Form and FormItem default slots have no scoped arguments. FormItem also provides label, help and extra slots without model helpers. Form manages state through the model object and field paths.

`validate(callback?)` and `validateField(fields, callback?)` await their rules, returning undefined on success or an error record by field on business failure. Callbacks only notify for a current task. Errors contain field, message, label, value, type and isRequiredError. The value remains the original field value.

submit-success precedes submit; business failure sends submit-failed before submit. An unfinished editing session sends only submit-failed. Its errors.editing contains only field="editing" and message, without fabricated field-validation data. FormSubmitError distinguishes this notice from a full ValidatedError.

These events notify only: listener Promises are not awaited and do not execute requests or control loading. Business code manages asynchronous-save loading. Native reset prevents default behavior, resets fields and then notifies reset. Form resetFields writes to model; an inner Form inside FilterForm has its own scope.

`beforeCommit` belongs to fields supporting editing transactions. Its signature is `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean>`. The payload contains value and previousValue; context contains signal and an optional event. Returning undefined waits for done; a boolean or Promise settles by its result. It is not a Form submit event or general loading entry point.

```ts
import type {
  FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance,
  ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData,
  FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError,
  BeforeFieldCommit,
} from '@maple-design/ui'
```

## 动态与异步字段

### 多字段异步聚合

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置       | 作用                                                     | 相关示例                                                 |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`    | 表单数据对象，`FormItem` 通过 `field` 从中读取和写入数据 | 多字段异步聚合、禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序 |
| `disabled` | 是否禁用                                                 | 禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序                 |
| `readonly` | 是否只读                                                 | 禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序                 |
| `rules`    | 按字段名配置的表单校验规则                               | 禁用、只读与异步确认                                     |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

显式调用validate()或validateField()会使等待中的旧原生submit失效：命令校验有自己的结果，不应让旧submit在完成后把旧错误或成功与当前模型混发。此后新的原生submit仍正常等待自己的字段校验并通知一次。该规则仅逻辑失效、不取消真实请求，不清空历史提交计数；既有方法签名不变，不保留旧的混发行为。等待中修改模型或规则也会使本次提交失效，需重新提交校验。

“返回最新用户名结果 / 返回最新代码结果”优先结清对应字段最新任务，可让新submit先完成、旧结果最后返回。新成功后旧失败不追加提交或恢复错误；新失败后旧成功不追加提交或清除新错误。仍须等最新提交的两个字段都返回，单个字段返回不提交；默认“返回用户名/代码结果”继续返回最早任务。

原生submit采用最新提交生效：旧提交仍等待时再次提交，使旧提交的submit/submit-success/submit-failed续体失效。用guest/bad提交后改为admin/1234再提交；先返回旧两个结果，原生提交计数应仍0，新提交仍等自己的两个结果。反向旧成功/新失败同理，旧成功不能提前报通过。这个规则不取消真实请求；等待中修改模型或规则同样使旧提交失效。

原生submit等待中调用resetFields（含原生reset）会使该提交失效；旧Promise结清后不得再发submit、submit-success或submit-failed。停用/卸载同样使旧提交失效，后续新提交仍正常校验。此为逻辑失效，不是取消远端请求；并发submit和跨字段异步依赖不在这个重置协议内。

“原生异步提交”是表单内的原生submit按钮，也可聚焦后按Enter。独立“原生提交”计数须等两个本地异步字段都返回才增加：用户名失败先返回时暂不提交，代码返回后记录失败；修正为admin再提交，反序返回代码/用户名后记录成功并清错。下方“结果”仍只表示命令式校验，两个计数/结果互不冒充。完成后重置清空字段、保留历史提交计数。此顺序重试不代表并发submit或跨字段异步依赖已覆盖。

同一示例可连续点击两次“校验两个字段”：先输入旧值并发起，再改值发起新一轮。“返回用户名结果 / 返回代码结果”各返回该字段最早任务。旧整表先完成时，新一轮仍须等它自己的两个字段；旧成功或失败都不应覆盖最新字段反馈。结果文案由示例序号单独保护，不是 Form 自动取消旧请求，也不是原生提交并发协议。

两个字段分别返回独立本地 Promise。先返回任一字段可更新该字段反馈，但整表须等两个字段都完成。重置使旧反馈和示例结果失效，旧任务仍可手动返回以观察迟到结果。这里演示命令式 validate()，不是原生提交事件并发或跨字段依赖。

也可在用户名结果已返回、代码仍等待时重置，立即输入新值并再次校验。此时返回最早代码只会结清旧任务，不能恢复旧错误或提前完成新整表；必须返回新一轮自己的两个结果。分别用旧失败/新成功、旧成功/新失败核对字段反馈；结果文案仍由示例版本号单独保护，不等于取消真实请求。

### 异步校验的返回顺序

主动调用 `validateField` 后可继续修改字段并发起新校验。本例用真实 Promise 规则且不访问网络，关闭自动触发，只通过按钮发起。先校验 guest，再校验 admin，先返回最新结果再返回最早结果，观察旧错误不会覆盖最新字段状态。结果文案由示例请求序号保护，“本次校验值”是校验快照，不是服务端提交。

清空校验或重置后，仍可返回等待中的旧结果；卸载和停用会结清本地等待。真实接口应取消请求，并由业务保护提交快照和版本。

等待中可切换表单 disabled / readonly：它们限制控件交互，不自动取消已发起校验，也不清除已有错误。外部校验控制按钮不在被禁用的 Form 内。需要使旧结果失效时主动清空校验或重置；解除限制后可再次输入并校验。

关闭 Mount async field 会移除字段但保留业务模型和待返回任务。重新挂载后可发起新校验，再按新旧顺序返回结果，核对旧实例的错误不会污染新字段；这不是删除业务数据，也不是整表并发提交协议。

等待中可通过“写入服务端错误”调用 `setFields` 设置显式错误；之前的异步成功或失败不应覆盖它。示例仍保留旧任务供手动返回，结果文案单独做版本保护。清空校验可移除错误，重新发起校验后以新结果为准；不代表真实接口已取消。

“校验整表”调用 `validate()`，“校验字段”调用 `validateField('name')`。可交错发起并按不同顺序返回，分别观察字段反馈和示例最新结果；重置使旧结果失效，不等于取消真实服务。当前示例只有一个异步字段，不代表多字段聚合、跨字段依赖或原生 submit 事件并发均已覆盖。

### Maple 规则协议

FormRules 是按字段名组织的 FormRule 或其数组。FormRule 支持函数或 Zod schema，不接受 Cedar FieldRule 规则对象；开发环境对不支持的规则结构给出属性诊断。必填校验和星号使用 FormItem.required，不使用只有装饰、没有实际校验的 rules.required 对象。函数接收 `(value, context)`，context 含当前 model 和 field；候选保存校验使用候选模型。正常返回 true 才表示通过，其他返回值按 String 转为错误文字；可返回 Promise。Zod 通过 safeParseAsync 运行，取首条 issue 的 message。

意外 throw 或 Promise 拒绝会让公开 validate 拒绝，调用方用 try/catch 处理；最新任务会释放 validating，保留之前的业务错误，不转成业务失败通知。旧任务异常不会清除新任务的等待状态。FormItem 的 validate 事件仅通知最新正常结算的布尔结果，不承担任务执行。Form.useValidation、Form.useForm、Form.useFormItem 和 FormItem.useFormItem 保持现有组合扩展职责。

```ts
import type { FormRule, FormRules, FormRuleContext } from '@maple-design/ui'
const nameRule: FormRule<string> = async (value, context) => {
  await Promise.resolve()
  return value.length > 0 || `${context.field} is required`
}
const rules: FormRules = { name: nameRule }
```

### 公开校验与通知合同

Form 与 FormItem 的默认插槽没有作用域参数；FormItem 还提供 label、help、extra 插槽，均不通过参数操作模型。Form 使用 model 对象及字段路径管理状态，不以插槽参数替代业务模型。

`validate(callback?)` 和 `validateField(fields, callback?)` 等待对应规则，成功返回 undefined，业务失败返回按字段聚合的错误对象；回调只通知当前有效任务。错误记录包含 field、message、label、value、type、isRequiredError。value 保留原字段值，不先转换成显示文字。

submit-success 先于 submit 通知，业务校验失败时 submit-failed 先于 submit。编辑会话未完成的阻止分支只通知 submit-failed，其 errors.editing 只有 field="editing" 与 message，不伪造字段校验信息；公开类型 FormSubmitError 区分该提示与完整 ValidatedError。

这些事件是通知，不等待监听器 Promise，也不自动执行请求或切换 loading。业务异步保存自行控制 loading。原生 reset 会阻止默认行为、执行 resetFields 后通知 reset；Form 的 resetFields 会写回 model，与 FilterForm 内部 Form 的职责不同。

`beforeCommit` 属于支持编辑事务的字段组件，签名为 `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean>`；payload 含 value、previousValue，context 含 signal 和可选 event。返回 undefined 表示等待 done；返回布尔或 Promise 按结果结算。它不是 Form 的 submit 事件或通用加载入口。

```ts
import type {
  FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance,
  ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData,
  FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError,
  BeforeFieldCommit,
} from '@maple-design/ui'
```

### Motion

HoverOverlay opacity transitions respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and are disabled when reduced motion is requested.

## API

### Standalone icon styles and usage boundaries

Resolver auto-imports include the lightweight rotation styles for standalone icons. With `importStyle: false`, applications must import those styles. The UI Icon style entry also includes them; loading every icon is unnecessary.

When manually importing standalone SVG components, import this stylesheet once in your application entry when using `spin`:

```ts
import '@maple-design/icons-vue/style.css'
```

`rotate` and `spin` can be combined; built-in rotation respects reduced motion. `transition` controls registered-name changes only, using milliseconds as a number or numeric string, such as `200` / `"200"`; it does not parse `"200ms"` / `"1s"`. The default slot owns content and skips name-`transition` animation. Removing it immediately shows the latest name. Custom `animation-class` should avoid overriding the `transform` used for continuous rotation and should implement reduced-motion behavior.

`name` only resolves icons explicitly registered in the current application before rendering; it does not download resources. Registration after mount does not refresh an existing icon automatically. The container's native `title` is not forwarded to its SVG. Set `title` on standalone icons for image naming, and use an accessibly named Button for actions. `click` is a notification supporting Vue `.once`; listener Promises do not manage waiting. `stroke-*` affects strokes only; filled or fixed multicolor artwork may not respond.

### Motion

Built-in motion follows prefers-reduced-motion: reduce: content and state feedback remain, while decorative spinning, shimmer and ripples stop. Icon name changes display the latest value immediately and cancel unfinished phases, keeping CSS and JS durations aligned. Callers must adapt custom animation classes. ## Usage notes



Only resolves icons registered in the current application. Repeated name changes display the latest requested icon, and unmounting stops pending switches.

Icons inherit the host font size on both platforms. For a fixed 20px icon, set size="20" or icon-size explicitly. The size prop overrides the variable; color inherits from the host by default.

# Image

Single and grouped previews default to body-mounted viewport overlays. Only explicit `:popup-container="false"` renders inline and requires a positioned, sized parent. Only the active image's load/error settles its loading indicator; returning to a cached image does not leave the spinner visible.

Closing the preview, changing the image or changing looping cancels pending movement. Deactivation or unmounting stops movement; reactivation uses the current image.

Preview long press500ms and double-tap recognition320ms are interaction policy, not CSS duration/close delay. Release/move/close/source replacement/deactivation/disposal invalidate stale timers; consumed callbacks cannot replay. Inactive/disposed input entries are inert. ## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Previous/next preview navigation, horizontal keys and swipes follow reading direction without reversing the value array. Direction changes cancel unfinished gestures while preserving the current image, zoom and rotation. Images and zoomed drag coordinates are not mirrored automatically. Image indices retain LTR numeric display.

When `images` is omitted or `undefined`, the group collects previewable child Images in DOM order; updating a child URL preserves its identity and position. An explicitly supplied array is the source, and `[]` means no images. Set it back to `undefined` to resume child collection. In array mode use the group `open` / `to` methods to select an image; child Images do not map themselves to array indices.

Public indices start at 1. The displayed index is clamped when data shrinks, and child reordering preserves the selected image identity. A controlled `modelValue` receives an update request when adjustment is needed; its owner can accept or reject it. No preview content is shown when the list is empty; the open state remains, so content may reappear when images return.

A previewable image exposes a named button action supporting Tab, Enter and Space. When preview closes, focus returns to its opener if focus is still in the preview or has fallen to the document body. The action is absent when preview is disabled or the image has failed. Explicit `alt=""` stays empty; a previewable decorative image still has a separately named preview action. When `alt` is omitted, `imgProps.alt`, `description`, then `loadDescription` supply the fallback.

When keyboard shortcuts are enabled, only the topmost preview handles arrow keys and Space. Inputs, editable regions and other interactive controls retain their own key behavior.

`Image.showPreview()` requests the current image preview. The `imagePreview`, `previewImage`, and `ImagePreviewFn` service accepts a URL, URL array, or options and returns `ImagePreviewHandle | undefined` (for example during SSR). Its handle offers the 12 Group operations; paging operations have no effect for a single image. The service also exposes `close()`, `setDefaultOptions()`, and `resetDefaultOptions()`. Native `lazy` is browser-scheduled and does not promise automatic retries.

Scale parameters must be finite and positive; invalid min/max/default/step values fall back to 0.5/8/1/0.5. If max is below min it resolves to min. Initial and reset scales are clamped, changes to bounds clamp the current value, and `zoomTo` ignores nonfinite input. `close` in `actionsLayout` is a toolbar action, independent of the separate button controlled by `closable`.

### Image-preview group numbering

`modelValue/defaultValue` start at `1`. `open(imageNumber = 1)` and `to(imageNumber)` use the same numbering; invalid/noninteger values are ignored. `prev()/next()` retain this numbering at loop boundaries. Model events are `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`; navigation emits `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`, while external assignments do not. Long press emits `long-press(imageNumber)`; the indicator slot receives `{ imageNumber, length }`. Internal array indices remain zero-based.

Root `class` and `style` merge with the Image wrapper. Use `img-props.class/style` to `style` the inner image. Preview `open-change` is a Vue notification event: each state transition emits once, `.once` uses Vue event semantics, and returned Promises do not control loading. The typed `onOpenChange` listener uses this same event path.

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。预览集合的上一张/下一张、水平键与滑动沿阅读方向工作，值数组不反转。方向切换取消尚未完成的手势并保持当前图片、缩放与旋转；图片本身和放大后的拖拽坐标不自动镜像。图片序号保持 LTR 数值显示。

`images` 未提供或为 `undefined` 时收集可预览的子 Image，并随实际 DOM 顺序变化；子图片地址更新不会改变其身份或顺序。显式提供数组时只使用数组，`[]` 表示空集合；切回 `undefined` 后恢复子图片模式。数组模式下请使用组的 `open` / `to` 方法选择图片，子图片不负责映射数组索引。

索引对外从 1 开始。数据减少时显示索引会限制在有效范围内；子图片重排时保留当前图片身份。受控 `modelValue` 需要调整时会发出更新请求，父级可自行接受或拒绝；无图片时不显示预览内容，既有 open 状态保留，数据再次出现时可能恢复显示。

可预览的图片提供具名按钮语义，支持 Tab、Enter 和 Space；预览关闭时，如果焦点仍在预览内或已回到页面主体，会尝试返回打开预览前的焦点。关闭预览功能或图片加载失败时不提供该入口。显式 `alt=""` 保持为空；可预览的装饰图仍通过独立的预览操作名称提供可访问入口。`alt` 未提供时依次使用 `imgProps.alt`、`description` 和 `loadDescription`。

开启键盘快捷键时，仅顶层预览处理方向键与空格；输入框、可编辑区域和其他交互控件保留自身按键行为。

### 图片预览组序号

`modelValue/defaultValue` 从 **1** 开始，`1` 表示第 1 张。`open(imageNumber = 1)`、`to(imageNumber)` 接收相同序号，无效或非整数序号会被忽略。`prev()/next()` 在循环边界也回传同一规则的序号。模型事件为 `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`，切换通知为 `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`；外部赋值不补发切换通知。长按通知为 `long-press(imageNumber)`，指示器插槽参数为 `{ imageNumber, length }`。内部数组下标仍从 0 开始。

根节点 `class`、`style` 与 Image 容器样式合并；内部图片样式通过 `img-props.class/style` 设置。预览的 `open-change` 是 Vue 通知事件：每次状态切换只发送一次，`.once` 遵循 Vue 事件语义，返回 Promise 不控制 loading。类型中的 `onOpenChange` 监听器也走同一事件入口。

## Reading direction

The default index list sits at inline end. Letter/item order and vertical scroll coordinates do not reverse. Safe areas and sticky top offsets retain their physical meaning.

No index is initially active until scrolling or `scrollTo` selects one. Navigation uses native buttons supporting Tab, Enter and Space. Provide readable, noninteractive content in `anchor-name`.

Identifiers use strict equality: numeric `0` differs from string `"0"`. An omitted index is excluded; an empty string is valid. Use unique identifiers; with duplicates, programmatic navigation uses the first match. `duration` is read as milliseconds from a number or numeric string; nonpositive or nonfinite values scroll immediately. `sticky-offset-top` uses the existing length conversion and refers to the physical top. A new scroll command replaces the previous one; deactivation and unmount cancel pending scrolling.

Runtime changes retain the native editor, focus and selection; the browser handles caret movement, mixed text and composition without swapping editing keys. Clearing notifies clear → input → update:modelValue → change once each, with one corresponding Form notification. Clearing is blocked while readonly, disabled or composing. Rejected controlled proposals restore the native content, including input types without cursor APIs. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/event-pipeline.vue ``` ### Native Attributes ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/native-attrs.vue ``` ### Commit approval Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed. ### Shared field loading `loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Inherits FormItem/Form when unset; standalone usage defaults to direct. readPretty displays plain text; popup editing updates v-model after confirmation by default. # 输入框 ## 阅读方向 输入框继承页面或局部容器的 `dir`；前后缀、清除操作和输入框组按阅读顺序排列。运行时切换方向保留原生输入节点、焦点和选区；光标、选区、混合文字与输入法组合由浏览器处理，不交换左右编辑键。父级重绘时保留正在组合的原生文本；旧选区恢复任务不会覆盖新的组合缓冲。 ## 基础示例 ### 基础用法 ```demo ../example/demos/basic.vue ``` ### 表单控件尺寸对照 切换五档 size 和三种字段变体，比较 Input、Button、Select、日期时间及其他单行表单控件的高度。Button 在这里固定使用 outline。DatePicker/TimePicker 是面板，此处使用带输入框的 Date/Time 字段。示例同时展示有值、可清空、标签删除与长标签多选；Select/Cascader 设置 tag-nowrap 时保持同档高度，长标签文字省略、删除图标保留；标签行可横向滚动，清空按钮和箭头固定在外侧。被省略的标签正文支持悬停、键盘聚焦或点按查看完整文字，点外部或按 Esc 关闭，不改变选中值。可清空后恢复选中值重复比较。多行文本和允许换行的多选内容按内容撑高。 ```demo ../../field-decorator/example/demos/control-sizes.vue ``` ### 介绍 用于输入单行文本。组件支持多种外观、浮动提示、输入类型、状态以及前后缀内容。 默认长度按 UTF-16 码元计算（emoji 通常占 2）；默认截断不会拆开有效的代理对，边界不足时舍去整个字符。若需按用户感知字符（字素簇）计数和裁剪，请配套提供 `word-length` 与 `word-slice`；自定义裁剪结果由业务负责。 ## 外观与状态 ### 外观配置对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | | `placeholder` | 占位符，也可作为浮动提示文字 | 表单反馈、提示文字 | | `hint` | 是否将 placeholder 用作浮动提示文字 | 表单反馈、提示文字 | | `clearable` | 是否可清除；有值且可编辑时清除图标常驻显示 | 表单反馈 | | `variant` | `filled`、`outline` 或 `standard` | 提示文字 | 选择一个对比维度后，同屏展示它的全部可选值；其余配置和内容保持一致。可切换其他配置检查组合效果；输入类预览共享一个值。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 外观组合 适用于表单中的单行文本输入。调整变体、尺寸，用相同数据观察变化。内容保持一致，便于比较不同设置的实际效果。

输入内容与布局 ### 字数限制 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | | `placeholder` | 占位符，也可作为浮动提示文字 | 字数限制、前缀和后缀、自定义清除图标 | | `clearable` | 是否可清除；有值且可编辑时清除图标常驻显示 | 字数限制、自定义清除图标、组合状态继承 | | `max-length` | 有限非负长度或 `{ length, errorOnly? }`；0 不限；非法值提示并回退不限 | 字数限制 | | `hint` | 是否将 placeholder 用作浮动提示文字 | 输入框组合 | | `default-value` | 非受控初始值，仅创建时读取；后续修改不重置输入，不回写父级 | 组合状态继承 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用 | 组合状态继承 | ```demo ../example/demos/max-length.vue ``` `max-length` 为有限非负数或 `{ length, errorOnly? }`，`0` 表示不限。对象的 `length` 同样须为有限非负数，`errorOnly` 为可选布尔值；非法值沿 Vue Prop 校验提示并按不限长度回退，传入 null 按未设置处理。默认截断按 UTF-16 码元计算；自定义计数与裁剪请配套提供 `word-length / word-slice`。 ### 密码输入框 `mp-input-password` 增加可见性切换，支持 `visibility` / `default-visibility`、`visibility-toggle` 和 `visibility-change`；其余 Input 属性与事件直接透传。 ```demo ../example/demos/password.vue ``` ### 前缀和后缀 ```demo ../example/demos/prefix-suffix.vue ``` ### 自定义清除图标 ```demo ../example/demos/custom-clear-icon.vue ``` ### 输入框组合 `mp-input-group` 统一传递 `size`、`variant`、`disabled`、`readonly`、`hint`，子输入框显式设置的值（包括 `false`）优先。`mp-input-group-label` 可作为前后附加内容。 ```demo ../example/demos/group.vue ``` `InputGroupLabel` 的根节点为 span，用于输入框外侧的附加内容。可见字段名与原生输入的关联由 FormItem、原生 label 的 for/id 或 `aria-label` 提供。 ### 组合状态继承 密码切换和清除按钮也遵循合并后的禁用状态；只读输入不会显示清除按钮。 ```demo ../example/demos/group-state.vue ``` ## # InputNumber Long-press stepping stops on release, cancellation, deactivation or unmounting. Starting a new hold replaces the previous one. Reactivation requires a new gesture instead of resuming an old hold. CSS motion variables do not control the repeat cadence. InputNumber edits and commits numeric values. - A defined model-value is controlled; default-value only initializes uncontrolled state. Drafts may differ while editing. A rejected proposal restores the parent value after commit. External updates never emit user events or trigger validation. - By default, Enter or blur commits. With model-event="input", complete numeric edits update immediately; change still represents a commit. Enter followed by blur does not commit twice. - Approved clearing notifies **clear → input → update:modelValue → change**. Clear is an action notification and is not emitted after a veto. A target equal to the current model does not invent change. The default clear value is undefined; explicit empty-value may provide null or another supported numeric value. - Intermediate signs and decimal points are preserved while editing. A trailing decimal point commits as a number; a lone sign/dot restores the previous value. Invalid text and non-finite numbers are never published. IME input is processed once after composition. - Range limits win over precision. Both copies use isolated Decimal configuration; the public model remains a JavaScript number, not arbitrary-precision storage. - disabled/readonly/size inherit from InputGroup and Form. Explicit false overrides inheritance. variant/hint inherit InputGroup. An outer FormItem label suppresses a duplicate floating label. Cedar also reads ConfigProvider for fallback size; Maple uses its existing defaults. - Mouse/touch long press stops on release, cancel, leave, window blur, deactivation, disposal or state changes. Button mode offers larger touch targets. Arrow keys step; Enter commits. Native inputs always use `autocomplete="off"`; native attribute bags cannot enable autofill. ## Reading direction The numeric input inherits its source `dir`; step buttons follow reading order. Values, precision and vertical keys retain their meaning: ArrowUp increases and ArrowDown decreases. Neither values nor display strings are reversed. ## Basic examples ### Basic states ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/field-basic.vue ``` ## Appearance and layout ### Appearance combinations #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | ------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | | `size` | All five sizes implemented; inheritable | Form control size comparison, Sizes and variants | | `variant` | Field variant; inherits InputGroup | Form control size comparison, Sizes and variants | | `placeholder` | Placeholder | Form control size comparison, Sizes and variants | | `min` | Minimum | Appearance combinations | | `max` | Maximum | Appearance combinations | | `disabled` | Disabled; inherits when omitted | Form control size comparison | Use this example for quantities and numeric limits. # InputNumber InputNumber 用于编辑和提交业务数字。 - `model-value !== undefined` 表示受控；`default-value` 仅初始化非受控值。编辑草稿允许暂时不同于业务值；提交后若父组件拒绝更新，恢复到父组件值。外部回填不触发用户事件或校验。 - 默认在 Enter / 失焦时更新；`model-event="input"` 输入完整数字时更新，但 `change` 仍在提交时触发。Enter 后再失焦不会重复提交。 - 清空获准后按 **clear → input → update:modelValue → change** 通知；clear 表示动作通知，审批拒绝时不发出。清空目标与当前模型相同时不虚构 change。默认清空值为 undefined，显式 empty-value 可输出 null 或其他受支持数值。 - `-`、`.`、`1.` 等输入中间态暂时保留；提交 `1.` 得到数字 1，单独符号恢复之前的业务值。非法文本、NaN、Infinity 不会写入业务值。IME 组合输入结束后只处理一次。 - 范围优先于精度：舍入后仍限制在 min/max 内，非对齐边界保留实际值。两端采用独立配置的 Decimal 运算，不受应用修改 Decimal 全局配置影响；模型仍是 JavaScript number，不承诺任意精度的大数存储。 - 禁用/只读/尺寸从 InputGroup、FormItem、Form 继承，显式 false 可以覆盖；Cedar 的缺省尺寸再读取 ConfigProvider，Maple 使用现有默认系统。字段外观与 hint 可继承 InputGroup；外层已有 FormItem 标题时不重复显示浮动标签。 - 鼠标、触控都支持长按；释放、取消、移出、窗口失焦、组件停用/卸载或状态变化时停止。移动端建议用 button 布局增加触控面积；↑/↓ 步进，Enter 提交。 所有原生输入统一使用 `autocomplete="off"`，传入原生属性也不会开启自动填充。 ## 阅读方向 数字输入继承来源 `dir`，增减按钮随阅读顺序排列。数值、精度和上下键语义保持不变：ArrowUp ### Virtual navigation

The demo uses `Space direction="column"` to place controls above a full-width list. `estimatedSize` estimates unmeasured rows; application rows do not need a fixed height.

Navigation uses rendered row bounds when available and updates virtual padding after measurement. Programmatic scroll events preserve the current alignment while rendering rows; a different native scroll position, a new command, data replacement, deactivation or disposal cancels its deferred correction. `auto` leaves a fully visible row and the rendered window unchanged. This does not promise continuous tracking of arbitrary asynchronous row resizing.

`scrollIntoView` forwards options to the internal VirtualList `scrollTo` only in virtual mode; it is not a direct native DOM scrollIntoView or a local motion timer. Native scrolling, preferences and retained-command lifecycle require a separate VirtualList consumer audit. Source hints are not visual acceptance; this classification changes no List API/implementation.

## API

The virtual list covers the viewport first and renders `buffer` items beyond it on each side. `buffer=0` is valid. `estimatedSize` must be finite and positive, including values below 1; invalid values fall back to 30px. `fixedSize` can change dynamically. Variable-height mode uses measured and estimated heights; rows are measured on mount and unmount, not continuously after asynchronous size changes. The `item` slot receives the original index and unknown data; return a single measurable root and provide a stable `itemKey`. To convey the complete collection to assistive technology, provide `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` on application rows as appropriate.

### List Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | Data consumed by item slot | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | Outer border | boolean | true |
| split | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | boolean | true |
| loading | Initial loading/refresh feedback, not pagination state | boolean | false |
| max-height | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

Virtual lists use a dedicated viewport without nesting a custom scrollbar. virtualListProps.height overrides maxHeight; with neither, height defaults to 200px. Numeric and unit-bearing CSS lengths are accepted. Invalid/nonpositive max-height does not constrain height.

ListVirtualListProps supports height, threshold, fixedSize, estimatedSize, buffer, itemKey and component. Removed isStaticItemHeight is unsupported; List.data supplies data. Counts at or below threshold render all items. Variable heights use measurements and estimatedSize; buffer controls overscan rows.

ListScrollbarProps supports type: 'track'|'embed', outerClass, outerStyle, hide, disableHorizontal and disableVertical. JavaScript object fields use camelCase.

### List Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event): one notification per real scroll event.
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align }): virtual-list positioning. index overrides key; align is top/bottom/auto. auto does nothing for a fully visible item, otherwise scrolls the minimum distance required. Invalid targets or nonvirtual mode do nothing.

### List Slots

List slots: default (overrides data), item({ item, index }), header, footer, empty. Empty state appears only without a default slot/data and while not loading. ListItem prefix/default/suffix retain list-item semantics without managing buttons/business interactions.

Each directive update replaces the complete configuration; omitted options and boolean `true` use defaults. Changing `fullscreen` while loading moves the overlay between the host and its owner document body. Host children stay in place. Multiple `fullscreen` instances share a counted scroll lock: closing a local instance does not unlock `fullscreen` instances, and the final `fullscreen` instance preserves an existing external lock class.

### Custom icon sizing and status semantics

A numeric `size` sets the custom indicator container's font `size` in pixels. Named sizes control built-in animations. Custom icons inherit the `--mp-loading-indicator-size` font `size` (20px by default): `1em` children scale with it, while SVGs with fixed pixel dimensions keep their own `size`. Use the `icon` slot for graphics and `tip` or its slot for status text.

Standalone Loading has `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. Without a tip it includes localized visually hidden status text, even when the icon is hidden. Wrapper mode retains `aria-busy`. The directive sets `aria-busy="true"` on the original host and restores its previous value on cleanup, preserving a later external change.

Assistive technology may defer announcements within a busy region. For business start, completion or failure messages, maintain a persistent status region outside the busy region and update its text. The overlay does not disable keyboard interaction. See [WAI-ARIA `aria-busy`](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#`aria-busy`) and [ARIA22 status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22).

# LoadingBar

CSS motion variables control progress-bar and fade transitions. Completion and cleanup wait for the visual transition; CSS styling does not control progress-update timing.

The service uses --mp-loading-bar-transition-duration (250ms) and --mp-loading-bar-transition-timing-function (ease) for width/opacity/background-color. Apply tokens to its real html/body ancestor, not a business card. Reduce disables transitions, not progress/cleanup. After DOM flush, hiding waits max(300ms, resolved width duration+delay); unmounting waits max(250ms, resolved opacity duration+delay). The 200ms show/tick and cleanup floors are scheduling policies, not CSS tokens; later arbitrary CSS changes/custom animation are not promised.

Repeated finish is deduplicated; start/error cancel obsolete tasks. Completion unmounts the service and the next load remounts. setDefaultOptions replaces the full configuration and resetDefaultOptions clears owned settings. SSR calls create no DOM/timers.

# Locale

### Intro

Component library uses Chinese as the default language, support multi-language switch.

### Multi-language Switch (Functional)

`Locale.add` is used for language mounted.

```js
// playground-ignore
import { Locale } from '@maple-design/ui'

Locale.add('en-US', Locale.enUS)
```

Use `Locale.merge` to override languages.

```js
// playground-ignore
Locale.merge('en-US', {
  dialogTitle: 'Hello'
})
```

Use `Locale.use` to switch language.

```js
// playground-ignore
Locale.use('en-US')
```

### Multi-language Switch (Component declarative)

```html
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Locale } from '@maple-design/ui'

const date = ref('2021-04-08')
const locale = ref('zh-CN')
const messages = {
  'zh-CN': Locale.zhCN,
  'en-US': Locale.enUS
}

function switchLocale() {
  locale.value = locale.value === 'zh-CN' ? 'en-US' : 'zh-CN'
}
</script>

<template>
  <mp-locale-provider :locale="locale" :messages="messages">
    <mp-date-picker v-model="date" />
    <mp-button status="primary" @click="switchLocale">Switch</mp-button>
  </mp-locale-provider>
</template>
```

### Notes

- `Locale.use` operates on a singleton language instance context. Do not call it on the server. It is recommended for client-side rendering scenarios.
- `LocaleProvider` is only valid for the sub-components it wraps, and is invalid for functional calls to components. It is recommended for server-side rendering scenarios.

### Global and independent instances

The root `Locale` is a global singleton with only `zh-CN` registered and active by default. Add another built-in language with `Locale.add` before selecting it with `Locale.use`. Japanese is available as `Locale.jaJP`; the `locale` entry has no separate named `jaJP` export. `Locale.useLocale()` (or the named `useLocale` export from `@maple-design/ui/locale`) creates an independent instance; it differs from Cedar's global language-switching function of the same name.

`add(lang, message)` writes `lang` to the supplied object. After replacing the current language's data, call `use` again to update the current reference. `merge(lang, partial)` shallow-merges and selects that language. `t` looks up a complete key, returns `undefined` for missing keys, and does not provide generic interpolation or nested-path lookup. Changing language does not automatically change reading direction.

根入口的 `Locale` 是全局单例；默认只注册并启用 `zh-CN`。使用其他内置语言前先调用 `Locale.add`，再调用 `Locale.use`。日语通过 `Locale.jaJP` 取得；`locale` 子入口没有单独的 `jaJP` 命名导出。`Locale.useLocale()`（或从 `@maple-design/ui/locale` 命名导入 `useLocale`）创建独立实例，它与 Cedar 的同名全局切换函数含义不同。

`add(lang, message)` 会把 `lang` 写入传入对象；替换当前语言的数据后需再次 `use` 才会更新当前引用。`merge(lang, partial)` 浅合并并切换到该语言。`t` 以完整键查找，缺失返回 `undefined`，不负责通用插值或嵌套路径解析。语言切换不会自动改变阅读方向。

# Menu Collects transient commands for the current object, such as overflow actions, context menus and the extra actions of a button. Use [Select](#/en-US/select) to pick form data and [Cascader](#/en-US/cascader) to pick hierarchical data. The popup is built on the unstyled [Trigger](#/en-US/trigger). It uses the shared twelve placements and the separate `cover` mode, defaulting to `bottom`. Use `auto-fit-popup-width` and `popup-max-height` for width matching and height limits. ## Basic examples ### Overflow Actions Pass the trigger element through the default slot and describe commands with `options`. `type: 'divider'` renders a separator. ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## Appearance and states ### Disabled State `disabled` on the menu disables the whole popup; on an option it disables that option and its descendants. ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## Options and hierarchy ### Groups, submenus and option content #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | Command tree | Groups, submenus and option content, Selection and visual emphasis | | `hide-on-select` | Close the popup after activating a command | Selection and visual emphasis | | `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Selection and visual emphasis | Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.
Configuration details and limits #### Option Group Group commands with `{ type: 'group', children }` inside `options`; no extra group component is needed. A group is purely visual and does not add a level. #### Submenu A plain option with `children` becomes a submenu. Every level shares `submenu-trigger`, which expands on tap by default; switching it to `'hover'` applies to all levels too. It cannot be set per option, so a single tree never mixes two expansion styles. #### Custom Option Content Prefer passing `icon`, `extra` or a VNode directly on the option; all three also accept a render function receiving `{ option, active, level }`. To render a whole data set uniformly, use the `option-label`, `option-icon` and `option-extra` scoped slots. `active` means this exact option matches the active value. A active descendant does not select its parent. Descendant selection and submenu opening remain private styling state. MenuOption uses `highlight` for visual emphasis without changing selection.
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### Selection and visual emphasis `active` is false on a parent whose child is active. The three examples compare render functions, scoped slots and manual MenuOption content; `highlight` only emphasizes a row. ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ## Triggers and positioning ### Context Menu #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | Root menu trigger | Context Menu, Trigger | | `options` | Command tree | Context Menu, Positioning strategy | | `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | Context Menu | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. Set both `trigger="contextMenu"` and `align-point`. The menu stays at the activation point as the pointer moves; another right click updates its position. ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### With SplitButton [SplitButton](#/en-US/split-button) already wraps a button together with a dropdown command menu and describes extra actions through `MenuOption`. ### Trigger ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### Placement ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### Positioning strategy Both root and nested menus use the same reactive `strategy` (`absolute` by default or `fixed`). Changing it does not change selection or close the menu. `popup-container` independently controls mounting; `fixed` does not automatically escape transformed ancestors. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/positioning.vue ``` ### Popup Max Height ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ## State and content customization ### Selected Value and Select Event Use `v-model` to keep the active value. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Adjacent groups add 8px; the first does not. Titles grow with content without line-height/padding overlap. ### State and duration Disabled overrides selection, pointer hover and keyboard focus. Selected hover has a separate role inheriting selection background by default and may be overridden. Selected backgrounds paint directly on options, matching Cedar. ### Data identity and trigger switching Reorderable items should provide stable unique values; internal Vue keys derive from business values. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` remain distinct. Groups, separators and display items without values retain identity through their original option objects; no public key alias is added.
