# Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 [Select](#/zh-CN/select)；选择层级数据请使用 [Cascader](#/zh-CN/cascader)。 弹出层基于无视觉样式的 [Trigger](#/zh-CN/trigger) 实现，使用统一十二方位和 `cover` 覆盖模式，默认 `bottom`。同宽、高度限制分别使用 `auto-fit-popup-width`、`popup-max-height`。 ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。`type: 'divider'` 渲染分隔线。 ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 `disabled` 加在菜单上禁用整个浮层，加在选项上只禁用该项及其后代。 ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。分组只负责视觉分隔，不增加子项层级。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，移动端默认点击展开；改成 `'hover'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### 与 SplitButton 组合 [SplitButton](#/zh-CN/split-button) 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作。 ### 触发方式 ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### 弹出方向 ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ```demo ../example/demos/positioning.vue ``` ### 高度限制 ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ## ## Behavior

- `duration` is milliseconds; `0` stays open. `Message.loading(...)` stays open by default.
- Within one mount container/position, the same `id` updates the instance without duplicate DOM.
- Only `resetOnUpdate`=`true` restarts the full duration on same-id updates.
- `pauseOnHover` saves remaining time and resumes it on pointer leave.
- Display deadlines are independent of CSS motion. Restarting, hover pause, cleanup/unmount invalidate old timer callbacks, which recheck open before running.
- KeepAlive deactivation cancels timers; reactivation restarts the current full duration. Updates while deactivated/retained restart after unmount do not schedule work.
- Resuming exhausted positive hover timing requests closing; resetting duration to 0 keeps it open. Only finite positive durations auto-close; negative/nonfinite values do not schedule.
- Services await actual leave completion rather than forcing 150ms/200ms exits. Closing/clearing before mount cleans up directly and reports service onClosed without inventing component open/opened/close animation events. Business duration stays independent of CSS transitions.
- Local reduced motion cancels transitions/displacement while retaining independent-message static horizontal/center positioning, colors and display deadlines. No global tiny-duration fallback is required.
- Queues isolate by `popupContainer + position`; `Message.clear(position?)` clears per position.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, icons and close-button spacing follow reading order. Direction changes do not alter message type, timers or closing. Programmatic calls use explicit configuration or document direction.

### Message Methods

| Method | Description |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `Message(options \| string)` | Open a default message |
| `Message.info/success/warning/error/loading(...)` | Open a message with the corresponding status |
| `Message.clear(position?)` | Clear all messages or a specified position |
| `Message.setDefaultOptions(options)` | Set defaults for subsequent calls |
| `Message.resetDefaultOptions()` | Restore defaults |

Returns `{ close() }`; repeated calls do not repeat closing. A handle owns a specific message item: it remains valid for same-id updates of that item, but cannot close a new item after the old item completed leaving and its id was reused.

The optional second appContext argument applies to each message: injections, registered components, global properties and error handling use that application context. It does not capture a local Provider at the call site. Applications still share one queue and chronological stack per target/position; Message.clear continues clearing across applications. Each call uses its explicit context, then the current install default. An update with no available context retains the existing item scope. Switching a same-id item to another available context remounts its presentation and restarts its duration while keeping its business handle valid; other items keep their presentation and timers.

`Message.Component` retains its real Props and instance types. Its `restartTimer()` instance method resets only while active, open and resetOnUpdate=true. It is not a service-handle method; while hover-paused, it resets only the saved remaining duration.

| Component instance method | Description |
| ---- | ---- |
| restartTimer() | Reset the current duration, subject to active, open, resetOnUpdate and hover-pause state |

`MessageContent` is `VNodeChild | (() => VNodeChild)`: text, numbers, empty boolean children, VNodes, nested child arrays and synchronous render functions. Arbitrary plain objects and asynchronous tasks are not renderable content. content, icon and action share this protocol; local slots take precedence.

duration must be finite and nonnegative. Negative values, NaN and Infinity do not schedule automatic closure and trigger development prop validation. Zero stays open; restartTimer follows the same rules.

## CSS Variables

Visual variant is independent of status. neutral uses a neutral popup and status icon; tonal uses a low-emphasis status background with dark content; solid uses a high-emphasis fill and matching foreground. Cedar/Maple both default to neutral; explicit solid/tonal have matching visual semantics. default/loading solid retains a dark background, with the loading icon indicating progress. Both export MessageVariant; function calls, setDefaultOptions and same-id updates support variant.

Colors use `--mp-message-{variant}-{status}-{bg|content-color|icon-color|border-color|close-color}`. bg sets the panel; content-color sets body/actions without separate styling; icon-color sets status icons; border-color sets borders; close-color sets close buttons. Custom backgrounds require checking all three foregrounds. Geometry retains platform density. Variables must affect actual Teleport-container ancestors.


Exceptions from close/closed notification callbacks do not retain closed entries or empty manager hosts. Resource cleanup is independent of callback execution.

### Component attribute forwarding

`Message.Component` forwards `id`, `class`, `style`, `aria-*` and native event listeners to its actual `role="alert"` region: the Cedar message root or the Maple inner visible panel. Each attribute is applied once. Required internal roles and classes remain; component lifecycle listeners such as `open` are not bound as DOM listeners. Native attributes update with the parent in both inline and Teleport modes. `dir` continues to determine reading direction. ## 行为说明

- `duration` 单位为毫秒，`0` 表示常驻；`Message.loading(...)` 默认常驻。
- 同一挂载容器和位置内，相同 `id` 更新原实例，不创建重复 DOM。
- 仅当 `resetOnUpdate` 为 `true` 时，相同 id 更新会重新计算完整显示时长。
- `pauseOnHover` 保存剩余时间，鼠标离开后从剩余时间继续。
- 展示期限独立于 CSS 动效；重启、hover 暂停、清理或卸载使旧计时回调失效，执行时再次检查 open。
- KeepAlive 停用取消计时，激活从当前配置完整 duration 重启；停用更新和卸载后保留的 restart 不调度。
- hover 正时长已耗尽时恢复会请求关闭；显式重置为0仍常驻。仅有限正 duration 自动关闭，负数和非有限值不调度。
- 服务等待真实离场完成，不再强制150ms或200ms退出。未挂载就 close/clear 直接清理并报告服务 onClosed，不伪造组件 open/opened/close 动画事件；业务 duration 独立于 CSS 过渡。
- 局部减少动效取消进出过渡和动画位移，保留独立提示的水平/居中静态定位、颜色及业务展示期限；不依赖全局极短时长。
- 队列按 `popupContainer + position` 隔离；`Message.clear(position?)` 可按位置清理。

### Cross-platform contract

When using the content slot, the custom panel takes its accessible name from the entry. Set aria-label or aria-labelledby on the entry when needed. Ensure custom entries have a meaningful name.

Both libraries create panel content on first open and retain it when closed or switched, including local drafts and expanded branches. With `unmount-on-close`, content is destroyed after the closing transition and recreated on the next open; the Item's own selected value remains intact. Applications own draft submission, resets and filter application.

Root `close()` requests closing Item panels and restores entry focus without changing selected values, active-item or desktop tree expanded-keys. Controlled open values remain authoritative when closure is rejected. Entries with neither options nor a content slot never open; asynchronous options follow the current open state when they arrive. KeepAlive suspension hides panels and requests closure; controlled state remains authoritative on activation.

Item values, open state, events, slot contexts and `select/close/setOpen` methods share the same contract. Both roots expose `close/resize/setActiveItem`. Names must be unique within the menu; changing a name releases the previous one. Batched swaps and insertions validate the final rendered names. Vertical options expand enabled ancestors of the selected value on initialization and value/options updates. Users can still collapse branches manually.

| Capability | Cedar | Maple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Root menu | options tree or Item entries; vertical by default | Item filter bar only; horizontal by default |
| popup-layout | dropdown (default) / full-width / full-height / full | full-width (default) / full |
| Panel origin | Individual entry bottom | Entire filter bar bottom; standalone Item uses its own bottom |
| Trigger and placement | trigger / placement | Click to open downward |
| Backdrop and scrolling | Non-modal; background scroll remains available | Root overlay / overlay-closable / lock-scroll / esc-to-close / z-index |
| Theme | theme override | Global theme; no theme prop |
| Tree-only methods | showOption / scrollTo / setCollapsed | — |

Each library exports `NavMenuPopupLayout` with its supported values. Maple's `NavMenuMode` is horizontal only; `options-mode` supports both orientations. The default entry slot replaces the entry's inner content. Maple renders it inside a native button: use non-interactive text/icons and place forms and action buttons in the content slot.

### NavMenuItem Props

| Prop | Description | Default |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| name | Unique root-level business activation key; omitted entries highlight their selections independently | — |
| label | Entry title when no option matches | — |
| options / field-names | Cedar-compatible options and field mapping | [] / — |
| model-value / default-value | Controlled / initial selected key; supports strings, numbers and null | undefined / null |
| open / default-open | Controlled / initial open state | undefined / false |

A standalone NavMenuItem uses its own bottom edge as the panel origin. Triggering is fixed to click; overflowing entries scroll horizontally. Mobile does not expose placement/trigger, dropdown, or side full-height layouts.

Events: update:model-value, update:open, select(key, option, event), click(event). Methods: select(key, event?), close(), setOpen(open).

Slots: default (entry contents), label, icon, content (replaces the default options panel), option-label, option-icon and option-extra. Entry/content slots receive `{ modelValue, selectedOption, active, open, select, close }`; option slots receive `{ option, active, expanded, level }`.

## Types

NavMenuKey is string | number. NavMenuOption uses key, label, icon, extra, children, disabled, show and props, with type item/group/divider. label/icon/extra accept VNodes or context render functions. Numeric 0 and empty strings are valid keys; missing or duplicate item keys throw. Disabled state is inherited by descendants; hidden items and their subtrees are omitted. All types are exported from @maple-design/ui.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

NavMenu inherits the nearest native `dir`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Left/Right moves navigation focus in reading direction; Home/End focuses available boundary entries. Down opens the option panel; Escape closes and returns trigger focus. Horizontal panel keys follow direction while Up/Down keeps existing order. Teleported panels inherit trigger direction. Direction changes do not clear filters or selections.

### 两端对应关系

两端面板均在首次展开时创建，关闭或切换入口后默认保留挂载，内部草稿和分支展开状态继续保留。设置 `unmount-on-close` 后，在关闭过渡结束时卸载面板；再次展开会重新创建内部组件，但不会清空 Item 自身的选中值。草稿提交、重置和筛选生效时机由业务决定。

根 `close()` 只请求关闭 Item 面板并恢复入口焦点，不改变选中值、active-item 或桌面导航树的 expanded-keys。受控 open 拒绝更新时仍保持展开。没有 options 且没有 content 插槽的入口不展开；异步 options 到达后按当前 open 状态展示。KeepAlive 停用期间隐藏面板并请求关闭，重新激活时仍以受控值为准。

Item 的选中值、展开状态、事件、插槽上下文及 `select/close/setOpen` 方法保持一致。两端根菜单都提供 `close/resize/setActiveItem`。`name` 必须在当前菜单内唯一，动态修改后会释放旧名称；同一次更新允许交换名称或在重排时复用旧名称，以更新完成后的名称检查重复。纵向选项会在初始值、受控值或 options 更新时展开当前值的可用祖先路径；用户仍可手动收起分支。

| 能力 | Cedar | Maple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 根菜单 | options 导航树或 Item 入口；默认 vertical | 仅 Item 筛选栏；默认 horizontal |
| popup-layout | dropdown（默认）/ full-width / full-height / full | full-width（默认）/ full |
| 面板起点 | 当前入口底边 | 整个筛选栏底边；独立 Item 使用自身底边 |
| 触发与定位 | trigger / placement | 固定点击向下展开 |
| 遮罩与滚动 | 非模态，不锁背景滚动 | 根级 overlay / overlay-closable / lock-scroll / esc-to-close / z-index |
| 主题 | theme 可覆盖 | 跟随全局主题，无 theme 属性 |
| 导航树专用方法 | showOption / scrollTo / setCollapsed | — |

两端 `NavMenuPopupLayout` 分别导出本端支持的值域；Maple 的 `NavMenuMode` 仅为 horizontal，`options-mode` 仍支持两个方向。入口 default 插槽替换入口内部内容，移动端位于原生按钮中，请使用文本、图标等非交互内容；表单和操作按钮放在 content 插槽。

NavMenu 继承最近的原生 `dir`，支持动态切换和局部覆盖。导航栏左右键按阅读方向移动焦点，Home/End 聚焦首尾可用项；下键打开选项面板，Escape 关闭并返回触发项。选项面板的水平按键随方向调整，上下键保持原有顺序。Teleport 面板继承触发项的方向，切换方向不会清空筛选值或选中项。

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Page numbers and previous/next meanings remain unchanged; default navigation icons follow reading direction. Page entry, disabled boundaries and selection do not change. Business code controls direction for custom icon slots.

## API

Use ordinary `v-model`: `modelValue` is the current page, starting at 1; pageSize independently controls items per page. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets or initialization `update:modelValue`. When `modelValue` is supplied, the parent value controls the display.

Totals, page numbers and page sizes use JavaScript safe integers. Finite positive values above the safe range are capped at the maximum safe integer and produce a development warning. To bound rendered page controls, base-size is capped at 201 and buffer-size at 100; out-of-range values produce a development warning.

Responsive switches between full and simple layouts preserve the page-jump draft without submitting it. Focus is preserved when both layouts display a jump input. Press Enter or leave the input to submit.

After a keyboard quick jump, if the ellipsis button disappears and the target page is accepted, focus moves to the current page button. Rejected controlled updates or focus moved elsewhere do not steal focus.

auto-adjust requests an adjustment only when total or page-size changes after creation; it does not clamp the initial default-value or controlled model-value to the page count. A controlled parent may reject the request.

## Behavior

Containers at or below `compact-breakpoint` automatically use compact mode, consistently in desktop sidebars and mobile. Totals/page-size selectors remain; auxiliary controls wrap. Previous/next sizes follow size without forced narrow-screen enlargement (formerly 36px). `responsive=false` retains full page numbers; extremely narrow page lists scroll internally without widening the page.

The compact current-page input also serves as the jumper, so no duplicate jumper appears. `page-item`, `page-item-ellipsis`, `jumper-prepend` and `jumper-append` render only in their full-mode controls.

Page buttons support Tab/Enter/Space, with `aria-current=page` on the current page. The jumper requests a numeric keyboard and submits on Enter/blur. Empty, nonnumeric or fractional values do not navigate; out-of-range integers clamp to valid pages. Disabled blocks all commits.

`auto-adjust` tries to preserve the previous page's first item when page size changes, clamps to the last page after total reductions and returns to page 1 for zero items. Controlled mode proposes updates only; the parent decides the display. An explicit parent modelValue in the same update batch takes precedence.

Both full and compact jumper inputs show the current page. Navigation, external modelValue changes and page-size adjustments update them together. Invalid input restores the current page number.

### PaginationPageSizeProps

Page-size selectors fit selected text/arrow with only item spacing, updating on option/locale changes. `--mp-pagination-select-width` overrides width. Popup menus size independently from option contents.

Both platforms support `disabled?: boolean`, `placement?: 'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end'`, `popupContainer?: string | HTMLElement | false`, `class?: string` and `style?: CSSProperties`. Outer disabled takes precedence. Default placement is bottom-start.

This configuration no longer forwards arbitrary SelectProps/MenuProps. page-size, page-size-options and size control the pagination value, options and dimensions.

### Placement semantics and configuration

No placement configuration is required for normal use: bottom-start is preferred and the underlying Trigger automatically flips/constrains the popup. pageSizeProps.placement is only a restricted override for the page-size Select: Pagination → Select.triggerProps.placement → Trigger. It does not position the pagination itself.

## 行为说明

容器宽度不超过 `compact-breakpoint` 时自动使用简洁模式；桌面侧栏与移动端规则相同。保留总数和条数选择器，辅助控件换行，上一页、下一页按钮跟随 size，不再在窄屏强制放大（默认 36px）。设置 `responsive=false` 保留完整页码，极窄时仅页码列表横向滚动，不撑宽页面。

简洁模式的当前页输入框承担跳转功能，不重复展示独立 jumper。`page-item`、`page-item-ellipsis`、`jumper-prepend`、`jumper-append` 仅在完整模式的对应控件中渲染。

页码按钮支持 Tab、Enter、Space，当前页使用 `aria-current=page`。跳转框使用数字键盘提示，Enter 或失焦提交；空值、非数字、小数不跳转，整数越界限制到有效页码。禁用状态阻止所有提交。

`auto-adjust` 在条数改变时尽量保留原页面首条数据的位置，总数减少时限制到最后一页，零条数据时页码回到 1。受控模式只发出更新请求，显示由父组件决定；父组件同一批更新明确设置 modelValue 时优先遵循该值。

完整模式和简洁模式的“前往”输入框均显示当前页码。点击翻页、外部更新 modelValue 或切换每页条数触发页码调整时同步回显；非法输入恢复为当前页码。

### PaginationPageSizeProps

每页条数选择器按已选文字与下拉箭头自适应宽度，两者之间仅保留条目间距，切换选项或语言时自动更新。可通过 `--mp-pagination-select-width` 自定义宽度。弹出菜单仍按选项内容独立计算宽度。

两端支持相同配置：`disabled?: boolean`、`placement?: 'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end'`、`popupContainer?: string | HTMLElement | false`、`class?: string`、`style?: CSSProperties`。外层 disabled 优先。默认 placement 为 bottom-start。

此配置不再透传任意 SelectProps/MenuProps。分页值、选项和尺寸分别使用 page-size、page-size-options、size。

### Paper Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bordered | Show a border independently of elevation | boolean | false |
| elevation | false disables; true uses level 2; numeric levels 0–24 | boolean / number | false |
| ripple | Opt-in ripple; does not add button semantics | boolean | false |
| radius | Explicit radius, taking priority over round | number / string | — |
| width | Width | number / string | — |
| height | Surface height | number / string | — |
| round | 50% radius; a circle only with equal width and height | boolean | false |
| inline | Use inline-flex | boolean | false |

Numbers and numeric strings for radius/width/height use px. Other strings pass through as CSS lengths, such as 1rem, 50% and calc(100% - 8px). Classes, native attributes and styles fall through to the root.

elevation=false adds no elevation class, true uses level 2, and numeric values are rounded to the nearest integer then clamped to 0–24. NaN/Infinity produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and fall back to 2 at runtime. Numeric radius/width/height values must be finite and nonnegative; invalid numbers remove that inline dimension instead of retaining its previous value, while zero remains valid. Decimal and scientific-notation numeric strings use px. Other CSS strings are parsed by the browser; expressions unsupported by the browser are not promised.

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| click | Triggered when the paper is clicked | MouseEvent |

click only notifies with the original MouseEvent, including bubbling clicks from children. @click.once follows standard Vue event semantics without awaiting listener Promises. PaperProps includes this listener and is consistent between root and subentry. PaperInstance has no additional business execution methods.

Unaccepted updates do not immediately roll back. Later external value changes synchronize again. Both confirm and cancel carry current candidates; cancel does not restore initial values. The component only notifies, while its owner controls closing. Changing optionHeight or optionCount recenters candidates and stops old scrolling transitions. columnsCount immediately updates visible columns, preserving retained nodes, focus and candidates. Layout changes send no additional model/change notifications and do not roll unaccepted candidates back to old external values. Removed column nodes are outside the focus-retention guarantee. Picker(options) is an explicit asynchronous selection service. It copies configuration and owns mutable open/dynamic state and singleton lifecycle without writing to caller options, including frozen objects. Explicit popupContainer values are respected; the default is body. open, defaultOpen and dynamic are not service Options; component Props still support embedded and popup modes. The service returns PickerResolvedData with state confirm, cancel or close. confirm/cancel include values, indexes and options; close contains only state. Notification callbacks are not awaited. confirm/cancel settle and request closing before notification; a throwing closed callback cannot skip host cleanup. Picker.close() closes only the current service singleton. The title, cancel and confirm toolbar slots have no scoped arguments. Custom buttons may call instance confirm()/cancel(). Only these two methods form the public instance contract; other setup render bindings are not business extension points. Picker.Component and _PickerComponent are actual SFCs; default Picker is the callable service and installation entry point. ```ts import { Picker, type PickerOptions, type PickerColumnOption, type PickerResolvedState, type PickerResolvedData, type PickerProps, type PickerInstance, type PickerEmits, type PickerSlots, type PickerSelection } from '@maple-design/ui' ``` ## Types ### PickerColumnOption | Prop | Description | Type | Default | | --------------- | -------------- | ---------------------- | ------- | | `text` | Text | _string \| number_ | `-` | | `value` | Value | _string \| number_ | `-` | | `disabled` | Whether disabled | _boolean_ | `false` | | `children` | Children list | _PickerColumnOption[]_ | `-` | | `className` | Class name | _string_ | `-` | | `textClassName` | Text Class Name | _string_ | `-` | ## CSS Variables The following CSS variables support customization with [StyleProvider](#/en-US/style-provider). ### Keyboard and reduced motion Each interactive column is a Tab-focusable listbox. Arrows move, Home/End reach first/last enabled items, skipping disabled options. aria-selected indicates the current wheel item; selected-values indicates separate checkmarks. Empty/all-disabled columns leave the Tab sequence. Reduced motion commits selection immediately without waiting for transitionend. Preference changes settle pending scrolling; unmount removes listeners. ### Brand appearance Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.

CSS Variables 以下为组件使用的 css 变量，可以使用 [StyleProvider 组件](#/zh-CN/style-provider) 进行样式定制。 ### 键盘与减少动效 每个可操作列为一个 listbox，可用 Tab 聚焦；方向键上下移动，Home/End 到首尾可用项，跳过禁用项。aria-selected 表达当前滚轮项；selected-values 只表达额外勾选标记，两者职责不同。空列和全禁用列不进入 Tab 顺序。 减少动效偏好下，选择立即提交且不等待 transitionend；偏好动态切换时收束待提交滚动，卸载时移除监听。 ### Brand appearance 函数调用的通知回调不控制任务完成。服务的选择或关闭结果独立于回调异常结算，关闭完成时仍会清理所属宿主。异常继续通过调用方或 Vue 错误通道传递；回调返回 Promise 不控制 loading 或关闭。

Use Tooltip for a short, non-interactive description. ## Basic examples ### Basic usage ```demo ../example/demos/basic-usage.vue ``` ## Content and presentation ### Placement, offset and width #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement, offset and width | | `popup-translate` | Additional screen-axis translation | Placement, offset and width | | `trigger` | Interaction | Trigger and controlled state | | `disabled` | Prevent opening | Trigger and controlled state | Open popovers one at a time to compare placement, offsets and trigger-width fitting. ```demo ../example/demos/positioning-comparison.vue ``` ### Trigger and controlled state ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ```demo ../example/demos/two-way-binding.vue ``` ```demo ../example/demos/events.vue ``` ```demo ../example/demos/disabled.vue ``` ## Interaction and control ### Interactive content and retained state ```demo ../example/demos/interactive.vue ``` ## Empty content With `hide-empty`, the panel is hidden when the title is empty and the body contains only comments or whitespace. The open state is unchanged and the panel appears when content becomes available. Component nodes count as content. ## Reading direction Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content defaults to inline-start alignment and popovers inherit source direction. Logical start/end follow reading direction; explicit left/right placements remain physical. ## API Popover inherits Trigger positioning, container, controlled state and `close` policies. `auto-fit-transform-origin` defaults to true; an omitted `animation-name` uses the Popover animation. `content-class` and `content-style` apply to the content panel; `popup-class` and `popup-style` apply to the outer positioning node. The instance exposes seven methods: `open`, `close`, `resize`, `allowClose`, `getReference`, `focusReference`, and `setReference`. Focus remains on the trigger when opening. The panel is non-modal and Tab order depends on its actual DOM mount location; provide an accessible keyboard path for interactive content. ### Popover Props | Prop | Description | Type | Default | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | v-model:open | Controlled open state | `boolean` | — | | default-open | Initial uncontrolled state | `boolean` | `false` | | title | Title | `string` | — | | content | Body | `string` | — | | trigger | Interaction | `TriggerEvent \| TriggerEvent[]`
`TriggerEvent: 'manual' \| 'focus' \| 'hover' \| 'click' \| 'contextMenu'` | `click` | | placement | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | `TriggerPlacement`
`'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top' \| 'top-start' \| 'top-end' \| 'bottom-start' \| 'bottom-end' \| 'left-start' \| 'left-end' \| 'right-start' \| 'right-end'` | `bottom` | | show-arrow | Show the arrow | `boolean` | `true` | | popup-offset | Main-axis distance | `number` | `10` | | popup-translate | Additional screen-axis translation | `[number, number] \| Record` | — | | popup-container | Render target; false renders locally | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` | | reference | External trigger element | `string \| HTMLElement \| SVGElement` | — | | disabled | Prevent opening | `boolean` | `false` | | unmount-on-close | Unmount after close; false retains draft state | `boolean` | `false` | | close-on-click-reference | Close when the trigger is clicked again | `boolean` | `true` | ### Popover Events | Event | Description | | --- | --- | | update:open | Requests a controlled open-state change | | open-change | Requests any open-state change | | open | Opening starts | | opened | Enter transition completes | | close | Closing starts | | closed | Leave transition completes | | click-outside | Clicked outside the popup | ### Popover Slots | Slot | Description | | --- | --- | | default | Trigger element | | title | Title; falls back to the `title` prop | | content | Body; falls back to the `content` prop | ### Popover Methods `open()`、`close()`、`resize()`、`allowClose()`、`getReference()`、`setReference()`、`focusReference()`。 The reference is connected to the panel with `aria-controls` and `aria-expanded`. The panel is a group and does not declare aria-haspopup by default. When setting an explicit popup type through reference-attrs, ensure it matches the actual content semantics. Use Trigger for unstyled positioning. Popover has no `defaultStyle`, `popoverClass`, or `elevation`; customize with tokens, `content-class`, or `content-style`. ## CSS Variables These are actual :root defaults. Prefer component variables for business customization; internal positioning variables are not public API. Maple dark mode retains a 2px radius and platform-specific shadows. Content and arrows share background/border variables, independent of Trigger style-loading order. With Teleport, variables must be in the actual popup scope, for example through `popup-style`. Trigger-button variables do not automatically inherit into popups.

Scrim variables dim only the background. Content background/text form a raised-surface color pair, with dark themes inheriting the same semantics. `unstyled` disables default background/text colors together. style sets content variables, overlay-style scrim variables, or place system variables on an actual common ancestor. ### Focus management

Built-in fade, center scaling, four-direction pop and base content/scrim transitions consume duration/timing-function tokens, retaining 250ms/ease defaults. Whole-layer overrides belong on the actual post-Teleport common ancestor or popup-container host. style affects content only; overlay-style affects scrim only. Use valid nonnegative CSS times. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce overrides built-in transitions/initial displacement/scaling. Business code adapts custom animations.

With unmount-on-close=true, content remains during closing and unmounts after completion; close locks are not released early. Rapid reopening cancels closing and retains slot state. opened/closed fire once per valid phase, never after destruction. No fixed 250ms JS timer is used. Initial opening retains mounted notification without promising complete appear timing. Business code must coordinate custom transitions or differing inner/outer durations.

Opening focuses the actual dialog panel. Tab/Shift+Tab cycle through available controls, skipping hidden/disabled elements. The topmost nested popup owns focus handling; closing restores its opener. Applications must retain trigger nodes and must not override internal focus-root markers.

### Landscape safe areas

`safe-area-inset-left` / `safe-area-inset-right` (boolean, default false) complement the existing top/bottom flags. Native overrides and nested consumption follow [SafeArea](#/en-US/safe-area).

### Closing by pulling the header

Enable `swipe-to-close` for bottom popups and mark draggable header areas with `data-popup-swipe-handle`. It is off by default and inactive at other placements. `swipe-threshold` defaults to 40 layout CSS px, including under parent scaling. Closing requests `update:open(false)` and emits `swipe-close(PointerEvent)` only if final movement is downward and reaches the threshold. Small/horizontal/canceled gestures, buttons/inputs and body scrolling do not close. Rejected controlled requests retain the popup and restore its position. Existing Esc/scrim/close controls remain.

The vertical threshold accounts for vertical scaling independently of horizontal scaling; gesture conversion under rotation or skew is not specified.

```html
<mp-popup v-model:open="open" placement="bottom" swipe-to-close>
  <header data-popup-swipe-handle>Edit information</header>
  <main>Popup content</main>
</mp-popup>
```

Maple field editors allow dragging blank header areas to cancel drafts by default; pending asynchronous confirmation disables gestures. ActionSheet can explicitly set swipe-to-close/swipe-threshold; default titles are marked, while custom title slots must mark their own drag area.
# Asynchronous close interception


Reasons: `overlay`, `escape`, `route`, `swipe`, `close`, `api`, `model`. The default slot provides `{ close, pending }`; `close` buttons should call `close('close', event)`. Instance `close()` uses `api`; `requestClose(reason, event)` specifies a reason and returns `Promise<boolean>`. External `open`=`false` uses `model`; rejection emits `update:open(true)`, which controlled parents should accept. Only enabled `close` entries request closing.

Adding, replacing, or removing `before-close` does not change the current `open` state; in controlled mode the parent continues to update `open`.

Direct destruction, removing `v-if` or destroying a route page is not a close request and cannot await internal guards. Await `requestClose()` before those parent actions. Keep business confirmation in `beforeCommit`; a close guard does not replace validation. The theme page's complete form demonstrates delayed allowance/rejection/errors and all close entries.

Popup close()/requestClose() and external open=false are guarded. Dialog on both ends and Cedar Drawer instance/service close() are direct commands with a different responsibility. Await `Promise<boolean>` when Popup confirmation is required; do not infer behavior from matching method names.

## before hooks and done compatibility



Synchronous logging-only hooks must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means awaiting a callback. Earlier `Promise<void>` hooks without done now allow closing when their Promise resolves.

Popup reasons: overlay, escape, route, swipe, close, api, model. Rejecting external open=false requests update:open(true). Direct destruction cannot await hooks; await requestClose() first.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

### Guard waiting feedback

Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

unmount-on-close=true 时关闭途中保留内容，完成回调后卸载；关闭前锁不会提前释放。快速重开取消关闭并保留插槽状态。opened／closed 每个有效阶段只发一次，销毁后不再补发；没有固定 250ms JS 定时器。初始打开仍沿用 mounted 通知，不承诺完整 appear 计时；自定义转场或内容与外层时长不同需要业务自行协调。

### 从头部下拉关闭

底部弹层设置 `swipe-to-close`，在可拖动标题区域添加 `data-popup-swipe-handle`。默认关闭；其他 placement 不触发。`swipe-threshold` 默认 40，单位为布局 CSS px（父级缩放时也保持一致）。手势结束前最后的移动方向为向下，且位移达到阈值才请求 `update:open(false)` 并发出 `swipe-close(PointerEvent)`。位移不足、横向手势、pointercancel、按钮/输入框和正文滚动不会关闭；受控父级拒绝时弹层保留并回到原位。已有 Esc、遮罩、关闭按钮继续可用。

阈值按垂直方向的缩放换算，支持水平和垂直比例不同的缩放；不承诺旋转或倾斜变换的手势换算。

```html
<mp-popup v-model:open="open" placement="bottom" swipe-to-close>
  <header data-popup-swipe-handle>编辑信息</header>
  <main>弹层内容</main>
</mp-popup>
```

Maple 字段编辑弹层默认从标题空白处下拉取消草稿；异步确认 pending 时禁用手势。ActionSheet 可以显式设置 swipe-to-close / swipe-threshold，默认标题已标记；自定义 title 插槽需自行标记拖动区域。
# 异步关闭拦截


关闭原因包括 `overlay`、`escape`、`route`、`swipe`、`close`、`api`、`model`。默认插槽提供 `{ close, pending }`，关闭按钮应调用 `close('close', event)`；实例 `close()` 使用 `api`，`requestClose(reason, event)` 可指定原因并返回 `Promise<boolean>`。外部将 `open` 设为 `false` 使用 `model`，拒绝后会发送 `update:open(true)`，受控父组件应正常接收该事件。只有启用对应关闭能力的入口会发起请求。

动态添加、更换或移除 `before-close` 不会改变当前开关状态；受控模式仍由父组件更新 `open`。

直接销毁组件、移除 `v-if` 或销毁路由页面不属于关闭请求，无法等待组件内的异步拦截；在父级执行这些操作前等待 `requestClose()` 的结果。业务表单确认继续使用 `beforeCommit`，不要用关闭 guard 替代数据校验。主题页完整表单提供延迟允许、拒绝、报错与各关闭入口的验证弹层。

Popup 的 close()/requestClose() 和外部 open=false 会经过守卫；两端 Dialog 与 Cedar Drawer 的实例或服务 close() 是直接关闭命令，职责不同。Popup 关闭前需要确认时等待 `Promise<boolean>`，不要依赖同名方法推断行为。

## before 钩子与 done 兼容



只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。

Popup 原因为 overlay、escape、route、swipe、close、api、model。拒绝外部 open=false 时请求 update:open(true)。直接销毁组件不能等待内部钩子，应先 await requestClose()。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

### 守卫等待反馈

before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

| default-value | Initial uncontrolled value; subsequent changes do not reset it | number | 0 |
| count | 0 < count <= 1000; floors to at least one; invalid or oversized counts fall back to five | number \| string | 5 |
| allow-half | Enable half-point steps | boolean | false |

size/gap do not accept xs/sm/md/lg/xl presets. Omitted or invalid values retain style defaults. Size must be positive; gap accepts zero and negative gaps fall back to the style default. CSS var/calc/min/max/clamp lengths are supported. Scores normalize to 0–count in steps of 1 or 0.5. Non-finite scores display zero without changing the external value.

focus() focuses the rating; blur() removes focus. Readonly remains focusable, while disabled leaves the Tab sequence. Arrow keys adjust, Home clears and End selects the maximum. ### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Handled scoring keys clear pointer preview and emit hover-change(0) once if a preview was active. If a controlled parent refuses an update, the display follows the external value. Later pointer motion can preview again; unhandled keys preserve the preview.

character.active means fully selected: at 1.5, the second symbol has active=false and its wrapper carries the half-selection class. read receives { value, text }, retaining null/undefined with shared formatted text. Custom read takes precedence over empty-text without changing an empty model to zero. Neither slot executes business tasks.

before-commit uses ({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal }). Return a boolean or Promise, or call done. A synchronous undefined return waits for done; aborted signals prevent stale results from committing. Ordinary change only notifies and does not await return values.

### Motion

expand-duration controls transform expansion; cubic-bezier controls its easing. fade-duration controls linear opacity appearance/disappearance. Put variables on the actual directive host so generated ripples inherit them. color overrides ripple-color. Both platforms default to 200ms/140ms.

250ms is the minimum display/post-fade cleanup wait, not visual duration or the complete lifecycle. Runtime reads computed ripple duration/delay. Fade starts no earlier than the later of creation+250ms or activation+expansion duration; deletion waits max(250ms, fade duration). 600ms/800ms overrides are not truncated. 0ms/unstyled cases retain cleanup floors. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce hides decorative ripples without changing host events. Expansion is sampled at creation/activation; fade at fade start. Arbitrary midphase CSS changes/custom animations are not guaranteed.

Repeated release does not duplicate work. Disabling/unmounting cleans owned timers/direct child ripples without removing nested instances. Document listeners bind to the mount-time ownerDocument; rebinding after cross-document movement is out of scope. Enter/Space activate on this host and end only on matching keyup/blur. Plain divs must provide their own interactive semantics, keyboard behavior and accessible names; v-ripple supplies none.


The binding type `RippleDirectiveValue` is exported from the package root and Ripple entry, with optional `color` and `disabled` fields. Color changes affect subsequently created waves. `disabled` controls decoration only; it does not disable the host. Global `Context.enableRipple` prevents new waves while existing waves finish normally. During animation the directive temporarily sets clipping and, when needed, positioning and stacking styles. When the final wave ends, or on disable or unmount, it restores styles it still owns and preserves values changed by application code. Coordinates account for axis-aligned scaling; rotation and skew are not guaranteed.

绑定值类型 `RippleDirectiveValue` 可从组件库根入口或 Ripple 入口导入，包含可选 `color` 和 `disabled`。颜色更新作用于之后创建的波纹；`disabled` 只关闭装饰，不禁用宿主交互。全局 `Context.enableRipple` 关闭时不创建新波纹，已有波纹按原生命周期结束。波纹显示期间会临时设置宿主裁切及必要的定位和层叠样式；最后一个波纹结束、禁用或卸载时恢复指令仍持有的样式，业务期间改写的值保留。坐标支持轴向缩放；旋转或倾斜变换不保证精确。

### Clear values and 1.x compatibility

`SelectValue` includes `undefined`. By default, single-select clear emits `''`; if the current options contain a `value: ''` option, it emits `undefined` to distinguish clearing from selecting that option. This published behavior is preserved. Both `change` and `update:modelValue` use `SelectValue`.

`empty-value` defines clear output; omission preserves the existing fallback. Single selection can use `() => undefined` to explicitly return undefined; multiple selection should return an array matching its model shape. Protected disabled selections take priority and prevent the clear override from running. Controlled mode still requires parent acceptance.

Root and component entries export `SelectValue` and `SelectEmptyValue`.

### Thumb drag lifecycle

Each primary-button start owns a session: generation, track/thumb nodes, immutable axis/start and thumb.ownerDocument.defaultView. Register mousemove/mouseup/contextmenu/blur on that original window. Release the full set and dragging/mouseOffset on normal end, context cancellation, blur, effective geometry/direction change, deactivation or disposal. This repairs leaked contextmenu, missing suspension/disposal cleanup and global-window iframe binding. Old move cannot drive a new gesture; old end cannot release one. Activation allows only fresh starts.

Changing direction/max/thumbSize/ratio cancels the gesture; replacing data with equal primitive geometry does not. Parent measurement/setOffset still settles final position. Recheck ownership after geometry/reactive writes to reject reentrant disposal. Inactive/disposed retained start/track/setOffset are inert without preventDefault; nonprimary clicks do not drag/page. Active setOffset clamping, drag-time suppression and one-thumb track paging remain. No Pointer/touch protocol migration or rollback of native scrolling.


### Scrollbar consumer lifecycle

Previously saved scroll commands do not affect deactivated or unmounted instances. Reactivation measures the current content. Changing direction or thumb geometry ends an active drag; use the current instance after remounting.

Zero is a valid coordinate, including scrollTo(0,0); measurement resets thumbs at zero. Horizontal measurement uses horizontal rather than vertical ratio. Zero/invalid viewport yields finite nonnegative metrics and no scrollbar on that zero-sized axis. Existing20px minimum thumb/15px track strategy remains. Hidden/disabled-axis thumb delivery is inert, but disabling the bar does not forbid content/public native scrolling. Options are forwarded without JS animation. Public signatures and CSS variables unchanged.

### Select Events / Methods

- `update:modelValue`, `change(value)`: emitted on commit, not while editing a draft.
- `update:open`, `open-change(open)`: request an expanded-state change.
- `update:inputValue`, `input-value-change(text)`, `search(text)`: search state.
- `focus(event)`, `blur(event)`, `clear(event)`: native field events; only the field owner notifies Form.
- Methods: `focus()`, `blur()`.

Select also emits `remove(value)`, `exceed-limit(value, event)`, `dropdown-scroll(event)`, and `dropdown-reach-bottom(event)`.

### Slots and option data

Use `label({ data })` for custom `selected` labels; `selected` replaces the whole selection area. Also supports `prefix`, `suffix`, `clear-icon({ clear })`, `arrow-icon`, `loading-icon`, `search-icon`, `empty`, and `option({ data })`.

Option `label` is searchable plain text. Use `render` or the `option` slot for custom `option` content, and `format-label` or `label` slot for selected content. Values identify selections; labels never do. `disabled` blocks selection/removal, and `tagProps` customizes selected tags.

Select additionally supports `header`, `footer`, `trigger`, and default `Option / Optgroup` children. Option props: `value`, `label`, `disabled`, `tagProps`, `index`; its default slot receives `selected`. Group data uses `{ isGroup: true, label, options }`. List and Picker also accept slot options; Picker displays their text labels.

Async search should clear old candidates when requests start and accept only the latest current-query response. Combine remote results with `loading`, `:filter-option="false"` and `show-extra-options="false"` to avoid treating ID display fallbacks as search results. Popup arrows/Enter operate current candidates only; bottom confirmation saves. Failed validation preserves drafts. Pending confirmation locks editing/closing; reset closes Popup and aborts submission. Closing/reset invalidates request ownership. See Form's unified field-presentation examples.

## CSS Variables


Single/multiple options both use popup-option-padding-horizontal. There is no implicit search-highlight DOM; custom option slots style their own highlighted fragments. Unused multi-popup-option-padding-horizontal and popup-option-highlight-* variables are removed.

<!-- generated variable reference omitted from archive -->

### Field and mobile-presentation style boundaries
Presentation containers use internal `src/_components/field-presentation/token.less` with system surfaces/spacing/dimensions. Option lists retain existing Select tokens.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Selected checkmark

### Public type exports
Root and component entries export `SelectEmits`、`SelectSlots`、`SelectExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

### Built-in search fields
`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

filterable enables entering a search query. filterOption controls only local matching and never sends requests. With an options loader, remote results are not filtered again by default; with only an array, local matching is enabled by default. Most callers do not need filter-option.

```vue
<mp-select v-model="value" :options="loadOptions" filterable />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

In direct mode, focus() targets the native input. In closed deferred mode it focuses the reference without opening; when open it targets the current editor. blur() blurs the current input or editor without reopening or simulating selection. Cached and remounted editors both resolve the current target.

Public SelectInstance/SelectExpose and PeopleSelectInstance/PeopleSelectExpose reflect the existing methods. PeopleSelectExpose is available from the root and component subentry. refresh() returns `Promise<void>` and reloads function-based options through the existing protocol; it does not represent completion of saving or business actions.

SelectEditMode is exported consistently from root and select subentries, retaining each platform public edit-mode values.

### Selection actions during loading

While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching.

Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing.

Option.extra has been removed; pass business data through object values or the original options data.

Multiple empty-value supports arrays, null/undefined and empty values recognized by empty-values; other scalars are rejected. Factories run only for a real clear with no disabled retained selections; invalid results produce a development diagnostic and fall back to [], without publishing an invalid scalar.

## Usage notes





Built-in motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, keeping content and state feedback while disabling decorative animations. Adapt custom animations to that preference in your application.

Built-in Skeleton placeholders and standalone Line/Shape primitives default to `aria-hidden="true"`. The root exposes waiting through `aria-busy`. Custom `template` content and the loaded default content remain accessible and can supply business status messages.

### Fullscreen coverage

`fullscreen` renders an inline `position: fixed` placeholder without automatically teleporting to body. It covers the viewport when no ancestor establishes a fixed positioning containing block. An ancestor with `transform`, a relevant `will-change`, or `contain` may limit coverage to that ancestor. To cover the viewport, place Skeleton outside those ancestors or arrange its position with Vue Teleport in the application. This loading placeholder does not manage modal focus. See [CSS Positioned Layout fixed containing blocks](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-position-3/#fixed-cb).

Omitted size props use their theme tokens. A `-` in the table means there is no Prop default, rather than no placeholder size. Both Line and the main component normalize non`-`finite and negative row counts to zero and round fractions down.

## 使用说明





内置动效遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`：保留内容与状态反馈，关闭装饰性动画。自定义动画需由调用方适配该偏好。

内置 Skeleton 占位及独立 Line、Shape 为装饰内容，默认 `aria-hidden="true"`；根节点通过 `aria-busy` 表示等待。自定义 `template` 和加载结束后的业务内容保持可访问，可按需提供业务状态文案。

### 全屏覆盖范围

`fullscreen` 使用当前位置的内联 `position: fixed` 占位，不会自动传送到 body。没有建立固定定位包含块的祖先时覆盖视口；祖先的 `transform`、相应 `will-change` 或 `contain` 可让覆盖范围变为该祖先。需要覆盖视口时，将 Skeleton 放在这些祖先之外，或由业务使用 Vue Teleport 安排位置。它是加载占位，不提供模态焦点管理。参见 [CSS Positioned Layout 固定定位包含块](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-position-3/#fixed-cb)。

尺寸属性未传值时使用对应主题 token；表中的 `-` 表示没有 Prop 默认值，并不表示占位没有尺寸。Line 与主体都将非有限行数归零，对负数取零，对小数向下取整。

CSS Variables ### Form 字段展示与确认 本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `direct`，保留直接编辑。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。 Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。 `before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。 `read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。 `empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。 ### 指针交互的取消收尾 每次有效指针 `start` 都有一次 `end`，包括被禁用、只读、边界/步长/方向/范围模式变化、丢失捕获、所属窗口失焦、KeepAlive 停用或卸载所取消的情况。`end` 携带该次手势最后的提案；未提出变更时携带开始值，切换范围模式不转换旧手势的载荷形状。取消只结束交互，不撤销此前的 `change`，不额外制造模型更新；是否接受提案仍由父级控制。迟到的 pointerup/move 不会让同一手势重复结束，普通通知返回的 Promise 不被等待。 公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。 步长按 min 的十进制网格对齐，保留精确端点和范围约束；支持可表示的小数及科学计数法。公开模型仍是 Number，小于当前数值可分辨间隔的增量无法表达；format-tooltip 仅改变显示。数值输入失焦按自身正常提交与校验流程执行，Slider 不额外制造一次数值提交。

# SplitButton 分裂按钮 演示文案跟随顶部站点语言，中间卡片和右侧手机集合使用同一 Vue 源文件，不依赖局部 locale 激活。 禁用的分段复用 Button 禁用配色并关闭交互反馈；整体禁用同时移除组阴影，仅禁用菜单按钮会阻止菜单打开并关闭非受控的已打开菜单。 箭头通过 icon 插槽显示，两段默认继承相同的 variant、status 和自定义颜色，图标布局不改变配色。 ### 介绍 将主要操作按钮和关联操作菜单组合在一起。点击主按钮执行操作，点击右侧按钮展开菜单。 示例统一使用两端都支持的 `Message.info(...)`。默认选择后关闭；仅“浮层与连续选择”保留菜单，同时弹出 Message。outline / text 的箭头保持透明背景。 ## 基础示例 ### 基础用法 主按钮执行发布，右侧按钮展开菜单；菜单项提供稳定的 value，并展示无权限的禁用项。 ```demo ../example/basic.vue ``` ## 外观与状态 ### 视觉变体 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `variant` | 按钮组变体 | 视觉变体 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用整个分裂按钮 | 禁用状态 | | `button-props` | 主按钮属性 | 禁用状态 | | `trigger-button-props` | 菜单触发按钮属性 | 禁用状态 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 外观配置对比 | 统一展示 default、outline、tonal、text 四种变体。 ```demo ../example/variants.vue ``` ### 禁用状态 对比整体禁用、仅主按钮禁用、仅菜单按钮禁用。整体 disabled 优先，子按钮的 disabled: false 不能解除整体禁用。 ```demo ../example/disabled.vue ``` ### 外观配置对比 选择一个对比维度后，同屏展示它的全部可选值；其余配置和内容保持一致。可切换其他配置检查组合效果；输入类预览共享一个值。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 五档尺寸 支持 xs、sm、md、lg、xl 五档尺寸，默认 md；窄屏自动换行。 #### 外观组合 适用于主操作和附加菜单。调整状态、尺寸，用相同数据观察变化。内容保持一致，便于比较不同设置的实际效果。
```demo ../example/demos/appearance-lab.vue ``` ## 内容与展示 ### 浮层与连续选择 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 浮层与连续选择 | | `offset-y` | 菜单纵向偏移 | 浮层与连续选择 | | `popup-max-height` | 菜单最大高度 | 浮层与连续选择 | | `hide-on-select` | 选择菜单项后是否关闭菜单 | 浮层与连续选择 | 演示 bottom-start、8px 纵向偏移和 160px 最大高度。hide-on-select=false 支持连续选择，页面显示最近选中的 value。 ```demo ../example/popup.vue ``` ## 自定义与插槽 ### 自定义图标 使用 icon 插槽中的 open 状态旋转箭头，两端使用相同图标。 ```demo ../example/custom-icon.vue ``` ## 交互与控制 ### 受控展开 外部控制按钮使用 `@click.stop`，避免同一次点击冒泡到 document 后又关闭菜单；正常点击外部仍会关闭。 使用 v-model:open 双向控制菜单；外部按钮、菜单触发器和选中关闭会同步更新状态。 ```demo ../example/controlled.vue ``` ## 异步与动态数据 ### 异步操作 click 是普通事件通知，支持 async 回调；loading 由业务状态控制，建议在 finally 中恢复。事件监听器的 Promise 不会自动驱动加载。禁用／加载链接移除有效 href。 ```demo ../example/async-action.vue ``` ## 阅读方向 主按钮位于阅读起点，菜单按钮位于阅读终点；LTR/RTL 切换不交换业务动作或额外触发选择。Enter/Space 保留原生按钮行为，菜单按钮支持上下键打开菜单并跳过禁用项，Home/End 定位首尾，Enter 选择，Escape 关闭并归还焦点。弹层继承触发按钮来源方向，start/end 对齐随方向变化，显式 left/right 保持物理侧。自定义向下图形不额外镜像。 ## 菜单按钮名称 菜单触发按钮默认使用本地化的“更多操作”名称；可通过 `trigger-button-props` 提供 `aria-label` 或 `aria-labelledby` 覆盖。 ## API ### SplitButton Props | 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------ | -------------------------------- | ----------- | | `open` | 菜单是否打开，支持 `v-model:open` | _boolean_ | `undefined` | | `default-open` | 菜单默认是否打开 | _boolean_ | `false` | | `disabled` | 是否禁用整个分裂按钮 | _boolean_ | `false` | | `status` | 按钮组主题色 | `SemanticStatus`

## Animation duration boundaries

Duration is finite nonnegative milliseconds. Zero reaches the target on the next frame. Negative, NaN and infinite values produce development prop diagnostics and safely behave as zero without continuing to request frames. Pausing or unmounting before that frame cancels completion. Changing animation-duration replays enabled numeric animation according to the existing rules.

## API

`precision` accepts integers from 0 to 100; invalid values fall back to 0. Numeric formatting uses JavaScript binary numbers and rounding and is not exact financial arithmetic. Very large values may use exponential notation; when the difference between animation endpoints overflows, the final value is shown directly. Numeric grouping follows en-US rules, `separator` replaces grouping commas, and the decimal point remains a dot; dates use local time. Non-finite numeric values produce a warning, display literally, and do not animate. An invalid animation start falls back to 0 and an invalid duration to 0 with completion on the next frame.

## Usage notes



Placeholder text updates when the default slot appears/disappears. Animation pauses on unmount/KeepAlive deactivation.

### Animation configuration and lifecycle

With `start=true`, dynamically enabling `animation` or changing the numeric target, `valueFrom` or `animationDuration` replays from the currently configured start. Formatting-only changes, such as precision or separators, do not replay. Disabling `animation` or switching to string/date immediately shows the target and stops frames. `start=false` pauses the current number; explicitly returning to `true` replays. Configuration changes while paused prepare a new start without scheduling frames. KeepAlive deactivation pauses; activation resumes unchanged configuration or resynchronizes changed configuration. Unmount releases frames.

## Usage notes





`active` indicates only whether the current one-based step index matches modelValue, independently of wait/process/finish/error status. A current error step remains `active`. Focus/hover do not change `active`.


### Placement semantics and configuration

content-placement shares side vocabulary and spelling, not an identical set across all components. Steps implements only right/bottom; dot and navigation variants have derived rules. Unsupported sides are not added for naming uniformity.


## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

Steps inherits the nearest `dir="ltr"` or `dir="rtl"`, including runtime changes. Horizontal steps, connectors and arrows follow reading direction; vertical steps remain top to bottom. Step numbers, progress values and custom icon content keep their meaning.

With `changeable`, Left/Right moves focus according to reading direction, or Up/Down vertically. Home/End focuses the first/last available step, skipping disabled items. Enter/Space confirms. Moving focus or changing reading direction does not update progress.

## API

主值使用普通 `v-model`：`modelValue` 表示当前步骤序号，从 1 开始。`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控状态，之后修改不会重置当前值；初始化不触发 `update:modelValue`。提供 `modelValue` 时由父级控制，以受控值为准。

Return false, `Promise` or done(false) to reject; true, done() or `Promise` allows. Synchronous void waits for done. Rejection keeps editing; exceptions use existing panel feedback without a separate error event. `open / default-open / update:open` controls the editor, and `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes reading content. Ordinary notification Promises do not run approval tasks. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. ### Form state inheritance Omitted `disabled` / `readonly` inherit FormItem, then Form; an explicit `false` overrides inherited state. Becoming `disabled` or read-only invalidates a pending `beforeChange`, so a late result cannot toggle the value. Outside a form, omitted values behave as `false`. ## Inheriting Form disabled state The default disabled=undefined means inheritance, resolved as local ?? FormItem ?? Form ?? false. Explicit false remains effective, allowing one field to stay enabled while unspecified fields follow Form. Form disabled is the form-wide default, not a lock preventing child overrides. `empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model. ```vue ``` ```ts const beforeChange = (next, done) => { canChange(next).then((allowed) => done(allowed)) } ``` Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed. ### Guard waiting feedback Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading. Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Navigation items follow reading order without changing selection values or item order. Automatic space for a floating button is at inline end; a center button remains centered. Explicit Badge placements remain physical corners.

## API

TabBar uses a group of buttons for state selection, with aria-pressed on the selected item. Give the root an aria-label when needed. Applications handle routing; ordinary events do not await return values.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected child name; unnamed positional mode uses zero-based indices. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets. Explicit binding wins, without initialization `update:modelValue`.

### Boundary with Cedar Table's typed configuration

Maple Table uses native-table slots and does not provide data, columns, sorting or filtering configuration. Cedar `defineTableConfig<Row>` applies only to the Cedar data table.

## Reading direction and scrolling

Table inherits native reading direction, with headers/cells defaulting to inline-start alignment. Custom alignment tokens may still specify physical left/right. The native scroll viewport is focusable: Left/Right scrolls visually, and Home/End reaches reading boundaries. Direction changes preserve the distance from inline start, clamped to the new range. Maple Table is a native slotted table and does not add Cedar data-column freezing, column resizing or grouped-header APIs.

Object syntax must explicitly include `{ loading: true, size: 24 }`. A configuration object without loading does not enable it, matching Cedar Table.

## API


Loading preserves the checked state and exposes disabled and busy semantics on checkable tags. If loading starts while the close control has focus, focus moves to the tag. Independent interactive controls in the content do not toggle the tag.

The close button name defaults to the current locale’s close text and can be overridden with `close-button-aria-label`. The tag root remains single-line; `nowrap` mainly enables the inner truncation wrapper and does not control multiline wrapping.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is a selectable tag's boolean checked state. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, without initialization `update:modelValue`.

## CSS Variables

The complete public contract is the `--mp-tag-*` set in `style/token.less`. Customize it with [StyleProvider](#/en-US/style-provider). Cedar uses the same logical names with a different brand prefix.

Status text and outline borders use the corresponding theme semantic colors with light colored fills. Unselected tags remain neutral; selected status colors take precedence over hover. The neutral background switches between fill-2 and fill-3. color takes precedence over status. Keep text readable on custom backgrounds and set text-color when needed.

### Motion
Built-in motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Reduced motion does not prevent loading-state or close-event updates.


## Usage notes



The application updates controlled show / checked values. Hiding retains the fade-out effect; class / style apply to the actual tag. CSS variables customize mobile touch sizing.

### Color override boundaries

Preset outline stays transparent; loading does not trigger preset fill hover. Dark backgrounds consume bg/bg-hover with instance overrides. Preset icon-color is separate from text-color. Unchecked presets remain neutral, while an explicit color still applies. Preset/custom colors do not guarantee contrast on arbitrary backgrounds.

## API


加载中保留选中状态，可选中标签声明禁用与忙碌状态；关闭按钮持焦时进入加载会将焦点移到标签。正文中的独立交互控件不会触发标签选中。

关闭按钮名称默认使用当前语言的关闭文案，可通过 `close-button-aria-label` 覆盖。标签根始终保持单行；`nowrap` 主要启用内容截断内层，并不控制多行换行。

### 主值与默认值

使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示可选标签是否选中，布尔值；`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控值，后续修改不会重置当前状态。显式绑定值优先，初始化不发出 `update:modelValue`。

## 使用说明



show / checked 为受控值时由调用方更新。隐藏时保留淡出效果，class / style 作用于实际标签；移动端触控尺寸可通过 CSS 变量定制。

### 颜色覆盖边界

预设色 outline 保持透明；loading 不触发预设填充 hover。暗色背景消费 bg/bg-hover 变量，实例覆盖同样生效。预设 icon-color 与 text-color 分开。未选中预设保持中性，但自定义 color 属性仍生效。预设／自定义色不保证任意背景上的对比度。

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

# Time If a parent keeps the popup open after confirmation, repeated confirmation without a new selection is deduplicated. A fresh time selection starts a new transaction and can be confirmed again. While expanded, the native combobox uses `aria-controls` to identify its own named popup. Closing updates the state and removes the link. `aria-label` and `aria-describedby` reach the native input. Custom selected/trigger slots must preserve accessible names, keyboard operation and state associations. In clock and wheel modes, min/max are inclusive same-day bounds. A minute stays selectable when some of its seconds are available. Second constraints compare the complete clock value, not seconds from a different hour. Use TimeRange show-next-day for overnight ranges, rather than reversed min/max. Installing Time also registers TimePicker, which is available through the static member `Time.Picker`. ## Basic examples ### Basic Usage ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/basic-usage.vue ``` ## Appearance and presentation ### Form control size comparison #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | ------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | | `format` | String parse, display and output format | Field appearance and nested options, Time formats and 12-hour clocks, Visible wheel fields | | `placeholder` | Placeholder | Form control size comparison, Field appearance and nested options, Time formats and 12-hour clocks | | `variant` | Variant: `filled` `standard` `outline` | Form control size comparison, Field appearance and nested options | | `use12-hours` | Twelve-hour panel; defaults to hh:mm:ss a without an explicit format | Time formats and 12-hour clocks, AM / PM | | `disabled` | Whether disabled | Form control size comparison | | `readonly` | Whether readonly | Form control size comparison | Compare Input, Button, Select, date/time fields and other single-line controls at the same size. Field variants share the height scale; Button uses outline here. DatePicker/TimePicker are panels; this example uses Date/Time fields. The example includes selected and clearable values, removable tags and long multiple selections. Select/Cascader keep the same size height with tag-nowrap. Long tag text uses ellipsis while removal icons remain available; tags scroll horizontally while clear and arrow controls stay outside the scrolling area. Hover, focus or tap truncated tag text to read its full content; dismiss with an outside click or Escape without changing the selected value. Restore values after clearing to repeat the comparison. Multiline text and wrapping multiple selections can grow with content. ```demo ../../field-decorator/example/demos/control-sizes.vue ``` ### Field appearance and nested options hint controls the floating label (Cedar defaults to false, Maple to true) and is suppressed by an outer Form label. line defaults to true; text-color/focus-color/blur-color accept optional color strings. An unset error inherits Form state; explicit false overrides it. TimeRange separator defaults to `~` and accepts an empty string. Default variants remain Cedar filled and Maple standard; set variant explicitly for matching appearance. The field owns values, defaults, open state, format, steps, bounds, disabled rules and readonly/disabled state. Set these directly on the field, not inside timePickerProps/timeRangePickerProps. Nested options customize presentation only; model/select/confirm listeners cannot replace the field flow. Types reject owner properties and runtime filtering removes them, even when a top-level constraint is unset. Maple pickerProps accepts visual options such as optionHeight/optionCount, not columns, fieldNames, selection, toolbar or open state. popupProps accepts positioning, appearance and lifecycle callbacks, but not open/defaultOpen or open-update listeners. Top-level popupContainer (including false) takes priority. Nested options in standalone time panels follow the same ownership rules. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/field-appearance.vue ``` Field interactions use one local controller: select stages a draft; confirmation validates current rules before commit and Form change notification. Clearing uses the commit path with undefined, followed by clear; it is blocked when readonly/disabled or not clearable. Readonly fields remain focusable; repeated focus/blur notifications are deduplicated. A pending controlled close request cannot repeat a commit. The panel owns one draft and confirmation flow; presentation content only renders that state. The example above counts valid confirmations and shows the extra slot. Reconfirming an unchanged value emits confirm without an extra change event. ### Time formats and 12-hour clocks Compare minute, second and 12-hour displays. Distinguish midnight (12 AM) from noon (12 PM); model formats and step constraints remain separate. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/format-comparison.vue ``` ### Visible wheel fields `time-fields` controls time columns and their order on fields and standalone panels. Range endpoints share the configuration. | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | ------------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | | `time-fields` | readonly TimePickerField[]
`TimePickerField: 'hour' \| 'minute' \| 'second'` | According to the time format | Controls time wheels, including those embedded in calendars. | Lists must be nonempty and unique. Explicit lists determine columns and order; only omitted props use defaults. Date and time fields cannot be mixed. Edits preserve hidden units in the full draft. Changing fields does not submit the model. Nested presentation props cannot override root field configuration. ### Next Day Label

When the end time is earlier than the start, `show-next-day` treats the end as the next day and shows a next-day marker. Without it, the draft is preserved, a red footer message is shown and confirmation is disabled. Now always updates only the active endpoint.

```html
<script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const range = ref(['22:00', '06:00'])
</script>

<template>
  <mp-time-range format="HH:mm" v-model="range" show-next-day placeholder="Overnight range" clearable />
</template>
```

hint controls the floating label (Cedar defaults to false, Maple to true) and is suppressed by an outer Form label. line defaults to true; text-color/focus-color/blur-color accept optional color strings. An unset error inherits Form state; explicit false overrides it. TimeRange separator defaults to `~` and accepts an empty string. Default variants remain Cedar filled and Maple standard; set variant explicitly for matching appearance.

The field owns values, defaults, open state, format, steps, bounds, disabled rules and readonly/disabled state. Set these directly on the field, not inside timeRangePickerProps. Nested options customize presentation only; model/select/confirm listeners cannot replace the field flow. Types reject owner properties and runtime filtering removes them, even when a top-level constraint is unset.

Maple pickerProps accepts visual options such as optionHeight/optionCount, not columns, fieldNames, selection, toolbar or open state. popupProps accepts positioning, appearance and lifecycle callbacks, but not open/defaultOpen or open-update listeners. Top-level popupContainer (including false) takes priority. Nested options in standalone time panels follow the same ownership rules.

```demo
../example/demos/en-US/field-appearance.vue
```

Field interactions use one local controller: select stages a draft; confirmation validates current rules before commit and Form change notification. Clearing uses the commit path with undefined, followed by clear; it is blocked when readonly/disabled or not clearable.
