## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

`popup-props` configures the anchored Trigger popover on both platforms. It cannot replace field open/disabled/trigger ownership. Top-level popup-container, including false, takes precedence. Panel and popup options are separate. `click(event)` fires once for an enabled field; readonly fields notify but do not open. Use `open-change(false)` for close requests, not proof that a controlled state changed. The field close event has been removed without an alias.

`suffix-icon` receives `focus: boolean` and `popupOpen: boolean`, replacing arrow-icon. `focus(index = 0)` focuses start (0) or end (1) without committing; `blur()` removes focus and requests closing.

Range `placeholder` accepts `string | string[]`: a string labels both endpoints; array entries label each endpoint, with missing entries empty. Explicit empty strings do not fall back to defaults.

### Pure-panel event and slot boundaries

`TimePicker`/`TimeRangePicker` do not manage fields/popups. Pass `open`, `size`, `variant`, clearing and popup configuration to `Time`/`TimeRange`.

- `select(value, date)`: edit the draft.
- `change(value, date)`: valid confirmation with a changed value; updates the model.
- `confirm(value, date)`: every valid confirmation, including unchanged values. `disableConfirm` also emits it on valid selection commits. Disabled, readonly or invalid drafts do not emit it.
- `extra`: additional explanatory content.
- `actions({ confirm, canConfirm, value })`: replace default tools. `value` is the draft; call `confirm()` to commit and disable buttons according to `canConfirm`.

Single-time events carry formatted strings and Date objects; range events carry corresponding arrays. Pure panels no longer emit `open-change`, `update:open` or `clear`.

Panels edit a draft and commit on confirmation. Cancellation or closing does not commit, while clearing commits an empty value and closes immediately. Mobile time fields do not open the software keyboard. See the combined field examples in the Date documentation.

### Defaults and format

Inherited, format-derived and effective-step defaults describe resolved behavior; raw Props may be undefined. Without format, the default is HH:mm:ss, or hh:mm:ss a with use12Hours=true. Bounds use 24-hour clock times, separate from Date-family valueFormat/time-zone rules.

### Complete field events and slots

Events notify only; listener Promises are not collected. update:modelValue and change include null, 0, Date or range arrays allowed by the clearing policy. select reports formatted draft rather than saving. Field update:open/open-change are opening requests; initialization does not notify automatically.

| Event | Prop |
| --- | --- |
| `update:modelValue` | `TimeRangeModelValue` |
| `change` | `TimeRangeModelValue, (Date \| undefined)[] \| undefined` |
| `select` | `(string \| undefined)[] \| undefined, (Date \| undefined)[] \| undefined` |
| `clear` | `()` |
| `click` | `Event` |
| `focus` | `()` |
| `blur` | `()` |
| `update:open` | `boolean` |
| `open-change` | `boolean` |

Field focus(index?)/blur() target the actual input or trigger without changing model. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?). prefix, selected, suffix and extra are unscoped; ranges also have separator. Cedar direct mode has a custom default trigger slot; Maple does not.

actions/extra belong to panel draft: Cedar direct forwards them, Maple direct does not, and deferred editing forwards them. Panel confirm() is not the outer field final-save entry point. Pure panels have actions/extra, without field read/clear-icon/loading-icon slots. Standalone panels expose no ref.confirm() method; custom confirmation uses actions.confirm.

### Complete pure-panel events

Arguments are tuples from the corresponding public event type. Date arguments are parsed from formatted clock times and do not promise to preserve an input Date calendar day.

| Event | Prop |
| --- | --- |
| `update:modelValue` | `TimeRangePickerEmits['update:modelValue']` |
| `change` | `TimeRangePickerEmits['change']` |
| `select` | `TimeRangePickerEmits['select']` |
| `confirm` | `TimeRangePickerEmits['confirm']` |

### Panel business events and draft initialization

Pure-panel business events are update:modelValue, change, select and confirm. select reports candidates; valid confirmation notifies confirm, while update:modelValue/change only occur for an actual value change. Field opening, clearing and focus events do not belong to pure panels.

draft-initialize is an internal Maple bridge staging the first visible candidate for the field owner. It is not business selection/commit, emits no select/change and does not close editing. Cedar does not promise this signal. Public panel event types exclude it; business code should not depend on it.

Complete panel actions scope below; extra has no arguments.

```ts
import type { TimeValue } from '@maple-design/ui'
type PanelActionsScope = { confirm: () => boolean; canConfirm: boolean; value: Array<TimeValue | undefined> | undefined; selectNow: () => boolean; nowDisabled: boolean }
```

### Explicit save guard

beforeCommit(payload, done, context) belongs to field saving. payload contains value/previousValue; context has signal and optional event. Returning undefined waits for done, while boolean/Promise results settle by their result. FormItem validates candidates first; failure retains draft. Ordinary select/change/confirm/click listener returns do not use this task protocol.

### Public types and entry points

```ts
import { TimeRange, TimeRangePicker, type TimeRangeProps, type TimeRangeEmits,
  type TimeRangeSlots, type TimeRangeInstance, type TimeRangePickerProps,
  type TimeRangePickerEmits, type TimeRangePickerSlots } from '@maple-design/ui'
```

CSS Variables 面板样式变量见 [`TimeRangePicker`](/zh-CN/time-range-picker)。 以下为组件使用的 css 变量，可以使用 [StyleProvider 组件](#/zh-CN/style-provider) 进行样式定制。 ### 值类型 ```ts export type TimeValue = string | number | Date ``` ### Form 字段展示与确认 本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `popup`，点击值区域打开编辑面板。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。 Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。 `before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。 日期／时间字段在 inline 下沿用原确认策略；在 popover/popup 中，内部纯面板隐藏确认工具栏，由编辑层提供唯一一组确认／取消。独立 DatePicker、DateRangePicker、TimePicker、TimeRangePicker 保留原有面板 API 和确认行为，不继承 Form 的字段展示。 移动端日期字段通过 `panel-type` 选择日历／滚轮内容；`edit-mode` 仅表示字段编辑方式。独立面板的内容形态以各自 API 为准，不由字段 edit-mode 控制。 `read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。 ### 移动端统一面板 滚轮上方按实际格式显示时、分、秒列名，并与两组滚轮对齐；十二小时制额外显示 AM/PM。不显示顶部摘要和可视的起止提示；左组编辑开始时间，右组编辑结束时间，跨日时在右组滚轮下方显示“次日”。 共享样式变量： 范围面板默认提供“此刻”，初次打开编辑开始时间；操作右侧滚轮后改为编辑结束时间。点击只修改当前端的草稿，另一端保留；即使开启 `disable-confirm`，点击此刻及后续调整仍需确认，取消则丢弃草稿。遵守格式、步长和禁用规则，次日提示与起止校验实时更新。字段、独立面板及弹层行为一致，均可用顶层 `:show-now-button="false"` 隐藏。自定义 `actions` 插槽可使用 `selectNow()` 和 `nowDisabled`。 ### 透传配置边界 open/defaultOpen、disabled、trigger、closeOnClickReference、preventFocus 和对应展开更新由时间字段管理。顶层 popup-container 明确设置时优先，否则使用嵌套配置；popupClass 会合并。inline 展示层固定 popupOffset=4；Maple 还固定 unmountOnClose=true，因此嵌套配置中的这些字段不保证能控制最终值。 ## # Trigger Replacing or clearing the popup reference, or unmounting the component, removes the old window scroll listeners. After closing or unbinding, pending positioning and scroll-close tasks do not affect a popup opened later. mouse-enter-delay / mouse-leave-delay are interaction delays, separate from CSS enter/leave duration. Cancel, replacement, KeepAlive deactivation and unmount invalidate dequeued commits; retained requests cannot schedule while inactive or disposed. Reactivation accepts new requests without replaying old delays. Controlled open remains caller-owned. Clicking another independent reference closes the previous top layer before opening the new one. Nested popups remain inside their parent. Controlled open state only receives a close request; the owner may reject it. ### Introduction A style-agnostic floating-layer primitive for interaction, positioning, teleporting, stacking and open state. Prefer Tooltip, Popover or Menu for end-user features; use Trigger directly when building another floating component. ## Basic examples ### Basic usage ```demo ../example/demos/basic.vue ``` ## Layout and arrangement ### Placement and arrow #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | `hover/click/focus/contextMenu/manual`, or an array | Placement and arrow | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. `content` supplies popup `content`. Exposes `open()`, `close()`, `resize()`, `allowClose()`, `getReference()`, `setReference()`, `focusReference()`, `isTopLayer()`. ### Accessibility `trigger="focus"` supports keyboard focus; Escape closes only the topmost popup. Trigger does not define business `role`/ARIA relationships; semantic wrappers supply them. ## CSS Variables These are actual :root defaults. Prefer component variables for business customization; internal positioning variables are not public API. Tooltip/Popover define arrow appearance themselves. Override their component variables rather than Trigger arrow-background. With Teleport, variables must be in the actual popup scope, for example through `popup-style`. Trigger-button variables do not automatically inherit into popups. ### Reduced motion Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots. `allowClose()` restores the internal closing gate; there is no public counterpart to disable closing, and this method cannot prevent closure. ### Placement semantics and configuration placement is the preferred side; auto-fit-position defaults to true and can change the final side. It is not a position coordinate. top-start describes anchor placement and alignment, whereas top-left is a container corner. Top/bottom start and end mirror with reading direction; left/right remain physical, and vertical start/end remain top/bottom. ## Native event modifiers on reference elements Native `click`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focusin`, `focusout`, `contextmenu` listeners and `.once`, `.capture`, `.passive` modifiers bind to the actual reference element, not the popup. `.once` follows the native element's listener lifetime. Replacing a callback does not reactivate a consumed listener; replacing the reference or removing and readding a listener starts a new lifetime. Deactivation/unmount unbind listeners. Listeners only notify; returned Promises do not drive opening/loading, and errors enter Vue's event error chain. `aria-describedby` from `reference-attrs` is merged and deduplicated with existing reference descriptions; cleanup or reference replacement restores the original attribute. Fixed positioning uses the actual fixed containing block when an ancestor has a transform, filter, perspective, or containing CSS property. Axis-aligned scaling is accounted for; rotated or skewed coordinate systems are not guaranteed. For accessible same-origin iframe references, the reference and popup documents share coordinate conversion and event handling; cross-origin or unrelated browsing contexts are not supported. With `update-at-scroll`, scrolling either document or a scrollable ancestor updates the popup.

和 aria 关系，上层语义组件负责补充。 ## CSS Variables 以下为实际 :root 默认值。业务定制优先使用组件变量；内部定位变量不属于公开 API。 Tooltip 与 Popover 自行定义箭头外观；应覆盖其组件变量，而不是 Trigger arrow-background。 使用 Teleport 时，变量需放在实际 popup 的作用域中（例如通过 `popup-style`）；触发按钮上的变量不会自动继承到浮层。 ### 减少动态效果 内置 CSS 过渡遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`。关闭过渡不改变最终显隐、选中／展开状态及事件语义；插槽内自定义动画由应用自行控制。 `allowClose()` 只恢复内部关闭门控；没有公开的对应禁用方法，也不能用它阻止关闭。 ### 方位语义与配置入口 placement 是首选方位，auto-fit-position 默认 true 时最终方位可能变化；它不是 position 坐标。top-start 与 top-left 不是同一种枚举：前者是锚点方位及沿边对齐，后者是容器角落。top/bottom 的 start/end 随阅读方向镜像；left/right 仍是物理方位，纵向 start/end 维持上下语义。 ## 参考元素的原生事件修饰符 `click`、`mouseenter`、`mouseleave`、`focusin`、`focusout`、`contextmenu` 的原生监听器和 `.once`、`.capture`、`.passive` 均绑定到实际参考元素，不会落到浮层。`.once` 按原生元素的监听生命周期执行；更新回调不重新启用已消费的监听，换参考元素或移除后重加监听才开始新的周期。停用和卸载会解绑。普通监听器只通知，返回 Promise 不驱动打开或加载，异常进入 Vue 的事件错误处理链。 `reference-attrs` 的 `aria-describedby` 与参考元素已有描述 ID 合并去重；清理或更换引用时恢复原始属性。 `fixed` 定位会识别 transform、filter、perspective 等形成的固定定位包含块，并处理轴向缩放；不保证旋转或倾斜坐标系精确。可访问的同源 iframe 引用与弹层之间会换算坐标并绑定各自文档事件；不支持跨源或无共同祖先的浏览上下文。启用 `update-at-scroll` 时，两端文档及可滚动祖先的滚动都会更新位置。

Generated local Files are not native file-chooser or network-upload coverage. The switch affects subsequent additions without rereading existing items. Completion only updates items that are still uploading: canceled items remain canceled and removed items do not reappear. Active requests return to zero after completion, cancellation, failure, or leaving the demo. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/queue-request.vue ``` ## Async hooks and requests ### Before removing With manual async confirmation enabled, the synchronous allow switch is ignored. Repeated removal of a pending file invokes one hook. Cancel keeps the file; resolving after disabling also keeps it, and a fresh removal is required after re-enabling. Counters expose the list, pending tasks, hook calls and remove notifications. Deactivation/unmount settles local tasks without network requests. All extra controls are local. Reject removal rejects the pending Promise, keeps the file and allows a fresh attempt. Replace same UID file creates a new local File; an old confirmation must not remove that replacement. Reset upload queue invokes public reset without a late remove notification. Activate upload suspends/restores Upload through KeepAlive; the outer Demo keeps pending jobs for manual completion, whose old results must stay invalid after activation. Suspending Upload does not physically cancel external business Promises; leaving the whole Demo settles its local jobs. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/before-remove.vue ``` ### Preparation and cancellation races For cancellation plus total-size retry, prepare two items, cancel, then submit again: four jobs remain pending, including two obsolete attempts. Resolving all jobs starts only one valid request. The over-limit item retains its original file and canceled status; it is not counted as a new failure or automatically restored to ready. Remove the successful item and resubmit the remaining item to succeed. Obsolete preparation results consume no extra capacity. In the total-size example, a 600B replacement fits the individual limit, but two replacements exceed the 1024B total limit. One request starts; the other item retains its original file and reports max-total-size. Remove the successful item, then prepare the remaining item again to free capacity. Reset clears the queue and pending preparations. This example uses local generated files and simulated requests. “Prepare and submit” pauses before-upload; repeated submission does not duplicate the same attempt. Cancel and submit again, then resolve both preparations: only the current valid attempt starts a request. Text and oversized replacements are rechecked against the image type and 1 KiB size limit. Rejected items stay ready and can be retried with a valid copy. The demo uses public useUploader and immediate local requests. Resetting, deactivation and unmounting release pending preparations. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/prepare-request.vue ``` ### Async request metadata Configure a local receiver you control, then resolve headers and data separately to exercise the default XHR transport. Resolving only one does not send; cancel before resolving the other to prevent the request. The receiver can inspect `X-Demo-Upload`, `auditMarker` and the `attachment` file field; its response is shown below. The endpoint starts empty, with no external upload service configured. The receiver must allow the documentation origin through CORS. Only generated synthetic text is used. Use Reject headers / Reject data to fail a preparation: the current attempt becomes error once. Retry before settling the other old Promise to verify that its late result cannot overwrite the new attempt. Rejections after cancellation do not add errors. Resolve/reject buttons settle all pending jobs of that kind, including obsolete ones, to make races observable; reset drains pending jobs. A preparation rejection is not an HTTP error. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/metadata-request.vue ``` ### Delayed request handles The local custom-request returns a Promise. Return an old handle after cancellation to see abort called immediately; its late success cannot restore the canceled item. Cancel, start again, and return all handles and callbacks: only the current attempt succeeds once. Counters show callbacks accepted by the queue, not real transmission. No network is used; reset, deactivation and unmounting release local waits. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/late-request.vue ``` ## API ### Empty values and reading placeholders `empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific. ### Upload Props | Prop | Type | Default / description | | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- | | model-value / default-value | UploadFileItem[] | Controlled value / uncontrolled initial [] | | accept / capture | `string / UploadCapture`

Form receives one change notification per change, including progress/state updates. - read(item): reading completed; business code may take over uploading. It does not indicate server success. - rejected(UploadRejectedFile[]): reason is accept/before-add/before-read/read-error/max-file-size/max-total-size/max-files. - exceed(nativeFiles, acceptedList): file-count limit exceeded. - progress(item,event?), success(item), error(item): active-request notifications. Stale/canceled callbacks have no effect. - remove(item): removal proposal after removal hooks accept it. - preview(item, UploadPreviewEvent): event.preventDefault() cancels built-in image/video preview. Programmatic previews are cancelable too; originalEvent is optional. ### Upload Slots - trigger({chooseFile,dragOver,disabled}): custom selection entry. Display-only content uses the wrapper button role and Enter/Space entry. Interactive custom content owns its keyboard behavior; the wrapper adds no button role or Tab stop. Bind the slot disabled value to your button. Calling chooseFile directly needs no .stop: bubbling does not choose again or also invoke requestChoose. Custom buttons relying on bubbling can still use requestChoose. Use requestChoose for asynchronous decisions, or synchronously call event.preventDefault() before awaiting and invoking chooseFile yourself. Click listener Promises are not collected. Each requestChoose callback selects at most once and expires on unmount or KeepAlive deactivation, even after reopening. - item({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace}): customize a whole file item. - remove-button({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace}): customize removal actions. - read({value,text}): field reading content; value is the nullable file model and text is formatted content. This differs from the file-read completion event. ### Upload Methods Provides chooseFile(), replace(file,replacement?), submit(file?), abort(file?), retry(file), remove(file), reset(), clearSuccess(), clearError(), getFiles(status?), preview(file) and closePreview(). useUploader(options) provides headless upload logic, addFiles(files), and input/drag handlers. chooseFile, replace, submit, retry and remove return `Promise` for their preparation stages. submit/retry await preparation hooks and request-factory creation, without guaranteeing network completion; success/error events report results. chooseFile completion does not mean the user has selected a file, and remove completion does not mean a controlled parent accepted its proposal. Item/remove-button remove, retry and replace, and trigger chooseFile retain the same Promise types. All public methods are callable before the editor first mounts. When it is unmounted, closed or deactivated, getFiles(status?) returns shallow snapshots of the accepted model filtered by status; asynchronous mutations settle as no-ops and synchronous mutations are no-ops. To perform an operation, first open and mount the editor through field interaction or controlled open, or use editMode="direct". Stored method references forward to the current instance after closing/reopening; cancelling an editor preserves the accepted model. ### Controlled state and lifecycle If a controlled parent rejects an addition, only read/list proposals emit; automatic upload waits until that uid is accepted, then runs once. Same-tick proposals merge transactionally; across ticks, the actual parent list is authoritative. Rejected entries do not count toward total size. Parents own consistency of late list replacements. Explicit removal of rejected items, reset or unmount releases generated URLs; external URLs are never revoked. Built-in preview retains its own URL ownership until closing and does not close another component's later preview. Cancellation covers before-upload, asynchronous headers/data/name and asynchronous custom-request handles. Retrying or replacing a File under the same uid invalidates old callbacks. before-read/before-upload replacements recheck limits. max-total-size counts accepted entries and the current valid prepared batch/request only. Disabled/readonly block selection, removal, submission and other mutations; readonly allows preview/download. KeepAlive deactivation cancels preparation/requests; reactivation allows new operations. ## Types UploadProps、UploadEmits、UploadSlots、UploadExpose、UploadPublicMethods、UploadFileItem、UploadStatus、UploadListType、UploadResolveType、UploadImageFit、UploadCapture、UploadRejectedFile、UploadRejectedReason、UploadRequestOptions、UploadRequest、UploadCustomRequest、UploadProgressEvent、UploadData、UploadHeaders、UploadBeforeRead、UploadBeforeUpload、UploadBeforeRemove、UploadCreateThumbnailUrl、UploadIsSuccessResponse、UploadRequestChoose、UploadPreviewEvent、UseUploaderOptions、UploadInstance。 ## CSS Variables Public variable suffixes match across platforms; all defaults appear below with c/mp prefixes respectively. ### Form field presentation and confirmation This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled. `before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form. Attachment confirmation commits file-list relationships; it cannot undo completed remote uploads or permanent deletion. To defer network side effects, set `auto-upload="false"` and upload after the final business submission. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. ### Replacing attachments and video duration `reupload` defaults to `false`. When enabled, each attachment has Replace, including at `max-files`. `replace(file, replacement?)` opens a single-file chooser when replacement is omitted or directly validates/proposes a supplied `File`. The replacement chooser respects request-choose/disabled/readonly and does not support multiple selection. New files pass before-add, before-read, accept, individual/total size/count checks, then before-remove. Count/total calculations subtract the old item. Canceling selection, validation/guard rejection or externally removed targets preserve the original. Accepted replacements use a new UID at the same position and emit `replace(next, previous)` plus `change`, without remove or server-deletion requests. Controlled parents decide acceptance. Acceptance invalidates old upload callbacks. Later upload failure displays an error/retry state without restoring the old file automatically. `UploadFileItem.duration?: number` is seconds. Finite nonnegative values display `mm:ss`/`h:mm:ss`; 0 displays `00:00`, unknown/invalid values remain hidden. Local video metadata waits at most 5 seconds and cleans temporary URLs/listeners/timers on success, failure, abort or unmount. Remote records may supply duration directly; reading it does not request remote videos. Text lists show duration text; image layouts show badges. | New entry | Type / default | | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | | reupload | boolean / false | | replace(file, replacement?) | `Promise`; a method completion, not successful remote upload | | replace event | next: UploadFileItem, previous: UploadFileItem; model proposal | | item slot replace | () => void; open this item's replacement chooser | | duration | Optional UploadFileItem duration in seconds | The complete-form example uses data-url to retain local attachment drafts across popup switches without temporary object URLs. Production uploads should store server URLs after success. The creating component/preview references still own object-url lifetimes. ### Guard waiting feedback Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection/failure restores interaction, and repeated input does not restart the same operation. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate. Files remain concurrent; feedback aggregates all current guard tasks without treating change/progress notifications as tasks. `useUploader()` exposes readonly `guardPending`, aggregating currently awaited before hooks. It does not represent upload progress. ### Preparation vetoes and exceptions `beforeUpload` returning `false` or resolving to `false` is a business veto: no transport starts, the item stays `ready`, and neither `error` nor `rejected` is emitted. Throwing or rejecting is a preparation failure: no transport starts, the item becomes `error`, and the existing `error(item)` event reports the original cause as `item.error` exactly once. This event covers preparation and transport failures; it does not imply an HTTP request was sent. Both outcomes permit a later submission with a valid hook result. Notification return Promises do not hold the preparation task open. Obsolete or canceled attempts cannot report a new `error`.

异步钩子与请求 ### 删除前确认 开启“手动异步确认”后忽略同步允许开关，删除等待“确认删除 / 取消删除”。同一文件等待时重复点击不会新增钩子；取消保留文件，等待中禁用后再确认也不会删除，解除禁用后需重新发起。计数核对列表、等待任务、钩子和 remove 通知；停用或卸载结清本地等待，不访问网络。 新增操作均不访问网络：“异常拒绝删除”拒绝本地Promise，文件保留且后续可重试；“替换同 UID 文件”生成新的本地File，旧删除确认不得移除替换项。“重置上传队列”调用公开reset，旧确认不再产生remove；“激活上传组件”通过KeepAlive停用/恢复Upload，等待任务保留在外层Demo用于手动返回，旧结果不得影响恢复后的实例。停用Upload不等于取消外部业务Promise；离开整个Demo才结清其本地等待。 ```demo ../example/demos/before-remove.vue ``` ### 上传前准备与取消竞争 取消后重试合计大小组合：双项进入准备后取消，再次提交会保留四个待返回任务（含两次已失效尝试）。统一返回时仍只启动一次有效请求；超限项保留取消前的原文件和 `canceled` 状态，不误算为新失败或自动恢复为 ready。删除成功项后可再次提交剩余项并成功；旧准备结果不占用额外容量。 合计大小组合：空队列选择“每项替换600B，合计上限1024B”，连续加入两个62B合成图片，再准备并统一完成。每项均满足单文件1024B限制，但两项替换后总量超限，因此只有一项发起本地请求，另一项保留ready原文件并报告max-total-size。删除成功项后，再准备剩余项可成功；重置清空队列、等待和请求计数。此处验证本地before-upload替换，不涉及原生文件选择或真实网络上传。 点击“准备并提交”后，`before-upload` 保持等待；重复提交不会重复创建同一尝试。取消准备后可以再次提交，再点击“完成准备”同时返回旧、新结果，只有当前有效尝试能发起请求。选择文本或超大图片替换时会再次检查类型和 1 KiB 大小限制，拒绝后保持 ready，可改为有效副本后重试。本示例使用公开 useUploader 和本地即时请求，不访问网络；重置、停用和卸载会释放等待任务。 ```demo ../example/demos/prepare-request.vue ``` ### 异步请求元数据 填写你控制的本地接收接口后，分别手动返回 headers 和 data，观察默认 XHR 的准备与取消。只返回一项时仍不发送；取消后再返回另一项不得启动请求。成功响应显示在示例下方，可由接收端核对 `X-Demo-Upload`、`auditMarker` 和 `attachment` 文件字段。接口地址默认留空，不预设外部上传服务；接收器必须允许文档站来源的 CORS。本例仅使用生成的合成文本，不选择真实文件。 使用“拒绝 headers / 拒绝 data”模拟准备失败，当前尝试只进入一次 error。可在另一项旧 Promise 未结清时重试，观察旧结果不会覆盖新尝试；取消后再拒绝不增加错误计数。返回/拒绝按钮会结清该类所有等待任务（包括旧尝试），便于验证竞争；重置会释放等待任务。准备失败不等同 HTTP 错误。 ```demo ../example/demos/metadata-request.vue ``` ### 请求句柄迟到与取消 本地模拟 custom-request 返回 Promise。取消后再返回旧句柄会立即调用其 abort；返回旧成功回调不会恢复已取消项。取消后再次发起、统一返回句柄和成功回调时，只接受当前尝试一次。计数展示回调是否被内核接受，不代表真实传输；本例不访问网络，重置/停用/卸载释放本地等待。 ```demo ../example/demos/late-request.vue ``` ## ### Upload Slots - trigger({chooseFile,dragOver,disabled})：自定义选择入口。 纯展示内容由外层提供按钮角色和 Enter/Space 入口；包含按钮、链接等交互内容时，外层不再增加按钮角色或 Tab 停靠点。自定义按钮应绑定插槽的 disabled，并负责自己的键盘行为。点击时直接调用 chooseFile 即可，无需 .stop；同次点击的冒泡不会再次选择，也不会额外调用 requestChoose。依赖默认冒泡的自定义按钮仍可使用 requestChoose。 异步选择判断请使用 requestChoose，或先同步 event.preventDefault() 取消默认选择，再自行等待并调用 chooseFile；普通点击事件的 Promise 不会被收集。requestChoose 收到的选择回调每次操作至多执行一次，卸载或 KeepAlive 停用后的旧回调不会在重开时恢复。 - item({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace})：自定义整项。 - remove-button({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace})：自定义删除操作。 - read({value,text})：字段阅读内容；value 为文件模型或 null，text 为格式化文字，与读取完成的 read 事件不同。 ### Upload Methods 提供 chooseFile()、replace(file,replacement?)、submit(file?)、abort(file?)、retry(file)、remove(file)、reset()、clearSuccess()、clearError()、getFiles(status?)、preview(file)、closePreview()。useUploader(options) 提供不含界面的上传逻辑，以及 addFiles(files) 和输入、拖放处理接口。 chooseFile、replace、submit、retry、remove 返回 `Promise`，保留各自准备阶段的等待；submit/retry 等待准备钩子和请求工厂创建，不承诺网络传输结束，结果由 success/error 事件报告。chooseFile 的完成不表示用户已选完文件；remove 完成也不表示受控父级已接受删除提议。item/remove-button 的 remove、retry、replace 以及 trigger 的 chooseFile 保留相同 Promise 类型。 所有公开方法在编辑器首次挂载前即保持可调用。未挂载、已关闭或停用时，getFiles(status?) 返回已接受模型的浅拷贝快照并按状态筛选；异步修改命令以空操作完成，同步修改命令为空操作。需要执行时，先通过字段交互或受控 open 打开编辑器并等待挂载，或使用 editMode="direct"。保存的方法引用在关闭/重开后转发到当前实例，编辑器取消会保留已接受模型。 ### 受控与生命周期 受控父级拒绝新增时只发读取与列表提议，不自动上传；后续父级接受该uid才会自动上传一次。同tick提议事务合并，跨tick仍以实际父级列表为真源，拒绝项目不占总大小；父级负责迟到列表替换的一致性。显式remove未接受项、reset或卸载会释放其生成URL；任意外部URL不会被回收。内建预览保留自己的URL使用权至关闭，不关闭其他组件后来打开的预览。 取消覆盖before-upload、异步headers/data/name及异步custom-request句柄阶段；重试和外部同uid换File令旧回调失效。before-read和before-upload的替换会复查限制，max-total-size只累计已接受项及当前正在准备的合法批次/请求。禁用/只读禁止选择、移除、提交等更改；只读允许预览/下载。KeepAlive停用取消当前准备/请求，恢复后允许新操作。 `read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。 ### 覆盖已有附件与视频时长 `reupload` 默认 `false`。开启后，每个附件显示「替换」按钮；达到 `max-files` 后仍可替换已有项。也可调用 `replace(file, replacement?)`：未传 replacement 时选择一个文件，传入 `File` 时直接校验并提出替换。替换选择器不支持多选，且遵守 request-choose、disabled 与 readonly。 新文件先经过 before-add、before-read、accept、单文件/总大小与数量校验，再经过 before-remove。数量和总大小计算扣除被替换项。取消文件选择、校验失败、守卫拒绝或目标已被外部移除时保留原项。通过后以新 UID 原位替换并发出 `replace(next, previous)` 和 `change`，不发出 remove，也不请求删除服务器资源。受控父级决定是否接纳；接纳后旧上传回调失效。此后新上传失败会显示失败状态，可重试，不会自动恢复旧文件。 `UploadFileItem.duration?: number` 使用秒，有限且非负时显示为 `mm:ss` 或 `h:mm:ss`；0 显示 `00:00`，未知/无效值不显示。本地视频会尝试读取元数据（最多 5 秒），成功、错误、中止和卸载都会清理临时 URL、监听及定时器。远端回显记录可直接传 duration，不会为读时长主动请求远端视频。文本列表显示时长文字，图片布局显示角标。 | ## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Verification codes are LTR content: rendering, pasting and focus movement use the original string order, while outer align start/end follows reading direction. RTL does not reverse code characters. Numeric and text codes share this order contract.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

Explicit null is a controlled empty code and never falls back to default-value, which applies only when model-value is absent. reset() still proposes an empty string. Presentation clearing can submit null through empty-value=null; finish never receives null. An omitted model-value remains uncontrolled.

In deferred mode input / paste describe editing, while finish describes the finally accepted complete value. Canceling, rejection, readonly, disabled, external replacement or unmount retires unaccepted completion notifications. Ordinary finish listener Promises do not hold confirmation. A synchronous undefined before-commit return waits for done. Invalid type / align values diagnose and fall back to digit / center; gutter=0 and 0px remain valid.

### VerificationCode Events

| Event | Prop | Semantics |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| input | character, index, event | Starting character and zero-based index of each valid native input proposal |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null | Complete-code proposal |
| change | value: string \| null | Complete-code proposal for each valid edit, not necessarily accepted by a controlled parent |
| finish | value: string | Direct mode notifies after the parent accepts the complete code in the current render; deferred mode waits for confirmation guards and parent acceptance, never draft completion |
| update:open | open: boolean | Controlled editor visibility update |
| open-change | open: boolean | Actual editor visibility change |
| paste | text, event | Pasted text after paste-transform/type processing |
| focus / blur | FocusEvent | Focus enters/leaves the whole component; moving between cells does not duplicate notifications |
| click | MouseEvent | Non-disabled click |

Valid input order: input → update:modelValue → change. finish waits until the parent accepts the complete value in that render. Rejected controlled values restore native inputs; later asynchronous parent assignments do not add finish. reset() proposes empty and emits update:modelValue/change without simulating native input. Disabled, readonly or composing state prevents reset from changing values.

Paste overwrites from the current cell; root-level paste starts at cell 1. Input beyond the first empty cell moves to that first empty cell. A whole-code native input distributes across subsequent cells. SMS suggestions depend on the platform and browser: Cedar hints one-time-code on the first cell, while Maple retains autocomplete=off for all cells. Typing one character in a filled cell replaces that cell even when the caret follows its old character. Composition prefers the current compositionend text, including multiple code points, and falls back to the native value only when event data is missing. Processing is type filtering, formatter, then length clipping; rejected characters consume no cell. Text counts Unicode code points rather than grapheme clusters. External values affect display without an automatic formatted model update.

| Slot | Prop | Description |
| --------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| separator | { index, character } | Overrides separator; not rendered after the last cell |
| read | { value: string \| null, text: string } | Custom read content, taking precedence over empty-text |

### VerificationCode Methods

- focus(index?): zero-based index; defaults to the first empty cell or the last cell when full. Direct readonly fields can receive focus. Deferred mode opens an editable panel first; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open.
- blur(): blur the current editor without reopening the panel.
- reset(): in direct mode, propose an empty value while respecting controlled ownership, disabled/readonly state, and composition. In deferred mode, open an empty draft; model and change notifications wait for final confirmation and before-commit approval. Cancellation preserves the original value.

Public methods remain callable from initial component mount. Stored methods resolve the current editor on every call and never use an old input after closure, reopening, or mode changes. Native input references are undefined while no editor is mounted.

### Keyboard and Form

Left/Right move cells. Backspace removes the current character, or the previous one when empty. Delete removes the current character; following characters shift forward. IME composition does not trim/delete/move focus. Each native input has an SSR-stable id, and all cells use autocomplete=off. Provide aria-label.

InputGroup/Form state is inherited, with explicit disabled/readonly/error/size taking precedence. Internal cell Inputs do not duplicate Form notifications; the complete control notifies input/change once per edit. Both platforms implement three variants/five sizes using local FieldDecorator tokens.

### Form field presentation and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

- focus(index?)：零基索引；省略时定位首个空格，满码定位末格。direct 只读时可聚焦；延迟模式下先打开允许编辑的面板，禁用、只读或纯阅读时不打开。

# Col

24-column Flex layout. Row manages gutters and alignment; Col manages spans, offsets, ordering and breakpoints. Use Grid for CSS Grid collapse and suffix items.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.

The order example restores every column to `order: 0` when reverse is turned off. Responsive breakpoints use the browser viewport rather than the demo card width; widening the card alone does not activate a breakpoint. `span: 0` hides a column, and a matching larger breakpoint can restore it.

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Row resolves responsive gutter with JavaScript matchMedia, using xs for SSR and synchronizing the viewport after mounting. Col uses CSS media queries: SSR already emits all configured classes without waiting for measurement. Breakpoints use viewport width: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Only configured fields override earlier values. Offset starts at the logical inline edge and mirrors in RTL. Order affects visual positioning while preserving DOM, keyboard and assistive technology reading order.

Span, offset and their breakpoint fields accept integers from 0 through 24. A zero span hides the column; offset 24 shifts it by a full row width. Order accepts finite integers, including negative values and values above 24, subject to browser CSS order computation. Gutter accepts finite nonnegative numbers, six-breakpoint objects or exactly two entries [horizontal, vertical]. Development diagnostics report unknown breakpoints, invalid numbers and enum values. Invalid span falls back to 24; invalid offset/order is ignored; breakpoint objects retain valid fields; invalid gutter components fall back to zero.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Import the independent Row and Col components from the library root or their row/col subpaths; installing Grid does not register them. The old Grid.Row/Grid.Col, GridRowInstance and GridColInstance exports are no longer available.

`flex` overrides column width while preserving `offset`, `order` and responsive configuration. `span: 0`, including breakpoint values, still hides the column; a matching nonzero span restores visibility while `flex` controls width. Removing `flex` restores the span width. Visual ordering does not change DOM or keyboard navigation `order`.

DatePicker is a standalone date panel with no input anchor; placement in the legacy date/picker directory is not a current public DatePicker prop. Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Date objects and millisecond timestamps represent instants; strings represent local time in the target zone. Display, typed input, min/max, shortcuts and disabling rules use the same protocol; event Date objects retain the actual instant. Omitting `timeZone` preserves local-zone behavior. Nonexistent daylight-saving times and invalid zones cannot be committed; repeated times use the first occurrence. Maple scroll / line are mobile calendar presentations; desktop retains its existing panel. ## Configuring the cleared value `empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults. `empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model. ### Values and formats DateValue is string, number or native Date. Numbers are timestamps and 0 is not empty; modelValue=null is explicitly empty. Ranges retain broad arrays and incomplete endpoints rather than forcing a tuple; commits still validate completeness and validity. Maple general DatePicker/Date multiple selection does not widen Cedar single-value Props. Tables list actual public properties. Inherited/precision-derived defaults describe resolved behavior; raw Props can be undefined. format controls display/text input and valueFormat controls the model protocol. Week/quarter display labels differ from model formats; function format has no reverse parser for text input. Bounds are inclusive. Invalid supplied bounds block confirmation instead of being treated as omitted. Preserve names, endpoint distinctions and keyboard access when replacing native controls. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?), respecting emptyValue and disabled/readonly guards. actions receives confirm/disabled/selectNow/nowDisabled, with both actions returning void. It has no Time-panel canConfirm/value arguments. disabled=true prevents confirmation. Standalone panels can replace the action region; the outer editing shell owns final saving in hosted editing, while the panel contributes auxiliary actions. Panel confirm is not the outer-save method. Now capabilities follow the actual panel: Cedar single panels support it, while Cedar range panels have no now action. Maple range panels stage now for the active endpoint, preserve the other endpoint and still require confirmation. The presence of selectNow in scope does not imply every mode supports the action. Cedar cell customizes a calendar cell with date and, for ranges, type=start/end; extra adds content. Maple Date/DatePicker page-calendar summaries support year({year}), month({year,month}), date({week,year,month,date}), range({choose}) and multiple({choose}) according to mode. Maple DateRange/DateRangePicker do not forward these single-panel summary slots, nor do scroll/line viewports promise them. loading-icon is not wired to date fields or pure panels and is not available merely because the underlying decorator supports it. Field focus(index?)/blur() delegate to real controls. Cedar/direct-field blur closes the field popup; Maple range persistent-reference blur only clears its focus, without pretending to close the outer Drawer. Pure panels expose no focus/blur methods. ### Presentation configuration and ranges datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps configure presentation without overriding owned model/rules/type/control events; Maple internal range datePickerProps uses a calendar allowlist. popupProps retains a broad dictionary, with public DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions recommended and owner keys still filtered at runtime. Cedar timePickerProps configures embedded time presentation; Maple pickerProps configures wheels. A range placeholder string applies to both endpoints; arrays configure each and missing entries are empty. readonly is separate from disabled; unset field state inherits Form. Cedar range-panel exchangeTime only handles reversed interactive candidates: true swaps their times, false retains endpoint times. It does not reorder external model/text/shortcut values. ### 表单控件尺寸对照 切换五档 size 和三种字段变体，比较 Input、Button、Select、日期时间及其他单行表单控件的高度。Button 在这里固定使用 outline。DatePicker/TimePicker 是面板，此处使用带输入框的 Date/Time 字段。示例同时展示有值、可清空、标签删除与长标签多选；Select/Cascader 设置 tag-nowrap 时保持同档高度，长标签文字省略、删除图标保留；标签行可横向滚动，清空按钮和箭头固定在外侧。被省略的标签正文支持悬停、键盘聚焦或点按查看完整文字，点外部或按 Esc 关闭，不改变选中值。可清空后恢复选中值重复比较。多行文本和允许换行的多选内容按内容撑高。 ### 选择类型 通过 `type` 切换日 / 周 / 月 / 年 / 季度。 ### 月份标签 字段通过 `date-picker-props`（Date）或 `date-range-picker-props`（DateRange）配置面板的该选项。 `abbreviation`（boolean，默认 `true`）控制日历月份网格的缩写；`false` 使用当前 Locale 的完整月份名。运行时修改立即生效，不改变值，也不触发选择事件。此开关不影响星期标签、标题、滚轮列或值格式。范围日历以顶层选项为准，嵌套日历参数不能覆盖。 ### 语言与嵌套日历参数 日期标签、标题和操作按钮的语言由全局 Locale 和 Provider 配置。切换语言不会选择或提交日期。 ### 日期语言的实例隔离 日期组件使用当前库的 Locale/Provider 配置，周起始日由各实例的 `day-start-of-week` 控制，不会修改应用中 Dayjs 的默认语言或基础语言配置。 `value-format` 是稳定英文日期协议（包括月份名称 token），`format` 的显示及手输文本使用界面语言。切换语言不会改写模型，也不会令英文月份名称模型失效。默认数字协议、Date 对象、时间戳不变。中文核心语言与 Maple 内置语言数据已接入；其他日期格式优先使用已注册 Dayjs 语言数据，未加载的语言安全回退英文。 周号和周比较不再依赖全局周起始设置，跨年同周号不能被误判成同一周。两个不同周起始实例的挂载、更新和卸载互不影响。 ## 时间与选择规则 ### 带时间 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | | `show-time` | 选择时间 | 带时间 | | `format` | 展示格式 | 带时间 | | `value-format` | 模型与事件的格式，可为自定义日期格式、Date 或 timestamp | 带时间 | | `clearable` | 可清除 | 带时间 | ### 内嵌时间与滚轮展示 `time-picker-props` 使用 `DateTimePickerOptions`：`use12Hours`、`step`、`hideDisabledOptions`、`class`、`style`。仅配置时间展示；日期值、格式/秒精度、约束和确认仍由日期所有者管理。`step` 负责展示采样，不静默修正外部值。未知参数及监听函数不转发。 ### 真实端侧能力 Cedar 字段使用桌面日历，通过 `date-picker-props` 或 `date-range-picker-props` 配置面板。Maple 保留这些真实扩展，使用 DateWheelOptions 与 DateRangeCalendarOptions。两端通过 `Date.datePickerProps` / `DateRange.dateRangePickerProps` 配置完整面板，`timePickerProps` 配置内嵌时间展示。初始日期时间放在顶层 `defaultValue`，不要放在 `timePickerProps.defaultValue` 中。 ## 值模型与输入 ### 模型格式与显示格式 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | | `format` | 展示格式 | 模型格式与显示格式、字符串模型：年月日、年月与月日范围、手输与面板选择 | | `value-format` | 模型与事件的格式，可为自定义日期格式、Date 或 timestamp | 模型格式与显示格式、字符串模型：年月日、年月与月日范围 | | `type` | 选择类型 | 字符串模型：年月日、年月与月日范围、周与季度手输 | | `date-picker-props` | 面板展示选项 | 周与季度手输 | ### 字符串模型：年月日、年月与月日范围 `format` 决定显示，`value-format` 决定提交值。下面直接得到 `"2026-09-10"`、`"2026-09"` 或 `["09-10", "10-10"]`，无需将 Date 再转换。日期范围使用数组。`MM-DD` 没有年份，解析时使用当前年，不能表示跨年先后或某个明确年份的 2 月 29 日；有跨年、时区或闰年要求时保留 `YYYY-MM-DD`，在业务提交时单独映射月日。默认仍是 page，未指定 timeZone 使用浏览器本地时区。 ### 周与季度手输 默认周展示 `gggg-wo` 按当前界面语言与实例周起始解析为该周的第一天，模型仍为 `YYYY-MM-DD`。中文周一起始的 `2020-53周` 提交 `2020-12-28`；不存在的周、错误序数后缀不提交。默认季度 `YYYY-[Q]Q`（如 `2025-Q2`）严格解析为首月，模型 `YYYY-MM`（`2025-04`）。手输继续遵守禁用、边界和范围顺序，不自动交换端点。 自定义周/季度展示可以使用 Dayjs 支持的普通日期 token；任意自定义周序数格式没有逆解析协议。`format` 为函数时请设置 `input-editable=false`，通过面板选择。 `input-editable` 默认 true；当 `format` 为函数时无法反向解析，输入保持只读。Maple 多选模式通过面板选择，不支持手动编辑拼接文本。 ### 手输与面板选择 ## 交互与字段配置 ### 交互状态对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | | `disabled` | 禁用 | 交互状态对比、统一字段与提交 | | `open` | 弹层显隐 | 受控关闭被拒绝、透传配置边界与优先级 | | `date-picker-props` | 面板展示选项 | 字段视口与快捷项事件、字段与面板边界 | | `placeholder` | 占位 | 统一字段与提交、字段与面板边界 | | `value-format` | 模型与事件的格式，可为自定义日期格式、Date 或 timestamp | 交互状态对比 | | `readonly` | 只读 | 交互状态对比 | 在同一实例上切换禁用、只读和错误状态后再操作控件，比较可编辑性和交互反馈。恢复开关位于目标控件外；错误外观本身不会执行校验。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 交互状态切换 适用于选择单个日期。调整禁用、只读、错误反馈，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。
### 受控关闭被拒绝 父级可以拒绝 `update:open(false)`，此时面板仍展开。一次选择只能提交并请求关闭一次；受控模型回写相同值不会重置已确认状态。在保持展开时选择新日期会开启新事务，可以再次确认。示例显示模型、提交次数与关闭请求次数。 ### 字段视口与快捷项事件 字段通过嵌套 `date-picker-props` 配置 `pickerValue`、`defaultPickerValue` 和快捷项，不新增第二套顶层视口 Prop。嵌套配置里的监听器不会透传；在字段组件上监听以下事件并回写嵌套 `pickerValue`。 | 事件 | 说明 | 参数 | | --------------------- | -------------------------------- | --------------------------------- | | `update:picker-value` | 请求日历视口更新，不改变选择模型 | value: DateSelection | | `picker-value-change` | 已请求的视口及展示通知 | value, date(s), formatted text(s) | | `select-shortcut` | 接受的快捷项，仍遵守字段确认策略 | shortcut: DateShortcut | 受控视口拒绝更新时保持原月份，后续回写才更新；快捷项选择先进入字段草稿，默认确认后提交。滚轮/时钟没有日历月份导航能力。 ### 展示模式的所有权 Cedar 只实现桌面日历，不公开移动 `edit-mode`。Maple 在字段/纯面板根选择真实展示模式；字段嵌套 `DatePickerOptions` / `DateRangePickerOptions` 不包含 presentation，两库复制的过滤器均拒绝嵌套选择器，不通过隐式覆盖保留无效 API。 ### 周起始日的响应式展示 `dayStartOfWeek` 更新时，日历表头与日期列位置同步更新，不改变选中值或提交草稿。纯面板使用根属性，字段通过 `datePickerProps` / `dateRangePickerProps` 配置；滚轮视图不使用星期列。 ### 动态日期限制 更新或移除 `min` / `max` 会重新计算可选日期，不自动修改已有模型或草稿。面板导航与候选日期校验是不同职责，已有值超出新限制时也不会被静默重写；用户重新选择或确认时按当前限制校验。 ### 编辑与确认 通过 `edit-mode` 配置编辑方式；未指定时依次继承 FormItem、Form，默认 `direct`。支持值：`direct / click / dblclick`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。 Cedar 使用 edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" 在字段附近打开编辑浮层，Enter/F2 也可进入；取消/Escape 丢弃草稿，确认后提交。readPretty 为独立阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 分开。 `before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。 日期／时间字段在 inline 下沿用原确认策略；在 click/dblclick 编辑展示中，内部纯面板隐藏确认工具栏，由编辑层提供唯一一组确认／取消。独立 DatePicker、DateRangePicker、TimePicker、TimeRangePicker 保留原有面板 API 和确认行为，不继承 Form 的字段展示。 独立 DatePicker / DateRangePicker 与 inline 共用日历基准宽度（每个 265px）。单日期带时间时，宽屏下日历与时间列左右排列；范围在宽屏保留两个并排日历。面板会按窄容器换行，侧边快捷项另占一列，不压缩日历；确认与 actions 插槽保持由面板自身管理。 `read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。 ### 统一字段与提交 Date / DateRange / Time / TimeRange 使用相同的 PickerField → FieldDecorator 字段链路。桌面支持键入有效值后回车或失焦提交；有确认按钮的面板只在确认时写回，Escape 或外部关闭丢弃草稿。清除立即提交空值。面板组件不再提供 `hideTrigger` 双模式，自定义触发器使用字段的默认插槽。 ### 字段与面板边界 字段保留输入和浮层状态；嵌套面板参数只接受展示选项，不能覆盖顶层模型、格式或校验规则。 ### 日期值格式 年/月/日模型格式为 `YYYY` / `YYYY-MM` / `YYYY-MM-DD`，日期时间默认含秒；`format="YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm"` 与 `value-format="YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm"` 使用分钟字符串。`format` 控制显示，`value-format` 控制模型和事件，支持自定义格式、`Date` 与 `timestamp`。Cedar 提供周/季度面板；Maple 提供移动端滚轮和时钟展示。 ### 透传配置边界与优先级 使用 `DatePopupOptions` 配置 `popup-props`，调整锚定弹层的外观和定位。open/defaultOpen、disabled/readonly、modelValue、值格式、日期规则及通知监听由字段管理，组件会过滤由字段管理的配置和通知监听器。popup-container 顶层明确传入时优先（包括 false），否则回退 popupProps.popupContainer；popupClass 与内部类合并。trigger、closeOnClickReference、preventFocus、popupOffset 由字段展示层固定（偏移当前为 4）；Maple 还固定 unmountOnClose=true。这些固定项由字段管理；Cedar 的 `unmountOnClose` 可通过现有浮层配置设置。可使用 popupTranslate 定制附加平移。其他有效展示字段保持原透传。 建议使用本页列出的专用配置类型；展开状态、模型和事件由组件管理，不能通过嵌套配置接管。 ```ts import type { DatePopupOptions } from "@cedar-design/ui"; ``` 日期范围还会保留未改动端点的原始 Date／时间戳及隐藏毫秒，避免重复小时中的第二次发生被错误转换成第一次。夏令时仅跳过半小时的地区仍可选择剩余有效分钟；交互范围排序比较真实时刻，交换日期但保留时间时会重新计算目标日期的时区偏移。 ### 复制与编辑 open-trigger-target="icon" 时，输入区可以编辑或复制，只有右侧选择按钮响应点击打开。关闭手输或搜索后，已有文本仍可复制。 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ## 阅读方向 组件继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部方向覆盖。日历日期、月份、年份按阅读顺序排列，前后翻页图形随方向调整，日期值与起止顺序保持原义。分页网格中左右键按视觉方向移动焦点，上下键移动一行，Home/End 移至当前行首尾并跳过禁用项；焦点移动不提交，Enter/Space 沿用选值行为，边界停留在当前显示网格。快捷区 `shortcuts-position="left|right"` 保持物理侧，底部使用 `bottom`。弹层继承字段来源方向。 ## 触发与定位 ### 弹层定位 Date 字段默认从输入框下方 bottom-start 打开。需要时通过 popupProps.placement 覆盖首选方位，由底层 Trigger 定位；不是透传给 Popup 或 Popover。DatePicker 是独立日期面板，没有输入框锚点，不能把旧 date/picker 目录中的 placement 当成当前 DatePicker 的公开属性。 公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。 ## API ### 空值识别与阅读空文案 `empty-values` ## Reading direction

Range values remain `[start, end]`; changing reading direction does not swap endpoints or commit drafts. Calendar range connections and boundary radii follow reading direction. In paged grids, Left/Right moves focus visually and Up/Down preserves date-row order. Maple endpoint editing and continuous range highlighting use different rendering paths. Explicit `shortcuts-position="left|right"` remains physical; popovers inherit the field's source direction.

## API

### DateRangePicker Props

Pure panels do not accept field/popup props such as open/default-open, popup-container, placement, trigger-props, placeholder, variant or clearable. Configure popups through Date/DateRange popup-props, and typing through input-editable. disable-confirm alone controls confirmation tools; show-confirm-btn is removed.

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `model-value` | Bound value | `(Date \| string \| number)[]` | `-` |

| `disabled` | Disable interaction | `boolean \| boolean[]` | `-` |
| `disabled-date` | Return true to disable a date | `Function` | `-` |

### Shared date-family contract

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `default-value` | Uncontrolled initial value, read once | DateValue / DateValue[] | — |
| `value-format` | Model and event value format: a date format string, Date, or timestamp | string | Follows type |
| `min` / `max` | Inclusive bounds; string bounds use value-format | DateValue | — |
| `disabled-time` | Disabled times for the current date and endpoint | (date: Date, side: DateSide) => DateDisabledTime | — |
| `disable-confirm` | Commit immediately | boolean | true |

`DateValue = Date | string | number`. Clearing a single value produces undefined; clearing a range produces [].
The date argument of `disabledDate(date, side)` and `disabledTime(date, side)` is always a Date; side is start/end.
Time callbacks return numeric lists from `disabledHours()`, `disabledMinutes(hour)` and `disabledSeconds(hour, minute)`.
Invalid dates and incomplete/reversed ranges cannot be committed. Confirmation revalidates dynamic disabling rules. Locked range endpoints cannot be cleared or changed.
Nested panel props configure presentation only; they must not override top-level model-value, format, bounds, disabling rules or control events.

### DateRangePicker Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| -------------------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `update:model-value` | Request a model update | value |
| `select` | Select a draft; does not imply submission | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |
| `change` | Committed value changes | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |
| `confirm` | Confirm valid selection; does not use ok | value, date(s), formatted text(s) |

Set `:disable-confirm="false"` to show confirmation tools. The `actions` slot provides `{ confirm, disabled }`; custom `actions` must still call confirm to validate.

## Public entries and types

Root/date-range entries export DateRangePicker, DateRangePickerProps, DateRangePickerInstance, DateRangePickerType, DateRangePickerOptions and DateRangePickerEmits. Install the panel independently with app.use or use DateRange.Picker. Options allows presentation only, excluding models, formats, bounds and disabling rules. No independent date-picker/date-range-picker npm subpaths exist.

Both support shortcuts/shortcuts-position, picker-value/default-picker-value, preview-shortcut, abbreviation and exchange-time. Mobile presentation, multiple/range, touch gestures and panel appearance are real platform differences; missing capabilities are not filled with empty APIs.

## Shortcuts and viewport

Range values and picker-value each contain two dates. Shortcuts cannot overwrite locked endpoints. See [Shortcuts and calendar viewport](/en/components/date-picker/#shortcuts-and-calendar-viewport).

### Interactive time exchange

exchange-time defaults to true: reversed interactive selection swaps complete date/time endpoints. false swaps dates only, retaining each position's time. Reordering revalidates endpoint rules, disabled times and locks. Model assignments, typed input and shortcuts are not reordered automatically. show-current controls current-date highlighting only; range panels have no show-now-button. See [Current date and range policies](/en/components/date-picker/#current-date-and-range-policies).

### Locale and nested calendar options

Date labels, titles and actions use each library's global Locale/Provider. Cedar removes component-level `locale` without dictionary overrides/aliases. Locale changes neither select nor commit dates.

### Embedded time and wheel presentation

Embedded time columns share the date columns’ draft transaction. Changing either endpoint's time still requires outer confirmation by default, preserving the selection without early model writeback.

Embedded time columns and date columns share one draft transaction. By default, changing either endpoint time requires the outer confirmation; the edit is preserved without committing early.

`time-picker-props` uses `DateTimePickerOptions`: `use12Hours`, `step`, `hideDisabledOptions`, `class`, `style`. It configures time presentation only. The date owner controls values, formats/second precision, constraints and confirmation. `step` samples displayed options without silently adjusting external values. Unknown options/listeners are not forwarded.

### Per-instance date locale isolation

Date components use the current library Locale/Provider configuration. Each instance controls its first weekday through `day-start-of-week`, without changing the application Dayjs default locale or base locale configuration.

`value-format` is a stable English date protocol, including month-name tokens. `format` display/typed text uses the UI language. Locale changes do not rewrite models or invalidate English-month models. Numeric protocols, Date objects and timestamps remain unchanged. Chinese core/Maple locale data is integrated; other formats prefer registered Dayjs locale data and safely fall back to English when unavailable.

Week numbers/comparisons no longer depend on global week-start settings; equal week numbers across years are not mistaken for the same week. Mounting/updating/unmounting instances with different week starts is isolated.

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the filter-fields object. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, and initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

Input updates the internal mirror before notifying the parent. If the parent does not accept the update, the input remains visible locally; a different external model replaces the mirror. `collapsed` likewise updates locally before notification and accepts later external changes. To reject an input, explicitly provide a new model object.

### FilterForm Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Form values; uses default-value when omitted | `Record<string, unknown>` | `undefined` |
| default-value | Initial values read only at creation | `Record<string, unknown>` | `{}` |
| fields | Filter-item schema | `FilterFormField[]` | `[]` |
| field-map | Optional field-component registry | `FilterFormFieldMap` | `{}` |
| rules | Forwarded Form validation rules | object | - |
| collapsed **(v-model)** | Whether to collapse extra items | boolean | `true` |
| collapsible | Whether expanding/collapsing is enabled | boolean | `true` |
| cols | Responsive column count | number \| object | `{ xs:1, sm:2, md:3, lg:3, xl:4, xxl:5 }` |
| grid-props | Forwarded Grid properties, taking precedence over matching container settings | `Record<string, unknown>` | - |
| change-debounce | change debounce in milliseconds; 0 notifies immediately; negative or nonfinite values fall back to 500 | number | `500` |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Immediate value snapshot notification on input | `(value: Record<string, unknown>) => void` |
| update:collapsed | Local expand/collapse notification | `(collapsed: boolean) => void` |
| change | Debounced input notification and immediate Enter notification; with autoEmitChange=false, blur or Enter notifies | `(value: Record<string, unknown>, field: string) => void` |

Events are notifications only; listener Promises are not collected and do not drive loading state.

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| actions | Actions such as search/reset beside expand/collapse; no scoped arguments; available with collapsible=false |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Instance Properties

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| formRef | `FormInstance \| undefined` | Inner Form instance after mounting; supports Form methods such as validate, clearValidate and resetFields |

`formRef` is an instance property. Calling the inner Form `resetFields` restores its recorded initial values locally without emitting FilterForm `update:modelValue` or `change`. To reset the complete filter, replace the bound business model; for example:

```ts
const makeInitialModel = () => ({ keyword: '', createdAt: new Date() })
const model = ref(makeInitialModel())
const resetFilters = () => { model.value = makeInitialModel() }
```

Use search/reset buttons with `type="button"` in `actions` and manage the model and queries in business handlers. The container exposes no additional reset/search methods or task execution entry point.

## Types

### FilterFormField

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| component | Vue component or a key in `fieldMap` | `string \| Component` | - |
| field | Form field path | string | - |
| label | Label | string | - |
| visible | Whether to render | boolean | `true` |
| autoEmitChange | Whether input emits change while editing | boolean | `true` |
| props | Props forwarded to the field component | object | - |
| gridItemProps | GridItem props | object | - |
| formItemProps | FormItem props | object | - |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| component | Field component | Component | - |
| defaultProps | Default props | object | - |

Field properties merge in order: registration `defaultProps`, `field` `props`, then the container-owned `modelValue`, with later values taking precedence. `gridItemProps` passes through to GridItem. `formItemProps` can override the FormItem `field` and `label`, but does not change the schema `field` path used for model writes. `grid-props` can also override Grid settings such as `cols` and `collapsed`; avoid conflicting container state.

```ts
import type {
  FilterFormProps,
  FilterFormInstance,
  FilterFormEmits,
  FilterFormSlots,
  FilterFormExpose,
  FilterFormField,
  FilterFormFieldMap,
  FilterFormFieldRegistration,
} from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

Grid column spacing is controlled by `grid-props.colGap` in numeric px. There is no same-name CSS override, ensuring numerical Grid measurements match actual spacing.

Changing changeDebounce reschedules the pending snapshot using the new delay; zero notifies immediately. Enter cancels the pending task before notifying the current value. External reset or a different model replacement cancels stale snapshots, while accepting the same update:modelValue proposal does not cancel change. KeepAlive deactivation and unmount cancel pending notifications; reactivation accepts new input.

Filter models use the existing Form data-snapshot policy. Date values, plain objects and arrays are copied independently; Map, Set, BigInt and cyclic references retain their data kinds instead of converting dates to strings or collections to empty objects. Mutating a plain-object or Date event snapshot does not alter the parent model or later internal snapshots. Identity semantics such as Map keys follow the existing Form policy. Functions, DOM nodes, WeakMap/WeakSet, Promises and instances with private state are outside the deeply isolated filter-data contract.

field supports the same dot and bracket paths as FormItem. Writes create missing object containers and preserve sibling fields. Prebuild array containers in default-value or model-value when an array is required. Existing intermediate values must be objects or arrays; input does not replace incompatible scalar structures. Existing local-mirror, debounce and accepted-echo behavior for model updates and change notifications is preserved.

## CSS Variables


Consumption verified on 2026-10-16: real Less compilation and mounted DOM confirm these 13 variables feed the container, FormItem, action-area and collapse-button rules. The static style entry also imports Form styles. Multi-column action `padding-top` consumes action-offset; stacked single-column mode overrides it to `0`. Root derived aliases do not necessarily recompute after locally overriding Form dependencies; adjust alignment by overriding `--c-filter-form-action-offset` on the actual FilterForm root.

# FilterForm

列表页筛选项。FilterForm **不内置**输入组件，通过 `fields[].component` 直接传入组件（也可使用可选的 `field-map` 注册表），避免无用依赖进包。

持久化（记住筛选）由业务侧自行处理：组件只通过 `v-model` 同步值，不读写 storage。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

在 `fields` 中直接传入组件并配置字段。宽屏会自动多列展示，超出时可展开/收起。

筛选容器使用主题表面色（亮色为白色、暗色随主题适配）、轻描边与20px内边距，不再使用输入控件的浅填充背景。操作区预留两列并与字段控件顶边对齐；单列时按可用列数收敛。单列/双列折叠默认保留一行字段和独立操作行，避免只剩按钮。展开/收起为原生按钮，支持Tab聚焦、Enter/空格操作并提供aria-expanded。行间距默认16px，可由grid-props.rowGap覆盖。

The filter uses the theme surface with a subtle border and 20px inset, rather than an input-fill background. Actions align with the fields and reserve two columns, clamped to the available column count. One- and two-column collapse retain a row of fields above the actions by default. Expand/collapse is a native keyboard-accessible button with aria-expanded. The default 16px row gap can be overridden through grid-props.rowGap.

<demo src="./__demos__/basic.vue"></demo>

```ts
import { Input, Select, type FilterFormField } from '@cedar-design/ui'

const fields: FilterFormField[] = [
  { field: 'keyword', label: '关键词', component: Input },
  {
    field: 'status',
    label: '状态',
    component: Select,
    props: { options: [{ label: '启用', value: 'enabled' }] },
  },
]
```

所有字段组件统一使用 `modelValue` / `update:modelValue` 同步值。自定义组件也应遵循该协议；其他协议可通过包装组件适配。值同步与 FilterForm 的防抖 `change` 通知独立，`autoEmitChange: false` 时值仍会即时同步。

## API

### 主值与默认值

使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示筛选字段对象；`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控值，后续修改不会重置当前状态。显式绑定值优先，初始化不发出 `update:modelValue`。

输入后先更新内部镜像，再通知父级。父级未接收更新时，界面仍保留本次输入；后续不同的外部模型会替换镜像。`collapsed` 同样先更新内部折叠状态再通知父级，并接受后续外部变化。需要业务拒绝输入时，应显式回写新的模型对象。

### FilterForm Props

| 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value **(v-model)** | 表单值；未传入时使用 default-value | `Record<string, unknown>` | `undefined` |
| default-value | 仅创建时读取的初始值 | `Record<string, unknown>` | `{}` |
| fields | 筛选项 schema | `FilterFormField[]` | `[]` |
| field-map | 可选字段组件注册表 | `FilterFormFieldMap` | `{}` |
| rules | 透传 Form 校验规则 | object | - |
| collapsed **(v-model)** | 是否折叠多余项 | boolean | `true` |
| collapsible | 是否启用展开/收起 | boolean | `true` |
| cols | 响应式列数 | number \| object | `{ xs:1, sm:2, md:3, lg:3, xl:4, xxl:5 }` |
| grid-props | 透传 Grid 属性，优先于容器给出的同名配置 | `Record<string, unknown>` | - |
| change-debounce | change 防抖毫秒；0 立即通知，非有限数或负数回退 500 | number | `500` |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Events

| 事件名 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | 输入时即时同步值快照 | `(value: Record<string, unknown>) => void` |
| update:collapsed | 本地展开/收起通知 | `(collapsed: boolean) => void` |
| change | 输入防抖、回车即时通知；autoEmitChange=false 时由失焦或回车通知 | `(value: Record<string, unknown>, field: string) => void` |

事件仅作通知，不收集 Promise，也不驱动加载状态。

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Slots

| 插槽名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| actions | 操作区（搜索 / 重置等），与展开收起同一行；没有作用域参数；collapsible=false 时仍可使用 |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Instance Properties

| 属性 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| formRef | `FormInstance \| undefined` | 挂载后的内部 Form 实例，可调用 validate、clearValidate、resetFields 等 Form 方法 |

`formRef` 是实例属性，不是方法。内部 Form 的 `resetFields` 恢复它记录的初始值，只影响内部模型，不发出 FilterForm 的 `update:modelValue` 或 `change`。整体重置筛选条件时，业务应替换绑定模型；例如：

```ts
const makeInitialModel = () => ({ keyword: '', createdAt: new Date() })
const model = ref(makeInitialModel())
const resetFilters = () => { model.value = makeInitialModel() }
```

field 支持与 FormItem 一致的点号及方括号路径。写入时自动创建缺失的中间对象，保留已有兄弟字段；需要数组型中间容器时，在 default-value 或 model-value 中预建数组。已有中间值须为对象或数组，不用输入操作覆盖不匹配的标量结构。模型同步及 change 的本地镜像、防抖和回传确认语义保持原有合同。

后可继续修改字段并发起新校验。示例关闭自动触发，只通过按钮发起，手动返回本地结果以比较新旧顺序。先校验 guest，再校验 admin，先返回最新结果再返回最早结果；旧错误不应覆盖最新字段状态。结果文案由示例的请求序号保护，“本次校验值”是校验快照，不是服务端提交。 # Grid

CSS Grid columns, spans, gaps, collapse and suffix items. Use Row / Col for 24-column Flex layouts.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.

### GridItem Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

The default slot receives `{ overflow: boolean }`, indicating whether the parent Grid hides ordinary items due to collapse. Every GridItem, including suffix items, reads this shared state; it does not describe that item’s own overflow. It is false when expanded. SSR and the initial pre-mount render show every item; collapse is computed after mounting, which can change the initial layout. Offset reserves space from the logical inline start and mirrors in RTL. Span counts content tracks, while offset is included separately in the track budget. There are no custom events or public methods.

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Breakpoints use the browser viewport: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Configured values resolve downward from the largest matching breakpoint. SSR starts with xs and responds to the viewport after mounting. Grid collapsing and dynamic ordering are calculated after mounting. These layout containers add no keyboard shortcuts; callers supply content semantics and focusable elements. There are no public methods or dedicated theme tokens.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Import the independent Row and Col components from the library root or their row/col subpaths; installing Grid does not register them. The old Grid.Row/Grid.Col, GridRowInstance and GridColInstance exports are no longer available.

## Numeric values and collapse budgeting

Numeric inputs must be finite. Existing finite-value rules remain: cols is rounded down with a minimum of 1; collapsed-rows has a minimum of 1; negative gaps and offsets become zero; nonpositive spans are hidden. Non-finite or malformed inputs fall back to the property default: cols=24, collapsed-rows=1, span=1, and gaps/offset=0. Responsive objects accept only the six breakpoints and retain valid fields; undefined is omitted. Development diagnostics use standard Vue prop validation.

Collapse budgeting follows actual DOM order. Suffix items may appear first, in the middle or last; budgeting never moves content nodes. A suffix occupies the logical end of its row, so later ordinary items may wrap. Ordinary items retain the fitting continuous prefix, while every suffix remains visible. If suffix items alone exceed the row budget, keeping them visible takes precedence over limiting total rows. Layout does not change DOM, keyboard or assistive technology reading order.
