The default slot receives `{ overflow: boolean }`, indicating whether the parent Grid hides ordinary items due to collapse. Every GridItem, including suffix items, reads this shared state; it does not describe that item’s own overflow. It is false when expanded. SSR and the initial pre-mount render show every item; collapse is computed after mounting, which can change the initial layout. Offset reserves space from the logical inline start and mirrors in RTL. Span counts content tracks, while offset is included separately in the track budget. There are no custom events or public methods.

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Breakpoints use the browser viewport: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Configured values resolve downward from the largest matching breakpoint. SSR starts with xs and responds to the viewport after mounting. Grid collapsing and dynamic ordering are calculated after mounting. These layout containers add no keyboard shortcuts; callers supply content semantics and focusable elements. There are no public methods or dedicated theme tokens.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Import the independent Row and Col components from the library root or their row/col subpaths; installing Grid does not register them. The old Grid.Row/Grid.Col, GridRowInstance and GridColInstance exports are no longer available.

## Numeric values and collapse budgeting

Numeric inputs must be finite. Existing finite-value rules remain: cols is rounded down with a minimum of 1; collapsed-rows has a minimum of 1; negative gaps and offsets become zero; nonpositive spans are hidden. Non-finite or malformed inputs fall back to the property default: cols=24, collapsed-rows=1, span=1, and gaps/offset=0. Responsive objects accept only the six breakpoints and retain valid fields; undefined is omitted. Development diagnostics use standard Vue prop validation.

Collapse budgeting follows actual DOM order. Suffix items may appear first, in the middle or last; budgeting never moves content nodes. A suffix occupies the logical end of its row, so later ordinary items may wrap. Ordinary items retain the fitting continuous prefix, while every suffix remains visible. If suffix items alone exceed the row budget, keeping them visible takes precedence over limiting total rows. Layout does not change DOM, keyboard or assistive technology reading order.

## Content and presentation

### Loading Directive

The two directive examples keep independent loading states. Their controls and host cards are stacked using Space's `direction="column"`; turning one off leaves the other overlay unchanged.


`v-mp-loading` accepts a boolean shorthand or a `{ loading, tip, type, size, radius, color, hideIcon, fullscreen, background }` options object. In object form, `loading` controls the loading state and the remaining component options match `Loading` props.

#### Registration

`v-mp-loading` renders its indicator with Maple's built-in `Loading` component. The `mp-` prefix avoids collisions with directives from other component libraries. Register it using any one of these approaches.


With `MapleResolver()`, `unplugin-vue-components` resolves `v-mp-loading` automatically. Set `directives: false` to disable directive resolution.

> Wrapper mode applies `opacity: 0.38` to its default-slot content. Because the directive preserves the host DOM, it inserts the built-in Loading VNode and uses an equivalent translucent background overlay instead.

```demo

```

## Usage notes

### Custom icon sizing and status semantics

A numeric `size` sets the custom indicator container's font `size` in pixels. Named sizes control built-in animations. Custom icons inherit the `--mp-loading-indicator-size` font `size` (20px by default): `1em` children scale with it, while SVGs with fixed pixel dimensions keep their own `size`. Use the `icon` slot for graphics and `tip` or its slot for status text.

Standalone Loading has `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. Without a tip it includes localized visually hidden status text, even when the icon is hidden. Wrapper mode retains `aria-busy`. The directive sets `aria-busy="true"` on the original host and restores its previous value on cleanup, preserving a later external change.

Assistive technology may defer announcements within a busy region. For business start, completion or failure messages, maintain a persistent status region outside the busy region and update its text. The overlay does not disable keyboard interaction. See [WAI-ARIA `aria-busy`](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#`aria-busy`) and [ARIA22 status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22).
### Configuration

The loading-directive mask prevents default click behavior and propagation. Clicking it does not activate Card or ordinary parent click handlers. Normal clicking resumes after loading. It does not disable keyboard access to underlying controls; set those controls’ `disabled` props to block all interaction.

### Overlay styles

Each directive update replaces the complete configuration; omitted options and boolean `true` use defaults. Changing `fullscreen` while loading moves the overlay between the host and its owner document body. Host children stay in place. Multiple `fullscreen` instances share a counted scroll lock: closing a local instance does not unlock `fullscreen` instances, and the final `fullscreen` instance preserves an existing external lock class.

### 自定义图标尺寸与状态语义

数字 `size` 为自定义指示器容器设置像素字号。枚举尺寸控制内置动画；自定义图标默认继承 `--mp-loading-indicator-size`（20px）字号，使用 `1em` 的子图标随字号缩放，固定像素尺寸的 SVG 仍由自身样式决定。`icon` 插槽负责图形，状态文案使用 `tip` 或 `tip` 插槽。

### Cross-platform contract

When using the content slot, the custom panel takes its accessible name from the entry. Set aria-label or aria-labelledby on the entry when needed. Ensure custom entries have a meaningful name.

Both libraries create panel content on first open and retain it when closed or switched, including local drafts and expanded branches. With `unmount-on-close`, content is destroyed after the closing transition and recreated on the next open; the Item's own selected value remains intact. Applications own draft submission, resets and filter application.

Root `close()` requests closing Item panels and restores entry focus without changing selected values, active-item or desktop tree expanded-keys. Controlled open values remain authoritative when closure is rejected. Entries with neither options nor a content slot never open; asynchronous options follow the current open state when they arrive. KeepAlive suspension hides panels and requests closure; controlled state remains authoritative on activation.

Item values, open state, events, slot contexts and `select/close/setOpen` methods share the same contract. Both roots expose `close/resize/setActiveItem`. Names must be unique within the menu; changing a name releases the previous one. Batched swaps and insertions validate the final rendered names. Vertical options expand enabled ancestors of the selected value on initialization and value/options updates. Users can still collapse branches manually.

| Capability | Cedar | Maple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Root menu | options tree or Item entries; vertical by default | Item filter bar only; horizontal by default |
| popup-layout | dropdown (default) / full-width / full-height / full | full-width (default) / full |
| Panel origin | Individual entry bottom | Entire filter bar bottom; standalone Item uses its own bottom |
| Trigger and placement | trigger / placement | Click to open downward |
| Backdrop and scrolling | Non-modal; background scroll remains available | Root overlay / overlay-closable / lock-scroll / esc-to-close / z-index |
| Theme | theme override | Global theme; no theme prop |
| Tree-only methods | showOption / scrollTo / setCollapsed | — |

Each library exports `NavMenuPopupLayout` with its supported values. Maple's `NavMenuMode` is horizontal only; `options-mode` supports both orientations. The default entry slot replaces the entry's inner content. Maple renders it inside a native button: use non-interactive text/icons and place forms and action buttons in the content slot.

| popup-class | Additional panel class | — |

### NavMenuItem Props

| Prop | Description | Default |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| name | Unique root-level business activation key; omitted entries highlight their selections independently | — |
| label | Entry title when no option matches | — |
| options / field-names | Cedar-compatible options and field mapping | [] / — |
| model-value / default-value | Controlled / initial selected key; supports strings, numbers and null | undefined / null |
| open / default-open | Controlled / initial open state | undefined / false |
| highlight | Visual highlight override; follows business active state when omitted | undefined |
| disabled | Disable the entry, also respecting the parent menu | undefined |
| hide-on-select | Close the panel after select | true |
| unmount-on-close | Destroy panel content after the closing transition; retain it by default | false |
| popup-layout | full-width spans the viewport width with content-driven height; full fills the visible area below the filter bar in both dimensions. Both open below the entire filter bar without automatic flipping; width does not depend on the entry | full-width |

A standalone NavMenuItem uses its own bottom edge as the panel origin. Triggering is fixed to click; overflowing entries scroll horizontally. Mobile does not expose placement/trigger, dropdown, or side full-height layouts.

Events: update:model-value, update:open, select(key, option, event), click(event). Methods: select(key, event?), close(), setOpen(open).

Slots: default (entry contents), label, icon, content (replaces the default options panel), option-label, option-icon and option-extra. Entry/content slots receive `{ modelValue, selectedOption, active, open, select, close }`; option slots receive `{ option, active, expanded, level }`.

## Types

NavMenuKey is string | number. NavMenuOption uses key, label, icon, extra, children, disabled, show and props, with type item/group/divider. label/icon/extra accept VNodes or context render functions. Numeric 0 and empty strings are valid keys; missing or duplicate item keys throw. Disabled state is inherited by descendants; hidden items and their subtrees are omitted. All types are exported from @maple-design/ui.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

NavMenu inherits the nearest native `dir`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Left/Right moves navigation focus in reading direction; Home/End focuses available boundary entries. Down opens the option panel; Escape closes and returns trigger focus. Horizontal panel keys follow direction while Up/Down keeps existing order. Teleported panels inherit trigger direction. Direction changes do not clear filters or selections.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Page numbers and previous/next meanings remain unchanged; default navigation icons follow reading direction. Page entry, disabled boundaries and selection do not change. Business code controls direction for custom icon slots.

## Triggers and positioning

### Popup placement

No placement configuration is required for normal use: bottom-start is preferred and the underlying Trigger automatically flips/constrains the popup. pageSizeProps.placement is only a restricted override for the page-size Select: Pagination → Select.triggerProps.placement → Trigger. It does not position the pagination itself.

## API

Use ordinary `v-model`: `modelValue` is the current page, starting at 1; pageSize independently controls items per page. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets or initialization `update:modelValue`. When `modelValue` is supplied, the parent value controls the display.

## Behavior

Containers at or below `compact-breakpoint` automatically use compact mode, consistently in desktop sidebars and mobile. Totals/page-size selectors remain; auxiliary controls wrap. Previous/next sizes follow size without forced narrow-screen enlargement (formerly 36px). `responsive=false` retains full page numbers; extremely narrow page lists scroll internally without widening the page.

The compact current-page input also serves as the jumper, so no duplicate jumper appears. `page-item`, `page-item-ellipsis`, `jumper-prepend` and `jumper-append` render only in their full-mode controls.

Page buttons support Tab/Enter/Space, with `aria-current=page` on the current page. The jumper requests a numeric keyboard and submits on Enter/blur. Empty, nonnumeric or fractional values do not navigate; out-of-range integers clamp to valid pages. Disabled blocks all commits.

`auto-adjust` tries to preserve the previous page's first item when page size changes, clamps to the last page after total reductions and returns to page 1 for zero items. Controlled mode proposes updates only; the parent decides the display. An explicit parent modelValue in the same update batch takes precedence.

Both full and compact jumper inputs show the current page. Navigation, external modelValue changes and page-size adjustments update them together. Invalid input restores the current page number.

### PaginationPageSizeProps

Page-size selectors fit selected text/arrow with only item spacing, updating on option/locale changes. `--mp-pagination-select-width` overrides width. Popup menus size independently from option contents.

Both platforms support `disabled?: boolean`, `placement?: 'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end'`, `popupContainer?: string | HTMLElement | false`, `class?: string` and `style?: CSSProperties`. Outer disabled takes precedence. Default placement is bottom-start.

This configuration no longer forwards arbitrary SelectProps/MenuProps. page-size, page-size-options and size control the pagination value, options and dimensions.

## 使用说明

### 焦点管理

内置 fade、center 缩放与四方向 pop 和内容／遮罩基础过渡消费 duration／timing-function 两项 Token，默认仍为 250ms／ease。要整层统一覆写，设置在 Teleport 后实际共同祖先或 popup-container 宿主；style 仅覆盖内容，overlay-style 仅覆盖遮罩。使用有效、非负 CSS 时间。prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 优先关闭内置过渡及起始位移／缩放；自定义动画由业务适配。

unmount-on-close=true 时关闭途中保留内容，完成回调后卸载；关闭前锁不会提前释放。快速重开取消关闭并保留插槽状态。opened／closed 每个有效阶段只发一次，销毁后不再补发；没有固定 250ms JS 定时器。初始打开仍沿用 mounted 通知，不承诺完整 appear 计时；自定义转场或内容与外层时长不同需要业务自行协调。

打开时焦点进入实际 dialog 面板，Tab/Shift+Tab 在可用控件间循环，跳过隐藏和禁用项。嵌套弹层由最上层接管；关闭后回到打开它的控件。应用必须保留触发器节点；内部焦点根标记不应由业务覆盖。

### Landscape safe areas

`safe-area-inset-left` / `safe-area-inset-right` (boolean, default false) complement the existing top/bottom flags. Native overrides and nested consumption follow [SafeArea](#/zh-CN/safe-area).

### 从头部下拉关闭

底部弹层设置 `swipe-to-close`，在可拖动标题区域添加 `data-popup-swipe-handle`。默认关闭；其他 placement 不触发。`swipe-threshold` 默认 40，单位为布局 CSS px（父级缩放时也保持一致）。手势结束前最后的移动方向为向下，且位移达到阈值才请求 `update:open(false)` 并发出 `swipe-close(PointerEvent)`。位移不足、横向手势、pointercancel、按钮/输入框和正文滚动不会关闭；受控父级拒绝时弹层保留并回到原位。已有 Esc、遮罩、关闭按钮继续可用。

阈值按垂直方向的缩放换算，支持水平和垂直比例不同的缩放；不承诺旋转或倾斜变换的手势换算。

```html
<mp-popup v-model:open="open" placement="bottom" swipe-to-close>
  <header data-popup-swipe-handle>编辑信息</header>
  <main>弹层内容</main>
</mp-popup>
```

Maple 字段编辑弹层默认从标题空白处下拉取消草稿；异步确认 pending 时禁用手势。ActionSheet 可以显式设置 swipe-to-close / swipe-threshold，默认标题已标记；自定义 title 插槽需自行标记拖动区域。
# 异步关闭拦截


关闭原因包括 `overlay`、`escape`、`route`、`swipe`、`close`、`api`、`model`。默认插槽提供 `{ close, pending }`，关闭按钮应调用 `close('close', event)`；实例 `close()` 使用 `api`，`requestClose(reason, event)` 可指定原因并返回 `Promise<boolean>`。外部将 `open` 设为 `false` 使用 `model`，拒绝后会发送 `update:open(true)`，受控父组件应正常接收该事件。只有启用对应关闭能力的入口会发起请求。

动态添加、更换或移除 `before-close` 不会改变当前开关状态；受控模式仍由父组件更新 `open`。

直接销毁组件、移除 `v-if` 或销毁路由页面不属于关闭请求，无法等待组件内的异步拦截；在父级执行这些操作前等待 `requestClose()` 的结果。业务表单确认继续使用 `beforeCommit`，不要用关闭 guard 替代数据校验。主题页完整表单提供延迟允许、拒绝、报错与各关闭入口的验证弹层。

Popup 的 close()/requestClose() 和外部 open=false 会经过守卫；两端 Dialog 与 Cedar Drawer 的实例或服务 close() 是直接关闭命令，职责不同。Popup 关闭前需要确认时等待 `Promise<boolean>`，不要依赖同名方法推断行为。

| 事件 | 参数 | 说明 |

| 插槽 | 参数 | 说明 |

### Popup Methods

| 方法 | 参数与返回值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `(event?: Event) => Promise<boolean>` | 以 `api` 原因请求关闭 |
| `requestClose` | `(reason?: PopupCloseReason, event?: Event) => Promise<boolean>` | 按指定原因请求关闭 |

## 关闭守卫



只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。

Popup 原因为 overlay、escape、route、swipe、close、api、model。拒绝外部 open=false 时请求 update:open(true)。直接销毁组件不能等待内部钩子，应先 await requestClose()。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

### 异步操作反馈

before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

## CSS Variables

遮罩变量只压暗背景层；内容背景／文字组成 raised 表面的配色对，暗色主题继承同一语义。`unstyled` 同时关闭默认背景和文字颜色。可通过 style 在内容节点设置内容变量，通过 overlay-style 设置遮罩变量；或在实际共同祖先设置 system 变量。Teleport 不会从原调用位置继承变量。Dialog 使用独立的遮罩变量，不受 Popup 组件变量影响。

## 使用说明

# Row

24-column Flex layout. Row manages gutters and alignment; Col manages spans, offsets, ordering and breakpoints. Use Grid for CSS Grid collapse and suffix items.

> **Choosing a layout**
>
> - Grid + GridItem: Use for form columns and card grids with consistent column widths, spans, responsive column counts, or collapsed rows and suffix items.
> - Row + Col: Use for 24-column Flex layouts that need horizontal/vertical alignment, wrapping control, fixed and flexible widths together, or responsive ordering. Row controls the row; Col controls width, offset and order.
> - Space: Use for simple groups of buttons, tags or text that only need spacing, direction and alignment. Use native Flex for more flexible width allocation.

## Responsiveness and accessibility

Row resolves responsive gutter with JavaScript matchMedia, using xs for SSR and synchronizing the viewport after mounting. Col uses CSS media queries: SSR already emits all configured classes without waiting for measurement. Breakpoints use viewport width: xs is the base; sm ≥576, md ≥768, lg ≥992, xl ≥1200 and xxl ≥1600px. Only configured fields override earlier values. Offset starts at the logical inline edge and mirrors in RTL. Order affects visual positioning while preserving DOM, keyboard and assistive technology reading order.

Span, offset and their breakpoint fields accept integers from 0 through 24. A zero span hides the column; offset 24 shifts it by a full row width. Order accepts finite integers, including negative values and values above 24, subject to browser CSS order computation. Gutter accepts finite nonnegative numbers, six-breakpoint objects or exactly two entries [horizontal, vertical]. Development diagnostics report unknown breakpoints, invalid numbers and enum values. Invalid span falls back to 24; invalid offset/order is ignored; breakpoint objects retain valid fields; invalid gutter components fall back to zero.

## Imports

Grid contains only Grid.Item. Import the independent Row and Col components from the library root or their row/col subpaths; installing Grid does not register them. The old Grid.Row/Grid.Col, GridRowInstance and GridColInstance exports are no longer available.

### Thumb drag lifecycle

Each primary-button start owns a session: generation, track/thumb nodes, immutable axis/start and thumb.ownerDocument.defaultView. Register mousemove/mouseup/contextmenu/blur on that original window. Release the full set and dragging/mouseOffset on normal end, context cancellation, blur, effective geometry/direction change, deactivation or disposal. This repairs leaked contextmenu, missing suspension/disposal cleanup and global-window iframe binding. Old move cannot drive a new gesture; old end cannot release one. Activation allows only fresh starts.

Changing direction/max/thumbSize/ratio cancels the gesture; replacing data with equal primitive geometry does not. Parent measurement/setOffset still settles final position. Recheck ownership after geometry/reactive writes to reject reentrant disposal. Inactive/disposed retained start/track/setOffset are inert without preventDefault; nonprimary clicks do not drag/page. Active setOffset clamping, drag-time suppression and one-thumb track paging remain. No Pointer/touch protocol migration or rollback of native scrolling.

## Usage notes

### Editing mode
Presentation containers use internal `src/_components/field-presentation/token.less` with system surfaces/spacing/dimensions. Option lists retain existing Select tokens.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Search fields
`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

### Configuration

Single/multiple options both use popup-option-padding-horizontal. There is no implicit search-highlight DOM; custom option slots style their own highlighted fragments.

### Select Events / Methods

- `update:modelValue`, `change(value)`: emitted on commit, not while editing a draft.
- `update:open`, `open-change(open)`: request an expanded-state change.
- `update:inputValue`, `input-value-change(text)`, `search(text)`: search state.
- `focus(event)`, `blur(event)`, `clear(event)`: native field events; only the field owner notifies Form.
- Methods: `focus()`, `blur()`.

Select also emits `remove(value)`, `exceed-limit(value, event)`, `dropdown-scroll(event)`, and `dropdown-reach-bottom(event)`.

### Slots and option data

Use `label({ data })` for custom `selected` labels; `selected` replaces the whole selection area. Also supports `prefix`, `suffix`, `clear-icon({ clear })`, `arrow-icon`, `loading-icon`, `search-icon`, `empty`, and `option({ data })`.

Option `label` is searchable plain text. Use `render` or the `option` slot for custom `option` content, and `format-label` or `label` slot for selected content. Values identify selections; labels never do. `disabled` blocks selection/removal, and `tagProps` customizes selected tags.

Select additionally supports `header`, `footer`, `trigger`, and default `Option / Optgroup` children. Option props: `value`, `label`, `disabled`, `tagProps`, `index`; its default slot receives `selected`. Group data uses `{ isGroup: true, label, options }`. List and Picker also accept slot options; Picker displays their text labels.

Async search should clear old candidates when requests start and accept only the latest current-query response. Combine remote results with `loading`, `:filter-option="false"` and `show-extra-options="false"` to avoid treating ID display fallbacks as search results. Popup arrows/Enter operate current candidates only; bottom confirmation saves. Failed validation preserves drafts. Pending confirmation locks editing/closing; reset closes Popup and aborts submission. Closing/reset invalidates request ownership. See Form's unified field-presentation examples.

## Types

### Type imports
Root and component entries export `SelectEmits`、`SelectSlots`、`SelectExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

filterable enables entering a search query. filterOption controls only local matching and never sends requests. With an options loader, remote results are not filtered again by default; with only an array, local matching is enabled by default. Most callers do not need filter-option.

```vue
<mp-select v-model="value" :options="loadOptions" filterable />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

In direct mode, focus() targets the native input. In closed deferred mode it focuses the reference without opening; when open it targets the current editor. blur() blurs the current input or editor without reopening or simulating selection. Cached and remounted editors both resolve the current target.

Public SelectInstance/SelectExpose and PeopleSelectInstance/PeopleSelectExpose reflect the existing methods. PeopleSelectExpose is available from the root and component subentry. refresh() returns `Promise<void>` and reloads function-based options through the existing protocol; it does not represent completion of saving or business actions.

SelectEditMode is exported consistently from root and select subentries, retaining each platform public edit-mode values.

### Selection actions during loading

While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching.

Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing.

Option.extra has been removed; pass business data through object values or the original options data.

Multiple empty-value supports arrays, null/undefined and empty values recognized by empty-values; other scalars are rejected. Factories run only for a real clear with no disabled retained selections; invalid results produce a development diagnostic and fall back to [], without publishing an invalid scalar.

signal })，无需调用 useAsyncData。options 继续接收数组，显式数组（包括 []）优先。组件内部管理 loading、旧结果隔离与请求取消；load-error 通知失败，实例 refresh() 重试。业务函数可只接收 query，忽略第二参数。 filterable 表示允许输入搜索词。filterOption 只控制本地候选匹配，从不发请求。使用 options 加载函数时默认不再二次过滤远程结果；仅传数组时默认启用本地匹配。业务通常无需设置 filter-option。 ```vue ``` `empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。 守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。 focus() 在 direct 模式聚焦原生输入；延迟模式关闭时聚焦引用而不打开，打开后聚焦当前编辑器。blur() 使当前输入或编辑器失焦，不重新打开或模拟选择；缓存复用和重新挂载都查找当前目标。 公开实例类型 SelectInstance/SelectExpose 与 PeopleSelectInstance/PeopleSelectExpose 对齐既有方法；PeopleSelectExpose 可从根入口及组件子入口导入。refresh() 返回 `Promise`；选项为函数时按既有协议重读选项，不表示保存或业务动作完成。 SelectEditMode 在根入口和 select 子入口一致导出，值沿用各端 edit-mode 的公开枚举。 ### 加载期间的选择动作 手动 loading 或当前候选请求处于加载状态时，纯选择字段保留已有值，暂停新选择、清空与标签移除。被阻止的动作不发送业务通知，也不提交模型。字段搜索仍可输入，disabled/readonly 不因此改写；需要禁止搜索时单独设置。 延迟编辑层的清空和确认在此期间不可用，仍可取消或关闭。手动标记和当前请求都结束后，操作按正常规则恢复，并继续尊重禁用选项。Input、AutoComplete 等自由文本字段的 ### Time bounds

`min` / `max` are optional strings, with no bound by default. Use 24-hour `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`, independently of format/use12Hours. Both endpoints are inclusive; omitted seconds mean 00. Range endpoints are validated individually; showNextDay does not make the bounds wrap across midnight. Reversed bounds allow no commit; unparseable bounds are treated as unset.

Changing bounds does not rewrite the external model. Commits must satisfy bounds, steps and disabled callbacks. Hidden seconds are validated as 00. Coarse list columns are disabled when their whole hour/minute is out of bounds; confirmation validates the complete time. Use hide-disabled-options to hide disabled choices.

### Default and controlled values

`defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled fields/panels once; subsequent edits are retained locally. `modelValue` is authoritative when provided. `defaultOpen` initializes field visibility once. Controlled `open` requires the parent to accept `update:open`; `open-change(open: boolean)` reports requests. `clear` has no arguments. Panels support `disabled` for both range endpoints.

```demo

```

Use the acceptance switches to reject value or visibility requests independently. Rejected requests leave parent state unchanged; proposals are shown separately. Reopening restores the parent model. A close request does not imply parent acceptance.

When the parent rejects closing, repeated confirmation without a new selection does not commit again. A fresh time selection starts a new transaction that can be confirmed while the panel remains open.

### Selection and commit

Field `focus` and `blur` events have no arguments and fire once per transition. Moving between range endpoints stays within one field. Readonly fields remain focusable but cannot open for editing; disabling a focused field releases its focus state and notifies blur.

Fields and standalone panels revalidate the current format, steps and disabled rules at commit time. Cedar text input follows the same rules. Changing constraints does not rewrite committed values. Reversed ranges are accepted only when `show-next-day` is enabled; otherwise a red footer message is shown and confirmation is disabled. Endpoints are never swapped. Clearing commits `undefined` regardless of candidate restrictions, but still respects readonly/disabled state.

`select(value, date)` reports user draft selection; `change(value, date)` reports a committed value. Both single and range fields clear to `undefined`, with an undefined date argument and a no-argument `clear` event. Date arguments represent local clock times (not next-day calendar arithmetic). Fields default to explicit confirmation; `disable-confirm` commits a valid choice immediately and requests close. Range confirmation rejects reversed endpoints unless `show-next-day` is enabled. Controlled `open` still requires parent acceptance. Standalone panels also default to confirmation; disable-confirm commits immediately without closing the panel.

### Shared field loading

`loading` displays the shared field indicator. `loading-mode` is `default` (indicator) or `line` (an indeterminate bottom line); it defaults to `default`. Rendering belongs to FieldDecorator. Loading does not implicitly disable editing or change readonly. Set those states separately.

## Reading direction

Range values stay `[start, end]`. LTR/RTL changes affect layout without swapping endpoints or changing cross-day meaning. Time columns and start/end panels follow reading order. Left/Right moves focus visually, including across endpoints. Cedar Up/Down moves focus and Enter/Space selects; Maple Up/Down retains wheel selection semantics. Existing draft/confirmation configuration is preserved, and popovers inherit source field direction.

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `popup` and opens an editor when the value area is clicked. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

Inline date/time fields retain existing confirmation policies. In popover/popup, pure panels hide confirmation tools and the editor provides one confirm/cancel pair. Standalone DatePicker/DateRangePicker/TimePicker/TimeRangePicker retain panel APIs/confirmation without inheriting Form field presentation.

Mobile date fields use `panel-type` to select calendar/wheel content; `edit-mode` controls only field editing. Standalone panel content follows each panel API and is not controlled by the field `edit-mode`.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Panel actions

Headers follow hour/minute/second format and align with both wheel groups; 12-hour mode adds AM/PM. No top summary or visible endpoint labels appear. Left edits start, right edits end; cross-day status appears below the right group.

Shared style variables:


Range panels provide Now by default. Start is initially current; using the right wheel makes end current. Now changes only that endpoint's draft. Even with `disable-confirm`, Now/subsequent edits require confirmation; cancel discards them. Format/step/disabling rules apply, and next-day/order checks update immediately. Fields, independent panels and popups behave alike; top-level `:show-now-button="false"` hides it. Custom `actions` can use `selectNow()`/`nowDisabled`.

### Forwarded configuration boundaries

The time field manages open/defaultOpen, disabled, trigger, closeOnClickReference, preventFocus and visibility updates. An explicit top-level popup-container takes precedence over nested configuration; popupClass is merged. Inline presentation fixes popupOffset=4, and Maple also fixes unmountOnClose=true, so those nested fields may not control the final values.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

`popup-props` configures the anchored Trigger popover on both platforms. It cannot replace field open/disabled/trigger ownership. Top-level popup-container, including false, takes precedence. Panel and popup options are separate. `click(event)` fires once for an enabled field; readonly fields notify but do not open. Use `open-change(false)` for close requests, not proof that a controlled state changed. 

`suffix-icon` receives `focus: boolean` and `popupOpen: boolean`, replacing arrow-icon. `focus(index = 0)` focuses start (0) or end (1) without committing; `blur()` removes focus and requests closing.

Range `placeholder` accepts `string | string[]`: a string labels both endpoints; array entries label each endpoint, with missing entries empty. Explicit empty strings do not fall back to defaults.

### Pure-panel event and slot boundaries

`TimePicker`/`TimeRangePicker` do not manage fields/popups. Pass `open`, `size`, `variant`, clearing and popup configuration to `Time`/`TimeRange`.

- `select(value, date)`: edit the draft.
- `change(value, date)`: valid confirmation with a changed value; updates the model.
- `confirm(value, date)`: every valid confirmation, including unchanged values. `disableConfirm` also emits it on valid selection commits. Disabled, readonly or invalid drafts do not emit it.
- `extra`: additional explanatory content.
- `actions({ confirm, canConfirm, value })`: replace default tools. `value` is the draft; call `confirm()` to commit and disable buttons according to `canConfirm`.

Single-time events carry formatted strings and Date objects; range events carry corresponding arrays. Pure panels no longer emit `open-change`, `update:open` or `clear`.

Panels edit a draft and commit on confirmation. Cancellation or closing does not commit, while clearing commits an empty value and closes immediately. Mobile time fields do not open the software keyboard. See the combined field examples in the Date documentation.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

During deferred editing, clearing retains the configured valid empty-value and confirmation submits that empty value; null is not replaced by midnight. A newly created empty wheel panel may initialize a visible candidate without selecting or committing a model. Later explicit empty drafts in that panel are not automatically refilled. Reopening and cancelling does not publish another value.

### Field notifications and public types

Field update:modelValue/change use TimeModelValue (TimeRangeModelValue for ranges). Normal selections commit formatted strings; explicit clears retain configured null, timestamps, Date objects or range arrays accepted by the property. Auxiliary dates may be undefined; clearing a range to an empty array also yields an empty auxiliary array. Clear does not emit select. Select remains a formatted user draft, which may be incomplete for a range.

Import each from the root or its component entry. Instances include the public Expose contract.

Field read receives { value, text } with a nullable model; suffix-icon receives { focus, popupOpen }; clear-icon receives a guarded clear(event?). Range fields also support separator. Cedar direct mode supports a default custom trigger, while Maple does not. Neither platform currently forwards field loading-icon, so types do not promise it. actions/extra operate on panel drafts: Cedar forwards them in direct mode; Maple forwards them during deferred editing, not direct mode. Inner confirm is not the outer final-save entry.

### Explicit save guard

beforeCommit(payload, done, context) belongs to field saving. payload contains value/previousValue; context has signal and optional event. Returning undefined waits for done, while boolean/Promise results settle by their result. FormItem validates candidates first; failure retains draft. Ordinary select/change/confirm/click listener returns do not use this task protocol.

`'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `-` | `content-placement` 表示正文所在的物理侧，旧版本在交替模式下实际显示在相反侧；升级时如需保持旧布局，请交换 left/right 或 top/bottom。根级 `mode` 的含义不变。 ### TimelineItem Slots | 插槽名 | 描述 | 参数 | 版本 | | ------ | :--------: | ---- | :----- | | default | 节点正文 | - | | | dot | 自定义节点 | - | | | label | 自定义标签 | - | 2.50.0 | ## Types 组件导出以下类型定义 ```ts import type { TimelineProps, TimelineItemProps, TimelineSlots, TimelineItemSlots, TimelineMode, TimelineLabelPosition, TimelineDotType, TimelineLineType, TimelineItemContentPlacement, TimelineInstance, TimelineItemInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui' ``` ## 阅读方向与键盘交互 Timeline 继承容器阅读方向，横向时间轴的节点和连接线随 LTR/RTL 排列。`reverse` 单独控制视觉倒序，切换阅读方向不会修改节点数据或自动切换 `reverse`。 纵向显式 `mode="left"` / `mode="right"` 及子项的物理侧别保持原意；`alternate` 继续在两侧交替。标签和自定义内容正常继承文字方向。 ## CSS Variables

Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy. ### Active Rendering - `options`: Supplies the available options. ### Option values Give each command a stable, unique `value` when adding, removing or reordering options. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` are different values. ## Triggers and positioning ### Context Menu #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | Root menu trigger | Context Menu, Trigger | | `options` | Command tree | Context Menu, Positioning | | `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | Context Menu | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. Clicking inside a submenu keeps its parent open. ### Popup placement Use `placement` to choose the preferred popup position relative to the trigger. See Menu Props for the available values. Automatic fitting can change the final position when space is limited. ## State and content customization ### Selection - `options`: Supplies the available options. ### Controlled Preview configuration: `v-model:open="open"`, `label="Option 1"`, `label="Option 2"`. ### Footer ## Reading direction Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Menus mounted externally inherit the source direction. Props are `label`, `value`, `disabled`, `ripple` and `highlight`; `option`, `childrenTrigger` and `uninjectContext` are for internal adapters. The `label` render function and `default`/`icon`/`suffix` slots receive `{ option, active, level }`. Clicking emits `click`. `highlight` controls visual emphasis without committing selection. Groups/submenus are described only through `options`; `MenuGroup` and `MenuSubmenu` are no longer exported. `MenuOption` emits `key-arrow-x` as a submenu navigation bridge. Its exposed `root`, `isFocusing`, `optionSelected`, `handleClick`, and `handleSelect` are internal adapter details. ### Instance methods and keyboard The instance exposes `open()`, `close()`, `resize()` and `setReference(reference?)`; `menu`, `panel`, and `computedOpen` are internal references. Enter, Space or arrow keys open the trigger and enter the menu. Enter, Space or the forward key enters a submenu; Escape closes one layer. Tab requests close and leaves focus navigation to the browser. Arrow keys outside the menu are not intercepted; editable inputs retain text editing keys. Root hover delays do not configure submenu delays. Classes, CSS variables and internal DOM markers consistently use `c-menu-*`, `--c-menu-*` and `data-menu-*`. ## CSS Variables ### Option state colors Use `--c-menu-option-bg-selected` for selected rows and `--c-menu-option-bg-selected-hover` for their hover background. Disabled colors take precedence over selected, hover and focus styles.

--- permalink: /components/menu/ --- # Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 Select；选择层级数据请使用 Cascader。 --- ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。菜单开启后会为触发元素添加 `c-menu-open` 类名。 ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 分组标题与选项左对齐，标题行高 20px、上下各 4px 留白（总高 28px）；后续分组额外间隔 8px，首组不添加组间距。 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，默认悬停展开；改成 `'click'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ### 选项值 动态增删或调整选项顺序时，为每个命令设置稳定且唯一的 `value`。数字 `0`、字符串 `'0'` 和布尔值 `false` 是不同的选项值。 ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ### 与 SplitButton 组合 SplitButton 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作，完整用法见 [SplitButton](/components/split-button/)。 ### 触发方式 ### 弹出方向 ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ### 高度限制 ### 切换触发元素 点击另一个由悬停打开的同级触发元素时，会关闭原菜单；点击子菜单内部不会关闭父菜单。 ### 弹层定位 使用 `placement` 设置菜单相对触发元素的首选方位，可选值见 Menu Props。空间不足时允许自动调整，最终位置可能与首选方位不同。 ## 状态与内容定制 ### 选中值与 select 事件 使用 `v-model` 管理当前激活值。激活命令时先触发 `update:modelValue`，再触发 `select(value, option, event)`；`select` 表示激活菜单项，不表示表单值变化。 ### 受控打开状态 ### 页脚 ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。子级沿阅读方向展开；进入子级与返回父级的左右键跟随当前方向，上下键与首尾定位保持顺序并跳过禁用项。挂载到外部容器的菜单继承来源方向，切换方向不改变选中值。 ## 尺寸与阴影 `size` 控制选项的行高与字号，`md` 保持默认主题；`elevation=true` 使用菜单默认阴影，`false` 取消阴影，数字使用对应的全局阴影层级。 ## API ### 主值与默认值 使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示选中选项的 value；`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控值，后续修改不会重置当前状态。显式绑定值优先，初始化不发出 `update:modelValue`。 ### Menu Props | 参数名 | 描述 | 类型 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | --- | :---: | | options | 命令树 | `MenuOptionData[]` | `[]` | | field-names | `label/value/children/disabled` 字段映射 | `MenuFieldNames` | `-` | | model-value **(v-model)** | 当前激活值，用于受控高亮 | `MenuValue` | `-` | | open **(v-model)** | 浮层是否可见 | `boolean` | `-` | | default-open | 非受控默认可见状态 | `boolean` | `false` | | trigger | 根菜单触发方式 | `'hover' \| 'click' \| 'focus' \| 'contextMenu'` 或数组 | `'click'` | | submenu-trigger | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | `'hover' \| 'click'` | `'hover'` | | placement | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | `MenuPlacement`

# Menu Collects transient commands for the current object, such as overflow actions, context menus and the extra actions of a button. Use [Select](#/en-US/select) to pick form data and [Cascader](#/en-US/cascader) to pick hierarchical data. The popup is built on the unstyled [Trigger](#/en-US/trigger). It uses the shared twelve placements and the separate `cover` mode, defaulting to `bottom`. Use `auto-fit-popup-width` and `popup-max-height` for width matching and height limits. ## Basic examples ### Overflow Actions Pass the trigger element through the default slot and describe commands with `options`. `type: 'divider'` renders a separator. ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## Appearance and states ### Disabled State `disabled` on the menu disables the whole popup; on an option it disables that option and its descendants. ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## Options and hierarchy ### Groups, submenus and option content #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | Command tree | Groups, submenus and option content, Selection and visual emphasis | | `hide-on-select` | Close the popup after activating a command | Selection and visual emphasis | | `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Selection and visual emphasis | Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.
Configuration details and limits #### Option Group Group commands with `{ type: 'group', children }` inside `options`; no extra group component is needed. A group is purely visual and does not add a level. #### Submenu A plain option with `children` becomes a submenu. Every level shares `submenu-trigger`, which expands on tap by default; switching it to `'hover'` applies to all levels too. It cannot be set per option, so a single tree never mixes two expansion styles. #### Custom Option Content Prefer passing `icon`, `extra` or a VNode directly on the option; all three also accept a render function receiving `{ option, active, level }`. To render a whole data set uniformly, use the `option-label`, `option-icon` and `option-extra` scoped slots. `active` means this exact option matches the active value. A active descendant does not select its parent. Descendant selection and submenu opening remain private styling state. MenuOption uses `highlight` for visual emphasis without changing selection.
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### Selection and visual emphasis `active` is false on a parent whose child is active. The three examples compare render functions, scoped slots and manual MenuOption content; `highlight` only emphasizes a row. ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ### Option values Give each command a stable, unique `value` when adding, removing or reordering options. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` are different values. ## Triggers and positioning ### Context Menu #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | Root menu trigger | Context Menu, Trigger | | `options` | Command tree | Context Menu, Positioning strategy | | `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | Context Menu | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement | | `strategy` | Positioning strategy inherited by every submenu | Positioning strategy | | `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Positioning strategy | Right click inside the target area. Set both `trigger="contextMenu"` and `align-point`. The menu stays at the activation point as the pointer moves; another right click updates its position. ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### With SplitButton [SplitButton](#/en-US/split-button) already wraps a button together with a dropdown command menu and describes extra actions through `MenuOption`. ### Trigger ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### Placement ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### Positioning strategy Both root and nested menus use the same reactive `strategy` (`absolute` by default or `fixed`). Changing it does not change selection or close the menu. `popup-container` independently controls mounting; `fixed` does not automatically escape transformed ancestors. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/positioning.vue ``` ### Popup Max Height ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ### Switching triggers Clicking another hover-open sibling trigger closes the previous menu. Clicking inside a submenu keeps its parent open. ### Popup placement Use `placement` to choose the preferred popup position relative to the trigger. See Menu Props for the available values. Automatic fitting can change the final position when space is limited. Enter, Space and arrow keys can open the trigger and enter the menu. Enter, Space or the forward key enters a submenu. Tab requests close while retaining browser focus navigation; arrows outside the menu are not intercepted, and editable inputs retain text editing keys. ## State and content customization ### Selected Value and Select Event Use `v-model` to keep the active value. Activating a command emits `update:model-value` first and then `select(value, option, event)`; `select` means a menu item was activated, not that a form value changed. ```demo ../example/demos/selection.vue ``` ### Controlled Open State ```demo ../example/demos/controlled.vue ``` ### Footer ```demo ../example/demos/footer.vue ``` ## Reading direction Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Menus mounted externally inherit the source direction. Direction changes do not change selection. ## Usage notes ### Configuration Group titles align left with options, using 20px line height plus 4px top/bottom padding, total 28px. Adjacent groups add 8px; the first does not. Titles grow with content without line-height/padding overlap. ## API ### Value and default value Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected option value; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once, and later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence. # Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 [Select](#/zh-CN/select)；选择层级数据请使用 [Cascader](#/zh-CN/cascader)。 弹出层基于无视觉样式的 [Trigger](#/zh-CN/trigger) 实现，使用统一十二方位和 `cover` 覆盖模式，默认 `bottom`。同宽、高度限制分别使用 `auto-fit-popup-width`、`popup-max-height`。 ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。`type: 'divider'` 渲染分隔线。 ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 `disabled` 加在菜单上禁用整个浮层，加在选项上只禁用该项及其后代。 ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。分组只负责视觉分隔，不增加子项层级。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，移动端默认点击展开；改成 `'hover'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ### 选项值 动态增删或调整选项顺序时，为每个命令设置稳定且唯一的 `value`。数字 `0`、字符串 `'0'` 和布尔值 `false` 是不同的选项值。 ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### 与 SplitButton 组合 [SplitButton](#/zh-CN/split-button) 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作。 ### 触发方式 ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### 弹出方向 ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ```demo ../example/demos/positioning.vue ``` ### 高度限制 ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ### 切换触发元素 点击另一个由悬停打开的同级触发元素时，会关闭原菜单；点击子菜单内部不会关闭父菜单。 ### 弹层定位 使用 `placement` 设置菜单相对触发元素的首选方位，可选值见 Menu Props。空间不足时允许自动调整，最终位置可能与首选方位不同。 触发器支持 Enter、Space 和方向键进入菜单；子菜单支持 Enter、Space 或阅读方向的前进键。Tab 请求关闭并保留浏览器焦点导航，菜单外方向键不被接管，可编辑输入保留文本编辑按键。 ## 状态与内容定制 ### 选中值与 select 事件 可使用 `v-model` 管理当前激活值。激活命令时先触发 `update:model-value`，再触发 `select(value, option, event)`；`select` 表示激活菜单项，不表示表单值变化。 ```demo ../example/demos/selection.vue ``` ### 受控打开状态 ```demo ../example/demos/controlled.vue ``` ### 页脚 ```demo ../example/demos/footer.vue ``` ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。子级沿阅读方向展开；进入子级与返回父级的左右键跟随当前方向，上下键与首尾定位保持顺序并跳过禁用项。挂载到外部容器的菜单继承来源方向，切换方向不改变选中值。 ## 使用说明 ### 配置说明 分组标题与选项左对齐，标题行高 20px、上下各 4px 留白（总高 28px）；相邻分组额外间隔 8px，首组不添加组间距。标题高度随内容自然撑开，避免行高与 padding 挤压重叠。 ## Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy. ### Active Rendering - `options`: Supplies the available options. ### Option values Give each command a stable, unique `value` when adding, removing or reordering options. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` are different values. ## Triggers and positioning ### Context Menu #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | Root menu trigger | Context Menu, Trigger | | `options` | Command tree | Context Menu, Positioning | | `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | Context Menu | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. Automatic fitting can change the final position when space is limited. - `placement`: Chooses the position relative to the trigger. ### Positioning - `options`: Supplies the available options. ### Popup Height Preview configuration: `:popup-max-height="120"`, `:label="item"`, `:popup-max-height="false"`. ### Switching triggers Clicking another hover-open sibling trigger closes the previous menu. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Props are `label`, `value`, `disabled`, `ripple` and `highlight`; `option`, `childrenTrigger` and `uninjectContext` are for internal adapters. The `label` render function and `default`/`icon`/`suffix` slots receive `{ option, active, level }`. Clicking emits `click`. `highlight` controls visual emphasis without committing selection. Groups/submenus are described only through `options`; `MenuGroup` and `MenuSubmenu` are no longer exported. `MenuOption` emits `key-arrow-x` as a submenu navigation bridge. Its exposed `root`, `isFocusing`, `optionSelected`, `handleClick`, and `handleSelect` are internal adapter details. ### Instance methods and keyboard The instance exposes `open()`, `close()`, `resize()` and `setReference(reference?)`; `menu`, `panel`, and `computedOpen` are internal references. Enter, Space or arrow keys open the trigger and enter the menu. Enter, Space or the forward key enters a submenu; Escape closes one layer. Tab requests close and leaves focus navigation to the browser. Arrow keys outside the menu are not intercepted; editable inputs retain text editing keys. Root hover delays do not configure submenu delays. --- permalink: /components/menu/ --- # Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 Select；选择层级数据请使用 Cascader。 --- ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。菜单开启后会为触发元素添加 `c-menu-open` 类名。 ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 分组标题与选项左对齐，标题行高 20px、上下各 4px 留白（总高 28px）；后续分组额外间隔 8px，首组不添加组间距。 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，默认悬停展开；改成 `'click'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ### 选项值 动态增删或调整选项顺序时，为每个命令设置稳定且唯一的 `value`。数字 `0`、字符串 `'0'` 和布尔值 `false` 是不同的选项值。 ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ### 与 SplitButton 组合 SplitButton 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作，完整用法见 [SplitButton](/components/split-button/)。 ### 触发方式 ### 弹出方向 使用 `placement` 设置菜单相对触发元素的首选方位，可选值见 Menu Props。空间不足时允许自动调整，最终位置可能与首选方位不同。 ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ### 高度限制 ### 切换触发元素 点击另一个由悬停打开的同级触发元素时，会关闭原菜单；点击子菜单内部不会关闭父菜单。 ## 状态与内容定制 ### 选中值与 select 事件 使用 `v-model` 管理当前激活值。激活命令时先触发 `update:modelValue`，再触发 `select(value, option, event)`；`select` 表示激活菜单项，不表示表单值变化。 ### 受控打开状态 ### 页脚 ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。子级沿阅读方向展开；进入子级与返回父级的左右键跟随当前方向，上下键与首尾定位保持顺序并跳过禁用项。挂载到外部容器的菜单继承来源方向，切换方向不改变选中值。 ## 尺寸与阴影 `size` 控制选项的行高与字号，`md` 保持默认主题；`elevation=true` 使用菜单默认阴影，`false` 取消阴影，数字使用对应的全局阴影层级。 ## API ### 主值与默认值 使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示选中选项的 value；`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控值，后续修改不会重置当前状态。显式绑定值优先，初始化不发出 `update:modelValue`。 ### Menu Props | 参数名 | 描述 | 类型 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | --- | :---: | | options | 命令树 | `MenuOptionData[]` | `[]` | | field-names | `label/value/children/disabled` 字段映射 | `MenuFieldNames` | `-` | | model-value **(v-model)** | 当前激活值，用于受控高亮 | `MenuValue` | `-` | | open **(v-model)** | 浮层是否可见 | `boolean` | `-` | | default-open | 非受控默认可见状态 | `boolean` | `false` | | trigger | 根菜单触发方式 | `'hover' \| 'click' \| 'focus' \| 'contextMenu'` 或数组 | `'click'` | | submenu-trigger | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | `'hover' \| 'click'` | `'hover'` | | placement | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | `MenuPlacement`

# Menu Collects transient commands for the current object, such as overflow actions, context menus and the extra actions of a button. Use [Select](#/en-US/select) to pick form data and [Cascader](#/en-US/cascader) to pick hierarchical data. The popup is built on the unstyled [Trigger](#/en-US/trigger). It uses the shared twelve placements and the separate `cover` mode, defaulting to `bottom`. Use `auto-fit-popup-width` and `popup-max-height` for width matching and height limits. ## Basic examples ### Overflow Actions Pass the trigger element through the default slot and describe commands with `options`. `type: 'divider'` renders a separator. ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## Appearance and states ### Disabled State `disabled` on the menu disables the whole popup; on an option it disables that option and its descendants. ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## Options and hierarchy ### Groups, submenus and option content #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | Command tree | Groups, submenus and option content, Selection and visual emphasis | | `hide-on-select` | Close the popup after activating a command | Selection and visual emphasis | | `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Selection and visual emphasis | Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.
Configuration details and limits #### Option Group Group commands with `{ type: 'group', children }` inside `options`; no extra group component is needed. A group is purely visual and does not add a level. #### Submenu A plain option with `children` becomes a submenu. Every level shares `submenu-trigger`, which expands on tap by default; switching it to `'hover'` applies to all levels too. It cannot be set per option, so a single tree never mixes two expansion styles. #### Custom Option Content Prefer passing `icon`, `extra` or a VNode directly on the option; all three also accept a render function receiving `{ option, active, level }`. To render a whole data set uniformly, use the `option-label`, `option-icon` and `option-extra` scoped slots. `active` means this exact option matches the active value. A active descendant does not select its parent. Descendant selection and submenu opening remain private styling state. MenuOption uses `highlight` for visual emphasis without changing selection.
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### Selection and visual emphasis `active` is false on a parent whose child is active. The three examples compare render functions, scoped slots and manual MenuOption content; `highlight` only emphasizes a row. ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ### Option values Give each command a stable, unique `value` when adding, removing or reordering options. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` are different values. ## Triggers and positioning ### Context Menu #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | Root menu trigger | Context Menu, Trigger | | `options` | Command tree | Context Menu, Positioning strategy | | `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | Context Menu | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement | | `strategy` | Positioning strategy inherited by every submenu | Positioning strategy | | `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Positioning strategy | Right click inside the target area. Set both `trigger="contextMenu"` and `align-point`. The menu stays at the activation point as the pointer moves; another right click updates its position. ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### With SplitButton [SplitButton](#/en-US/split-button) already wraps a button together with a dropdown command menu and describes extra actions through `MenuOption`. ### Trigger ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### Placement Use `placement` to choose the preferred popup position relative to the trigger. See Menu Props for the available values. Automatic fitting can change the final position when space is limited. Enter, Space and arrow keys can open the trigger and enter the menu. Enter, Space or the forward key enters a submenu. Tab requests close while retaining browser focus navigation; arrows outside the menu are not intercepted, and editable inputs retain text editing keys. ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### Positioning strategy Both root and nested menus use the same reactive `strategy` (`absolute` by default or `fixed`). Changing it does not change selection or close the menu. `popup-container` independently controls mounting; `fixed` does not automatically escape transformed ancestors. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/positioning.vue ``` ### Popup Max Height ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ### Switching triggers Clicking another hover-open sibling trigger closes the previous menu. Clicking inside a submenu keeps its parent open. ## State and content customization ### Selected Value and Select Event Use `v-model` to keep the active value. Activating a command emits `update:model-value` first and then `select(value, option, event)`; `select` means a menu item was activated, not that a form value changed. ```demo ../example/demos/selection.vue ``` ### Controlled Open State ```demo ../example/demos/controlled.vue ``` ### Footer ```demo ../example/demos/footer.vue ``` ## Reading direction Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Menus mounted externally inherit the source direction. Direction changes do not change selection. ## Usage notes ### Configuration Group titles align left with options, using 20px line height plus 4px top/bottom padding, total 28px. Adjacent groups add 8px; the first does not. Titles grow with content without line-height/padding overlap. ## API ### Value and default value Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected option value; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once, and later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence. # Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 [Select](#/zh-CN/select)；选择层级数据请使用 [Cascader](#/zh-CN/cascader)。 弹出层基于无视觉样式的 [Trigger](#/zh-CN/trigger) 实现，使用统一十二方位和 `cover` 覆盖模式，默认 `bottom`。同宽、高度限制分别使用 `auto-fit-popup-width`、`popup-max-height`。 ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。`type: 'divider'` 渲染分隔线。 ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 `disabled` 加在菜单上禁用整个浮层，加在选项上只禁用该项及其后代。 ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。分组只负责视觉分隔，不增加子项层级。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，移动端默认点击展开；改成 `'hover'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ### 选项值 动态增删或调整选项顺序时，为每个命令设置稳定且唯一的 `value`。数字 `0`、字符串 `'0'` 和布尔值 `false` 是不同的选项值。 ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### 与 SplitButton 组合 [SplitButton](#/zh-CN/split-button) 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作。 ### 触发方式 ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### 弹出方向 使用 `placement` 设置菜单相对触发元素的首选方位，可选值见 Menu Props。空间不足时允许自动调整，最终位置可能与首选方位不同。 触发器支持 Enter、Space 和方向键进入菜单；子菜单支持 Enter、Space 或阅读方向的前进键。Tab 请求关闭并保留浏览器焦点导航，菜单外方向键不被接管，可编辑输入保留文本编辑按键。 ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ```demo ../example/demos/positioning.vue ``` ### 高度限制 ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ### 切换触发元素 点击另一个由悬停打开的同级触发元素时，会关闭原菜单；点击子菜单内部不会关闭父菜单。 ## 状态与内容定制 ### 选中值与 select 事件 可使用 `v-model` 管理当前激活值。激活命令时先触发 `update:model-value`，再触发 `select(value, option, event)`；`select` 表示激活菜单项，不表示表单值变化。 ```demo ../example/demos/selection.vue ``` ### 受控打开状态 ```demo ../example/demos/controlled.vue ``` ### 页脚 ```demo ../example/demos/footer.vue ``` ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。子级沿阅读方向展开；进入子级与返回父级的左右键跟随当前方向，上下键与首尾定位保持顺序并跳过禁用项。挂载到外部容器的菜单继承来源方向，切换方向不改变选中值。 ## 使用说明 ### 配置说明 分组标题与选项左对齐，标题行高 20px、上下各 4px 留白（总高 28px）；相邻分组额外间隔 8px，首组不添加组间距。标题高度随内容自然撑开，避免行高与 padding 挤压重叠。 ## ## Usage notes



The close button supports keyboard activation. close fires once; closed fires after the leave transition finishes.

### Close labels and elevation types

The close control uses the shared `common.close` locale key and updates reactively with its language scope. The `close-icon` slot replaces only the graphic. Customize `locale.common.close` through Cedar ConfigProvider, or the `'common.close'` message through Maple LocaleProvider.

`elevation` accepts only booleans or numbers. Use `:elevation="4"` for a numeric level; the string `elevation="4"` is outside the public type. Keyboard activation and clicks emit a MouseEvent; `closed` still fires after the leave transition.

## CSS Variables

See `style/token.less`; all variables use the `--c-alert-` prefix. Example override:

```css
:root {
  --c-alert-padding-vertical: 12px;
  --c-alert-padding-horizontal: 20px;
}
```

Colored titles, content, icons and outline borders use readable system content colors. standard and tonal share the same level-1 background; standard adds a subtle decorative border. Default titles use content-primary; body text and icons use content-secondary. The content variable also sets the root inherited color, used by close icons and actions without an explicit color. Maple dark mode inherits these colors while retaining its geometry overrides: 16px padding, 22px icons, 12px icon/close gaps and 1.5 body line height. color changes only the background; callers must also verify foreground contrast. The table lists :root defaults, not theme overrides.

#### 外观组合

#### 提示类型

警告提示有 `info`、`success`、`warning`、`danger`、`default` 五种类型。`default` 类型下默认不展示图标，可通过 `#icon` 插槽自定义。

## 升级提示（Breaking）

| 旧 | 新 |
| -- | -- |
| `type="error"` | `type="danger"` |
| `type="normal"` | `type="default"` |
| `closeable` | `closable` |
| `#close-element` slot | `#close-icon` slot |

`type="default"` 不渲染内置图标；需要图标时用 `#icon`。

## 使用说明



关闭按钮支持键盘操作；close 只触发一次，closed 在离场动画完成后触发。

### 关闭名称与投影类型

关闭入口的可访问名称使用通用语言词条 `common.close`，随当前语言作用域响应式更新；`close-icon` 仅替换图形。Cedar 通过 ConfigProvider 的 `locale.common.close` 定制，Maple 通过 LocaleProvider 语言包的 `'common.close'` 词条定制。

`elevation` 只接受布尔值或数字；数字层级请使用 `:elevation="4"`，字符串 `elevation="4"` 不属于公开类型。键盘关闭与点击统一发出 MouseEvent，`closed` 仍在退出动画结束后通知。

## CSS Variables

参见 `style/token.less`，所有变量以 `--c-alert-` 为前缀。覆盖示例：

```css
:root {
  --c-alert-padding-vertical: 12px;
  --c-alert-padding-horizontal: 20px;
}
```

彩色标题、正文、图标及 outline 描边使用可读 system content。standard 与 tonal 使用同一第 1 阶浅底，前者额外带弱装饰描边；默认标题为 content-primary，正文、图标为 content-secondary。content 变量同时控制根容器继承色，关闭图标及未显式设色的操作内容跟随它。Maple 暗色继承同一套颜色，但保留原有几何覆盖（内边距 16px、图标 22px、图标/关闭间距 12px、正文行高 1.5）。color 仅改背景，调用方须同时验证前景对比度。下表为 :root 默认值，不是主题覆盖值。

### 动效

内置动效遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`；减少动效不会阻止加载状态或关闭事件更新。

# AutoComplete

Text input with suggested completions. Suggestions accept arrays or an explicit options loader; the component manages request waiting and cancellation, while ordinary events remain notifications.

## Reading direction

The editor and suggestion popup inherit source dir, including in custom containers. Horizontal caret keys keep native editing behavior; vertical keys navigate candidates, Enter selects and Escape closes. Candidate updates preserve the native composition buffer until composition ends instead of repainting the previous model value.

## Search and visibility

Default matching searches labels and ignores case; search-fields can include values. Custom filter-option callbacks own their case policy; false bypasses local filtering for remote results. Candidate visibility is private and follows input/focus plus should-open. Public open/default-open and their events control the deferred field editor. Trigger presentation options cannot force candidate visibility.
