## 异步与关闭控制

### 异步关闭

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `before-close` | 返回 boolean/Promise 或调用 done；首次完成生效 | 异步关闭、before 钩子与 done 兼容 |
| `title` | 标题 | 异步关闭 |
| `message` | 内容（也可用 default 插槽） | 异步关闭 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

<demo src="./__demos__/async.vue"></demo>

### 关闭守卫

`beforeClose({ action }, done, context)` 为统一入口，不新增另一套命名。


只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。


<demo src="./__demos__/guard-protocol.vue"></demo>


Promise 与 done 共用一次完成状态：`false` / `done(false)` 阻止，`true` / `done()` 允许；Promise<void> 正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。内容、标题与动作间距使用逻辑起止位置；外部弹层继承来源方向。关闭、确认、取消和未提交状态不因方向切换改变。

## 使用说明

### 异步操作反馈
before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

函数调用的通知回调不控制任务完成。服务的选择或关闭结果独立于回调异常结算，关闭完成时仍会清理所属宿主。异常继续通过调用方或 Vue 错误通道传递；回调返回 Promise 不控制 loading 或关闭。

### 拖动与取消
标题拖动只由发起手势的主指针控制。停用 `draggable`、关闭、进入全屏、丢失指针捕获或所属窗口失焦、停用以及卸载都会结束当前手势并释放监听和捕获。重新启用后需发起新手势，不会接续旧指针；停用保留当前偏移，全屏和原有关闭结束后的重置恢复默认位置。监听归属标题元素所在文档。

# Divider

Separate content sections in lists and layouts.

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`. Horizontal text start/end follows reading order; vertical start/end remains top/bottom. Inset controls along-line indentation and spacing controls perpendicular margins. Paired horizontal inset and vertical spacing uses logical start/end. Vertical borders use inline start; hairline, border type and aria-orientation retain their meaning. Direction changes preserve content nodes.

## Content and layout

### Content height and minimum thickness

## API

### Divider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `orientation` | Horizontal/vertical orientation of the divider itself, default horizontal; does not control text alignment | `horizontal` \| `vertical` | `horizontal` |
| `type` | Line style | `solid` \| `dashed` \| `dotted` \| `double` | `solid` |
| `text-align` | Text position along the line; start/end follow logical direction | `start` \| `center` \| `end` | `center` |
| `description` | Description text; the default slot takes priority | `string` | — |
| `inset` | Inset along the line: left/right horizontally, top/bottom vertically | `DividerSize` | — |
| `spacing` | Outer spacing across the line: top/bottom horizontally, left/right vertically | `DividerSize` | `md` |
| `thickness` | Finite line width of at least 1px; omission uses the 1px theme default; hairline takes precedence | `number` | — |
| `hairline` | Scale the theme line width by half; 0.5px with the default theme | `boolean` | `false` |
| `color` | Line color; defaults to the theme border color | `string` | — |
| `opacity` | Opacity of the entire divider, including text, from 0 to 1; zero preserves layout | `number` | — |

### Spacing values

`DividerSize = number | string | [number | string] | [number | string, number | string]`

`inset` controls the ends of the line; `spacing` controls the outer gap between the line and adjacent content. Both accept presets `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, a number in px, a CSS length, or an array. A scalar or single-item array applies to both ends; `[start, end]` sets each end separately. Array entries are lengths, not preset names.

| Direction | inset array order | spacing array order |
| --- | --- | --- |
| horizontal | Inline start/end inset; right/left in RTL | Top/bottom margin |
| vertical | Top/bottom inset | Inline start/end margin; right/left in RTL |

`inset` has no `inset` by default; `spacing` defaults to the platform’s `md` `spacing`. Presets use platform theme tokens, so pixel values may differ.


Development checks cover orientation, text-align, type, spacing shape, thickness and opacity. Invalid enums use defaults; invalid inset produces no indentation, invalid spacing falls back to md, and invalid opacity does not override styles. opacity must be finite and within 0–1. Arrays accept one or two lengths and no preset names. Finite negative margins and CSS var/calc expressions remain supported; browsers parse their CSS syntax.

# Drawer

A side panel with declarative and programmatic APIs and cancellable before-close operations.

The default header associates its `title` slot with the dialog through a stable, unique title id. Text and render-function service titles follow the same rule; simultaneous service roots do not reuse title ids. An explicit `ariaLabel` takes precedence, and a plain `title` prop can still name the dialog. Hidden or fully custom headers do not reference unrendered titles; provide `ariaLabel` explicitly.

`DrawerConfig` supports the same `dir`, `ariaLabel`, `closeButtonAriaLabel` and `overlayAnimationName` as the component. Guard errors notify `onGuardError(error, action)`. Retired `beforeConfirm` / `beforeCancel` have been replaced by `beforeClose`; changing a guard does not reopen a closed drawer.

Promise and done share a single completion state: false/done(false) rejects; true/done() allows; a resolved Promise<void> allows. The first completion wins. Errors emit guard-error; cancellation/unmount invalidates late completion. Synchronous void retains the callback protocol and waits for done on these close/confirm guards.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Drawer placement left/right remain physical sides, so entrance/exit follows the corresponding screen edge. Header, content and footer inherit reading direction. Direction changes do not commit or clear content.

## Usage notes

### Async operation feedback
Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

### Drawer Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:open | Request a visibility update | `boolean` |
| confirm / cancel | Accepted confirm or cancel action | `Event` |
| open / close | Opening or closing begins | - |
| opened / closed | Opening or closing transition completes | - |
| click-overlay | Click the topmost overlay | `MouseEvent` |

### Drawer Slots

`default`, `header`, `title`, `footer`. The `footer` slot receives `confirm`, `cancel` and `close` methods.

Footer confirm/cancel/close, built-in controls, overlay and Escape are beforeClose requests; instance confirm()/cancel() are guarded too. Instance close(), Drawer.open() handle close() and parent open=false are direct commands for completion or explicit exit, bypassing the guard without extra confirm/cancel. Controlled close() still only requests update:open(false); a rejecting parent remains authoritative. Direct closing aborts pending guards and invalidates late results. close() returns void and does not await leave; use closed/onClosed for completion.

Both Dialog implementations share this policy. Maple Popup close()/requestClose() and external model closing are awaitable guard requests returning `Promise<boolean>`; they are not Drawer direct-close commands. Popup destruction remains parent-owned. The demo Close directly action keeps an exit without changing Allow closing or pretending the guard approved.

### Imperative calls

`Drawer.open(config)` uses camelCase options such as `cancelButtonText`, `beforeClose` and `closeOnRouteChange`. Notifications use `onConfirm`, `onCancel`, `onOpen`, `onOpened`, `onClose`, `onClosed`, `onClickOverlay` and `onKeyEscape`.

```ts
import type { DrawerAction, DrawerConfig, DrawerProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## CSS Variables

Built-in fade and four-direction slide disable transitions and initial displacement under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Adapt custom animations to the reduced-motion preference in your application.

Panel bg uses surface-raised; overlay-bg uses sys-color-scrim; header-text-color/content-text-color use content-primary, with the close button inheriting header-text-color; border-color uses border-default. Drawer keeps its existing geometry, motion and stacking defaults. Drawer is a Cedar component; Maple does not define empty same-name variables.

overlay-style sets instance scrim variables; drawer-style sets panel variables. These sibling nodes do not inherit variables from one another. Set global system theme variables on a real common ancestor. Explicit background props take precedence over variable consumption.

# Drawer

从容器一侧进入的桌面抽屉。Drawer 与 Maple Popup 共用同一套模态表面控制逻辑；标题、页脚、操作按钮和宽高仍是 Drawer 的桌面端能力。

## 关闭与异步控制

### 关闭守卫

`beforeClose({ action }, done, context)` 为统一入口，不新增另一套命名。


只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。


<demo src="./__demos__/guard-protocol.vue"></demo>


Promise 与 done 共用一次完成状态：`false` / `done(false)` 阻止，`true` / `done()` 允许；Promise<void> 正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。抽屉 placement 的 left/right 保持物理侧，进入/退出仍从对应屏幕边缘运动；标题、内容和底部动作继承阅读方向。方向切换不提交或清空内容。

## 使用说明

### 异步操作反馈
before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

| 事件 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:open | 可见状态请求 | `boolean` |
| confirm / cancel | 点击对应操作按钮并获准关闭 | `Event` |

### Drawer Slots

`default`、`header`、`title`、`footer`。`footer` 获得 `confirm`、`cancel`、`close` 三个方法。

footer 的 confirm、cancel、close 和内置按钮、遮罩、Esc 都是守卫请求，走 beforeClose；实例 confirm()/cancel() 也走守卫。实例 close()、Drawer.open() 返回句柄的 close()、父级直接设置 open=false 是不经过守卫的关闭命令，用于业务完成或主动退出，不额外发 confirm/cancel。受控实例的 close() 仍只请求 update:open(false)，父级拒绝时不会强改模型。直接关闭会终止当前守卫并使迟到结果失效；close() 返回 void，不等待离场，完成请监听 closed/onClosed。

这一职责与两端 Dialog 一致。Maple Popup 的 close()/requestClose() 和外部模型关闭属于可等待的守卫请求，返回 `Promise<boolean>`；不要将它们当作 Drawer 的直接关闭命令。Popup 的直接销毁仍由父级掌握。示例的“直接关闭”保留退出入口，不修改“允许关闭”选择，也不会伪装成守卫批准。

`Drawer.open(config)` 使用 camelCase 的同名配置，例如 `cancelButtonText`、`beforeClose`、`closeOnRouteChange`。通知事件使用 `onConfirm`、`onCancel`、`onOpen`、`onOpened`、`onClose`、`onClosed`、`onClickOverlay` 和 `onKeyEscape`。

## Usage notes

### Rows and content boundaries

expand-trigger supports only click. Invalid values produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and do not enable button semantics, click or keyboard expansion. line-clamp accepts finite numbers or numeric strings of at least one row and floors decimals. Values below one, nonfinite values and invalid strings warn and fall back to ordinary single-line mode, clearing old multiline styles. Prefer plain text or inline content without independent interactions. The default Tooltip still does not detect actual overflow and remains focusable with Tab when enabled. Custom tooltip content and controlled expansion remain unchanged.

## API

### Ellipsis Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expand` | Controlled expansion | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `default-expand` | Initial uncontrolled expansion | `boolean` | `false` |
| `expand-trigger` | Enable click / Enter / Space toggling | `'click'` | `—` |
| `line-clamp` | Positive line count; omitted or invalid means single line | `number \| string` | `—` |
| `tooltip` | Tooltip configuration; false disables it | `boolean \| TooltipProps` | `true` |

Providing `expand` makes the component request updates from its parent rather than changing controlled state. When omitted, internal state is used, initialized once by `default-expand`. Tooltip follows its own width and trigger defaults; display does not depend on measured overflow. Touch callers can include `click` in `tooltip.trigger` explicitly. External class/style/width apply directly to the text node.

### Ellipsis Events / Slots

- `update:expand(expand: boolean)`: the new state requested by user interaction; external updates do not emit it.
- `default`: body text.
- `tooltip-content`: tooltip content. Without it, tooltip.content takes precedence, then body text; content is not concatenated twice.
- Keyboard: expandable text supports Enter / Space; tooltip-enabled text is focusable with Tab. No public instance methods.

## Types

```ts
import type { EllipsisProps, EllipsisInstance, EllipsisExpandTrigger } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

### Imports and event types

The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.

```ts
import Ellipsis, { Ellipsis as NamedEllipsis } from '@cedar-design/ui/ellipsis'
import { Ellipsis as RootEllipsis } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import type { EllipsisProps, EllipsisInstance } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import type { EllipsisProps as SubEllipsisProps } from '@cedar-design/ui/ellipsis'
const options: EllipsisProps = { 'onUpdate:expand': (expanded: boolean) => String(expanded) }
```

--- permalink: /components/field-decorator/ --- # FieldDecorator 字段装饰器 FieldDecorator 是 Input、Textarea、Select 与日期时间控件的展示外壳，负责边框、尺寸、浮动提示、前后缀和清除按钮；不管理输入值、表单校验或弹层开合。 - 三种变体：`outline`（默认）、`filled`、`standard`。消费者可以显式选择自己的默认变体。 - 五种尺寸：`xs / sm / md / lg / xl`，默认 `md`；具体高度使用各端 token。 - `hint` 在两端默认均为 `true`；Input 在 FormItem 已有外部标签时关闭浮动提示。 - 有内容且可编辑时才渲染清除按钮；`0` 算非空，`[]` 算空。Cedar 在 hover/focus 时显示，Maple 常驻；触屏媒体条件下 Cedar 也常驻。 - 默认按钮通过各端全局语言系统读取无障碍文案，不维护组件私有词典。 - 内容列尺寸使用 ResizeObserver 观察，支持前缀变化及隐藏容器重新显示；卸载时清理监听。 输入控件聚焦时不额外绘制外圈 outline，沿用各变体已有的边框、底线或背景聚焦反馈；适用于 Input、Textarea、Date 和 Time 等消费者。 输入框、文本域和数字输入框的光标使用 `currentColor`，与当前输入文字颜色一致；错误态不单独覆盖光标颜色。 `--c-field-caret-color` 默认 `currentColor`，统一控制 Input、InputNumber 与 Textarea 的光标颜色；不改变文字色。 ## 基础示例 ### 表单控件尺寸对照 切换五档 size 和三种字段变体，比较 Input、Button、Select、日期时间及其他单行表单控件的高度。Button 在这里固定使用 outline。DatePicker/TimePicker 是面板，此处使用带输入框的 Date/Time 字段。示例同时展示有值、可清空、标签删除与长标签多选；Select/Cascader 设置 tag-nowrap 时保持同档高度，长标签文字省略、删除图标保留；标签行可横向滚动，清空按钮和箭头固定在外侧。被省略的标签正文支持悬停、键盘聚焦或点按查看完整文字，点外部或按 Esc 关闭，不改变选中值。可清空后恢复选中值重复比较。多行文本和允许换行的多选内容按内容撑高。 ## 加载与等待 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ## 使用说明 ### 错误与禁用边框 动态更换 `tag` 后，尺寸观察会绑定当前根节点和内容节点。KeepAlive 停用释放观察和排队测量；旧激活代次的帧不会修改当前布局。 ## API ### FieldDecorator Props 浮动提示为描边预留缺口，缺口与内容列对齐，左右间距通过 `hint-space` 调整。 | 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 / 含义 | | --- | --- | --- | | `loading` | `boolean` | `false`，显示加载状态，不改变禁用或只读 | | `loading-mode` | `'default' \| 'line'` | `default`；指示器或底部进度线 | | `tag` | `'div' \| 'span'` | `div`，外壳标签 | | `value` | `unknown` | 仅判断内容是否为空 | | `id` | `string` | 浮动标签关联的原生控件 id | | `title` | `string` | 原生标题提示 | | `size` | `ComponentSize`

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the filter-fields object. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, and initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

Input updates the internal mirror before notifying the parent. If the parent does not accept the update, the input remains visible locally; a different external model replaces the mirror. `collapsed` likewise updates locally before notification and accepts later external changes. To reject an input, explicitly provide a new model object.

### FilterForm Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value **(v-model)** | Form values; uses default-value when omitted | `Record<string, unknown>` | `undefined` |
| default-value | Initial values read only at creation | `Record<string, unknown>` | `{}` |
| fields | Filter-item schema | `FilterFormField[]` | `[]` |
| field-map | Optional field-component registry | `FilterFormFieldMap` | `{}` |
| rules | Forwarded Form validation rules | object | - |
| collapsed **(v-model)** | Whether to collapse extra items | boolean | `true` |
| collapsible | Whether expanding/collapsing is enabled | boolean | `true` |
| cols | Responsive column count | number \| object | `{ xs:1, sm:2, md:3, lg:3, xl:4, xxl:5 }` |
| grid-props | Forwarded Grid properties, taking precedence over matching container settings | `Record<string, unknown>` | - |
| change-debounce | change debounce in milliseconds; 0 notifies immediately; negative or nonfinite values fall back to 500 | number | `500` |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Immediate value snapshot notification on input | `(value: Record<string, unknown>) => void` |
| update:collapsed | Local expand/collapse notification | `(collapsed: boolean) => void` |
| change | Debounced input notification and immediate Enter notification; with autoEmitChange=false, blur or Enter notifies | `(value: Record<string, unknown>, field: string) => void` |

Events are notifications only; listener Promises are not collected and do not drive loading state.

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| actions | Actions such as search/reset beside expand/collapse; no scoped arguments; available with collapsible=false |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Instance Properties

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| formRef | `FormInstance \| undefined` | Inner Form instance after mounting; supports Form methods such as validate, clearValidate and resetFields |

`formRef` is an instance property. Calling the inner Form `resetFields` restores its recorded initial values locally without emitting FilterForm `update:modelValue` or `change`. To reset the complete filter, replace the bound business model; for example:

```ts
const makeInitialModel = () => ({ keyword: '', createdAt: new Date() })
const model = ref(makeInitialModel())
const resetFilters = () => { model.value = makeInitialModel() }
```

Use search/reset buttons with `type="button"` in `actions` and manage the model and queries in business handlers. The container exposes no additional reset/search methods or task execution entry point.

## Types

### FilterFormField

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| component | Vue component or a key in `fieldMap` | `string \| Component` | - |
| field | Form field path | string | - |
| label | Label | string | - |
| visible | Whether to render | boolean | `true` |
| autoEmitChange | Whether input emits change while editing | boolean | `true` |
| props | Props forwarded to the field component | object | - |
| gridItemProps | GridItem props | object | - |
| formItemProps | FormItem props | object | - |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| component | Field component | Component | - |
| defaultProps | Default props | object | - |

Field properties merge in order: registration `defaultProps`, `field` `props`, then the container-owned `modelValue`, with later values taking precedence. `gridItemProps` passes through to GridItem. `formItemProps` can override the FormItem `field` and `label`, but does not change the schema `field` path used for model writes. `grid-props` can also override Grid settings such as `cols` and `collapsed`; avoid conflicting container state.

```ts
import type {
  FilterFormProps,
  FilterFormInstance,
  FilterFormEmits,
  FilterFormSlots,
  FilterFormExpose,
  FilterFormField,
  FilterFormFieldMap,
  FilterFormFieldRegistration,
} from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

Grid column spacing is controlled by `grid-props.colGap` in numeric px. There is no same-name CSS override, ensuring numerical Grid measurements match actual spacing.

Changing changeDebounce reschedules the pending snapshot using the new delay; zero notifies immediately. Enter cancels the pending task before notifying the current value. External reset or a different model replacement cancels stale snapshots, while accepting the same update:modelValue proposal does not cancel change. KeepAlive deactivation and unmount cancel pending notifications; reactivation accepts new input.

Filter models use the existing Form data-snapshot policy. Date values, plain objects and arrays are copied independently; Map, Set, BigInt and cyclic references retain their data kinds instead of converting dates to strings or collections to empty objects. Mutating a plain-object or Date event snapshot does not alter the parent model or later internal snapshots. Identity semantics such as Map keys follow the existing Form policy. Functions, DOM nodes, WeakMap/WeakSet, Promises and instances with private state are outside the deeply isolated filter-data contract.

field supports the same dot and bracket paths as FormItem. Writes create missing object containers and preserve sibling fields. Prebuild array containers in default-value or model-value when an array is required. Existing intermediate values must be objects or arrays; input does not replace incompatible scalar structures. Existing local-mirror, debounce and accepted-echo behavior for model updates and change notifications is preserved.

## CSS Variables

Override `--c-filter-form-action-offset` on the FilterForm root to adjust multi-column action alignment. The single-column stacked layout uses no additional top offset.

# FilterForm

列表页筛选项。FilterForm **不内置**输入组件，通过 `fields[].component` 直接传入组件（也可使用可选的 `field-map` 注册表），避免无用依赖进包。

持久化（记住筛选）由业务侧自行处理：组件只通过 `v-model` 同步值，不读写 storage。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

在 `fields` 中直接传入组件并配置字段。宽屏会自动多列展示，超出时可展开/收起。

筛选容器使用主题表面色（亮色为白色、暗色随主题适配）、轻描边与20px内边距，不再使用输入控件的浅填充背景。操作区预留两列并与字段控件顶边对齐；单列时按可用列数收敛。单列/双列折叠默认保留一行字段和独立操作行，避免只剩按钮。展开/收起为原生按钮，支持Tab聚焦、Enter/空格操作并提供aria-expanded。行间距默认16px，可由grid-props.rowGap覆盖。

The filter uses the theme surface with a subtle border and 20px inset, rather than an input-fill background. Actions align with the fields and reserve two columns, clamped to the available column count. One- and two-column collapse retain a row of fields above the actions by default. Expand/collapse is a native keyboard-accessible button with aria-expanded. The default 16px row gap can be overridden through grid-props.rowGap.

<demo src="./__demos__/basic.vue"></demo>

```ts
import { Input, Select, type FilterFormField } from '@cedar-design/ui'

const fields: FilterFormField[] = [
  { field: 'keyword', label: '关键词', component: Input },
  {
    field: 'status',
    label: '状态',
    component: Select,
    props: { options: [{ label: '启用', value: 'enabled' }] },
  },
]
```

所有字段组件统一使用 `modelValue` / `update:modelValue` 同步值。自定义组件也应遵循该协议；其他协议可通过包装组件适配。值同步与 FilterForm 的防抖 `change` 通知独立，`autoEmitChange: false` 时值仍会即时同步。

| `field-map` | 可选字段组件注册表 | 可选组件注册表 |
| `collapsible` | 是否启用展开/收起 | 可选组件注册表 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

需要复用组件默认属性或使用后端 JSON schema 时，可通过 `fieldMap` 注册组件，字段的 `component` 填写注册表 key。注册表支持直接传组件或 `{ component, defaultProps }`，字段 `props` 覆盖注册表默认属性。未注册的字符串 key 不渲染。

## API

### 主值与默认值

使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示筛选字段对象；`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控值，后续修改不会重置当前状态。显式绑定值优先，初始化不发出 `update:modelValue`。

输入后先更新内部镜像，再通知父级。父级未接收更新时，界面仍保留本次输入；后续不同的外部模型会替换镜像。`collapsed` 同样先更新内部折叠状态再通知父级，并接受后续外部变化。需要业务拒绝输入时，应显式回写新的模型对象。

### FilterForm Props

| 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| model-value **(v-model)** | 表单值；未传入时使用 default-value | `Record<string, unknown>` | `undefined` |
| default-value | 仅创建时读取的初始值 | `Record<string, unknown>` | `{}` |
| fields | 筛选项 schema | `FilterFormField[]` | `[]` |
| field-map | 可选字段组件注册表 | `FilterFormFieldMap` | `{}` |
| rules | 透传 Form 校验规则 | object | - |
| collapsed **(v-model)** | 是否折叠多余项 | boolean | `true` |
| collapsible | 是否启用展开/收起 | boolean | `true` |
| cols | 响应式列数 | number \| object | `{ xs:1, sm:2, md:3, lg:3, xl:4, xxl:5 }` |
| grid-props | 透传 Grid 属性，优先于容器给出的同名配置 | `Record<string, unknown>` | - |
| change-debounce | change 防抖毫秒；0 立即通知，非有限数或负数回退 500 | number | `500` |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Events

| 事件名 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | 输入时即时同步值快照 | `(value: Record<string, unknown>) => void` |
| update:collapsed | 本地展开/收起通知 | `(collapsed: boolean) => void` |
| change | 输入防抖、回车即时通知；autoEmitChange=false 时由失焦或回车通知 | `(value: Record<string, unknown>, field: string) => void` |

事件仅作通知，不收集 Promise，也不驱动加载状态。

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Slots

| 插槽名 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| actions | 操作区（搜索 / 重置等），与展开收起同一行；没有作用域参数；collapsible=false 时仍可使用 |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration Instance Properties

| 属性 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| formRef | `FormInstance \| undefined` | 挂载后的内部 Form 实例，可调用 validate、clearValidate、resetFields 等 Form 方法 |

`formRef` 是实例属性，不是方法。内部 Form 的 `resetFields` 恢复它记录的初始值，只影响内部模型，不发出 FilterForm 的 `update:modelValue` 或 `change`。整体重置筛选条件时，业务应替换绑定模型；例如：

```ts
const makeInitialModel = () => ({ keyword: '', createdAt: new Date() })
const model = ref(makeInitialModel())
const resetFilters = () => { model.value = makeInitialModel() }
```

在 `actions` 中使用 `type="button"` 的搜索或重置按钮，并在业务处理函数中操作模型、执行查询。容器没有额外的 reset/search 方法或任务执行入口。

## Types

### FilterFormField

| 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| component | Vue 组件，或 `fieldMap` 的 key | `string \| Component` | - |
| field | 表单字段路径 | string | - |
| label | 标签 | string | - |
| visible | 是否渲染 | boolean | `true` |
| autoEmitChange | 输入过程是否触发 change | boolean | `true` |
| props | 透传给字段组件 | object | - |
| gridItemProps | GridItem 属性 | object | - |
| formItemProps | FormItem 属性 | object | - |

### FilterFormFieldRegistration

| 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| component | 字段组件 | Component | - |
| defaultProps | 默认 props | object | - |

字段属性按注册表 `defaultProps`、字段 `props`、容器管理的 `modelValue` 顺序合并，后者优先。`gridItemProps` 直接透传 GridItem；`formItemProps` 可覆盖 FormItem 的 `field` 和 `label`，但不会改变模型写入使用的 schema `field` 路径。`grid-props` 也可覆盖 `cols`、`collapsed` 等同名 Grid 配置，配置时应避免与容器状态冲突。

```ts
import type {
  FilterFormProps,
  FilterFormInstance,
  FilterFormEmits,
  FilterFormSlots,
  FilterFormExpose,
  FilterFormField,
  FilterFormFieldMap,
  FilterFormFieldRegistration,
} from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

Grid 列间距通过 `grid-props.colGap`（数字 px）控制；没有同名 CSS 覆盖入口，以确保 Grid 的数值测量与实际间距一致。

changeDebounce 改变时按新延迟重排待发送快照，0为立即通知。回车先取消待发送任务再通知当前值；外部重置或不同模型替换会取消旧快照，但正常接受 update:modelValue 的相同值回传不会取消 change。KeepAlive 停用与卸载取消待发送任务；重新激活后接受新输入。

筛选模型使用与 Form 一致的数据快照复制策略。Date、普通对象和数组会独立复制；Map、Set、BigInt 和循环引用保留数据形态，不把日期转换成字符串或把集合变成空对象。事件接收方修改普通对象或 Date 快照，不会改动父模型或后续内部快照；Map 键等标识语义沿用现有 Form 策略。函数、DOM、WeakMap/WeakSet、Promise 和带私有状态的实例不属于可深隔离的筛选数据模型，不承诺复制其内部状态。

field 支持与 FormItem 一致的点号及方括号路径。写入时自动创建缺失的中间对象，保留已有兄弟字段；需要数组型中间容器时，在 default-value 或 model-value 中预建数组。已有中间值须为对象或数组，不用输入操作覆盖不匹配的标量结构。模型同步及 change 的本地镜像、防抖和回传确认语义保持原有合同。

An asynchronous rule must return a Promise; normal completion without an error callback means success. A delayed callback without a returned Promise is not awaited. --- permalink: /components/form/ --- # Form 具有数据收集、校验和提交功能的表单，包含复选框、单选框、输入框、下拉选择框等元素。 标签一律由 `FormItem` 的 `label`（或 label 插槽）负责渲染；控件本身只提供 `placeholder` 等占位文案，不承担字段标签。 ## 阅读方向 Form 与 FormItem 的 content-align 支持 start、end、left、center、right，label-align 支持 start、end、left、right；默认内容 start、标签 end。默认 LTR 位置保持不变，RTL 按阅读方向排列；显式 left/right 均为物理对齐。字段覆盖优先于 Form，逐实例标签列样式保持最高优先级。切换方向不重置业务值、校验结果或只读/禁用状态。 组件导出以下类型定义 ```ts import type { FormProps } from "@cedar-design/ui"; ``` ## 基础示例 ### 基础用法 ## 表单外观与布局 ### 全局禁用 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | | `layout` | 表单的布局方式，包括水平、垂直、多列 | 表单布局、标签与内容装饰、标签宽度方案对比 | | `model` | 表单数据对象 | 标签与内容装饰、标签宽度方案对比 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用表单 | 全局禁用 | | `label-align` | 标签的对齐方向 | 标签宽度方案对比 | | `auto-label-width` | 是否开启自动标签宽度，仅在 `layout="horizontal"` 下生效。 | 标签宽度方案对比 | | `label-col-flex` | 标签列 flex；数字为伸缩比例，带单位字符串为宽度 | 标签宽度方案对比 | 通过 disabled 属性可以禁用整个表单。 ### 表单布局 `edit-mode` 表示编辑模式：`direct` 始终显示控件；`click` / `dblclick` 保留当前在字段附近展开编辑浮层的行为。`readPretty` 是独立布尔属性。FormItem 和字段未设置时继承上层。 表单支持三种布局方式： horizontal - 水平排列（默认，标签在左、控件在右）， vertical - 垂直排列（标签在上、控件在下）， inline - 行内排列。 组合切换 `layout`、`content-align` 与 `direct / click / dblclick` 编辑方式及独立的 `readPretty` 阅读开关，观察标签、字段值和长文字换行的对齐效果。备注项可单独覆盖布局，已有输入数据在切换时保留。`click` 单击进入弹层，`dblclick` 双击进入弹层，`readPretty` 只展示已保存的文字。 ### 标签与内容装饰 ### 额外信息和帮助信息 可以使用 extra 添加额外信息。 如果需要在外部自定义校验信息，可以使用`help`属性或插槽。error 状态下校验信息优先；无错误展示时显示 help。 ### 标签宽度方案对比 先输入数据，再切换自动测量、响应式栅格和固定宽度，三种方案使用同一份表单数据。修改最长标签或隐藏联系方式，观察自动测量更新。响应式方案在 576px 以下上下排列；固定宽度默认 6rem，联系方式单项覆盖为 8rem。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 自动标签宽度 设置 `auto-label-width` 开启自动标签宽度。仅在 `layout="horizontal"` 布局下生效。 自动宽度随标签修改、字段增删更新，各个表单独立计算。 #### 标签栅格与局部覆盖 两端默认横向比例为标签 5/24、内容 19/24；Cedar 默认 horizontal，Maple 默认 vertical。仅 horizontal 消费栅格比例与自动宽度；vertical/inline 不套用 Col 百分比。响应式 xs/sm 等按视口宽度生效。 #### 固定标签宽度 FormItem 显式配置优先于 Form。Col 参数与 style 对象整项覆盖，不做深层合并。label-col-flex 优先于 auto-label-width；带单位字符串指定宽度，数字沿用 Col 的伸缩比例（并非 px），内容列自动填满剩余空间。隐藏标签时内容占满。 自动宽度只测量未指定 label-col-flex 的横向标签；标签文字变化、动态增删会重新对齐。多个 Form 各自计算，标签为空或移除全部字段时不会产生 Infinity/NaN。使用很长的标签时建议在窄屏切换 vertical 或设置固定宽度。
## 字段与数据模型 ### 嵌套数据 展示了多种表单项嵌套的方式。 表单控件通过 FormItem 注入的上下文继承状态和事件，无需绑定到第一子组件。 如果使用 Grid 组件进行布局，请设置 :content-flex="false" 关闭表单项内容的 flex 布局。 ### 栅格布局 展示了使用栅格布局的方式。可以使用 `label-col-flex` 的带单位字符串指定标签宽度，数字表示 Col 伸缩比例。 ### 文本与数值字段 ### 开关与勾选字段 ### 下拉选择字段 ### 层级选择字段 ### 日期字段 ### 时间字段 ### 进度与评分字段 ### 附件字段 ### 专用字段 ## 校验与提交 ### 验证表单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | -------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | | `model` | 表单数据对象 | 验证表单、跨字段校验与原生提交、清空时校验 | | `layout` | 表单的布局方式，包括水平、垂直、多列 | 清空时校验 | 展示了表单校验的使用方法。 ### 跨字段校验与原生提交 Pause cross-field validation holds the local confirmation rule until Resolve cross-field result. Completion compares its confirmation value with the current source. Native reset settles pending tasks, clears the model and submitted snapshot, retains the history count and prevents late submission. This is not remote cancellation or exhaustive dependency-race coverage. “暂停跨字段校验”示例通过手动返回结果模拟异步校验。提交等待期间修改依赖字段、重置表单或卸载组件，会使该次提交失效；确认当前输入后可重新提交。 未暂停时确认规则立即比较当前源代码。先匹配通过，再修改源代码，主动只校验确认值或重新提交会显示依赖错误；改正确认值后可按 Enter 或提交按钮提交。原生重置清空模型、反馈和上次提交值，提交次数累计不清零。依赖由业务主动复验，单纯编辑不保证已有成功态仍有效；本地示例不等于任意异步提交竞争或外部持久化。 ### 清空时校验 `validate-trigger="clear"` 只在用户点击控件的清空按钮时校验；普通输入不会触发。本例清空后显示必填错误；重新输入不会自动清除该错误，可主动校验或重置表单。 ### 空值标记与必填校验 接口用 -1 表示未选择。点击“校验”会显示必填错误；选择部门后再次校验通过。点击清空返回 -1，再次校验失败。Form 统一提供识别列表，字段单独指定清空输出；自定义校验仍收到原值。 ### 自定义表单校验状态 开启 feedback 可以让部分输入组件展示当前状态信息 ## 字段呈现与交互 ### 交互状态切换 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- | | `layout` | 表单的布局方式，包括水平、垂直、多列 | 交互状态切换、校验展示状态、桌面与移动的同场景展示 | | `model` | 表单数据对象 | 字段展示与确认提交、桌面与移动的同场景展示、滚动到指定表单字段 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用表单 | 交互状态切换 | | `readonly` | 是否将表单控件设为只读 | 交互状态切换 | | `scroll-to-error` | 验证失败后滚动到页面顺序的第一个（start）或最后一个（end）错误字段；不是视口对齐方式 | 滚动到指定表单字段 | 适用于整张表单的状态继承。调整禁用、只读，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。 ### 字段展示与确认提交 Form、FormItem、Input 和 Select 支持 edit-mode 继承，优先级为字段 > FormItem > Form。默认 direct；Cedar 支持 click/dblclick。普通 v-model 不变，弹层默认确认后提交。readPretty 不显示编辑器和搜索。direct 即时更新，弹层确认后更新；搜索框按展示位置自动排列。 ### 原位编辑的提交与切换 `click` / `dblclick` 共用事务逻辑：点击外部、Tab 离开或切换字段时先尝试保存，成功后关闭；校验失败或 `beforeCommit` 拒绝时保留草稿和错误，并阻止打开其他字段。同一文档同时只打开一个原位编辑器，包括不同 Form 和独立字段。字段自身传送到 body 的选项、日期和时间面板属于内部区域，选值不会触发外部保存。 内层面板打开时，Enter 优先选值，Esc 只关闭最上层面板并回到控件、保留字段草稿；面板关闭后，Enter 保存，Esc 取消并恢复原值。悬浮或键盘聚焦时显示编辑图标，并通过提示区分单击/双击；点击图标始终直接进入编辑。 多行文本保留 Enter 换行，Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 保存。输入法组词期间的 Enter 不提交。日期、时间面板内的单元格和列选项也只更新草稿，不误触外层保存。异步确认期间禁止重复确认、取消和切换；重置会终止保存及等待中的切换，迟到的结果不会写回。保存失败后可修改并重试。 ### 阅读空文案与配置继承 初始为阅读模式，姓名继承 Form 的默认“-”，编号使用 FormItem 的“未分配”，昵称使用字段的“匿名”，数量 0 保持可见。切换空文案只影响继承的字段；切换阅读/编辑不改模型。优先级为字段 > FormItem > Form；自定义 read 插槽优先。 ### 校验展示状态 显式 validate-status 优先于自动状态；error 才显示错误信息，其他状态显示 help。它只控制展示，不改变 validate 的真实结果。自动校验经历 validating → success/error；clearValidate 恢复未校验状态。setFields 仅传 message 会设为 error；显式 status='' 和 message='' 可清空。 ### 桌面与移动的同场景展示 桌面字段在当前位置展开面板；选择后观察已提交模型。 ### 独立面板操作区 ### 滚动到指定表单字段 展示了提交失败自动滚动到第一个错误字段和手动滚动对应字段的使用方法。 ### 确认事件来源 ## 动态与异步字段 ### 动态表单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ---------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | | `model` | 表单数据对象 | 动态表单、表单异步校验、多字段异步聚合 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用表单 | 禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序 | | `readonly` | 是否将表单控件设为只读 | 禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序 | | `rules` | 表单项校验规则 | 禁用、只读与异步确认 | 通过数据动态控制表单内容。 ### 表单异步校验 本地模拟异步校验，用户名输入 `admin` 后提交通过，其他值显示错误；不访问外部接口。原生提交/重置按钮使用 `html-type`。重置会取消本例的模拟校验并忽略旧提交结果，卸载或停用也会清理计时器。 外层标签通过 `label-attrs.for` 对应 Input 的 `id`；多个示例实例使用独立 ID，便于点击标签聚焦和辅助技术识别。 ### 多字段异步聚合 State-command addendum: public `clearValidate()` and `setFields()` also invalidate a pending native submission, including field-scoped calls. Old completion cannot append submit events after a clear or explicit error; a fresh native submission still validates normally. The imperative result is independent: an older submit must not later combine stale errors or success with the current model. A fresh native submit still waits for its own fields and notifies once. This is logical invalidation, not request cancellation, and retains submission history. Method signatures are unchanged; stale mixed notifications are not retained for compatibility. Changing model values or validation rules while waiting also invalidates that submission; submit again to validate the new inputs. “返回最新用户名结果 / 返回最新代码结果”优先结清对应字段最新任务，可让新submit先完成、旧结果最后返回。新成功后旧失败不追加提交或恢复错误；新失败后旧成功不追加提交或清除新错误。仍须等最新提交的两个字段都返回，单个字段返回不提交；默认“返回用户名/代码结果”继续返回最早任务。 年。禁用项不能作为端点，范围可以跨过它们；翻页后检查禁用项仍保持灰态。 ### 异步提交的输入归属 原生提交只接受本次校验期间保持有效的响应式模型和规则。等待中修改任意模型字段（包括其他字段或改后恢复）、替换模型/规则、修改 FormItem 的规则/required/field，或增删已注册字段，会使本次提交失效。旧校验成功或失败都不再触发 # Hover

Start with the basic example, then compare related settings before moving to controlled, asynchronous or combined use cases.

## Basic examples

### Basic usage

Preview configuration: `:hovering="hovering"`, `:focusing="focusing"`.

<demo src="./__demos__/basic.vue"></demo>

## API

### HoverOverlay Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hovering | boolean | false | Hover decoration state |
| focusing | boolean | false | Focus decoration state |

`useHoverOverlay()` returns `hovering` and `handleHovering` for directive callbacks. The overlay has no declared events, slots or business instance methods and does not capture interaction. It uses absolute positioning, so the host needs a positioning context; for standalone use import `@cedar-design/ui/hover/style`.

Object styles override only the supplied properties. Leaving or disabling restores their original inline values and `!important` priorities; changing the desktop/mobile argument removes old listeners.

## Types

### Directives

| Usage | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `v-hover="callback"` | Notifies `(hovering: boolean) => void` on mouse enter and leave |
| `v-hover="styleObject"` | Applies styles on mouse enter and restores them on leave |
| `v-hover:desktop` / `v-hover:mobile` | Enabled according to the directive's platform detection; this does not imply real touchscreen hover support |

# Hover 悬停反馈

`v-hover` 通过鼠标进入和离开更新样式或通知回调；`HoverOverlay` 根据显式的悬停与聚焦状态绘制装饰遮层。两者可独立组合，遮层不接管点击和键盘语义。

## 基础示例

### 悬停与焦点

将鼠标移入按钮，观察悬停状态；再通过 Tab 聚焦，观察焦点状态。示例使用原生按钮语义，悬停指令自身只处理 mouseenter / mouseleave，键盘焦点由宿主事件传入。

<demo src="./__demos__/basic.vue"></demo>

## API

### 指令

| 用法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `v-hover="callback"` | 鼠标进入和离开时通知 `(hovering: boolean) => void` |
| `v-hover="styleObject"` | 鼠标进入时应用样式，离开时恢复 |
| `v-hover:desktop` / `v-hover:mobile` | 按指令的端侧判断启用，不代表支持真实触屏悬停 |

### HoverOverlay Props

| 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| hovering | boolean | false | 悬停装饰状态 |
| focusing | boolean | false | 焦点装饰状态 |

`useHoverOverlay()` 返回 `hovering` 与 `handleHovering`，可连接指令回调。遮层不提供声明事件、插槽或业务实例方法，不接管交互；遮层使用绝对定位，宿主需提供定位上下文；独立使用时引入 `@cedar-design/ui/hover/style`。

对象样式只覆盖传入的属性，离开或停用时恢复这些属性原有的内联值和 `!important` 优先级；动态切换 desktop/mobile 参数会清理旧监听。

You can use the **SVG Symbol JS** or **Web Component JS** generated by an IconPark custom project directly. Exporting individual SVG files or generating a Vue component for every icon is optional. These are SVG resource mechanisms, separate from loading text fonts with `@font-face`.

The public `@icon-park/vue-next` component package and your custom project's JS are separate resource sources. Installing the public package does not automatically include your team's uploaded or maintained icons.

| Approach | Resource source | Rendering | Loading unit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SVG Symbol JS | Custom project script | `svg` / `use` in the default slot | The icon collection in that file |
| Web Component JS | Custom project script | A custom element in the default slot | Depends on the generated implementation; do not assume individual icon loading |
| Individual SVG Vue components | Local files or a component package | Vue components in the default slot | Imported modules, subject to build configuration |

SVG Symbol is a suitable starting point: it reuses the Icon container without configuring Vue custom element recognition.

**Current API:** `CIcon` does not have a `symbol` prop and does not download, register or inject IconPark resources. The examples below use the existing default slot. `name` only resolves icon components registered in the current Vue application; it does not resolve Symbol IDs or Web Component icon names. Default slot content takes precedence over `name`.

#### SVG Symbol: load the project script

Copy the **SVG Symbol** script URL from your custom project and load it once in the application's HTML entry, such as `index.html` in a Vite application:

```html
<!-- Example path: replace with your project URL or a locally deployed copy -->
<script src="/icons/project-symbol.js" defer></script>
```

After execution, the script should inject an SVG collection containing `symbol` nodes into the page. The application owns the resource URL and decides whether to use a remote URL or a deployed static file. The component library does not embed business project URLs. Load the script type you chose; using the same collection does not require loading both script variants.

#### SVG Symbol: reference an icon

Suppose the script injects `<symbol id="project-home" viewBox="0 0 48 48">`. You can render it as follows. Paths and IDs in these examples are placeholders; use the values in your generated output.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon as CIcon } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import '@cedar-design/ui/icon/style'
</script>

<template>
  <c-icon :size="24" color="#1677ff">
    <svg width="1em" height="1em" aria-hidden="true">
      <use href="#project-home" />
    </svg>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

`href` uses the complete Symbol ID with a leading `#`. Display names, the library's `name` prop and IconPark icon names may differ from the Symbol ID. Do not invent or strip prefixes; inspect `symbol[id]` in developer tools. This references resources injected into the current page: do not use `href="project.js#project-home"`.

`size` sets the container's font size, and the inner SVG follows it through `1em`. `rotate` and `spin` affect the entire container. Without an explicit `size`, normal Icon size inheritance applies. Preserve the generated Symbol's `viewBox` to avoid clipping or incorrect scaling.

#### An application wrapper for shorter usage

Create an application component named `ProjectIcon.vue` if you want to pass an ID as a prop. This requires neither a library API change nor a generated Vue file for each icon:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon as CIcon } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import '@cedar-design/ui/icon/style'

defineProps<{ symbol: string }>()
</script>

<template>
  <c-icon>
    <svg width="1em" height="1em" aria-hidden="true">
      <use :href="`#${symbol}`" />
    </svg>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

Use it in the application:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import ProjectIcon from './ProjectIcon.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <ProjectIcon symbol="project-home" :size="24" color="#1677ff" />
</template>
```

Here, `symbol` belongs to the application wrapper and excludes `#`. Undeclared attributes such as `size`, `color`, `rotate` and `spin` fall through to the single `CIcon` root. Forward `$attrs` explicitly if you add multiple roots or disable `inheritAttrs`. The existing `transition` prop only animates `CIcon`'s `name` changes; it does not animate Symbol reference changes inside the slot.

#### Web Component: script and compiler configuration

Alternatively, load your project's **Web Component JS** and place its registered element in the slot. The following assumes the generated element is named `iconpark-icon` and uses a `name` attribute. Confirm element names, attributes and theme support against your project's generated usage instructions.

```html
<!-- Application HTML entry; use the Web Component variant here -->
<script src="/icons/project-web-component.js" defer></script>
```

Configure the build that compiles Vue SFCs containing this tag to recognize the custom element. For Vite:

```ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    vue({
      template: {
        compilerOptions: {
          isCustomElement: (tag) => tag === 'iconpark-icon',
        },
      },
    }),
  ],
})
```

Merge this into the existing Vue plugin configuration instead of adding a duplicate plugin. `isCustomElement` is a compile-time setting; setting only `app.config.compilerOptions` does not replace this configuration when using a build tool. Configure the library build when the tag is wrapped inside library source, or the application build when application source uses the tag directly.

```vue
<template>
  <c-icon :size="24" color="#1677ff">
    <iconpark-icon name="project-home" size="1em"></iconpark-icon>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

This example uses the application's existing `c-icon` import or registration. The outer `CIcon` does not automatically forward theme, stroke width or other attributes to slot content. Set supported attributes directly on the custom element. If it uses Shadow DOM, external `.c-icon svg` rules cannot directly style its inner SVG; use the element's supported attributes, inherited styles or CSS variables.

#### Size, color and multicolor icons

| Setting | Behavior and limitations |
| --- | --- |
| `size` | Symbol examples inherit through `1em`; check the Web Component's own sizing API |
| `color` | Works only when the graphic uses `currentColor` or supports corresponding inheritance |
| Fixed `fill` / `stroke` | Colors embedded in the graphic are not automatically overridden by the container's `color` |
| Multicolor icons | Preserve their colors; avoid forcing a single `fill` or `stroke` across all paths |
| Themes and stroke width | Depend on generated output; public Vue icon package props do not automatically apply to project scripts |

#### On-demand loading and bundle size

Importing components on demand and loading icon resources are independent. Slot usage does not make `CIcon` depend on the entire IconPark package, and existing Resolver imports still work. The Resolver does not load resources based on a `use` ID.

A Symbol script that injects a collection loads that entire file. If it contains 200 icons and a page references three, all 200 are still downloaded and injected. `href="#project-home"` selects a graphic; it does not request an individual icon. A static script is outside the application's module tree-shaking analysis, and string IDs do not automatically remove unused Symbols.

| Goal | Approach |
| --- | --- |
| Small collection reused across pages | Load once at application entry and reuse the browser cache by file version |
| Large collection with distinct business modules | Split resources into shared and module collections; load each when its route or module needs it |
| Render the page before loading icons | Manage loading, failure and placeholder states in the application; show icons when resources are ready |
| Require individual icons to participate in tree shaking | Use separate SVG modules or Vue components and verify package exports and actual build output |

Remote JS is outside the library's npm package but still contributes to application download size. Updating the project requires updating generated resources and their cache versions. The component library's build size alone does not describe page cost.

#### Loading order, SSR and accessibility

- Make static resources available when icons are needed. For dynamic loading, wait for successful script execution. For Web Components, `customElements.whenDefined('iconpark-icon')` can additionally wait for registration; it neither downloads the script nor automatically settles on a resource loading failure.
- Load each resource once per application instead of inserting a script on every component mount. Keep Symbol IDs unique across collections to avoid conflicting references.
- Do not execute scripts requiring `window`, `document` or `customElements` on the server. Use HTML scripts or client lifecycle loading. When rendering conditionally, keep server and initial client placeholders consistent. Icons remain invisible until their resources exist; strict first-paint requirements need server-inlined Symbols or individual SVGs.
- Use `aria-hidden="true"` for decorative SVGs. Give standalone informative SVGs `role="img"` and an accessible name. Give icon-only buttons an `aria-label` on the button itself.

#### Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Check |
| --- | --- |
| Blank icon | Successful script execution, correct script variant, exact ID and nonzero container size |
| `Failed to resolve component: iconpark-icon` | Compile-time `isCustomElement` configuration for the source containing the tag |
| Color does not change | Fixed graphic colors or the Web Component's supported color interface |
| Size does not follow `CIcon` | Inner SVG / element sizing through `1em` and any fixed pixel dimensions |
| Old icon after a project update | Current script version and browser / CDN caching |
| Works locally but fails after deployment | Resource base paths, network requests, CSP `script-src` and script execution errors |
| Wrong icon with multiple collections | Symbol ID collisions, duplicate scripts and the unique IDs in actual output |

References: [Vue and Web Components](https://vuejs.org/guide/extras/web-components), [SVG use element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Element/use).

## API

### Standalone icon styles and usage boundaries

Resolver auto-imports include the lightweight rotation styles for standalone icons. With `importStyle: false`, applications must import those styles. The UI Icon style entry also includes them; loading every icon is unnecessary.

When manually importing standalone SVG components, import this stylesheet once in your application entry when using `spin`:

```ts
import '@cedar-design/icons-vue/style.css'
```

`rotate` and `spin` can be combined; built-in rotation respects reduced motion. `transition` controls registered-name changes only, using milliseconds as a number or numeric string, such as `200` / `"200"`; it does not parse `"200ms"` / `"1s"`. The default slot owns content and skips name-`transition` animation. Removing it immediately shows the latest name. Custom `animation-class` should avoid overriding the `transform` used for continuous rotation and should implement reduced-motion behavior.

`name` only resolves icons explicitly registered in the current application before rendering; it does not download resources. Registration after mount does not refresh an existing icon automatically. The container's native `title` is not forwarded to its SVG. Set `title` on standalone icons for image naming, and use an accessibly named Button for actions. `click` is a notification supporting Vue `.once`; listener Promises do not manage waiting. `stroke-*` affects strokes only; filled or fixed multicolor artwork may not respond.

## Usage notes



Only resolves icons registered in the current application. Repeated name changes display the latest requested icon, and unmounting stops pending switches.

Icons inherit the host font size on both platforms. For a fixed 20px icon, set size="20" or icon-size explicitly. The size prop overrides the variable; color inherits from the host by default.

### Motion

Built-in motion follows prefers-reduced-motion: reduce: content and state feedback remain, while decorative spinning, shimmer and ripples stop. Icon name changes display the latest value immediately and cancel unfinished phases, keeping CSS and JS durations aligned. Callers must adapt custom animation classes. Ripple duration/cleanup follows Ripple documentation; its historical 250ms rule is not an Icon duration limit.

### 接入 IconPark 自定义项目

IconPark 自定义项目提供的 **SVG Symbol JS** 和 **Web Component JS** 都可以直接接入，不需要逐个导出 SVG，也不需要为每个图标生成 Vue 组件。它们是 SVG 资源方案，与通过 `@font-face` 加载文字字体不同。

`@icon-park/vue-next` 提供的公共图标组件与自定义项目 JS 是不同的资源入口；安装公共图标包不会自动包含团队上传或维护的自定义图标。

| 方式 | 图标资源来源 | 使用方式 | 加载粒度 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SVG Symbol JS | 自定义项目生成的 JS | 默认插槽放入 `svg` / `use` | 该 JS 包含的图标集合 |
| Web Component JS | 自定义项目生成的 JS | 默认插槽放入自定义元素 | 以生成产物的实现为准，不能假定逐图标加载 |
| 独立 SVG Vue 组件 | 本地图标文件或组件包 | 默认插槽放入 Vue 图标组件 | 按模块导入，具体取决于打包配置 |

建议先使用 SVG Symbol：它可以复用 Icon 容器，并且不需要配置 Vue 自定义元素识别。

**当前 API 边界：** `CIcon` 没有 `symbol` 属性，也不会自动下载、注册或注入 IconPark 资源。本文通过现有默认插槽接入；`name` 只解析当前 Vue 应用已注册的图标组件，不能用于查找 Symbol ID 或 Web Component 图标名称。默认插槽优先于 `name`。

#### SVG Symbol：加载项目 JS

从 IconPark 自定义项目复制 **SVG Symbol** 类型的 JS 地址，在业务应用的 HTML 入口加载一次。例如 Vite 应用的 `index.html`：

```html
<!-- 示例路径：替换为自定义项目生成的 JS 地址，或部署到此路径的本地副本 -->
<script src="/icons/project-symbol.js" defer></script>
```

脚本执行后，应在页面中注入带有 `symbol` 节点的 SVG 集合。组件库不内置业务项目地址；由应用决定使用远程地址还是随应用部署的静态文件。Web Component 和 Symbol 两种 JS 按选定方式加载即可，不需要为了同一个图标集合同时引入两份。

#### SVG Symbol：引用图标

假设脚本注入了 `<symbol id="project-home" viewBox="0 0 48 48">`，可以这样使用。以下路径和 ID 均为示例，以实际生成产物为准。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon as CIcon } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import '@cedar-design/ui/icon/style'
</script>

<template>
  <c-icon :size="24" color="#1677ff">
    <svg width="1em" height="1em" aria-hidden="true">
      <use href="#project-home" />
    </svg>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

`href` 指向页面中的完整 Symbol ID，包含 `#`。显示名称、组件库的 `name`、项目中的图标名称不一定等于 Symbol ID；不要自行添加或移除前缀。可在开发者工具中检查 `symbol[id]`。这里使用的是 JS 注入的页面内资源，不能写成 `href="项目.js#project-home"`。

`size` 控制外层字号，内部 SVG 使用 `1em` 跟随尺寸；`rotate`、`spin` 作用于整个容器。没有显式 `size` 时沿用 Icon 的尺寸继承规则。Symbol 应保留生成产物中的 `viewBox`，避免图形裁剪或缩放异常。

#### 在业务层封装简写

如果需要按 ID 传参，可以增加一个业务组件 `ProjectIcon.vue`，无需修改组件库或生成每个图标的 Vue 文件：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon as CIcon } from '@cedar-design/ui'
import '@cedar-design/ui/icon/style'

defineProps<{ symbol: string }>()
</script>

<template>
  <c-icon>
    <svg width="1em" height="1em" aria-hidden="true">
      <use :href="`#${symbol}`" />
    </svg>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

业务调用：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import ProjectIcon from './ProjectIcon.vue'
</script>

<template>
  <ProjectIcon symbol="project-home" :size="24" color="#1677ff" />
</template>
```

这里的 `symbol` 属于业务组件 `ProjectIcon`，传值不包含 `#`；`size`、`color`、`rotate`、`spin` 等未声明属性通过 Vue 的单根属性透传交给 `CIcon`。若封装组件增加多个根节点或关闭 `inheritAttrs`，需要显式转发 `$attrs`。`transition` 目前只控制 `CIcon` 的 `name` 切换，不会为插槽内的 Symbol 引用切换提供动画。

#### Web Component：加载与编译配置

也可以加载自定义项目提供的 **Web Component JS**，然后在插槽中使用其注册的元素。以下假设生成产物使用 `iconpark-icon` 标签和 `name` 属性，实际名称、属性及可配置主题以项目生成的使用说明为准。

```html
<!-- 放在业务应用的 HTML 入口；这是 Web Component 版本的 JS -->
<script src="/icons/project-web-component.js" defer></script>
```

在使用该标签的 Vue SFC 的构建配置中，将它识别为自定义元素。Vite 示例：

```ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    vue({
      template: {
        compilerOptions: {
          isCustomElement: (tag) => tag === 'iconpark-icon',
        },
      },
    }),
  ],
})
```

把配置合并到现有的 Vue 插件配置中，不要重复添加插件。`isCustomElement` 是编译时选项；使用构建工具时，仅设置 `app.config.compilerOptions` 不能替代上面的配置。如果组件库内部封装了该标签，应在组件库编译时配置；业务源码直接使用时，应在业务构建中配置。

```vue
<template>
  <c-icon :size="24" color="#1677ff">
    <iconpark-icon name="project-home" size="1em"></iconpark-icon>
  </c-icon>
</template>
```

示例沿用项目已有的 `c-icon` 导入或注册配置。外层 `CIcon` 不会自动把主题、线宽等属性传给插槽中的元素；请按生成产物支持的 API 直接设置。若元素使用 Shadow DOM，外部 `.c-icon svg` 样式不能直接设置内部 SVG；尺寸和颜色应通过该元素支持的属性、继承样式或 CSS 变量设置。

#### 尺寸、颜色与多色图标

| 配置 | 实际效果与限制 |
| --- | --- |
| `size` | Symbol 示例通过 `1em` 继承容器尺寸；Web Component 需要确认自身尺寸 API |
| `color` | 只有图形使用 `currentColor` 或支持相应继承机制时才生效 |
| 固定 `fill` / `stroke` | 图形内部写死的颜色不会被外层 `color` 自动覆盖 |
| 多色图标 | 保留原有颜色，不建议对所有路径统一强制覆盖 `fill` 或 `stroke` |
| 主题与线宽 | 取决于生成产物能力，不能把公共 Vue 图标包的属性直接套用到项目 JS |

#### 按需加载与体积

组件的按需引入与图标资源的加载是两件事。使用插槽不会让 `CIcon` 自动依赖整个 IconPark 包，现有 Resolver 的按需导入方式仍然适用；Resolver 也不会根据 `use` 的 ID 自动加载图标资源。

对于一次性注入集合的 Symbol JS，加载单位是整个文件。例如项目文件包含 200 个图标，即使页面只引用 3 个，也会下载并注入该文件中的 200 个图标。`href="#project-home"` 只选择要显示的图形，不会触发单个图标的网络请求。静态脚本不进入业务模块的 tree-shaking 分析，字符串 ID 也不会让未使用的 Symbol 被自动裁剪。

| 目标 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 集合较小、多个页面频繁复用 | 应用入口加载一次，按文件版本复用浏览器缓存 |
| 集合较大、模块之间差异明显 | 在资源侧拆分公共集合和业务集合，在对应路由或模块需要时加载 |
| 希望先渲染页面，再加载图标 | 业务维护加载完成、失败和占位状态，资源可用后显示图标 |
| 必须逐个图标参与打包裁剪 | 使用独立 SVG 模块或 Vue 组件，并验证组件包导出和构建工具的裁剪结果 |

远程 JS 不会进入组件库 npm 包，但仍计入应用实际下载体积。新增或删除图标后需要更新项目产物并处理缓存版本；不要只依据组件库的构建体积判断页面成本。

#### 加载时机、SSR 与可访问性

- 静态脚本应在需要使用图标时可用；动态加载应等待脚本成功执行。Web Component 还可通过 `customElements.whenDefined('iconpark-icon')` 等待元素注册，该方法不负责下载脚本，也不表示资源加载失败会自动结束等待。
- 一个应用统一加载相同资源一次，避免组件每次挂载都创建脚本。多个集合中的 Symbol ID 应保持唯一，避免同名图形互相覆盖或引用错误。
- SSR 环境中，不要在服务端执行依赖 `window`、`document`、`customElements` 的项目脚本。通过 HTML 脚本或客户端生命周期加载；需要条件渲染时，让服务端和客户端首次渲染的占位内容一致。图形资源尚未注入时不会显示，严格要求首屏图标的场景需另行准备服务端内联 Symbol 或独立 SVG。
- 装饰性 SVG 使用 `aria-hidden="true"`。独立传递信息的 SVG 应设置 `role="img"` 和可访问名称；只有图标的按钮应给按钮设置 `aria-label`，不能仅靠图标表达操作。

#### 常见问题

| 问题 | 检查项 |
| --- | --- |
| 图标空白 | 脚本是否成功执行、是否选对 JS 类型、完整 ID 是否存在、容器尺寸是否为零 |
| `Failed to resolve component: iconpark-icon` | 使用标签的源码是否在编译时配置了 `isCustomElement` |
| 图标颜色不变 | 图形是否使用固定颜色，或 Web Component 是否提供了颜色设置接口 |
| 尺寸不跟随 `CIcon` | 内部 SVG / 自定义元素是否使用 `1em`，是否存在固定像素尺寸 |
| 更新项目后仍显示旧图标 | 页面是否加载了新版本 JS，浏览器或 CDN 缓存是否已更新 |
| 本地正常，部署后空白 | 检查静态资源基础路径、网络请求、CSP 的 `script-src` 及脚本执行错误 |
| 多项目图标显示错误 | 检查 Symbol ID 冲突和重复加载，使用资源产物实际提供的唯一 ID |

参考：[Vue 与 Web Components](https://cn.vuejs.org/guide/extras/web-components)、[SVG use 元素](https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/SVG/Reference/Element/use)。

## API

### 独立图标样式与使用边界

Resolver 自动导入独立图标时会一并引入轻量旋转样式；`importStyle: false` 时由业务自行引入。UI Icon 的样式入口也包含这份样式，不需要加载全部图标。

手动导入独立 SVG 组件时，若使用 `spin`，请在应用入口引入一次：

```ts
import '@cedar-design/icons-vue/style.css'
```

`rotate` 与 `spin` 可以组合；内置旋转遵循减少动态效果设置。`transition` 只控制注册名称的切换，以毫秒数值或数字字符串传入（如 `200` / `"200"`），不解析 `"200ms"` / `"1s"`。默认插槽接管内容后不执行名称切换动画，移除插槽时立即显示最新名称。自定义 `animation-class` 应避免覆盖持续旋转使用的 `transform`，并自行适配减少动态效果设置。

`name` 只查找当前应用在渲染前显式注册的图标，不自动下载资源；挂载后补注册不会自动刷新。容器的原生 `title` 不会传给内部 SVG，需要图像名称时在独立图标上设置 `title`；作为操作入口时使用带可访问名称的 Button。`click` 是普通通知事件，支持 Vue 的 `.once`，不会根据监听器返回的 Promise 管理等待状态。`stroke-*` 只作用于描边，填充或固定多色资源不保证随这些属性变化。

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Previous/next preview navigation, horizontal keys and swipes follow reading direction without reversing the value array. Direction changes cancel unfinished gestures while preserving the current image, zoom and rotation. Images and zoomed drag coordinates are not mirrored automatically. Image indices retain LTR numeric display.

## API

ImagePreviewGroup binds a one-based image number through ordinary `v-model`; `defaultValue` initializes the uncontrolled index. Panel opening uses `v-model:open` and `defaultOpen` independently. Programmatic preview options also use modelValue/`defaultValue` and onUpdate:modelValue.

When `images` is omitted or `undefined`, the group collects previewable child Images in DOM order; updating a child URL preserves its identity and position. An explicitly supplied array is the source, and `[]` means no images. Set it back to `undefined` to resume child collection. In array mode use the group `open` / `to` methods to select an image; child Images do not map themselves to array indices.

Public indices start at 1. The displayed index is clamped when data shrinks, and child reordering preserves the selected image identity. A controlled `modelValue` receives an update request when adjustment is needed; its owner can accept or reject it. No preview content is shown when the list is empty; the open state remains, so content may reappear when images return.

A previewable image exposes a named button action supporting Tab, Enter and Space. When preview closes, focus returns to its opener if focus is still in the preview or has fallen to the document body. The action is absent when preview is disabled or the image has failed. Explicit `alt=""` stays empty; a previewable decorative image still has a separately named preview action. When `alt` is omitted, `imgProps.alt`, `description`, then `loadDescription` supply the fallback.

When keyboard shortcuts are enabled, only the topmost preview handles arrow keys and Space. Inputs, editable regions and other interactive controls retain their own key behavior.

`Image.showPreview()` requests the current image preview. The `imagePreview`, `previewImage`, and `ImagePreviewFn` service accepts a URL, URL array, or options and returns `ImagePreviewHandle | undefined` (for example during SSR). Its handle offers the 12 Group operations; paging operations have no effect for a single image. The service also exposes `close()`, `setDefaultOptions()`, and `resetDefaultOptions()`. Native `lazy` is browser-scheduled and does not promise automatic retries.

Scale parameters must be finite and positive; invalid min/max/default/step values fall back to 0.5/8/1/0.5. If max is below min it resolves to min. Initial and reset scales are clamped, changes to bounds clamp the current value, and `zoomTo` ignores nonfinite input. `close` in `actionsLayout` is a toolbar action, independent of the separate button controlled by `closable`.

### ImagePreview Methods

Replacing an imperative preview disposes the previous instance and invokes its `onClosed` once, just like normal closure. Use this callback to release owned resources such as Object URLs. Old handles never close newer previews. If `onClosed` synchronously opens a new preview, that newer call wins and the interrupted outer call returns `undefined`.

## FAQ

### `image-preview` prop notes

1. Set `keyboard` to `true` to enable preview shortcuts independently of `actions-layout`. Escape is controlled by `esc-to-close`.

- `esc`: close the preview
- `left`: previous image
- `right`: next image
- `up`: zoom in
- `down`: zoom out
- `space`: restore original size

2. `defaultScale` sets the initial zoom ratio. For example, 1.5 initially displays the image at 1.5 times its original size.

3. `scaleStep` sets the zoom increment for wheel, double-click and toolbar actions.

### Image-preview group numbering

`modelValue/defaultValue` start at `1`. `open(imageNumber = 1)` and `to(imageNumber)` use the same numbering; invalid/noninteger values are ignored. `prev()/next()` retain this numbering at loop boundaries. Model events are `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`; navigation emits `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`, while external assignments do not. Long press emits `long-press(imageNumber)`; the indicator slot receives `{ imageNumber, length }`. Internal array indices remain zero-based.

Root `class` and `style` merge with the Image wrapper. Use `img-props.class/style` to `style` the inner image. Preview `open-change` is a Vue notification event: each state transition emits once, `.once` uses Vue event semantics, and returned Promises do not control loading. The typed `onOpenChange` listener uses this same event path.

### Custom styling

`--c-image-preview-arrow-font-size` controls preview-group arrows. Use preview-color-action-* and preview-padding-action-content for the toolbar, and footer variables for the bottom bar. ## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。预览集合的上一张/下一张、水平键与滑动沿阅读方向工作，值数组不反转。方向切换取消尚未完成的手势并保持当前图片、缩放与旋转；图片本身和放大后的拖拽坐标不自动镜像。图片序号保持 LTR 数值显示。

## API

`images` 未提供或为 `undefined` 时收集可预览的子 Image，并随实际 DOM 顺序变化；子图片地址更新不会改变其身份或顺序。显式提供数组时只使用数组，`[]` 表示空集合；切回 `undefined` 后恢复子图片模式。数组模式下请使用组的 `open` / `to` 方法选择图片，子图片不负责映射数组索引。

索引对外从 1 开始。数据减少时显示索引会限制在有效范围内；子图片重排时保留当前图片身份。受控 `modelValue` 需要调整时会发出更新请求，父级可自行接受或拒绝；无图片时不显示预览内容，既有 open 状态保留，数据再次出现时可能恢复显示。

可预览的图片提供具名按钮语义，支持 Tab、Enter 和 Space；预览关闭时，如果焦点仍在预览内或已回到页面主体，会尝试返回打开预览前的焦点。关闭预览功能或图片加载失败时不提供该入口。显式 `alt=""` 保持为空；可预览的装饰图仍通过独立的预览操作名称提供可访问入口。`alt` 未提供时依次使用 `imgProps.alt`、`description` 和 `loadDescription`。

开启键盘快捷键时，仅顶层预览处理方向键与空格；输入框、可编辑区域和其他交互控件保留自身按键行为。

`Image.showPreview()` 请求打开当前可预览图片；服务 `imagePreview`、`previewImage` 和 `ImagePreviewFn` 接受 URL、URL 数组或配置对象，返回 `ImagePreviewHandle | undefined`（例如 SSR）。返回的 handle 提供 Group 的 12 项能力，单图中不适用的翻页调用无效果。服务还提供 `close()`、`setDefaultOptions()` 和 `resetDefaultOptions()`。原生 `lazy` 由浏览器调度，不承诺自动重试。

缩放参数必须为有限正数；无效的 min/max/default/step 分别回退 0.5/8/1/0.5，若 max 小于 min 则按 min 处理。初始与重置缩放限制在区间内；边界变化会夹紧当前值，`zoomTo` 忽略非有限值。`actionsLayout` 中的 `close` 是工具栏关闭动作，与 `closable` 控制的独立关闭按钮分别配置。

### ImagePreview Methods

命令式预览被新的调用替换时，会清理旧实例并触发旧实例的 `onClosed`；与正常关闭一样，每个实例只通知一次，可用于释放 Object URL 等资源。旧句柄不会关闭后来打开的预览。若 `onClosed` 内同步打开新的预览，保留该新调用，外层调用返回 `undefined`。

- `esc`: 关闭预览
- `left`: 切换至上一张图片
- `right`: 切换至下一张图片
- `up`: 放大图片
- `down`: 缩小图片
- `space`: 还原至原始大小

2. 默认缩放比例 `defaultScale` 此属性定义了默认的图片缩放比例。例如，当设置为 1.5 时，图片将默认放大到原始大小的 1.5 倍。

3. `scaleStep` 控制滚轮、双击和工具栏每次放大或缩小的增量。

### 图片预览组序号

`modelValue/defaultValue` 从 **1** 开始，`1` 表示第 1 张。`open(imageNumber = 1)`、`to(imageNumber)` 接收相同序号，无效或非整数序号会被忽略。`prev()/next()` 在循环边界也回传同一规则的序号。模型事件为 `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`，切换通知为 `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`；外部赋值不补发切换通知。长按通知为 `long-press(imageNumber)`，指示器插槽参数为 `{ imageNumber, length }`。内部数组下标仍从 0 开始。

根节点 `class`、`style` 与 Image 容器样式合并；内部图片样式通过 `img-props.class/style` 设置。预览的 `open-change` 是 Vue 通知事件：每次状态切换只发送一次，`.once` 遵循 Vue 事件语义，返回 Promise 不控制 loading。类型中的 `onOpenChange` 监听器也走同一事件入口。

When `target` is a selector, its element must exist when binding occurs. `check()` uses the current binding and does not resolve the selector again; pass the element or change `target` to rebind. Accept the emitted `loading` via `v-model:status`, then set `idle`, `error`, or `finished` when the request settles; assigning the original `idle` alone does not release the request lock. A negative numeric offset requires scrolling past the bottom. String offsets are resolved as CSS widths: negative lengths fall back to zero, and percentages use the measurement element’s CSS containing-block width.

## API

| Parameter | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| status | Pagination state; supports `v-model:status` | `'idle' \| 'loading' \| 'error' \| 'finished'` | `'idle'` |

| immediate | Whether to check immediately after mounting and resolving the scroll container | `boolean` | `true` |
| disabled | Pause loading and retry | `boolean` | `false` |
| target | Scroll container; defaults to the nearest scrolling ancestor | `string \| HTMLElement` | `-` |

### InfiniteScroll Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | --------- |
| update:status | Requests pagination status `loading` | `loading` |
| load | Emitted when idle and the threshold is reached | - |
| retry | Emitted when retry is invoked in the error state | - |

`retry` does not also emit `load`. Both events may call the same business request function.

### InfiniteScroll Methods

| Method | Description |
| ------ | ---------------------------- |
| check | Immediately check whether the loading threshold is reached |
| retry | Request a retry in the `error` state |

### InfiniteScroll Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| -------- | ---------------- | ------------------- |
| default | Observed content | - |
| loading | Pagination loading state | - |
| error | Pagination error state | `retry: () => void` |
| finished | All-pages-loaded state | - |

The default error area retries on click. `finished` is terminal; detection resumes only when the parent resets `status` to `idle`.

# InfiniteScroll

InfiniteScroll 负责检测接近滚动底部并驱动分页状态，不负责请求、数据拼接或列表布局。通常与 `List` 组合使用。

## 基础示例

### 与列表组合

`status` 是唯一分页状态。组件触底时先同步更新为 `loading`，再触发 `load`；请求结束后由业务更新为 `idle`、`error` 或 `finished`。

<demo src="./__demos__/list.vue"></demo>

## 内容与展示

### 加载失败

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | 分页状态，支持 `v-model:status` | 加载失败 |
| `target` | 滚动容器；未传时使用最近滚动父级 | 加载失败 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

请求失败时将 `status` 设置为 `error`。默认错误区域和 `error` 插槽都可以触发 `retry`，重试事件不会额外触发 `load`。

<demo src="./__demos__/error.vue"></demo>

自定义重试操作请使用按钮，支持键盘 Enter/Space。示例中的模拟请求会在卸载或停用时清理计时器，避免离开页面后继续回写。

基础、自定义状态和错误重试示例均清理模拟请求；KeepAlive 恢复后可从 idle 状态重新加载，不复用取消前的计时器。

## 自定义与插槽

### 自定义状态

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | 分页状态，支持 `v-model:status` | 自定义状态 |
| `target` | 滚动容器；未传时使用最近滚动父级 | 自定义状态 |
| `bottom-offset` | 距离底部的触发阈值，数字按 px，字符串按 CSS length | 自定义状态 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

通过 `loading`、`finished` 插槽自定义底部状态，同时可使用 CSS 长度设置 `bottom-offset`。

<demo src="./__demos__/custom-status.vue"></demo>

虚拟列表场景应将 `target` 指向实际虚拟滚动容器，并在追加数据后把 `status` 改回 `idle`；必要时调用 `check()`。

## 生命周期与边界

### 测量绑定生命周期

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | 分页状态，支持 `v-model:status` | 测量绑定生命周期 |
| `target` | 滚动容器；未传时使用最近滚动父级 | 测量绑定生命周期 |
| `immediate` | 挂载并解析滚动容器后是否立即检查 | 测量绑定生命周期 |
<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

<demo src="./__demos__/scheduler-lifecycle.vue"></demo>

`target` 为选择器时，目标必须在绑定时已存在；`check()` 只检查当前绑定，不重新解析选择器。目标稍后出现时，请改传元素或变更 `target` 触发重新绑定。使用 `v-model:status` 接收组件发出的 `loading`，请求结束后再设为 `idle`、`error` 或 `finished`；仅重复赋值原来的 `idle` 不会解除请求锁。数字负阈值表示越过底部后才触发；字符串作为 CSS 宽度解析，负长度无效并回退 0，百分比按测量元素的 CSS 包含块宽度计算。

## API

### InfiniteScroll Props

| 参数名        | 描述                                               | 类型                                           | 默认值   |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| status        | 分页状态，支持 `v-model:status`                    | `'idle' \| 'loading' \| 'error' \| 'finished'` | `'idle'` |
| bottom-offset | 距离底部的触发阈值，数字按 px，字符串按 CSS length | `string \| number`                             | `0`      |
| immediate     | 挂载并解析滚动容器后是否立即检查                   | `boolean`                                      | `true`   |
| disabled      | 是否暂停加载和重试                                 | `boolean`                                      | `false`  |
| target        | 滚动容器；未传时使用最近滚动父级                   | `string \| HTMLElement`                        | `-`      |

### InfiniteScroll Events

| 事件名        | 描述                       | 参数      |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | --------- |
| update:status | 请求分页状态改为 `loading` | `loading` |
| load          | 空闲状态下到达阈值时触发   | -         |
| retry         | 错误状态下调用重试时触发   | -         |

`retry` 不会同时触发 `load`。业务可让两个事件调用同一个请求函数。

### InfiniteScroll Methods

| 方法名 | 描述                         |
| ------ | ---------------------------- |
| check  | 立即检查当前是否到达加载阈值 |
| retry  | 在 `error` 状态下发起重试    |

### InfiniteScroll Slots

| 插槽名   | 描述             | 参数                |
| -------- | ---------------- | ------------------- |
| default  | 被监听的内容     | -                   |
| loading  | 分页加载状态     | -                   |
| error    | 分页失败状态     | `retry: () => void` |
| finished | 全部加载完成状态 | -                   |

默认错误区域可点击重试。`finished` 是终态，只有外部将 `status` 重置为 `idle` 后才会恢复检测。

### Shared field loading

## Composition input

IME composition preserves the native text being entered; external model updates do not replace it before completion. Existing formatting and controlled-owner acceptance apply afterward. Queued restoration from an earlier input cannot replace a later edit's text or caret. Numeric updates still follow model-event, with unchanged blur/Enter commit timing.

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.



`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`--c-field-caret-color` sets the shared caret color, defaulting to `currentColor`. `--c-input-number-caret-color` overrides this component and defaults to `var(--c-field-caret-color)`.

Explicit beforeCommit waiting uses the existing loadingMode indicator and sets aria-busy on the actual input. Manual loading remains business-owned and does not imply readonly; beforeCommit guards retain their existing interaction lock. Notification return Promises, including change/step, do not control waiting.

Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Clear output

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Min may be finite or -Infinity; max may be finite or Infinity. Negative values and 0 are valid. Invalid individual bounds use Vue prop-validation diagnostics and fall back to their unbounded defaults. An inverted range diagnoses both bounds and becomes unbounded, without swapping values. Input commits, stepping, and ARIA share the effective bounds; clear markers still follow empty-value.

Approved clearing notifies **clear → input → update:modelValue → change**. Clear is an action notification and is not emitted after a veto. A target equal to the current model does not invent change. The default clear value is undefined; explicit empty-value may provide null or another supported numeric value.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` receives `{ value, previousValue }`; context provides `signal`. Synchronous void waits for done; true, done(), or fulfilled `Promise<void>` allows the operation. False, done(false), `Promise<false>`, throwing, or rejection cancels. Direct mode approves changed model values before committing, stepping, or clearing; `model-event="input"` also approves before publishing, without repeated approval for the same value. Pending work announces aria-busy and locks typing/stepping. External model/configuration/state changes or deactivation/unmount cancel stale work. Direct approval errors preserve the value and notify `commit-error`; deferred editing approves once at final confirmation and uses the existing panel feedback. With approval enabled, holding a button does not start repeated requests. Ordinary listener Promises are not approval tasks.

# InputNumber

InputNumber 用于编辑和提交业务数字。

- `model-value !== undefined` 表示受控；`default-value` 仅初始化非受控值。编辑草稿允许暂时不同于业务值；提交后若父组件拒绝更新，恢复到父组件值。外部回填不触发用户事件或校验。
- 默认在 Enter / 失焦时更新；`model-event="input"` 输入完整数字时更新，但 `change` 仍在提交时触发。Enter 后再失焦不会重复提交。
- 清空获准后按 **clear → input → update:modelValue → change** 通知；clear 表示动作通知，审批拒绝时不发出。清空目标与当前模型相同时不虚构 change。默认清空值为 undefined，显式 empty-value 可输出 null 或其他受支持数值。
- `-`、`.`、`1.` 等输入中间态暂时保留；提交 `1.` 得到数字 1，单独符号恢复之前的业务值。非法文本、NaN、Infinity 不会写入业务值。IME 组合输入结束后只处理一次。
- 范围优先于精度：舍入后仍限制在 min/max 内，非对齐边界保留实际值。两端采用独立配置的 Decimal 运算，不受应用修改 Decimal 全局配置影响；模型仍是 JavaScript number，不承诺任意精度的大数存储。
- 禁用/只读/尺寸从 InputGroup、FormItem、Form 继承，显式 false 可以覆盖；Cedar 的缺省尺寸再读取 ConfigProvider，Maple 使用现有默认系统。字段外观与 hint 可继承 InputGroup；外层已有 FormItem 标题时不重复显示浮动标签。
- 鼠标、触控都支持长按；释放、取消、移出、窗口失焦、组件停用/卸载或状态变化时停止。移动端建议用 button 布局增加触控面积；↑/↓ 步进，Enter 提交。

## 使用说明

### 编辑与确认

通过 `edit-mode` 配置编辑方式；未指定时依次继承 FormItem、Form，默认 `direct`。支持值：`direct / click / dblclick`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Cedar 使用 edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" 在字段附近打开编辑浮层，Enter/F2 也可进入；取消/Escape 丢弃草稿，确认后提交。readPretty 为独立阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 分开。



`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

统一光标色通过 `--c-field-caret-color` 设置（默认 `currentColor`）；本组件可用 `--c-input-number-caret-color` 单独覆盖，默认 `var(--c-field-caret-color)`。

显式 beforeCommit 等待会沿用现有 loadingMode 指示器并设置实际输入的 aria-busy。手动 loading 保持业务所有权，不会隐式只读；beforeCommit 守卫保留已有输入锁定规则。change/step 等通知返回 Promise 不控制等待。

延迟编辑的 `change` 在有来源时保留真实确认事件，例如保存按钮事件；程序触发的编辑器接力没有 DOM 事件，第二个参数可缺省。事件 target 可能是确认控件，不保证是输入元素。`change` 只通知，不等待监听器返回的 Promise；异步审批请使用 `before-commit`。

公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](/guide/empty-values/)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

### 清空输出

`empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。

`empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。

清空获准后按 **clear → input → update:modelValue → change** 通知；clear 表示动作通知，审批拒绝时不发出。清空目标与当前模型相同时不虚构 change。默认清空值为 undefined，显式 empty-value 可输出 null 或其他受支持数值。

Used to avoid style flicker when rendering on the server side. ## Reading direction Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content inherits reading direction. Sider placement=left/right remains physical; collapse and ResizeBox handle meanings do not reverse. Header and content may use their own local dir. Set a local mode with an outer ``. This component has no theme prop. Nest theme="light" for a light region; library popups follow their owning provider. ## API ### Layout Props | Prop | Description | Type | Default | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | scrollable | Native scrolling on the layout;
