constrain its height | `boolean` | `false` | ### LayoutFooter Props | Prop | Description | Type | Default | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | bordered | Show the top border | `boolean` | `false` | ### LayoutSider Props | Prop | Description | Type | Default | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | bordered | Show the border next to the content | `boolean` | `false` | | placement | Physical sider placement; RTL does not swap left/right | `'left' \| 'right'` | `'left'` | | collapse-mode | width changes available width; transform retains expanded content width and translates/clips it | `'width' \| 'transform'` | `'width'` | | collapsed | Controlled when provided; waits for parent writeback | `boolean` | `undefined` | | default-collapsed | Initial uncontrolled collapsed state | `boolean` | `false` | | collapsible | Show the default trigger; does not block external or responsive collapse | `boolean` | `false` | | width | Expanded base width; finite nonnegative pixels or a nonempty CSS width string | `number \| string` | `200` | | collapsed-width | Collapsed width; finite nonnegative pixels, with a recovery trigger at zero | `number` | `48` | | reverse-arrow | Reverse the default arrow; right placement also reverses it | `boolean` | `false` | | breakpoint | Request collapse on narrow screens after mounting; re-evaluate changed configurations immediately | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' \| 'xxl'` | `undefined` | | resize-directions | Use ResizeBox instead of the default div; physical edges, with handles removed while collapsed | `ResizeBoxDirection[]`
`ResizeBoxDirection: 'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `undefined` | | hide-trigger | Hide the default trigger; the caller supplies recovery access | `boolean` | `false` | ### LayoutSider Events | Component | Event | Parameters and meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | Layout / LayoutContent / LayoutSider | scroll | Native Event; scrolling notification | | LayoutSider | update:collapsed | boolean; collapsed-state update request | | LayoutSider | collapse | boolean and 'clickTrigger' / 'responsive'; request source | | LayoutSider | breakpoint | boolean; whether the environment requests collapse, independently of controlled state | ### LayoutSider Slots | Component | Slot | Parameters and meaning | | --- | --- | --- | | Layout / LayoutHeader / LayoutContent / LayoutFooter / LayoutSider | default | Unscoped layout content | | LayoutSider | trigger | Scope { collapsed: boolean }; rendered inside a native button, so do not nest another button | ### LayoutSider Methods Layout, LayoutContent and LayoutSider expose scrollTo(options: ScrollToOptions) and scrollTo(x: number, y: number); Header/Footer have no dedicated instance methods. ## Types The component exports the following types ```ts import type { LayoutProps } from '@cedar-design/ui' ``` ### Additional layout capabilities | Component | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Content | scrollable | boolean | false | Use this element as a native scroll container | | Header / Footer / Sider | bordered | boolean | false | Show the border next to the content | | Sider | placement | 'left' / 'right' | 'left' | Sidebar placement; handles arrows automatically, while reverse-arrow remains supported | | Sider | collapse-mode | 'width' / 'transform' | 'width' | Resize or translate content while collapsing | Layout, Content and Sider emit `scroll`(event: Event) and expose `scrollTo(options: ScrollToOptions)` / `scrollTo(x: number, y: number)`. Sider scrolls its internal content node by default. `width` accepts numeric px or CSS lengths. Percentage widths with transform mode are discouraged; use definite lengths such as px/rem. The collapse control is a native button supporting Tab, Enter and Space. With `collapsed-width="0"`, the hidden region is inert and the expansion entry stays at the sidebar edge. A custom trigger slot should contain display content without nested buttons. ## Responsive sider Breakpoint subscriptions begin after mounting; SSR retains the initial collapsed or default-collapsed state. Changing the breakpoint immediately evaluates the current viewport. Removing it stops automatic responses and keeps the current collapsed state. The xs breakpoint requests collapse at widths up to 575px; other breakpoints request collapse below their minimum width, consistently collapsing on narrow screens. The breakpoint event reports the current narrow-screen state on initial subscription and breakpoint configuration changes, then on matching-state changes, independently of collapsed. update:collapsed and collapse(..., responsive) are requested only when the target differs from the current collapsed state. Controlled mode waits for the parent to update the prop; environmental notifications still occur when the parent declines a state request. Notification events do not await promises returned by listeners. ## Resizable sider width ownership When resize-directions is provided, Sider owns the current width: expanded mode retains the most recently resized width; collapsed mode uses collapsed-width and removes resize handles; expanding restores the latest expanded width. Collapse/expand preserves content nodes and input state. A collapsed-width of zero still supports the recovery trigger outside the content area. When the width prop value changes, temporary resizing is cleared and the new numeric or CSS length value takes effect. Controlled collapsed still waits for parent writeback. Transform-mode content width and translation use the latest expanded width. Development uses Vue prop validation for enums, non-finite/negative widths and duplicate/unknown resize edges. Runtime filters/deduplicates edges, defaults invalid width/collapsed-width to 200/48 and placement to left, and does not subscribe to invalid breakpoints. Default trigger names use locale.layout.expandSider/collapseSider through global useLocale or ConfigProvider.locale. Public Props derive from actual components with typed event listeners; resizeDirections uses ResizeBoxDirection[]. ```ts import type { LayoutProps, SiderProps } from '@cedar-design/ui' const layout: LayoutProps = { onScroll: (event) => event.preventDefault() } const sider: SiderProps = { resizeDirections: ['right'], onCollapse: (collapsed, reason) => console.log(collapsed, reason) } ``` ## CSS Variables

## API

The virtual list covers the viewport first and renders `buffer` items beyond it on each side. `buffer=0` is valid. `estimatedSize` must be finite and positive, including values below 1; invalid values fall back to 30px. `fixedSize` can change dynamically. Variable-height mode uses measured and estimated heights; rows are measured on mount and unmount, not continuously after asynchronous size changes. The `item` slot receives the original index and unknown data; return a single measurable root and provide a stable `itemKey`. To convey the complete collection to assistive technology, provide `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` on application rows as appropriate.

### List Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | Data consumed by item slot | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | Outer border | boolean | true |
| split | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | boolean | true |
| loading | Initial loading/refresh feedback, not pagination state | boolean | false |
| max-height | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

Virtual lists use a dedicated viewport without nesting a custom scrollbar. virtualListProps.height overrides maxHeight; with neither, height defaults to 200px. Numeric and unit-bearing CSS lengths are accepted. Invalid/nonpositive max-height does not constrain height.

ListVirtualListProps supports height, threshold, fixedSize, estimatedSize, buffer, itemKey and component. List.data supplies data. Counts at or below threshold render all items. Variable heights use measurements and estimatedSize; buffer controls overscan rows.

ListScrollbarProps supports type: 'track'|'embed', outerClass, outerStyle, hide, disableHorizontal and disableVertical. JavaScript object fields use camelCase.

### List Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event): one notification per real scroll event.
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align }): virtual-list positioning. index overrides key; align is top/bottom/auto. auto does nothing for a fully visible item, otherwise scrolls the minimum distance required. Invalid targets or nonvirtual mode do nothing.

### List Slots

List slots: default (overrides data), item({ item, index }), header, footer, empty. Empty state appears only without a default slot/data and while not loading. ListItem prefix/default/suffix retain list-item semantics without managing buttons/business interactions.

## Types

ListProps、ListSize、ListVirtualListProps、ListScrollbarProps、ListExpose、ListSlots、ListEmits、ListInstance、ListItemInstance。

List handles display and an optional virtual viewport. Compose InfiniteScroll status/target behavior for pagination rather than duplicating its loading state machine inside List.

同时提供默认插槽与 `data` 时，默认插槽优先，`item` 插槽不会被调用。`loading` 仅表示整张列表首次加载或刷新；需要滚动分页时请使用 [InfiniteScroll](/components/infinite-scroll/) 组合。

### 无限长列表

通过指定 `virtualListProps` 来开启虚拟列表，在大量数据时获得高性能表现。
在使用虚拟列表时，如果列表元素之间高度变化较大可能导致滚动时视口出现空白区域，可通过调整 `virtualListProps.buffer`
属性解决，[使用方式](/vue/docs/faq#%E8%99%9A%E6%8B%9F%E5%88%97%E8%A1%A8%E7%9A%84%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8)。

### 虚拟定位

示例使用 `Space direction="column"` 将操作区放在列表上方，列表独占可用宽度；`estimatedSize` 是未测量行的估计高度，不要求业务行采用固定高度。

定位优先使用已渲染行的真实边界，行高测量会同步更新虚拟留白。程序滚动触发的渲染保留当前对齐；不同位置的原生滚动、新命令、数据替换、停用或卸载会取消旧补偿。`auto` 对已完整可见行不改变滚动位置和渲染窗口；这不代表持续追踪任意异步行高变化。

## API

虚拟列表先覆盖视口，再按 `buffer` 在前后预渲染；`buffer=0` 合法，`estimatedSize` 必须是有限正数（包括小于 1 的值），无效值回退 30px。`fixedSize` 可动态切换；可变高度使用已测量值和估计值，行在挂载及卸载时测量，已挂载行异步高度变化不会持续监听。`item` 插槽接收原始索引和 unknown 数据，应返回单个可测量根节点并提供稳定的 `itemKey`。需要向辅助技术表达完整集合时，可在业务行上按实际数据提供 `aria-setsize` 和 `aria-posinset`。

### List Props

| 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | 数据，与 item 插槽配合 | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | 仅实现 sm/md/lg，不支持 xs/xl | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | 外边框 | boolean | true |
| split | 头尾及列表项分隔线，与边框独立 | boolean | true |
| loading | 首次加载/刷新反馈，不管理分页 | boolean | false |
| max-height | 普通列表最大高度；数字px/CSS长度，0不限 | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | 数据模式虚拟化；default插槽存在时忽略 | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | 普通列表自定义滚动条；false使用原生滚动 | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

虚拟列表使用独立视口，不额外嵌套自定义滚动条。virtualListProps.height 优先于 maxHeight；均省略时虚拟视口默认 200px。数字/带单位CSS长度受支持，非法或非正 max-height 不限制高度。

ListVirtualListProps 支持 height、threshold、fixedSize、estimatedSize、buffer、itemKey、component。没有废弃的 isStaticItemHeight；data 统一由 List.data 提供。数据量小于或等于 threshold 时渲染全部；非固定高度使用测量值与 estimatedSize 估计，buffer 控制前后预渲染行数。

ListScrollbarProps 支持 type: 'track'|'embed'、outerClass、outerStyle、hide、disableHorizontal、disableVertical。属性作为 JavaScript 对象字段使用 camelCase。

### List Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event)：真实滚动事件，一次滚动通知一次。
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align })：虚拟列表定位，index 优先；align 为 top/bottom/auto。auto 在项目已完整可见时不滚动，否则最小滚动使其可见。无效目标、非虚拟模式不操作。

### List Slots

List：default（优先于data）、item({ item, index })、header、footer、empty。空态仅无默认插槽、无数据、非加载时渲染。ListItem：prefix、default、suffix，保持列表项语义，不管理按钮/业务交互。

## Types

ListProps、ListSize、ListVirtualListProps、ListScrollbarProps、ListExpose、ListSlots、ListEmits、ListInstance、ListItemInstance。

List 与 InfiniteScroll 分工独立：List管理展示与可选虚拟视口；无限分页应组合 InfiniteScroll 的 status/target 交互，不在 List 中重复维护加载状态机。

## API

### Loading Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------- | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| type | Loading animation type | `circle \| wave \| cube \| rect \| disappear` | `circle` |
| size | Loading-indicator size; numbers are px | `xs \| sm \| md \| lg \| xl \| number` | `md` |
| radius | Radius for `circle` indicators | `string \| number` | - |
| color | Indicator and hint-text color | `string` | - |
| loading | Whether loading; effective only when wrapping content | `boolean` | `false` |
| tip | Prompt copy | `string` | - |
| hide-icon | Whether to hide the loading indicator | `boolean` | `false` |

`v-c-loading` accepts boolean shorthand or `{ loading, tip, type, size, radius, color, hideIcon, fullscreen, background }`. The object's `loading` field controls state; other props match `Loading`.

### Loading Slots

| Slot | Description |
| ------- | ---------------------- |
| default | Content covered by the loading mask |
| tip | Custom hint content |
| icon | Custom loading indicator |

The `icon` slot replaces every built-in `type` animation. Without it, the ConfigProvider `loading` slot takes precedence over built-in animations. `hide-icon=true` hides all indicators while allowing tip content to remain visible.

## Types

### Registration

`v-c-loading` renders Cedar's built-in `Loading` component. The `c-` prefix avoids collisions with other libraries’ directives. Register it in any of the following ways.

```ts
// 1. Full installation: registers Loading and v-c-loading automatically
import CedarVue from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.use(CedarVue);
```

```ts
// 2. Install Loading on demand: registers the component and directive
import { Loading } from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.use(Loading);
```

```ts
// 3. Register only the directive manually
import { vLoading } from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.directive("c-loading", vLoading);
```

With `CedarResolver()`, `unplugin-vue-components` resolves template `v-c-loading` automatically. `directives: false` disables directive resolution.

The component exports the following types:

```ts
import type { LoadingProps } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

The loading-directive mask prevents default click behavior and propagation. Clicking it does not activate Card or ordinary parent click handlers. Normal clicking resumes after loading. It does not disable keyboard access to underlying controls; set those controls’ `disabled` props to block all interaction.

### Overlay styles

| Variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-loading-overlay-background` | Directive overlay background; the background option overrides this value. |

Content-overlay class: `.c-loading__content-overlay`.

Each directive update replaces the complete configuration; omitted options and boolean `true` use defaults. Changing `fullscreen` while loading moves the overlay between the host and its owner document body. Host children stay in place. Multiple `fullscreen` instances share a counted scroll lock: closing a local instance does not unlock `fullscreen` instances, and the final `fullscreen` instance preserves an existing external lock class.

### Icons and status messages

A numeric `size` sets the custom indicator container's font `size` in pixels. Named sizes control built-in animations. Custom icons inherit the `--c-loading-indicator-size` font `size` (20px by default): `1em` children scale with it, while SVGs with fixed pixel dimensions keep their own `size`. Use the `icon` slot for graphics and `tip` or its slot for status text.

Standalone Loading has `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. Without a tip it includes localized visually hidden status text, even when the icon is hidden. Wrapper mode retains `aria-busy`. The directive sets `aria-busy="true"` on the original host and restores its previous value on cleanup, preserving a later external change.

Assistive technology may defer announcements within a busy region. For business start, completion or failure messages, maintain a persistent status region outside the busy region and update its text. The overlay does not disable keyboard interaction. See [WAI-ARIA `aria-busy`](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#`aria-busy`) and [ARIA22 status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22).

## API

### Loading Props

| --------- | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| type      | 加载动画类型                           | `circle \| wave \| cube \| rect \| disappear` | `circle` |

`v-c-loading` 支持布尔值简写，也支持 `{ loading, tip, type, size, radius, color, hideIcon, fullscreen, background }` 配置对象。对象形式中的 `loading` 控制加载状态，其余组件属性与 `Loading` 保持一致。

#### 注册方式

`v-c-loading` 使用 Cedar 内置的 `Loading` 组件渲染指示器。`c-` 前缀可以避免与其他组件库的同名指令冲突，使用前可通过以下任一方式注册。

```ts
// 1. 全量安装：自动注册 Loading 组件和 v-c-loading 指令
import CedarVue from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.use(CedarVue);
```

```ts
// 2. 按需安装 Loading：同时注册组件和指令
import { Loading } from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.use(Loading);
```

```ts
// 3. 只手动注册指令
import { vLoading } from "@cedar-design/ui";

app.directive("c-loading", vLoading);
```

使用 `CedarResolver()` 时，`unplugin-vue-components` 会自动解析模板中的 `v-c-loading`；`directives: false` 会关闭指令自动解析。

### Loading Slots

| 插槽名  | 说明                   |
| ------- | ---------------------- |
| default | 需要展示加载遮罩的内容 |
| tip     | 自定义提示内容         |
| icon    | 自定义加载指示器     |

`icon` 插槽替换全部内置 `type` 动画；未提供时使用 ConfigProvider 的 `loading` 插槽，再回退到内置动画。`hide-icon=true` 隐藏所有指示器，提示内容仍可显示。

## Types

组件导出以下类型定义：

```ts
import type { LoadingProps } from "@cedar-design/ui";
```

加载指令的遮罩会阻止点击默认行为和冒泡，点击遮罩不会触发 Card 或父级的普通 `@click`；关闭加载后恢复正常点击。遮罩不会禁用底层控件的键盘操作，如需完全禁止操作，请同时设置控件的 `disabled`。

### 覆盖层样式

| 变量 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `--c-loading-overlay-background` | 指令覆盖层背景色；background 选项可覆盖该值。 |

内容覆盖层类名：`.c-loading__content-overlay`。

指令每次更新都替换完整配置，省略的选项以及布尔值 `true` 使用默认值。加载中修改 `fullscreen` 会在宿主与所属文档的 body 之间迁移遮罩，宿主内容保持原位。多个全屏实例按数量持有滚动锁：关闭局部实例不会解除全屏锁，最后一个全屏实例结束时保留外部原有的锁类。

### 图标与状态提示

数字 `size` 为自定义指示器容器设置像素字号。枚举尺寸控制内置动画；自定义图标默认继承 `--c-loading-indicator-size`（20px）字号，使用 `1em` 的子图标随字号缩放，固定像素尺寸的 SVG 仍由自身样式决定。`icon` 插槽负责图形，状态文案使用 `tip` 或 `tip` 插槽。

独立 Loading 使用 `role="status"`、`aria-live="polite"` 和 `aria-atomic="true"`；未提供提示时，包含本地化的隐藏状态文字，隐藏图标不会移除文字。包裹模式保留 `aria-busy`，指令会给原宿主设置 `aria-busy="true"`，结束时恢复原值；若业务已修改该值，则保留业务的新值。

`aria-busy` 可能推迟区域内的状态播报。需要报告业务开始、完成或失败时，应在等待区域外维护持续存在的状态区域并更新文案；加载遮罩本身不会禁用键盘操作。参见 [WAI-ARIA aria-busy](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#aria-busy) 和 [ARIA22 状态消息](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22)。

| clearable | Show the clear button | `boolean` | `false` |
| map-style | Styles applied directly to the map; can set map height | `object` | `{ height: '300px'}` |

### Map Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------- |
| change | Position change notification | `(scopedValue, fullValue)` |
| init | Emitted after map initialization | `(initialValue, completedValue)` |
| loading:address | Emitted while resolving the selected location's address | `-` |
| loaded:address | Emitted after resolving the selected location's address | `-` |
| update:modelValue | Proposes a new location model | New model object |

### MapSelect Events

| Event | Description | Argument |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | Current reverse-geocoding request failed | Original cause `unknown` |
| `clear` | Clear was requested | None |
| `change` | Position change proposed | `(scopedValue, fullValue)` |
| `init` | Map initialization forwarded | `(initialValue, completedValue)` |
| `update:modelValue` | Proposed model preserving other existing fields | New model object |

The parent owns `model-value`. Selection and geocoding propose a new object via `update:modelValue`; the display follows the accepted value. Results from obsolete requests or after deactivation or unmount do not commit.


`geocoder-handler` receives numeric longitude and latitude and can synchronously or asynchronously return an object containing `address`, `poi`, `area_code`, `country_code`, `city`, and `country`; it takes precedence over `fetch`. Otherwise reverse geocoding uses `geocoder-url`, or derives a default from `map-type` and `base-path`; `fetch.get` must return a response with `isValid()` and `data`. MapSelect fallback uses updated aliases and service configuration for subsequent requests; zero is a valid coordinate. Runtime SDK service reconfiguration requires verification when the SDK is restored. The root and `map` entry export `MapProps`, `MapSelectProps`, `MapFetch`, `MapGeocoderHandler`, `MapGeocoderResult`, and component instance types. The map SDK is not included in the current build; map interaction is unavailable when it is not configured.

| 事件名          | 说明                       | 参数                      |
| --------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------- |

| init            | 初始化地图完成时触发 | `(initialValue, completedValue)` |
| loading:address | 选择地点，地址解析中触发   | `-`                       |
| loaded:address  | 选择地点，地址解析完成触发 | `-`                       |

### MapSelect Events

| 事件名 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | 当前逆地址解析请求失败 | 原始错误 `unknown` |
| `clear` | 请求清空位置 | 无 |
| `change` | 提出位置变化 | `(scopedValue, fullValue)` |
| `init` | 转发地图初始化 | `(initialValue, completedValue)` |
| `update:modelValue` | 提出包含现有其他字段的新模型 | 新模型对象 |

`model-value` 由父组件持有；选择或解析结果通过 `update:modelValue` 提出新对象，父组件接受后更新显示。旧请求、停用或卸载后的结果不会提交。

--- permalink: /components/menu/ --- # Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 Select；选择层级数据请使用 Cascader。 --- ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。菜单开启后会为触发元素添加 `c-menu-open` 类名。 ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 分组标题与选项左对齐，标题行高 20px、上下各 4px 留白（总高 28px）；后续分组额外间隔 8px，首组不添加组间距。 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，默认悬停展开；改成 `'click'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ### 选项值 动态增删或调整选项顺序时，为每个命令设置稳定且唯一的 `value`。数字 `0`、字符串 `'0'` 和布尔值 `false` 是不同的选项值。 ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ### 与 SplitButton 组合 SplitButton 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作，完整用法见 [SplitButton](/components/split-button/)。 ### 触发方式 ### 弹出方向 使用 `placement` 设置菜单相对触发元素的首选方位，可选值见 Menu Props。空间不足时允许自动调整，最终位置可能与首选方位不同。 ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ### 高度限制 ### 切换触发元素 点击另一个由悬停打开的同级触发元素时，会关闭原菜单；点击子菜单内部不会关闭父菜单。 ## 状态与内容定制 ### 选中值与 select 事件 使用 `v-model` 管理当前激活值。激活命令时先触发 `update:modelValue`，再触发 `select(value, option, event)`；`select` 表示激活菜单项，不表示表单值变化。 ### 受控打开状态 ### 页脚 ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。子级沿阅读方向展开；进入子级与返回父级的左右键跟随当前方向，上下键与首尾定位保持顺序并跳过禁用项。挂载到外部容器的菜单继承来源方向，切换方向不改变选中值。 ## 尺寸与阴影 `size` 控制选项的行高与字号，`md` 保持默认主题；`elevation=true` 使用菜单默认阴影，`false` 取消阴影，数字使用对应的全局阴影层级。 ## 键盘操作 在触发元素上按 Enter、Space 或方向键进入菜单。菜单内使用上下键、Home/End 在可用选项间移动，Enter 或 Space 激活选项。前进方向键进入子菜单，后退方向键返回，方向随阅读方向变化。Escape 请求关闭最上层菜单，关闭后焦点返回触发元素。Tab 请求关闭并继续浏览器焦点导航；可编辑输入保留文本编辑按键。 ## API ### 主值与默认值 使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示选中选项的 value；`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控值，后续修改不会重置当前状态。显式绑定值优先，初始化不发出 `update:modelValue`。 ### Menu Props | 参数名 | 描述 | 类型 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | --- | :---: | | options | 命令树 | `MenuOptionData[]` | `[]` | | field-names | `label/value/children/disabled` 字段映射 | `MenuFieldNames` | `-` | | model-value **(v-model)** | 当前激活值，用于受控高亮 | `MenuValue` | `-` | | open **(v-model)** | 浮层是否可见 | `boolean` | `-` | | default-open | 非受控默认可见状态 | `boolean` | `false` | | trigger | 根菜单触发方式 | `'hover' \| 'click' \| 'focus' \| 'contextMenu'` 或数组 | `'click'` | | submenu-trigger | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | `'hover' \| 'click'` | `'hover'` | | placement | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | `MenuPlacement`

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, icons and close-button spacing follow reading order. Direction changes do not alter message type, timers or closing. Programmatic calls use explicit configuration or document direction.

## Usage notes

### Component attribute forwarding

`Message.Component` forwards `id`, `class`, `style`, `aria-*` and native event listeners to its actual `role="alert"` region: the Cedar message root or the Maple inner visible panel. Each attribute is applied once. Required internal roles and classes remain; component lifecycle listeners such as `open` are not bound as DOM listeners. Native attributes update with the parent in both inline and Teleport modes. `dir` continues to determine reading direction. A function service `id` identifies the message for updates and is separate from a component native DOM `id`.
### Configuration

Exceptions from close/closed notification callbacks do not retain closed entries or empty manager hosts. Resource cleanup is independent of callback execution.

## API

### Message Options

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------- |
| open / `v-model:open` | Controlled visibility | `boolean` | `false` |
| id | Unique queue identifier; the same id updates the existing instance | `string \| number` | Automatically generated |
| status | Semantic status | `default \| info \| success \| warning \| danger \| loading` | `default` |
| variant | Visual emphasis | `neutral \| tonal \| solid` | `neutral` |
| position | Region of the message itself in the viewport: top/center/bottom, default top. Not positioned relative to a trigger | `top \| center \| bottom` | `top` |
| content | Content | `MessageContent` | - |
| icon | Custom icon | `MessageContent` | - |
| action | Action-area content | `MessageContent` | - |
| duration | Auto-close duration in ms; `0` disables automatic closing | `number` | `3000` |
| showIcon | Whether to show the status icon | `boolean` | `true` |
| closable | Show the close button | `boolean` | `false` |
| pauseOnHover | Pause while hovered | `boolean` | `false` |
| resetOnUpdate | Whether same-id updates reset the complete duration | `boolean` | `false` |
| closeButtonAriaLabel | Close button label | `string` | `Close message` |
| popupContainer | Mount container; function-call queues are isolated by container and position | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` |

Function options additionally accept `onOpen / onOpened / onClose / onClosed`. Close callbacks receive the current `id`.

### Message Events

`update:open`, `open`, `opened`, `close`, and `closed`, emitted once per visibility cycle.

### Message Methods

| Method | Description |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `Message(options \| string)` | Open a default message |
| `Message.info/success/warning/error/loading(...)` | Open a message with the corresponding status |
| `Message.clear(position?)` | Clear all messages or a specified position |
| `Message.setDefaultOptions(options)` | Set defaults for subsequent calls |
| `Message.resetDefaultOptions()` | Restore defaults |

Returns `{ close() }`; repeated calls do not repeat closing. A handle owns a specific message item: it remains valid for same-id updates of that item, but cannot close a new item after the old item completed leaving and its id was reused.

The optional second appContext argument applies to each message: injections, registered components, global properties and error handling use that application context. It does not capture a local Provider at the call site. Applications still share one queue and chronological stack per target/position; Message.clear continues clearing across applications. Each call uses its explicit context, then the current install default. An update with no available context retains the existing item scope. Switching a same-id item to another available context remounts its presentation and restarts its duration while keeping its business handle valid; other items keep their presentation and timers.

`Message.Component` retains its real Props and instance types. Its `restartTimer()` instance method resets only while active, open and resetOnUpdate=true. It is not a service-handle method; while hover-paused, it resets only the saved remaining duration.

| Component instance method | Description |
| ---- | ---- |
| restartTimer() | Reset the current duration, subject to active, open, resetOnUpdate and hover-pause state |

`MessageContent` is `VNodeChild | (() => VNodeChild)`: text, numbers, empty boolean children, VNodes, nested child arrays and synchronous render functions. Arbitrary plain objects and asynchronous tasks are not renderable content. content, icon and action share this protocol; local slots take precedence.

duration must be finite and nonnegative. Negative values, NaN and Infinity do not schedule automatic closure and trigger development prop validation. Zero stays open; restartTimer follows the same rules.

### Message Slots

`default`、`icon`、`action`。

## CSS Variables

Visual variant is independent of status. neutral uses a neutral popup and status icon; tonal uses a low-emphasis status background with dark content; solid uses a high-emphasis fill and matching foreground. Cedar/Maple both default to neutral; explicit solid/tonal have matching visual semantics. default/loading solid retains a dark background, with the loading icon indicating progress. Both export MessageVariant; function calls, setDefaultOptions and same-id updates support variant.

Colors use `--c-message-{variant}-{status}-{bg|content-color|icon-color|border-color|close-color}`. bg sets the panel background; content-color sets body/action text unless separately styled; icon-color sets status icons; border-color sets borders; close-color sets close controls. With a custom background, verify all three foregrounds. Geometry retains platform density rather than forcing equal defaults. Variables must affect actual Teleport-container ancestors.

`duration` 单位为毫秒，`0` 表示常驻；`Message.loading(...)` 默认常驻。

展示期限独立于 CSS 进出动效。重启、hover 暂停、清理或卸载使旧计时回调失效，关闭状态在回调执行时再次检查；不会用动效 Token 修改业务展示时长。

KeepAlive 停用取消计时，激活从当前配置完整 duration 重启；停用期间更新、卸载后保留的 restart 不调度。hover 正时长已耗尽时恢复会请求关闭，显式重置为0仍常驻。仅有限正 duration 自动关闭，负数和非有限值不调度。

服务等待真实离场完成再清理和调用 onClosed，不再强制150ms或200ms退出。未挂载就 close/clear 的条目直接清理；此时服务 onClosed 仍报告完成，但组件未产生 open/opened/close 动画事件。业务 duration 与 CSS 过渡时长分开。

启用减少动态效果时，关闭内置进出场过渡和装饰图标淡入，保留静态位置、颜色和展示时长；自定义图标动效由调用方适配。

## 使用说明

### 组件属性透传

`Message.Component` 的 `id`、`class`、`style`、`aria-*` 和原生事件监听器透传到实际 `role="alert"` 消息区域：Cedar 为消息根节点，Maple 为内部可见消息面板。每个属性只应用一次；内部必需角色和样式类保留，组件 `open` 等生命周期监听器不会绑定为同名 DOM 事件。原生属性会随父级更新，内联与 Teleport 模式使用同一规则。`dir` 继续决定消息的阅读方向。函数服务的 `id` 仍是更新同一消息的业务标识，不等同于组件的原生 DOM id。
### 配置说明

视觉变体与 status 独立：neutral 是中性浮层与状态图标；tonal 是低强调状态色底与深色正文；solid 是高强调实色底与配套前景。Cedar 与 Maple 默认均为 neutral；显式 solid / tonal 保持相同视觉语义。default/loading 的 solid 保留深色底，loading 图标仍表达进度。两端导出 MessageVariant，函数调用、setDefaultOptions 和相同 id 更新都支持 variant。

close/closed 通知回调抛错不会保留已关闭项目或空管理器宿主，资源清理独立于通知回调执行。

## API

### Message Options

| 属性                  | 说明                                   | 类型                                                         | 默认值          |
| --------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------- |
| open / `v-model:open` | 是否显示（组件）                       | `boolean`                                                    | `false`         |
| id                    | 队列内唯一标识，相同 id 更新原实例     | `string \| number`                                           | 自动生成        |
| status                | 语义状态                               | `default \| info \| success \| warning \| danger \| loading` | `default`       |
| variant | 视觉强调层级 | `neutral \| tonal \| solid` | `neutral` |
| position              | 消息自身在可视区域中的 top/center/bottom 区域，默认 top；不相对触发元素定位 | `top \| center \| bottom`                                    | `top`           |
| content               | 内容                                   | `MessageContent`                                             | -               |
| icon                  | 自定义图标                             | `MessageContent`                                             | -               |
| action                | 操作区内容                             | `MessageContent`                                             | -               |
| duration              | 自动关闭时长（ms），`0` 不自动关闭     | `number`                                                     | `3000`          |
| showIcon              | 是否显示状态图标                       | `boolean`                                                    | `true`          |
| closable              | 是否显示关闭按钮                       | `boolean`                                                    | `false`         |
| pauseOnHover          | 悬停时暂停并保存剩余时间               | `boolean`                                                    | `false`         |
| resetOnUpdate         | 相同 id 更新时是否重置完整时长         | `boolean`                                                    | `false`         |
| closeButtonAriaLabel  | 关闭按钮无障碍名称                     | `string`                                                     | `Close message` |
| popupContainer        | 挂载容器；函数调用按容器和位置隔离队列 | `string \| HTMLElement \| false`                             | `body`          |

函数选项另支持 `onOpen / onOpened / onClose / onClosed`，关闭回调接收当前 `id`。

### Message Events

`update:open`、`open`、`opened`、`close`、`closed`；每次开关周期各触发一次。

### Message Methods

| 方法                                              | 说明                     |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `Message(options \| string)`                      | 打开默认提示             |
| `Message.info/success/warning/error/loading(...)` | 打开对应状态提示         |
| `Message.clear(position?)`                        | 清空全部或指定位置的提示 |
| `Message.setDefaultOptions(options)`              | 设置后续调用的默认值     |
| `Message.resetDefaultOptions()`                   | 恢复默认值               |

返回 `{ close() }`；重复调用 `close()` 不会重复触发关闭生命周期。句柄绑定具体消息项：相同 id 更新原项时旧句柄仍有效；原项离场完成后复用 id，新项不会被旧句柄关闭。

函数第二参数 appContext 对每条消息生效，内容中的注入、全局组件、全局属性和错误处理使用该应用上下文；它不会自动捕获调用处的局部 Provider。不同应用仍共享同一容器和位置的队列与排列顺序，Message.clear 也继续跨应用清理。每次调用优先显式上下文，其次 install 设置的当前默认上下文；更新原项且没有可用上下文时保留原作用域。相同 id 改用另一可用上下文会重建该项展示并按 duration 重新计时，原业务句柄仍有效；其他消息的展示和计时不受影响。

`Message.Component` 是具有真实 Props 和实例类型的声明式组件；`restartTimer()` 为组件实例方法，只在已激活、open 且 resetOnUpdate=true 时重新计时。它不是函数服务句柄的方法，hover 暂停时只重置保存的剩余时间。

| 组件实例方法 | 说明 |
| ---- | ---- |
| restartTimer() | 按当前 duration 重置计时；受 active、open、resetOnUpdate 与 hover 暂停约束 |

`MessageContent` 为 `VNodeChild | (() => VNodeChild)`：支持文字、数字、布尔空内容、VNode、嵌套子节点数组及同步渲染函数。任意普通对象和异步任务不是内容协议。content、icon、action 使用相同规则，本地插槽优先。

duration 应为有限非负数；负数、NaN、Infinity 等非法值不调度自动关闭，并在开发环境触发属性校验提示。0 表示常驻，restartTimer 仍遵守相同规则。

### Message Slots

`default`、`icon`、`action`。

## CSS Variables

颜色命名为 `--c-message-{variant}-{status}-{bg|content-color|icon-color|border-color|close-color}`。bg 控制面板底，content-color 控制正文与未单独设色的 action，icon-color 控制状态图标，border-color 控制边线，close-color 控制关闭按钮。自定义背景时需要同时验证三个前景。几何变量保留端侧密度，不要求两端强行同值。变量必须作用于实际 Teleport 容器祖先。

## Usage notes

### Configuration

`popup-layout="full"` starts at the bottom edge of the trigger, spans the viewport width and fills the remaining viewport height below it. On Maple, the same layout starts below the entire filter bar. Mobile defaults to full-width; desktop defaults to dropdown.

Set a local mode with an outer `<c-style-provider theme="dark">`. This component has no theme prop. Nest theme="light" for a light region; library popups follow their owning provider.

## API

### NavMenu Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| options | Navigation tree | NavMenuOption[] | [] |
| model-value | Current selected key; supports v-model. null means no selection | string / number / null | undefined |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled selected value | string / number / null | null |
| active-item | Controlled named NavMenu.Item activation; supports v-model:active-item | string / number / null | undefined |
| default-active-item | Initial uncontrolled named NavMenu.Item activation | string / number / null | null |
| expanded-keys | Controlled expanded branches | (string / number)[] | undefined |
| default-expanded-keys | Initial uncontrolled expanded branches | (string / number)[] | [] |
| default-expand-all | Initially expand every branch | boolean | false |
| auto-expand-selected | Expand selected-item ancestors in vertical noncollapsed mode; controlled mode requests updates | boolean | true |
| accordion | Expand only one branch per level | boolean | false |
| mode | Navigation orientation | vertical / horizontal | vertical |
| collapsed | Collapsed state; supports v-model:collapsed | boolean | undefined |
| default-collapsed | Initial uncontrolled collapsed state | boolean | false |
| size | Size | xs / sm / md / lg / xl | md |
| disabled | Globally disable selection/user expansion | boolean | false |
| field-names | Field mapping for key/label/children/disabled | NavMenuFieldNames | Same-name fields by default |
| responsive | Enable horizontal overflow collection | boolean | true |
| indent | Indent per level in px | number | 24 |
| root-indent | Root indent in px | number | 12 |
| collapsed-width | Collapsed width in px | number | 56 |
| icon-size | Icon size in px | number | 20 |
| popup-container | Popup mount container; false renders locally | Matching Trigger type | Inherits Trigger definition |
| popup-class | Additional popup class | string / array / object | — |
| overflow-label | Overflow entry label; follows the current locale when omitted | string | Localized More |
| node-props | Node DOM attributes/events; internal selection, disabled and keyboard semantics remain | (context) => Record<string, unknown> | — |

Controlled props follow supplied values; update events are requests only. `default-*` initializes once, not on later changes. Selection and expansion are independent. `showOption` does not select.

### Platform correspondence

On both platforms, a panel is created on first opening and remains mounted after closing or switching entries by default. Internal drafts and expanded branches are preserved. With `unmount-on-close`, content unmounts after the closing transition and is recreated on reopening, without clearing the Item's own selection. Business code defines draft commit, reset and filter application timing.

Root `close()` only requests closing Item panels and restores entry focus. It does not change selected values, active-item or desktop navigation-tree expanded-keys. A controlled open that rejects updates stays open. An entry with neither options nor a content slot does not open; arriving async options render according to current open state. KeepAlive deactivation hides panels and requests closing; reactivation still follows the controlled value.

Item selection, open state, events, slot contexts and `select/close/setOpen` methods are consistent. Both roots expose `close/resize/setActiveItem`. `name` must be unique in the current menu; changing it releases the old `name`. Names may swap or be reused during reordering in one update, with duplicates checked after the update. Vertical options expand the current value's available ancestor path on initialization or controlled value/options updates, while users can still collapse branches manually.

| Capability | Cedar | Maple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Root menu | Options navigation tree or Item entries; vertical by default | Item filter bar only; horizontal by default |
| popup-layout | dropdown (default) / full-width / full-height / full | full-width (default) / full |
| Panel origin | Below the current entry | Below the entire filter bar; a standalone Item uses its own lower edge |
| Trigger and positioning | trigger / placement | Click to open downward |
| Overlay and scrolling | Nonmodal; does not lock background scrolling | Root overlay / overlay-closable / lock-scroll / esc-to-close / z-index |
| Code Theme | Controlled by the local StyleProvider theme | Follows the global theme; no theme prop |
| Navigation-tree methods only | showOption / scrollTo / setCollapsed | — |

Each library exports `NavMenuPopupLayout` with its supported values. Maple's `NavMenuMode` is horizontal only; `options-mode` supports both orientations. The default entry slot replaces the entry's inner content. Maple renders it inside a native button: use non-interactive text/icons and place forms and action buttons in the content slot.

### Arrow direction

Horizontal dropdowns point down when closed/up when open. Vertical inline branches point right/down. Right-opening submenus point right/left. Independent Item arrows follow placement and reverse when open. Arrows follow actual open state, not unaccepted controlled proposals.

### Keyboard

Vertical Up/Down and horizontal Left/Right move focus; Home/End reach first/last. Right expands vertical branches, Down opens horizontal branches, Left returns to parents. Escape closes the current popup and restores reference focus. Enter/Space activates nodes. Disabled nodes are skipped; inputs retain native keys. If narrowing moves a focused item into overflow, focus moves to the overflow entry.

### NavMenuOption Events

| Event | Prop |
| --- | --- |
| update:model-value | key / null |
| update:active-item | name / null |
| update:expanded-keys | keys |
| update:collapsed | collapsed |
| select | key, original option, original Event |

### NavMenuOption Slots

The default slot contains independent `CNavMenuItem` entries. When present, horizontal menus scroll rather than using `responsive` overflow collection.

label/icon/extra render functions, same-name slots and nodeProps receive `{ option, active, expanded, level }`. `active` means this node itself matches modelValue; ancestor-path emphasis is internal. `expanded` describes branch expansion; level starts at 0.

### NavMenuOption Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| close() | Request closing Item panels and restore focus without changing tree expansion |
| showOption(key?) | Expand ancestors of the specified item, defaulting to current selection; does not select |
| scrollTo(key?) | Expand then scroll to an item; controlled expansion requires parent acceptance |
| resize() | Manually remeasure horizontal overflow |
| setCollapsed(value) | Update uncontrolled collapse or request a controlled update |
| setActiveItem(value) | Update uncontrolled named-Item activation or request a controlled update |

### NavMenuItem Props

When using the content slot, the custom panel takes its accessible name from the entry. Set aria-label or aria-labelledby on the entry when needed. Ensure custom entries have a meaningful name.

Titles follow matching selected options by default. `label` slots take highest precedence: use `<template #label>Advanced filters</template>` for fixed titles or bind a separate reactive variable for manual titles. `update-label` is removed.

`v-model` stores panel selection. Slot `active` indicates business entry state: named entries in a root menu compare root activeItem with name; independent entries match their main value against ordinary options, including 0/empty string. Unknown values/groups/dividers do not activate independent entries. `highlight` overrides emphasis only: true forces it, false removes it, omission follows `active`. It changes neither `active` nor value. Opening a panel does not activate the entry.

`CNavMenuItem` (also `NavMenu.Item`) is an independent top-level entry outside root navigation-tree `modelValue`. Without `name`, each Item highlights from its own value, allowing simultaneous category/region filters. With unique names, root `activeItem/defaultActiveItem` maintains one highlighted entry. Both modes allow only one open Item panel without clearing other panels’ values. Ordinary root navigation uses `options + v-model`. Entries define their own `options` or replace panels through `content`. default customizes the entry; `label`/`icon` customize parts; `option-label`/`option-icon`/`option-extra` customize `options`.

Horizontal menus with default slots scroll rather than collecting entries into overflow, avoiding cloned form content. Pure `options` menus retain automatic overflow collection.  Item panels within one NavMenu are mutually exclusive. Clicking another entry requests closing the previous one; controlled open requires parent acceptance.

| Item prop | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name | Stable unique entry identifier; root activeItem makes named entries mutually exclusive. highlight separately overrides appearance | — |
| label | Entry title when unselected or selection does not match options; supports VNode/render functions | — |
| options / fieldNames | Same options/field mappings as NavMenu | `[]` |
| model-value / default-value | Independent controlled/initial value; string, number or null | `undefined` / `null` |
| highlight | Visual emphasis override without changing active/selection; defaults to active | — |
| hide-on-select | Close the panel after select | `true` |
| unmount-on-close | Destroy panel content after the closing transition; retain it by default | false |
| open / default-open | Controlled / initial panel state | `undefined` / `false` |
| disabled | Disable the entry, also respecting parent menu disabled | `undefined` |
| trigger | Trigger mode | `click` |
| placement | Ordinary dropdown placement; full-height right/left placements align to the corresponding entry edge | `bottom-start` |
| popup-layout | `dropdown`: standard `dropdown` / `full-width`: `full` width below the trigger / `full-height`: `full` height on the right / `full`: fills the available width and height below the trigger | `dropdown` |
| popup-style | Panel CSS; may override full-height width/direction/dimensions | — |
| popup-container / popup-class | Trigger container and popup class | Follow parent menu |
| options-mode | Horizontal/vertical default options-panel layout | `vertical` |

Entry/`content` slots receive `{ modelValue, selectedOption, active, open, select, close }`. select(key,event?) emits `update:modelValue` and select(key,option,event). Custom panels may select outside options, making option undefined and independent active false; use highlight if emphasis is needed. `close()` closes/restores entry focus. Controlled values affect titles/active only after acceptance. Entry-slot active is entry state, while label-render active compares its context option with the Item value. `hideOnSelect` is independent of acceptance; set false for manual confirmation.

Item also emits `update:open`/entry `click` and exposes `select`/`close`/`setOpen`. Full-width/full-height popups are nonmodal without scroll locks/focus traps. They default to body; custom containers must avoid ancestor transforms changing the fixed-position reference.

## Types

### NavMenuOption

```ts
interface NavMenuOption {
  key?: string | number
  type?: 'item' | 'group' | 'divider'
  label?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  icon?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  extra?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  children?: NavMenuOption[]
  disabled?: boolean
  show?: boolean
  props?: HTMLAttributes
}
```

Ordinary options require unique stable keys, using mapped keys when fieldNames is supplied. Numeric 0 is valid. Groups/dividers may omit keys, though explicit keys are recommended for dynamic reordering. Duplicate keys/missing ordinary-item keys throw to prevent ambiguous selection paths. show=false hides nodes/subtrees. Disabled branches propagate downward. Ordinary branches expand; leaves select.

## Design reference

The workspace Naive UI 2.44.1 Menu informed option trees, ancestor paths and content rendering. No Naive UI/TreeMate runtime dependency is introduced. Local Trigger provides popups; public APIs follow Cedar names.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

NavMenu inherits the nearest native `dir` and supports runtime changes. Horizontal Left/Right navigation follows reading direction; vertical Up/Down does not reverse. In RTL, Left expands/enters a submenu and Right collapses/returns; LTR uses the opposite mapping. Escape closes the popover and returns focus to its trigger.

Nested data-menu popovers prefer inline end and adjust when space is limited, inheriting their source scope. Explicit `NavMenu.Item` physical `placement` keeps its meaning. Direction changes do not select a menu item or clear filter values.

# NavMenu 导航菜单

通过 `options` 定义导航结构，支持纵向展开、横向下拉及横向溢出收纳。子菜单由 `children` 自动产生，也可用 `NavMenu.Item` 定义独立一级入口；无需 SubMenu/ItemGroup 组件。

### 程序化滚动的生命周期

`scrollTo(key)` 展开路径后等待渲染，再以 nearest 对齐原生定位；返回 `Promise<void>`。连续调用只执行最新仍有效的请求。禁用、options／fieldNames／mode／responsive／折叠配置变化、KeepAlive 停用及卸载使旧请求失效；重新激活后请显式发起新请求，不会重放旧滚动。取消不回滚已经执行的浏览器滚动。

NavMenu 有两种清晰的使用方式：导航树使用 `options`，业务筛选等独立入口使用 `NavMenu.Item`。下面先介绍常用导航，再逐步进入层级、响应式和高级定制。

##### 统一激活

为 Item 设置唯一 `name`，再通过根菜单的 `v-model:active-item` 统一保持单选高亮。打开一级入口只展开面板，不会提前激活；选择叶子节点后才更新当前高亮项，每个面板的内部值仍独立保留。确实需要初始高亮时，可以显式设置 `active-item` 或 `default-active-item`。

##### 独立激活

不设置 `name` 时，每个 Item 根据自己的值独立高亮，适合多个筛选条件同时生效。下例初始同时选中了分类和地区，因此两个入口都会高亮；清空其中一项不会影响另一项。

`popup-layout="full"` 从入口底边开始，宽度占满视口，高度占满下方剩余视口区域。Maple 同名布局从整个筛选栏底边开始；移动端默认 full-width，桌面端默认 dropdown。

受控属性以传入值为准；更新事件只是请求。`default-*` 仅初始化，不跟随后续修改。单选值与展开状态相互独立，`showOption` 不会更改选中值。

### 两端对应关系

两端面板均在首次展开时创建，关闭或切换入口后默认保留挂载，内部草稿和分支展开状态继续保留。设置 `unmount-on-close` 后，在关闭过渡结束时卸载面板；再次展开会重新创建内部组件，但不会清空 Item 自身的选中值。草稿提交、重置和筛选生效时机由业务决定。

根 `close()` 只请求关闭 Item 面板并恢复入口焦点，不改变选中值、active-item 或桌面导航树的 expanded-keys。受控 open 拒绝更新时仍保持展开。没有 options 且没有 content 插槽的入口不展开；异步 options 到达后按当前 open 状态展示。KeepAlive 停用期间隐藏面板并请求关闭，重新激活时仍以受控值为准。

Item 的选中值、展开状态、事件、插槽上下文及 `select/close/setOpen` 方法保持一致。两端根菜单都提供 `close/resize/setActiveItem`。`name` 必须在当前菜单内唯一，动态修改后会释放旧名称；同一次更新允许交换名称或在重排时复用旧名称，以更新完成后的名称检查重复。纵向选项会在初始值、受控值或 options 更新时展开当前值的可用祖先路径；用户仍可手动收起分支。

| 能力 | Cedar | Maple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 根菜单 | options 导航树或 Item 入口；默认 vertical | 仅 Item 筛选栏；默认 horizontal |
| popup-layout | dropdown（默认）/ full-width / full-height / full | full-width（默认）/ full |
| 面板起点 | 当前入口底边 | 整个筛选栏底边；独立 Item 使用自身底边 |
| 触发与定位 | trigger / placement | 固定点击向下展开 |
| 遮罩与滚动 | 非模态，不锁背景滚动 | 根级 overlay / overlay-closable / lock-scroll / esc-to-close / z-index |
| 主题 | 由 StyleProvider 局部主题控制 | 跟随全局主题，无 theme 属性 |
| 导航树专用方法 | showOption / scrollTo / setCollapsed | — |

两端 `NavMenuPopupLayout` 分别导出本端支持的值域；Maple 的 `NavMenuMode` 仅为 horizontal，`options-mode` 仍支持两个方向。入口 default 插槽替换入口内部内容，移动端位于原生按钮中，请使用文本、图标等非交互内容；表单和操作按钮放在 content 插槽。

### 箭头方向

横向下拉入口收起朝下、展开朝上；纵向内联分支收起朝右、展开朝下；向右弹出的子菜单收起朝右、展开朝左。独立 Item 根据 placement 显示方向，展开后反向。箭头跟随实际 open 状态，受控状态未接受更新时不切换。

### 键盘

纵向 Up/Down 与横向 Left/Right 移动焦点，Home/End 到首尾；Right 展开纵向分支，Down 打开横向分支；Left 返回父级，弹出层 Escape 关闭当前层并恢复参考项焦点。Enter/空格激活节点。禁用项跳过；输入框保留原生按键。横向缩窄导致当前项进入“更多”时，焦点迁移至更多入口。

### NavMenuOption Events

| 事件 | 参数 |
| --- | --- |
| update:model-value | key / null |
| update:active-item | name / null |
| update:expanded-keys | keys |
| update:collapsed | collapsed |
| select | key, 原始 option, 原始 Event |

### NavMenuOption Slots

默认插槽用于放置独立的 `CNavMenuItem`。存在默认插槽时，横向菜单使用滚动，`responsive` 不进行更多收纳。

label/icon/extra 渲染函数、同名插槽及 nodeProps 均接收 `{ option, active, expanded, level }`。`active` 只表示当前节点自身匹配 modelValue，祖先路径强调留在内部；`expanded` 表示分支展开，level 从 0 开始。

### NavMenuOption Methods

| 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| close() | 请求关闭所有 Item 面板并恢复入口焦点，不修改导航树展开状态 |
| showOption(key?) | 展开指定项的祖先路径，默认当前选中项；不选择 |
| scrollTo(key?) | 先展开，再滚动到该项；受控展开需父级接受 |
| resize() | 手动重新计算横向溢出 |
| setCollapsed(value) | 更新非受控折叠或发出受控更新请求 |
| setActiveItem(value) | 更新具名 Item 的非受控激活项或发出受控更新请求 |

### NavMenuItem Props

使用 content 插槽时，自定义面板的无障碍名称跟随入口的名称；入口可通过 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby 指定名称。请确保自定义入口具有有意义的名称。

标题默认跟随匹配的选中选项。`label` 插槽优先级最高：固定标题可写 `<template #label>高级筛选</template>`；手动标题可绑定独立的响应式变量。

`v-model` 保存面板的选中值。插槽 `active` 只表示业务上的当前入口：提供 name 且处于根菜单中时，由根 activeItem 是否等于该 name 决定；独立入口则由主值是否匹配 options 中的普通选项决定（包括 0 和空字符串）。未知值、分组和分隔项不激活独立入口。`highlight` 仅覆盖视觉强调，true 强制强调、false 取消强调，省略时跟随 active；它不改变 active 或主值。打开面板不会激活入口。

`CNavMenuItem`（也可写 `NavMenu.Item`）是自定义一级入口，不参与根菜单普通导航树的 `modelValue`。未提供 `name` 时，Item 根据自己的值独立高亮，适合分类、地区等多个筛选条件同时生效；提供唯一 `name` 后，由根菜单的 `activeItem/defaultActiveItem` 统一保持单选高亮。两种模式都只允许同一时间展开一个 Item 面板，且不会清空其他面板的内部值。普通一级导航仍使用根 NavMenu 的 `options + v-model`。每个入口通过自己的 `options` 定义菜单，或通过 `content` 插槽完全替换面板。默认插槽自定义入口内部内容，`label`、`icon` 插槽局部自定义入口，`option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 自定义选项。

有默认插槽时，横向菜单使用滚动而不收入“更多”，避免复制包含表单的入口。纯 `options` 菜单继续支持自动溢出收纳。同一 NavMenu 下的 Item 面板互斥，点击其他入口会请求关闭已打开的面板；受控 open 需要业务接受 update:open。

| Item 属性 | 说明 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name | 稳定且唯一的入口标识；提供后由根菜单 activeItem 互斥管理当前入口；视觉覆盖另用 highlight | — |
| label | 未选中或选中值未匹配 options 时的入口标题，支持 VNode / 渲染函数 | — |
| options / fieldNames | 与 NavMenu 相同的选项和字段映射 | `[]` |
| model-value / default-value | 独立受控值 / 初始值，支持字符串、数字和 null | `undefined` / `null` |
| highlight | 入口视觉强调覆盖，不改变业务 active 或选中值；省略时跟随 active | — |
| hide-on-select | 调用 select 后关闭面板 | `true` |
| unmount-on-close | 关闭过渡结束后卸载面板；默认保留首次展开后的内容 | false |
| open / default-open | 受控 / 初始面板状态 | `undefined` / `false` |
| disabled | 禁用入口（同时遵循父菜单 disabled） | `undefined` |
| trigger | Trigger 触发方式 | `click` |
| placement | 普通下拉的位置；全高面板使用 right/left 系列时紧贴入口对应边缘 | `bottom-start` |
| popup-layout | `dropdown` 普通下拉 / `full-width` 入口下方通栏 / `full-height` 右侧全高 / `full` 入口下方宽高铺满 | `dropdown` |
| popup-style | 面板 CSS，可覆盖全高面板宽度、方向和尺寸 | — |
| popup-container / popup-class | Trigger 挂载容器及浮层类名 | 跟随父菜单 |
| options-mode | 默认选项面板的横向 / 纵向排列 | `vertical` |

所有入口插槽和 `content` 插槽收到 `{ modelValue, selectedOption, active, open, select, close }`。`select(key, event?)` 发出 `update:modelValue` 和 `select(key, option, event)`；自定义面板可以选择 options 外的值，此时 option 为 undefined；独立入口 active 为 false，如需强调可显式设置 highlight。`close()` 关闭并恢复入口焦点。受控值只有父组件接受后才影响标题和业务 active。入口插槽的 active 表示入口状态；label 渲染函数的 active 则表示其上下文 option 自身是否匹配 Item 的主值，未匹配时为 false。`hideOnSelect` 独立于值是否被接受，需手动确认时设为 false。

Item 还发出 `update:open`、入口 `click`，暴露 `select`、`close`、`setOpen` 方法。通栏 / 全高是非模态浮层，不锁定页面滚动或限制焦点；默认挂载到 body，使用自定义容器时需避免祖先 transform 改变 fixed 定位基准。

## Types

### NavMenuOption

```ts
interface NavMenuOption {
  key?: string | number
  type?: 'item' | 'group' | 'divider'
  label?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  icon?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  extra?: VNodeChild | ((context: NavMenuRenderContext) => VNodeChild)
  children?: NavMenuOption[]
  disabled?: boolean
  show?: boolean
  props?: HTMLAttributes
}
```

普通选项必须提供唯一且稳定的 key（自定义字段时使用映射后的 key）；数字 0 是合法 key。group/divider 可省略 key，但动态重排时建议显式提供。重复 key 或普通项缺失 key 会报错，避免选中路径混乱。show=false 的节点及其子树不渲染；禁用分支向下继承禁用。存在 children 的普通项负责展开，叶项负责选择。

## 设计参考

参考工作区 Naive UI 2.44.1 Menu 的 options 树、祖先路径和内容渲染设计；未引入 Naive UI 或 TreeMate 运行时依赖。浮层由本库 Trigger 提供，公开 API 使用 Cedar 命名约定。

## 阅读方向与键盘交互

NavMenu 继承最近的原生 `dir` 并支持动态切换。横向菜单的左右键按阅读方向移动焦点；纵向上下键不反转。RTL 下左键展开/进入子级，右键收起/返回父级，LTR 相反；Escape 关闭浮层并返回触发项。

数据菜单的嵌套浮层优先向阅读结束侧展开，空间不足时自动调整，浮层继承来源作用域。显式 `NavMenu.Item` 的物理 `placement` 保持原意。切换方向不会选中菜单或清空筛选值。

使用说明 ### 配置说明 Teleport 后主题变量按实际 DOM 祖先继承；放在内容内部的变量不会向上传到服务创建的容器。 close/closed 通知回调抛错不会保留已关闭项目或空管理器宿主，资源清理独立于通知回调执行。 ## API clear 同步移除条目并释放 ID；随后重新添加相同 ID 会创建新条目，并从完整展示时长开始计时。活动条目的普通更新保持原位，clear 不额外触发业务 onClose。启用减少动态效果时，关闭内置进出场过渡和位移，保留静态布局、颜色及业务展示时长。 duration（默认 3000ms，0 持续显示）是业务展示计时，不是 CSS 动效时长。close 每个挂载实例只通知一次，立即取消计时器；离场期间的更新／重复关闭不再安排自动关闭。reset-on-update 只重启活动且未关闭实例的计时。KeepAlive 停用取消计时，重新激活从完整配置时长计时；卸载和已失效回调不会补发 close。列表仍通过实际 TransitionGroup 的离场完成卸载，不按 duration 等待 CSS 动画。现有六项 transition-* Token 控制 opacity／左右进入／离开效果，不改变自动关闭期限。 ### Notification Methods `Notification` 提供的全局方法，可以通过以下三种方法使用： 1. 通过 `this.$notification` 调用 2. 在 Composition API 中，通过 `getCurrentInstance().appContext.config.globalProperties.$notification` 调用 3. 导入 `Notification`，通过 `Notification` 本身调用 以上入口都支持 `remove` 和 `clear`。服务端没有可用的 DOM 时，通知方法返回可安全调用 `close()` 的空句柄，不创建通知，也不会在客户端自动补发。 当通过 `import` 方式使用时，组件没有办法获取当前的 Vue Context，如 i18n 或 route 等注入在 AppContext 上的内容无法在内部使用，需要在调用时手动传入 AppContext，或者为组件全局指定 AppContext ```ts import { createApp } from 'vue' import { Notification } from '@cedar-design/ui' const app = createApp(App) Notification._context = app._context ``` ## `NotificationPosition: 'top-right' \| 'top-left' \| 'bottom-right' \| 'bottom-left'` | `-` | ### NotificationConfig | 参数名 | 描述 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 | | ---------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | :-----: | :----- | | content | 内容 | `RenderContent` | `-` | | | title | 标题 | `RenderContent` | `-` | | | icon | 图标 | `RenderFunction` | `-` | | | id | 唯一id | `string` | `-` | | | style | 样式 | `CSSProperties` | `-` | | | class | 样式类名 | `ClassName` | `-` | | | position | 通知自身在可视区域中的物理角落，默认 top-right；四角使用上下在前的 kebab-case 拼写 | `'top-left'\|'top-right'\|'bottom-left'\|'bottom-right'` | `top-right` | | | showIcon | 是否显示图标 | `boolean` | `true` | | | closable | 是否可关闭 | `boolean` | `false` | | | duration | 显示的持续时间，单位为 `ms` | `number` | `3000` | | | footer | 底部内容 | `RenderFunction` | `-` | 2.25.0 | | closeIcon | 关闭按钮图标 | `RenderFunction` | `-` | | | closeIconElement | 关闭按钮元素 | `RenderFunction` | `-` | | | closeButtonAriaLabel | 关闭按钮的无障碍名称 | `string` | `Close notification` | | | onClose | 关闭时的回调函数 | `(id: number \| string) => void` | `-` | | `NotificationConfig` 是服务调用配置；`NotificationProps` 对应底层视图的 `type`、`showIcon`、`closable`、`duration`、`resetOnUpdate` 和 `closeButtonAriaLabel`，不等同于服务配置。同一 ID 的通知更新时，仅显式传入 `duration` 会重启计时；未传时继续当前计时。 ### NotificationReturn | 参数名 | 描述 | 类型 | 默认值 | | ------ | ------------------ | ------------ | :----: | | close | 关闭当前通知提醒框 | `() => void` | `-` | 组件导出以下类型定义 ```ts import type { NotificationInstance, NotificationConfig, NotificationReturn } from '@cedar-design/ui' ``` ## CSS Variables 面板使用 surface-overlay，正文／标题使用 content-primary，关闭按钮使用 content-secondary，边框使用 border-default。状态图标使用可读 content 状态色；info 使用信息状态色，loading 使用 content-brand。颜色变量按状态分组；自定义背景须同时检查内容、图标与关闭按钮。纯文本 action／footer 继承面板正文色；自带样式的插槽内容由业务负责。 wrapper-* 控制列表位置／留白；padding-*、margin-* 控制面板布局；icon-*、title-*、content-* 控制各部分排版；close-* 控制关闭按钮；border-*、box-shadow 控制边框／阴影；transition-* 控制动效；z-index 控制层级。本阶段保留几何与动效默认值。下表列出实际声明，未声明所有历史几何变量均已验证消费。

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Page numbers and previous/next meanings remain unchanged; default navigation icons follow reading direction. Page entry, disabled boundaries and selection do not change. Business code controls direction for custom icon slots.

## Triggers and positioning

### Popup placement

No placement configuration is required for normal use: bottom-start is preferred and the underlying Trigger automatically flips/constrains the popup. pageSizeProps.placement is only a restricted override for the page-size Select: Pagination → Select.triggerProps.placement → Trigger. It does not position the pagination itself.

## API

Use ordinary `v-model`: `modelValue` is the current page, starting at 1; pageSize independently controls items per page. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets or initialization `update:modelValue`. When `modelValue` is supplied, the parent value controls the display.

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

| responsive | Automatically use simple mode by container width | `boolean` | `true` |

Totals, page numbers and page sizes use JavaScript safe integers. Finite positive values above the safe range are capped at the maximum safe integer and produce a development warning. To bound rendered page controls, base-size is capped at 201 and buffer-size at 100; out-of-range values produce a development warning.

Responsive switches between full and simple layouts preserve the page-jump draft without submitting it. Focus is preserved when both layouts display a jump input. Press Enter or leave the input to submit.

After a keyboard quick jump, if the ellipsis button disappears and the target page is accepted, focus moves to the current page button. Rejected controlled updates or focus moved elsewhere do not steal focus.

auto-adjust requests an adjustment only when total or page-size changes after creation; it does not clamp the initial default-value or controlled model-value to the page count. A controlled parent may reject the request.

## Behavior

Containers at or below `compact-breakpoint` automatically use compact mode, consistently in desktop sidebars and mobile. Totals/page-size selectors remain; auxiliary controls wrap. Previous/next sizes follow size without forced narrow-screen enlargement (formerly 36px). `responsive=false` retains full page numbers; extremely narrow page lists scroll internally without widening the page.

The compact current-page input also serves as the jumper, so no duplicate jumper appears. `page-item`, `page-item-ellipsis`, `jumper-prepend` and `jumper-append` render only in their full-mode controls.

Page buttons support Tab/Enter/Space, with `aria-current=page` on the current page. The jumper requests a numeric keyboard and submits on Enter/blur. Empty, nonnumeric or fractional values do not navigate; out-of-range integers clamp to valid pages. Disabled blocks all commits.

`auto-adjust` tries to preserve the previous page's first item when page size changes, clamps to the last page after total reductions and returns to page 1 for zero items. Controlled mode proposes updates only; the parent decides the display. An explicit parent modelValue in the same update batch takes precedence.

Both full and compact jumper inputs show the current page. Navigation, external modelValue changes and page-size adjustments update them together. Invalid input restores the current page number.

### PaginationPageSizeProps

The page-size selector fits its selected text and arrow with only item spacing between them, updating on option/language changes. `--c-pagination-select-width` overrides its width. Popup menus size independently from option content.

Both platforms support `disabled?: boolean`, `placement?: 'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end'`, `popupContainer?: string | HTMLElement | false`, `class?: string` and `style?: CSSProperties`. Outer disabled takes precedence. Default placement is bottom-start.

Use the documented page-size selector options. page-size, page-size-options and size control the pagination value, options and dimensions.

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。页码与上一页/下一页含义保持不变，默认前后图形跟随阅读方向。输入页码、禁用边界和选择不因方向切换而改变；自定义图形插槽由业务决定方向。

## 触发与定位

### 弹层定位

普通使用无需配置方位：默认 bottom-start，空间不足时底层 Trigger 自动翻转和约束。pageSizeProps.placement 仅是条数 Select 的受限覆盖入口，链路为 Pagination → Select.triggerProps.placement → Trigger；不是分页器自身位置。

## 行为说明

容器宽度不超过 `compact-breakpoint` 时自动使用简洁模式；桌面侧栏与移动端规则相同。保留总数和条数选择器，辅助控件换行，上一页、下一页按钮跟随 size，不再在窄屏强制放大（默认 36px）。设置 `responsive=false` 保留完整页码，极窄时仅页码列表横向滚动，不撑宽页面。

简洁模式的当前页输入框承担跳转功能，不重复展示独立 jumper。`page-item`、`page-item-ellipsis`、`jumper-prepend`、`jumper-append` 仅在完整模式的对应控件中渲染。

页码按钮支持 Tab、Enter、Space，当前页使用 `aria-current=page`。跳转框使用数字键盘提示，Enter 或失焦提交；空值、非数字、小数不跳转，整数越界限制到有效页码。禁用状态阻止所有提交。

`auto-adjust` 在条数改变时尽量保留原页面首条数据的位置，总数减少时限制到最后一页，零条数据时页码回到 1。受控模式只发出更新请求，显示由父组件决定；父组件同一批更新明确设置 modelValue 时优先遵循该值。

完整模式和简洁模式的“前往”输入框均显示当前页码。点击翻页、外部更新 modelValue 或切换每页条数触发页码调整时同步回显；非法输入恢复为当前页码。

### PaginationPageSizeProps

每页条数选择器按已选文字与下拉箭头自适应宽度，两者之间仅保留条目间距，切换选项或语言时自动更新。可通过 `--c-pagination-select-width` 自定义宽度。弹出菜单仍按选项内容独立计算宽度。

两端支持相同配置：`disabled?: boolean`、`placement?: 'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end'`、`popupContainer?: string | HTMLElement | false`、`class?: string`、`style?: CSSProperties`。外层 disabled 优先。默认 placement 为 bottom-start。

此配置不再透传任意 SelectProps/MenuProps。分页值、选项和尺寸分别使用 page-size、page-size-options、size。

Border and shadow are independent. An explicit radius overrides round; removing it restores round. The inner native button provides keyboard semantics, and its click bubbles to Paper to update parent-owned feedback.

<demo src="./__demos__/live-properties.vue"></demo>

## API

### Paper Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bordered | Show a border independently of elevation | boolean | false |
| elevation | false disables; true uses level 2; numeric levels 0–24 | boolean / number | false |
| ripple | Opt-in ripple; does not add button semantics | boolean | false |
| radius | Explicit radius, taking priority over round | number / string | — |
| width | Width | number / string | — |
| height | Surface height | number / string | — |
| round | 50% radius; a circle only with equal width and height | boolean | false |
| inline | Use inline-flex | boolean | false |

Numbers and numeric strings for radius/width/height use px. Other strings pass through as CSS lengths, such as 1rem, 50% and calc(100% - 8px). Classes, native attributes and styles fall through to the root.

elevation=false adds no elevation class, true uses level 2, and numeric values are rounded to the nearest integer then clamped to 0–24. NaN/Infinity produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and fall back to 2 at runtime. Numeric radius/width/height values must be finite and nonnegative; invalid numbers remove that inline dimension instead of retaining its previous value, while zero remains valid. Decimal and scientific-notation numeric strings use px. Other CSS strings are parsed by the browser; expressions unsupported by the browser are not promised.

### Paper Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| click | Triggered when the paper is clicked | MouseEvent |

click only notifies with the original MouseEvent, including bubbling clicks from children. @click.once follows standard Vue event semantics without awaiting listener Promises. PaperProps includes this listener and is consistent between root and subentry. PaperInstance has no additional business execution methods.

| --- | --- |
| default | Paper content |

## Content and presentation

### Guard Protocol

<demo src="./__demos__/en-US/guard-protocol.vue"></demo>

Promise and done share a single completion state: false/done(false) rejects; true/done() allows; a resolved Promise<void> allows. The first completion wins. Errors emit guard-error; cancellation/unmount invalidates late completion. Synchronous void retains the callback protocol and waits for done on these close/confirm guards.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

## Keyboard and focus

Provide a focusable trigger in the default slot. Opening moves focus into the non-modal confirmation dialog; Tab reaches its buttons and Escape requests closure. When focus is still inside on closure, it returns to the trigger. Clicking outside and moving focus away does not pull it back. In controlled mode, focus stays in the dialog if the parent declines the close request.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content and actions use logical alignment, with confirmation/cancellation following reading order. Direction changes do not confirm or cancel. Explicit popup placements retain their existing physical/logical contract.

## 内容与展示

### 关闭守卫

`beforeConfirm(payload, done, context)` 和 `beforeCancel(payload, done, context)` 分别接收确认或取消的 action、完成回调与上下文。


只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。


<demo src="./__demos__/guard-protocol.vue"></demo>


Promise 与 done 共用一次完成状态：`false` / `done(false)` 阻止，`true` / `done()` 允许；Promise<void> 正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

## Reading direction

Horizontal segments, highlights and hints share the same logical origin. Vertical progress remains top to bottom; rings retain their existing angles and data order.

## Usage notes

### Geometry and motion
Built-in effects respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Track thickness applies to both horizontal and vertical layouts; circle geometry remains prop-driven.


`orientation` controls linear layout only; circle legend arrangement is unchanged. Circle `stroke-width` is a number in the 100×100 SVG coordinate system, not a CSS length. A `text` slot is displayed even when `show-text=false`. When `item.slot` is set, its prefix and `-leading`, `-label`, `-trailing` slots are used; missing dynamic slots use built-in content rather than generic `item-*` slots.

The pointer can enter and remain over the tooltip; after leaving, the focused segment’s tooltip returns. Escape closes it. Tooltip content is descriptive and should not contain interactive form controls.

将多个数值展示为同一条进度轨中的分段，并提供对应图例。

## 基础示例

### 基础用法

`items` 中每项的 `value` 都以 `max` 为基准计算宽度，开启 `show-text` 可展示累计百分比。

#### 尺寸

#### 颜色与纯进度轨

### 超额数据与键盘提示

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->
#### 本组配置对照

| 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | 分段数据 | 超额数据与键盘提示 |
| `max` | 所有分段计算占比时的总值 | 超额数据与键盘提示 |
| `tooltip` | 是否启用分段悬浮/聚焦提示 | 超额数据与键盘提示 |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

示例按钮由父级更新 `max`、`items` 和 `tooltip`，同步驱动线形与环形；它们不是组件内置的编辑事件。可切换容量 100/200、清空/恢复数据、关闭/开启提示。关闭提示后分段不再进入 Tab 顺序，清空后不保留提示。鼠标悬浮优先于键盘焦点，离开悬浮段后回到焦点段提示。

<demo src="./__demos__/overflow-keyboard.vue"></demo>

线形与环形按数据顺序累计裁剪到 max；图例和提示仍保留每项原始占比。例如 70+50 时第二段实际显示 30%，图例仍为 50%。非有限值和负数归零，非法 max 回退 100。Tab 聚焦可见分段展示提示，Escape 关闭；鼠标离开不会关闭仍处于焦点的提示。用 aria-label 为整个分组命名。

size 五档均实现，仅影响线形厚度（2/4/8/12/16px）；环形用 circle-size（支持 number/CSS长度）和 stroke-width。累计文本开关为 show-text，自定义插槽为 text。

使用 `text` 和 `item-trailing` 插槽自定义累计状态与图例尾部内容。

鼠标悬浮或键盘聚焦分段时会显示提示并加粗当前分段。item 的 `tip` 可覆盖默认文案，`tooltip` 插槽可完全自定义内容。

<demo src="./__demos__/slots.vue"></demo>

## 阅读方向

横向分段、高亮与提示使用同一逻辑起点；垂直进度仍从上到下，圆环保持原有角度与数据顺序。

## 使用说明

### 布局与动效
内置动效遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`。线形厚度同时适用于横向和纵向布局；环形尺寸通过属性配置。


`orientation` 只控制线形布局，圆环的图例排列不随它变化。圆环 `stroke-width` 是 100×100 SVG 坐标中的数值，不是 CSS 长度。提供 `text` 插槽时，即使 `show-text=false` 也会显示该槽。设置 `item.slot` 后使用该前缀及其 `-leading`、`-label`、`-trailing` 槽；未提供的动态槽使用内置内容，不回退到通用 `item-*` 槽。

提示支持鼠标移入和停留，离开后恢复焦点对应的提示；Escape 可关闭。提示内容用于说明，请勿放入可交互表单控件。

--- permalink: /components/radio/ --- # Radio 在一组相关且互斥数据中，用户仅能选择一个选项。 分组示例覆盖父级接受/拒绝更新、只读和异步选项回显；移除选项不会清空业务值。示例外层 Space 的纵向布局使用 `direction="column"`，与选择组自身的 `orientation="vertical"` 分开理解。 ## 阅读方向 单选组继承来源 dir。RTL 的左右方向键按可见方向移动，跳过禁用项；上下键、Home/End 保持逻辑顺序。普通与按钮式单选组均保留单一 Tab 入口，方向切换不修改已选业务值。 ## 基础示例 ### 基本使用 单选框的基本用法。 ## 分组与布局 ### 单选组声明方式 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ---------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | | `value` | 选项的`value` | 单选组声明方式、单选框组方向、按钮类型的单选框组 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用；未设置时继承表单/分组 | 单选组声明方式、布局 | 比较子项与 options 声明，选择不同项观察组值；自定义字段与异步数据仍单独展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 单选框组 通过`RadioGroup`组件展示单选框组 #### 单选框组选项 `RadioGroup`通过`options`属性设置子元素
### 单选框组方向 通过设置`orientation="vertical"`可以展示竖直的单选框组。 ### 按钮类型的单选框组 通过指定`variant="button"`，可以显示按钮类型的单选框组。 ### 布局 使用`RadioGroup`传入`Radio`配合`Grid`组件实现灵活布局。 ### 分组状态与只读 `model-value !== undefined` 表示受控，父级不回写时保留原值；`default-value` 只初始化非受控值。分组内只由 Group 发出 `update:modelValue → change(value, event?)`，并通知 FormItem 一次，子项不重复发值变化事件。 原生输入的选中值、ARIA 状态和选中样式与模型保持一致。受控分组拒绝选择时，同时恢复原选中项和被点击项；标签、Enter 和空格激活各只提出一次更新。 Group 的 `disabled`、`readonly`、`error` 未设置时继承表单，显式 `false` 可以覆盖表单；子项不能绕过 Group 的禁用或只读限制。 ### 按钮尺寸 两端均支持 `variant="button"`。RadioGroup 的 `size` 支持 `xs / sm / md / lg / xl`，只调整按钮高度；普通圆形 Radio 不随 size 缩放。未设置时继承表单/全局尺寸，最终默认为 md。Group 的 variant 优先于子项。 ## 选项与值模型 ### 独立值模型与方法 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------- | | `default-value` | 非受控初始值 | 独立值模型与方法、受控 | | `value` | 选项的`value` | 独立值模型与方法 | | `readonly` | 是否只读；未设置时继承表单/分组 | 独立值模型与方法 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用；未设置时继承表单/分组 | 独立值模型与方法 | Radio 的值为 string / number / boolean 或 null，null 表示未选中；重复点击已选项不会取消，父级可写 null 清空。 两端统一使用 `default-value` 初始化非受控值；受控提议被拒绝时保持原值。用户选择按 `update:modelValue → change(value, event?)` 通知，命令式调用的 event 为 undefined。 提供 `select()`、`focus(options?)`、`blur()`。禁用禁止选择和聚焦，只读允许聚焦、禁止改值。Enter 按下与空格释放激活当前控件，长按不重复激活，失焦/停用会取消待处理的空格操作。 ### 选项数据与标签 两端均支持原始值或对象选项。`field-names` 映射 `label/value/disabled/readonly/indeterminate`；只读选项允许聚焦但不能改值，Checkbox 的半选仅用于展示。 `label` 插槽接收 `{ data, checked }`，优先于标签渲染函数 `(data, checked) => VNodeChild`。data 为保留业务字段的归一化副本，不修改输入对象；未提供标签时显示值的文字。 显式传入 `options` 时替代默认插槽，包括 `[]`；不传时使用默认插槽。选项值限字符串、有限数字或布尔值；缺失/非法值及同类型重复值被忽略（保留第一项）。`false`、`0`、`''` 和 `'0'` 是不同选项。异步选项变更不反向修改模型。 RadioGroup 默认 `null`，表示未选中；外部写入 `null` 清空。`''` 是有效选项，不再作为空状态标记。 ### 受控 通过`v-model`(`model-value`)属性控制是否选中 ## 交互与键盘 ### 交互状态切换 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ---------- | ------------------------------- | ------------ | | `value` | 选项的`value` | 交互状态切换 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用；未设置时继承表单/分组 | 交互状态切换 | | `readonly` | 是否只读；未设置时继承表单/分组 | 交互状态切换 | | `error` | 错误态；未设置时继承表单/分组 | 交互状态切换 | 适用于互斥选项。调整禁用、只读、错误反馈，用相同数据观察变化。控制区始终可用，可以随时恢复编辑；错误外观本身不会触发表单校验。 ### 键盘导航 Tab 进入已选项（没有已选项时进入第一个可用项）；方向键循环，Home / End 跳到首尾，跳过禁用项。只读项可聚焦但不改变值。导航仅作用于当前分组，不拦截面板内其他按钮的键盘事件。 ## 控件与内容定制 ### 原生控件与自定义图标 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ---------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | | `value` | 选项的`value` | 原生控件与自定义图标、自定义单选框 | | `readonly` | 是否只读；未设置时继承表单/分组 | 原生控件与自定义图标 | 两端均使用原生 radio input。Group 的 name 供原生表单提交，子项可覆盖。aria-label/input-attrs 作用于 input；组件管理的 type、checked、disabled、tabindex 不允许覆盖。图标插槽仅替换图标；#radio 替换全部可见内容，使用时须提供可访问名称。 ### 自定义单选框 使用 #radio 插槽自定义单选框的展示。 ## 异步选项 ### 异步选项 开启“手动返回”后使用真实本地Promise，不走默认定时器。连续加载两次，分别按新旧或旧新顺序返回：只有当前请求版本可替换选项、结束加载。移除选项使在途版本失效但保留业务选值；旧任务仍可手动返回。Applied/Ignored/Pending显示应用、忽略及等待数，加载/返回不增加用户变更次数。版本保护和等待清理由示例业务加载器负责，不代表Radio自动解决网络竞争，也不访问外部服务。 选项载入、移除和外部值更新均不会反向触发值变化；未载入的已选值不会自动清理。重复选择当前值不再触发 change，false、0、空字符串按实际值比较。 示例以 800ms 本地延迟模拟加载。等待期间可设为设备 A 或清空选择，选项到达后按最新模型反显；这些外部操作不会增加用户变更次数。加载中移除选项会取消待完成任务，避免旧选项重新显示。 等待期间仍可用方向键选择已加载的选项；同值选项重新加载后保留当前焦点。加载提示保持稳定节点，避免提示显隐导致分组重新挂载；重复激活当前值不会增加 change 次数。 ## 原生输入属性与键盘拦截 `id`、`form`、`required`、其他原生约束、`aria-*`、`data-*` 和键盘监听器传给实际 input；`class` / `style` 和其他外壳属性保留在 label。未提供 id 时生成稳定且唯一的原生 id；外部 label[for] 可以关联显式 id。HTML required 参与浏览器原生表单验证，与 Form 的业务校验规则分开。 原生监听的 Once / Capture / Passive 修饰符保留在 input，不会因插槽中嵌套按钮而错误触发。原生键盘监听 preventDefault() 可以阻止 Enter / Space ## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

size/gap do not accept xs/sm/md/lg/xl presets. Omitted or invalid values retain style defaults. Size must be positive; gap accepts zero and negative gaps fall back to the style default. CSS var/calc/min/max/clamp lengths are supported. Scores normalize to 0–count in steps of 1 or 0.5. Non-finite scores display zero without changing the external value.

Precedence: grading > character > icon/half-icon/empty-icon > default icon. String icons require global registration; component values do not.

### Rate Methods

focus() focuses the rating; blur() removes focus. Readonly remains focusable, while disabled leaves the Tab sequence. Arrow keys adjust, Home clears and End selects the maximum. Keyboard events from interactive children and Alt/Ctrl/Meta combinations are not intercepted. Touch and mouse share half-selection/clearing rules.
