## 阅读方向与键盘交互 Tree 继承容器阅读方向，缩进、连接线和展开箭头随方向显示。键盘焦点与选中状态独立：上下键移动到上一/下一可用可见节点，Home/End 移动到首尾。LTR 右键展开或进入子级、左键收起或返回父级；RTL 左右互换。Enter 选中，Space 优先勾选可勾选节点，否则执行选中。 键盘跳过禁用节点，根节点通过 `aria-activedescendant` 标识当前焦点，虚拟滚动时保持根节点焦点。展开、过滤、删除节点后会修正活动节点。拖放的前/内/后仍由纵向位置决定，不因 RTL 反转。TreeSelect 内嵌使用时由组合框管理焦点。 复选框作为节点状态的视觉控件，不单独进入 Tab 顺序；键盘使用 Space 勾选当前节点，指针点击复选框仍可勾选并保持树焦点。节点的 `aria-checked` 表示选中、未选中或半选状态。 ## CSS --- lang: en-US permalink: /en/components/tree-select/ --- # TreeSelect A tree-backed selection field with explicit search fields and controlled selection. ## Reading direction Inherits source dir. Horizontal keys expand, enter children, return or collapse according to reading direction; vertical keys and Home/End keep logical order. Search uses the actual active match. Values and multiple-value arrays are not reversed. Portaled content retains source direction in custom containers. ## Basic examples ### Basic ## Data and options ### Search Matching #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | -------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | | `data` | Data | Search Matching, Retain the query after selecting | | `filterable` | Whether to allow searching | Search Matching, Retain the query after selecting | | `case-sensitive` | Case-sensitive built-in search | Search Matching | | `multiple` | Whether to support multiple selection | Retain the query after selecting | | `retain-input-value` | Keep search text after selecting an option | Retain the query after selecting | ### Retain the query after selecting Type Al, then select Alice: the selected model contains Alice in both examples. Without retain-input-value the search text becomes empty; with it enabled, Al remains so Alan is still easy to select next. This does not control the selected label or whether the field is searchable. filterable enables searching. The candidate `data` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. Components own loading, cancellation and stale results, and emit load-error on failure. Choice groups initialize with an empty query; searchable fields load when queries change. Root tree loaders remain independent of existing load-more child loading. ## Lifecycle and edge cases ### Passthrough Options #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- | | `data` | Data | Passthrough Options | | `tree-props` | Can accept Props of all [Tree](/vue/component/tree) components | Passthrough Options | | `open-trigger-target` | Pointer opening target: the whole field or only the suffix icon. Explicit keyboard opening and controlled open remain available. | Copying and editing | | `filterable` | Whether to allow searching | Copying and editing | ### Copying and editing With open-trigger-target="icon", use the input area to edit or copy and the suffix button to open. Existing text remains copyable when editing or search is disabled. ## API ### Empty values and reading placeholders `empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/). | Prop | Type | Default and scope | | ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- | | empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list | | empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid | These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. TreeSelectValue, TreeSelectLabelValue, TreeSelectReadScope, TreeSelectNodeStatus, TreeSelectEmits, TreeSelectSlots and TreeSelectExpose are available from the root and tree-select entry points. There is no default editor replacement slot; use tree-slot-label for node content. ### Editing and confirmation Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled. ### In-place editing and keyboard precedence `click`/`dblclick` use Form's editing inheritance. Hover/focus shows an edit icon that opens editing directly. disabled, readonly and readPretty hide edit entries. Panel clicks change only the draft. While open, arrows navigate visible enabled nodes; Left/Right collapse/expand or move to parents/children; Home/End reach first/last nodes. Enter selects/checks the current node, or toggles an unselectable branch. Search prioritizes matching nodes; multiple selection uses Tree checking rules. Esc first closes the panel, retaining the draft and restoring input focus. With the panel closed, Enter saves and Esc cancels editing. Compare AutoComplete/PeopleSelect in Form's unified field-presentation examples. Checkboxes in a multiple-selection tree do not create separate Tab stops. Pointer selection retains input focus, and nodes expose checked and mixed states through `aria-checked`. Duplicate expansion requests for the same asynchronously loaded node are merged. Replacing nodes, closing editors or resetting Form invalidates old requests so they cannot expand/check nodes. Arrows can enter loaded children immediately. Query/candidate changes clear old filters before Enter can choose stale options. Field confirmation still validates before asynchronous commit. ### Node fields and business values Nodes default to `{ value, label, children }`. `value` is a tree-wide unique string/number, including `0`; `label` is display content. Map other backend fields with `fieldNames: { value: 'id', label: 'text', children: 'items' }` without changing backend data. Declarative child `name`, Vue `:key` and Table `rowKey` retain separate meanings. Independent Tree state uses `selectedValues/defaultSelectedValues`, `checkedValues/defaultCheckedValues`, `halfCheckedValues` and `expandedValues/defaultExpandedValues`, updated through corresponding named v-models. `check` event indeterminate sets use `halfCheckedValues`. Node content uses `label`; TreeSelect forwards `tree-slot-label`. `scrollIntoView({ value })` locates business values; explicit `index` remains a zero-based virtual-list array `index`. ### Search configuration Use `filterable` for searching; omission follows only `multiple`. Enabling `tree-checkable` alone creates a `multiple`-value model without enabling searching; set `filterable` explicitly. `retain-input-value` independently retains search text after selection and defaults to false. Replace the old `allow-search` with `filterable`. Replace `{ retainInputValue: true }` with `filterable` plus `retain-input-value`. ### Search fields `searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node. ## Configuring the cleared value `empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults. Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests. ### Input and open button The native combobox and separate open button both announce aria-haspopup=tree. While the panel is visible, the same aria-controls points to the actual tree. Expanded state stays synchronized; disabled/readonly and open-trigger-target rules remain in force. ### Selection actions during loading While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching. Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing. ## CSS Variables

基础示例 ### 基础用法 基础用法。 ## 数据与选项 ### 搜索大小写与匹配字段 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | -------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | | `data` | 树节点数据 | 搜索大小写与匹配字段、选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 | | `filterable` | 是否启用搜索 | 搜索大小写与匹配字段、选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 | | `case-sensitive` | 内置搜索是否区分大小写 | 搜索大小写与匹配字段 | | `multiple` | 多选 | 选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 | | `retain-input-value` | 选中后保留搜索文本 | 选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 | 现在统一默认为 label、不区分大小写。` :search-fields="['value', 'label']"` 同时匹配两字段；字段通过 fieldNames 映射。自定义 filterTreeNode 优先，disableFilter=true 跳过本地筛选。匹配祖先时保留父子树路径，可见节点和键盘候选使用同一规则。 如需按 value 区分大小写搜索，显式设置 `:search-fields="['value']" case-sensitive`。 ### 选择后保留搜索词是什么意思 输入 Al，再点 Alice：两种情况都已经选中 Alice。不开 retain-input-value 时搜索输入清成空字符串；开启后输入框里还保留 Al，方便接着选同样匹配 Al 的 Alan。它不控制选中人员的显示名称，也不负责开启搜索；filterable 才是允许输入搜索词。 候选属性 `data` 支持数组或 `(query, { signal }) => 数组/Promise`。加载、取消、过期结果隔离由组件内部处理，失败触发 load-error。单选/多选分组初始化以空字符串查询，搜索型字段在查询变化时调用；树形字段根数据与原有 load-more 子节点懒加载独立。 ## 继承同一编辑规则。悬浮或聚焦显示编辑图标，点击图标直接编辑；disabled、readonly、readPretty 不显示编辑入口。面板内点击仅修改草稿。 面板打开时，方向键导航可见且未禁用的节点，左右键展开/收起或移动到子/父节点，Home/End 定位首末节点；Enter 选择/勾选当前节点，不能选择的分支则展开或收起。搜索优先激活匹配节点，多选复用树的勾选规则。Esc 先关闭面板并保留草稿、恢复输入焦点；面板关闭后 Enter 保存字段，Esc 取消编辑。与 AutoComplete、PeopleSelect 的对比示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。 多选树的复选框不单独进入 Tab 顺序；指针勾选时保留输入焦点，节点通过 `aria-checked` 暴露选中和半选状态。 异步加载同一节点时合并重复展开操作；节点被替换、编辑器关闭或表单重置后，旧请求不再触发展开或勾选。加载完成后，方向键可立即进入新子节点。搜索词或候选变化时先清除旧过滤结果，避免 Enter 选中旧候选；字段确认仍先校验，再执行异步提交。 ### 节点字段与业务值 节点默认使用 `{ value, label, children }`，`value` 是全树唯一的字符串或数字（支持 `0`），`label` 是展示内容。后端使用其他字段时可配置 `fieldNames: { value: 'id', label: 'text', children: 'items' }`，无需修改后端数据。声明式组件子项的 `name`、Vue 的 `:key` 和 Table 的 `rowKey` 保持各自含义。 Tree 的独立状态采用 `selectedValues/defaultSelectedValues`、`checkedValues/defaultCheckedValues`、`halfCheckedValues`、`expandedValues/defaultExpandedValues`，分别通过同名具名 v-model 更新；`check` 事件数据中的半选集合为 `halfCheckedValues`。节点内容插槽为 `label`，TreeSelect 对应透传插槽为 `tree-slot-label`。`scrollIntoView({ value })` 按业务值定位；显式 `index` 仍表示虚拟列表从 0 开始的数组下标。 ### 搜索开关 统一使用 `filterable` 启用搜索；未指定时只跟随 `multiple`。单独开启 `tree-checkable` 会产生多值模型，但不自动启用搜索，可显式设置 `filterable`。`retain-input-value` 独立控制选中后是否保留搜索文本，默认 false。 旧 `allow-search` 改为 `filterable`；原 `{ retainInputValue: true }` 写法改为 `filterable` 加 `retain-input-value`。 ### 搜索字段 `searchFields` / `search-fields` 是只读 `('label' | 'value')[]`，默认 `['label']`；多字段为 OR 匹配，大小写默认不敏感。配置 `['value', 'label']` 可同时搜索编码和名称，fieldNames 将语义字段映射到业务字段；空数组对非空查询不匹配任何项。value 采用字符串比较，不做对象深层搜索，对象值或拼音等复杂规则仍用自定义回调。自定义回调优先并自行决定大小写；远程结果使用原有关闭本地过滤协议。Cascader 保留路径语义，会检查路径各节点的配置字段。 ## 配置清空后的值 `empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。 refresh 可在编辑器未打开时重试组件自有的异步选项读取，沿用既有 AbortSignal、loading 和 load-error 协议，不自动打开编辑器；静态数组不产生额外请求。 ### 输入与展开按钮 原生 combobox 与独立展开按钮都声明 aria-haspopup=tree；面板可见时，两者通过同一 aria-controls 指向实际树。展开状态同步，按钮仍遵守禁用/只读和 open-trigger-target 规则。 ### 加载期间的选择动作 手动 loading 或当前候选请求处于加载状态时，纯选择字段保留已有值，暂停新选择、清空与标签移除。被阻止的动作不发送业务通知，也不提交模型。字段搜索仍可输入，disabled/readonly 不因此改写；需要禁止搜索时单独设置。 延迟编辑层的清空和确认在此期间不可用，仍可取消或关闭。手动标记和当前请求都结束后，操作按正常规则恢复，并继续尊重禁用选项。Input、AutoComplete 等自由文本字段的 loading 继续允许文本编辑与清空，不套用选择值的暂停规则。 ## CSS Variables

Trigger does not assign `role`, `aria-describedby` or business labels; semantic wrappers such as Tooltip, Popover and Menu must supply them. ## Native event modifiers on reference elements Native `click`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focusin`, `focusout`, `contextmenu` listeners and `.once`, `.capture`, `.passive` modifiers bind to the actual reference element, not the popup. `.once` follows the native element's listener lifetime. --- permalink: /components/trigger/ --- # Trigger 更换或清空浮层引用，以及卸载组件时，会移除旧窗口的滚动监听。 关闭或解绑后，尚未执行的定位和滚动关闭任务不会影响后续打开的浮层。 mouse-enter-delay／mouse-leave-delay 是交互请求延迟，独立于CSS进出时长。取消、替换、KeepAlive停用或卸载后，旧已出队回调不会提交；停用或卸载后保留的请求方法不再调度。重新激活接受新请求、不重放旧延迟，受控open仍由调用方决定。 连续点击两个独立触发器时，先关闭之前的顶层浮层，再打开新的浮层；嵌套子浮层仍视为父层内部。受控 open 只发出关闭请求，调用方仍可决定是否接受。 无视觉样式的锚点浮层基础组件，统一负责触发、定位、挂载、层级和打开状态。业务提示优先使用 Tooltip，结构化内容使用 Popover，命令选择使用 Menu；只有构建新的浮层组件时才直接使用 Trigger。 ## `.once`、`.capture`、`.passive` 均绑定到实际参考元素，不会落到浮层。`.once` 按原生元素的监听生命周期执行；更新回调不重新启用已消费的监听，换参考元素或移除后重加监听才开始新的周期。停用和卸载会解绑。普通监听器只通知，返回 Promise 不驱动打开或加载，异常进入 Vue 的事件错误处理链。 `reference-attrs` 的 `aria-describedby` 与参考元素已有描述 ID 合并去重；清理或更换引用时恢复原始属性。 `fixed` 定位会识别 transform、filter、perspective 等形成的固定定位包含块，并处理轴向缩放；不保证旋转或倾斜坐标系精确。可访问的同源 iframe 引用与弹层之间会换算坐标并绑定各自文档事件；不支持跨源或无共同祖先的浏览上下文。启用 `update-at-scroll` 时，两端文档及可滚动祖先的滚动都会更新位置。 ## CSS Variables Tooltip 与 Popover 自行定义箭头外观；应覆盖其组件变量，而不是 Trigger arrow-background。 ### 减少动态效果 内置 CSS 过渡遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`。关闭过渡不改变最终显隐、选中／展开状态及事件语义；插槽内自定义动画由应用自行控制。

The editor is single-line. `heading` accepts 1–6 and falls back to h1 for invalid values. `copy-delay` accepts finite values from 0 to 2147483647 ms and falls back to 3000 for invalid values. `info` and `tertiary` use their semantic text colors; `default` or an omitted status uses the normal text color. ## CSS Variables

--- permalink: /components/typography/ --- # 排版 Typography 用于展示标题、段落、文本内容。 ## 基础示例 ### 基础用法 排版组件用于展示标题、段落、文本内容，这里展示了排版的组合使用。 ## 内容与展示 ### 标题 展示不同级别的标题。 ### 文本 不同样式的文本。 ### 段落 文本段落样式。长文本推荐默认行高，短文本推荐 `spacing="close"`。 ### 省略 在空间不足时省略多行文本内容。支持 JS 测量省略、CSS 省略、Tooltip / Popover 以及展开折叠。 ## 交互与控制 ### 可交互 提供复制、编辑文本等功能。 ## 生命周期与边界 ### 测量与复制反馈生命周期 复制反馈使用现有 `copy-delay`（默认 3000ms），是交互反馈等待，不是 CSS 动效完成时间。重复复制替换旧等待；关闭复制、禁用或修改等待时长会清除当前反馈。停用／卸载取消反馈计时与省略测量 RAF，保留操作和旧回调不能继续写入；激活重新测量，不恢复旧任务。禁用态文字仍可测量省略，不允许复制／编辑／展开交互。省略关闭、展开或进入编辑会取消旧测量；完成后重放和测量重入不能覆盖新结果。 ## API ### Typography Slots | 插槽名 | 描述 | 参数 | | --- | --- | --- | | default | 排版内容 | `-` | ### TypographyText Props | 属性名 | 描述 | 类型 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | --- | :---: | | status | 文本语义状态 | `SemanticStatus`

Types 组件导出以下类型定义： ```ts import type { TypographyInstance, TypographyParagraphInstance, TypographyTitleInstance, TypographyTextInstance, EllipsisConfig, } from '@cedar-design/ui' ``` ### EllipsisConfig | 属性名 | 描述 | 类型 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | --- | :---: | | rows | 显示行数；非安全正整数或非有限值回退为 1 | `number` | `1` | | expandable | 是否支持展开/折叠 | `boolean` | `false` | | ellipsisStr | 省略号 | `string` | `'...'` | | suffix | 后缀 | `string` | `-` | | showTooltip | 配置省略时的弹出框 | `boolean \| { type: 'tooltip' \| 'popover'; props: Record }` | `false` | | css | 是否使用 CSS 省略（此模式暂不支持展开、自定义省略号和后缀） | `boolean` | `false` | 编辑时，输入法候选确认不会结束编辑；非组合输入的 Enter 或失焦结束编辑。 复制成功后才显示反馈并触发 `copy`；原生剪贴板失败时尝试浏览器回退，回退也失败则不显示成功反馈。重复点击可重试，迟到的旧结果不会覆盖新状态。 CSS 省略只裁剪文本内容；复制和编辑按钮仍显示在裁剪区域外。CSS 模式不支持展开、自定义省略号和后缀。 默认复制和省略测量读取已渲染插槽的可读文本，组件内部更新也会同步；不会为了提取文字另外挂载插槽组件。富内容按浏览器文本规则提取，不包含 HTML 或输入控件的当前值；需要精确内容时请提供 `copy-text`。 编辑时保留原组件的标签、`id`、类名和布局样式；输入框使用提供的 `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby`，未提供时使用本地化编辑名称。回车结束后在按键释放时将焦点返回编辑按钮；失焦或业务已转移焦点时不会抢回焦点。`v-model:editing` 与 `v-model:edit-text` 的更新事件由各排版组件转发。 根 Typography 提供 `default` 插槽。`TypographyEmits` 和 `TypographyContentSlots` 可从根入口或组件入口导入；`TypographySlots` 是根组件插槽类型。`edit-text` 只控制编辑框的值，展示文本仍由 `default` 插槽提供，通常将同一业务值绑定到两处。编辑器为单行输入。 `heading` 支持 1–6，非法值渲染为 h1；`copy-delay` 支持 0 至 2147483647 毫秒的有限数，非法值回退为 3000。`info` 和 `tertiary` 使用对应语义文字色；`default` 或未设置沿用普通文字色。 ## --- lang: en-US permalink: /en/components/upload/ --- # Upload Disabled downloads match Link/Button link mode: remove href while retaining the link role, `aria-disabled` and `tabindex=-1`, and cancel the default click action. `readonly` still allows downloading. Re-enabling restores the original file URL and download filename. Upload UI and a headless useUploader composable. The application owns transport and server file deletion. ## Replacement and video metadata Enable reupload for per-item replacement, or call replace(file, replacementFile). Validation and beforeRemove rejection preserve the original item. An accepted replacement occupies the same position with a new UID and emits replace/change, not remove. A failed new upload can be retried; it does not automatically restore the old server file or delete it. Video duration is expressed in seconds and rendered as mm:ss or h:mm:ss. Local files are inspected; remote echoes provide duration from application metadata. Temporary resources are released on success, error, cancellation and disposal. | Variable | Default | | --------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | | --c-upload-gap | var(--c-sys-space-4) | | --c-upload-trigger-min-height | var(--c-sys-control-height-md) | | --c-upload-trigger-padding-horizontal | var(--c-sys-space-6) | | --c-upload-trigger-draggable-min-height | calc(var(--c-sys-control-height-md) * 2) | | --c-upload-card-size | calc(var(--c-sys-control-height-md) * 2) | | --c-upload-item-min-height | var(--c-sys-control-height-md) | | --c-upload-item-padding | var(--c-sys-space-4) | | --c-upload-thumb-size | var(--c-sys-control-height-lg) | | --c-upload-border-radius | var(--c-sys-radius-md) | | --c-upload-border-color | var(--c-sys-color-border-default) | | --c-upload-background | var(--c-sys-color-surface-default) | | --c-upload-text-color | var(--c-sys-color-content-primary) | | --c-upload-secondary-text-color | var(--c-sys-color-content-secondary) | | --c-upload-hover-background | var(--c-sys-color-state-hover) | | --c-upload-active-color | var(--c-sys-color-action-primary) | | --c-upload-error-color | var(--c-sys-color-content-danger) | | --c-upload-action-size | var(--c-sys-control-touch-target) | | --c-upload-progress-height | var(--c-sys-space-2) | | --c-upload-disabled-opacity | .56 | | --c-upload-font-size | var(--c-sys-font-size-md) | ## Basic examples ### Read Only ## Appearance and states ### State Controls ### State Lab ### Custom Surface ## File sources and validation ### Directory ### Clipboard ### Replacement Validation ## Queues and progress ### External State ### Queue Request ## Async hooks and requests ### Before Remove ### Prepare Request ### Metadata Request ### Late Request ## Usage notes ### Editing and confirmation This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled. `before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form. Attachment confirmation commits file-list relationships; it cannot undo completed remote uploads or permanent deletion. To defer network side effects, set `auto-upload="false"` and upload after the final business submission. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. ### Configuration Public variable suffixes match across platforms; all defaults appear below with c/mp prefixes respectively. ## API ### Empty values and reading placeholders `empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/). | Prop | Type | Default and scope | | ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- | | empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list | | empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid | These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. Form receives one change notification per change, including progress/state updates. - read(item): reading completed; business code may take over uploading. It does not indicate server success. - rejected(UploadRejectedFile[]): reason is accept/before-add/before-read/read-error/max-file-size/max-total-size/max-files. - exceed(nativeFiles, acceptedList): file-count limit exceeded. - progress(item,event?), success(item), error(item): active-request notifications. Stale/canceled callbacks have no effect. - remove(item): removal proposal after removal hooks accept it. - preview(item, UploadPreviewEvent): event.preventDefault() cancels built-in image/video preview. Programmatic previews are cancelable too; originalEvent is optional. ### Upload Slots - trigger({chooseFile,dragOver,disabled}): custom selection entry. Display-only content uses the wrapper button role and Enter/Space entry. Interactive custom content owns its keyboard behavior; the wrapper adds no button role or Tab stop. Bind the slot disabled value to your button. Calling chooseFile directly needs no .stop: bubbling does not choose again or also invoke requestChoose. Custom buttons relying on bubbling can still use requestChoose. Use requestChoose for asynchronous decisions, or synchronously call event.preventDefault() before awaiting and invoking chooseFile yourself. Click listener Promises are not collected. Each requestChoose callback selects at most once and expires on unmount or KeepAlive deactivation, even after reopening. - item({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace}): customize a whole file item. - remove-button({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace}): customize removal actions. - read({value,text}): field reading content; value is the nullable file model and text is formatted content. This differs from the file-read completion event. ### Upload Methods Provides chooseFile(), replace(file,replacement?), submit(file?), abort(file?), retry(file), remove(file), reset(), clearSuccess(), clearError(), getFiles(status?), preview(file) and closePreview(). useUploader(options) provides headless upload logic, addFiles(files), and input/drag handlers. chooseFile, replace, submit, retry and remove return `Promise` for their preparation stages. submit/retry await preparation hooks and request-factory creation, without guaranteeing network completion; success/error events report results. chooseFile completion does not mean the user has selected a file, and remove completion does not mean a controlled parent accepted its proposal. Item/remove-button remove, retry and replace, and trigger chooseFile retain the same Promise types. All public methods are callable before the editor first mounts. When it is unmounted, closed or deactivated, getFiles(status?) returns shallow snapshots of the accepted model filtered by status; asynchronous mutations settle as no-ops and synchronous mutations are no-ops. To perform an operation, first open and mount the editor through field interaction or controlled open, or use editMode="direct". Stored method references forward to the current instance after closing/reopening; cancelling an editor preserves the accepted model. ### Controlled state and lifecycle If a controlled parent rejects an addition, only read/list proposals emit; automatic upload waits until that uid is accepted, then runs once. Same-tick proposals merge transactionally; across ticks, the actual parent list is authoritative. Rejected entries do not count toward total size. Parents own consistency of late list replacements. Explicit removal of rejected items, reset or unmount releases generated URLs; external URLs are never revoked. Built-in preview retains its own URL ownership until closing and does not close another component's later preview. Cancellation covers before-upload, asynchronous headers/data/name and asynchronous custom-request handles. Retrying or replacing a File under the same uid invalidates old callbacks. before-read/before-upload replacements recheck limits. max-total-size counts accepted entries and the current valid prepared batch/request only. Disabled/readonly block selection, removal, submission and other mutations; readonly allows preview/download. KeepAlive deactivation cancels preparation/requests; reactivation allows new operations. ## Types UploadProps、UploadEmits、UploadSlots、UploadExpose、UploadPublicMethods、UploadFileItem、UploadStatus、UploadListType、UploadResolveType、UploadImageFit、UploadCapture、UploadRejectedFile、UploadRejectedReason、UploadRequestOptions、UploadRequest、UploadCustomRequest、UploadProgressEvent、UploadData、UploadHeaders、UploadBeforeRead、UploadBeforeUpload、UploadBeforeRemove、UploadCreateThumbnailUrl、UploadIsSuccessResponse、UploadRequestChoose、UploadPreviewEvent、UseUploaderOptions、UploadInstance。 ## Cover attachments and video duration `reupload` (default false) enables a per-item replacement action, including when maxFiles has been reached. `replace(file, replacement?: File): Promise` opens a single-file chooser or validates the supplied File. It respects readonly/disabled and the chooser hook. Validation and beforeRemove run before an atomic in-place replacement proposal with a new UID; count and total size exclude the old item. Cancellation, rejection, guard veto and stale targets preserve the old item. A controlled parent decides acceptance. The `replace(next, previous)` event is a model proposal, not remote success or removal; remove is not emitted. Once accepted, obsolete transport callbacks are ignored; new upload failures can be retried. The item slot also exposes replace(). `UploadFileItem.duration?: number` uses seconds, displayed as mm:ss / h:mm:ss; unknown/invalid durations are hidden. Metadata reads local File objects only, waits at most 5 seconds and cleans temporary resources. Business code supplies remote durations. Video previews use popupContainer. Rejection/failure restores interaction, and repeated input does not restart the same operation. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate. Files remain concurrent; feedback aggregates all current guard tasks without treating change/progress notifications as tasks. `useUploader()` exposes readonly `guardPending`, aggregating currently awaited before hooks. It does not represent upload progress. ### Preparation vetoes and exceptions `beforeUpload` returning `false` or resolving to `false` is a business veto: no transport starts, the item stays `ready`, and neither `error` nor `rejected` is emitted. Throwing or rejecting is a preparation failure: no transport starts, the item becomes `error`, and the existing `error(item)` event reports the original cause as `item.error` exactly once. This event covers preparation and transport failures; it does not imply an HTTP request was sent. Both outcomes permit a later submission with a valid hook result. Notification return Promises do not hold the preparation task open. Obsolete or canceled attempts cannot report a new `error`. ## CSS Variables

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Verification codes are LTR content: rendering, pasting and focus movement use the original string order, while outer align start/end follows reading direction. RTL does not reverse code characters. Numeric and text codes share this order contract.

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / click / dblclick`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Cedar uses edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" to open an editor popup near the field. Enter/F2 also opens it; cancel/Escape discards the draft, and confirmation commits it. readPretty is an independent reading setting, separate from readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.
### Configuration

initial means no public override. CSS reads size fallbacks at the component element. Override through component style or theme.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](/en/guide/`empty-values`/).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

Explicit null is a controlled empty code and never falls back to default-value, which applies only when model-value is absent. reset() still proposes an empty string. Presentation clearing can submit null through empty-value=null; finish never receives null. An omitted model-value remains uncontrolled.

In deferred mode input / paste describe editing, while finish describes the finally accepted complete value. Canceling, rejection, readonly, disabled, external replacement or unmount retires unaccepted completion notifications. Ordinary finish listener Promises do not hold confirmation. A synchronous undefined before-commit return waits for done. Invalid type / align values diagnose and fall back to digit / center; gutter=0 and 0px remain valid.

### VerificationCode Events

| Event | Prop | Semantics |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| input | character, index, event | Starting character and zero-based index of each valid native input proposal |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null | Complete-code proposal |
| change | value: string \| null | Complete-code proposal for each valid edit, not necessarily accepted by a controlled parent |
| finish | value: string | Direct mode notifies after the parent accepts the complete code in the current render; deferred mode waits for confirmation guards and parent acceptance, never draft completion |
| update:open | open: boolean | Controlled editor visibility update |
| open-change | open: boolean | Actual editor visibility change |
| paste | text, event | Pasted text after paste-transform/type processing |
| focus / blur | FocusEvent | Focus enters/leaves the whole component; moving between cells does not duplicate notifications |
| click | MouseEvent | Non-disabled click |

Valid input order: input → update:modelValue → change. finish waits until the parent accepts the complete value in that render. Rejected controlled values restore native inputs; later asynchronous parent assignments do not add finish. reset() proposes empty and emits update:modelValue/change without simulating native input. Disabled, readonly or composing state prevents reset from changing values.

Paste overwrites from the current cell; root-level paste starts at cell 1. Input beyond the first empty cell moves to that first empty cell. A whole-code native input distributes across subsequent cells. SMS suggestions depend on the platform and browser: Cedar hints one-time-code on the first cell, while Maple retains autocomplete=off for all cells. Typing one character in a filled cell replaces that cell even when the caret follows its old character. Composition prefers the current compositionend text, including multiple code points, and falls back to the native value only when event data is missing. Processing is type filtering, formatter, then length clipping; rejected characters consume no cell. Text counts Unicode code points rather than grapheme clusters. External values affect display without an automatic formatted model update.

### VerificationCode Slots

| Slot | Prop | Description |
| --------- | -------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| separator | { index, character } | Overrides separator; not rendered after the last cell |
| read | { value: string \| null, text: string } | Custom read content, taking precedence over empty-text |

### VerificationCode Methods

- focus(index?): zero-based index; defaults to the first empty cell or the last cell when full. Direct readonly fields can receive focus. Deferred mode opens an editable panel first; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open.
- blur(): blur the current editor without reopening the panel.
- reset(): in direct mode, propose an empty value while respecting controlled ownership, disabled/readonly state, and composition. In deferred mode, open an empty draft; model and change notifications wait for final confirmation and before-commit approval. Cancellation preserves the original value.

Public methods remain callable from initial component mount. Stored methods resolve the current editor on every call and never use an old input after closure, reopening, or mode changes. Native input references are undefined while no editor is mounted.

### Keyboard and Form

Left/Right move between cells. Backspace removes the current character, or the previous one when empty. Delete removes the current character; following characters shift forward. IME composition does not trim, delete or move focus. Each native input has an SSR-stable id. Cell 1 uses autocomplete=one-time-code, others off. Provide aria-label.

InputGroup/Form state is inherited, with explicit disabled/readonly/error/size taking precedence. Internal cell Inputs do not duplicate Form notifications; the complete control notifies input/change once per edit. Both platforms implement three variants/five sizes using local FieldDecorator tokens.

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。验证码是 LTR 内容区域，按原字符串顺序展示、粘贴和移动焦点；外围 align 的 start/end 仍随阅读方向。RTL 不会将验证码字符倒序，数字与文字验证码使用相同的顺序契约。

## 使用说明

### 编辑与确认

通过 `edit-mode` 配置编辑方式；未指定时依次继承 FormItem、Form，默认 `direct`。支持值：`direct / click / dblclick`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Cedar 使用 edit-mode="click" / "dblclick" 在字段附近打开编辑浮层，Enter/F2 也可进入；取消/Escape 丢弃草稿，确认后提交。readPretty 为独立阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 分开。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。
### 配置说明

initial 表示未指定公开覆盖，实际 CSS 在组件元素处读取尺寸 fallback；可直接在组件 style 或主题中覆盖。

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](/guide/empty-values/)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

显式 null 是受控空码，不回退到 default-value；默认值仅用于未提供 model-value 的初始状态。reset() 仍提议空字符串；展示层清空可通过 empty-value=null 提交 null，不会让 finish 收到 null。未设置 model-value 时仍为非受控整码。

延迟模式的 input / paste 仍表示编辑过程；finish 表示最终接受的完整值，取消、拒绝、只读、禁用、外部替换及卸载会丢弃未接受的完成通知。普通 finish 监听返回的 Promise 不参与确认等待。before-commit 同步返回 undefined 时等待 done。type / align 非法值诊断后分别按 digit / center 处理；gutter=0 和 0px 均有效。

有效输入顺序是 input → update:modelValue → change，父级在本轮渲染接受完整值后才发 finish。拒绝的受控值会恢复原生输入；若父级异步接受，后续单独的模型赋值不会补发 finish。reset() 提议空值，发 update:modelValue / change，不模拟原生 input。禁用、只读及组合输入时 reset 不修改值。

粘贴从当前格开始覆盖，根元素的粘贴从第 1 格开始；超出首个空格的输入会归到首个空格。收到一次整码原生输入时会分配到后续格；是否显示短信建议由平台和浏览器决定，Cedar 首格提供 one-time-code 提示，Maple 保留所有格 autocomplete=off 的既有策略。已填格中单字符键入总是替换当前格，即使光标位于旧字符末尾；输入法优先使用本次 compositionend 提交文本（支持多码点分配），事件缺失提交文本时才回退原生值。type 过滤 → formatter → 长度裁剪，拒绝字符不占格。text 按 Unicode 码点（不是字素簇）计数。修改外部值只影响显示，不自动格式化写回。

| read | { value: string \| null, text: string } | 自定义阅读内容，优先于 empty-text |

### VerificationCode Methods

- focus(index?)：零基索引；省略时定位首个空格，满码定位末格。direct 只读时可聚焦；延迟模式下先打开允许编辑的面板，禁用、只读或纯阅读时不打开。
- blur()：使当前编辑器失焦，不重新打开面板。
- reset()：direct 模式提议清空，遵守受控模型及禁用/只读/组合输入限制；延迟模式先打开并清空草稿，最终确认及 before-commit 通过前不发模型更新或 change，取消则保留原值。

# ActionSheet

### Intro

An action sheet pops up to give the user the ability to select options.
`ActionSheet` supports service and component calls. The service uses a separate application and mounts to body; the component uses its host application context and `popup-container`.
The function returns a `Promise`, on selection return `action`. Click modal close to return `close`.

## Function calls

### Basic usage

```html
<script setup>
  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui'

  async function createBasic() {
    const action = await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
        },
      ],
    })

    action !== 'close' && Message(`Selected: ${action.name}`)
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="createBasic">Basic usage</mp-button>
</template>
```

## Keyboard and dialog name

Default actions use native buttons; disabled actions cannot be focused or selected. The title or title slot names the dialog, unless an explicit `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` overrides it. The visible cancel button requests closure through the close guard.

## Controlled state

When an action is selected, `close-on-click-action` requests an `open` update. A controlled parent that keeps `open=true` keeps the sheet `open`. Without `open`, `default-open` initializes internal state.

## Usage notes

### Closing from the title dropdown

`swipe-to-close` defaults to false. When enabled, the header can be dragged down to close; `swipe-threshold` defaults to 40 CSS px. Custom title slots use the surrounding header handle. Body options and header buttons do not initiate dragging. See Popup for gesture details.
`before-close` forwards to Popup. Overlay, Esc, route, dropdown and post-action `open` changes may be rejected asynchronously. Exceptions emit `close-error(error, reason)`. An action `select` event does not mean closing was approved.

## API

`open/defaultOpen` control current/initial uncontrolled panel visibility. Use `v-model:open` for two-way binding. defaultOpen is read once without initialization writeback.

### ActionSheet Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------ | -------- |
| `v-model:open` | Controlled visibility | _boolean_ | `-` |
| `default-open` | Initial uncontrolled visibility | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `before-close` | Close guard | _PopupBeforeClose_ | `-` |
| `swipe-to-close` | Enable downward swipe in the header | _boolean_ | `false` |
| `swipe-threshold` | Downward close threshold (CSS px) | _number_ | `40` |
| `actions` | Action list | _Actions_ | `[]` |
| `title` | Action sheet title | _string_ | `请选择` |
| `overlay` | Show overlay | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `overlay-class` | Custom overlay class | _string_ | `-` |
| `overlay-style` | Custom overlay style | _object_ | `-` |
| `lock-scroll` | Whether to disable scrolling penetration, scrolling the Dialog when disabled will not cause the body to scroll | _boolean_ | `true` |

## Close guards

The guard signature is `beforeClose({ reason }, done, { signal, event })`.

Return true/false or `Promise<boolean>`; a normally resolved async void result allows closing. Call done() to allow or done(false) to reject; synchronous void waits for done. The first result wins. Pending requests are deduplicated; errors retain the sheet and restore temporary button state. The third context argument supplies `signal` and the optional original `event`. Closing, unmounting or replacing the hook invalidates stale results.

Synchronous logging-only hooks must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means awaiting a callback. Earlier `Promise<void>` hooks without done now allow closing when their Promise resolves.

Popup reasons are overlay, escape, route, swipe, close, api and model. Rejecting an external open=false requests update:open(true). The component does not expose `requestClose()`; use an existing guarded close entry. Direct destruction does not wait for the hook.

Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.
`ActionSheet.close()` requests closing and respects `beforeClose`. A veto retains the service owner so closing can be requested again. A new programmatic invocation replaces the previous singleton: it disposes the previous host and settles its result as `close`, without waiting for that `close` guard or synthesizing lifecycle notifications.

# 动作面板

### 介绍

弹出一个动作面板提供用户选择选项的能力。

## 函数调用

### 基本使用

```html
<script setup>
  import { ActionSheet, Message } from '@maple-design/ui'

  async function createBasic() {
    const action = await ActionSheet({
      actions: [
        {
          name: 'Item 01',
          icon: 'user-circle-fill',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 02',
          icon: 'notebook',
        },
        {
          name: 'Item 03',
          icon: 'wifi',
        },
      ],
    })

    action !== 'close' && Message(`您选择的是:${action.name}`)
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-button status="primary" block @click="createBasic">基本使用</mp-button>
</template>
```

## 键盘与对话框名称

默认动作使用原生按钮，禁用动作不可聚焦或选择。标题和 title 插槽为对话框提供名称；显式 `aria-label` 或 `aria-labelledby` 可覆盖。可见的取消按钮通过关闭守卫请求关闭。

## 受控状态

选择动作时，`close-on-click-action` 会请求更新 `open`；受控父组件保持 `open=true` 时面板保持打开。未传 `open` 时使用 `default-open` 初始化内部状态。

## 使用说明

### 标题下拉关闭

`swipe-to-close` 默认 false；开启后可以从默认标题向下拖动关闭。`swipe-threshold` 默认为 40 CSS px。自定义 title 插槽沿用外层标题拖动区域，正文选项和标题内按钮不会触发拖动关闭。详见 Popup 的头部手势说明。
`before-close` 透传到 Popup，遮罩、Esc、路由、下拉以及操作后修改 `open` 的关闭请求均可异步拒绝；异常触发 `close-error(error, reason)`。操作的 `select` 表示选择事件，不代表关闭已获批准。

## API

`open/defaultOpen` 分别控制面板状态与非受控初始开合；使用 `v-model:open` 双向绑定。defaultOpen 只在创建时读取，不在初始化时回写。

## 关闭守卫

守卫签名为 `beforeClose({ reason }, done, { signal, event })`。

返回 true/false 或 `Promise<boolean>`；async 函数正常完成且返回 void 时放行。回调方式使用 done() 放行、done(false) 拒绝；同步返回 void 时等待 done，可异步调用。返回值和 done 同时使用时，第一次完成生效。等待中去重；异常保留弹层并恢复临时按钮状态。`signal` 和可选原始 `event` 由第三个 context 参数提供。关闭、卸载或更换钩子会使旧结果失效。

只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。

Popup 原因为 overlay、escape、route、swipe、close、api、model。拒绝外部 open=false 时请求 update:open(true)。组件未公开 `requestClose()`；需要受守卫控制的关闭时使用现有关闭入口，直接销毁组件不会等待内部钩子。

函数调用的通知回调不控制任务完成。服务的选择或关闭结果独立于回调异常结算，关闭完成时仍会清理所属宿主。异常继续通过调用方或 Vue 错误通道传递；回调返回 Promise 不控制 loading 或关闭。
`ActionSheet.close()` 是遵守 `beforeClose` 的关闭请求；拒绝后保留服务所有权，可以再次请求关闭。再次函数调用会替换旧单例：直接清理旧宿主并将旧结果结算为 `close`，不等待旧关闭守卫，也不合成生命周期通知。

# AutoComplete

Free-text input with suggestions. Both libraries independently maintain the same component, props, Menu and styles. Local Input/Form integration supplies hover versus touch behavior; no shared runtime or platform configuration.

Opening and filtering are independent: shouldOpen controls opening, filterOption filters candidates. Empty results, disabled and readonly keep the menu closed. No list/picker presentation is provided.

## Reading direction

The editor and suggestion popup inherit source dir, including in custom containers. Horizontal caret keys keep native editing behavior; vertical keys navigate candidates, Enter selects and Escape closes. Candidate updates preserve the native composition buffer until composition ends instead of repainting the previous model value.

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `popup` and opens an editor when the value area is clicked. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

Asynchronous search should clear old candidates when requests start and accept only the latest response for the current query. Popup arrows/Enter operate only current candidates; the bottom confirm button saves. Failed validation preserves drafts. Confirmation locks editing/closing; Form reset closes Popup and aborts submission. Closing/reset invalidates request ownership. See Form's unified field-presentation examples.

The candidate list shares group, selected and disabled styling with Select, and AutoComplete variables follow their Select counterparts by default. In direct mode the list opens below the input and updates while scrolling; trigger-props can change placement or enable automatic flipping. The field presentation owns the deferred editor while the internal input owns suggestions; each platform retains its public edit-mode values.

### Search fields

`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

### Configuration

Clearing does not emit search or reopen candidates, including when focus returns from a keyboard-focused clear button to the input. The parent controls the value: each rejected clear or selection still emits a change proposal; an accepted candidate selection notifies Form once.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### AutoComplete Events

| Event | Prop |
| --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| input | value: string, event: Event |
| search | value: string, event: Event |
| change | value: string \| null, event: Event |
| select | value: string, option: AutoCompleteOptionInfo, event: Event |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| dropdown-scroll / dropdown-reach-bottom | event: Event |
| load-error | error: unknown |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean |

Typing: `input → update:modelValue → search`; selection: `update:modelValue → select → change`; clear: `clear → input → update:modelValue → change`. Selecting the same value emits only select. change is a commit on blur, Enter or selection. Input owns typing/focus/clear Form notifications; AutoComplete notifies Form once for suggestion commits. Selection applies maxLength; select.value is the committed string, while option.value retains the original suggestion. clear receives an event, not a string.

options is an explicit data loader accepting query and { signal }; it may return an array or a Promise. Failures emit load-error, and refresh retries the current query. Ordinary events such as search only notify and do not collect listener Promises. open events refer only to the deferred field editor.

### AutoComplete Slots

| Slot | Description and arguments |
| --- | --- |
| option | data: AutoCompleteOptionInfo |
| empty | Empty candidate content inside the field editor; no arguments. Cedar shows it with its native input; Maple shows it in the editor candidate area. |
| footer | Menu footer |
| prefix / suffix | Input prefix / suffix |
| clear-icon | clear(event?: Event): void |
| read | value: string \| null, text: string; preserves the raw empty model |

default does not replace the input. option customizes candidates, read customizes reading content, and empty customizes the field editor with no candidates. Ordinary direct input closes the menu when no candidates match.

### AutoComplete Methods

| Method | Prop | Returns |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | - | void |
| blur | - | void |
| refresh | - | `Promise<void>` |

Arrow keys reopen after Escape: ArrowDown activates the first enabled candidate and ArrowUp the last, without submitting a model; Enter selects. Composition, canceled keyboard events, readonly/disabled and should-open remain respected. Tab retains native focus navigation. Vue useId keeps SSR identifiers stable.

## Types

```ts
import type {
  AutoCompleteFieldNames,
  AutoCompleteFilterOption,
  AutoCompleteInstance,
  AutoCompleteOption,
  AutoCompleteOptionData,
  AutoCompleteOptionInfo,
  AutoCompleteProps,
} from '@maple-design/ui'
```

### Type imports

Root and component entries export `AutoCompleteEmits`、`AutoCompleteSlots`、`AutoCompleteExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

`case-sensitive` only makes built-in local filtering `case-sensitive`: `ap` matches `Apple` when false, but not when true. It does not require choosing an option or validate the value. A custom `filterOption` takes priority; `filterOption=false` disables local filtering and makes `case-sensitive` irrelevant.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

AutoComplete text input always supports searching; filter-option only controls local matching and does not issue requests. Explicit options loaders disable secondary local filtering by default; arrays enable it. Business code usually does not need filter-option.

```vue
<mp-auto-complete v-model="text" :options="loadSuggestions" />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Refresh can retry the component-owned asynchronous option source before the editor opens, using the existing AbortSignal, loading, and load-error protocol without opening the editor; static arrays do not create extra requests.

允许自由输入的单行文本框，候选用于快捷填写。

### 透传配置边界与优先级

建议使用 `AutoCompleteTriggerOptions` 声明 trigger-props。候选列表的展开由内部输入/焦点与 shouldOpen 管理。顶层 open/default-open/update:open/open-change 属于字段延迟编辑层，不能直接控制候选列表。disabled 归顶层管理；不能用嵌套配置绕过只读/禁用。placement、popupOffset、样式等普通 Trigger 属性延续原透传。popup-container 顶层明确传入时优先（包括 false），否则回退 triggerProps.popupContainer。内部 Trigger 展开监听继续执行；不要通过嵌套监听替代内部展开协议。

AutoCompleteTriggerOptions 是主动选用的安全配置子集，排除内部托管字段；trigger-props 保持 TriggerProps 宽类型，与 Select/Cascader 的现有协议一致。宽类型允许传入不代表能覆盖内部开关和禁用；专用类型用于在配置编写时提早检查职责边界。

## 使用说明

### 编辑与确认

本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `popup`，点击值区域打开编辑面板。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

异步搜索时应在新请求开始时清除旧候选，并只采纳当前搜索词的最后一次响应。popup 内方向键与 Enter 只操作当前候选，保存由底部确认按钮完成。校验失败保留草稿；确认期间锁定编辑和关闭，表单重置会关闭 popup 并中止提交。请求归属应在关闭和重置时失效，完整示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

候选列表与 Select 统一使用分组、选中、禁用样式，AutoComplete 样式变量默认跟随对应的 Select 变量。direct 模式的候选列表默认在输入框下方展开，随滚动更新位置；可通过 trigger-props 调整方向或开启自动翻转。延迟编辑层由字段展示层管理，候选列表仍由内部输入管理；两端保留各自公开 edit-mode 值。

### 搜索字段

`searchFields` / `search-fields` 是只读 `('label' | 'value')[]`，默认 `['label']`；多字段为 OR 匹配，大小写默认不敏感。配置 `['value', 'label']` 可同时搜索编码和名称，fieldNames 将语义字段映射到业务字段；空数组对非空查询不匹配任何项。value 采用字符串比较，不做对象深层搜索，对象值或拼音等复杂规则仍用自定义回调。自定义回调优先并自行决定大小写；远程结果使用原有关闭本地过滤协议。Cascader 保留路径语义，会检查路径各节点的配置字段。

### 配置说明

清空不发 search，也不重新展开候选面板，包括从键盘聚焦的清空按钮回到输入框。受控值由父级决定：连续被拒绝的清空或选择仍各自发出 change 提议；已接受的候选选择只通知 Form 一次。

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](#/zh-CN/emptyValues)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

### AutoComplete Events

| 事件 | 参数 |
| --- | --- |
| update:modelValue | value: string \| null |
| input | value: string, event: Event |
| search | value: string, event: Event |
| change | value: string \| null, event: Event |
| select | value: string, option: AutoCompleteOptionInfo, event: Event |
| clear | event: Event |
| focus / blur | event: FocusEvent |
| dropdown-scroll / dropdown-reach-bottom | event: Event |
| load-error | error: unknown |
| update:open / open-change | open: boolean |

输入顺序：`input → update:modelValue → search`；选择：`update:modelValue → select → change`；清除：`clear → input → update:modelValue → change`。同值选择只发 select。change 表示失焦、Enter 或候选选择产生的提交。Input 负责输入、焦点与清除的 Form 通知，AutoComplete 仅对候选提交通知一次。选择也遵守 maxLength；select 的 value 是最终提交字符串，option.value 保留原始候选。clear 参数为事件，不再是字符串。

options 是显式数据加载入口，接收 query 和 { signal }，可以返回数组或 Promise；失败通知 load-error，refresh 可重试当前查询。search 等普通事件只通知，不采集监听器返回的 Promise。open 事件只表示延迟编辑层开关。

### AutoComplete Slots

| 插槽 | 说明与参数 |
| --- | --- |
| option | data: AutoCompleteOptionInfo |
| empty | 字段编辑面板中的无候选内容；无参数。Cedar 随原生输入显示，Maple 在编辑候选区域显示 |
| footer | 菜单底部 |
| prefix / suffix | 输入框前后缀 |
| clear-icon | clear(event?: Event): void |
| read | value: string \| null, text: string；保留原始空模型 |

default 不提供输入替换。option 定制候选内容，read 定制阅读内容；empty 定制字段编辑面板中的无候选内容，普通 direct 输入无匹配时关闭菜单。

### AutoComplete Methods

| 方法 | 参数 | 返回值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focus | - | void |
| blur | - | void |
| refresh | - | `Promise<void>` |

方向键可在 Escape 关闭后重新展开：ArrowDown 定位首个可用候选，ArrowUp 定位末个可用候选，不提交模型；Enter 选择。组合输入、取消的键盘事件、readonly/disabled 和 should-open 条件仍受尊重；Tab 保持原生焦点导航。使用 Vue useId 保证 SSR 标识稳定。

## Types

```ts
import type {
  AutoCompleteFieldNames,
  AutoCompleteFilterOption,
  AutoCompleteInstance,
  AutoCompleteOption,
  AutoCompleteOptionData,
  AutoCompleteOptionInfo,
  AutoCompleteProps,
} from '@maple-design/ui'
```

### 类型导入

根入口和组件入口均导出 `AutoCompleteEmits`、`AutoCompleteSlots`、`AutoCompleteExpose`，与 Props、Instance 配套。可通过实例调用 `focus()`、`blur()`。

`case-sensitive` 只使内置本地过滤区分大小写：默认 false 时输入 `ap` 可以匹配 `Apple`，true 时不能。它不限制必须选择候选，不校验输入值。自定义 `filterOption` 优先；`filterOption=false` 关闭本地过滤，此时 case-sensitive 不起作用。

## 配置清空后的值

`empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。

## 函数属性加载候选

直接传 options(query, { signal })，无需调用 useAsyncData。options 继续接收数组，显式数组（包括 []）优先。组件内部管理 loading、旧结果隔离与请求取消；load-error 通知失败，实例 refresh() 重试。业务函数可只接收 query，忽略第二参数。

AutoComplete 的文本输入始终可搜索；filter-option 只控制本地候选匹配，不负责发请求。使用 options 加载函数时默认不再二次过滤远程结果；仅传数组时默认启用本地匹配。业务通常无需设置 filter-option。

```vue
<mp-auto-complete v-model="text" :options="loadSuggestions" />
```

`empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。

公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。

refresh 可在编辑器未打开时重试组件自有的异步选项读取，沿用既有 AbortSignal、loading 和 load-error 协议，不自动打开编辑器；静态数组不产生额外请求。

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
The default image `error` icon retains a nonempty `alt` as its accessible name; an empty `alt` denotes decoration. Provide appropriate semantics for a custom `error` slot. The default slot may switch dynamically between images and text; application code owns slotted image load events and styles.

When `trigger-icon` contains no interactive control, the avatar exposes button semantics and supports Enter and Space. Describe the action with `trigger-aria-label` or the root `aria-label`. If the slot supplies its own interactive control, that control handles keyboard input. The default click-triggered group summary can be opened by keyboard; Escape closes it and restores focus.

Group `shape` and `auto-fix-font-size` override item values, and a supplied group `size` takes priority. `max-count` is a nonnegative integer; zero or an invalid value means unlimited. Numeric `size` must be finite and nonnegative; invalid numbers use the default, while strings are CSS lengths. `offset` accepts finite negative numbers or CSS length strings; invalid numbers use the default spacing. The summary participates in group stacking order, which overrides z-index in `max-style`.

### Reduced motion

Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots.

## Usage notes

### Easing and errors

duration must be finite, nonnegative milliseconds; zero scrolls immediately. Invalid durations produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and retain the immediate-completion runtime fallback. The easing presets are linear, quartOut and easeInOutCubic; invalid names warn and fall back to quartOut. A custom function receives progress from 0 to 1: finite results are clamped to 0–1, while nonfinite or nonnumeric results use the current linear progress. Promises are not awaited. Thrown errors propagate unchanged to the calling environment; that frame schedules no further animation, and scrollToTop can retry. No click success or extra error event is fabricated.

## API

### BackTop Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target-container` | Scroll target; omitted means page | `string \| HTMLElement \| (() => HTMLElement \| null \| undefined)` | `—` |
| `popup-container` | Render target; false renders locally | `string \| HTMLElement \| false` | `body` |
| `visible-height` | Inclusive scroll threshold in px, numeric strings accepted | `number \| string` | `200` |
| `duration` | Animation duration in ms; 0 is immediate | `number` | `200` |
| `easing` | Built-in curve or normalized progress function | `'linear' \| 'quartOut' \| 'easeInOutCubic' \| ((progress: number) => number)` | `'quartOut'` |
| `right` | Right offset; number in px, string accepts CSS units | `number \| string` | `—` |
| `bottom` | Bottom offset; number in px, string accepts CSS units | `number \| string` | `—` |
| `elevation` | Shadow level; true uses level 2 | `boolean \| number` | `true` |
| `aria-label` | Accessible name | `string` | `'Back to top'` |

When `popup-container=false`, the button is positioned absolutely; give its containing block `position: relative`. Repeated clicks replace the previous animation; changing target, deactivation and unmount cancel queued work. Reduced-motion preference skips animation. Horizontal scroll position is preserved.

### BackTop Events / Slots / Methods

- `click(event: MouseEvent)`: emitted once per activation.
- Default slot: noninteractive text or icons. The root is already a native button; do not nest another Button or link.
- `scrollToTop()`: scrolls the current target without emitting an additional click.
- Keyboard: Tab focuses the visible button; Enter / Space activates it. Hidden buttons are not focusable.

## 使用说明

### 缓动与异常

duration 必须是有限非负毫秒数；0 立即回顶。非法时长在开发环境由 Vue 属性校验提示，运行时沿用立即完成回退。easing 内置值只有 linear、quartOut、easeInOutCubic，非法名称提示后回退 quartOut。自定义函数输入为 0–1 进度：有限返回值夹取到 0–1，非有限或非数字返回值使用当前线性进度；不等待 Promise。函数抛出的错误原样交给调用环境报告，该帧不再安排后续动画，可以再次调用 scrollToTop 重试；不会伪造 click 成功或新增错误事件。

# Breadcrumb

The current page uses primary text color with normal font weight and `aria-current="page"`. Plain text has no interaction feedback. Links, click actions and dropdown triggers use brand color, pointer cursor, hover / pressed feedback and a visible keyboard focus outline. Click actions support Enter and Space. Keep the last item as plain text unless an action is explicitly supplied.

On touch devices, interactive items have a minimum 44 × 44px target. Press feedback clears after release; mouse hover styles do not stick. The default ellipsis is static; use a focusable button in the more-icon slot with a Tooltip to reveal omitted paths.

The default navigation landmark and ellipsis labels follow the current locale. Set aria-label on the root to customize the landmark name.

### Intro

Identify the page location in a hierarchy and navigate upward when needed. The API aligns with Cedar Design Web core features (`routes` / `max-count` / separator slots). Affix positioning is not included for mobile.

## Usage notes



- A nonempty `routes` array takes precedence over the default slot; an empty array falls back to the slot. Default route rendering links all items except the last, which has `aria-current="page"`. `item-render` controls links itself.
- Separator precedence: child slot → child prop → parent slot → parent prop. `0` and an empty string are supported.
- `max-count` is a nonnegative integer; 0 means unlimited. A value of 1 acts as 2 to preserve the first and current items. Positive fractions are rounded down and clamped to at least 2; negative or nonfinite values act as 0. Invalid values produce a development warning. Collapsing occurs only when the total exceeds the effective count plus 1; the overflow position does not trigger omitted items’ clicks, links or dropdowns.
- Built-in dropdown selection emits `select(route, event)`. Indices and separators update with dynamic insertion, removal, reordering and SSR.
- Custom attributes apply to the breadcrumb item content node.

# Card

Source changes synchronously invalidate render generations. Close, row direction, newer work, deactivation or disposal prevent old nextTick/timer/double-frame continuations from changing newer phases. Render/timer deliveries consume once. Recheck lifecycle/request/node after geometry hooks to reject reentrant disposal. Suspension cancels both timers and retained close/click input is inert; activation starts a fresh phase from current props without replay, and initial KeepAlive activation does not duplicate the wait.

## API

<!-- same-source-api:start -->
`row-reverse` reverses the horizontal cover and body order, with reading direction still following the container. Collapsed `floating-content` keeps its nodes and state but is inert to keyboard and assistive technology; it becomes interactive when expanded. Floating is available only in column direction.

The default close button uses the current locale’s close text and can be overridden with `close-button-aria-label`. `floating-duration` is a finite nonnegative duration in milliseconds; 0 means no delay and invalid values fall back to 250.

### Usage notes

Props, event arguments and slots match. Cedar inherits the global size when size is omitted: xs/sm map to sm, all others to md. Maple falls back to md. Pass size explicitly for identical density. Themes and CSS prefixes remain platform-specific.
Card no longer has a loading prop. Compose a loading overlay with the Loading directive.

## CSS Variables


Regular/filled backgrounds and borders use `surface-default`, `surface-muted` and `border-default`. Titles, body and secondary text use `content-primary`, `content-tertiary` and `content-secondary`. Expanded floating buttons use `content-primary`; text and icons on dark close buttons use `content-on-dark`.

<!-- generated variable reference omitted from archive -->

### Sizing and motion

Use `--mp-card-content-row-margin` for horizontal content spacing. Card supports only sm / md sizes. `--mp-card-animation-duration` defaults to `var(--mp-sys-motion-duration-slow)` and `--mp-card-animation-easing` to `var(--mp-sys-motion-easing-standard)`. Reduced motion disables Card transitions.

# Carousel

Autoplay interval is business playback cadence (business-clock), not CSS duration. Autoplay remains off by default; true uses3000ms, with existing numeric/config intervals and hover/focus/hidden pause rules. Cancellation/replacement invalidates old playback work; delivery consumes once before navigation. Retained inactive/disposed next/prev/to, keyboard and wheel cannot navigate or intercept input. Activation creates fresh observer/event bindings; detached deliveries cannot use a newer active state to reschedule.

## Usage notes

### Looping and autoplay

Each slide always has one component instance. Ordinary previous/next navigation recycles positions after the departing slide exits. Multi-slide or centered jumps that would require one slide in two positions settle immediately without animation, cloning interactive content or queuing unlimited transitions. Fewer items than visible slides are not cloned to fill space. Accessible names follow global Locale; explicit label props take precedence.

Native root listeners such as `keydown`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focusin` and `focusout` run alongside internal navigation and autoplay pause handling. Native `.once` listeners fire once for the root element lifetime.

`space-between` also accepts valid CSS lengths such as percentages and `calc()`. Multi-slide layout uses unscaled CSS pixels, so ancestor scaling does not change the gap-to-slide proportion.

If a focused slide becomes inaccessible through navigation or removal, focus moves to the carousel container. Focus in a still-visible slide or outside the carousel is preserved. The container is programmatically focusable but is not in the Tab order unless `keyboard` is enabled; an explicit `tabindex` remains under caller control.

The autoplay example sets `auto-play=false` on focus entry and provides an external switch for an explicit restart. The component itself only pauses temporarily while focus is inside; playback resumes on blur. This differs from the WAI-ARIA APG recommendation to stop on focus until the user explicitly restarts, and is not a claim of full APG conformance; applications requiring that behavior should control playback state. Reduced motion disables transitions but does not by itself stop automatic navigation.

Slide numbers start at 1; finite fractions are truncated toward zero and then wrapped or clamped according to `loop`. Finite `move-speed` values use non-negative milliseconds; non-finite values use the CSS transition duration. The root is a named region and default indicator buttons have localized slide names and current state; their container has no separate group name. `line` and `slider` share the same default bar dimensions; `slider` can grow into available container space and is not draggable.

## API

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the current slide number, starting at 1. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state only on creation; later changes do not reset it. An explicit bound value takes precedence. Initialization does not emit `update:modelValue`.

### Model and interaction
Public slide numbers start at 1. Controlled actions emit update:model-value, then change(slideNumber, previousSlideNumber, isManual), and do not move until the parent accepts current. External assignments do not emit change. Method option event:false suppresses only change, not the model proposal. isManual is true for user actions and false for autoplay.

loop moves existing children across boundaries without cloning component instances. Without looping or centering, the final viewport is clamped to avoid empty space; selection can move within the final visible group without moving the track. Partly visible slides remain accessible; fully offscreen slides are inert. fade displays one slide. auto uses explicit CarouselItem width horizontally or height vertically; vertical mode requires a container height. Only CarouselItem children, including those inside Vue Fragments, count as slides; comments and ordinary elements do not.

auto-play=true uses 3000ms and pauses on hover; a number sets milliseconds without hover pausing; an object configures interval/hoverToPause. Focus within, dragging, hidden documents/ancestors and KeepAlive deactivation always pause playback. Reduced-motion preferences are respected. Interactive children such as inputs/buttons keep native behavior; mark custom interactive areas with data-carousel-no-drag. show-arrow=hover also shows arrows on keyboard focus.

## 使用说明

### 循环与自动播放

每个轮播项始终只有一个组件实例。普通上一页/下一页在出场项离开后回收位置；跨多页或居中跳转若需要同一项同时占据两个位置，则直接无动画定位，不复制交互内容，也不排队执行无限过渡。项目数量小于可视页数时不会复制项目填满。可访问名称跟随全局 Locale，显式标签属性优先。

根节点的 `keydown`、`mouseenter`、`mouseleave`、`focusin`、`focusout` 原生监听器与内部翻页、自动播放暂停逻辑同时生效；原生 `.once` 监听器在该根元素生命周期内只执行一次。

`space-between` 也接受百分比和 `calc()` 等有效 CSS 长度；多页布局按未缩放的 CSS 像素计算，祖先缩放不会改变间距与页宽的比例。

当正在聚焦的幻灯片因切页或删除而不再可访问时，焦点移至轮播容器；仍可见的幻灯片及组件外焦点保持不变。容器默认可通过程序聚焦，但 `keyboard` 未启用时不进入 Tab 顺序；显式 `tabindex` 仍由调用方控制。

自动播放示例在焦点进入时将 `auto-play` 设为 `false` 持续停止，由外部开关显式重启；组件本身的焦点暂停只是临时暂停，离开后会自动恢复。这与 WAI-ARIA APG 建议的“焦点进入后停止，直到用户显式重启”不同，不能视为完整 APG 轮播模式；需要该行为时请由业务控制播放状态。减少动态效果关闭过渡，不会单独停止自动换页。

页码从 1 开始，有限小数向零截断后，根据 `loop` 循环或限制到有效页；`move-speed` 有限值按非负毫秒处理，非有限值使用 CSS 过渡时长。根为具名 region，每个默认指示按钮有本地化页码名称和当前页状态；指示器容器本身没有单独的 group 名称。`line` 和 `slider` 默认使用相同的长条尺寸，`slider` 在容器有可分配空间时可伸展，并非拖动滑块。

### 模型与交互
公开页序号从 1 开始。受控操作先发 update:model-value，再发 change(slideNumber, previousSlideNumber, isManual)，父级接受 current 前不移动；外部赋值不补发 change。方法 options 的 event:false 只关闭 change，不吞掉模型提议。用户操作的 isManual 为 true，自动播放为 false。

loop 跨边界移动原有子项，不复制组件实例。非循环且未居中时，末尾视区钳制以避免留白，选中项可能在最后一组可见项内移动而不再移动轨道。部分可见页保持可访问，完全离屏页 inert。fade 固定展示一页；auto 使用 CarouselItem 显式 width（横向）或 height（纵向），纵向需提供容器高度。默认插槽只统计 CarouselItem（可包在 Vue Fragment 中），注释、普通元素不成为页。

auto-play=true 使用 3000ms 且悬停暂停，数字指定毫秒且不启用悬停暂停；对象配置 interval/hoverToPause。焦点在组件内、拖动中、文档/祖先隐藏、KeepAlive 停用始终暂停。尊重减少动态效果偏好。输入框、按钮等交互子项保留原生行为，自定义交互区域可加 data-carousel-no-drag。show-arrow=hover 在键盘聚焦时也显示。

# 级联选择器 多选时，`inline` 下拉只显示选项；已选内容、单项移除和清空由输入框承担。`popup` 编辑面板保留“已选／清空”，选择为草稿，确认后提交。 ## 阅读方向 继承来源 dir；子列沿阅读方向展开，展开图标及列分隔线随方向变化。左右键按可见方向进入已加载子级或返回父级，并跳过禁用子项；上下键保持逻辑顺序。搜索状态保留原生左右光标编辑，不反转路径或多选数组。关闭状态清空最后值后，重开从根级恢复导航。 `empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。 `empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。 候选属性 `options` 支持数组或 `(query, { signal }) => 数组/Promise`。加载、取消、过期结果隔离由组件内部处理，失败触发 load-error。单选/多选分组初始化以空字符串查询，搜索型字段在查询变化时调用；树形字段根数据与原有 load-more 子节点懒加载独立。 ## 基础示例 ### 请选择地区 ```demo ../example/demos/placeholder.vue ``` ## 外观与状态 ### 外观组合 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------- | | `options` | 树形选项；叶值模式要求叶值唯一，路径模式可区分不同分支 | 外观组合、表单控件尺寸对照 | | `clearable` | 允许清除，保留禁用的已选项 | 外观组合、表单控件尺寸对照 | | `edit-mode` | 字段展示；未指定时继承 FormItem / Form | 表单控件尺寸对照 | | `size` | 完整支持 xs、sm、md、lg、xl，未设置时继承分组与表单 | 表单控件尺寸对照 | | `variant` | filled、outline、standard；未设置时继承 InputGroup | 表单控件尺寸对照 | | `placeholder` | 占位文本 | 表单控件尺寸对照 | 适用于地区等层级选项。调整变体、尺寸，用相同数据观察变化。内容保持一致，便于比较不同设置的实际效果。 ```demo ../example/demos/appearance-lab.vue ``` ### 表单控件尺寸对照 切换 size 和字段变体，对比有值、可清空、多选不换行的 Cascader、Select、Input 与 Button。长标签文字省略，删除图标保留，标签行可横向滚动；清空按钮和箭头固定在外侧。被省略的标签正文支持悬停、键盘聚焦或点按查看完整文字，点外部或按 Esc 关闭，不改变选中值。 ```demo ../../field-decorator/example/demos/control-sizes.vue ``` ## 选择模式与路径 ### 级联多选 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------- | | `path-mode` | true 返回完整路径；false 返回选中节点的值 | 级联多选、Dialog 多选、Popup 多选 | | `placeholder` | 占位文本 | 级联多选、Dialog 多选、Popup 多选 | | `options` | 树形选项；叶值模式要求叶值唯一，路径模式可区分不同分支 | 级联多选、Dialog 多选、Popup 多选 | | `multiple` | 多选；默认启用搜索 | 级联多选、Dialog 多选、Popup 多选 | | `show-tags` | 多选值以标签展示；false 改用分隔文本 | 级联多选、Dialog 多选、Popup 多选 | | `edit-mode` | 字段展示；未指定时继承 FormItem / Form | Dialog 多选、Popup 多选 | ```demo ../example/demos/placeholder-multiple.vue ``` ### Dialog 多选 ```demo ../example/demos/placeholder-picker-multiple.vue ``` ### Popup 多选 ```demo ../example/demos/placeholder-list-multiple.vue ``` ### 展示与提交规则 inline 即选即提交；popup、dialog 单选和多选都编辑草稿，外层确认一次后提交。取消、遮罩关闭、Escape、切换展示方式都丢弃草稿；外部 modelValue 更新优先。搜索在弹层内，沿用本地过滤、search 事件和 loadMore 异步加载。 ### 管理已选项 多选面板顶部提供已选数量与清空。Cedar 在列表上方显示可删除标签；Maple 点击数量查看已选明细，支持逐项移除并返回可选项。popup/popover 与 dialog 共用该内容。移除和清空先修改草稿，关闭取消会恢复原值，确认后才提交；禁用项保留，异步确认期间禁用操作。面板的清空入口独立于字段清空图标。 ### 非路径模式 ```demo ../example/demos/placeholder-path-mode.vue ``` ##
