配置与组合 ### 透传配置边界与优先级 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | | `edit-mode` | 字段展示；未指定时继承 FormItem / Form | 透传配置边界与优先级、复制与编辑 | | `options` | 树形选项；叶值模式要求叶值唯一，路径模式可区分不同分支 | 透传配置边界与优先级、复制与编辑 | | `trigger-props` | Menu 的 Trigger 属性；展开状态由字段控制 | 透传配置边界与优先级 | | `open-trigger-target` | 打开面板的点击区域：field 为整个字段，icon 仅右侧选择按钮。清除、移除等独立操作除外；不影响键盘展开和受控 open。 | 复制与编辑 | | `filterable` | 开启搜索 | 复制与编辑 | 建议使用 `CascaderTriggerOptions` 声明 trigger-props。open/defaultOpen、disabled 和展开更新归 Cascader 管理。popup-container 顶层明确传入时优先（包括 false），否则回退 triggerProps.popupContainer。Trigger 的普通配置保留原顺序，嵌套 unmountOnClose 仍可覆盖顶层 unmount-on-close；默认的定位/交互配置也仍可被有效嵌套字段覆盖。内部展开监听继续执行，通知使用 Cascader 事件。 建议使用本页列出的专用配置类型；展开状态、模型和事件由组件管理，不能通过嵌套配置接管。 ```ts import type { CascaderTriggerOptions } from '@maple-design/ui' ``` ```demo ../example/demos/passthrough-options.vue ``` ### 复制与编辑 通过 open-trigger-target 独立控制打开区域；icon 模式下点击、聚焦和输入不会自动展开。input-editable / filterable 仍负责是否可编辑或搜索。右侧按钮、显式键盘展开和受控 open 可打开面板。 ```demo ../example/demos/open-trigger-target.vue ``` ## 异步加载与回显 ### 回调懒加载 ```demo ../example/demos/load-more.vue ``` ### 异步设备与 ID 回显 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | | `edit-mode` | 字段展示；未指定时继承 FormItem / Form | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `options` | 树形选项；叶值模式要求叶值唯一，路径模式可区分不同分支 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `loading` | 加载状态；禁止选择和确认 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `path-mode` | true 返回完整路径；false 返回选中节点的值 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `filterable` | 开启搜索 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | | `clearable` | 允许清除，保留禁用的已选项 | 异步设备与 ID 回显 | ```demo ../example/demos/async-devices.vue ``` ### 介绍 通过下拉菜单或底部弹窗的形式进行级联选择。 单选已选项在右侧显示内置主色对勾。多选使用 Checkbox：可选后代全部未选为未选，部分选中为半选，全部可选叶子选中为全选；禁用叶子不参与全选计算。checkStrictly 开启时父子独立选择，不汇总半选。确认式编辑面板中的选择先作为草稿，确认后才提交。 ### 共享字段加载 `loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。 ### 懒加载结束与异常 字段和独立 Panel 的 `loadMore(option, done)` 均保留回调协议：`done(children)` 接收子项，`done()` 结束等待并允许重试。只接受首次回调；返回值（包括已完成的 Promise）不替代 `done`。加载函数同步抛错时结束等待，并进入 Vue 的 `errorCaptured` / 应用 `errorHandler`。`load-error` 仍仅报告 `options` 候选数据源错误，不重复报告 `loadMore` 异常。业务中的异步请求失败需自行处理并调用 `done()`。 替换选项（包括嵌套原地修改）、字段映射或加载函数会使旧请求和懒加载缓存失效。卸载、停用会取消待处理回调；旧结果不能写入替换后的节点或清除新请求的等待。 ## 使用说明 ### 编辑方式 通过 `edit-mode` 选择直接编辑或移动端编辑面板。 ### 编辑与确认 本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `popup`，点击值区域打开编辑面板。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。 Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。 `before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。 字段编辑统一使用 edit-mode：Cedar 支持 direct/click/dblclick，Maple 支持 direct/popup；不保留 menu/list/picker 这些旧编辑枚举。弹层复用原选项索引、搜索、异步加载与虚拟列表算法。 `read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。 ### 搜索字段 `searchFields` / `search-fields` 是只读 `('label' | 'value')[]`，默认 `['label']`；多字段为 OR 匹配，大小写默认不敏感。配置 `['value', 'label']` 可同时搜索编码和名称，fieldNames 将语义字段映射到业务字段；空数组对非空查询不匹配任何项。value 采用字符串比较，不做对象深层搜索，对象值或拼音等复杂规则仍用自定义回调。自定义回调优先并自行决定大小写；远程结果使用原有关闭本地过滤协议。Cascader 保留路径语义，会检查路径各节点的配置字段。 公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。 refresh 可在编辑器未打开时重试组件自有的异步选项读取，沿用既有 AbortSignal、loading 和 load-error 协议，不自动打开编辑器；静态数组不产生额外请求。 ### 加载期间的选择动作 手动 loading 或当前候选请求处于加载状态时，纯选择字段保留已有值，暂停新选择、清空与标签移除。被阻止的动作不发送业务通知，也不提交模型。字段搜索仍可输入，disabled/readonly 不因此改写；需要禁止搜索时单独设置。 延迟编辑层的清空和确认在此期间不可用，仍可取消或关闭。手动标记和当前请求都结束后，操作按正常规则恢复，并继续尊重禁用选项。Input、AutoComplete 等自由文本字段的 loading 继续允许文本编辑与清空，不套用选择值的暂停规则。 option({ data }) 接收规范化 CascaderOptionInfo，data.raw 是原始选项，data.path 是根到当前的规范化路径；label({ data }) 接收字段展示项 key/value/label/closable/tagProps。arrow-icon({ focus, menuOpen }) 接收真实字段的聚焦和展开状态。read({ value, text }) 的 value 保留 null/undefined 及原模型形状。 公开类型包含 CascaderBaseValue、CascaderOptionInfo、CascaderReadScope、CascaderEmits、CascaderSlots、CascaderExpose，可从根入口及 cascader 子入口导入。纯 CascaderPanel 只接收选项数组，不接管根候选加载函数。 ## ## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Icons, labels, values and extra content follow reading order, with logical start/end spacing. Explicit device safe-area and physical-position contracts do not reverse.

## API

`clickable` gives the main content button semantics, focus and Enter/Space activation. When omitted it follows `ripple`; explicit false omits the main action semantics. Use `action-aria-label` when the content does not name the action. `extra` is separate and can contain independent controls; their clicks bubble by default, so use `.stop` for independent actions. Do not nest interactive controls in the main content of an actionable cell. `title-class` and `description-class` affect only their default nodes; slot content owns its styles. Numeric `border-offset` must be finite; negative values and zero are valid, while invalid numbers use default spacing.

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。图标、标签、值和扩展区继承阅读顺序，间距使用逻辑起止位置。显式设备安全区和物理位置约定不反转。

## API

`clickable` 开启主内容的按钮语义、焦点和 Enter/Space；未设置时跟随 `ripple`，显式 false 不生成主操作语义。图标或内容不足以命名操作时可设置 `action-aria-label`。`extra` 与主操作分开，可放独立控件；子控件点击默认冒泡，独立操作可使用 `.stop`。可操作行的主内容不应再嵌套交互控件。`title-class` 和 `description-class` 仅作用于对应默认节点，插槽自行设置样式。数字 `border-offset` 必须有限，负数和 0 有效；无效数字使用默认边距。

### 异步选项 开启手动返回后，每次加载创建本地 Promise，可分别返回最早或最新任务验证两种乱序。示例业务加载器用版本保护忽略旧响应：旧结果不结束新加载、不清空选择、不释放 `max=2` 名额，也不增加用户变更次数。移除使在途结果失效，新加载仍按保留模型反显；停用或卸载会结清等待并取消定时器。此保护属于示例业务逻辑，不代表组件自动处理网络竞争；不访问外部接口。 选项载入、移除和外部值更新均不会反向触发值变化；未载入的已选值不会自动清理。示例使用 800ms 本地延迟模拟请求；加载中移除选项会取消待完成的加载，避免旧结果重新显示。已选 remote 占一个名额，再选设备 A 后达到 `max=2`，设备 B 将不可选；取消任一已选项会释放名额。外部超限值不会自动裁剪。 等待期间可用空格或 Enter 操作已有选项；同值选项重载后保留键盘焦点和最新选择。加载提示保持稳定节点，避免显隐导致分组重新挂载，取消已选项后仍可继续选择并释放名额。 ```demo ../example/demos/async-options.vue ``` ## 原生输入属性与键盘拦截 `id`、`form`、`required`、其他原生约束、`aria-*`、`data-*` 和键盘监听器传给实际 input；`class` / `style` 和其他外壳属性保留在 label。未提供 id 时生成稳定且唯一的原生 id；外部 label[for] 可以关联显式 id。HTML required 参与浏览器原生表单验证，与 Form 的业务校验规则分开。 原生监听的 Once / Capture / Passive 修饰符保留在 input，不会因插槽中嵌套按钮而错误触发。原生键盘监听 preventDefault() 可以阻止 Enter / Space 的组件激活及 RadioGroup 方向键导航；被取消的 Space 不留下延迟释放动作。组件仍管理 checked、disabled、输入类型及分组的 Tab 焦点规则。 Checkbox 的 null 模型仍表示空状态；default / checkbox 插槽中的 checked 始终为 boolean，null 对应 false，不会仅为渲染而提交新模型。 ## 使用说明 ### 编辑与确认 通过 `edit-mode` 配置编辑方式；未指定时依次继承 FormItem、Form，默认 `direct`。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。 Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。 `before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。 `read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。 `empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。 候选属性 `options` 支持数组或 `(query, { signal }) => 数组/Promise`。加载、取消、过期结果隔离由组件内部处理，失败触发 load-error。单选/多选分组初始化以空字符串查询，搜索型字段在查询变化时调用；树形字段根数据与原有 load-more 子节点懒加载独立。 公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。 CheckboxGroup 的 checkAll/inverseAll 仅由活动编辑器执行变更；延迟编辑器关闭、停用或卸载后调用，返回当前业务值的独立数组副本，不打开编辑器或发布模型变化。 ## API ### 参数、展示清空与挂载边界 orientation 仅接受 horizontal / vertical，非法值诊断后按 horizontal 展示。max 仅用于 CheckboxGroup：合法值为有限非负整数，0 表示不能新增选择，省略为不限；不裁剪已有外部模型。非法 JS 值诊断后保留既有归一化：负数按 0、小数向下取整、NaN 按不限，Infinity 仍按不限处理。 icon-size 接受正长度，数值和纯数字字符串按 px，允许 0.5 这样的正小数；无效、非正或非有限数值诊断并回退主题，不套用 Divider 的最小 1。CSS 表达式的最终解析值由业务样式负责。 uninject-group-context 在挂载时决定是否接入分组；运行中修改不会重新注入，需改变 key 或重新挂载，脱离分组后仍参与 Form。clearable / empty-value 只控制延迟展示层的显式清空；原生取消勾选仍输出 false 或从数组移除该值，不会使用 empty-value。普通事件返回 Promise 不参与等待；before-commit 仅在延迟保存时按 payload / done / context 协议执行。 显式 options 加载期间，两端分组通过 aria-busy 通知等待，失败发一次 load-error；不增加 loading 属性或额外图形，也不因加载或失败提议新模型。 ### 空值识别与阅读空文案 `empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](#/zh-CN/emptyValues)。 | 参数 | 类型 | 缺省与范围 | | ## Numeric and animation boundaries

### Scientific notation and decimal floor

Precision is an integer from -292 to 292. Fractional and nonfinite precision falls back to 0; out-of-range integers are clamped. Unsupported inputs produce a development prop warning. String precision keeps the existing parseFloat conversion. Negative precision rounds at tens/hundreds and larger decimal places. The result is a number rounded toward negative infinity, without trailing-zero padding, and may use scientific notation. Changing precision only reformats the current value. IEEE-754 representability still applies; animation values are not decimal accounting values.

```demo
../example/demos/decimal-floor.vue
```

### Zero duration and replay

```demo
../example/demos/zero-duration.vue
```

### Change easing and replay

Changing timing-function affects the next reset, including resets caused by from, to or duration changes. It does not restart the current animation. Pause/start resumes the existing curve; reset creates a fresh playback using the latest function. Clearing the function restores linear easing. A curve may reach the target early, but end still reports completion of the configured duration.

```demo
../example/demos/easing-replay.vue
```

## Animation duration boundaries

Duration is a finite nonnegative number of milliseconds. Zero reaches the target on the next frame. Negative, NaN and infinite values produce development prop diagnostics and safely behave as zero without continuing to request animation frames. Pausing or unmounting before that frame cancels completion. String durations retain parseFloat conversion. reset reads auto-start again. end remains a notification; its listener Promise is not awaited.

## API

String `from`, `to`, `duration`, and `precision` values use parseFloat, so `10px` parses as 10. Invalid or non-finite endpoints produce a warning and use 0. If the difference between finite endpoints overflows, the animation completes on the next frame. `precision` floors the numeric result toward negative infinity without padding zeros and accepts integers in the range [-292, 292]. `auto-start` is read on mount or reset; calling start after completion does not replay until reset.

# Countdown

### Countdown business clock and deactivation

Countdown RAF refreshes business time, not visual interpolation; CSS duration/reduced motion must not alter the clock. Pause and KeepAlive deactivation freeze remaining duration; activation resumes that value without charging inactive time. Inactive time updates/reset may update data and emit change but schedule no RAF; auto-start is deferred to activation, and explicit pause cancels pending resume. Direct inactive start is ignored; disposed start/reset emit and schedule nothing.

Pausing or resetting cancels pending countdown updates. A newer start or reset takes precedence over an earlier update. end fires once per round; reset permits a new completion.

### Intro

For real-time display of countdown values, with millisecond precision.

`time` is remaining duration in milliseconds. To align with a deadline, pass `deadline - Date.now()`.

# Date

The year panel aligns the selected year, falling back to the current year, only inside its own scroll surface. It never scrolls the outer document. Alignment runs after mounting, accounts for dialog scale transitions, and is retired on deactivation or disposal.

While expanded, the native combobox uses `aria-controls` to identify its own named popup. Closing updates the state and removes the link. `aria-label` and `aria-describedby` reach the native input. Custom selected/trigger slots must preserve accessible names, keyboard operation and state associations.

Floating panels use the visual viewport instead of a half-screen cap. A full calendar is visible when space permits; short windows scroll content while keeping actions visible. Override `--mp-date-picker-popover-max-height` to cap the panel (default `100dvh - 32px`). Switching back to default/Maple removes brand overrides.

Pure panels do not accept open/default-open, popup-container, placement, trigger-props, placeholder, variant or clearable. disable-confirm controls confirmation; actions receives { confirm, disabled }. # Time zones and calendar views

`time-zone` accepts an IANA zone such as `America/New_York`. Dates and millisecond timestamps represent instants; strings represent civil time in that zone. Display, text entry, limits, shortcuts and disabled rules share this protocol. Event Dates remain actual instants. Omit the prop for existing host-local behavior. DST gaps are rejected, folds choose the earlier instant, and invalid zones block submission.

`interactive-mode` is `page` by default. `scroll` shows months between the limits with `use-virtual-scroll` enabled by default; without limits, the initial viewport has a one-year window on each side. `line` separates weekday headings from a row of dates, reuses round date selection, and labels the visible week with its date range. Previous/next buttons move by one week. Navigation never commits a field draft. Day-precision date-time uses these views together with the existing quick-time and detailed wheels. Range summaries, endpoint locks, reversed-range feedback and confirmation remain owned by the existing field transaction. Non-day precision retains its existing renderer.

Virtual months have equal height and six week rows. Customize `--mp-date-calendar-scroll-height`, `--mp-date-calendar-month-height`, `--mp-date-calendar-row-height` and `--mp-date-calendar-line-height` together. Existing calendar color tokens cover both brands and light/dark modes. Disabling virtualization renders the entire range.

### Values and formats

DateValue is string, number or native Date. Numbers are timestamps and 0 is not empty; modelValue=null is explicitly empty. Ranges retain broad arrays and incomplete endpoints rather than forcing a tuple; commits still validate completeness and validity. Maple general DatePicker/Date multiple selection does not widen Cedar single-value Props.

Tables list actual public properties. Inherited/precision-derived defaults describe resolved behavior; raw Props can be undefined. format controls display/text input and valueFormat controls the model protocol. Week/quarter display labels differ from model formats; function format has no reverse parser for text input.

Bounds are inclusive. Invalid supplied bounds block confirmation instead of being treated as omitted. Tightening rules does not clear the business model. disabledDate/disabledTime are explicit validation callbacks rather than asynchronous event tasks; time callbacks return disabled lists through DateDisabledTime.

### Slots and instance methods

Field default replaces the trigger; prefix/selected/suffix replace content, and ranges also support separator. Preserve names, endpoint distinctions and keyboard access when replacing native controls. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?), respecting emptyValue and disabled/readonly guards.

actions receives confirm/disabled/selectNow/nowDisabled, with both actions returning void. It has no Time-panel canConfirm/value arguments. disabled=true prevents confirmation. Standalone panels can replace the action region; the outer editing shell owns final saving in hosted editing, while the panel contributes auxiliary actions. Panel confirm is not the outer-save method.

Now capabilities follow the actual panel: Cedar single panels support it, while Cedar range panels have no now action. Maple range panels stage now for the active endpoint, preserve the other endpoint and still require confirmation. The presence of selectNow in scope does not imply every mode supports the action.

Cedar cell customizes a calendar cell with date and, for ranges, type=start/end; extra adds content. Maple Date/DatePicker page-calendar summaries support year({year}), month({year,month}), date({week,year,month,date}), range({choose}) and multiple({choose}) according to mode. Maple DateRange/DateRangePicker do not forward these single-panel summary slots, nor do scroll/line viewports promise them.

loading-icon is not wired to date fields or pure panels and is not available merely because the underlying decorator supports it. Field focus(index?)/blur() delegate to real controls. Cedar/direct-field blur closes the field popup; Maple range persistent-reference blur only clears its focus, without pretending to close the outer Drawer. Pure panels expose no focus/blur methods.

### Presentation configuration and ranges

datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps configure presentation without overriding owned model/rules/type/control events; Maple internal range datePickerProps uses a calendar allowlist. popupProps retains a broad dictionary, with public DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions recommended and owner keys still filtered at runtime. Cedar timePickerProps configures embedded time presentation; Maple pickerProps configures wheels.

A range placeholder string applies to both endpoints; arrays configure each and missing entries are empty. readonly is separate from disabled; unset field state inherits Form. Cedar range-panel exchangeTime only handles reversed interactive candidates: true swaps their times, false retains endpoint times. It does not reorder external model/text/shortcut values. Maple does not expose this property.

| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Values and events

`DateValue = Date | string | number`. Invalid dates and incomplete/reversed ranges cannot commit. min/max are inclusive; strings follow value-format, while Date/timestamps are also accepted. Confirmation revalidates rules. `disabledTime` returns numeric lists from `disabledHours()`, `disabledMinutes(hour)`, `disabledSeconds(hour, minute)`. Valid pure panels emit `confirm(value, date(s), text(s))`; fields use `update:open`/`open-change`, not close. Nested panel/popup props configure presentation only, not top-level models/rules/state events. Range disabled accepts [startDisabled, endDisabled]; locked endpoints cannot be cleared/modified.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

## Visible wheel fields

`date-fields` and `time-fields` independently control date and time columns and their order. The two groups do not interleave. Fields and standalone panels share the same props; range endpoints share the configuration.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `date-fields` | readonly DatePickerField[]<br>`DatePickerField: 'month' \| 'year' \| 'day'` | Generate year/month/day columns from type | year, month, day. Only date wheels are affected; the calendar grid is unchanged. |
| `time-fields` | readonly TimePickerField[]<br>`TimePickerField: 'hour' \| 'minute' \| 'second'` | Hour/minute/second | Controls time wheels, including those embedded in calendars. |

Arrays must be nonempty and unique; explicit arrays strictly determine column visibility/order. Omission uses defaults. Date/time field groups validate separately and cannot mix. Hidden units retain existing values and merge back into the complete draft. Changing field configuration does not commit the model. Nested display options cannot override root props.

Date/DateRange time areas apply only with show-time. `format` controls input text; `value-format` controls saved representation; neither determines panel columns. Unspecified datetime formats save seconds by default. For minute strings, configure both formats explicitly. Hiding year still uses the complete draft year. MM-DD alone cannot represent cross-year ranges; save complete dates for leap-year/cross-year workflows.

# 时区与多月日历

`time-zone="Asia/Shanghai"` 使用 IANA 时区名。`Date`、毫秒时间戳表示真实时刻，切换时区只改变展示；字符串按目标时区的当地时间解释。`min`、`max`、手输、快捷项、事件和禁用规则使用相同协议；事件中的 `Date` 仍是真实时刻。未设置时保持浏览器本地时区行为。夏令时不存在的时间拒绝选择，重复出现的时间取第一次，非法时区禁止提交。

`interactive-mode` 支持 `page`（默认）、`scroll`、`line`。`scroll` 在 `min` / `max` 间展示多月，默认开启 `use-virtual-scroll`，只渲染视口附近月份；未提供边界时使用初始视口前后各一年。`line` 使用独立星期表头和一行日期，复用日历日期按钮的圆形选中态；标题显示本周起止日期，前后按钮按周切换。浏览和翻周不会提交表单；选择、取消、确认仍沿用 Maple 字段草稿机制。

这两个视图支持日精度日期与日期时间，日期时间继续使用原有快捷时间和详细时间滚轮；范围端点摘要、单端点锁定、反序反馈及确认／取消继续由原封装管理。年／月／周精度沿用原有面板。设置 `use-virtual-scroll="false"` 会渲染全部月份，大范围建议保持虚拟滚动。

布局可覆盖 `--mp-date-calendar-scroll-height`、`--mp-date-calendar-month-height`、`--mp-date-calendar-row-height` 和 `--mp-date-calendar-line-height`；月份使用固定六周网格。虚拟滚动要求月份等高，调整行高时同步调整月高度，避免内容溢出。颜色复用日历既有主题 token，支持 Alps / Firefly 亮暗主题。

### 展示模式只在根设置

`Date` / `DateRange` 字段通过根 `panel-type` 选择内容，独立日期面板通过根 `presentation` 选择内容；独立面板内容默认 `calendarPicker`，不带时间时显示日历；字段的 popup 内容默认 `calendar`。`DatePickerOptions` / `DateRangePickerOptions` 不能覆盖根组件选择的面板模式。周起始、视口、快捷项和合法外观仍可嵌套配置。单值根支持 picker/calendar/calendarPicker，范围根支持 picker/calendar/calendarPicker；Cedar 只有桌面日历，不提供这些空模式。

### 周起始日的响应式展示

`dayStartOfWeek` 更新时，日历表头与日期列位置同步更新，不改变选中值或提交草稿。纯面板使用根属性，字段通过 `datePickerProps` / `dateRangePickerProps` 配置；滚轮视图不使用星期列。

### 动态日期限制

更新或移除 `min` / `max` 只影响可选日期，不自动修改已有模型或草稿。日历的日/月/年导航状态根据当前视口和两端限制派生；移除一端限制只恢复对应方向，不释放另一端，也不触发选择或提交。

### 编辑与确认

本组件支持 `edit-mode`，字段 > FormItem > Form 逐层继承；未指定时为 `popup`，点击值区域打开编辑面板。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

日期／时间字段在 inline 下沿用原确认策略；在 popover/popup 中，内部纯面板隐藏确认工具栏，由编辑层提供唯一一组确认／取消。独立 DatePicker、DateRangePicker、TimePicker、TimeRangePicker 保留原有面板 API 和确认行为，不继承 Form 的字段展示。

移动端日期字段通过 `panel-type` 选择日历／滚轮内容；`edit-mode` 仅表示字段编辑方式。独立面板的内容形态以各自 API 为准，不由字段 edit-mode 控制。

日期选择**面板**，可单独嵌入页面使用。本页聚合 DatePicker 示例，没有独立的 date-picker 文档路由。日期范围面板请参阅 [`DateRangePicker`](#/zh-CN/date-range) 所在的范围文档；表单字段请使用 [`Date`](#/zh-CN/date) / [`DateRange`](#/zh-CN/date-range)。

### 字段与嵌入式面板

字段负责输入与浮层，纯面板直接嵌入页面。day-start-of-week 统一为数字 0～6，0 为周日；范围日历也支持动态更新。嵌套 Options 只配置展示，不覆盖顶层值、格式、边界或禁用规则。

日历面板箭头的可访问名称跟随全局 Locale，局部 LocaleProvider 可以覆盖对应文案，缺少的导航键回退全局语言。日面板为上一月/下一月，月份面板为上一年/下一年，年份列表为上一组/下一组年份；按钮仍遵守日期边界，预览变化不等于提交日期。

### 透传配置边界与优先级

使用 `DatePopupOptions` 配置 `popup-props`，调整锚定弹层的外观和定位。open/defaultOpen、disabled/readonly、modelValue、值格式、日期规则及通知监听由字段管理，组件会过滤由字段管理的配置和通知监听器。popup-container 顶层明确传入时优先（包括 false），否则回退 popupProps.popupContainer；popupClass 与内部类合并。trigger、closeOnClickReference、preventFocus、popupOffset 由字段展示层固定（偏移当前为 4）；Maple 还固定 unmountOnClose=true。这些固定项由字段管理；Cedar 的 `unmountOnClose` 可通过现有浮层配置设置。可使用 popupTranslate 定制附加平移。其他有效展示字段保持原透传。

建议使用本页列出的专用配置类型；展开状态、模型和事件由组件管理，不能通过嵌套配置接管。

import type { DatePopupOptions } from '@maple-design/ui'
```

夏令时跳过的整小时或半小时会从时间候选中排除，仍然存在的分钟保持可选。新的当地时间选择遇到重复小时默认取第一次；已有 Date／时间戳即使位于第二次重复小时，切换时区展示、无修改确认以及编辑另一个范围端点都保留原始时刻和未显示的毫秒。字符串不携带重复小时的发生次数，如需保留明确时刻应使用 Date 或 timestamp。

### 复制与编辑

通过 open-trigger-target 独立控制打开区域；icon 模式下点击、聚焦和输入不会自动展开。input-editable / filterable 仍负责是否可编辑或搜索。右侧按钮、显式键盘展开和受控 open 可打开面板。

### 共享字段加载

`loading` 控制共享字段加载状态；`loading-mode` 为 `default`（指示器）或 `line`（底部不定进度线），默认 `default`。渲染统一由 FieldDecorator 负责，不隐式改变 disabled/readonly；需要禁止编辑时单独设置。

## 阅读方向

组件继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部方向覆盖。日历日期、月份、年份按阅读顺序排列，前后翻页图形随方向调整，日期值与起止顺序保持原义。分页网格中左右键按视觉方向移动焦点，上下键移动一行，Home/End 移至当前行首尾并跳过禁用项；焦点移动不提交，Enter/Space 沿用选值行为，边界停留在当前显示网格。快捷区 `shortcuts-position="left|right"` 保持物理侧，底部使用 `bottom`。弹层继承字段来源方向。

## 触发与定位

### 弹层定位

Date 字段默认从输入框下方 bottom-start 打开。需要时通过 popupProps.placement 覆盖首选方位，由底层 Trigger 定位；不是透传给 Popup 或 Popover。DatePicker 是独立日期面板，没有输入框锚点；弹层位置通过 Date 字段配置。

公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。

## 使用说明

### 面板配置

DatePicker 与 DateRangePicker 用于独立日期选择。通过 `show-current` 控制当前日期高亮，使用 `picker-value` 或 `default-picker-value` 设置面板显示的日期。

控制当前日期高亮使用 showCurrent，选择当前按钮使用 showNowButton；定位面板视口使用 pickerValue 或 defaultPickerValue，约束可选值使用 min、max 和 disabledDate。已有的列字段、缩写、滚轮配置、外观和真实面板功能继续保留。loading-icon 没有接通到该面板或日期字段的公共插槽，不列为可用能力。


<!-- date-contract:start -->

### 值与格式

DateValue 为 string、number 或原生 Date。数值按时间戳处理，0 不按空值处理；modelValue=null 是显式空值。范围使用宽数组并允许不完整端点，不把现有协议强制改成二元组；提交仍校验完整性与合法性。Maple 通用 DatePicker/Date 的多选能力不扩展到 Cedar 单值 Props。

属性表列出实际公开集合；继承及按精度说明表示有效缺省，原始 Props 可为 undefined。format 控制显示与手输，valueFormat 控制模型协议。week/quarter 的显示标签与模型格式不同；函数 format 无反向解析，不能据此开启手输。

min/max 包含端点；非法的已提供边界阻止确认，不静默当作未设置。动态收紧规则不清空已有业务模型。disabledDate/disabledTime 是明确校验回调，不是异步事件任务，时间禁用回调返回 DateDisabledTime 的禁用列表。

### Date Slots / Methods

字段 default 可替换触发区；prefix/selected/suffix 替换相应内容，范围还支持 separator。替换原生控件时保留名称、起止区别及键盘入口。read 接收 { value, text }，suffix-icon 接收 { focus, popupOpen }，clear-icon 接收受保护的 clear(event?)；不直接绕过 emptyValue 或禁用/只读守卫。

actions 的参数为 { confirm, disabled, selectNow, nowDisabled }，两个动作返回 void；没有时间面板的 canConfirm/value 参数。disabled=true 时不能确认。独立面板可以替换整块操作区；托管编辑的最终保存由外层编辑壳负责，面板只贡献辅助操作，不把其 confirm 当作外层保存方法。

此刻能力按面板定义：Cedar 单值面板支持，Cedar 范围面板没有此刻入口；Maple 范围面板对当前端暂存此刻，另一端保留并仍需确认。不要只因 scope 中存在 selectNow 就假定所有模式都支持此刻。

Cedar cell 定制日历格，参数含 date，范围另含 type=start/end；extra 是附加内容。Maple Date/DatePicker 在 page 日历摘要中支持 year({year})、month({year,month})、date({week,year,month,date})、range({choose})、multiple({choose})；后两者按实际模式使用。Maple DateRange/DateRangePicker 不转发这些单值摘要槽，scroll/line 视口也不承诺摘要槽。

loading-icon 尚未接通到日期字段或纯面板，不因底层装饰器支持而列为可用槽。字段 focus(index?)、blur() 委托真实控件；Cedar/直接字段 blur 会关闭字段浮层，Maple 范围持久 reference 的 blur 只清其焦点，不冒充外层 Drawer 关闭。纯面板没有公开 focus/blur 方法。

### 展示配置与日期范围

datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps 只配置展示，不能覆盖根模型、规则、类型或控制事件；Maple 范围内部 datePickerProps 另用日历白名单。popupProps 保留宽字典入口，推荐公开 DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions，运行时仍过滤所有者字段。Cedar timePickerProps 只配置内嵌时间展示；Maple 使用 pickerProps 配置滚轮。

范围 placeholder 字符串重复用于两端，数组分别指定起止且缺项为空；readonly 与 disabled 分开，未设置字段值时继承表单。Cedar 范围面板 exchangeTime 只处理交互候选反序：true 连时间交换，false 保留端点时间；不会重排外部模型、手输或快捷值。Maple 未公开该属性。

## API

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](#/zh-CN/emptyValues)。

| 参数         | 类型               | 缺省与范围                                            |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | 字段 > FormItem > Form > 组件族默认；完整覆盖，不合并 |
| empty-text   | string             | 字段 > FormItem > Form > '-'；显式 '' 有效            |

以上是字段展示层 API；纯面板不因此新增阅读模式。Form 与 FormItem 提供继承配置。empty-value 的现有类型与默认输出仍按该组件原 API 执行。

### 值与事件

`DateValue = Date | string | number`。无效日期、不完整或逆序范围不能提交。min/max 包含边界，字符串按 value-format 解析，也可直接传 Date 或时间戳。确认时重新校验规则。`disabledTime` 返回 `disabledHours()`、`disabledMinutes(hour)`、`disabledSeconds(hour, minute)` 数字列表。纯面板通过校验后触发 `confirm(value, date(s), text(s))`；字段展开使用 `update:open` / `open-change`，不再使用 close。嵌套面板和弹层 props 只配置展示，不能覆盖顶层模型、规则与状态事件。范围 disabled 支持 `[起点禁用, 终点禁用]`，锁定端点不能被清除或修改。

## 滚轮可见字段

`date-fields` 与 `time-fields` 分别控制日期、时间滚轮列的显隐及顺序，两组不会交错排列。范围起止两端共用配置，字段与独立面板使用相同属性。

# DateRange

Endpoint locks are provided reactively by the local mobile presentation adapter to calendars and wheels. Inherited and current locks are merged and remain intact when switching views or unlocking the other endpoint. The shared draft/confirmation owner has no mobile injection dependency; external model updates and confirm/cancel behavior are unchanged.

Floating panels use the visual viewport instead of a half-screen cap. A full calendar is visible when space permits; short windows scroll content while keeping actions visible. Override `--mp-date-picker-popover-max-height` to cap the panel (default `100dvh - 32px`). Switching back to default/Maple removes brand overrides.

The embedded example calls `confirm` from the `actions` slot and binds its `disabled` state to the submit button. Selecting a draft does not update the committed value until confirmation. Tightening bounds does not clear the existing model, but an invalid draft cannot be submitted; choose valid endpoints to submit again.
Pure panels do not accept open/default-open, popup-container, placement, trigger-props, placeholder, variant or clearable. disable-confirm controls confirmation; actions receives { confirm, disabled }. Panels support independent app.use installation. Root and date/date-range subpaths export components, Props, Instance, Type, Options and Emits; no standalone date-picker/date-range-picker npm subpath exists.

Installing DateRange also registers DateRangePicker, which is available through the static member `DateRange.Picker`.

Fields configure this through `dateRangePickerProps`.

`abbreviation` (boolean, default `true`) controls abbreviated month labels in the calendar month grid. Set it to `false` for full month names from the active Locale. It does not affect weekday labels, headers, wheel columns, or value formats. Range calendars use the top-level option; nested calendar options cannot override it.

### Endpoint locks

Locking both endpoints does not block parent model updates, but dates and confirmation stay disabled. Unlocking the start afterward restores editing without submitting. Choosing 16 and confirming retains the new end 22 rather than restoring the old end 15.

“External range 18~~22” updates the parent model directly: the pending draft synchronizes and the locked endpoint uses the new model as its baseline. This update adds no selection or confirmation events. Choosing 24 and confirming then commits 18~~24, without restoring the old start.

Locking an endpoint after editing its draft does not authorize that draft to replace the committed endpoint. Confirmation stays disabled while that locked draft differs from the model. Unlocking preserves the draft and restores confirmation, but does not itself submit; explicitly confirm to commit.

An inverted candidate that would move a locked endpoint must be rejected before it changes a nested calendar draft. The committed range and displayed draft remain unchanged; a subsequent valid choice can still be confirmed. Range sorting must never silently relocate a locked endpoint.

This demo explicitly sets disable-confirm=false. With one locked endpoint, a single date choice edits only the unlocked endpoint instead of starting a new two-click range. With both locked, date candidates expose disabled semantics and confirmation is unavailable; unlocking restores editing without submitting.

Use disabled=[startLocked, endLocked] to retain a committed endpoint while editing the other draft. Confirmation writes the model; changing locks alone does not submit. Locking both endpoints blocks selection. This standalone panel does not demonstrate popup cancellation.

### Root-only presentation selection

`Date` / `DateRange` fields select their content through root `panel-type`; standalone date panels use root `presentation`. Date and DateRange fields default to `calendar`, and standalone date panels to `calendarPicker`. Field `DatePickerOptions` / `DateRangePickerOptions` do not accept root-owned `presentation`; untyped nested selectors are filtered at runtime. Week start, viewport, shortcuts and valid appearance remain configurable. Single roots support picker/calendar/calendarPicker; ranges support picker/calendar/calendarPicker. Cedar only implements its desktop calendar and does not expose empty mobile modes.

### Reactive first weekday

`dayStartOfWeek` updates the calendar headers and date columns together without changing the selected value or submitting a draft. Use the root prop on pure panels; on fields configure `datePickerProps` / `dateRangePickerProps`. The wheel view does not use weekday columns.

### Dynamic date limits

Updating or removing `min` / `max` changes selectable dates, not the existing model or draft. In Maple calendar views, day/month/year navigation availability is derived from the current viewport and both limits; removing one limit restores only that side. A released bound does not trigger selection or submission.

### Editing and confirmation

`edit-mode` inherits from field > FormItem > Form and defaults to `popup`. Supported values are `direct / popup`. Inline keeps the existing control behavior. Overlay editing uses a Cell reference and an isolated draft; only confirmation updates v-model. Cancel, reset and enabling readPretty discard the draft.

Maple edit-mode="popup" opens the editor by clicking the value area; direct edits directly. readPretty is independent reading mode, separate from readonly/disabled.

`before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

Direct editing keeps the existing date/time confirmation policy. In popup, the inner pure panel hides its toolbar and the host owns the single confirmation boundary. Standalone DatePicker, DateRangePicker, TimePicker and TimeRangePicker retain their panel API and confirmation behavior. On fields, use `panel-type` to choose calendar/picker content; `edit-mode` controls the field container. Standalone date pickers use `presentation` for panel content; time pickers follow their panel APIs.

### Range panel interaction

Date and date-time ranges edit only the active endpoint. Neither manual selection nor Now swaps endpoints. Reversed drafts show a red footer message and disable Confirm until corrected; correcting the range still requires explicit confirmation. Cancel discards the draft. Bounds, disabled date/time rules and locked endpoints remain enforced. Time-only ranges retain their next-day behavior.

### Disabled units inside a range

`disabled-date` restricts the start and end. A range may span disabled interior units; it is not scanned unit by unit or automatically truncated. The same rule applies to dates, months, and years. Disabled interior cells stay gray. Paging preserves the selected first endpoint and clears hover previews; reverse clicks are ordered chronologically.

Standalone DatePicker / DateRangePicker panels and inline fields share a 265px calendar width. Date and time controls appear side by side when space permits and wrap in narrow containers. Explicit `presentation="picker"` preserves wheels. Standalone confirmation and the actions slot remain owned by the panel.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

The lightning button on date-time ranges opens a localized quick-range panel. Choosing an allowed preset updates the draft only. Click Confirm to submit through the regular validation and before-commit flow and close the editor. Custom shortcuts replace the built-in ranges. Now changes only the active endpoint without swapping. Even with `disable-confirm`, Now and subsequent edits require confirmation; cancelling discards the draft. Standalone panels, inline fields and popups behave consistently; reversed ranges show a red message and disable Confirm. Set `:show-now-button="false"` to hide Now.

DateRangePicker also supports shortcuts, shortcuts-position, preview-shortcut and picker-value/default-picker-value. Range viewports have two dates; shortcuts cannot change locked endpoints and previews do not commit. Events: update:picker-value, picker-value-change(value, dates, texts), select-shortcut(shortcut). ### Current endpoint selection

show-current controls highlighting only. Range fields provide Now by default, controlled by top-level `show-now-button` and editing only the current top-summary endpoint. Reversed ranges show a red warning and disable confirmation; disabled-date/time violations disable Now. See Date's current-date/range-policy example.

Top-level show-current alone controls highlighting. Nested date-picker-props rejects showCurrent/showNowButton to avoid ineffective/conflicting settings.

### Locale and nested calendar options

Date labels, titles and actions use each library's global Locale/Provider. Cedar removes component-level `locale` without dictionary overrides/aliases. Locale changes neither select nor commit dates.

`DateRangePicker.datePickerProps` and `DateRange.datePickerProps` accept only `DateRangeCalendarOptions`: `hint`, `color`, `titleColor`, `buttonElevation`, `touchable`. Model, validation, viewport, presentation, elevation, abbreviation and action control stay at the range root. Unknown keys and event listeners are not forwarded. The calendar branches explicitly use calendar presentation.

Field appearance merges with `dateRangePickerProps.datePickerProps`. Empty default objects no longer override nested settings; explicitly supplied field keys take precedence.

### Actual platform capabilities

Cedar does not expose `Date.pickerProps`, `DateRange.pickerProps` or `DateRange.datePickerProps`. PC fields use desktop calendar panels. Maple retains real extensions via DateWheelOptions/DateRangeCalendarOptions. Both configure complete panels with `Date.datePickerProps` / `DateRange.dateRangePickerProps`. Range time wheels use `picker-props`; initial datetime belongs in top-level `defaultValue`.

### Per-instance date locale isolation

Date components use the current library Locale/Provider configuration. Each instance controls its first weekday through `day-start-of-week`, without changing the application Dayjs default locale or base locale configuration.

`value-format` is a stable English date protocol, including month-name tokens. `format` display/typed text uses the UI language. Locale changes do not rewrite models or invalidate English-month models. Numeric protocols, Date objects and timestamps remain unchanged. Chinese core/Maple locale data is integrated; other formats prefer registered Dayjs locale data and safely fall back to English when unavailable.

### Typed-input format boundaries

Date input is parsed strictly according to `format`, serialized according to `value-format`, and checked against disabled rules and bounds. Manual entry is enabled by default. Clicking edits the input; the calendar button or ArrowDown opens the panel; Enter / blur commits. Set `input-editable=false` for panel-only selection. Multiple mode and function format do not support reverse parsing and keep the input readonly; disable `input-editable` with function format. Maple does not provide week/quarter presentation modes.

### Clearing a deferred range

In deferred editing, clearing changes the draft; confirmation runs form validation and `beforeCommit` before publishing the configured `emptyValue`. Cancel restores the committed range. An untouched empty range or a half-selected range still requires complete endpoints; an explicit change from a non-empty range to an empty draft can be confirmed. Disabled/readonly fields and locked endpoints cannot be cleared. A rejected controlled open cannot publish a cleared model.

Range values remain `[start, end]`; changing reading direction does not swap endpoints or commit drafts. Calendar range connections and boundary radii follow reading direction. In paged grids, Left/Right moves focus visually and Up/Down preserves date-row order. Maple endpoint editing and continuous range highlighting use different rendering paths. ### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

Date/date-time range fields edit only the currently selected endpoint. Neither manual selection nor Now swaps endpoints. Reversed complete ranges retain the draft, display a bottom warning and disable confirmation. Correct the current endpoint or switch through the top summary. Cancel discards unconfirmed drafts. A single endpoint in an empty form remains a draft until both endpoints are complete/valid. Bounds, disabled dates/times and endpoint locks still apply.

### Values and events

`DateValue = Date | string | number`. Invalid dates and incomplete/reversed ranges cannot commit. min/max are inclusive; strings follow value-format, while Date/timestamps are also accepted. Confirmation revalidates rules. `disabledTime` returns numeric lists from `disabledHours()`, `disabledMinutes(hour)`, `disabledSeconds(hour, minute)`. Valid pure panels emit `confirm(value, date(s), text(s))`; fields use `update:open`/`open-change`, not close. Nested panel/popup props configure presentation only, not top-level models/rules/state events. Range disabled accepts [startDisabled, endDisabled]; locked endpoints cannot be cleared/modified.

Panels edit a draft and commit on confirmation. Cancellation or closing does not commit, while clearing commits an empty value and closes immediately. DateRange allows manual entry by default; set `input-editable=false` for panel-only selection. See the combined field examples in the Date documentation.

## Time zones and mobile calendars

`time-zone` shares Date's IANA and instant/local-string protocol. `interactive-mode="scroll"` provides virtual multimonth scrolling; line shows one week. Both support datetime and single-endpoint locking. Opening from a start/end entry edits only that endpoint's date/time. Locked entries are disabled; the other endpoint retains its instant. Both values are order-validated. See Date's `time-zone`/multimonth calendar notes.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

## Visible wheel fields

`date-fields` and `time-fields` independently control date and time columns and their order. The two groups do not interleave. Fields and standalone panels share the same props; range endpoints share the configuration.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| ------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `date-fields` | readonly DatePickerField[]<br>`DatePickerField: 'month' \| 'year' \| 'day'` | Generate year/month/day columns from type | year, month, day. Only date wheels are affected; the calendar grid is unchanged. |
| `time-fields` | readonly TimePickerField[]<br>`TimePickerField: 'hour' \| 'minute' \| 'second'` | Hour/minute/second | Controls time wheels, including those embedded in calendars. |

Arrays must be nonempty and unique; explicit arrays strictly determine column visibility/order. Omission uses defaults. Date/time field groups validate separately and cannot mix. Hidden units retain existing values and merge back into the complete draft. Changing field configuration does not commit the model. Nested display options cannot override root props.

Date/DateRange time areas apply only with show-time. `format` controls input text; `value-format` controls saved representation; neither determines panel columns. Unspecified datetime formats save seconds by default. For minute strings, configure both formats explicitly. Hiding year still uses the complete draft year. MM-DD alone cannot represent cross-year ranges; save complete dates for leap-year/cross-year workflows.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Native range-input references apply string placeholders, including empty strings, to both endpoints and retain array labels by endpoint. Input placeholder visibility still follows hint. Readonly native inputs remain focusable and copyable while editing, opening and clearing are blocked. Global or endpoint disabled states take precedence over readonly. Existing omitted-placeholder defaults for each editing mode are preserved.

Native date-range references emit focus/blur without arguments: entering the input group emits focus, switching endpoints does not duplicate it, and leaving emits blur. Form receives each corresponding notification once under its existing rules. Readonly clicks still notify the original event without opening or editing. Disabled clicks do not notify or consume click.once early. Returning a Promise from an ordinary listener does not start busy state or block opening; asynchronous submission still uses explicit before-commit.

### Panel configuration

DatePicker and DateRangePicker provide standalone date selection. Use `show-current` for current-date highlighting and `picker-value` or `default-picker-value` for the displayed date.

Use showCurrent for current-date highlighting, showNowButton for selecting now, pickerValue/defaultPickerValue for the viewport, and min/max/disabledDate for selectable-value constraints. Existing field lists, abbreviation, wheel settings, appearance and actual panel capabilities remain available. loading-icon is not wired to a public panel or date-field slot and is not an available capability.

### Values and formats

DateValue is string, number or native Date. Numbers are timestamps and 0 is not empty; modelValue=null is explicitly empty. Ranges retain broad arrays and incomplete endpoints rather than forcing a tuple; commits still validate completeness and validity. Maple general DatePicker/Date multiple selection does not widen Cedar single-value Props.

Inherited/precision-derived defaults describe resolved behavior; raw Props can be undefined. format controls display/text input and valueFormat controls the model protocol. Week/quarter display labels differ from model formats; function format has no reverse parser for text input.

Bounds are inclusive. Invalid supplied bounds block confirmation instead of being treated as omitted. Tightening rules does not clear the business model. disabledDate/disabledTime are explicit validation callbacks rather than asynchronous event tasks; time callbacks return disabled lists through DateDisabledTime.

### DateRange Slots / Methods

Field default replaces the trigger; prefix/selected/suffix replace content, and ranges also support separator. Preserve names, endpoint distinctions and keyboard access when replacing native controls. read receives value/text, suffix-icon receives focus/popupOpen, and clear-icon receives guarded clear(event?), respecting emptyValue and disabled/readonly guards.

actions receives confirm/disabled/selectNow/nowDisabled, with both actions returning void. It has no Time-panel canConfirm/value arguments. disabled=true prevents confirmation. Standalone panels can replace the action region; the outer editing shell owns final saving in hosted editing, while the panel contributes auxiliary actions. Panel confirm is not the outer-save method.

Now capabilities follow the actual panel: Cedar single panels support it, while Cedar range panels have no now action. Maple range panels stage now for the active endpoint, preserve the other endpoint and still require confirmation. The presence of selectNow in scope does not imply every mode supports the action.

Cedar cell customizes a calendar cell with date and, for ranges, type=start/end; extra adds content. Maple Date/DatePicker page-calendar summaries support year({year}), month({year,month}), date({week,year,month,date}), range({choose}) and multiple({choose}) according to mode. Maple DateRange/DateRangePicker do not forward these single-panel summary slots, nor do scroll/line viewports promise them.

loading-icon is not wired to date fields or pure panels and is not available merely because the underlying decorator supports it. Field focus(index?)/blur() delegate to real controls. Cedar/direct-field blur closes the field popup; Maple range persistent-reference blur only clears its focus, without pretending to close the outer Drawer. Pure panels expose no focus/blur methods.

### Presentation configuration and ranges

datePickerProps/dateRangePickerProps configure presentation without overriding owned model/rules/type/control events; Maple internal range datePickerProps uses a calendar allowlist. popupProps retains a broad dictionary, with public DatePopupOptions/DateRangePopupOptions recommended and owner keys still filtered at runtime. Cedar timePickerProps configures embedded time presentation; Maple pickerProps configures wheels.

A range placeholder string applies to both endpoints; arrays configure each and missing entries are empty. readonly is separate from disabled; unset field state inherits Form. Cedar range-panel exchangeTime only handles reversed interactive candidates: true swaps their times, false retains endpoint times. It does not reorder external model/text/shortcut values. Maple does not expose this property.

# Dialog

With `draggable` enabled, title inputs, textareas, buttons, links with href and editable content retain native pointer behavior and do not start a drag. The ordinary title area remains draggable. In non-centered mode, numeric `top=0` is supported just like the string `0px`.

Use `<mp-dialog>` for component usage and explicit `Dialog.*` methods for functional usage. Both forms share one configuration model. Callable `Dialog(...)` is not supported.

### Before hooks and callback compatibility

`beforeClose({ action }, done, context)` is the only hook entry. No new closeGuard/confirmGuard/cancelGuard prop is introduced.


A before hook that only logs synchronously must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means callback completion is still pending. Old async callbacks that returned `Promise<void>` without calling done now complete on Promise resolution.


```demo
../example/demos/en-US/guard-protocol.vue
```


Promise and done share a single completion state: false/done(false) rejects; true/done() allows; a resolved Promise<void> allows. The first completion wins. Errors emit guard-error; cancellation/unmount invalidates late completion. Synchronous void retains the callback protocol and waits for done on these close/confirm guards.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, titles and action spacing use logical start/end. External popovers inherit their source direction. Closing, confirmation, cancellation and uncommitted state are unchanged by direction switches.

## Usage notes

### Async operation feedback
Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

Programmatic notification callbacks do not control task completion. Service selection/closing results settle independently of callback errors, and closing completion always releases the owned host. Exceptions still propagate through the caller or Vue error channel; returned Promises do not control loading or closing.

### Dragging and cancellation
Title dragging is controlled only by the initiating primary pointer. Disabling `draggable`, closing, entering fullscreen, losing pointer capture or owner-window focus, deactivation and unmount all end the gesture and release listeners and capture. Reenabling requires a new gesture; the previous pointer cannot resume it. Disabling preserves the current offset; fullscreen and the existing post-close reset restore defaults. Listeners belong to the title element's document.

### Programmatic dialog mount targets
Function calls honor `popupContainer` from explicit configuration or `setDefaultOptions`, using the component's selector/HTMLElement resolution and missing/invalid-selector fallback to body. The default targets body; `false` renders inline in the service's own body host. `handle.update({ popupContainer })` moves the same dialog and preserves content state and app context. Closing removes teleported content and its service host, independently of notification callback results. A custom container controls DOM attachment; layout still follows Dialog positioning and its containing block.

Built-in buttons, overlay, Escape, footer methods and instance confirm()/cancel() request beforeClose. Instance close(), returned handle close(), Dialog.close() and parent open=false are direct commands that bypass guards; a controlled parent still decides whether to accept update:open(false). Direct closing retires pending guards so late results cannot close a reopened instance. close does not mean leave completion; observe closed/onClosed. Maple Popup close()/requestClose() instead return `Promise<boolean>` for guarded requests.

### Dialog Methods

All open methods accept `DialogConfig | string` and return `Promise<DialogAction | void> & DialogReturn`.
Function-based Dialog calls default to simple layout (`simple: true`) with the top-right close button hidden (`closable: false`). Explicit options or global defaults can override both.

| Method | Default behavior |
| ------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `Dialog.open(config)` | Ordinary dialog |
| `Dialog.confirm(config)` | `type: 'warning'`, simple layout |
| `Dialog.alert(config)` | No cancel button; overlay/ESC closing disabled |
| `Dialog.info/success/warning/error(config)` | Corresponding status, no cancel button, simple layout |
| `Dialog.close()` | Close the latest functional dialog |
| `Dialog.setDefaultOptions(config)` | Set default programmatic options |
| `Dialog.resetDefaultOptions()` | Reset default programmatic options |

`DialogConfig` matches camelCase component props and additionally supports renderable `content`/`title`/`message`/`footer` plus `onOpen`/`onOpened`/`onClose`/`onClosed`/`onConfirm`/`onCancel`/`onClickOverlay`/`onKeyEscape`.

`DialogReturn.close()` closes this dialog; `DialogReturn.update(config)` updates mutable configuration. After installation, `this.$dialog` exposes the same API.

```ts
type DialogAction = 'confirm' | 'cancel' | 'close'
type DialogType = 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'
```

## CSS Variables

Variables use `--mp-`, e.g. `--mp-dialog-width`, `--mp-dialog-background`, `--mp-dialog-border-radius`, `--mp-dialog-simple-width`, `--mp-dialog-fullscreen-width` and `--mp-dialog-close-button-color`.

Color semantics match Cedar: `--mp-dialog-background` uses `surface-raised`; `--mp-dialog-overlay-background` controls scrim; titles/body use primary content and close controls secondary content. `--mp-dialog-status-{info|success|warning|danger}-color` uses readable content-info/success/warning/danger, not status fill. Business themes should override component variables; shared themes override system variables. Mobile borderless geometry/layout remain independent.

The backdrop consumes `sys-color-scrim` through the Dialog component variable. Maple no longer uses Popup colors for Dialog. Set a per-instance backdrop variable via `overlay-style`; a variable on the panel (`dialog-style`) does not inherit to its sibling backdrop. Explicit `overlay-style.backgroundColor` wins. Teleported content needs variables on its actual DOM ancestors. Dark themes inherit the same semantic colors; geometry remains platform-specific. Status icons use readable content colors.

Variables are grouped by purpose: background/overlay-background for panel/scrim; border-* for panel/divider borders; title-* for title typography; content-* for body typography; actions-* for actions; close-button-* for the close button; status-* for semantic icons; simple-*/fullscreen-* for mode dimensions; animation-* for enter/leave motion. width/margin-top control ordinary panel layout. Internal drag/position variables are not public customization points.

表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。 ```demo ../example/demos/guard-protocol.vue ``` Promise 与 done 共用一次完成状态：`false` / `done(false)` 阻止，`true` / `done()` 允许；Promise<void> 正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。 守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。 ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。内容、标题与动作间距使用逻辑起止位置；外部弹层继承来源方向。关闭、确认、取消和未提交状态不因方向切换改变。 ## 使用说明 ### 异步操作反馈 before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。 函数调用的通知回调不控制任务完成。服务的选择或关闭结果独立于回调异常结算，关闭完成时仍会清理所属宿主。异常继续通过调用方或 Vue 错误通道传递；回调返回 Promise 不控制 loading 或关闭。 ### 拖动与取消 标题拖动只由发起手势的主指针控制。停用 `draggable`、关闭、进入全屏、丢失指针捕获或所属窗口失焦、停用以及卸载都会结束当前手势并释放监听和捕获。重新启用后需发起新手势，不会接续旧指针；停用保留当前偏移，全屏和原有关闭结束后的重置恢复默认位置。监听归属标题元素所在文档。 ### 函数调用的挂载目标 函数调用保留显式配置或 `setDefaultOptions` 中的 # Divider

Separate content sections in lists and layouts.

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`. Horizontal text start/end follows reading order; vertical start/end remains top/bottom. Inset controls along-line indentation and spacing controls perpendicular margins. Paired horizontal inset and vertical spacing uses logical start/end. Vertical borders use inline start; hairline, border type and aria-orientation retain their meaning. Direction changes preserve content nodes.

## Content and layout

### Content height and minimum thickness

Explicit thickness accepts finite numbers greater than or equal to 1. hairline still takes priority, using half the theme width. Values below 1 (including zero and negative values), and non-finite values, are ignored and use the theme width; development builds warn.

Multiline descriptions and custom content occupy their full height, including spacing=0. Subsequent content stays below the divider.

### Spacing values

`DividerSize = number | string | [number | string] | [number | string, number | string]`

`inset` controls the ends of the line; `spacing` controls the outer gap between the line and adjacent content. Both accept presets `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, a number in px, a CSS length, or an array. A scalar or single-item array applies to both ends; `[start, end]` sets each end separately. Array entries are lengths, not preset names.

| Direction | inset array order | spacing array order |
| --- | --- | --- |
| horizontal | Inline start/end inset; right/left in RTL | Top/bottom margin |
| vertical | Top/bottom inset | Inline start/end margin; right/left in RTL |

`inset` has no `inset` by default; `spacing` defaults to the platform’s `md` `spacing`. Presets use platform theme tokens, so pixel values may differ.


Development checks cover orientation, text-align, type, spacing shape, thickness and opacity. Invalid enums use defaults; invalid inset produces no indentation, invalid spacing falls back to md, and invalid opacity does not override styles. opacity must be finite and within 0–1. Arrays accept one or two lengths and no preset names. Finite negative margins and CSS var/calc expressions remain supported; browsers parse their CSS syntax.

## Usage notes

### Rows and content boundaries

expand-trigger supports only click. Invalid values produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and do not enable button semantics, click or keyboard expansion. line-clamp accepts finite numbers or numeric strings of at least one row and floors decimals. Values below one, nonfinite values and invalid strings warn and fall back to ordinary single-line mode, clearing old multiline styles. Prefer plain text or inline content without independent interactions. The default Tooltip still does not detect actual overflow and remains focusable with Tab when enabled. Custom tooltip content and controlled expansion remain unchanged.

## API

### Ellipsis Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expand` | Controlled expansion | `boolean` | `undefined` |
| `default-expand` | Initial uncontrolled expansion | `boolean` | `false` |
| `expand-trigger` | Enable click / Enter / Space toggling | `'click'` | `—` |
| `line-clamp` | Positive line count; omitted or invalid means single line | `number \| string` | `—` |
| `tooltip` | Tooltip configuration; false disables it | `boolean \| TooltipProps` | `true` |

Providing `expand` makes the component request updates from its parent rather than changing controlled state. When omitted, internal state is used, initialized once by `default-expand`. Tooltip follows its own width and trigger defaults; display does not depend on measured overflow. Touch callers can include `click` in `tooltip.trigger` explicitly. External class/style/width apply directly to the text node.

### Ellipsis Events / Slots

- `update:expand(expand: boolean)`: the new state requested by user interaction; external updates do not emit it.
- `default`: body text.
- `tooltip-content`: tooltip content. Without it, tooltip.content takes precedence, then body text; content is not concatenated twice.
- Keyboard: expandable text supports Enter / Space; tooltip-enabled text is focusable with Tab. No public instance methods.

The subentry default component and the named components from the subentry and root are the same component. Props includes actual listener parameters. Events remain notifications and do not await returned Promises. Use only the documented instance methods.

# Fab

### Intro

The floating action button component, press to display a group of action buttons.

The live preview starts expanded. Actions show a Message and collapse the menu. Changing direction moves the button to a compatible edge. Use click on touch devices; hover is intended for a mouse.

The local preview uses `fixed=false` and `popup-container=false`. The drag example keeps the default `fixed=true` to enable dragging and uses `popup-container=false` to keep the button inside the preview container. Drag boundaries use the container dimensions. Dragging uses touch gestures.

The preview and button remain visible when toggling dragging. Switching it off stops dragging. The preview scrolls with the page.

### visible versus v-if

Use `<mp-fab v-if="showFab" />` when destroying the instance is acceptable; visible is optional. v-if=false destroys FAB, its drag state and action children; remounting reads defaultOpen again. `:visible="showFab"` retains the instance and internal state while hiding its trigger and actions. FAB uses Drag/Teleport, so visible controls the actual content internally; avoid relying on v-show on the Teleport component. The action menu itself still uses open.

The default icon button has a localized name; pass `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` to customize it. When actions exist, the trigger also exposes `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Bind the `triggerProps` slot value to a custom focusable button; the application owns its disabled state.

Hover mode supports Enter/Space on the trigger. It stays open while focus remains on the trigger or actions after the pointer leaves, and closes when both pointer and focus leave. Escape requests close and returns focus to the trigger when focus was in the actions. Action clicks do not close automatically; control `v-model:open` in the application when desired.

`open` and `close` are interaction requests which a controlled parent may reject. External model changes and disabling do not necessarily emit matching request events. `opened`/`closed` receive the action element after the animation. Position and placement use physical sides without automatic flipping; `FabDrag` is a boolean or an object with `axis`, `attraction`, and `boundary`.

## API

`open`/`update:open` control the action menu through `v-model:open`. Without binding, `defaultOpen` initializes internally maintained state. `visible` controls the whole component without changing saved menu-`open` state. ### visible 与 v-if

不需要保留实例时，直接使用 `<mp-fab v-if="showFab" />`，无需再传 visible。v-if=false 会销毁 FAB、拖拽状态与动作子组件；重新显示会重新读取 defaultOpen。`:visible="showFab"` 保留实例和内部状态，只隐藏触发器与动作内容。FAB 默认通过 Drag/Teleport 挂到弹层容器，visible 在实际内容内部控制显示；不要依赖对 Teleport 组件直接使用 v-show。动作菜单自身仍使用 open。

默认图标按钮有本地化名称；可通过 `aria-label` 或 `aria-labelledby` 指定名称。若有动作，触发器还暴露 `aria-expanded` 和 `aria-controls`。自定义触发器应把 `triggerProps` 绑定到实际可聚焦按钮，并由业务自行处理禁用。

hover 模式支持触发器上的 Enter/Space；焦点仍在触发器或动作区时鼠标离开不会收起，焦点与鼠标均离开时收起。Escape 请求关闭，焦点位于动作区时回到触发器。动作点击不会自动关闭，业务可使用 `v-model:open` 收起。

`open`/`close` 表示交互请求，受控父级可以拒绝；外部改变 `open` 或禁用时的状态变化不保证产生相应请求事件。`opened`/`closed` 在动画结束时提供动作区元素。位置与展开方向均是物理方向，动作区不会自动翻转；`FabDrag` 为 boolean 或包含 `axis`、`attraction`、`boundary` 的对象。

# FieldDecorator

表单触发器外壳（与 Cedar `FieldDecorator` **同名同职责骨架**）。

## 职责

- variant / size / floating hint / line / clear / prefix / suffix
- outline/filled 的 fieldset 边框，standard 下划线

## 消费者

Input、Textarea、Select、Cascader、Date、Time、DateRange、TimeRange 等。  
内容放入 default slot；不要在消费者里再实现边框 / 浮动标签。

## 平台差异

| 项                       | Maple                  | Cedar                         | 说明                                     |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| 组件名                   | `FieldDecorator`       | `FieldDecorator`              | 对齐                                     |
| variant                  | 默认 **standard**      | 默认 **filled**               | 默认值平台差                             |
| size                     | 壳 `small` \| `normal` | `xs`–`xl`                     | 映射：`small↔sm`，`normal↔md`            |
| 浮动 hint / line / clear | 壳内置                 | Cedar 无 hint；clear 在消费者 | 平台差                                   |
| Token                    | `--mp-field-*`         | `--c-field-*`                 | 共享语义键对齐；hint 几何 token 仅 Maple |

## Size 映射（文档约定）

| Maple FD | Cedar FD |
| -------- | -------- |
| `small`  | `sm`     |
| `normal` | `md`     |

上层若用 `xs|sm|md|lg`（如 InputNumber），再映射到 FD：`xs/sm → small`，其余 → `normal`。

## 聚焦样式

输入控件聚焦时不额外绘制外圈 outline，沿用各变体已有的边框、底线或背景聚焦反馈；适用于 Input、Textarea、Date 和 Time 等消费者。

输入框、文本域和数字输入框的光标使用 `currentColor`，与当前输入文字颜色一致；错误态不单独覆盖光标颜色。

# FloatingPanel

### Intro
A panel floating at the bottom of the page, is often used to provide additional functionality or information, allowing users to freely drag up and down through content.

## Basic examples

### Basic Usage

The demo is confined to a 400px container using `popup-container=false` and a local fixed-position containing block, so it does not cover the documentation. Application panels still default to the window bottom. Custom anchors are 80, 180 and 320px; the header-only example lets content scroll without resizing the panel.

```demo
../example/demos/basic.vue
```

## Usage notes

### Configuration

Native `id`, `aria-*`, class, style and event listeners apply to the actual panel root. Internal transforms merge with business styles.

## API

### Value and default value

Use normal `v-model`. `modelValue` is the strictly controlled docked height in px. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once and later changes do not reset it. An explicit binding takes precedence; initialization does not emit `update:modelValue`. Dragging shows a temporary height. Ending notifies the candidate anchor; a refusing parent restores the effective bound anchor. `touchcancel`, deactivation, or model/anchor changes during dragging cancel without committing.

### FloatingPanel Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ---------------- |
| `v-model` | Current settled height in pixels; updated after dragging and snapping | _number_ | `-` |
| `default-value` | Initial uncontrolled height, read only at creation | _number_ | `100` |
| `anchors` | Finite nonnegative anchors in px. Invalid entries are filtered and duplicates removed; empty or entirely invalid arrays use defaults. Sorting is unnecessary; ties prefer the earlier supplied entry. | _number[]_ | `[100, window.innerHeight * 0.6]` |
| `content-draggable` | Whether to allow to drag panel content area | _boolean_ | `true` |
| `duration` | Finite nonnegative animation duration in ms. Numeric strings are supported; invalid values fall back to 300 and 0 disables transform animation. | _number \| string_ | `300` |
| `elevation` | Elevation level, options `true` `false` and level of `0-24` | _number \| boolean_ | `true` |
| `popup-container` | Mount target: defaults to body; false renders in place. Supports a selector or HTMLElement. | _PopupContainer_ | `body` |
| `safe-area` | Whether to adapt to the bottom, left and right safe areas | _boolean_ | `false` |

Omitting `popup-container` mounts to `body`; `false` renders inline. Missing or invalid selectors fall back to `body` with a development warning. Targets can change at runtime, and SSR does not query browser DOM.

### FloatingPanel Events

| Event | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `update:model-value` | Height after dragging and snapping; not emitted during initialization | `height: number` |
| `height-change` | Notifies a changed candidate anchor on drag end; parent acceptance is not guaranteed. | `height: number` |

### FloatingPanel Slots

| Slot | Description | Prop |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | Custom panel content | `-` |
| `header` | Custom panel header | `-` |

### Keyboard and types

The custom-anchor example uses native Collapse and Expand buttons in the header slot. Enter/Space adjusts the same v-model. The default drag handle supports touch only. The panel root does not automatically declare a dialog or button role; provide region names and interaction semantics for the content.

Heights and initial values must be finite and nonnegative; invalid values display the minimum effective anchor. Dynamic anchors rematch the nearest value without writing back. External changes do not emit user commit events. Events are notifications; Promises are not awaited and do not drive loading. `content-draggable=false` preserves native content scrolling.

```ts
import { FloatingPanel } from '@maple-design/ui/floating-panel'
import type { FloatingPanelProps, FloatingPanelInstance, PopupContainer } from '@maple-design/ui'
```

No custom public instance methods. Eight props, two events and two unscoped slots. PopupContainer accepts HTMLElement, selectors and false; the shared type is authoritative.

## Reading direction

Form and FormItem accept start/end/left/center/right for content-align and start/end/left/right for label-align. Content defaults to start and labels to end: default LTR placement stays the same while RTL follows reading order. Explicit left/right remain physical. Item overrides and explicit label-column styles retain precedence. Direction changes preserve values, validation and disabled/readonly state.

## Form appearance and layout

### Layout switching and item overrides

`edit-mode` describes editing behavior: `direct` always shows the control; `popup` opens the mobile editor. `readPretty` is an independent boolean. FormItem and fields inherit the mode when omitted. 

Combine `vertical`, `horizontal` and `inline` layouts with `direct / popup` editing and the independent `readPretty` boolean to compare label, control, value and wrapped-text alignment while retaining the same data. Notes can override the layout or inherit it. In `popup`, click a value to edit and confirm to save; `readPretty` uses `read-pretty` to display plain text.

`content-align` switches values between left, center and right in every field mode. FormItem inherits Form unless overridden. It positions compact controls and aligns field values; label alignment and help/error text stay independent. A field's explicit `text-align` overrides the inherited alignment.

When not paused, confirmation immediately compares the current source code. Change the source after a successful match, then validate only confirmation or submit again to observe the dependency error; correct confirmation and submit with Enter or the submit button. Native reset clears model values, feedback and the displayed last-submission value, while the submission count remains cumulative. Dependencies are revalidated explicitly: editing alone does not guarantee that an existing success is current. This local example is not exhaustive asynchronous submit-race coverage or external persistence.

```demo
../example/demos/en-US/cross-field.vue
```

Pause cross-field validation holds the confirmation rule until Resolve cross-field result. Completion compares that confirmation value with the current source, not a remote service or a source snapshot from submission start. Changing the source while waiting invalidates the native submission. The old field validation can still return a dependency error, but submission counts remain unchanged; correct confirmation and submit again. Native reset settles local tasks, clears values and the submitted snapshot, retains the history count and prevents late submission. Suspension/disposal also clean pending tasks. ### Maple rule protocol

FormRules maps field names to a FormRule or rule array. FormRule supports functions and Zod schemas rather than Cedar FieldRule objects; unsupported structures produce development prop diagnostics. Use FormItem.required for required validation and markers rather than a decorative-only rules.required object. Functions receive `(value, context)` with model and field; candidate saves validate a candidate model. Only true passes; other normal returns become error text through String. Promises are supported. Zod uses safeParseAsync and the first issue message.

Unexpected throws or Promise rejection reject public validate for try/catch handling. The current task releases validating and retains its previous business error, without a business-failure notification. Stale exceptions do not clear newer pending feedback. FormItem validate only notifies the latest normal boolean result. Form.useValidation, Form.useForm, Form.useFormItem and FormItem.useFormItem retain their composition roles.

```ts
import type { FormRule, FormRules, FormRuleContext } from '@maple-design/ui'
const nameRule: FormRule<string> = async (value, context) => {
  await Promise.resolve()
  return value.length > 0 || `${context.field} is required`
}
const rules: FormRules = { name: nameRule }
```

### Public validation and notification contract

Form and FormItem default slots have no scoped arguments. FormItem also provides label, help and extra slots without model helpers. Form manages state through the model object and field paths.

`validate(callback?)` and `validateField(fields, callback?)` await their rules, returning undefined on success or an error record by field on business failure. Callbacks only notify for a current task. Errors contain field, message, label, value, type and isRequiredError. The value remains the original field value.

submit-success precedes submit; business failure sends submit-failed before submit. An unfinished editing session sends only submit-failed. Its errors.editing contains only field="editing" and message, without fabricated field-validation data. FormSubmitError distinguishes this notice from a full ValidatedError.

These events notify only: listener Promises are not awaited and do not execute requests or control loading. Business code manages asynchronous-save loading. Native reset prevents default behavior, resets fields and then notifies reset. Form resetFields writes to model; an inner Form inside FilterForm has its own scope.

`beforeCommit` belongs to fields supporting editing transactions. Its signature is `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean>`. The payload contains value and previousValue; context contains signal and an optional event. Returning undefined waits for done; a boolean or Promise settles by its result. It is not a Form submit event or general loading entry point.

```ts
import type {
  FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance,
  ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData,
  FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError,
  BeforeFieldCommit,
} from '@maple-design/ui'
```
