### 多字段异步聚合

<!-- demo-config-notes:start -->

#### 本组配置对照

| 配置       | 作用                                                     | 相关示例                                                 |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`    | 表单数据对象，`FormItem` 通过 `field` 从中读取和写入数据 | 多字段异步聚合、禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序 |
| `disabled` | 是否禁用                                                 | 禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序                 |
| `readonly` | 是否只读                                                 | 禁用、只读与异步确认、异步校验的返回顺序                 |
| `rules`    | 按字段名配置的表单校验规则                               | 禁用、只读与异步确认                                     |

<!-- demo-config-notes:end -->

显式调用validate()或validateField()会使等待中的旧原生submit失效：命令校验有自己的结果，不应让旧submit在完成后把旧错误或成功与当前模型混发。此后新的原生submit仍正常等待自己的字段校验并通知一次。该规则仅逻辑失效、不取消真实请求，不清空历史提交计数。等待中修改模型或规则也会使本次提交失效，需重新提交校验。

“返回最新用户名结果 / 返回最新代码结果”优先结清对应字段最新任务，可让新submit先完成、旧结果最后返回。新成功后旧失败不追加提交或恢复错误；新失败后旧成功不追加提交或清除新错误。仍须等最新提交的两个字段都返回，单个字段返回不提交；默认“返回用户名/代码结果”继续返回最早任务。

原生submit采用最新提交生效：旧提交仍等待时再次提交，使旧提交的submit/submit-success/submit-failed续体失效。用guest/bad提交后改为admin/1234再提交；先返回旧两个结果，原生提交计数应仍0，新提交仍等自己的两个结果。反向旧成功/新失败同理，旧成功不能提前报通过。这个规则不取消真实请求；等待中修改模型或规则同样使旧提交失效。

原生submit等待中调用resetFields（含原生reset）会使该提交失效；旧Promise结清后不得再发submit、submit-success或submit-failed。停用/卸载同样使旧提交失效，后续新提交仍正常校验。此为逻辑失效，不是取消远端请求；并发submit和跨字段异步依赖不在这个重置协议内。

“原生异步提交”是表单内的原生submit按钮，也可聚焦后按Enter。独立“原生提交”计数须等两个本地异步字段都返回才增加：用户名失败先返回时暂不提交，代码返回后记录失败；修正为admin再提交，反序返回代码/用户名后记录成功并清错。下方“结果”仍只表示命令式校验，两个计数/结果互不冒充。完成后重置清空字段、保留历史提交计数。此顺序重试不代表并发submit或跨字段异步依赖已覆盖。

同一示例可连续点击两次“校验两个字段”：先输入旧值并发起，再改值发起新一轮。“返回用户名结果 / 返回代码结果”各返回该字段最早任务。旧整表先完成时，新一轮仍须等它自己的两个字段；旧成功或失败都不应覆盖最新字段反馈。结果文案由示例序号单独保护，不是 Form 自动取消旧请求，也不是原生提交并发协议。

两个字段分别返回独立本地 Promise。先返回任一字段可更新该字段反馈，但整表须等两个字段都完成。重置使旧反馈和示例结果失效，旧任务仍可手动返回以观察迟到结果。这里演示命令式 validate()，不是原生提交事件并发或跨字段依赖。

也可在用户名结果已返回、代码仍等待时重置，立即输入新值并再次校验。此时返回最早代码只会结清旧任务，不能恢复旧错误或提前完成新整表；必须返回新一轮自己的两个结果。分别用旧失败/新成功、旧成功/新失败核对字段反馈；结果文案仍由示例版本号单独保护，不等于取消真实请求。

### 异步校验的返回顺序

主动调用 `validateField` 后可继续修改字段并发起新校验。本例用真实 Promise 规则且不访问网络，关闭自动触发，只通过按钮发起。先校验 guest，再校验 admin，先返回最新结果再返回最早结果，观察旧错误不会覆盖最新字段状态。结果文案由示例请求序号保护，“本次校验值”是校验快照，不是服务端提交。

清空校验或重置后，仍可返回等待中的旧结果；卸载和停用会结清本地等待。真实接口应取消请求，并由业务保护提交快照和版本。

等待中可切换表单 disabled / readonly：它们限制控件交互，不自动取消已发起校验，也不清除已有错误。外部校验控制按钮不在被禁用的 Form 内。需要使旧结果失效时主动清空校验或重置；解除限制后可再次输入并校验。

关闭 Mount async field 会移除字段但保留业务模型和待返回任务。重新挂载后可发起新校验，再按新旧顺序返回结果，核对旧实例的错误不会污染新字段；这不是删除业务数据，也不是整表并发提交协议。

等待中可通过“写入服务端错误”调用 `setFields` 设置显式错误；之前的异步成功或失败不应覆盖它。示例仍保留旧任务供手动返回，结果文案单独做版本保护。清空校验可移除错误，重新发起校验后以新结果为准；不代表真实接口已取消。

“校验整表”调用 `validate()`，“校验字段”调用 `validateField('name')`。可交错发起并按不同顺序返回，分别观察字段反馈和示例最新结果；重置使旧结果失效，不等于取消真实服务。当前示例只有一个异步字段，不代表多字段聚合、跨字段依赖或原生 submit 事件并发均已覆盖。

## 使用说明

### 校验结果与异常

函数规则返回 true 表示通过，返回错误文字或 false 表示业务校验不通过。意外 throw 或 Promise 拒绝仍会使公开 `validate()` 拒绝，调用方需要处理该异常；当前任务会释放 validating，不合成新的业务错误，之前已有的业务错误消息继续保留。旧任务异常不会清理更新任务的等待状态。

## API

通过 edit-mode 设置编辑方式，通过 read-pretty 设置阅读状态。内部描述符名称 fieldEditModeProp 不是 Form 或 FormItem 的公开属性。

### 空值识别与阅读空文案

### Maple 规则协议

FormRules 是按字段名组织的 FormRule 或其数组。FormRule 支持函数或 Zod schema，不接受 Cedar FieldRule 规则对象；开发环境对不支持的规则结构给出属性诊断。必填校验和星号使用 FormItem.required，不使用只有装饰、没有实际校验的 rules.required 对象。函数接收 `(value, context)`，context 含当前 model 和 field；候选保存校验使用候选模型。正常返回 true 才表示通过，其他返回值按 String 转为错误文字；可返回 Promise。Zod 通过 safeParseAsync 运行，取首条 issue 的 message。

意外 throw 或 Promise 拒绝会让公开 validate 拒绝，调用方用 try/catch 处理；最新任务会释放 validating，保留之前的业务错误，不转成业务失败通知。旧任务异常不会清除新任务的等待状态。FormItem 的 validate 事件仅通知最新正常结算的布尔结果，不承担任务执行。Form.useValidation、Form.useForm、Form.useFormItem 和 FormItem.useFormItem 保持现有组合扩展职责。

```ts
import type { FormRule, FormRules, FormRuleContext } from '@maple-design/ui'
const nameRule: FormRule<string> = async (value, context) => {
  await Promise.resolve()
  return value.length > 0 || `${context.field} is required`
}
const rules: FormRules = { name: nameRule }
```

### 公开校验与通知合同

Form 与 FormItem 的默认插槽没有作用域参数；FormItem 还提供 label、help、extra 插槽，均不通过参数操作模型。Form 使用 model 对象及字段路径管理状态，不以插槽参数替代业务模型。

`validate(callback?)` 和 `validateField(fields, callback?)` 等待对应规则，成功返回 undefined，业务失败返回按字段聚合的错误对象；回调只通知当前有效任务。错误记录包含 field、message、label、value、type、isRequiredError。value 保留原字段值，不先转换成显示文字。

submit-success 先于 submit 通知，业务校验失败时 submit-failed 先于 submit。编辑会话未完成的阻止分支只通知 submit-failed，其 errors.editing 只有 field="editing" 与 message，不伪造字段校验信息；公开类型 FormSubmitError 区分该提示与完整 ValidatedError。

这些事件是通知，不等待监听器 Promise，也不自动执行请求或切换 loading。业务异步保存自行控制 loading。原生 reset 会阻止默认行为、执行 resetFields 后通知 reset；Form 的 resetFields 会写回 model，与 FilterForm 内部 Form 的职责不同。

`beforeCommit` 属于支持编辑事务的字段组件，签名为 `(payload, done, context) => void | boolean | Promise<void | boolean>`；payload 含 value、previousValue，context 含 signal 和可选 event。返回 undefined 表示等待 done；返回布尔或 Promise 按结果结算。它不是 Form 的 submit 事件或通用加载入口。

```ts
import type {
  FormProps, FormItemProps, FormInstance, FormItemInstance,
  ValidatedError, FormValidateErrors, FieldData,
  FormEmits, FormSlots, FormItemSlots, FormSubmitError,
  BeforeFieldCommit,
} from '@maple-design/ui'
```

### Selectively Enable For Different Devices

Considering the differences in `hover` effects on different platforms, the hover command can only be enabled on specific platforms.

## API

### Standalone icon styles and usage boundaries

Resolver auto-imports include the lightweight rotation styles for standalone icons. With `importStyle: false`, applications must import those styles. The UI Icon style entry also includes them; loading every icon is unnecessary.

When manually importing standalone SVG components, import this stylesheet once in your application entry when using `spin`:

```ts
import '@maple-design/icons-vue/style.css'
```

`rotate` and `spin` can be combined; built-in rotation respects reduced motion. `transition` controls registered-name changes only, using milliseconds as a number or numeric string, such as `200` / `"200"`; it does not parse `"200ms"` / `"1s"`. The default slot owns content and skips name-`transition` animation. Removing it immediately shows the latest name. Custom `animation-class` should avoid overriding the `transform` used for continuous rotation and should implement reduced-motion behavior.

`name` only resolves icons explicitly registered in the current application before rendering; it does not download resources. Registration after mount does not refresh an existing icon automatically. The container's native `title` is not forwarded to its SVG. Set `title` on standalone icons for image naming, and use an accessibly named Button for actions. `click` is a notification supporting Vue `.once`; listener Promises do not manage waiting. `stroke-*` affects strokes only; filled or fixed multicolor artwork may not respond.

# Image

Single and grouped previews default to body-mounted viewport overlays. Only explicit `:popup-container="false"` renders inline and requires a positioned, sized parent. Only the active image's load/error settles its loading indicator; returning to a cached image does not leave the spinner visible.

Closing the preview, changing the image or changing looping cancels pending movement. Deactivation or unmounting stops movement; reactivation uses the current image.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Previous/next preview navigation, horizontal keys and swipes follow reading direction without reversing the value array. Direction changes cancel unfinished gestures while preserving the current image, zoom and rotation. Images and zoomed drag coordinates are not mirrored automatically. Image indices retain LTR numeric display.

## Usage notes

### Image-preview group numbering

`modelValue/defaultValue` start at `1`. `open(imageNumber = 1)` and `to(imageNumber)` use the same numbering; invalid/noninteger values are ignored. `prev()/next()` retain this numbering at loop boundaries. Model events are `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`; navigation emits `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`, while external assignments do not. Long press emits `long-press(imageNumber)`; the indicator slot receives `{ imageNumber, length }`. Internal array indices remain zero-based.

Root `class` and `style` merge with the Image wrapper. Use `img-props.class/style` to `style` the inner image. Preview `open-change` is a Vue notification event: each state transition emits once, `.once` uses Vue event semantics, and returned Promises do not control loading. The typed `onOpenChange` listener uses this same event path.

## API

ImagePreviewGroup binds a one-based image number through ordinary `v-model`; `defaultValue` initializes the uncontrolled index. Panel opening uses `v-model:open` and `defaultOpen` independently. Programmatic preview options also use modelValue/`defaultValue` and onUpdate:modelValue.

When `images` is omitted or `undefined`, the group collects previewable child Images in DOM order; updating a child URL preserves its identity and position. An explicitly supplied array is the source, and `[]` means no images. Set it back to `undefined` to resume child collection. In array mode use the group `open` / `to` methods to select an image; child Images do not map themselves to array indices.

Public indices start at 1. The displayed index is clamped when data shrinks, and child reordering preserves the selected image identity. A controlled `modelValue` receives an update request when adjustment is needed; its owner can accept or reject it. No preview content is shown when the list is empty; the open state remains, so content may reappear when images return.

A previewable image exposes a named button action supporting Tab, Enter and Space. When preview closes, focus returns to its opener if focus is still in the preview or has fallen to the document body. The action is absent when preview is disabled or the image has failed. Explicit `alt=""` stays empty; a previewable decorative image still has a separately named preview action. When `alt` is omitted, `imgProps.alt`, `description`, then `loadDescription` supply the fallback.

When keyboard shortcuts are enabled, only the topmost preview handles arrow keys and Space. Inputs, editable regions and other interactive controls retain their own key behavior.

`Image.showPreview()` requests the current image preview. The `imagePreview`, `previewImage`, and `ImagePreviewFn` service accepts a URL, URL array, or options and returns `ImagePreviewHandle | undefined` (for example during SSR). Its handle offers the 12 Group operations; paging operations have no effect for a single image. The service also exposes `close()`, `setDefaultOptions()`, and `resetDefaultOptions()`. Native `lazy` is browser-scheduled and does not promise automatic retries.

Scale parameters must be finite and positive; invalid min/max/default/step values fall back to 0.5/8/1/0.5. If max is below min it resolves to min. Initial and reset scales are clamped, changes to bounds clamp the current value, and `zoomTo` ignores nonfinite input. `close` in `actionsLayout` is a toolbar action, independent of the separate button controlled by `closable`.

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。预览集合的上一张/下一张、水平键与滑动沿阅读方向工作，值数组不反转。方向切换取消尚未完成的手势并保持当前图片、缩放与旋转；图片本身和放大后的拖拽坐标不自动镜像。图片序号保持 LTR 数值显示。

## 使用说明

### 图片预览组序号

`modelValue/defaultValue` 从 **1** 开始，`1` 表示第 1 张。`open(imageNumber = 1)`、`to(imageNumber)` 接收相同序号，无效或非整数序号会被忽略。`prev()/next()` 在循环边界也回传同一规则的序号。模型事件为 `update:modelValue(imageNumber)`，切换通知为 `change(imageNumber, previousImageNumber)`；外部赋值不补发切换通知。长按通知为 `long-press(imageNumber)`，指示器插槽参数为 `{ imageNumber, length }`。内部数组下标仍从 0 开始。

根节点 `class`、`style` 与 Image 容器样式合并；内部图片样式通过 `img-props.class/style` 设置。预览的 `open-change` 是 Vue 通知事件：每次状态切换只发送一次，`.once` 遵循 Vue 事件语义，返回 Promise 不控制 loading。类型中的 `onOpenChange` 监听器也走同一事件入口。

## API

图片预览组使用 `v-model` 绑定从 1 开始的图片序号，`defaultValue` 提供非受控初始图片序号；面板开关独立使用 `v-model:open` 与 `defaultOpen`。函数式预览配置同步使用 modelValue/defaultValue 和 onUpdate:modelValue。

## Reading direction

The default index list sits at inline end. Letter/item order and vertical scroll coordinates do not reverse. Safe areas and sticky top offsets retain their physical meaning.

No index is initially active until scrolling or `scrollTo` selects one. Navigation uses native buttons supporting Tab, Enter and Space. Provide readable, noninteractive content in `anchor-name`.

Identifiers use strict equality: numeric `0` differs from string `"0"`. An omitted index is excluded; an empty string is valid. Use unique identifiers; with duplicates, programmatic navigation uses the first match. `duration` is read as milliseconds from a number or numeric string; nonpositive or nonfinite values scroll immediately. `sticky-offset-top` uses the existing length conversion and refers to the physical top. A new scroll command replaces the previous one; deactivation and unmount cancel pending scrolling.

# InfiniteScroll

Bottom checks use coalesced RAF (zero-delay timeout fallback), not CSS motion duration. Rebinding/deactivation/disposal invalidates old tasks and detached observers; consumed callbacks cannot replay or clear newer handles. Retained inactive/disposed check/retry remain inert; activation uses fresh binding/checks. Business request cancellation belongs to the caller. Controlled lifecycle audit:10/10 per copy, not native browser/OS or cross-document proof.

Demo scroll containers use the current theme background to keep list text readable in dark mode.

A behavioral infinite loader. It handles bottom detection and pagination status only; compose it with `List`, `Cell`, or custom content.

## Usage notes

```html
<script setup lang="ts">
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from '@maple-design/ui'

  const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>('idle')
  const items = ref([])

  async function loadMore() {
    try {
      const next = await fetchNextPage()
      items.value.push(...next.items)
      status.value = next.hasMore ? 'idle' : 'finished'
    } catch {
      status.value = 'error'
    }
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-infinite-scroll v-model:status="status" @load="loadMore" @retry="loadMore">
    <mp-list :data="items">
      <template #item="{ item }">
        <mp-list-item>{{ item.name }}</mp-list-item>
      </template>
    </mp-list>
  </mp-infinite-scroll>
</template>
```

At the bottom threshold, the component synchronously emits `update:status('loading')`, then `load` and locks immediately. After requests, parents must set `idle`/`error`/`finished`. `retry()` emits `retry` only, not `load`.

## Error slot

Use a button for custom retry, supporting Enter/Space. Simulated requests clean timers on unmount/deactivation to avoid later writes.

Basic/custom-status/retry examples all clean simulated requests. KeepAlive reactivation can load again from idle without reusing canceled timers.

The default error area retries on click. Custom error areas can use the same `retry` method:

```html
<template #error="{ retry }">
  <mp-button html-type="button" @click="retry">Reload</mp-button>
</template>
```

## Scroll containers and thresholds

Without `target`, the nearest scrolling ancestor is resolved automatically. CSS selectors/`HTMLElement` are accepted. Numeric `bottomOffset` uses px; strings use full CSS lengths including `rem`/`em`/`vh`/`vw`/`calc(...)`.

## Composing PullRefresh

Use `disabled` to pause pagination while refreshing. Then replace data, reset `status`, re-enable and check:

```ts
async function refresh() {
  infiniteDisabled.value = true
  const firstPage = await fetchFirstPage()
  items.value = firstPage.items
  status.value = firstPage.hasMore ? 'idle' : 'finished'
  infiniteDisabled.value = false
  await nextTick()
  infiniteScrollRef.value?.check()
}
```

Hidden tabs do not load; reactivation checks automatically. Business activation callbacks may also call `check()`.

When `target` is a selector, its element must exist when binding occurs. `check()` uses the current binding and does not resolve the selector again; pass the element or change `target` to rebind. Accept the emitted `loading` via `v-model:status`, then set `idle`, `error`, or `finished` when the request settles; assigning the original `idle` alone does not release the request lock. A negative numeric offset requires scrolling past the bottom. String offsets are resolved as CSS widths: negative lengths fall back to zero, and percentages use the measurement element’s CSS containing-block width.

## 使用说明

```html
<script setup lang="ts">
  import { ref } from 'vue'
  import type { InfiniteScrollStatus } from '@maple-design/ui'

  const status = ref<InfiniteScrollStatus>('idle')
  const items = ref([])

  async function loadMore() {
    try {
      const next = await fetchNextPage()
      items.value.push(...next.items)
      status.value = next.hasMore ? 'idle' : 'finished'
    } catch {
      status.value = 'error'
    }
  }
</script>

<template>
  <mp-infinite-scroll v-model:status="status" @load="loadMore" @retry="loadMore">
    <mp-list :data="items">
      <template #item="{ item }">
        <mp-list-item>{{ item.name }}</mp-list-item>
      </template>
    </mp-list>
  </mp-infinite-scroll>
</template>
```

组件触底时先同步发出 `update:status('loading')`，再发出 `load`，并立即加锁。父组件完成请求后必须把状态设为 `idle`、`error` 或 `finished`。`retry()` 只发出 `retry`，不会额外发出 `load`。

## 错误插槽

自定义重试操作请使用按钮，支持键盘 Enter/Space。示例中的模拟请求会在卸载或停用时清理计时器，避免离开页面后继续回写。

基础、自定义状态和错误重试示例均清理模拟请求；KeepAlive 恢复后可从 idle 状态重新加载，不复用取消前的计时器。

默认错误区可点击重试。自定义错误区可使用同一个 `retry` 方法：

```html
<template #error="{ retry }">
  <mp-button html-type="button" @click="retry">重新加载</mp-button>
</template>
```

## 滚动容器与阈值

未提供 `target` 时自动查找最近的滚动父级；也可传 CSS 选择器或 `HTMLElement`。数字 `bottomOffset` 按 px，字符串按完整 CSS length 换算，支持 `rem`、`em`、`vh`、`vw` 与 `calc(...)`。

## 与 PullRefresh 组合

刷新期间使用 `disabled` 暂停分页。刷新完成后替换数据、重置 `status`，再启用并检查：

```ts
async function refresh() {
  infiniteDisabled.value = true
  const firstPage = await fetchFirstPage()
  items.value = firstPage.items
  status.value = firstPage.hasMore ? 'idle' : 'finished'
  infiniteDisabled.value = false
  await nextTick()
  infiniteScrollRef.value?.check()
}
```

隐藏的 Tab 不会触发加载，重新激活后会自动检查；也可在业务激活回调中调用 `check()`。

`target` 为选择器时，目标必须在绑定时已存在；`check()` 只检查当前绑定，不重新解析选择器。目标稍后出现时，请改传元素或变更 `target` 触发重新绑定。使用 `v-model:status` 接收组件发出的 `loading`，请求结束后再设为 `idle`、`error` 或 `finished`；仅重复赋值原来的 `idle` 不会解除请求锁。数字负阈值表示越过底部后才触发；字符串作为 CSS 宽度解析，负长度无效并回退 0，百分比按测量元素的 CSS 包含块宽度计算。

### InfiniteScroll Props

| 参数             | 说明                  | 类型                                           | 默认值   |
| ---------------- | --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `v-model:status` | 分页状态              | `'idle' \| 'loading' \| 'error' \| 'finished'` | `'idle'` |
| `bottom-offset`  | 触底阈值              | `string \| number`                             | `0`      |
| `immediate`      | 挂载后是否立即检查    | `boolean`                                      | `true`   |
| `disabled`       | 是否暂停加载和重试    | `boolean`                                      | `false`  |
| `target`         | 滚动容器或 CSS 选择器 | `string \| HTMLElement`                        | `-`      |

### InfiniteScroll Events

| 事件名          | 说明             | 参数       |
| --------------- | ---------------- | ---------- |
| `update:status` | 请求更新分页状态 | `(status)` |
| `load`          | 触底请求下一页   | `-`        |
| `retry`         | 从错误状态重试   | `-`        |

### InfiniteScroll Slots

| 名称       | 说明     | 参数        |
| ---------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `default`  | 内容     | `-`         |
| `loading`  | 加载状态 | `-`         |
| `error`    | 错误状态 | `{ retry }` |
| `finished` | 完成状态 | `-`         |

### InfiniteScroll Methods

| 方法      | 说明                 |
| --------- | -------------------- |
| `check()` | 主动检查是否到达阈值 |
| `retry()` | 在错误状态发起重试   |

# 输入框 ## 阅读方向 输入框继承页面或局部容器的 `dir`；前后缀、清除操作和输入框组按阅读顺序排列。运行时切换方向保留原生输入节点、焦点和选区；光标、选区、混合文字与输入法组合由浏览器处理，不交换左右编辑键。父级重绘时保留正在组合的原生文本；旧选区恢复任务不会覆盖新的组合缓冲。 ## 基础示例 ### 基础用法 ```demo ../example/demos/basic.vue ``` ### 表单控件尺寸对照 切换五档 size 和三种字段变体，比较 Input、Button、Select、日期时间及其他单行表单控件的高度。Button 在这里固定使用 outline。DatePicker/TimePicker 是面板，此处使用带输入框的 Date/Time 字段。示例同时展示有值、可清空、标签删除与长标签多选；Select/Cascader 设置 tag-nowrap 时保持同档高度，长标签文字省略、删除图标保留；标签行可横向滚动，清空按钮和箭头固定在外侧。被省略的标签正文支持悬停、键盘聚焦或点按查看完整文字，点外部或按 Esc 关闭，不改变选中值。可清空后恢复选中值重复比较。多行文本和允许换行的多选内容按内容撑高。 ```demo ../../field-decorator/example/demos/control-sizes.vue ``` ### 介绍 用于输入单行文本。组件支持多种外观、浮动提示、输入类型、状态以及前后缀内容。 默认长度按 UTF-16 码元计算（emoji 通常占 2）；默认截断不会拆开有效的代理对，边界不足时舍去整个字符。若需按用户感知字符（字素簇）计数和裁剪，请配套提供 `word-length` 与 `word-slice`；自定义裁剪结果由业务负责。 ## 外观与状态 ### 外观配置对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------ | | `placeholder` | 占位符，也可作为浮动提示文字 | 表单反馈、提示文字 | | `hint` | 是否将 placeholder 用作浮动提示文字 | 表单反馈、提示文字 | | `clearable` | 是否可清除；有值且可编辑时清除图标常驻显示 | 表单反馈 | | `variant` | `filled`、`outline` 或 `standard` | 提示文字 | 选择一个对比维度后，同屏展示它的全部可选值；其余配置和内容保持一致。可切换其他配置检查组合效果；输入类预览共享一个值。

# InputNumber Long-press stepping stops on release, cancellation, deactivation or unmounting. Starting a new hold replaces the previous one. Reactivation requires a new gesture instead of resuming an old hold. CSS motion variables do not control the repeat cadence. InputNumber edits and commits numeric values. - A defined model-value is controlled; default-value only initializes uncontrolled state. Drafts may differ while editing. A rejected proposal restores the parent value after commit. External updates never emit user events or trigger validation. - By default, Enter or blur commits. With model-event="input", complete numeric edits update immediately; change still represents a commit. Enter followed by blur does not commit twice. - Approved clearing notifies **clear → input → update:modelValue → change**. Clear is an action notification and is not emitted after a veto. A target equal to the current model does not invent change. The default clear value is undefined; explicit empty-value may provide null or another supported numeric value. - Intermediate signs and decimal points are preserved while editing. A trailing decimal point commits as a number; a lone sign/dot restores the previous value. Invalid text and non-finite numbers are never published. IME input is processed once after composition. - Range limits win over precision. Both copies use isolated Decimal configuration; the public model remains a JavaScript number, not arbitrary-precision storage. - disabled/readonly/size inherit from InputGroup and Form. Explicit false overrides inheritance. variant/hint inherit InputGroup. An outer FormItem label suppresses a duplicate floating label. Cedar also reads ConfigProvider for fallback size; Maple uses its existing defaults. - Mouse/touch long press stops on release, cancel, leave, window blur, deactivation, disposal or state changes. Button mode offers larger touch targets. Arrow keys step; Enter commits. Native inputs always use `autocomplete="off"`; native attribute bags cannot enable autofill. ## Reading direction The numeric input inherits its source `dir`; step buttons follow reading order. Values, precision and vertical keys retain their meaning: ArrowUp increases and ArrowDown decreases. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. `--mp-field-caret-color` defaults to `currentColor` and sets shared caret color. `--mp-input-number-caret-color` overrides this component, default `var(--mp-field-caret-color)`. Explicit beforeCommit waiting uses the existing loadingMode indicator and sets aria-busy on the actual input. Manual loading remains business-owned and does not imply readonly; beforeCommit guards retain their existing interaction lock. Notification return Promises, including change/step, do not control waiting. Deferred `change` preserves the real confirmation event when available (for example, the save button). Programmatic editor handoff has no DOM event, so its second argument is optional. The event target can be the confirmation control rather than the input. `change` is a notification: its returned Promise is not awaited; use `before-commit` to approve asynchronous saves. Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls. ## API ### Empty values and reading placeholders `empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. ### Virtual navigation

The demo uses `Space direction="column"` to place controls above a full-width list. `estimatedSize` estimates unmeasured rows; application rows do not need a fixed height.

Navigation uses rendered row bounds when available and updates virtual padding after measurement. Programmatic scroll events preserve the current alignment while rendering rows; a different native scroll position, a new command, data replacement, deactivation or disposal cancels its deferred correction. `auto` leaves a fully visible row and the rendered window unchanged. This does not promise continuous tracking of arbitrary asynchronous row resizing.

`scrollIntoView` forwards options to the internal VirtualList `scrollTo` only in virtual mode; it is not a direct native DOM scrollIntoView or a local motion timer. Native scrolling, preferences and retained-command lifecycle require a separate VirtualList consumer audit. Source hints are not visual acceptance; this classification changes no List API/implementation.

## API

The virtual list covers the viewport first and renders `buffer` items beyond it on each side. `buffer=0` is valid. `estimatedSize` must be finite and positive, including values below 1; invalid values fall back to 30px. `fixedSize` can change dynamically. Variable-height mode uses measured and estimated heights; rows are measured on mount and unmount, not continuously after asynchronous size changes. The `item` slot receives the original index and unknown data; return a single measurable root and provide a stable `itemKey`. To convey the complete collection to assistive technology, provide `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` on application rows as appropriate.

### List Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | Data consumed by item slot | unknown[] | undefined |
| size | Implemented sizes only; xs/xl are not supported | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | md |
| bordered | Outer border | boolean | true |
| split | Item/header/footer separators, independent of border | boolean | true |
| loading | Initial loading/refresh feedback, not pagination state | boolean | false |
| max-height | Maximum ordinary viewport height; number in px or CSS length, zero means unlimited | number \| string | 0 |
| virtual-list-props | Data virtualization; ignored when default slot exists | ListVirtualListProps | undefined |
| scrollbar | Ordinary viewport custom scrollbar; false uses native scrolling | boolean \| ListScrollbarProps | true |

Virtual lists use a dedicated viewport without nesting a custom scrollbar. virtualListProps.height overrides maxHeight; with neither, height defaults to 200px. Numeric and unit-bearing CSS lengths are accepted. Invalid/nonpositive max-height does not constrain height.

ListVirtualListProps supports height, threshold, fixedSize, estimatedSize, buffer, itemKey and component. List.data supplies data. Counts at or below threshold render all items. Variable heights use measurements and estimatedSize; buffer controls overscan rows.

ListScrollbarProps supports type: 'track'|'embed', outerClass, outerStyle, hide, disableHorizontal and disableVertical. JavaScript object fields use camelCase.

### List Events / Methods

- scroll(event: Event): one notification per real scroll event.
- scrollIntoView({ index?, key?, align }): virtual-list positioning. index overrides key; align is top/bottom/auto. auto does nothing for a fully visible item, otherwise scrolls the minimum distance required. Invalid targets or nonvirtual mode do nothing.

### List Slots

List slots: default (overrides data), item({ item, index }), header, footer, empty. Empty state appears only without a default slot/data and while not loading. ListItem prefix/default/suffix retain list-item semantics without managing buttons/business interactions.

## Types

ListProps、ListSize、ListVirtualListProps、ListScrollbarProps、ListExpose、ListSlots、ListEmits、ListInstance、ListItemInstance。

List handles display and an optional virtual viewport. Compose InfiniteScroll status/target behavior for pagination rather than duplicating its loading state machine inside List.

# 列表 List

`scrollIntoView` 仅在虚拟模式可用，参数与内部 VirtualList 的 `scrollTo` 一致，不等同于原生 DOM 的 `scrollIntoView`。

纯展示型列表。分页加载请组合使用 `InfiniteScroll`。

```html
<mp-list :data="items" size="md" bordered>
  <template #header>联系人</template>
  <template #item="{ item, index }">
    <mp-list-item>
      <template #prefix>{{ index + 1 }}</template>
      {{ item.name }}
      <template #suffix>{{ item.phone }}</template>
    </mp-list-item>
  </template>
  <template #empty>暂无联系人</template>
  <template #footer>共 {{ items.length }} 项</template>
</mp-list>
```

也可以直接传入默认插槽。默认插槽与 `data` 同时存在时，默认插槽优先，`item` 不会被调用。

```html
<mp-list :data="items">
  <mp-list-item>默认插槽内容</mp-list-item>
  <template #item="{ item }">{{ item }}</template>
</mp-list>
```

`loading` 表示整张列表首次加载或刷新，不表示下一页正在加载。空列表加载时不会同时显示空态。

## Content and presentation

### Loading Directive

The two directive examples keep independent loading states. Their controls and host cards are stacked using Space's `direction="column"`; turning one off leaves the other overlay unchanged.


`v-mp-loading` accepts a boolean shorthand or a `{ loading, tip, type, size, radius, color, hideIcon, fullscreen, background }` options object. In object form, `loading` controls the loading state and the remaining component options match `Loading` props.

#### Registration

`v-mp-loading` renders its indicator with Maple's built-in `Loading` component. The `mp-` prefix avoids collisions with directives from other component libraries. Register it using any one of these approaches.


With `MapleResolver()`, `unplugin-vue-components` resolves `v-mp-loading` automatically. Set `directives: false` to disable directive resolution.

> Wrapper mode applies `opacity: 0.38` to its default-slot content. Because the directive preserves the host DOM, it inserts the built-in Loading VNode and uses an equivalent translucent background overlay instead.

```demo
../example/demos/directive.vue
```

## Usage notes

### Icons and status messages

A numeric `size` sets the custom indicator container's font `size` in pixels. Named sizes control built-in animations. Custom icons inherit the `--mp-loading-indicator-size` font `size` (20px by default): `1em` children scale with it, while SVGs with fixed pixel dimensions keep their own `size`. Use the `icon` slot for graphics and `tip` or its slot for status text.

Standalone Loading has `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`. Without a tip it includes localized visually hidden status text, even when the icon is hidden. Wrapper mode retains `aria-busy`. The directive sets `aria-busy="true"` on the original host and restores its previous value on cleanup, preserving a later external change.

Assistive technology may defer announcements within a busy region. For business start, completion or failure messages, maintain a persistent status region outside the busy region and update its text. The overlay does not disable keyboard interaction. See [WAI-ARIA `aria-busy`](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-1.2/#`aria-busy`) and [ARIA22 status messages](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22).
### Configuration

The loading-directive mask prevents default click behavior and propagation. Clicking it does not activate Card or ordinary parent click handlers. Normal clicking resumes after loading. It does not disable keyboard access to underlying controls; set those controls’ `disabled` props to block all interaction.

### Overlay styles

Each directive update replaces the complete configuration; omitted options and boolean `true` use defaults. Changing `fullscreen` while loading moves the overlay between the host and its owner document body. Host children stay in place. Multiple `fullscreen` instances share a counted scroll lock: closing a local instance does not unlock `fullscreen` instances, and the final `fullscreen` instance preserves an existing external lock class.

# LoadingBar

CSS motion variables control progress-bar and fade transitions. Completion and cleanup wait for the visual transition; CSS styling does not control progress-update timing.

The service uses --mp-loading-bar-transition-duration (250ms) and --mp-loading-bar-transition-timing-function (ease) for width/opacity/background-color. Apply tokens to its real html/body ancestor, not a business card. Reduce disables transitions, not progress/cleanup. After DOM flush, hiding waits max(300ms, resolved width duration+delay); unmounting waits max(250ms, resolved opacity duration+delay). The 200ms show/tick and cleanup floors are scheduling policies, not CSS tokens; later arbitrary CSS changes/custom animation are not promised.

Repeated finish is deduplicated; start/error cancel obsolete tasks. Completion unmounts the service and the next load remounts. setDefaultOptions replaces the full configuration and resetDefaultOptions clears owned settings. SSR calls create no DOM/timers.

Use `auto-fit-popup-width` and `popup-max-height` for width matching and height limits. ## Basic examples ### Overflow Actions Pass the trigger element through the default slot and describe commands with `options`. `type: 'divider'` renders a separator. ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## Appearance and states ### Disabled State `disabled` on the menu disables the whole popup; on an option it disables that option and its descendants. ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## Options and hierarchy ### Groups, submenus and option content #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | Command tree | Groups, submenus and option content, Selection and visual emphasis | | `hide-on-select` | Close the popup after activating a command | Selection and visual emphasis | | `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Selection and visual emphasis | Compare flat groups, nested menus and option content. Expand or select options to inspect their hierarchy.
Configuration details and limits #### Option Group Group commands with `{ type: 'group', children }` inside `options`; no extra group component is needed. A group is purely visual and does not add a level. #### Submenu A plain option with `children` becomes a submenu. Every level shares `submenu-trigger`, which expands on tap by default; switching it to `'hover'` applies to all levels too. It cannot be set per option, so a single tree never mixes two expansion styles. #### Custom Option Content Prefer passing `icon`, `extra` or a VNode directly on the option; all three also accept a render function receiving `{ option, active, level }`. To render a whole data set uniformly, use the `option-label`, `option-icon` and `option-extra` scoped slots. `active` means this exact option matches the active value. A active descendant does not select its parent. Descendant selection and submenu opening remain private styling state. MenuOption uses `highlight` for visual emphasis without changing selection.
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### Selection and visual emphasis `active` is false on a parent whose child is active. The three examples compare render functions, scoped slots and manual MenuOption content; `highlight` only emphasizes a row. ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ### Option values Give each command a stable, unique `value` when adding, removing or reordering options. Numeric `0`, string `'0'` and boolean `false` are different values. ## Triggers and positioning ### Context Menu #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | Root menu trigger | Context Menu, Trigger | | `options` | Command tree | Context Menu, Positioning strategy | | `align-point` | Align to the pointer position at activation; stays in place until the next context menu activation | Context Menu | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement | | `strategy` | Positioning strategy inherited by every submenu | Positioning strategy | | `submenu-trigger` | How every submenu level expands | Positioning strategy | Right click inside the target area. Set both `trigger="contextMenu"` and `align-point`. The menu stays at the activation point as the pointer moves; another right click updates its position. ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### With SplitButton [SplitButton](#/en-US/split-button) already wraps a button together with a dropdown command menu and describes extra actions through `MenuOption`. ### Trigger ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### Placement Use `placement` to choose the preferred popup position relative to the trigger. See Menu Props for the available values. Automatic fitting can change the final position when space is limited. ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### Positioning strategy Both root and nested menus use the same reactive `strategy` (`absolute` by default or `fixed`). Changing it does not change selection or close the menu. `popup-container` independently controls mounting; `fixed` does not automatically escape transformed ancestors. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/positioning.vue ``` ### Popup Max Height ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ### Switching triggers Clicking another hover-open sibling trigger closes the previous menu. Clicking inside a submenu keeps its parent open. ## State and content customization ### Selected Value and Select Event Use `v-model` to keep the active value. Activating a command emits `update:model-value` first and then `select(value, option, event)`; `select` means a menu item was activated, not that a form value changed. ```demo ../example/demos/selection.vue ``` ### Controlled Open State ```demo ../example/demos/controlled.vue ``` ### Footer ```demo ../example/demos/footer.vue ``` ## Reading direction Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Submenus expand in reading order; enter/return horizontal keys follow the current direction, while Up/Down and boundary navigation preserve order and skip disabled options. Menus mounted externally inherit the source direction. Direction changes do not change selection. ## Keyboard interaction Enter, Space or an arrow key opens the menu from its trigger. Up/Down and Home/End move between enabled options; Enter or Space activates an option. The forward key enters a submenu and the backward key returns, following the reading direction. Escape requests closing the topmost menu; focus returns to its trigger after closing. Tab requests close and continues browser focus navigation. Editable inputs retain their text-editing keys. ## API ### Value and default value Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected option value; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once, and later changes do not reset it. # Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 [Select](#/zh-CN/select)；选择层级数据请使用 [Cascader](#/zh-CN/cascader)。 弹出层基于无视觉样式的 [Trigger](#/zh-CN/trigger) 实现，使用统一十二方位和 `cover` 覆盖模式，默认 `bottom`。同宽、高度限制分别使用 `auto-fit-popup-width`、`popup-max-height`。 ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。`type: 'divider'` 渲染分隔线。 ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 `disabled` 加在菜单上禁用整个浮层，加在选项上只禁用该项及其后代。 ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。分组只负责视觉分隔，不增加子项层级。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，移动端默认点击展开；改成 `'hover'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ### 选项值 动态增删或调整选项顺序时，为每个命令设置稳定且唯一的 `value`。数字 `0`、字符串 `'0'` 和布尔值 `false` 是不同的选项值。 ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### 与 SplitButton 组合 [SplitButton](#/zh-CN/split-button) 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作。 ### 触发方式 ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### 弹出方向 使用 `placement` 设置菜单相对触发元素的首选方位，可选值见 Menu Props。空间不足时允许自动调整，最终位置可能与首选方位不同。 ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ```demo ../example/demos/positioning.vue ``` ### 高度限制 ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ### 切换触发元素 点击另一个由悬停打开的同级触发元素时，会关闭原菜单；点击子菜单内部不会关闭父菜单。 ## 状态与内容定制 ### 选中值与 select 事件 可使用 `v-model` 管理当前激活值。激活命令时先触发 `update:model-value`，再触发 `select(value, option, event)`；`select` 表示激活菜单项，不表示表单值变化。 ```demo ../example/demos/selection.vue ``` ### 受控打开状态 ```demo ../example/demos/controlled.vue ``` ### 页脚 ```demo ../example/demos/footer.vue ``` ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。子级沿阅读方向展开；进入子级与返回父级的左右键跟随当前方向，上下键与首尾定位保持顺序并跳过禁用项。挂载到外部容器的菜单继承来源方向，切换方向不改变选中值。 ## 键盘操作 在触发元素上按 Enter、Space 或方向键进入菜单。菜单内使用上下键、Home/End 在可用选项间移动，Enter 或 Space 激活选项。前进方向键进入子菜单，后退方向键返回，方向随阅读方向变化。Escape 请求关闭最上层菜单，关闭后焦点返回触发元素。Tab 请求关闭并继续浏览器焦点导航；可编辑输入保留文本编辑按键。 ## ## Behavior

- `duration` is milliseconds; `0` stays open. `Message.loading(...)` stays open by default.
- Within one mount container/position, the same `id` updates the instance without duplicate DOM.
- Only `resetOnUpdate`=`true` restarts the full duration on same-id updates.
- `pauseOnHover` saves remaining time and resumes it on pointer leave.
- Display deadlines are independent of CSS motion. Restarting, hover pause, cleanup/unmount invalidate old timer callbacks, which recheck open before running.
- KeepAlive deactivation cancels timers; reactivation restarts the current full duration. Updates while deactivated/retained restart after unmount do not schedule work.
- Resuming exhausted positive hover timing requests closing; resetting duration to 0 keeps it open. Only finite positive durations auto-close; negative/nonfinite values do not schedule.
- Services await actual leave completion rather than forcing 150ms/200ms exits. Closing/clearing before mount cleans up directly and reports service onClosed without inventing component open/opened/close animation events. Business duration stays independent of CSS transitions.
- Local reduced motion cancels transitions/displacement while retaining independent-message static horizontal/center positioning, colors and display deadlines. No global tiny-duration fallback is required.
- Queues isolate by `popupContainer + position`; `Message.clear(position?)` clears per position.

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Content, icons and close-button spacing follow reading order. Direction changes do not alter message type, timers or closing. Programmatic calls use explicit configuration or document direction.

## Usage notes

### Component attribute forwarding

`Message.Component` forwards `id`, `class`, `style`, `aria-*` and native event listeners to its actual `role="alert"` region: the Cedar message root or the Maple inner visible panel. Each attribute is applied once. Required internal roles and classes remain; component lifecycle listeners such as `open` are not bound as DOM listeners. Native attributes update with the parent in both inline and Teleport modes. `dir` continues to determine reading direction. A function service `id` identifies the message for updates and is separate from a component native DOM `id`.
### Configuration

Exceptions from close/closed notification callbacks do not retain closed entries or empty manager hosts. Resource cleanup is independent of callback execution.

### Message Methods

| Method | Description |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| `Message(options \| string)` | Open a default message |
| `Message.info/success/warning/error/loading(...)` | Open a message with the corresponding status |

Returns `{ close() }`; repeated calls do not repeat closing. A handle owns a specific message item: it remains valid for same-id updates of that item, but cannot close a new item after the old item completed leaving and its id was reused.

The optional second appContext argument applies to each message: injections, registered components, global properties and error handling use that application context. It does not capture a local Provider at the call site. Applications still share one queue and chronological stack per target/position; Message.clear continues clearing across applications. Each call uses its explicit context, then the current install default. An update with no available context retains the existing item scope. Switching a same-id item to another available context remounts its presentation and restarts its duration while keeping its business handle valid; other items keep their presentation and timers.

`Message.Component` retains its real Props and instance types. Its `restartTimer()` instance method resets only while active, open and resetOnUpdate=true. It is not a service-handle method; while hover-paused, it resets only the saved remaining duration.

| Component instance method | Description |
| ---- | ---- |
| restartTimer() | Reset the current duration, subject to active, open, resetOnUpdate and hover-pause state |

`MessageContent` is `VNodeChild | (() => VNodeChild)`: text, numbers, empty boolean children, VNodes, nested child arrays and synchronous render functions. Arbitrary plain objects and asynchronous tasks are not renderable content. content, icon and action share this protocol; local slots take precedence.

duration must be finite and nonnegative. Negative values, NaN and Infinity do not schedule automatic closure and trigger development prop validation. Zero stays open; restartTimer follows the same rules.

`default`、`icon`、`action`。

## CSS Variables

Visual variant is independent of status. neutral uses a neutral popup and status icon; tonal uses a low-emphasis status background with dark content; solid uses a high-emphasis fill and matching foreground. Cedar/Maple both default to neutral; explicit solid/tonal have matching visual semantics. default/loading solid retains a dark background, with the loading icon indicating progress. Both export MessageVariant; function calls, setDefaultOptions and same-id updates support variant.

Custom backgrounds require checking all three foregrounds. Geometry retains platform density. Variables must affect actual Teleport-container ancestors.

## 行为说明

- `duration` 单位为毫秒，`0` 表示常驻；`Message.loading(...)` 默认常驻。
- 同一挂载容器和位置内，相同 `id` 更新原实例，不创建重复 DOM。
- 仅当 `resetOnUpdate` 为 `true` 时，相同 id 更新会重新计算完整显示时长。
- `pauseOnHover` 保存剩余时间，鼠标离开后从剩余时间继续。
- 展示期限独立于 CSS 动效；重启、hover 暂停、清理或卸载使旧计时回调失效，执行时再次检查 open。
- KeepAlive 停用取消计时，激活从当前配置完整 duration 重启；停用更新和卸载后保留的 restart 不调度。
- hover 正时长已耗尽时恢复会请求关闭；显式重置为0仍常驻。仅有限正 duration 自动关闭，负数和非有限值不调度。
- 服务等待真实离场完成，不再强制150ms或200ms退出。未挂载就 close/clear 直接清理并报告服务 onClosed，不伪造组件 open/opened/close 动画事件；业务 duration 独立于 CSS 过渡。
- 局部减少动效取消进出过渡和动画位移，保留独立提示的水平/居中静态定位、颜色及业务展示期限；不依赖全局极短时长。
- 队列按 `popupContainer + position` 隔离；`Message.clear(position?)` 可按位置清理。

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。内容、图标与关闭按钮间距随阅读方向排列；方向切换不改变消息类型、计时或关闭语义。函数式调用遵循显式配置或文档方向。

### Cross-platform contract

When using the content slot, the custom panel takes its accessible name from the entry. Set aria-label or aria-labelledby on the entry when needed. Ensure custom entries have a meaningful name.

Both libraries create panel content on first open and retain it when closed or switched, including local drafts and expanded branches. With `unmount-on-close`, content is destroyed after the closing transition and recreated on the next open; the Item's own selected value remains intact. Applications own draft submission, resets and filter application.

Root `close()` requests closing Item panels and restores entry focus without changing selected values, active-item or desktop tree expanded-keys. Controlled open values remain authoritative when closure is rejected. Entries with neither options nor a content slot never open; asynchronous options follow the current open state when they arrive. KeepAlive suspension hides panels and requests closure; controlled state remains authoritative on activation.

Item values, open state, events, slot contexts and `select/close/setOpen` methods share the same contract. Both roots expose `close/resize/setActiveItem`. Names must be unique within the menu; changing a name releases the previous one. Batched swaps and insertions validate the final rendered names. Vertical options expand enabled ancestors of the selected value on initialization and value/options updates. Users can still collapse branches manually.

| Capability | Cedar | Maple |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Root menu | options tree or Item entries; vertical by default | Item filter bar only; horizontal by default |
| popup-layout | dropdown (default) / full-width / full-height / full | full-width (default) / full |
| Panel origin | Individual entry bottom | Entire filter bar bottom; standalone Item uses its own bottom |
| Trigger and placement | trigger / placement | Click to open downward |
| Backdrop and scrolling | Non-modal; background scroll remains available | Root overlay / overlay-closable / lock-scroll / esc-to-close / z-index |
| Theme | theme override | Global theme; no theme prop |
| Tree-only methods | showOption / scrollTo / setCollapsed | — |

Each library exports `NavMenuPopupLayout` with its supported values. Maple's `NavMenuMode` is horizontal only; `options-mode` supports both orientations. The default entry slot replaces the entry's inner content. Maple renders it inside a native button: use non-interactive text/icons and place forms and action buttons in the content slot.

### 两端对应关系

### Pause scrolling

Use `paused` with an action button to let readers pause and resume. When the system requests reduced motion, content wraps without animation.

`speed` is measured in CSS pixels per second. The cycle is recalculated when the container, text, or slot content changes size; animation progress is retained, so the visible position may shift. ## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Icons, text and close actions follow reading order. Scrolling text moves from inline end toward start, reversing motion in RTL without mirroring text or changing close/replay event meanings.

Icon and close spacing use `--mp-notice-bar-icon-margin` and `--mp-notice-bar-close-margin`; RTL uses `--mp-notice-bar-icon-margin-rtl` and `--mp-notice-bar-close-margin-rtl`. The close control uses the nearest LocaleProvider, falling back to the global language.

String `speed` and `delay` values are parsed by their numeric prefix. Nonfinite speeds and speeds below 1 use 1 px/s; invalid or nonfinite delays use 0 seconds, while negative delays retain CSS animation semantics. Closing hides the component without unmounting it; remount it from the parent to show it again. Internal instance state and handlers are not public reopen or pause methods; use `paused` to pause.

### Intro

## Basic examples

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Header and actions inherit reading direction. The numeric keypad retains LTR digit order; RTL does not reverse digits or entered values. Safe areas still use physical device edges.

Keys are native buttons supporting Tab, Enter and Space. The icon-only delete button has a localized name. The visible `title` names the dialog by default; component `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` can provide an explicit dialog name.

Input and visibility use local passive state and emit updates; parents should accept and synchronize them, since refusing an update alone does not guarantee that the panel remains open. `hide-on-click-outside` controls backdrop closing, not arbitrary outside mouse clicks.

`max-length` uses JavaScript UTF-16 length. Finite values are floored and clamped to zero; `Infinity` or the exact string `"Infinity"` is unlimited. Extra keys may contain multiple characters: an addition that exceeds the limit is rejected in full and emits no `input`. Delete removes one UTF-16 code unit. There are no public business methods or slots; ordinary event promises do not control input or visibility.

## API

`open/defaultOpen` control current/initial uncontrolled panel visibility. Use `v-model:open` for two-way binding. defaultOpen is read once without initialization writeback.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is input text; `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets. Explicit binding wins; initialization emits no `update:modelValue`.

The keyboard panel uses an independent `open/defaultOpen` model with `update:open`. Text and panel opening are separate states.

`max-length` 按 JavaScript UTF-16 长度计算；有限值向下取整并且至少为 0，`Infinity` 或字符串 `"Infinity"` 表示不限。额外键可包含多个字符；整个追加结果超限则拒绝，既不截断也不发 `input`。删除每次移除一个 UTF-16 单元。数字键盘没有公开业务方法或插槽；普通事件返回的 Promise 不决定开合或输入。

## API

`open/defaultOpen` 分别控制面板状态与非受控初始开合；使用 `v-model:open` 双向绑定。defaultOpen 只在创建时读取，不在初始化时回写。

### 主值与默认值

使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示输入文字；`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控值，后续修改不会重置当前状态。显式绑定值优先，初始化不发出 `update:modelValue`。

键盘面板独立使用 `open/defaultOpen` 与 `update:open`；输入值和面板开关互不替代。

## Triggers and positioning

### Popup placement

No placement configuration is required for normal use: bottom-start is preferred and the underlying Trigger automatically flips/constrains the popup. pageSizeProps.placement is only a restricted override for the page-size Select: Pagination → Select.triggerProps.placement → Trigger. It does not position the pagination itself.

## API

Use ordinary `v-model`: `modelValue` is the current page, starting at 1; pageSize independently controls items per page. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets or initialization `update:modelValue`. When `modelValue` is supplied, the parent value controls the display.

<!-- same-source-api:start -->

### Pagination Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| total | Total item count; required | `number` | `—` |
| model-value | Current page; v-model | `number` | `—` |
| default-value | Initial uncontrolled page | `number` | `1` |
| page-size | Page size; v-model:page-size | `number` | `—` |
| default-page-size | Initial uncontrolled page size | `number` | `10` |
| disabled | Disable all interactions | `boolean` | `false` |
| hide-on-single-page | Hide with at most one page | `boolean` | `false` |
| simple | Explicit simple mode | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-total | Show total | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-more | Append forward jump in full mode | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-jumper | Show separate jumper in full mode; simple mode includes input | `boolean` | `false` |
| show-page-size | Show page size selector | `boolean` | `false` |
| page-size-options | Positive integer size options | `number[]` | `[10, 20, 30, 40, 50]` |
| page-size-props | Optional restricted configuration for the page-size Select. Placement defaults to bottom-start and reaches Trigger through Select.triggerProps for automatic positioning; cannot override pagination values, options or size | `PaginationPageSizeProps` | `—` |
| size | Size of all controls | `'xs' / 'sm' / 'md' / 'lg' / 'xl'` | `'md'` |
| page-item-style | Base numeric page style | `CSSProperties` | `—` |
| active-page-item-style | Additional active numeric page style | `CSSProperties` | `—` |
| base-size | Base threshold for ellipsis in full mode | `number` | `6` |
| buffer-size | Pages on either side of current page | `number` | `2` |
| elevation | Page button shadow; true uses level 2 | `boolean / number` | `false` |
| responsive | Automatically use simple mode by container width | `boolean` | `true` |
| compact-breakpoint | Maximum container width for compact mode, in px | `number` | `480` |
| auto-adjust | Preserve first record on size change; clamp after total shrinks | `boolean` | `true` |

Totals, page numbers and page sizes use JavaScript safe integers. Finite positive values above the safe range are capped at the maximum safe integer and produce a development warning. To bound rendered page controls, base-size is capped at 201 and buffer-size at 100; out-of-range values produce a development warning.

Responsive switches between full and simple layouts preserve the page-jump draft without submitting it. Focus is preserved when both layouts display a jump input. Press Enter or leave the input to submit.

After a keyboard quick jump, if the ellipsis button disappears and the target page is accepted, focus moves to the current page button. Rejected controlled updates or focus moved elsewhere do not steal focus.

auto-adjust requests an adjustment only when total or page-size changes after creation; it does not clamp the initial default-value or controlled model-value to the page count. A controlled parent may reject the request.

| page-size-change | Committed size change; paired with update:page-size | `number` |

## Behavior

Containers at or below `compact-breakpoint` automatically use compact mode, consistently in desktop sidebars and mobile. Totals/page-size selectors remain; auxiliary controls wrap. Previous/next sizes follow size without forced narrow-screen enlargement (formerly 36px). `responsive=false` retains full page numbers; extremely narrow page lists scroll internally without widening the page.

The compact current-page input also serves as the jumper, so no duplicate jumper appears. `page-item`, `page-item-ellipsis`, `jumper-prepend` and `jumper-append` render only in their full-mode controls.

Page buttons support Tab/Enter/Space, with `aria-current=page` on the current page. The jumper requests a numeric keyboard and submits on Enter/blur. Empty, nonnumeric or fractional values do not navigate; out-of-range integers clamp to valid pages. Disabled blocks all commits.

`auto-adjust` tries to preserve the previous page's first item when page size changes, clamps to the last page after total reductions and returns to page 1 for zero items. Controlled mode proposes updates only; the parent decides the display. An explicit parent modelValue in the same update batch takes precedence.

Both full and compact jumper inputs show the current page. Navigation, external modelValue changes and page-size adjustments update them together. Invalid input restores the current page number.

### PaginationPageSizeProps

Page-size selectors fit selected text/arrow with only item spacing, updating on option/locale changes. `--mp-pagination-select-width` overrides width. Popup menus size independently from option contents.

Both platforms support `disabled?: boolean`, `placement?: 'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end'`, `popupContainer?: string | HTMLElement | false`, `class?: string` and `style?: CSSProperties`. Outer disabled takes precedence. Default placement is bottom-start.

Use the documented page-size selector options. page-size, page-size-options and size control the pagination value, options and dimensions.

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。页码与上一页/下一页含义保持不变，默认前后图形跟随阅读方向。输入页码、禁用边界和选择不因方向切换而改变；自定义图形插槽由业务决定方向。

## 触发与定位

### 弹层定位

普通使用无需配置方位：默认 bottom-start，空间不足时底层 Trigger 自动翻转和约束。pageSizeProps.placement 仅是条数 Select 的受限覆盖入口，链路为 Pagination → Select.triggerProps.placement → Trigger；不是分页器自身位置。

## 行为说明

容器宽度不超过 `compact-breakpoint` 时自动使用简洁模式；桌面侧栏与移动端规则相同。保留总数和条数选择器，辅助控件换行，上一页、下一页按钮跟随 size，不再在窄屏强制放大（默认 36px）。设置 `responsive=false` 保留完整页码，极窄时仅页码列表横向滚动，不撑宽页面。

简洁模式的当前页输入框承担跳转功能，不重复展示独立 jumper。`page-item`、`page-item-ellipsis`、`jumper-prepend`、`jumper-append` 仅在完整模式的对应控件中渲染。

页码按钮支持 Tab、Enter、Space，当前页使用 `aria-current=page`。跳转框使用数字键盘提示，Enter 或失焦提交；空值、非数字、小数不跳转，整数越界限制到有效页码。禁用状态阻止所有提交。

`auto-adjust` 在条数改变时尽量保留原页面首条数据的位置，总数减少时限制到最后一页，零条数据时页码回到 1。受控模式只发出更新请求，显示由父组件决定；父组件同一批更新明确设置 modelValue 时优先遵循该值。

完整模式和简洁模式的“前往”输入框均显示当前页码。点击翻页、外部更新 modelValue 或切换每页条数触发页码调整时同步回显；非法输入恢复为当前页码。

### PaginationPageSizeProps

每页条数选择器按已选文字与下拉箭头自适应宽度，两者之间仅保留条目间距，切换选项或语言时自动更新。可通过 `--mp-pagination-select-width` 自定义宽度。弹出菜单仍按选项内容独立计算宽度。

两端支持相同配置：`disabled?: boolean`、`placement?: 'top' | 'top-start' | 'top-end' | 'bottom' | 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end'`、`popupContainer?: string | HTMLElement | false`、`class?: string`、`style?: CSSProperties`。外层 disabled 优先。默认 placement 为 bottom-start。

此配置不再透传任意 SelectProps/MenuProps。分页值、选项和尺寸分别使用 page-size、page-size-options、size。

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |

| bordered | Show a border independently of elevation | boolean | false |

Numbers and numeric strings for radius/width/height use px. Other strings pass through as CSS lengths, such as 1rem, 50% and calc(100% - 8px). Classes, native attributes and styles fall through to the root.

elevation=false adds no elevation class, true uses level 2, and numeric values are rounded to the nearest integer then clamped to 0–24. NaN/Infinity produce Vue prop validation warnings in development and fall back to 2 at runtime. Numeric radius/width/height values must be finite and nonnegative; invalid numbers remove that inline dimension instead of retaining its previous value, while zero remains valid. Decimal and scientific-notation numeric strings use px. Other CSS strings are parsed by the browser; expressions unsupported by the browser are not promised.

click only notifies with the original MouseEvent, including bubbling clicks from children. @click.once follows standard Vue event semantics without awaiting listener Promises. Unaccepted updates do not immediately roll back. Later external value changes synchronize again. Both confirm and cancel carry current candidates; cancel does not restore initial values. The component only notifies, while its owner controls closing. Changing optionHeight or optionCount recenters candidates and stops old scrolling transitions. columnsCount immediately updates visible columns, preserving retained nodes, focus and candidates. Layout changes send no additional model/change notifications and do not roll unaccepted candidates back to old external values. Removed column nodes are outside the focus-retention guarantee. Picker(options) is an explicit asynchronous selection service. It copies configuration and owns mutable open/dynamic state and singleton lifecycle without writing to caller options, including frozen objects. Explicit popupContainer values are respected; the default is body. open, defaultOpen and dynamic are not service Options; component Props still support embedded and popup modes. The service returns PickerResolvedData with state confirm, cancel or close. confirm/cancel include values, indexes and options; close contains only state. Notification callbacks are not awaited. confirm/cancel settle and request closing before notification; a throwing closed callback cannot skip host cleanup. Picker.close() closes only the current service singleton. The title, cancel and confirm toolbar slots have no scoped arguments. Custom buttons may call instance confirm()/cancel(). Only these two methods form the public instance contract; other setup render bindings are not business extension points. Picker.Component and _PickerComponent are actual SFCs; default Picker is the callable service and installation entry point. ```ts import { Picker, type PickerOptions, type PickerColumnOption, type PickerResolvedState, type PickerResolvedData, type PickerProps, type PickerInstance, type PickerEmits, type PickerSlots, type PickerSelection } from '@maple-design/ui' ``` ## Types ### PickerColumnOption | Prop | Description | Type | Default | | --------------- | -------------- | ---------------------- | ------- | | `text` | Text | _string \| number_ | `-` | | `value` | Value | _string \| number_ | `-` | | `disabled` | Whether disabled | _boolean_ | `false` | | `children` | Children list | _PickerColumnOption[]_ | `-` | | `className` | Class name | _string_ | `-` | | `textClassName` | Text Class Name | _string_ | `-` | ## CSS Variables The following CSS variables support customization with [StyleProvider](#/en-US/style-provider).

## Usage notes

### Focus management

Built-in fade, center scaling, four-direction pop and base content/scrim transitions consume duration/timing-function tokens, retaining 250ms/ease defaults. Whole-layer overrides belong on the actual post-Teleport common ancestor or popup-container host. style affects content only; overlay-style affects scrim only. Use valid nonnegative CSS times. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce overrides built-in transitions/initial displacement/scaling. Business code adapts custom animations.

With unmount-on-close=true, content remains during closing and unmounts after completion; close locks are not released early. Rapid reopening cancels closing and retains slot state. opened/closed fire once per valid phase, never after destruction. No fixed 250ms JS timer is used. Initial opening retains mounted notification without promising complete appear timing. Business code must coordinate custom transitions or differing inner/outer durations.

Opening focuses the actual dialog panel. Tab/Shift+Tab cycle through available controls, skipping hidden/disabled elements. The topmost nested popup owns focus handling; closing restores its opener. Applications must retain trigger nodes and must not override internal focus-root markers.

### Landscape safe areas

`safe-area-inset-left` / `safe-area-inset-right` (boolean, default false) complement the existing top/bottom flags. Native overrides and nested consumption follow [SafeArea](#/en-US/safe-area).

### Closing by pulling the header

Enable `swipe-to-close` for bottom popups and mark draggable header areas with `data-popup-swipe-handle`. It is off by default and inactive at other placements. `swipe-threshold` defaults to 40 layout CSS px, including under parent scaling. Closing requests `update:open(false)` and emits `swipe-close(PointerEvent)` only if final movement is downward and reaches the threshold. Small/horizontal/canceled gestures, buttons/inputs and body scrolling do not close. Rejected controlled requests retain the popup and restore its position. Existing Esc/scrim/close controls remain.

The vertical threshold accounts for vertical scaling independently of horizontal scaling; gesture conversion under rotation or skew is not specified.

```html
<mp-popup v-model:open="open" placement="bottom" swipe-to-close>
  <header data-popup-swipe-handle>Edit information</header>
  <main>Popup content</main>
</mp-popup>
```

Maple field editors allow dragging blank header areas to cancel drafts by default; pending asynchronous confirmation disables gestures. ActionSheet can explicitly set swipe-to-close/swipe-threshold; default titles are marked, while custom title slots must mark their own drag area.
# Asynchronous close interception


Reasons: `overlay`, `escape`, `route`, `swipe`, `close`, `api`, `model`. The default slot provides `{ close, pending }`; `close` buttons should call `close('close', event)`. Instance `close()` uses `api`; `requestClose(reason, event)` specifies a reason and returns `Promise<boolean>`. External `open`=`false` uses `model`; rejection emits `update:open(true)`, which controlled parents should accept. Only enabled `close` entries request closing.

Adding, replacing, or removing `before-close` does not change the current `open` state; in controlled mode the parent continues to update `open`.

Direct destruction, removing `v-if` or destroying a route page is not a close request and cannot await internal guards. Await `requestClose()` before those parent actions. Keep business confirmation in `beforeCommit`; a close guard does not replace validation. The theme page's complete form demonstrates delayed allowance/rejection/errors and all close entries.

Popup close()/requestClose() and external open=false are guarded. Dialog on both ends and Cedar Drawer instance/service close() are direct commands with a different responsibility. Await `Promise<boolean>` when Popup confirmation is required; do not infer behavior from matching method names.

## Close guards



Synchronous logging-only hooks must explicitly return true; synchronous undefined means awaiting a callback. Earlier `Promise<void>` hooks without done now allow closing when their Promise resolves.

Popup reasons: overlay, escape, route, swipe, close, api, model. Rejecting external open=false requests update:open(true). Direct destruction cannot await hooks; await requestClose() first.


Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

### Async operation feedback

Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection or failure restores interaction; repeated input does not start the same operation again. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate in loading.

Content background/text form a raised-surface color pair, with dark themes inheriting the same semantics. `unstyled` disables default background/text colors together. style sets content variables, overlay-style scrim variables, or place system variables on an actual common ancestor. Teleport does not inherit from the original call site. Dialog uses independent scrim variables unaffected by Popup variables.

内置 fade、center 缩放与四方向 pop 和内容／遮罩基础过渡消费 duration／timing-function 两项 Token，默认仍为 250ms／ease。要整层统一覆写，设置在 Teleport 后实际共同祖先或 popup-container 宿主；style 仅覆盖内容，overlay-style 仅覆盖遮罩。使用有效、非负 CSS 时间。prefers-reduced-motion: reduce 优先关闭内置过渡及起始位移／缩放；自定义动画由业务适配。

unmount-on-close=true 时关闭途中保留内容，完成回调后卸载；关闭前锁不会提前释放。快速重开取消关闭并保留插槽状态。opened／closed 每个有效阶段只发一次，销毁后不再补发；没有固定 250ms JS 定时器。初始打开仍沿用 mounted 通知，不承诺完整 appear 计时；自定义转场或内容与外层时长不同需要业务自行协调。

打开时焦点进入实际 dialog 面板，Tab/Shift+Tab 在可用控件间循环，跳过隐藏和禁用项。嵌套弹层由最上层接管；关闭后回到打开它的控件。应用必须保留触发器节点；内部焦点根标记不应由业务覆盖。

### 横屏安全区

通过 `safe-area-inset-left`、`safe-area-inset-right` 为左右两侧增加安全区留白，默认均为 `false`。宿主边距与嵌套容器的用法见 [SafeArea](#/zh-CN/safe-area)。

### 从头部下拉关闭

底部弹层设置 `swipe-to-close`，在可拖动标题区域添加 `data-popup-swipe-handle`。默认关闭；其他 placement 不触发。`swipe-threshold` 默认 40，单位为布局 CSS px（父级缩放时也保持一致）。手势结束前最后的移动方向为向下，且位移达到阈值才请求 `update:open(false)` 并发出 `swipe-close(PointerEvent)`。位移不足、横向手势、pointercancel、按钮/输入框和正文滚动不会关闭；受控父级拒绝时弹层保留并回到原位。已有 Esc、遮罩、关闭按钮继续可用。

阈值按垂直方向的缩放换算，支持水平和垂直比例不同的缩放；不承诺旋转或倾斜变换的手势换算。

```html
<mp-popup v-model:open="open" placement="bottom" swipe-to-close>
  <header data-popup-swipe-handle>编辑信息</header>
  <main>弹层内容</main>
</mp-popup>
```

Maple 字段编辑弹层默认从标题空白处下拉取消草稿；异步确认 pending 时禁用手势。ActionSheet 可以显式设置 swipe-to-close / swipe-threshold，默认标题已标记；自定义 title 插槽需自行标记拖动区域。
# 异步关闭拦截


关闭原因包括 `overlay`、`escape`、`route`、`swipe`、`close`、`api`、`model`。默认插槽提供 `{ close, pending }`，关闭按钮应调用 `close('close', event)`；实例 `close()` 使用 `api`，`requestClose(reason, event)` 可指定原因并返回 `Promise<boolean>`。外部将 `open` 设为 `false` 使用 `model`，拒绝后会发送 `update:open(true)`，受控父组件应正常接收该事件。只有启用对应关闭能力的入口会发起请求。

动态添加、更换或移除 `before-close` 不会改变当前开关状态；受控模式仍由父组件更新 `open`。

直接销毁组件、移除 `v-if` 或销毁路由页面不属于关闭请求，无法等待组件内的异步拦截；在父级执行这些操作前等待 `requestClose()` 的结果。业务表单确认继续使用 `beforeCommit`，不要用关闭 guard 替代数据校验。主题页完整表单提供延迟允许、拒绝、报错与各关闭入口的验证弹层。

Popup 的 close()/requestClose() 和外部 open=false 会经过守卫；两端 Dialog 与 Cedar Drawer 的实例或服务 close() 是直接关闭命令，职责不同。Popup 关闭前需要确认时等待 `Promise<boolean>`，不要依赖同名方法推断行为。

## 关闭守卫



只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。

Popup 原因为 overlay、escape、route、swipe、close、api、model。拒绝外部 open=false 时请求 update:open(true)。直接销毁组件不能等待内部钩子，应先 await requestClose()。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

### 异步操作反馈

before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

## CSS Variables

遮罩变量只压暗背景层；内容背景／文字组成 raised 表面的配色对，暗色主题继承同一语义。`unstyled` 同时关闭默认背景和文字颜色。可通过 style 在内容节点设置内容变量，通过 overlay-style 设置遮罩变量；或在实际共同祖先设置 system 变量。Teleport 不会从原调用位置继承变量。Dialog 使用独立的遮罩变量，不受 Popup 组件变量影响。

## Async options

### Asynchronous options

Enable Manual responses to start real local promises instead of the default timer. Load twice and resolve newest/oldest in either order: only the current request version may replace options or end loading. Removing options invalidates the outstanding version but preserves the selected business value; old tasks remain available to resolve manually. Applied/Ignored/Pending expose this behavior. Loading and responses do not count as user changes. Versioning and pending cleanup belong to this Demo's business loader, not an automatic Radio network-race guarantee; no external service is called.

Loading/removing options or updating the external value never emits reverse updates. Selected values absent from the current options are retained. Selecting the current value again does not emit change. false, zero and empty string retain their identity.

This demo simulates loading with an 800ms local delay. Set Device A or clear the selection while waiting: arriving options reflect the latest model without increasing the user-change count. Removing options while loading cancels the pending task so stale options do not reappear.

Arrow keys can still select existing options while loading. Reloading the same option values preserves focus. Keep the loading-status node stable to avoid remounting the group when the message changes; activating the current value again does not emit another change.


## Native input attributes and keyboard cancellation

Native `id`, `form`, `required`, constraints, aria/data attributes and keyboard listeners belong to the actual input. Class/`style` and other shell attributes remain on the label. Generated native IDs are stable and unique, and an external label can target an explicit `id`. HTML `required` participates in native browser `form` validation, separately from Form business rules.

Once / Capture / Passive native listener modifiers stay on the input rather than firing from interactive slot children. Native preventDefault can veto Enter / Space activation and RadioGroup arrow navigation; canceled Space leaves no delayed release action. Checked, disabled, input type and group Tab navigation remain component-managed.

input-attrs remains a native alias and takes precedence over overlapping top-level native attrs, while managed state remains authoritative. Radio tabindex stays component-managed, and groups keep their single Tab entry.
