### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

The `options` prop accepts an array or `(query, { signal }) => array/Promise`. The component manages loading, cancellation and stale-result isolation; failures emit load-error. Single/multiple groups initialize with an empty-string query, searchable fields reload when the query changes, and root loading for tree fields remains independent of existing load-more child loading.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

## API

### Parameters, presentation clearing and mount-time boundaries

orientation accepts horizontal / vertical and falls back to horizontal after invalid-value diagnostics. max belongs to CheckboxGroup: valid values are finite nonnegative integers, zero forbids new choices, and omission is unlimited. Existing external values are never truncated. Invalid JavaScript callers retain the existing normalization after diagnostics: negatives become zero, fractions are floored, NaN is unlimited, and Infinity remains unlimited.

icon-size accepts positive lengths. Numbers and numeric strings use px, including positive fractions such as 0.5. Invalid, nonpositive or nonfinite values diagnose and fall back to the theme; the Divider minimum of 1 does not apply. Business styles determine the final resolved value of CSS expressions.

uninject-group-context decides group participation at mount. Changing it later does not reinject; change the key or remount. An isolated control still participates in Form. clearable / empty-value apply only to explicit presentation-layer clearing; native unchecking still proposes false or removes the array value and never uses empty-value. Ordinary event Promises do not participate in waiting; before-commit uses payload / done / context only when saving a deferred edit.

During an explicit options request both group roots announce aria-busy and emit one load-error on failure. No loading prop or extra graphic is added, and loading/failure never proposes a new model.

Ordinary circular Radio icons do not scale with Group.size. The five sizes apply to button presentation; circular dimensions use icon-size or the theme. The radio slot replaces the complete visible circular content while retaining the native input. Button presentation uses the default label and ignores the radio slot.

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

`ChoiceValue = string | number | boolean`；`CheckboxModel = boolean | ChoiceValue[] | null`；`RadioModel = ChoiceValue | null`。

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

### Rate Methods

focus() focuses the rating; blur() removes focus. Readonly remains focusable, while disabled leaves the Tab sequence. Arrow keys adjust, Home clears and End selects the maximum. Keyboard events from interactive children and Alt/Ctrl/Meta combinations are not intercepted. Touch and mouse share half-selection/clearing rules.

## Configuring the cleared value

`empty-value` defines the output of an existing clear action. Omission preserves the component fallback; supported types remain component-specific. It does not change empty-values recognition or Form reset defaults.

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Public focus/blur methods are callable from initial mount. Focus opens an editable deferred editor and targets it after readiness; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open. Blur only blurs the current target without reopening. Stored methods never bind an old editor; closure, mode changes, deactivation, or unmount cancel queued calls.

Handled scoring keys clear pointer preview and emit hover-change(0) once if a preview was active. If a controlled parent refuses an update, the display follows the external value. Later pointer motion can preview again; unhandled keys preserve the preview.

character.active means fully selected: at 1.5, the second symbol has active=false and its wrapper carries the half-selection class. read receives { value, text }, retaining null/undefined with shared formatted text. Custom read takes precedence over empty-text without changing an empty model to zero. Neither slot executes business tasks.

before-commit uses ({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal }). Return a boolean or Promise, or call done. A synchronous undefined return waits for done; aborted signals prevent stale results from committing. Ordinary change only notifies and does not await return values.

## CSS Variables

Cedar defaults to gold stars and compact spacing. Maple defaults to the theme primary color and larger touch spacing. CSS variables with the same suffix serve the same purpose on both platforms, while defaults may differ.

`transition-duration` controls hover/color transitions, `scale-duration` controls selection animation, and `transition-timing-function` controls easing. Reduced motion disables these animations. `size` and `gap` props override the corresponding tokens for a single instance.

## 使用说明

### 编辑与确认

通过 `edit-mode` 配置编辑方式；未指定时依次继承 FormItem、Form，默认 `direct`。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。

`before-commit({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal })` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

`empty-values` 用于空值识别，`empty-value` 保留原清空输出；`empty-text` 仅在 `read-pretty` 空内容下展示，默认 `'-'`，字段 > FormItem > Form，自定义 read 插槽优先。显式配置 empty-values 后，内置 required 接入该策略，自定义校验仍收到原值。详见[统一说明](#/zh-CN/emptyValues)。

## 配置清空后的值

`empty-value` 指定当前组件已有清空动作的输出；省略时采用该组件默认返回。具体类型以组件 API 为准。它不改变 empty-values 的识别规则，也不改变 Form reset 的初始值。

`empty-value` 可显式设为 `null`（或 `() => null`），清空时原样提交 null；省略时保留组件原默认值。界面把 null 显示为空，不会把普通输入的空字符串自动转成 null。支持弹出编辑的字段中，清空先修改草稿，确认后提交，取消则保留原值。

公共 focus/blur 从首次挂载即可调用。focus 会打开可编辑的延迟编辑器，等待其就绪后定位；禁用、只读或纯阅读时不因此打开。blur 只失焦当前目标，不重新打开。保存的方法不会绑定旧编辑器，关闭、切换模式、停用或卸载会取消排队调用。

已处理的评分键盘操作会清除鼠标悬浮预览；存在预览时发送一次 hover-change(0)。受控父级拒绝评分更新时，显示仍以外部值为准。再次移动鼠标可以继续预览，未处理的按键不清除预览。

character 的 active 仅表示整颗已选：例如 1.5 分时第二颗 active 为 false，其外层带半选类，负责半分视觉；read 收到 { value, text }，保留 null/undefined，text 是共享格式化文本。自定义 read 优先于 empty-text，不把空值替换成数值 0。character 和 read 不承担业务任务执行。

before-commit 使用 ({ value, previousValue }, done, { signal }) 协议；可返回布尔或 Promise，也可调用 done 完成。同步返回 undefined 会等待 done；signal 取消后旧结果不再提交。普通 change 只通知，不等待返回值。

### Styles

MapleResolver directive resolution automatically imports `@maple-design/ui/ripple/style`. When registering Ripple without the resolver, explicitly import that style in the application entry. Runtime code does not import CSS, so the package can be imported on the server. Unmounting or disabling cancels pending animations; keyboard state belongs to each instance.

## Usage notes

### Motion

Repeated release does not duplicate work. Disabling/unmounting cleans owned timers/direct child ripples without removing nested instances. Document listeners bind to the mount-time ownerDocument; rebinding after cross-document movement is out of scope. Enter/Space activate on this host and end only on matching keyup/blur. Plain divs must provide their own interactive semantics, keyboard behavior and accessible names; v-ripple supplies none.

### Motion

expand-duration controls transform expansion; cubic-bezier controls its easing. fade-duration controls linear opacity appearance/disappearance. Put variables on the actual directive host so generated ripples inherit them. color overrides ripple-color. Both platforms default to 200ms/140ms.

250ms is the minimum display/post-fade cleanup wait, not visual duration or the complete lifecycle. Runtime reads computed ripple duration/delay. Fade starts no earlier than the later of creation+250ms or activation+expansion duration; deletion waits max(250ms, fade duration). 600ms/800ms overrides are not truncated. 0ms/unstyled cases retain cleanup floors. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce hides decorative ripples without changing host events. Expansion is sampled at creation/activation; fade at fade start. Arbitrary midphase CSS changes/custom animations are not guaranteed.

The binding type `RippleDirectiveValue` is exported from the package root and Ripple entry, with optional `color` and `disabled` fields. Color changes affect subsequently created waves. `disabled` controls decoration only; it does not disable the host. Global `Context.enableRipple` prevents new waves while existing waves finish normally. During animation the directive temporarily sets clipping and, when needed, positioning and stacking styles. When the final wave ends, or on disable or unmount, it restores styles it still owns and preserves values changed by application code. Coordinates account for axis-aligned scaling; rotation and skew are not guaranteed.

This complete fixture currently uses Chinese labels. ```demo ../example/demos/app-form.vue ``` ### Component integration Choose an edge-aligned component, adjust bottom, left and right insets independently and open it. Expand the measurements when you need exact values. Simulation stays local to this example. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/affected-components.vue ``` ### Asymmetric safe areas on Duo Duo outer and inner displays in both orientations, plus left and right Split View windows, update the viewport and simulated insets together. Expanded / collapsed toolbar controls select small / large viewport heights. Left / right avoidance swaps asymmetric insets on the current viewport; zero only clears the insets. WebKit Safari 27.1 CSS viewport sizes (width × small/large height): outer portrait 382 × 580/618, outer landscape 594 × 368/406, inner portrait 669 × 867/902, inner landscape 951 × 585/620, each split window 385 × 571/609. These are not physical display dimensions. Insets are independent stress-test values, not measured insets for those viewports; do not compensate again for a side rail Safari already excludes. Read each edge independently. The host must update the remaining insets relative to the WebView content viewport after folding, unfolding, rotation, Split View or safe-area changes; pass `0` for edges already handled by the host. Safari and native apps may expose different usable viewports. Keep browser `env()` defaults unless the host supplies accurate remaining insets. Do not copy native side-rail widths into a webpage. A fold inside the screen requires separate segmented layout and cannot be represented by four edge insets. References: [WebKit web adaptation](https://webkit.org/blog/18486/webkit-features-for-safari-27-1/) and [Apple safe-area guidance](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111461/). ## Application usage ### 1. Enable browser support Configure the viewport in application HTML: ```html ``` Wrap regions needing safe-area spacing. Browser `env(safe-area-inset-*, 0px)` is read by default; do not hardcode a phone's dimensions: ```vue Submit ``` For on-demand imports, load `@maple-design/ui/safe-area/style`. Auto-import resolvers handle styles automatically. ### 2. Override when the app supplies insets Pass CSS pixels still needing avoidance within the WebView content viewport, not physical device pixels or keyboard height. ```ts import { SafeArea } from '@maple-design/ui' SafeArea.setInsets({ top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 34, left: 0 }) SafeArea.setInsets(null) // Remove overrides; restore browser/inherited values ``` `0` is valid. Each call replaces all four target-edge overrides; omitted edges inherit/browser-default. App adapters own initial snapshots, rotation/resume updates and unsubscription. Clear global overrides when removing adapters. Without native data, keep browser defaults. ### 3. Local containers and popups ```vue ``` Insets inherit along actual DOM. Body-teleported popups leave local containers: use root overrides or a `popup-container` with correct insets. `SafeArea.setInsets(insets, hostElement)` updates only that host. Iframes must load styles in their own document. ## Avoid duplicate spacing - `edges`: padding `edges` at this layer; `[]` adds none. - `insets`: effective subtree `insets`; omitted edges inherit, `0` means no avoidance needed. - `consume`: `true` by default; used edges reset to 0 on direct element children, inherited by descendants. Choose one avoidance layer per content path. If a bottom bar uses `safe-area`, do not duplicate its padding outside. Use `consume=false` only when descendants need independent compensation. Viewport-fixed elements need explicit hosts/insets; ordinary-flow ancestor compensation is insufficient. | Component | Enable through | Behavior | | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | | Popup | `safe-area-inset-top/right/bottom/left` | Add padding to specified edges | | Picker / ActionSheet / NumberKeyboard | `safe-area` | Delegate bottom, left and right spacing to Popup | | TabBar / FloatingPanel | `safe-area` | Add bottom, left and right padding | | Fab | `safe-area` | Respect the vertical and horizontal safe areas at the corner selected by position | | Form popup editor | Automatically handle bottom/left/right insets | Inherit the actual popup host without changing draft confirmation | ## Common questions **Why no spacing in desktop browsers?** Without device safe areas, `env()` is usually 0. Examples use local simulated values for visibility. **Should bottom change when the keyboard opens?** Do not treat keyboard height as safe-area inset. WebView resizing, overlays, input scrolling and fixed action bars depend on host policy. **Does changing themes reset safe areas?** No. Themes manage appearance; SafeArea manages environment insets. Simulators check layout, but status bars, keyboards and rotation require actual iOS/Android WebView tests. ## API ### SafeArea Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | ------- | -------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------ | | edges | `SafeAreaEdge[]`
`SafeAreaEdge: 'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left']` | Physical edges receiving spacing; [] compensates none and does not represent position or expansion direction | | insets | SafeAreaInsets | undefined | Local CSS-px overrides; 0 is valid, omitted edges inherit | | consume | boolean | true | Clear already-consumed edges for descendants | | tag | string | div | Container element | Default slot is content; no new events. `SafeArea.setInsets(insets, target?)`: insets is SafeAreaInsets or null; target defaults to document.documentElement. Replaces four-edge overrides while retaining other target CSS, without registering native listeners. Safely returns during SSR without document. Component insets can render in SSR without writing request data into global modules. Values must be finite/nonnegative or throw TypeError; DOM stays unchanged until every value validates. ## Types ```ts import SafeArea from '@maple-design/ui/safe-area' import type { SafeAreaProps, SafeAreaInstance, SafeAreaEdge, SafeAreaInsets } from '@maple-design/ui' import type { SafeAreaProps as SubSafeAreaProps } from '@maple-design/ui/safe-area' const options: SafeAreaProps = { edges: ['bottom'], insets: { bottom: 0 } } SafeArea.setInsets({ bottom: 0 }) ``` SafeAreaEdge is the top/right/bottom/left union, and SafeAreaInsets maps those edges optionally to numbers. SafeAreaInstance represents a component instance without a setInsets method. setInsets is static on the component object; do not call it on a template ref. ## CSS Variables These are runtime-environment values, not Alps/Firefly brand-theme values. Use StyleProvider for brands and SafeArea for app adaptation; neither clears the other.

# SafeArea 安全区 为贴近屏幕边缘的内容预留空间，避免被刘海、圆角或底部手势区域遮挡。浏览器通常自动提供安全区；App WebView 也可以传入自己的边距。 ## 什么时候用 | 页面情况 | 建议 | | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | | 普通页面，没有贴边内容 | 通常无需额外设置 | | 底部操作栏、全屏内容靠近设备边缘 | 用 SafeArea 包裹需要避让的区域，指定 `edges` | | Popup、TabBar 等组件已经开启安全区 | 使用组件自身的开关，避免外层再次添加相同留白 | | App 已经为 WebView 避让 | 显式传入对应边的 `0` | ## 基础示例 ### 底部留白与嵌套 先看最常见的底部操作栏。斜纹表示安全区，修改数值可在桌面浏览器中观察效果；关闭嵌套保护可对比重复留白。 ```demo ../example/demos/basic.vue ``` ## 页面与组件组合 ### App 页面模拟 选择竖屏、横屏、Duo 左右不对称模拟或四边归零，观察滚动内容、固定提交栏和字段弹层。四边可独立输入 0–120 CSS px；横屏默认缩放到可用宽度，也可切换原尺寸查看。 页面避让上、左、右，提交栏只避让底部；嵌套容器不重复增加留白。测量区显示实际 padding，弹层数值包含其原有内容间距。表单状态、上传和日期等附加控制放在“更多表单选项”中。 ```demo ../example/demos/app-form.vue ``` ### 组件联动 选择一个贴边组件，独立调整底部、左侧和右侧留白，再打开或操作它。需要核对具体数值时，展开测量结果。所有模拟值只作用于当前示例。 ```demo ../example/demos/affected-components.vue ``` ### Duo 不对称安全区 Duo 外屏横竖屏、内屏横竖屏和左右分屏预设会同时切换视口与四边模拟值；工具栏展开 / 收起切换小 / 大视口高度。左右避让按钮可在当前视口上交换不对称边距，归零只清空安全区。 尺寸采用 WebKit 公布的 Safari 27.1 CSS 视口：外屏竖屏 382 × 580/618，外屏横屏 594 × 368/406，内屏竖屏 669 × 867/902，内屏横屏 951 × 585/620，分屏每窗 385 × 571/609。它们不是设备物理屏幕尺寸。安全区值仅用于独立压力测试，不是这些视口对应的实测 inset；Safari 已避让的侧栏不要重复补偿。四边必须独立读取；宿主在折叠、展开、旋转、分屏及安全区变化后更新相对 WebView 内容视口的剩余边距，已经避让的边传 `0`。 Safari 与原生 App 的可用视口可能不同，不要把原生侧边栏宽度直接补到网页上。保留浏览器 `env()` 默认行为，宿主有准确数据时才覆盖。屏幕中间的折叠区域需要单独的分段布局，不能用四边 inset 表达。 参考：[WebKit 网页适配说明](https://webkit.org/blog/18486/webkit-features-for-safari-27-1/)、[苹果安全区适配说明](https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/tech-talks/111461/)。 ## 在应用中使用 ### 1. 开启浏览器适配 在应用 HTML 中配置视口： ```html ``` 包裹需要留白的区域。默认读取浏览器 `env(safe-area-inset-*, 0px)`，无需写死某款手机的尺寸： ```vue 提交 ``` 按需引入时加载 `@maple-design/ui/safe-area/style`；使用自动导入 Resolver 时由工具处理样式。 ### 2. App 提供边距时再覆盖 传入 WebView **内容视口仍需避让的 CSS 像素**，不是设备物理像素，也不是键盘高度。 ```ts import { SafeArea } from '@maple-design/ui' SafeArea.setInsets({ top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 34, left: 0 }) SafeArea.setInsets(null) // 移除覆盖，恢复浏览器或继承值 ``` `0` 是有效覆盖。每次调用替换目标的四边覆盖，省略的边恢复继承或浏览器值。应用适配器统一负责初始快照、旋转及页面恢复后的更新和退订；移除适配器时再清理全局覆盖。没有原生数据时保留浏览器默认值即可。 ### 3. 局部容器和弹层 ```vue ``` 边距沿实际 DOM 继承。传送到 body 的弹层离开了局部容器，应使用根节点覆盖，或把弹层挂载到带有正确边距的 `popup-container`。也可以调用 `SafeArea.setInsets(insets, hostElement)`，只更新指定宿主；iframe 需要在自己的文档加载样式。 ## 避免重复留白 - `edges`：本层给哪些边增加 padding；`[]` 表示不增加。 - `insets`：当前子树使用的有效边距；省略边继承，`0` 表示无需避让。 - `consume`：默认 `true`，已使用的边在直接元素子节点重置为 0，后代继续继承。 同一条内容路径选择一个避让位置。例如底栏已启用 `safe-area`，就不要再给外层手写相同的 padding。需要后代独立避让时才设 `consume=false`。相对视口固定定位的元素应有明确的宿主或边距，不能假设普通流祖先已经为它避让。 | 组件 | 开启方式 | 行为 | | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | | Popup | `safe-area-inset-top/right/bottom/left` | 对指定边增加 padding | | Picker / ActionSheet / NumberKeyboard | `safe-area` | 底部及左右留白转交给 Popup | | TabBar / FloatingPanel | `safe-area` | 增加底部及左右 padding | | Fab | `safe-area` | 按 position 避让所在角落的上下及左右安全区 | | 表单 popup 编辑层 | 自动处理底部与左右边距 | 继承实际弹层宿主，不改变草稿确认流程 | ## 常见问题 **桌面浏览器为什么没有留白？** 没有设备安全区时 `env()` 通常为 0。上方示例使用局部模拟值，便于观察。 **键盘弹出后要更新 bottom 吗？** 不要把键盘高度直接当作安全区。WebView 的 resize、overlay、输入滚动和固定操作栏需要结合宿主策略处理。 **切换主题会重置安全区吗？** 不会。主题管理外观，SafeArea 管理运行环境边距。模拟器能检查布局，系统状态栏、键盘和设备旋转仍需在实际 iOS / Android WebView 中验证。 ## API ### SafeArea Props | 属性 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 | | ------- | -------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------ | | edges | `SafeAreaEdge[]`
`SafeAreaEdge: 'left' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'top'` | `['top', 'right', 'bottom', 'left']` | 需要留白的物理边；[] 不补偿，不表示位置或展开方向 | | insets | SafeAreaInsets | undefined | 局部 CSS px 覆盖，0 有效，省略边继承 | | consume | boolean | true | 对后代清除已消费的边 | | tag | string | div | 容器标签 | 默认插槽为内容，无新增事件。 `SafeArea.setInsets(insets, target?)`：insets 为 SafeAreaInsets 或 null；target 默认为当前 document.documentElement。替换该目标四边覆盖，保留目标其他 CSS；不隐式注册原生监听。SSR 无 document 时安全返回；组件 insets 可以在 SSR 中输出，避免把请求相关数据写入全局模块。数值必须有限且非负，否则抛 TypeError，并在校验全部通过前不修改 DOM。 ## Types ```ts import SafeArea from '@maple-design/ui/safe-area' import type { SafeAreaProps, SafeAreaInstance, SafeAreaEdge, SafeAreaInsets } from '@maple-design/ui' import type { SafeAreaProps as SubSafeAreaProps } from '@maple-design/ui/safe-area' const options: SafeAreaProps = { edges: ['bottom'], insets: { bottom: 0 } } SafeArea.setInsets({ bottom: 0 }) ``` SafeAreaEdge 是 top/right/bottom/left 的联合类型，SafeAreaInsets 是这些边到 number 的可选映射。SafeAreaInstance 表示组件实例，没有 setInsets 实例方法；setInsets 是组件对象上的静态方法，模板 ref 上不要调用。 ## CSS Variables 这些是运行环境值，不要把它们写入 Alps/Firefly 品牌主题。品牌切换使用 StyleProvider；App 适配使用 SafeArea，两者不互相清空。

Loading does not imply disabled or readonly. ### Native form and popup ownership The active keyword input exclusively owns its configured id. References and cached closed editors use distinct internal ids and leave the accessibility/Tab order. Visible labels associate with their input; ariaLabel takes precedence over label text. Field selectors describe field choice, while keyword inputs have their own accessible name. The reference supplies one native FormData name/value. Popup edits immediately update the same model without duplicating name submission. To use native required and other HTML constraints inside the popup, give the form an id and explicitly associate inputAttrs.form. Closing releases editor constraint ownership so cached inputs cannot block later submission. Popup input immediately updates v-model. cancel ends the history interface; business code cancels its own requests. A nonempty recent-searches list is required to open history. Switching to reading releases history state. Business state controls loading: editing stays available and repeat searches are blocked. Ordinary search/change listener Promises do not control waiting. ```demo ../example/demos/native-form.vue ``` ## API ### Empty values and reading placeholders `empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. # Select

In multiple mode, the inline dropdown contains options only; the field owns selected values, removal and clearing. The popup editor retains the selected-items summary and clear action, and commits its draft on confirmation.

## Reading direction

Select inherits source `dir`. Standalone fields align to inline start; FormItem content-align still takes precedence when inherited. Explicit left/right alignment remains physical. Tags keep their array order and empty-search Backspace removes the last closable value. Dropdowns and picker panels retain source direction, including in a custom popup-container.

### Thumb drag lifecycle

Each primary-button start owns a session: generation, track/thumb nodes, immutable axis/start and thumb.ownerDocument.defaultView. Register mousemove/mouseup/contextmenu/blur on that original window. Release the full set and dragging/mouseOffset on normal end, context cancellation, blur, effective geometry/direction change, deactivation or disposal. This repairs leaked contextmenu, missing suspension/disposal cleanup and global-window iframe binding. Old move cannot drive a new gesture; old end cannot release one. Activation allows only fresh starts.

Changing direction/max/thumbSize/ratio cancels the gesture; replacing data with equal primitive geometry does not. Parent measurement/setOffset still settles final position. Recheck ownership after geometry/reactive writes to reject reentrant disposal. Inactive/disposed retained start/track/setOffset are inert without preventDefault; nonprimary clicks do not drag/page. Active setOffset clamping, drag-time suppression and one-thumb track paging remain.

### Scrollbar consumer lifecycle

Previously saved scroll commands do not affect deactivated or unmounted instances. Reactivation measures the current content. Changing direction or thumb geometry ends an active drag; use the current instance after remounting.

Zero is a valid coordinate, including scrollTo(0,0); measurement resets thumbs at zero. Horizontal measurement uses horizontal rather than vertical ratio. Zero/invalid viewport yields finite nonnegative metrics and no scrollbar on that zero-sized axis. Existing20px minimum thumb/15px track strategy remains. Hidden/disabled-axis thumb delivery is inert, but disabling the bar does not forbid content/public native scrolling. Options are forwarded without JS animation. ## Usage notes

### Editing mode
Presentation containers use internal `src/_components/field-presentation/token.less` with system surfaces/spacing/dimensions. Option lists retain existing Select tokens.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Search fields
`searchFields` / `search-fields` is a readonly `('label' | 'value')[]`, defaulting to `['label']`. Multiple fields use OR matching, case-insensitive by default. `['value', 'label']` searches codes and names; fieldNames maps semantic fields to business fields. An empty array matches no items for a nonempty query. Values are compared as strings; object traversal, object values and pinyin matching require a custom callback. A custom callback takes precedence and decides case handling itself. Remote results use the existing protocol for disabling local filtering. Cascader retains path semantics and checks the configured fields on each path node.

### Configuration

Single/multiple options both use popup-option-padding-horizontal. There is no implicit search-highlight DOM; custom option slots style their own highlighted fragments.

## Types

### Type imports
Root and component entries export `SelectEmits`、`SelectSlots`、`SelectExpose` alongside Props and Instance. Emits are event argument tuples derived from the runtime validators; Expose contains focus/blur.

## Loading options through a function prop

Pass options(query, { signal }) directly; useAsyncData is unnecessary. options still accepts arrays, and an explicit array, including [], takes precedence. The component manages loading, stale-result isolation and cancellation. load-error reports failures, and the instance refresh() method retries. A business loader may accept only query and ignore the second argument.

filterable enables entering a search query. filterOption controls only local matching and never sends requests. With an options loader, remote results are not filtered again by default; with only an array, local matching is enabled by default. Most callers do not need filter-option.

```vue
<mp-select v-model="value" :options="loadOptions" filterable />
```

`empty-value` accepts explicit `null` (or `() => null`). Clearing publishes `null` unchanged; omitted values preserve the existing default. Editors render `null` as blank without converting ordinary empty-string input to `null`. In popup editing, clearing changes the draft; confirm commits it and cancel preserves the original model.

Cancellable hooks use `(payload, done, context)`: closure payloads contain `{ action }`, change/commit payloads contain `{ value, previousValue }`, and Popup uses `{ reason }`. Context provides `signal` and an optional original `event`. Return a boolean/Promise, or call done()/done(false). Synchronous void waits for done; Promise<void> allows the operation. First completion wins. Pending state controls loading/disabled automatically. Cancellation invalidates stale results. Button refs are not exposed.

In direct mode, focus() targets the native input. In closed deferred mode it focuses the reference without opening; when open it targets the current editor. blur() blurs the current input or editor without reopening or simulating selection. Cached and remounted editors both resolve the current target.

Public SelectInstance/SelectExpose and PeopleSelectInstance/PeopleSelectExpose reflect the existing methods. PeopleSelectExpose is available from the root and component subentry. refresh() returns `Promise<void>` and reloads function-based options through the existing protocol; it does not represent completion of saving or business actions.

SelectEditMode is exported consistently from root and select subentries, retaining each platform public edit-mode values.

### Selection actions during loading

While manual loading or the current candidate request is active, selection fields preserve existing values and pause selection, clearing and tag removal. Blocked actions neither notify nor submit a model. Search text remains editable and disabled/readonly are not changed; set them separately to prevent searching.

Deferred editor clearing and confirmation are unavailable while loading; cancellation and closing remain available. Actions return to their normal state after both the manual flag and current request finish, still respecting disabled options. Loading on free-text fields such as Input and AutoComplete continues to allow text editing and clearing.

Pass business data through object values or the original options data.

Multiple empty-value supports arrays, null/undefined and empty values recognized by empty-values; other scalars are rejected. Factories run only for a real clear with no disabled retained selections; invalid results produce a development diagnostic and fall back to [], without publishing an invalid scalar.

# 选择框 多选时，`inline` 下拉只显示选项；已选内容、单项移除和清空由输入框承担。`popup` 编辑面板保留“已选／清空”，选择为草稿，确认后提交。 ## 阅读方向 选择框继承来源 `dir`；独立使用时默认按阅读起点对齐，在 FormItem 内继续继承其 content-align。显式 left/right 保持物理对齐；标签保持业务数组顺序，空搜索时 Backspace 删除最后一个可关闭值。下拉与选择面板携带来源方向，自定义 popup-container 不覆盖该方向。 ## 基础示例 ### 基础用法 点击展开选项，选中后回填并收起；清除后可重新选择。本例只演示单选。 ```demo ../example/demos/standard.vue ``` ## 外观与状态 ### 外观配置对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | | `options` | 原始值、对象、分组均支持；三种展示使用同一数据源 | 外观配置对比、表单控件尺寸对照 | | `clearable` | 允许清除，保留禁用的已选项 | 外观配置对比、表单控件尺寸对照 | | `disabled` | 禁止选择与移除 | 表单控件尺寸对照 | | `edit-mode` | 字段展示；未指定时继承 FormItem/Form | 表单控件尺寸对照 | | `size` | 完整支持 xs、sm、md、lg、xl，未设置时继承分组与表单 | 表单控件尺寸对照 | | `variant` | filled、outline、standard；未设置时继承 InputGroup | 表单控件尺寸对照 | 选择一个对比维度后，同屏展示它的全部可选值；其余配置和内容保持一致。可切换其他配置检查组合效果；输入类预览共享一个值。

## 使用说明 ### 编辑方式 展示容器使用内部 `src/_components/field-presentation/token.less`，复用系统表面色、间距与尺寸变量。选项列表继续使用 Select 的现有 Token。 `read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。 ### 搜索字段 `searchFields` / `search-fields` 是只读 `('label' | 'value')[]`，默认 `['label']`；多字段为 OR 匹配，大小写默认不敏感。配置 `['value', 'label']` 可同时搜索编码和名称，fieldNames 将语义字段映射到业务字段；空数组对非空查询不匹配任何项。value 采用字符串比较，不做对象深层搜索，对象值或拼音等复杂规则仍用自定义回调。自定义回调优先并自行决定大小写；远程结果使用原有关闭本地过滤协议。Cascader 保留路径语义，会检查路径各节点的配置字段。 ### 配置说明 单选和多选选项统一使用 popup-option-padding-horizontal。组件没有隐式搜索高亮 ## Drawing sessions

### Writing-session cancellation

A stroke belongs to its initiating single touch identifier. Extra contacts do not restart it; moves/end events from unrelated contacts and events older than the current start cannot take it over. Native `touchcancel`, reset, KeepAlive deactivation, unmount, owner-window blur, a hidden owner document, and the existing resize reset end an active session exactly once. Ordinary release also emits one `end`; cleanup without a stroke does not manufacture an event. After cancellation/reactivation, moving an old contact cannot resume writing: a fresh `touchstart` is required.

`end` means interaction ended, including cancellation; it is not a save/validation task. Cancellation retains already drawn ink, while explicit reset clears it before notifying `end`. Ordinary event handler return Promises are not awaited. The demo schedules business-owned reset/pause from a start notification and clears its timer when the session ends; it does not dispatch fake browser cancellation events. See the size and export contract below.

```demo
../example/demos/session-lifecycle.vue
```

## Drawing and export boundaries

Input is touch-only; mouse, pen and keyboard drawing are not supported. Provide clear instructions and an accessible alternative, such as uploading an existing signature or a non-canvas signing flow. This component does not determine legal validity. A tap and release draws a round dot; movement starts at the initial point with round caps and joins. Cancellation does not add a dot.

The bitmap follows the container size and device pixel ratio. Existing pixels scale to the new size; a zero-size hidden container keeps its bitmap until it becomes visible again. Repeated scaling can interpolate pixels. ResizeObserver tracks container changes where available; otherwise window resize updates the bitmap. Device-pixel-ratio changes are also applied on window resize.

PNG keeps transparency. JPEG uses a white background, so white ink may be invisible in JPEG. The root CSS background is display-only: it is not included in PNG and does not replace the white JPEG background. `line-width` accepts a finite positive number or parseable numeric string, including values below 1; invalid widths fall back to 2px. `stroke-style` is a Canvas color; `currentColor` is resolved when a stroke starts.

## 书写会话

### 书写会话取消

一笔由发起时的单个 touch identifier 持有；额外触点不重开当前笔画，其他触点的 move/end 以及早于本次 start 的事件不能接管它。原生 `touchcancel`、重置、KeepAlive 停用、卸载、所属窗口失焦、所属文档隐藏，以及原有尺寸重置都会让活动会话结束一次；正常抬手同样只发一次 `end`，没有活动笔画时清理不制造事件。取消或再次激活后，旧触点继续移动不能恢复书写，必须重新 `touchstart`。

`end` 表示交互结束，包含取消，不代表自动保存或校验任务。取消保留已绘制内容；显式重置会先清空画布再通知 `end`。普通事件回调返回的 Promise 不被等待。示例在 start 通知中由业务安排重置/停用，并在会话结束后清理计时器，不通过伪造浏览器取消事件展示功能。尺寸变化的笔迹保留和位图导出见下文。

```demo
../example/demos/session-lifecycle.vue
```

## 绘制与导出边界

目前只处理触摸输入，不提供鼠标、手写笔或键盘绘制。业务应提供清晰说明和可访问的替代签署方式，例如上传已有签名或其他非画布流程；本组件不判断签名法律效力。轻点并抬手会留下圆点，移动会从起点连线，笔帽和连接处为圆形；取消不会新增圆点。

画布按容器尺寸和设备像素比设置位图。容器尺寸变化时按新尺寸缩放已有位图；隐藏导致尺寸为零时保留原图，重新显示后恢复。重复缩放可能产生像素插值。支持 ResizeObserver 的浏览器会跟踪容器变化，否则在窗口 resize 时更新；设备像素比变化也在窗口 resize 时更新。

PNG 保留透明背景；JPEG 使用白色背景，因此白色笔迹在 JPEG 中可能不可见。根元素的 CSS 背景只用于显示，不会进入 PNG 或替换 JPEG 的白底。`line-width` 为正有限数或可解析的数字字符串，允许小于 1 的笔宽；无效值回退 2px。`stroke-style` 使用 Canvas 支持的颜色；`currentColor` 在起笔时读取组件颜色。

## Usage notes





Built-in motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, keeping content and state feedback while disabling decorative animations. Adapt custom animations to that preference in your application.

Built-in Skeleton placeholders and standalone Line/Shape primitives default to `aria-hidden="true"`. The root exposes waiting through `aria-busy`. Custom `template` content and the loaded default content remain accessible and can supply business status messages.

### Fullscreen coverage

`fullscreen` renders an inline `position: fixed` placeholder without automatically teleporting to body. It covers the viewport when no ancestor establishes a fixed positioning containing block. An ancestor with `transform`, a relevant `will-change`, or `contain` may limit coverage to that ancestor. To cover the viewport, place Skeleton outside those ancestors or arrange its position with Vue Teleport in the application. This loading placeholder does not manage modal focus. See [CSS Positioned Layout fixed containing blocks](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-position-3/#fixed-cb).

Omitted size props use their theme tokens. A `-` in the table means there is no Prop default, rather than no placeholder size. Both Line and the main component normalize non`-`finite and negative row counts to zero and round fractions down.

### 全屏覆盖范围

`fullscreen` 使用当前位置的内联 `position: fixed` 占位，不会自动传送到 body。没有建立固定定位包含块的祖先时覆盖视口；祖先的 `transform`、相应 `will-change` 或 `contain` 可让覆盖范围变为该祖先。需要覆盖视口时，将 Skeleton 放在这些祖先之外，或由业务使用 Vue Teleport 安排位置。它是加载占位，不提供模态焦点管理。参见 [CSS Positioned Layout 固定定位包含块](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-position-3/#fixed-cb)。

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest native `dir`. `direction="row"` follows reading order; `column` remains top to bottom. justify/align flex-start and flex-end follow their respective flex axes. `size=[rowGap,columnGap]` always describes row and `column` gaps without swapping in RTL. Wrapping and split slots follow content order. Direction changes do not reverse data or recreate children with stable keys.

## API

### Children and size boundaries

Reordering keyed Fragment groups preserves local child identity. Whitespace, empty text, comments and empty Fragments do not generate spacing items. Meaningful text, numeric zero and empty elements are retained. Empty split content does not produce separators.

With wrap and split, a separator follows the previous item and may appear at a line end; hiding separators at every line boundary is not guaranteed. An item wider than its available line may still overflow. Without wrap, existing Flex gap and justify allocation remain. Layout switches do not recreate content nodes.

block switches the container between flex and inline-flex. align=stretch stretches the internal item wrapper without guaranteeing that its control fills it. Use the child control's block or width:100% when needed.

Invalid size shapes, negative/nonfinite numbers and arrays other than pairs fall back to md with development diagnostics. Array entries are lengths and do not accept preset names. CSS var/calc expressions remain supported; the browser handles syntax and resolved lengths.

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`。`direction="row"` 沿阅读顺序排列，`column` 保持从上到下；justify/align 的 flex-start、flex-end 跟随对应 flex 轴。`size=[rowGap,columnGap]` 始终分别表示行间距、列间距，不因 RTL 交换。换行与 split 插槽沿内容顺序排列，方向切换不反转数据或重建有稳定 key 的子节点。

## API

### 子节点与尺寸边界

带 key 的 Fragment 分组重排时保留局部子项身份。纯空白、空文本、注释和空 Fragment 不生成间距项；有意义的文字、数字 0 和空元素保留。空的 split 内容也不生成分隔项。

wrap 与 split 组合时，分隔符跟随前一项，可以出现在行尾；不承诺隐藏每行边缘的分隔符。单项宽度超出可用行宽时仍可能溢出。未开启 wrap 时，保持原有 Flex gap 与 justify 分配规则。切换布局不会重建内容节点。

block 将容器切换为 flex / inline-flex；align=stretch 拉伸内部 item 包装层，不保证其中的控件填满。需要撑满时使用子控件的 block 或 width:100%。

非法 size 结构、负数/非有限数字、非二元组数组会回退 md，并在开发环境提示。数组项为长度，不接受预设名。仍支持 CSS var/calc 表达式，具体 CSS 语法与解析值由浏览器处理。

## Animation duration boundaries

Duration is finite nonnegative milliseconds. Zero reaches the target on the next frame. Negative, NaN and infinite values produce development prop diagnostics and safely behave as zero without continuing to request frames. Pausing or unmounting before that frame cancels completion. Changing animation-duration replays enabled numeric animation according to the existing rules.

## API

`precision` accepts integers from 0 to 100; invalid values fall back to 0. Numeric formatting uses JavaScript binary numbers and rounding and is not exact financial arithmetic. Very large values may use exponential notation; when the difference between animation endpoints overflows, the final value is shown directly. Numeric grouping follows en-US rules, `separator` replaces grouping commas, and the decimal point remains a dot; dates use local time. Non-finite numeric values produce a warning, display literally, and do not animate. An invalid animation start falls back to 0 and an invalid duration to 0 with completion on the next frame.

## Usage notes



Placeholder text updates when the default slot appears/disappears. Animation pauses on unmount/KeepAlive deactivation.

### Animation configuration and lifecycle

With `start=true`, dynamically enabling `animation` or changing the numeric target, `valueFrom` or `animationDuration` replays from the currently configured start. Formatting-only changes, such as precision or separators, do not replay. Disabling `animation` or switching to string/date immediately shows the target and stops frames. `start=false` pauses the current number; explicitly returning to `true` replays. Configuration changes while paused prepare a new start without scheduling frames. KeepAlive deactivation pauses; activation resumes unchanged configuration or resynchronizes changed configuration. Unmount releases frames.

## 动画时长边界

时长为有限非负毫秒数。0 在下一帧到达目标；负数、NaN 和无穷值会产生开发环境属性诊断，并安全地按 0 处理，不会持续请求动画帧。下一帧执行前暂停或卸载会取消本次完成。启用数值动画时，修改 animation-duration 按已有规则重新播放。

## Usage notes





`active` indicates only whether the current one-based step index matches modelValue, independently of wait/process/finish/error status. A current error step remains `active`. Focus/hover do not change `active`.

## Reading direction and keyboard interaction

Steps inherits the nearest `dir="ltr"` or `dir="rtl"`, including runtime changes. Horizontal steps, connectors and arrows follow reading direction; vertical steps remain top to bottom. Step numbers, progress values and custom icon content keep their meaning.

With `changeable`, Left/Right moves focus according to reading direction, or Up/Down vertically. Home/End focuses the first/last available step, skipping disabled items. Enter/Space confirms. Moving focus or changing reading direction does not update progress.

# StyleProvider

Provides local CSS variable overrides for descendant components.

## Local themes

`theme="light | dark"` switches a complete local light/dark theme. Omit it to inherit, and nest explicit themes to override. It does not mutate the document theme. `style-vars` overrides theme defaults; outer custom variables are preserved and inner keys win. Null clears only this provider's overrides.

Library declarative popups, menus, dialogs and floating content inherit their owning Vue provider's theme and overrides, including body, custom popup-container and inline destinations. Programmatic services created outside a provider have no implicit caller context: theme their actual host explicitly. Third-party Teleports need an explicit boundary at their destination.

Theme boundaries reuse demand-loaded CSS and re-evaluate aliases without patching each descendant. Switching recalculates styles in the affected region, so prefer providers around page regions. A provider with only style-vars retains its existing override semantics without rebuilding all aliases.

## Global calls

```ts
import { StyleProvider, Themes } from '@maple-design/ui'

StyleProvider.setStyleVars(Themes.default.dark)
StyleProvider.setStyleVars({ '--mp-color-scheme': 'light' })
StyleProvider.setStyleVars(null)
```

Each call replaces previous injected values rather than merging cumulatively. Values already equal to base styles are not written again.
`dark` sets `html[maple-theme="dark"]`; `light` removes it. Without color-scheme, existing attributes remain. `null` removes this library's injection/theme attributes without affecting the other library. SSR calls have no side effects.

Variables accept full CSS names or camelCase such as `mpColorScheme`. Prefixes are not added automatically. Prefer full `--mp-*` names.

## Installation and defaults

```ts
import { StyleProvider } from '@maple-design/ui'

app.use(StyleProvider)

StyleProvider.setPropsDefaults({
  tag: 'section',
  styleVars: () => ({ '--mp-demo-color': 'teal' }),
})
```

Set defaults during initialization before mounting; mounted instances are not retroactively updated. Explicit props take precedence. Object defaults are copied per instance; factories/`null` are supported. Defaults are local to each library, not shared.
Installation always registers `MpStyleProvider` without changing app-global config. Use `app.component('MyStyleProvider', StyleProvider)` for aliases.

## API

### StyleProvider Props

| Prop | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | Local mode; inherits when omitted | `'light' \| 'dark'` | — |
| `style-vars` | Local CSS variables; null clears local overrides | `Record<string, string> \| null` | `{}` |
| `tag` | Wrapper tag | `string` | `div` |

The default slot supplies component content. No events.

## Types

Exports `StyleVars`, `StyleProviderProps`, `StyleProviderDefaults` and `StyleProviderInstance`. `StyleProvider` is the only public component entry; `styleProviderProps` and resolver-facing `_StyleProviderComponent` are also exported.

No component-specific theme tokens. Variable values are strings; numeric dimensions should be unit-bearing strings.

## 局部主题

`theme="light | dark"` 切换本区域的完整亮暗主题；省略时继承外层，可嵌套覆盖，不修改文档主题。`style-vars` 在主题默认值之上覆盖，外层自定义变量仍继承，内层同名变量优先；null 只移除本层变量。

库内声明式弹层、菜单、对话框与浮动内容通过 Vue 上下文继承所属 Provider 的主题和变量，挂载到 body、自定义 popup-container 或保持行内均适用。脱离 Provider 创建的命令式服务没有调用位置的组件上下文，需在其实际挂载宿主配置主题。第三方 Teleport 需要自行在目标处设置主题边界。

主题由按需 CSS 样式在边界重新计算，不逐个修改后代组件；切换会触发所属区域的样式重算。建议按页面区域设置 Provider。仅传 style-vars 时仍是原有的局部变量覆盖，不会自动重建全部派生别名。

## 全局调用

```ts
import { StyleProvider, Themes } from '@maple-design/ui'

StyleProvider.setStyleVars(Themes.default.dark)
StyleProvider.setStyleVars({ '--mp-color-scheme': 'light' })
StyleProvider.setStyleVars(null)
```

每次调用替换上次注入，不累计合并。与当前基础样式一致的变量不重复写入。
`dark` 设置 `html[maple-theme="dark"]`；`light` 移除该属性。未提供 color-scheme 时保留现有主题属性；`null` 移除本库注入和主题属性，不影响另一库。SSR 中函数调用无副作用。

变量支持完整 CSS 名称，也支持驼峰（如 `mpColorScheme`）；不会自动补充库前缀。推荐完整 `--mp-*` 名称。

## 安装与默认值

```ts
import { StyleProvider } from '@maple-design/ui'

app.use(StyleProvider)

StyleProvider.setPropsDefaults({
  tag: 'section',
  styleVars: () => ({ '--mp-demo-color': 'teal' }),
})
```

在应用初始化、挂载组件之前设置默认值，不追溯更新已挂载实例；显式 Props 优先。对象形式会为每个实例复制变量对象，也支持工厂和 `null`。默认配置仅属于本库，不跨库共享。
安装固定注册 `MpStyleProvider`，不修改应用全局配置；自定义别名使用 `app.component('MyStyleProvider', StyleProvider)`。

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Navigation items follow reading order without changing selection values or item order. Automatic space for a floating button is at inline end; a center button remains centered. Explicit Badge placements remain physical corners.

## API

`default`/`icon` slot active indicates whether this item's name matches modelValue; focus/hover do not change it. activeColor/inactiveColor control current/noncurrent colors.

#### Async operation feedback
Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection/failure restores interaction; repeated input does not restart the same operation. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate. Switching to a different target retains the latest-request-wins rule.

#### guard-error
Emitted once after a switching guard fails, with `(error, value)`.

TabBar uses a group of buttons for state selection, with aria-pressed on the selected item. Give the root an aria-label when needed. Applications handle routing; ordinary events do not await return values.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is the selected child name; unnamed positional mode uses zero-based indices. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once without later resets. Explicit binding wins, without initialization `update:modelValue`.

## API

`default` 和 `icon` 插槽的 active 表示当前项 name 是否对应 modelValue；焦点、悬停不会改变 active。activeColor/inactiveColor 分别控制当前项和非当前项的颜色。

#### 异步操作反馈
before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。切换到其他目标仍保留最后一次请求优先的规则。

TabBar 使用按钮组表达状态选择，选中项通过 aria-pressed 标记；可为根组件传入 aria-label 命名。若用于页面导航，业务负责路由跳转；普通事件只通知，不等待返回值。

## Reading direction and scrolling

Table inherits native reading direction, with headers/cells defaulting to inline-start alignment. Custom alignment tokens may still specify physical left/right. The native scroll viewport is focusable: Left/Right scrolls visually, and Home/End reaches reading boundaries. Direction changes preserve the distance from inline start, clamped to the new range. Maple Table is a native slotted table and does not add Cedar data-column freezing, column resizing or grouped-header APIs.

Object syntax must explicitly include `{ loading: true, size: 24 }`. A configuration object without loading does not enable it, matching Cedar Table.

## API


Loading preserves the checked state and exposes disabled and busy semantics on checkable tags. If loading starts while the close control has focus, focus moves to the tag. Independent interactive controls in the content do not toggle the tag.

The close button name defaults to the current locale’s close text and can be overridden with `close-button-aria-label`. The tag root remains single-line; `nowrap` mainly enables the inner truncation wrapper and does not control multiline wrapping.

### Value and default value

Use ordinary `v-model`. `modelValue` is a selectable tag's boolean checked state. `defaultValue` initializes uncontrolled state once; later changes do not reset it. Explicit binding takes precedence, without initialization `update:modelValue`.

## Usage notes



The application updates controlled show / checked values. Hiding retains the fade-out effect; class / style apply to the actual tag. CSS variables customize mobile touch sizing.

### Color override boundaries

Preset outline stays transparent; loading does not trigger preset fill hover. Dark backgrounds consume bg/bg-hover with instance overrides. Preset icon-color is separate from text-color. Unchecked presets remain neutral, while an explicit color still applies. Preset/custom colors do not guarantee contrast on arbitrary backgrounds.

## CSS Variables

The complete public contract is the `--mp-tag-*` set in `style/token.less`. Customize it with [StyleProvider](#/en-US/style-provider). Cedar uses the same logical names with a different brand prefix.

Status text and outline borders use the corresponding theme semantic colors with light colored fills. Unselected tags remain neutral; selected status colors take precedence over hover. The neutral background switches between fill-2 and fill-3. color takes precedence over status. Keep text readable on custom backgrounds and set text-color when needed.

### Motion

Built-in motion follows `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Reduced motion does not prevent loading-state or close-event updates.

## API


加载中保留选中状态，可选中标签声明禁用与忙碌状态；关闭按钮持焦时进入加载会将焦点移到标签。正文中的独立交互控件不会触发标签选中。

关闭按钮名称默认使用当前语言的关闭文案，可通过 `close-button-aria-label` 覆盖。标签根始终保持单行；`nowrap` 主要启用内容截断内层，并不控制多行换行。

### 主值与默认值

使用普通 `v-model`。`modelValue` 表示可选标签是否选中，布尔值；`defaultValue` 仅在创建时初始化非受控值，后续修改不会重置当前状态。显式绑定值优先，初始化不发出 `update:modelValue`。

# Time If a parent keeps the popup open after confirmation, repeated confirmation without a new selection is deduplicated. A fresh time selection starts a new transaction and can be confirmed again. While expanded, the native combobox uses `aria-controls` to identify its own named popup. Closing updates the state and removes the link. `aria-label` and `aria-describedby` reach the native input. Custom selected/trigger slots must preserve accessible names, keyboard operation and state associations. In clock and wheel modes, min/max are inclusive same-day bounds. A minute stays selectable when some of its seconds are available. Second constraints compare the complete clock value, not seconds from a different hour. Use TimeRange show-next-day for overnight ranges, rather than reversed min/max. Installing Time also registers TimePicker, which is available through the static member `Time.Picker`. ## Basic examples ### Basic Usage ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/basic-usage.vue ``` ## Appearance and presentation ### Form control size comparison #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | ------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | | `format` | String parse, display and output format | Field appearance and nested options, Time formats and 12-hour clocks, Visible wheel fields | | `placeholder` | Placeholder | Form control size comparison, Field appearance and nested options, Time formats and 12-hour clocks | | `variant` | Variant: `filled` `standard` `outline` | Form control size comparison, Field appearance and nested options | | `use12-hours` | Twelve-hour panel; defaults to hh:mm:ss a without an explicit format | Time formats and 12-hour clocks, AM / PM | | `disabled` | Whether disabled | Form control size comparison | | `readonly` | Whether readonly | Form control size comparison | Compare Input, Button, Select, date/time fields and other single-line controls at the same size. Field variants share the height scale; Button uses outline here. DatePicker/TimePicker are panels; this example uses Date/Time fields. The example includes selected and clearable values, removable tags and long multiple selections. Select/Cascader keep the same size height with tag-nowrap. Long tag text uses ellipsis while removal icons remain available; tags scroll horizontally while clear and arrow controls stay outside the scrolling area. Hover, focus or tap truncated tag text to read its full content; dismiss with an outside click or Escape without changing the selected value. Restore values after clearing to repeat the comparison. Multiline text and wrapping multiple selections can grow with content. ```demo ../../field-decorator/example/demos/control-sizes.vue ``` ### Field appearance and nested options hint controls the floating label (Cedar defaults to false, Maple to true) and is suppressed by an outer Form label. line defaults to true; text-color/focus-color/blur-color accept optional color strings. An unset error inherits Form state; explicit false overrides it. TimeRange separator defaults to `~` and accepts an empty string. Default variants remain Cedar filled and Maple standard; set variant explicitly for matching appearance. The field owns values, defaults, open state, format, steps, bounds, disabled rules and readonly/disabled state. Set these directly on the field, not inside timePickerProps/timeRangePickerProps. Nested options customize presentation only; model/select/confirm listeners cannot replace the field flow. Types reject owner properties and runtime filtering removes them, even when a top-level constraint is unset. Maple pickerProps accepts visual options such as optionHeight/optionCount, not columns, fieldNames, selection, toolbar or open state. popupProps accepts positioning, appearance and lifecycle callbacks, but not open/defaultOpen or open-update listeners. Top-level popupContainer (including false) takes priority. Nested options in standalone time panels follow the same ownership rules. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/field-appearance.vue ``` Field interactions use one local controller: select stages a draft; confirmation validates current rules before commit and Form change notification. Clearing uses the commit path with undefined, followed by clear; it is blocked when readonly/disabled or not clearable. Readonly fields remain focusable; repeated focus/blur notifications are deduplicated. A pending controlled close request cannot repeat a commit. The panel owns one draft and confirmation flow; presentation content only renders that state. The example above counts valid confirmations and shows the extra slot. Reconfirming an unchanged value emits confirm without an extra change event. ### Time formats and 12-hour clocks Compare minute, second and 12-hour displays. Twelve-hour hour columns automatically include AM/PM. ```demo ../example/demos/time-fields.vue ``` ### AM / PM ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/ampm-formats.vue ``` ## Value model and selection rules ### Model types and literals #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | | `format` | String parse, display and output format | Model types and literals, Hour/minute/second steps, Time bounds | | `disabled-hours` | Disabled hours (0–23) | Hour/minute/second steps, Wheel constraints | | `min` | Minimum selectable time | Time bounds, Wheel constraints | | `max` | Maximum selectable time | Time bounds, Wheel constraints | | `use12-hours` | Twelve-hour panel; defaults to hh:mm:ss a without an explicit format | Hour/minute/second steps | | `step` | Candidate steps anchored at midnight; invalid values use 1 | Hour/minute/second steps | ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/format-model.vue ``` ### Hour/minute/second steps With 12-hour display and a 5-hour step, hours remain anchored to midnight: 0/5/10/15/20, not restarted at noon. AM offers 12/05/10 and PM offers 03/08. Selecting 03 PM commits 15:30:00 because this Demo retains HH:mm:ss as its model format. Changing the rules preserves the old 09:30:00; cancellation does not commit aligned candidates. Only confirmation writes the selected value. Enable Disable 15:00 to combine disabled-hours with the step: 03 PM is unavailable while 08 PM still means 20:00. Turning off Accept controlled updates records proposals without changing the business value; re-enable it before confirming an accepted value. Proposal counts are not acceptance counts. Other non-dividing steps and physical touch remain separate coverage. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/step.vue ``` ### Time bounds After tightening the minimum to 10:30:40, the field retains 10:30:38 but the panel cannot confirm it. Selecting and confirming the inclusive maximum 10:31:02 updates the model. Editing seconds to 00 and canceling keeps seconds 02. `min` / `max` are optional strings, with no bound by default. Use 24-hour `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`, independently of format/use12Hours. Both endpoints are inclusive; omitted seconds mean 00. Range endpoints are validated individually; showNextDay does not make the bounds wrap across midnight. Reversed bounds allow no commit; unparseable bounds are treated as unset. Changing bounds does not rewrite the external model. Commits must satisfy bounds, steps and disabled callbacks. Hidden seconds are validated as 00. Coarse list columns are disabled when their whole hour/minute is out of bounds; confirmation validates the complete time. Use hide-disabled-options to hide disabled choices. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/bounds.vue ``` ### Wheel constraints ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/wheel-limits.vue ``` ## Standalone time panels ### Basic Usage ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/picker-basic.vue ``` ### Panel confirmation and disabled options For a pending single-value draft, enabling readonly, hiding disabled hours or switching to immediate mode does not submit the old draft. Mouse/keyboard checks do not establish physical touch-inertia behavior. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/panel-behavior.vue ``` The standalone panel owns its draft and commit state directly. 值模型与选择规则 ### 模型类型与固定文字 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | | `format` | 字符串解析、显示及输出格式 | 模型类型与固定文字、时分秒步长、时间上下限 | | `disabled-hours` | 返回禁用小时（0–23） | 时分秒步长、滚轮约束与动态禁用 | | `min` | 可选最小时间 | 时间上下限、滚轮约束与动态禁用 | | `max` | 可选最大时间 | 时间上下限、滚轮约束与动态禁用 | | `use12-hours` | 十二小时面板；未传 format 时默认 hh:mm:ss a | 时分秒步长 | | `step` | 候选步长以 0 点为起点；无效值回退为 1 | 时分秒步长 | ```demo ../example/demos/format-model.vue ``` ### 时分秒步长 十二小时显示与 5 小时步长组合时，步长从 24 小时制的零点计算，合法小时为 0 / 5 / 10 / 15 / 20，不在中午重新起算。AM 显示 12 / 05 / 10，PM 显示 03 / 08；03 PM 对应模型 15:30:00。切换规则不修改已有值，确认合法候选后才提交，取消保留原值；禁用 15 点后，03 PM 不可选，08 PM 仍对应 20 点。 ```demo ../example/demos/step.vue ``` ### 时间上下限 收紧下限至 10:30:40 时，字段仍显示原值 10:30:38，但面板不能确认该值。选择上界 10:31:02 并确认后才更新模型；再次编辑为秒数 00 后取消，模型仍保留秒数 02。 `min` / `max` 的类型为 `string`，默认不限制；格式固定为 24 小时制 `HH:mm` 或 `HH:mm:ss`，不受 `format` 或 `use12Hours` 影响，包含端点。`HH:mm` 的秒视为 00。范围的两个端点分别校验；`showNextDay` 不把边界变成跨午夜区间。`min > max` 时没有可提交时间。无法解析的边界按未设置处理。 动态修改边界不会改写外部模型。提交须同时满足边界、步长和禁用回调；不显示秒时按秒为 00 校验。列表粗粒度列在整个小时/分钟都越界时禁用，最终确认仍校验完整时间。隐藏禁用项使用 `hide-disabled-options`。 ```demo ../example/demos/bounds.vue ``` ### 滚轮约束与动态禁用 ```demo ../example/demos/wheel-limits.vue ``` ## 独立时间面板 ### 基本使用 ```demo ../example/demos/picker-basic.vue ``` ### 纯面板确认与禁用选项 纯面板默认确认后提交：选择时仅发 select，确认后才更新模型并发 change；disable-confirm 开启后有效选择立即提交。hide-disabled-options 默认 false，开启后隐藏禁用项；时钟保留原刻度角度。字段和日期组件内部显式跳过子面板确认，由外层负责提交。外部模型替换会重置草稿，不主动派发事件。 在未确认的草稿中启用只读、隐藏禁用小时或切换立即提交，不会提交旧草稿；解除只读也不提交，下一次有效选择才提交。切换移动端滚轮展示会保留草稿，不改变父级模型。 ```demo ../example/demos/panel-behavior.vue ``` 独立面板直接管理自己的草稿与提交状态。外部替换模型会重置草稿，不触发选择或变更事件；只读、禁用均阻止选择和确认。Cedar 使用列表，Maple 使用滚轮，展示层不另建一份草稿。 ### 只读 ```demo ../example/demos/picker-readonly.vue ``` ### 24小时格式 使用 `format="HH:mm"` 选择时和分。 ```demo ../example/demos/picker-hour24.vue ``` ### 显示秒 使用 `format="HH:mm:ss"` 显示秒。 ```demo ../example/demos/picker-seconds.vue ``` ### 时间限制 时钟示例显示已提交模型。10:30时的35秒低于下限、45秒被回调禁用，点击均不改变草稿；选择50秒并确认才提交。切换18时并选40分时，秒草稿会对齐到包含上限22秒，但确认前模型不变；25秒不可选。此处说明鼠标刻度选择，不代表真机触屏惯性或全部边界组合。 通过 `min`、`max` 与三个禁用回调共同控制可选时间，时钟和滚轮均生效。 ```demo ../example/demos/picker-limit.vue ``` ### 操作栏 ```demo ../example/demos/picker-actions.vue ``` ## 输入与状态控制 ### 交互状态对比 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | ---------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | | `format` | 字符串解析、显示及输出格式 | 交互状态对比、手输与面板选择、默认值与受控值 | | `clearable` | 是否可清除 | 手输与面板选择、默认值与受控值、选择与提交 | | `readonly` | 是否只读 | 交互状态对比、选择与提交、多个独立字段 | | `disabled` | 是否禁用 | 交互状态对比、选择与提交 | | `input-editable` | 是否允许手输；关闭后仍可面板选择 | 手输与面板选择、复制与编辑 | | `placeholder` | 占位符 | 多个独立字段、搭配 FormItem | 在同一实例上切换禁用、只读和错误状态后再操作控件，比较可编辑性和交互反馈。恢复开关位于目标控件外；错误外观本身不会执行校验。

`focus` / `blur` 事件均无参数，同一次聚焦或失焦只通知一次；范围两端切换不产生额外整字段事件。只读字段仍可聚焦，但不能展开修改；禁用字段不能聚焦，已聚焦时动态禁用会释放焦点状态并通知失焦。 字段和纯面板提交时按当前格式、步长及禁用规则重新校验；手动输入也遵守相同规则。规则变化不会自动改写已提交值。范围始终保留端点顺序，结束早于开始时仅在开启 `show-next-day` ### Next Day Label

When the end time is earlier than the start, `show-next-day` treats the end as the next day and shows a next-day marker. Without it, the draft is preserved, a red footer message is shown and confirmation is disabled. Now always updates only the active endpoint.

```html
<script setup>
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const range = ref(['22:00', '06:00'])
</script>

<template>
  <mp-time-range format="HH:mm" v-model="range" show-next-day placeholder="Overnight range" clearable />
</template>
```

hint controls the floating label (Cedar defaults to false, Maple to true) and is suppressed by an outer Form label. line defaults to true; text-color/focus-color/blur-color accept optional color strings. An unset error inherits Form state; explicit false overrides it. TimeRange separator defaults to `~` and accepts an empty string. Default variants remain Cedar filled and Maple standard; set variant explicitly for matching appearance.

The field owns values, defaults, open state, format, steps, bounds, disabled rules and readonly/disabled state. Set these directly on the field, not inside timeRangePickerProps. Nested options customize presentation only; model/select/confirm listeners cannot replace the field flow. Types reject owner properties and runtime filtering removes them, even when a top-level constraint is unset.

Maple pickerProps accepts visual options such as optionHeight/optionCount, not columns, fieldNames, selection, toolbar or open state. popupProps accepts positioning, appearance and lifecycle callbacks, but not open/defaultOpen or open-update listeners. Top-level popupContainer (including false) takes priority. Nested options in standalone time panels follow the same ownership rules.

```demo
../example/demos/en-US/field-appearance.vue
```

Field interactions use one local controller: select stages a draft; confirmation validates current rules before commit and Form change notification. Clearing uses the commit path with undefined, followed by clear; it is blocked when readonly/disabled or not clearable. Readonly fields remain focusable; repeated focus/blur notifications are deduplicated. A pending controlled close request cannot repeat a commit.

The panel owns one draft and confirmation flow; presentation content only renders that state. The example above counts valid confirmations and shows the extra slot. Reconfirming an unchanged value emits confirm without an extra change event.

Invalid input is not normalized or written back. `min`/`max` remain 24-hour `HH:mm[:ss]` strings, and disabled callbacks always receive actual hours 0–23.

### Time bounds

`min` / `max` are optional strings, with no bound by default. Use 24-hour `HH:mm` or `HH:mm:ss`, independently of format/use12Hours. Both endpoints are inclusive; omitted seconds mean 00. Range endpoints are validated individually; showNextDay does not make the bounds wrap across midnight. Reversed bounds allow no commit; unparseable bounds are treated as unset.

Changing bounds does not rewrite the external model. Commits must satisfy bounds, steps and disabled callbacks. Hidden seconds are validated as 00. Coarse list columns are disabled when their whole hour/minute is out of bounds; confirmation validates the complete time. Use hide-disabled-options to hide disabled choices.

### Selection and commit

Field `focus` and `blur` events have no arguments and fire once per transition. Moving between range endpoints stays within one field. Readonly fields remain focusable but cannot open for editing; disabling a focused field releases its focus state and notifies blur.

Clearing commits `undefined` regardless of candidate restrictions, but still respects readonly/disabled state.

`select(value, date)` reports user draft selection; `change(value, date)` reports a committed value. Both single and range fields clear to `undefined`, with an undefined date argument and a no-argument `clear` event. Date arguments represent local clock times (not next-day calendar arithmetic). Fields default to explicit confirmation; `disable-confirm` commits a valid choice immediately and requests close. Range confirmation rejects reversed endpoints unless `show-next-day` is enabled. ## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `popup` and opens an editor when the value area is clicked. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-direct modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

Inline date/time fields retain existing confirmation policies. In popover/popup, pure panels hide confirmation tools and the editor provides one confirm/cancel pair. Standalone DatePicker/DateRangePicker/TimePicker/TimeRangePicker retain panel APIs/confirmation without inheriting Form field presentation.

Mobile date fields use `panel-type` to select calendar/wheel content; `edit-mode` controls only field editing. Standalone panel content follows each panel API and is not controlled by the field `edit-mode`.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.

### Panel actions

Headers follow hour/minute/second format and align with both wheel groups; 12-hour mode adds AM/PM. No top summary or visible endpoint labels appear. Left edits start, right edits end; cross-day status appears below the right group.

Shared style variables:


Range panels provide Now by default. Start is initially current; using the right wheel makes end current. Now changes only that endpoint's draft. Even with `disable-confirm`, Now/subsequent edits require confirmation; cancel discards them. Format/step/disabling rules apply, and next-day/order checks update immediately. Fields, independent panels and popups behave alike; top-level `:show-now-button="false"` hides it. Custom `actions` can use `selectNow()`/`nowDisabled`.

The time field manages open/defaultOpen, disabled, trigger, closeOnClickReference, preventFocus and visibility updates. ## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

`popup-props` configures the anchored Trigger popover on both platforms. It cannot replace field open/disabled/trigger ownership. Top-level popup-container, including false, takes precedence. Panel and popup options are separate. `click(event)` fires once for an enabled field; readonly fields notify but do not open. Use `open-change(false)` for close requests, not proof that a controlled state changed. 

`suffix-icon` receives `focus: boolean` and `popupOpen: boolean`, replacing arrow-icon. `focus(index = 0)` focuses start (0) or end (1) without committing; `blur()` removes focus and requests closing.

Range `placeholder` accepts `string | string[]`: a string labels both endpoints; array entries label each endpoint, with missing entries empty. Explicit empty strings do not fall back to defaults.

### Pure-panel event and slot boundaries

`TimePicker`/`TimeRangePicker` do not manage fields/popups. Pass `open`, `size`, `variant`, clearing and popup configuration to `Time`/`TimeRange`.

- `select(value, date)`: edit the draft.
- `change(value, date)`: valid confirmation with a changed value; updates the model.
- `confirm(value, date)`: every valid confirmation, including unchanged values. `disableConfirm` also emits it on valid selection commits. Disabled, readonly or invalid drafts do not emit it.
- `extra`: additional explanatory content.
- `actions({ confirm, canConfirm, value })`: replace default tools. `value` is the draft; call `confirm()` to commit and disable buttons according to `canConfirm`.

Single-time events carry formatted strings and Date objects; range events carry corresponding arrays. Use field `open-change` and `update:open` to manage the popup, and field `clear` for clearing the value.

Panels edit a draft and commit on confirmation. Cancellation or closing does not commit, while clearing commits an empty value and closes immediately. Mobile time fields do not open the software keyboard. See the combined field examples in the Date documentation.

### Explicit save guard

beforeCommit(payload, done, context) belongs to field saving. payload contains value/previousValue; context has signal and optional event. Returning undefined waits for done, while boolean/Promise results settle by their result. FormItem validates candidates first; failure retains draft. Ordinary select/change/confirm/click listener returns do not use this task protocol.

# Trigger Replacing or clearing the popup reference, or unmounting the component, removes the old window scroll listeners. After closing or unbinding, pending positioning and scroll-close tasks do not affect a popup opened later. mouse-enter-delay / mouse-leave-delay are interaction delays, separate from CSS enter/leave duration. Cancel, replacement, KeepAlive deactivation and unmount invalidate dequeued commits; retained requests cannot schedule while inactive or disposed. Reactivation accepts new requests without replaying old delays. Controlled open remains caller-owned. Clicking another independent reference closes the previous top layer before opening the new one. Nested popups remain inside their parent. Controlled open state only receives a close request; the owner may reject it. ### Introduction A style-agnostic floating-layer primitive for interaction, positioning, teleporting, stacking and open state. Prefer Tooltip, Popover or Menu for end-user features; use Trigger directly when building another floating component. ## Basic examples ### Basic usage ```demo ../example/demos/basic.vue ``` ## Layout and arrangement ### Placement and arrow #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | `hover/click/focus/contextMenu/manual`, or an array | Placement and arrow | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Placement and arrow | | `popup-offset` | Outward main-axis distance | Placement and arrow | | `show-arrow` | Render the decorative arrow | Placement and arrow | ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ## Interaction and control ### Controlled state and offset #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | `hover/click/focus/contextMenu/manual`, or an array | Controlled state and offset | | `placement` | Preferred popup side relative to the trigger, default bottom. With the default auto-fit-position enabled, Trigger may flip and constrain it to the viewport when space is limited; this is not a fixed final position | Controlled state and offset | | `popup-offset` | Outward main-axis distance | Controlled state and offset | | `popup-translate` | Screen-axis translation or placement map | Controlled state and offset | `popup-offset` moves outward on the placement main axis. `popup-translate` adds a screen-axis x/y translation. The demo accepts requests through `v-model:open` and displays the parent's value. External controls update that value; Enter/Space activates the native trigger button, while Escape and outside clicks request closing. It does not demonstrate rejected controlled requests. Trigger is listed in the component menu so its right-side preview shows these demos instead of the home page. ```demo ../example/demos/controlled.vue ``` ## Triggers and positioning ### Popup placement placement is the preferred side; auto-fit-position defaults to true and can change the final side. It is not a position coordinate. top-start describes anchor placement and alignment, whereas top-left is a container corner. Top/bottom start and end mirror with reading direction; left/right remain physical, and vertical start/end remain top/bottom. ## Usage notes ### Configuration These are actual :root defaults. With Teleport, variables must be in the actual popup scope, for example through `popup-style`.
