`content` supplies popup `content`. Exposes `open()`, `close()`, `resize()`, `allowClose()`, `getReference()`, `setReference()`, `focusReference()`, `isTopLayer()`. ### Accessibility `trigger="focus"` supports keyboard focus; Escape closes only the topmost popup. Trigger does not define business `role`/ARIA relationships; semantic wrappers supply them. ## Native event modifiers on reference elements Native `click`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`, `focusin`, `focusout`, `contextmenu` listeners and `.once`, `.capture`, `.passive` modifiers bind to the actual reference element, not the popup. `.once` follows the native element's listener lifetime. Replacing a callback does not reactivate a consumed listener; replacing the reference or removing and readding a listener starts a new lifetime. Deactivation/unmount unbind listeners. Listeners only notify; returned Promises do not drive opening/loading, and errors enter Vue's event error chain. `aria-describedby` from `reference-attrs` is merged and deduplicated with existing reference descriptions; cleanup or reference replacement restores the original attribute. Fixed positioning uses the actual fixed containing block when an ancestor has a transform, filter, perspective, or containing CSS property. Axis-aligned scaling is accounted for; rotated or skewed coordinate systems are not guaranteed. For accessible same-origin iframe references, the reference and popup documents share coordinate conversion and event handling; cross-origin or unrelated browsing contexts are not supported. With `update-at-scroll`, scrolling either document or a scrollable ancestor updates the popup. ## CSS Variables Tooltip/Popover define arrow appearance themselves. Override their component variables rather than Trigger arrow-background. ### Reduced motion Built-in CSS transitions follow `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. Removing transitions does not change final visibility, selected/expanded state or event semantics. Applications control custom animations inside slots.

Repeated removal of a pending file invokes one hook. Cancel keeps the file; resolving after disabling also keeps it, and a fresh removal is required after re-enabling. Counters expose the list, pending tasks, hook calls and remove notifications. Deactivation/unmount settles local tasks without network requests. All extra controls are local. Reject removal rejects the pending Promise, keeps the file and allows a fresh attempt. Replace same UID file creates a new local File; an old confirmation must not remove that replacement. Reset upload queue invokes public reset without a late remove notification. Activate upload suspends/restores Upload through KeepAlive; the outer Demo keeps pending jobs for manual completion, whose old results must stay invalid after activation. Suspending Upload does not physically cancel external business Promises; leaving the whole Demo settles its local jobs. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/before-remove.vue ``` ### Preparation and cancellation races For cancellation plus total-size retry, prepare two items, cancel, then submit again: four jobs remain pending, including two obsolete attempts. Resolving all jobs starts only one valid request. The over-limit item retains its original file and canceled status; it is not counted as a new failure or automatically restored to ready. Remove the successful item and resubmit the remaining item to succeed. Obsolete preparation results consume no extra capacity. In the total-size example, a 600B replacement fits the individual limit, but two replacements exceed the 1024B total limit. One request starts; the other item retains its original file and reports max-total-size. Remove the successful item, then prepare the remaining item again to free capacity. Reset clears the queue and pending preparations. This example uses local generated files and simulated requests. “Prepare and submit” pauses before-upload; repeated submission does not duplicate the same attempt. Cancel and submit again, then resolve both preparations: only the current valid attempt starts a request. Text and oversized replacements are rechecked against the image type and 1 KiB size limit. Rejected items stay ready and can be retried with a valid copy. The demo uses public useUploader and immediate local requests. Resetting, deactivation and unmounting release pending preparations. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/prepare-request.vue ``` ### Async request metadata Configure a local receiver you control, then resolve headers and data separately to exercise the default XHR transport. Resolving only one does not send; cancel before resolving the other to prevent the request. The receiver can inspect `X-Demo-Upload`, `auditMarker` and the `attachment` file field; its response is shown below. The endpoint starts empty, with no external upload service configured. The receiver must allow the documentation origin through CORS. Only generated synthetic text is used. Use Reject headers / Reject data to fail a preparation: the current attempt becomes error once. Retry before settling the other old Promise to verify that its late result cannot overwrite the new attempt. Rejections after cancellation do not add errors. Resolve/reject buttons settle all pending jobs of that kind, including obsolete ones, to make races observable; reset drains pending jobs. A preparation rejection is not an HTTP error. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/metadata-request.vue ``` ### Delayed request handles The local custom-request returns a Promise. Return an old handle after cancellation to see abort called immediately; its late success cannot restore the canceled item. Cancel, start again, and return all handles and callbacks: only the current attempt succeeds once. Counters show callbacks accepted by the queue, not real transmission. No network is used; reset, deactivation and unmounting release local waits. ```demo ../example/demos/en-US/late-request.vue ``` ## Usage notes ### Editing and confirmation This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft. Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled. `before-commit(value, { previousValue, signal })` can reject an overlay save. FormItem validates the candidate first and keeps the editor open on failure. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. Use `#read="{ value, text }"` to customize display. See the full field comparison in Form. Attachment confirmation commits file-list relationships; it cannot undo completed remote uploads or permanent deletion. To defer network side effects, set `auto-upload="false"` and upload after the final business submission. `read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor. ### Replacing attachments and video duration `reupload` defaults to `false`. When enabled, each attachment has Replace, including at `max-files`. `replace(file, replacement?)` opens a single-file chooser when replacement is omitted or directly validates/proposes a supplied `File`. The replacement chooser respects request-choose/disabled/readonly and does not support multiple selection. New files pass before-add, before-read, accept, individual/total size/count checks, then before-remove. Count/total calculations subtract the old item. Canceling selection, validation/guard rejection or externally removed targets preserve the original. Accepted replacements use a new UID at the same position and emit `replace(next, previous)` plus `change`, without remove or server-deletion requests. Controlled parents decide acceptance. Acceptance invalidates old upload callbacks. Later upload failure displays an error/retry state without restoring the old file automatically. `UploadFileItem.duration?: number` is seconds. Finite nonnegative values display `mm:ss`/`h:mm:ss`; 0 displays `00:00`, unknown/invalid values remain hidden. Local video metadata waits at most 5 seconds and cleans temporary URLs/listeners/timers on success, failure, abort or unmount. Remote records may supply duration directly; reading it does not request remote videos. Text lists show duration text; image layouts show badges. | New entry | Type / default | | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | | reupload | boolean / false | | replace(file, replacement?) | `Promise`; a method completion, not successful remote upload | | replace event | next: UploadFileItem, previous: UploadFileItem; model proposal | | item slot replace | () => void; open this item's replacement chooser | | duration | Optional UploadFileItem duration in seconds | The complete-form example uses data-url to retain local attachment drafts across popup switches without temporary object URLs. Production uploads should store server URLs after success. The creating component/preview references still own object-url lifetimes. ### Async operation feedback Awaited before-* hooks show loading feedback and aria-busy. Rejection/failure restores interaction, and repeated input does not restart the same operation. Ordinary event return Promises do not participate. Files remain concurrent; feedback aggregates all current guard tasks without treating change/progress notifications as tasks. `useUploader()` exposes readonly `guardPending`, aggregating currently awaited before hooks. It does not represent upload progress. ### Preparation vetoes and exceptions `beforeUpload` returning `false` or resolving to `false` is a business veto: no transport starts, the item stays `ready`, and neither `error` nor `rejected` is emitted. Throwing or rejecting is a preparation failure: no transport starts, the item becomes `error`, and the existing `error(item)` event reports the original cause as `item.error` exactly once. This event covers preparation and transport failures; it does not imply an HTTP request was sent. Both outcomes permit a later submission with a valid hook result. Notification return Promises do not hold the preparation task open. Obsolete or canceled attempts cannot report a new `error`. ### Configuration Public variable suffixes match across platforms; all defaults appear below with c/mp prefixes respectively. ## API ### Empty values and reading placeholders `empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. disabled prevents interaction | | elevation / ripple | boolean or number / boolean | false / true | UploadFileItem requires uid, status and percent. name/size/type/file/url/thumbnailUrl/fit/response/error are optional. status is ready/reading/uploading/success/error/canceled/removed. ### Upload Events - update:model-value(files), change(files, changedFile?): queue proposal order; Form receives one change notification per change, including progress/state updates. - read(item): reading completed; business code may take over uploading. It does not indicate server success. - rejected(UploadRejectedFile[]): reason is accept/before-add/before-read/read-error/max-file-size/max-total-size/max-files. - exceed(nativeFiles, acceptedList): file-count limit exceeded. - progress(item,event?), success(item), error(item): active-request notifications. Stale/canceled callbacks have no effect. - remove(item): removal proposal after removal hooks accept it. - preview(item, UploadPreviewEvent): event.preventDefault() cancels built-in image/video preview. Programmatic previews are cancelable too; originalEvent is optional. ### Upload Slots - trigger({chooseFile,dragOver,disabled}): custom selection entry. Display-only content uses the wrapper button role and Enter/Space entry. Interactive custom content owns its keyboard behavior; the wrapper adds no button role or Tab stop. Bind the slot disabled value to your button. Calling chooseFile directly needs no .stop: bubbling does not choose again or also invoke requestChoose. Custom buttons relying on bubbling can still use requestChoose. Use requestChoose for asynchronous decisions, or synchronously call event.preventDefault() before awaiting and invoking chooseFile yourself. Click listener Promises are not collected. Each requestChoose callback selects at most once and expires on unmount or KeepAlive deactivation, even after reopening. - item({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace}): customize a whole file item. - remove-button({file,index,remove,retry,abort,replace}): customize removal actions. - read({value,text}): field reading content; value is the nullable file model and text is formatted content. This differs from the file-read completion event. ### Upload Methods Provides chooseFile(), replace(file,replacement?), submit(file?), abort(file?), retry(file), remove(file), reset(), clearSuccess(), clearError(), getFiles(status?), preview(file) and closePreview(). useUploader(options) provides headless upload logic, addFiles(files), and input/drag handlers. chooseFile, replace, submit, retry and remove return `Promise` for their preparation stages. submit/retry await preparation hooks and request-factory creation, without guaranteeing network completion; success/error events report results. chooseFile completion does not mean the user has selected a file, and remove completion does not mean a controlled parent accepted its proposal. Item/remove-button remove, retry and replace, and trigger chooseFile retain the same Promise types. All public methods are callable before the editor first mounts. When it is unmounted, closed or deactivated, getFiles(status?) returns shallow snapshots of the accepted model filtered by status; asynchronous mutations settle as no-ops and synchronous mutations are no-ops. To perform an operation, first open and mount the editor through field interaction or controlled open, or use editMode="direct". Stored method references forward to the current instance after closing/reopening; cancelling an editor preserves the accepted model. ### Controlled state and lifecycle If a controlled parent rejects an addition, only read/list proposals emit; automatic upload waits until that uid is accepted, then runs once. Same-tick proposals merge transactionally; across ticks, the actual parent list is authoritative. Rejected entries do not count toward total size. Parents own consistency of late list replacements. Explicit removal of rejected items, reset or unmount releases generated URLs; external URLs are never revoked. Built-in preview retains its own URL ownership until closing and does not close another component's later preview. Cancellation covers before-upload, asynchronous headers/data/name and asynchronous custom-request handles. Retrying or replacing a File under the same uid invalidates old callbacks. before-read/before-upload replacements recheck limits. max-total-size counts accepted entries and the current valid prepared batch/request only. Disabled/readonly block selection, removal, submission and other mutations; readonly allows preview/download. KeepAlive deactivation cancels preparation/requests; reactivation allows new operations. ## Types UploadProps、UploadEmits、UploadSlots、UploadExpose、UploadPublicMethods、UploadFileItem、UploadStatus、UploadListType、UploadResolveType、UploadImageFit、UploadCapture、UploadRejectedFile、UploadRejectedReason、UploadRequestOptions、UploadRequest、UploadCustomRequest、UploadProgressEvent、UploadData、UploadHeaders、UploadBeforeRead、UploadBeforeUpload、UploadBeforeRemove、UploadCreateThumbnailUrl、UploadIsSuccessResponse、UploadRequestChoose、UploadPreviewEvent、UseUploaderOptions、UploadInstance。 ## CSS Variables

## Reading direction

Inherits the nearest `dir="ltr|rtl"`, including runtime changes and local overrides. Verification codes are LTR content: rendering, pasting and focus movement use the original string order, while outer align start/end follows reading direction. RTL does not reverse code characters. Numeric and text codes share this order contract.

## Usage notes

### Editing and confirmation

This component supports `edit-mode` with field > FormItem > Form precedence. When unset, it defaults to `direct` and preserves `direct` editing. Supported values: `direct / popup`. Non-`direct` modes open the editor through the field value trigger and keep one draft; v-model updates only after confirmation. Cancel, reset or enabling readPretty discards the draft.

Maple uses edit-mode="popup" to open the editor when the value area is clicked; direct edits immediately. readPretty is a reading-only setting, independent of readonly and disabled.

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` can guard saving the editor. FormItem validates the candidate first; invalid candidates keep the editor open. `open / default-open / update:open` control the editor. `#read="{ value, text }"` customizes read content. See the unified field presentation examples in Form.

`read-pretty` is an independent boolean alongside `readonly` and `disabled`. It inherits from field to FormItem to Form; explicit `false` overrides the parent. The default is `false`. Reading mode renders no editor.
### Configuration

initial means no public override. CSS reads size fallbacks at the component element. Override through component style or theme.

## API

### Empty values and reading placeholders

`empty-values` recognizes empty data; `empty-value` keeps existing clear output. `empty-text` defaults to `'-'` under `read-pretty`, with Field > FormItem > Form precedence and custom read slots first. With explicit `empty-values`, built-in required uses the policy; custom validators receive original data. See the [shared guide](#/en-US/emptyValues).

| Prop | Type | Default and scope |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| empty-values | readonly unknown[] | Field > FormItem > Form > component-family default; replaces the whole list |
| empty-text | string | Field > FormItem > Form > '-'; explicit '' is valid |

These props belong to field presentation; pure panels do not gain reading mode. Form and FormItem provide inherited settings. The existing empty-value type and clear fallback remain component-specific.

Explicit null is a controlled empty code and never falls back to default-value, which applies only when model-value is absent. reset() still proposes an empty string. Presentation clearing can submit null through empty-value=null; finish never receives null. An omitted model-value remains uncontrolled.

In deferred mode input / paste describe editing, while finish describes the finally accepted complete value. Canceling, rejection, readonly, disabled, external replacement or unmount retires unaccepted completion notifications. Ordinary finish listener Promises do not hold confirmation. A synchronous undefined before-commit return waits for done. Invalid type / align values diagnose and fall back to digit / center; gutter=0 and 0px remain valid.

Valid input order: input → update:modelValue → change. finish waits until the parent accepts the complete value in that render. Rejected controlled values restore native inputs; later asynchronous parent assignments do not add finish. reset() proposes empty and emits update:modelValue/change without simulating native input. Disabled, readonly or composing state prevents reset from changing values.

Paste overwrites from the current cell; root-level paste starts at cell 1. Input beyond the first empty cell moves to that first empty cell. A whole-code native input distributes across subsequent cells. SMS suggestions depend on the platform and browser: Cedar hints one-time-code on the first cell, while Maple retains autocomplete=off for all cells. Typing one character in a filled cell replaces that cell even when the caret follows its old character. Composition prefers the current compositionend text, including multiple code points, and falls back to the native value only when event data is missing. Processing is type filtering, formatter, then length clipping; rejected characters consume no cell. Text counts Unicode code points rather than grapheme clusters. External values affect display without an automatic formatted model update.

### VerificationCode Methods

- focus(index?): zero-based index; defaults to the first empty cell or the last cell when full. Direct readonly fields can receive focus. Deferred mode opens an editable panel first; disabled, readonly, or reading fields do not open.
- blur(): blur the current editor without reopening the panel.
- reset(): in direct mode, propose an empty value while respecting controlled ownership, disabled/readonly state, and composition. In deferred mode, open an empty draft; model and change notifications wait for final confirmation and before-commit approval. Cancellation preserves the original value.

Public methods remain callable from initial component mount. Stored methods resolve the current editor on every call and never use an old input after closure, reopening, or mode changes. Native input references are undefined while no editor is mounted.

### Keyboard and Form

Left/Right move cells. Backspace removes the current character, or the previous one when empty. Delete removes the current character; following characters shift forward. IME composition does not trim/delete/move focus. Each native input has an SSR-stable id, and all cells use autocomplete=off. Provide aria-label.

InputGroup/Form state is inherited, with explicit disabled/readonly/error/size taking precedence. Internal cell Inputs do not duplicate Form notifications; the complete control notifies input/change once per edit. Both platforms implement three variants/five sizes using local FieldDecorator tokens.

## 使用说明

### 编辑与确认

通过 `edit-mode` 配置编辑方式；未指定时依次继承 FormItem、Form，默认 `direct`。支持值：`direct / popup`。非 direct 编辑模式通过字段值入口打开编辑面板，并维护单份草稿；确认后才更新 v-model，取消、重置或启用 readPretty 时丢弃草稿。

Maple 使用 edit-mode="popup" 点击值区域打开编辑面板；direct 直接编辑。 readPretty 为纯阅读属性，与 readonly、disabled 独立。

`before-commit(payload, done, context)` 可拦截弹层保存；FormItem 先校验候选值，失败保持编辑。`open / default-open / update:open` 控制编辑层。`#read="{ value, text }"` 可自定义阅读内容。集中示例见 Form 的“各类字段统一展示”。

`read-pretty` 为独立布尔属性，与 `readonly`、`disabled` 同级；字段 > FormItem > Form 继承，显式 `false` 覆盖父级。默认 `false`。纯阅读不显示编辑器。

Repeated toggling does not accumulate layers; unmounting removes that instance. ```demo ../example/demos/fullscreen.vue ``` ## Customization and slots ### Watermark spacing, offset and rotation #### Configuration reference for this comparison | Configuration | Purpose | Related examples | | --- | --- | --- | | `content` | One or more text lines; also used when an image fails | Watermark spacing, offset and rotation | | `gap` | Watermark gap `[x, y]` | Watermark spacing, offset and rotation | | `offset` | First mark offset; defaults to half the gap | Watermark spacing, offset and rotation | | `rotate` | Rotation angle | Watermark spacing, offset and rotation | Compare repetition gaps, origin offsets and rotation independently of image loading and fullscreen positioning. ```demo ../example/demos/geometry-comparison.vue ``` ## Usage notes ### Sizing and redraw - Supply two finite numbers for `gap` and `offset`; non-negative gaps are recommended. A negative gap is currently clamped to zero only for tile dimensions, while drawing and background offsets use the original value, so do not rely on negative gaps for overlap. Use finite positive values for `width`, `height`, `font.fontSize`, and `font.lineHeight`; rendered width and height are at least 1. `rotate` and `zIndex` should be finite. Invalid inputs are not guaranteed to be corrected; valid `alpha` values are finite and between 0 and 1. - The default `lineHeight` is `Math.round(fontSize * 1.4)`. Canvas parses the text color: `font.color` takes precedence over the computed color token. Supply a color supported by Canvas; CSS variable expressions are not guaranteed to resolve directly. Asynchronously loaded fonts do not trigger redraw automatically; call `redraw()` after they are ready. - Image load failures emit `error` and fall back to text when available; Canvas failures also emit `error`. `redraw()` returns a Promise and normally handles rendering failures internally. Older asynchronous results cannot overwrite the current layer or report errors after props change or unmount, but the underlying image request is not cancelled. The `default` slot is not drawn into the watermark image. ## API ### Watermark Props | Prop | Description | Type | Default | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `content` | One or more text lines; also used when an image fails | `string \| string[]` | `-` | | `image` | Image URL, preferred over text | `string` | `-` | | `width` | Mark width; measured from content by default | `number` | `-` | | `height` | Mark height; measured from content by default | `number` | `-` | | `gap` | Watermark gap `[x, y]` | `[number, number]` | `[90, 90]` | | `offset` | First mark offset; defaults to half the gap | `[number, number]` | `[gap[0] / 2, gap[1] / 2]` | | `rotate` | Rotation angle | `number` | `-22` | | `font` | Text style | `WatermarkFont` | `-` | | `z-index` | Layer z-index | `number` | `6` | | `alpha` | Overall opacity in the `0..1` range | `number` | `1` | | `anti-tamper` | Restore a removed or modified layer | `boolean` | `true` | | `grayscale` | Render in grayscale | `boolean` | `false` | | `repeat` | Repeat the mark | `boolean` | `true` | | `staggered` | Stagger repeated rows | `boolean` | `true` | | `fullscreen` | Cover the viewport | `boolean` | `false` | ### WatermarkFont Events | Event | Description | Prop | | --- | --- | --- | | `error` | Image loading or Canvas rendering failed | `{ source: 'image' \| 'canvas'; error: unknown }` | ### WatermarkFont Methods | Method | Description | Returns | | --- | --- | --- | | `redraw` | Regenerate the watermark from current props | `Promise` | ### WatermarkFont Slots | Slot | Description | | --- | --- | | `default` | Page content covered by the watermark | ## Types ### WatermarkFont | Prop | Type | Default | | --- | --- | --- | | `color` | `string` | `var(--mp-watermark-content-color)` | | `fontSize` | `number` | `16` | | `fontFamily` | `string` | `sans-serif` | | `fontStyle` | `'normal' \| 'italic' \| 'oblique'` | `normal` | | `fontWeight` | `string \| number` | `normal` | | `textAlign` | `CanvasTextAlign`
`'center' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'start'` | `center` | | `lineHeight` | `number` | `Math.round(fontSize × 1.4)` | ## CSS Variables The watermark reads its color from the computed CSS variable and redraws when a `class` or `style` change on the component or its current ancestors changes that color. Call `redraw()` after changes that cannot be observed, such as CSSOM or media query changes, or after moving it to a new ancestor. `anti-tamper` restores removal and class/style changes to the managed layer; it is not a security boundary.

# 水印 给页面或局部区域添加文字、图片水印。组件会自动响应属性和主题变化，无需手动刷新。 ## 基础示例 ### 文字水印 示例支持切换深浅背景、显示状态和水印文字；font.color 在深色底使用半透明白色，在浅色底使用半透明黑色。修改文字或颜色会重新生成水印。水印不拦截指针操作，内容按钮支持点击和 Enter；隐藏后重新显示只保留一层水印。 ```demo ../example/demos/text-watermark.vue ``` ## 内容与展示 ### 多行文本 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `content` | 单行或多行文字；图片加载失败时作为回退内容 | 多行文本、图片水印、全屏 | | `image` | 图片地址，优先于文字 | 图片水印 | | `width` | 单块水印宽度，默认按内容测量 | 图片水印 | | `height` | 单块水印高度，默认按内容测量 | 图片水印 | | `font` | 文字样式 | 图片水印 | | `fullscreen` | 是否固定覆盖整个视口 | 全屏 | ```demo ../example/demos/multiline.vue ``` ### 图片水印 “本地图片失败”使用无效的 data URL，触发 source=image 错误通知并回退为 FALLBACK 201 文字。按 Enter 激活“恢复图片”后恢复原图，错误记录保留，水印层仍只有一层。 ```demo ../example/demos/image-watermark.vue ``` ### 全屏 全屏水印固定覆盖视口，不拦截指针操作；退出后回到局部容器，默认插槽内容保持原位。重复切换不会累积水印层，卸载会移除该实例的水印。 ```demo ../example/demos/fullscreen.vue ``` ## 自定义与插槽 ### 水印间距、偏移与旋转 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `content` | 单行或多行文字；图片加载失败时作为回退内容 | 水印间距、偏移与旋转 | | `gap` | 水印间距 `[x, y]` | 水印间距、偏移与旋转 | | `offset` | 第一块水印相对容器的偏移，默认是间距的一半 | 水印间距、偏移与旋转 | | `rotate` | 旋转角度 | 水印间距、偏移与旋转 | 比较水印重复间距、起始偏移和旋转角度；图片加载与全屏定位保持独立。 ```demo ../example/demos/geometry-comparison.vue ``` ## 使用说明 ### 尺寸与重绘 - `gap` 和 `offset` 应为包含两个有限数的数组；建议 `gap` 非负。当前负间距仅在计算平铺尺寸时按 0 处理，绘制和背景偏移仍使用原值，因此不要依赖负间距实现重叠。`width`、`height` 和 `font.fontSize`、`font.lineHeight` 应为有限正数；宽高实际至少为 1。`rotate` 应为有限角度，`zIndex` 应为有限数。非法输入不保证自动纠正；`alpha` 的合法范围为有限的 0 到 1。 - `lineHeight` 未指定时为 `Math.round(fontSize * 1.4)`。文字颜色由 Canvas 解析：优先使用 `font.color`，否则使用计算后的颜色变量；应传 Canvas 支持的颜色值，不保证直接解析 CSS 变量表达式。异步字体就绪后不会自动重绘，可调用 `redraw()`。 - 图片加载失败通过 `error` 通知；有文字时尝试回退文字，Canvas 失败也通过 `error` 通知。`redraw()` 返回 Promise，正常情况下内部渲染失败会被处理；较早的异步结果在属性更新或卸载后不会覆盖最新图层或再报告错误，但底层图片请求不会因此取消。`default` 内容不会被绘入水印图片。 ## API ### Watermark Props | 参数 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `content` | 单行或多行文字；图片加载失败时作为回退内容 | `string \| string[]` | `-` | | `image` | 图片地址，优先于文字 | `string` | `-` | | `width` | 单块水印宽度，默认按内容测量 | `number` | `-` | | `height` | 单块水印高度，默认按内容测量 | `number` | `-` | | `gap` | 水印间距 `[x, y]` | `[number, number]` | `[90, 90]` | | `offset` | 第一块水印相对容器的偏移，默认是间距的一半 | `[number, number]` | `[gap[0] / 2, gap[1] / 2]` | | `rotate` | 旋转角度 | `number` | `-22` | | `font` | 文字样式 | `WatermarkFont` | `-` | | `z-index` | 水印层级 | `number` | `6` | | `alpha` | 整体透明度，范围为 `0..1` | `number` | `1` | | `anti-tamper` | 水印节点被移除或修改后是否恢复 | `boolean` | `true` | | `grayscale` | 是否灰阶渲染 | `boolean` | `false` | | `repeat` | 是否重复水印 | `boolean` | `true` | | `staggered` | 重复时是否错列 | `boolean` | `true` | | `fullscreen` | 是否固定覆盖整个视口 | `boolean` | `false` | ### WatermarkFont Events | 事件名 | 说明 | 参数 | | --- | --- | --- | | `error` | 图片加载或 Canvas 渲染失败 | `{ source: 'image' \| 'canvas'; error: unknown }` | ### WatermarkFont Methods | 方法名 | 说明 | 返回值 | | --- | --- | --- | | `redraw` | 按当前属性重新生成水印 | `Promise` | ### WatermarkFont Slots | 插槽名 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | `default` | 被水印覆盖的页面内容 | ## Types ### WatermarkFont | 参数 | 类型 | 默认值 | | --- | --- | --- | | `color` | `string` | `var(--mp-watermark-content-color)` | | `fontSize` | `number` | `16` | | `fontFamily` | `string` | `sans-serif` | | `fontStyle` | `'normal' \| 'italic' \| 'oblique'` | `normal` | | `fontWeight` | `string \| number` | `normal` | | `textAlign` | `CanvasTextAlign`
`'center' \| 'end' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| 'start'` | `center` | | `lineHeight` | `number` | `Math.round(fontSize × 1.4)` | ## CSS Variables 水印颜色取自组件计算后的 CSS 变量；组件及其当前祖先的 `class` 或 `style` 改变导致颜色变化时会自动重绘。通过 CSSOM、媒体查询等无法观察到的变化，以及移动到新祖先后，可调用 `redraw()` 更新。`anti-tamper` 仅恢复受管水印层的移除及 class/style 修改，不能作为安全防护。

# Dialog

`draggable` 开启时，标题中的 input、textarea、button、带 href 的链接和可编辑内容保留原生指针行为，不启动拖动；普通标题区域仍可拖动。非居中模式支持数字 `top=0`，与字符串 `0px` 一样表示距顶部零像素。

在当前页面打开一个浮层，承载相关操作。组件式与函数式 API 命名一致。

### 关闭守卫

`beforeClose({ action }, done, context)` 为统一入口，不新增另一套命名。


只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。


<demo src="./__demos__/guard-protocol.vue"></demo>


Promise 与 done 共用一次完成状态：`false` / `done(false)` 阻止，`true` / `done()` 允许；Promise<void> 正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。内容、标题与动作间距使用逻辑起止位置；外部弹层继承来源方向。关闭、确认、取消和未提交状态不因方向切换改变。

## 使用说明

### 异步操作反馈
before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

函数调用的通知回调不控制任务完成。服务的选择或关闭结果独立于回调异常结算，关闭完成时仍会清理所属宿主。异常继续通过调用方或 Vue 错误通道传递；回调返回 Promise 不控制 loading 或关闭。

### 拖动与取消
标题拖动只由发起手势的主指针控制。停用 `draggable`、关闭、进入全屏、丢失指针捕获或所属窗口失焦、停用以及卸载都会结束当前手势并释放监听和捕获。重新启用后需发起新手势，不会接续旧指针；停用保留当前偏移，全屏和原有关闭结束后的重置恢复默认位置。监听归属标题元素所在文档。

## CSS Variables

Dialog 的公开颜色变量与 Maple 同义：`--c-dialog-background` 表示浮层背景（`surface-raised`），`--c-dialog-overlay-background` 表示遮罩，`--c-dialog-title-text-color` 和 `--c-dialog-content-text-color` 表示主要内容，`--c-dialog-close-button-color` 表示次要操作；`--c-dialog-status-{info|success|warning|danger}-color` 对应可读状态内容色（content-info/success/warning/danger），不是状态填充色。业务主题优先覆盖这些组件变量，跨组件主题则覆盖相应的 system 变量。边框、宽度、间距和布局仍遵循桌面端规格。

遮罩通过 Dialog 组件变量消费 `sys-color-scrim`；Maple 不再借用 Popup 的遮罩颜色。实例遮罩变量可放在 `overlay-style` 上；放在面板 `dialog-style` 上的变量不会继承给兄弟遮罩节点。显式 `overlay-style.backgroundColor` 优先。Teleport 场景需要在实际 DOM 祖先作用域设置变量。暗色主题继承同一套颜色语义；几何保留平台差异。状态图标改用可读的 content 状态色。

变量按用途分组：background／overlay-background 是面板与遮罩；border-* 是面板或分隔线边框；title-* 是标题排版；content-* 是正文排版；actions-* 是操作区；close-button-* 是关闭按钮；status-* 是语义图标；simple-*／fullscreen-* 是对应模式的尺寸；animation-* 是入退场动效。width／margin-top 控制常规面板布局。内部拖动与定位变量不构成公开定制入口。

# Drawer

从容器一侧进入的桌面抽屉。Drawer 与 Maple Popup 共用同一套模态表面控制逻辑；标题、页脚、操作按钮和宽高仍是 Drawer 的桌面端能力。

默认头部中的 `title` 插槽通过稳定且唯一的标题 id 与对话框关联；函数服务的文字或渲染函数标题使用相同规则，多个服务不会复用标题 id。显式 `ariaLabel` 优先，普通 `title` 属性仍可提供名称。隐藏头部或提供完整 `header` 插槽时，不引用未渲染的标题，应显式提供 `ariaLabel`。

`DrawerConfig` 支持与组件相同的 `dir`、`ariaLabel`、`closeButtonAriaLabel`、`overlayAnimationName`，错误通知为 `onGuardError(error, action)`。修改守卫不会重新打开已关闭的抽屉。

## 关闭与异步控制

### 关闭守卫

`beforeClose({ action }, done, context)` 为统一入口，不新增另一套命名。


只记录日志的同步钩子应显式 return true；同步 undefined 表示仍在等待回调。注意：以前返回 `Promise<void>` 却不调用 done 的异步钩子，现在会在 Promise 完成后放行。


<demo src="./__demos__/guard-protocol.vue"></demo>


Promise 与 done 共用一次完成状态：`false` / `done(false)` 阻止，`true` / `done()` 允许；Promise<void> 正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。


守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason }`。context 提供 `signal` 和可选原始 `event`。返回 boolean/Promise，或调用 done()/done(false)；同步 void 等待 done，Promise<void> 放行。首次完成生效。等待期间自动管理 loading/disabled，取消后旧结果失效，不暴露内部按钮 refs。

## 阅读方向

继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。抽屉 placement 的 left/right 保持物理侧，进入/退出仍从对应屏幕边缘运动；标题、内容和底部动作继承阅读方向。方向切换不提交或清空内容。

## 使用说明

### 异步操作反馈
before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。

### Drawer Events

| 事件 | 说明 | 参数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:open | 可见状态请求 | `boolean` |
| confirm / cancel | 点击对应操作按钮并获准关闭 | `Event` |
| open / close | 开始打开 / 开始关闭 | - |
| opened / closed | 打开 / 关闭动画结束 | - |
| click-overlay | 点击当前最上层遮罩 | `MouseEvent` |
| key-escape | 当前最上层抽屉收到 ESC | `KeyboardEvent` |
| guard-error | beforeClose 抛错或拒绝时通知；保持打开并结束等待 | `(error: unknown, action: DrawerAction)` |

### Drawer Slots

`default`、`header`、`title`、`footer`。`footer` 获得 `confirm`、`cancel`、`close` 三个方法。

footer 的 confirm、cancel、close 和内置按钮、遮罩、Esc 都是守卫请求，走 beforeClose；实例 confirm()/cancel() 也走守卫。实例 close()、Drawer.open() 返回句柄的 close()、父级直接设置 open=false 是不经过守卫的关闭命令，用于业务完成或主动退出，不额外发 confirm/cancel。受控实例的 close() 仍只请求 update:open(false)，父级拒绝时不会强改模型。直接关闭会终止当前守卫并使迟到结果失效；close() 返回 void，不等待离场，完成请监听 closed/onClosed。

这一职责与两端 Dialog 一致。Maple Popup 的 close()/requestClose() 和外部模型关闭属于可等待的守卫请求，返回 `Promise<boolean>`；不要将它们当作 Drawer 的直接关闭命令。Popup 的直接销毁仍由父级掌握。示例的“直接关闭”保留退出入口，不修改“允许关闭”选择，也不会伪装成守卫批准。

### 命令式调用

`Drawer.open(config)` 使用 camelCase 的同名配置，例如 `cancelButtonText`、`beforeClose`、`closeOnRouteChange`。通知事件使用 `onConfirm`、`onCancel`、`onOpen`、`onOpened`、`onClose`、`onClosed`、`onClickOverlay` 和 `onKeyEscape`。

```ts
import type { DrawerAction, DrawerConfig, DrawerProps } from '@cedar-design/ui'
```

## CSS Variables

内置淡入和四方向滑动在 `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` 下关闭过渡及起始位移。自定义动画需由业务适配减少动态效果的偏好。

面板 bg 使用 surface-raised；overlay-bg 使用 sys-color-scrim；header-text-color／content-text-color 使用 content-primary，关闭按钮与标题共享 header-text-color；border-color 使用 border-default。几何、动效与层级保留 Drawer 既有默认值。Drawer 是 Cedar 平台组件，不在 Maple 创建空壳同名变量。

overlay-style 可设置实例遮罩变量，drawer-style 可设置面板内变量；两者是兄弟节点，变量不会互相继承。全局主题在实际共同祖先设置 system 变量。显式背景属性优先于变量消费。

正常完成允许。重复完成只生效一次，异常触发 guard-error，取消或卸载后迟到结果无效。此类关闭/确认回调同步返回 void 时保留原回调协议，等待 done。 守卫统一使用 `(payload, done, context)`：关闭 payload 为 `{ action }`，切换和提交为 `{ value, previousValue }`，Popup 为 `{ reason `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。内容、标题与动作间距使用逻辑起止位置；外部弹层继承来源方向。关闭、确认、取消和未提交状态不因方向切换改变。 ## 使用说明 ### 异步操作反馈 before-* 等待期间显示加载反馈并标记 aria-busy；拒绝或失败后恢复，重复提交不再启动同一操作。普通事件返回的 Promise 不参与加载。 `dialog-style` 上的变量不会继承给兄弟遮罩节点。显式 `overlay-style.backgroundColor` 优先。Teleport 场景需要在实际 DOM 祖先作用域设置变量。暗色主题继承同一套颜色语义；几何保留平台差异。状态图标改用可读的 content 状态色。 变量按用途分组：background／overlay-background 是面板与遮罩；border-* 是面板或分隔线边框；title-* 是标题排版；content-* 是正文排版；actions-* 是操作区；close-button-* 是关闭按钮；status-* 是语义图标；simple-*／fullscreen-* 是对应模式的尺寸；animation-* 是入退场动效。width／margin-top 控制常规面板布局。内部拖动与定位变量不构成公开定制入口。

# Menu 菜单 用于收纳针对当前对象的临时命令，例如更多操作、右键菜单和按钮的附加操作。选择表单数据请使用 [Select](#/zh-CN/select)；选择层级数据请使用 [Cascader](#/zh-CN/cascader)。 使用 `placement` 设置弹出方向，默认 `bottom`；`cover` 控制是否覆盖触发元素。通过 `auto-fit-popup-width` 使菜单与触发元素同宽，`popup-max-height` 限制菜单高度。 ## 基础示例 ### 更多操作 使用默认插槽传入触发元素，通过 `options` 定义命令。`type: 'divider'` 渲染分隔线。 ```demo ../example/demos/overflow-actions.vue ``` ## 外观与状态 ### 禁用状态 `disabled` 加在菜单上禁用整个浮层，加在选项上只禁用该项及其后代。 ```demo ../example/demos/disabled-state.vue ``` ## 选项与层级 ### 分组、子菜单与选项内容 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `options` | 命令树 | 分组、子菜单与选项内容、选中与视觉强调 | | `hide-on-select` | 激活命令后关闭浮层 | 选中与视觉强调 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 选中与视觉强调 | 比较平级分组、层级菜单和自定义选项内容。展开子菜单或选择选项，观察各自的数据层级；受控选中与外部定位独立展示。
配置说明与使用限制 #### 选项分组 在 `options` 中使用 `{ type: 'group', children }` 分组，不需要额外的分组组件。分组只负责视觉分隔，不增加子项层级。 #### 多级菜单 带 `children` 的普通选项自动成为子菜单。所有层级的子菜单共用 `submenu-trigger`，移动端默认点击展开；改成 `'hover'` 时同样对所有层级生效，不能逐项配置，避免同一棵菜单里出现两种展开方式。 #### 自定义选项内容 选项的 `label`、`icon`、`extra` 都支持文本、VNode 或接收 `{ option, active, level }` 的渲染函数。需要统一渲染整组数据时，使用 `option-label`、`option-icon`、`option-extra` 作用域插槽。 `active` 只表示当前选项自身是否匹配菜单的选中值。选中子项时，父分支的 `active` 仍为 `false`；后代选中及展开状态只用于组件内部的路径强调，不作为渲染参数公开。根 Menu 使用 `modelValue/defaultValue` 控制选中值、`open/defaultOpen` 控制展开。`MenuOption` 的视觉强调统一使用 `highlight`，不会改变选中值。
```demo ../example/demos/structure-comparison.vue ``` ### 选中与视觉强调 对比渲染函数、作用域插槽和手写 MenuOption。父分支可以有选中路径样式，但 active 仍为 false；highlight 也不会把选项变成选中值。 ```demo ../example/demos/active-rendering.vue ``` ### 选项值 动态增删或调整选项顺序时，为每个命令设置稳定且唯一的 `value`。数字 `0`、字符串 `'0'` 和布尔值 `false` 是不同的选项值。 ## 触发与定位 ### 右键菜单 #### 本组配置对照 | 配置 | 作用 | 相关示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `trigger` | 根菜单触发方式 | 右键菜单、触发方式 | | `options` | 命令树 | 右键菜单、定位策略 | | `align-point` | 按触发时的鼠标坐标定位；打开后保持该位置，再次右键时更新 | 右键菜单 | | `placement` | 浮层相对触发元素的首选方位，默认 bottom；启用默认的 auto-fit-position 时，空间不足会自动翻转并约束到可视区域，不保证最终停在该侧 | 弹出方向 | | `strategy` | 根菜单及全部子菜单的定位策略 | 定位策略 | | `submenu-trigger` | 各级子菜单的展开方式，对所有层级统一生效 | 定位策略 | 在目标区域内点击鼠标右键触发，需要同时设置 `trigger="contextMenu"` 和 `align-point`。菜单固定在本次右键触发的位置，移动鼠标不会改变位置；再次右键时才更新定位点。 ```demo ../example/demos/context-menu.vue ``` ### 与 SplitButton 组合 [SplitButton](#/zh-CN/split-button) 已封装按钮与下拉命令菜单的组合，并通过 `MenuOption` 定义附加操作。 ### 触发方式 ```demo ../example/demos/trigger.vue ``` ### 弹出方向 使用 `placement` 设置菜单相对触发元素的首选方位，可选值见 Menu Props。空间不足时允许自动调整，最终位置可能与首选方位不同。 ```demo ../example/demos/placement.vue ``` ### 定位策略 根菜单和各级子菜单响应式使用同一 `strategy`，默认 `absolute`，可选 `fixed`。切换策略不会改变激活值或主动关闭菜单。`popup-container` 独立控制挂载位置；`fixed` 不保证脱离 transform 祖先的包含块。 ```demo ../example/demos/positioning.vue ``` ### 高度限制 ```demo ../example/demos/popup-max-height.vue ``` ### 切换触发元素 点击另一个由悬停打开的同级触发元素时，会关闭原菜单；点击子菜单内部不会关闭父菜单。 ## 状态与内容定制 ### 选中值与 select 事件 可使用 `v-model` 管理当前激活值。激活命令时先触发 `update:model-value`，再触发 `select(value, option, event)`；`select` 表示激活菜单项，不表示表单值变化。 ```demo ../example/demos/selection.vue ``` ### 受控打开状态 ```demo ../example/demos/controlled.vue ``` ### 页脚 ```demo ../example/demos/footer.vue ``` ## 阅读方向 继承最近的 `dir="ltr|rtl"`，支持运行时切换与局部覆盖。子级沿阅读方向展开；进入子级与返回父级的左右键跟随当前方向，上下键与首尾定位保持顺序并跳过禁用项。挂载到外部容器的菜单继承来源方向，切换方向不改变选中值。 ## 键盘操作 在触发元素上按 Enter、Space 或方向键进入菜单。菜单内使用上下键、Home/End 在可用选项间移动，Enter 或 Space 激活选项。前进方向键进入子菜单，后退方向键返回，方向随阅读方向变化。Escape 请求关闭最上层菜单，关闭后焦点返回触发元素。Tab 请求关闭并继续浏览器焦点导航；可编辑输入保留文本编辑按键。 ##
